articleTitle: Optimized Insect Classification on Farms using Tuned Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective classification of farm insects plays a critical role in agricultural pest management. This paper introduces a refined convolutional neural network (CNN) model that enhances the capability of pre-trained models for the task of insect classification. Leveraging advanced architectures such as ResNet-50V2 and Xception, we modified these models to better suit our specific classification needs. Our investigation not only includes a comparative analysis of these pre-trained models but also explores the influence of various hyper-parameters on model performance. Experimental outcomes demonstrated that while the pre-trained models achieved classification accuracies of $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 3 \%}$ for ResNet-50V2 and Xception respectively, our tailored model significantly outperformed these by securing a $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$ accuracy rate on a dataset comprising 15 different classes of farm insects. Moreover, our model exhibited a notable reduction in overfitting, illustrating its robustness and effectiveness in insect classification. This research work paves the way for more empirical and efficient computational intelligence approaches in the use of deep learning for agricultural applications.

articleTitle: Investigating Fuzzy Time Series for Hyper Spectral Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fuzzy Time collection (FTS) is a machine learning technique for temporal statistics that makes use of fuzzy common sense and a rule-based method to pick out styles in facts series. FTS may be used for picture popularity obligations with the aid of applying time series strategies to the temporal domain of photograph facts. This research examines the utility of FTS in recognition duties for hyperspectral image facts. Hyperspectral images seize records from the infrared, seen and ultraviolet spectral bands, which may be used to discover scene functions and gadgets within the photograph. The examine specializes in two responsibilities: spectral anomaly detection and the identity of subsections of the picture for hyperparameter optimization. To acquire these duties, two FTS-primarily based classifiers, the fuzzy Time class Tree and the fuzzy Time series affiliation guidelines, are supplied and evaluated. Results display that each strategies are able to improve present classical processes and can also doubtlessly be utilized in other popularity duties inclusive of video evaluation and item detection.

articleTitle: Empowering Production Optimization with Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are discriminative supervised getting-to-know fashions used for both classification and regression tasks. They are broadly used for information mining and predictive analytics due to their powerful accuracy, potential to address high dimensional records, and robustness to outliers. This paper discusses the usage of SVMs for reinforcing the efficiency and effectiveness of production optimization. Particularly, it investigates the performance of SVMs in predicting and optimizing production yield effects over a ramification of industries primarily based on enter traits related to manufacturing. Based on the outputs, SVMs can identify relevant factors related to yield predictions and be used to gain insight into potential methods to improve production efficiency or yields. In addition, the paper shows that with well-adjusted parameters, SVMs can create generalizable models that (in turn)can be applied to various industries and situations.

articleTitle: Observer-based Time Varying Linear Quadratic Control of Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the past few years, the modular multilevel converter (MMC) has seen extensive application in the highvoltage sector. The MMC is composed of multiple similar submodules. To ensure the optimal functioning of the MMC, it is imperative to maintain a balance between the voltages of the upper and lower arms of the capacitor. Additionally, it is essential to suppress the alternating current components of the circulating current. In this paper, an observer-based timevarying linear-quadratic control approach that has timevarying feedback gains for achieving stable and voltagebalanced operation while simultaneously decreasing the ac components of the circulating current. An observer is used to estimate the state variables of the MMC system, such as voltages and currents, which are not directly measurable, has been investigated. The simulations were conducted utilizing a single-phase half-bridge Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) comprising ten submodules [1]. The results of both the theoretical study and the simulation are provided and discussed here. The simulation results confirm the efficacy of the suggested control approach.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning for Early Detection of Brain Tumors
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to leveraging device-getting techniques for early detection of brain tumors. It describes a system that can detect brain tumors through the use of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans and pc-aided classification fashions. The paper discusses a complete method consisting of extracting capabilities from MRI scans of patients laid low with a brain tumor, deciding on a suitable ML set of rules, and training a multi-magnificence class model. The version is then used to classify new MRI scans as either healthful or having benign or malignant tumors. The experiments show that the proposed model changed into able to achieve an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$ for detecting brain tumor cases. The outcomes endorse that leveraging machine mastering is a feasible and cost-effective method for the early detection of mind tumors.

articleTitle: A Combined Deep Learning Approach for Pusa Gourd Classification in India
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Classification of crops is vital for improving yields and provision of food items through agriculture. In India particularly, the identification of bottle gourds, with more emphasis on varieties like Pusa Samridhi, Pusa Naveen, Pusa Meghdoot, and Hybrid 1 is of much value to the farmers and agricultural scientists. This paper presents a new combined deep learning model for these bottle gourd varieties classification applying convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN) deep learning models for the best accuracy. The CNN component is employed to extract features from the images of the bottle gourds in terms of the pattern and the texture of the skin while the RNN is used in the processing of the features to model the temporal analysis and sequence data for better classification results. The proposed CNN-RNN hybrid model shows enhanced accuracy in identifying all the various kinds of bottle gourd, which is quite higher than the conventional methods of classification. This work is a major contribution to the agricultural technology domain, as it presents a practical and accurate approach for crop classification that can be applied to other types of crops, thereby contributing to the development of precision agriculture and enhancement of crop selection in India.

articleTitle: Examining the Challenges in Implementing AIDriven Systems for Automated Data Science
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

articleTitle: Password Strength Checker Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The security of sensitive data heavily depends on the strength of user passwords. Traditional password regulations often fail to provide strong security against modern threats due to easily guessed or reused passwords. This paper presents a novel machine learning-based method for assessing password strength using algorithms that analyze various factors such as length, complexity, entropy, and patterns. Our methodology was tested on a diverse dataset, demonstrating a $20 \%$ improvement in password strength estimation accuracy compared to traditional heuristic-based methods. The proposed system, implemented on a web application, utilizes machine learning techniques like Decision Tree (DT), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Random Forest (RF) to categorize passwords into Weak, Medium, and Strong. This approach ensures real-time feedback, aiding users in creating secure passwords.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Different Power Factor Correction Topologies
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Power Factor Correction (PFC) is important to minimize harmonic distortion and maximize power efficiency in AC-DC converters. This research performs a comparative analysis of three widely employed PFC configurations: Boost PFC, Totem Pole Bridgeless PFC, and Interleaved Totem Pole PFC with MOSFET line rectification. Also, the closed-loop control method of these converters is explained to ensure the extraction of a distortion-free sinusoidal current from the grid. Using MATLAB Simulink and by considering parasitics in each of the converters, the study evaluates their performance metrics including Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), input power factor, and efficiency. Additionally, an analysis of incorporating a boost pre-charge diode into the Interleaved Totem-Pole PFC circuit is presented.

Author Keywords: interleaved totem-pole PFC with MOSFET line rectification

articleTitle: Study of Digital Image Compression Techniques and Framework for Suitability Selection based on Similarity Measuring Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, capturing and transmitting color images through the network to convey visual information in a short time has become a crucial task. Choosing the appropriate compression technique is a challenging endeavor due to technological advancements with inccrement of the memory usage. Various lossless and lossy image compression techniques have been developed over the years. However, the studies pertains to a lack of extensive assessment across various compression algorithms and metrics, necessitating a practical comparative analysis of existing methodologies for color image optimization in graphical representation and storage. Hence, a comprehensive comparative study is conducted on six types of lossless compression techniques (Huffman, RLE, LZW encoding, JPEG2KLeGall53, PNG, WebP) and six types of lossy compression techniques (JPEG-DCT, SVD, K-means, JPEG2K-CDF97, PNG, WebP), evaluating their performance based on input parameters for compresion such as quality factor, selection of singular values, and number of clusters. The outputs are analzed followed by the extracted parameters such as compression ratio (CR), time, RMSE, PSNR, SSIM, FSIM, and bpp to determine the best case of compression. Furthermore, a weighted Friedman ranking test is conducted to determine the most effective compression technique. It is concluded that JPEG2K-CDF97 is optimal for lossy compression, while WebP is considerable for lossless compression.

articleTitle: Automated Virtual Toll Booth System Based on Number Plate Recognition Using YOLOv8 and EasyOCR
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this work, a virtual toll booth system utilizing cutting-edge technologies like EasyOCR with optical character recognition, or OCR, and YOLOv8 for object detection is introduced. By connecting the accounts stored in a database with vehicle number plate recognition, the system is meant to streamline toll collection procedures. By using this technique, the system may efficiently handle toll transactions without the need for actual toll booths or human involvement. The registration of car number plates as well as owner data, which is kept in a database based on CSV files, is the first step in the system’s process. The system’s camera takes a picture of the license plate when a car gets close to the toll station. After that, the image is processed using the EasyOCR engine to extract the information from the number plate and the YOLOv8 algorithm to determine whether a car is present. An extra toll is charged if the license plate is within a set distance of the toll booth and matches a registered number in the database. The toll amount, the date and time of the transaction, the vehicle’s license plate, and other transaction details are all stored in the database by the system. There is no toll if the registration number is not found or is found outside of the predetermined range. Comprehensive testing was used to assess the system’s performance, and the results showed that it could recognize license plates and manage toll transactions with high accuracy. The results show that the system can increase the overall efficiency of toll management systems, reduce operational expenses, and speed up toll collection procedures.

articleTitle: Welded Joint Performance Analysis through Mechanical and Thermal Property Prediction with Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The research conducted in this study utilizes a comprehensive dataset that incorporates various materials, welding procedures, and climatic variables in order to train the Random Forest model. Our objective is to conduct a full evaluation of the performance of welded joints, specifically for their applicability in certain applications, by integrating predictions of both mechanical and thermal properties. The Random Forest model exhibits amazing predictive skills, allowing for accurate estimation of crucial parameters such as tensile strength, impact toughness, and thermal conductivity. This methodology not only optimizes the assessment of welded joint efficacy but also mitigates the necessity for significant and laborious physical experimentation. Our research findings emphasize the significance of a number of factors, such as welding parameters, base material selection, and joint shape, in determining the performance of joints.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Analysis of a 350kW Solar Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The 350 kW rooftop solar plant at REVA University Premises exceeds goals, serving as a sustainable energy role model. It showcases practical solar technology benefits, encourages others to follow. Solar rooftops provide hands-on learning, research opportunities for universities, saving costs, reducing environmental impact, engaging communities, and promoting sustainable practices. They decrease emissions, decrease reliance on fossil fuels, contribute to community sustainability, and improve financial stability. Solar energy creates jobs and promotes renewable energy adoption. The presence of 350 kW solar rooftops holds significant importance in terms of sustainability, economic feasibility, and technological advancement in the field of energy. Solar power is vital for the upcoming phase of energy production and utilization.

articleTitle: Prediction of Small Molecules Binding Site with RNA as a Target
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: RNA are essential biomolecules and are potent drug targets, as many small RNA molecules are known to play significant roles in many disease pathways. Predicting drug binding sites in RNA molecules is thus an essential step towards RNA-based drug discovery. Several previous works have focussed on sequence-based and structure-based features to predict binding sites in proteins and RNA. The low availability of RNA-small structures is a bottleneck for predictive model performance. We show that using an atomic-level feature set instead of residue-level feature set, increases the dataset size and can help build a promising model using a dataset of smaller size, which is the primary concern in RNA-Small molecule complexes. We focus on a rich set of physio-chemical, structural information, and dynamic features at the atomic level. Lastly we use a voting scheme to predict the small molecule binding sites for RNA. K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Decision Tree and Random Forest models performed well with MCC values above 0.5. Among them, Random Forest performed best with an MCC of 0.78, and an accuracy of 0.89.

articleTitle: Enhancing Text-to-Image Synthesis with Higher Fusion Powers in Deep Fusion GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Text-to-image generation is crucial in domains like computer vision, computer-aided design, and security. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models are widely used for this task, but GANs often struggle with effectively merging text and image features. While architectures like DF-GAN have advanced this field, further improvements are necessary. Our research enhances text-to-image fusion techniques in GANs by evaluating higher power affine transformations. Experiments on the Caltech-UCSD Birds (CUB) dataset show that these transformations improve image quality, achieving a $14 \%$ better FID score compared to baseline DF-GAN. We systematically evaluate various fusion technique configurations and analyze the relationship between higher power fusions and key metrics such as Inception Score (IS) and Frechet Inception Distance (FID), demonstrating their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Embedding Advanced Security Protocols to Enhance EMC in Networking Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Embedding advanced security protocols into networking systems is vital for offering business enterprise-grade Mutual Confidentiality (EMC) within a given network. Safety protocols must be designed to prevent sensitive records from being accessed, altered, or disclosed at some stage in their transit across a network. Particularly, those protocols must include strong encryption strategies, comfy key trade and authentication mechanisms, and active chance detection and reaction skills. By enforcing superior safety protocols into the framework of a network, groups can ensure that their data stays exclusive throughout all levels of the network and that malicious actors are not able to breach it. Additionally, EMC will assist corporations in meeting regulatory requirements while making sure that their statistics are nicely covered.

articleTitle: Finding Interesting Patterns in Massively Large Scale Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Large scale records has emerge as the norm in companies, and the potential to identify styles and traits within this statistics has come to be increasingly necessary for ensuring a success operations. This paper examines the usage of various records mining techniques to perceive meaningful styles in massive datasets that can be used to inform strategic decisions. It starts off evolved via discussing the function of data mining in figuring out styles and trends, and the way it’s far used to draw conclusions from statistics. It then outlines a ramification of facts mining strategies together with clustering, class, affiliation evaluation, and anomaly detection, and presents particular examples of ways they’re used. The paper additionally gives a top level view of numerous datasets usually used for locating charming patterns and explains how those datasets are represented and analyzed. In the end, it concludes with realistic tips for running with massive statistics units and highlights the challenges related to large records.

articleTitle: Unmasking Sarcasm: Content-Based Detection and Interpretation of Sarcastic Expressions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Detecting personal intentions or opinions from text, particularly identifying sarcasm, irony, and non-literal language, poses a significant challenge in natural language processing. Sarcasm, with its contextual and nuanced nature, requires an understanding of linguistic cues and situational context. In this study, we propose a methodology for sarcasm detection that fine-tunes the pre-trained BERT model using a large dataset of annotated sarcastic expressions. By leveraging BERT’s rich contextual embeddings, we effectively capture the subtle linguistic features indicative of sarcasm. Our approach employs a content-based strategy, utilizing BERT’s contextual embeddings to identify sarcastic intent within sentences or utterances. We then train a Bi-LSTM model to map these embedded sentences to sarcasm and non-sarcasm labels. Experimental results show that our model achieves an accuracy of $94.5 \%$, with precision, recall, and F1-score all exceeding 0.95. Furthermore, qualitative analysis demonstrates the model’s ability to accurately identify and interpret sarcastic expressions across various contexts and linguistic styles. Our method, based on advanced deep-learning techniques, represents a significant contribution to sarcasm detection. It lays the groundwork for more accurate and robust models in natural language understanding tasks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) Using Electroencephalography
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article proposes a Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) detection system based on EEG and machine learning techniques. The first step involves pre-processing the EEG signals to eliminate unwanted artifacts and enhance their quality. To extract features, the Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) technique is employed, which provides a time-frequency representation of the brain activity. Feature selection is performed to determine the most relevant and discriminative features for classification, using Select K Best and Mutual Information Regression techniques. The Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HistGradientBoost) and Light Gradient Boost Machine algorithms are used to compare and choose the best algorithm for classification. Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HistGradientBoost) yielded an accuracy of $\mathbf{7 5. 6 6 \%}$ followed by Light Gradient Boost Machine which gave an accuracy of 75.62%. The proposed system seeks to classify EEG patterns with precision, distinguishing between states indicative of PTSD and those that are not. This effort aims to advance the development of more precise and effective diagnostic tools for PTSD. Extensive experimentation and evaluation on a suitable dataset are conducted to assess the effectiveness and reliability of the approach. Analyzed in different environments like indoors with infrastructure, and the same communicated to the caretakers through IoT.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Concrete Strength Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study assesses machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, GS-SVR, Multiple Linear Regression, and AdaBoost, in predicting compressive strength of concrete in construction. Utilizing a diverse dataset with feature-enhanced variables, the research aims to provide insights into model performance regarding accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. The dataset is split for unbiased evaluation, and algorithms are selected for their diverse strengths. Random Forest captures complex relationships, GSSVR handles non-linearities, Multiple Linear Regression serves as a benchmark, and AdaBoost explores boosting potential. Performance metrics like MSE, R-squared, Absolute Percentage Error, MAE, and RMS assess model accuracy and efficiency. Results offer information into algorithm strengths and constraints, assisting practitioners in the model selection process. The study contributes to machine learning in construction materials science, providing practical guidance for precise concrete strength predictions and enhancing the quality of infrastructure.

Author Keywords: Support Vector Regression with Grid Search (GS-SVR)

articleTitle: Smart Bridge System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bridge Load Testing can answer many of the questions about the behavior of the bridge which cannot be answered by direct observations. At present, most of the bridges in India were constructed according to the British planning which are oldest planning and contain many limitations. These bridges have to be tested otherwise they may lead to major destruction. But Bridge Load Testing is not an easy task it requires more human involvement. So, we want to solve this aspect by creating a new interface to get the readings of the Bridge Load Test continuously without human involvement. Our main aim is to create a mobile app that is used to connect the IOT device which measures the Strain levels of the bridge and transmits the readings to the user. The behavior of the bridge is predicted by the Stress levels of the bridge, which cannot be calculated directly. So, we first calculate the Strain levels of the bridge and by using strain we can able to calculate the stress levels of the bridge. With the help of those readings, we can able to predict the condition of the bridge, and based on those readings further tasks, and measurements are taken to stop the destruction of bridges in advance. The failures of the bridges lead to major accidents. So, we want to create a mobile app using Flutter to find the readings of the bridge obtained by the Bridge Load Test as our project.

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning to Strengthening Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cyber safety threats have become a central problem in the contemporary world, with hackers constantly finding new approaches to make the most systems and users to gain unauthorized admission. Gadget learning has been determined to be a promising approach to combat these threats, considering the improvement of state-of-the-art algorithms capable of detecting malicious activities in near real-time. Through supervised studying, neural networks, or other sample popularity techniques, these algorithms can learn how to locate malicious conduct and lift an alert to take appropriate countermeasures. Additionally, device getting to know can be used to identify new threats and recognize formerly unknown flaws in present defenses, allowing them to be patched or upgraded promptly. Given the ever-converting nature of the cyber security landscape, gadget studying programs are worthwhile for staying ahead of the curve and retaining information secure.

articleTitle: Secure spectrum sensing in CRNs: A study on SSDF attacks and countermeasure using USRP
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs), the Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol is essential for managing dynamic spectrum access among secondary users (SUs) without disrupting primary users (PUs) transmissions. The MAC protocol’s decisions are based on the availability of spectrum bands determined through spectrum sensing (SS). To improve SS efficiency, SUs collaborate to detect unused spectrum bands more accurately, reducing false alarm rates and enhancing SS reliability. However, cooperative SS is vulnerable to Spectrum Sensing Data Falsification (SSDF) attacks, compromising SS integrity and affecting MAC protocol decisions. An ElGamal-based digital signature (EGDS) algorithm is used to authenticate SS information and protect against unauthorized access. Using digital signatures, SUs can securely authenticate spectrum access requests and messages, mitigating unauthorized access and tampering risks. The EGDS algorithm ensures the authenticity and integrity of communication between SUs and the spectrum access system. This approach detects modifications post-signature generation, maintaining SS reliability and enabling MAC protocols to make better decisions on token distribution and spectrum access in CRNs. Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) devices are utilized to demonstrate SSDF attacks and showcase vulnerabilities and countermeasures.

articleTitle: Ensuring Web Page Layout Integrity: A Study on Verification and Accessibility
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Modern internet requires the integrity of its pages to secure trust and functionality. The concept of web page integrity is explored in this research, with a focus on how verification and accessibility intersect. This article outlines some existing verification methods like digital signatures and hash functions that ensure unaltered content. Similarly, we analyze how user confidence and seamless browsing are supported by accessibility standards as well as best practices.This paper studies conflicts between strict certification measures and accommodating features for people with disabilities. It also suggests approaches to fill in this gap where secureness can blend with inclusiveness on the internet site. Research further delves into how emerging technologies like blockchain, and decentralized web protocols affect web page integrity. Lastly, possible future directions for studies in this critical area are given.

articleTitle: Botanical Distinction: Classifying Basil Types in India with CNN and Random Forest - An Advanced Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study looks at how different kinds of basil in India are grouped using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Random Forest (RF) models. The research with 12,500 clear images of three types of basil (Purple Basil, Sweet Basil, and Genovese) uses a mixed model to separate features by CNN. This is then followed up using a Random Forest for final classification. The data is split into three parts: training (74%), checking(13%) and testing (13%). The finished model works well and is 97.96% correct in telling different kinds of basil popular in India apart from each other. These measures focus on the model’s balanced performance with few mistakes during classifications. This makes it a top choice for classifying different types of basil plants. This research helps with farming by making sure things are sorted out for growing and keeping safe. It also promises to help in medicine and cooking, letting people pick special kinds of basil that can be used differently from one another. Future projects can work on checking that the model works well with different data sets. They also need to find ways of making it easier for people to understand what’s happening, so everything is clearer and more open. This study gives a good start to use machine learning in sorting plants. It helps classify different kinds of basil growing in India very well.

articleTitle: Herbal P-glycoprotein Inhibitors Enhance Bioavailability of Cardioprotective Drugs – An In Silico Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Background: The efficient treatment of cardiovascular diseases may face challenge owing to the presence of an efflux transporter p-glycoprotein in the cardiac tissue, which plays pivotal role in limiting the penetration of allopathic medications into target cell, thereby contributing to drug resistance. Objective: This study is aimed at identifying herbal inhibitors of p-glycoprotein which would enhance the intracellular concentration of co-administered drugs and potentially improve their therapeutic outcomes. Materials and Methods: The study encompassed assessment of druggability and pharmacokinetic attributes of herbal compounds. Additionally, their binding affinity with 6C0V structure of p-glycoprotein was examined through molecular docking utilizing CDOCKER program within Discovery Studio. The stability of the resulting docked complex was verified using molecular dynamics simulation. Results: The herbal inhibitors viz., palmatine from Tinospora cordifolia, arjunone from Terminalia arjuna, pareirubrine A from Cissampelos pareira, have been identified as best interacting molecules against p-glycoprotein, demonstrating strong binding efficacy. Conclusion: These therapeutic herbs if used in conjunction with allopathic drugs, are expected to play crucial role in circumvention of drug efflux and serve as potential candidates for amelioration of cardiovascular diseases. The lead compounds hold promise for exploration through in vivo experiments and subsequent clinical trials, aiming to complement medical treatments effectively.

articleTitle: A Reliable High Impedance Fault Protection Technique using Variational Mode Decomposition and Subspace KNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to their small magnitude, conventional relays in the microgrid system cannot recognize high impedance faults(HIMFs). Adding distributed generators(DGEs) to the extant microgrid system also affects the relay performance as the current subsidy from the grid decreases. This paper proposes a HIMF detection technique by Variational mode decomposition(VMD) incorporating DGEs and fault classification techniques based on the Subspace KNN classifier. The methodology separates the HIMF from no-fault switching cases. Residual power obtained from the grid side is processed through VMD, and the intrinsic mode functions(IMFs) obtained are utilized to classify the HIMF. The Subspace KNN classifier differentiates the HIMF from no-fault cases with better accuracy, precision index, recall index, and $\mathbf{f 1}$ score. The proposed methodology is verified using PSCAD/MATLAB.

articleTitle: The Role of 5G Communication in Facilitating Health Care Management Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The 5G conversation generation has emerged as an important enabler for healthcare transport fashions. As 5G networks make bigger into health centre settings, the functionality advantages of the usage of 5G verbal exchange to enhance healthcare control models have emerged. 5G communication can help the efficient and comfortable shipping of virtual fitness offerings, particularly for folks who rely upon actual-time statistics. It includes enhancing affected person care and the manipulation of scientific records. 5G also can permit some distance-off monitoring of an affected individual’s fitness, lowering the need for in-person visits and physical touch with healthcare companies. Further, the 5G-enabled conversation offers a platform for increasing healthcare efficiencies, bearing in mind extra nicely timed and cost-powerful delivery of clinical services. With its high bandwidth and low latency, 5G conversation generation can help the seamless transmission of vital medical statistics through disparate assets, which complements the accuracy of diagnoses and remedies. The upward thrust of the 5G communication holds the promise of a more inexperienced and customized healthcare shipping and management model, main to stepped-ahead affected person effects.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for GDP Forecasting: Enhancing Economic Projections in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: GDP is an important metric for measuring economic performance, directing policy decisions, simplifying investment decisions, and assessing social wellbeing. GDP prediction is important for a country’s future development. GDP prediction is critical for shaping economic policies, directing company strategy and affecting financial market performance. Machine Learning with its sophisticated techniques can easily assist in predicting the GDP of any country according to the previous yearly dataset. In this study, machine learning techniques are applied to forecast Bangladesh’s GDP in the coming years based on data spanning the previous 43 years. The dataset is collected from Wikipedia and the World Bank. The dataset has nine features and the GDP is highly dependent on these features. Machine learning algorithms like Linear Regression, Random Forest, AdaBoost, KNN, Decision Tree, Lasso are used in this research and the best performing model is always the KNN for all alpha values with the accuracy of 98.40% go along with Random Forest, Decision Tree, AdaBoost, Linear Regression and Lasso with the accuracy of 95.80%, 95.32%, 95.05%, 90.78% and 67.14% respectively.

articleTitle: VR Enabled Solar/Wind Microgrid for Enhanced Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This publication presents a pioneering initiative of establishing a virtual microgrid to bridge the educational divide and address energy challenges in rural communities. Leveraging virtual reality (VR), and energy management systems (EMS), the virtual microgrid integrates renewable energy sources, energy storage systems, virtual control station, and interactive learning student labs. Adoption of Virtual reality in learning environments can help facilitate teaching and learning in environments which are not physically accessible to students and teachers. Through immersive virtual interactions, students and community members in remote areas access enriched educational experiences and interactive simulations. This paper showcases the successful implementation of a virtual microgrid, highlighting its transformative impact on education and rural development. It sheds light on the technical aspects of the virtual microgrid, the design of immersive learning experiences, and the socio-economic benefits achieved. The lessons learned and best practices shared in this study can serve as a valuable guide for similar initiatives globally, empowering communities, and promoting equitable access to education and energy for sustainable development.

articleTitle: Phishing Attack Detection Using MapReduce and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Phishing attacks, where tricksters try to get personal details by deceit, are getting more sophisticated. Such type of attacks become very common these days. articleTitle: Bengali Sign Language Detection using Deep Learning Techniques

abstract: Hand gesture recognition has emerged as a pivotal domain within the expansive field of computer vision, offering diverse applications extending beyond traditional boundaries. The importance of robust hand gesture recognition systems cannot be overstated, from facilitating seamless interpretation of sign language to enabling intuitive human-computer interaction. This study explores the intricacies of hand gesture recognition through a meticulous evaluation of various state-of-the-art deep neural networks. By examining the performance of ResNet50, ResNet101, ResNet152, Densenet121, DenseNet169, DenseNet201, Inception, and Xception architectures, we aim to uncover the subtle nuances that underlie their effectiveness in interpreting complex hand gestures. Central to our investigation is a carefully curated dataset designed to encompass the diverse range of hand gestures found in Bengali sign language. By leveraging this extensive dataset, we strive to ensure the inclusivity and relevance of our findings, catering to the linguistic and cultural nuances of diverse communities. By thoroughly analyzing our experimental results, we endeavor to shed light on the strengths and weaknesses of each neural network architecture. Beyond academic inquiry, our research carries profound implications for societal progress and inclusivity. By improving the accuracy and reliability of hand gesture recognition systems, we aim to transcend mere technological innovation and pave the way for greater societal equity and accessibility. Our endeavor transcends the boundaries of academia, catalyzing transformative change. We strive to usher in a more inclusive and accessible world where communication barriers are dismantled and individuals are empowered to express themselves freely, regardless of auditory impairments.

articleTitle: EES-RPL: Energy Efficient Secure-based RPL OF for IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) framework is the richest network that provides interconnection to different devices or objects to exchange their information with each other without human intervention. These devices are resource-constrained and have a limited transmission range to communicate over the network. For this reason, low-power and lossy networks (LLNs) have been introduced for effective communication. This network uses the RPL (IPv6 Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks) for data transmission based on objective functions. The standard Objective Functions (OF) of RPL are OF0 and MRHOF which suffer from low security and more energy consumption due to the use of a single metric to calculate the rank of the node. These OFs are not suitable for many IoT applications. To mitigate these issues, we proposed an energy-efficient objective function with a trust-based Intrusion Detection System (EESRPL) to provide defense against sinkhole attacks. The suggested work use the fuzzy weighted sum model for calculating the path cost by considering the ETX, energy, and trust value of each node to select the best parent. The performance analysis of the proposed work, EES-RPL compared with the default OF of RPL, MRHOF, and existing algorithm CAFOR in terms of packet loss rate, energy consumption, latency, and average network throughput. The simulation results show that the EESRPL outperforms the existing works.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Lossless and Lossy Data Compression & Source Coding

abstract: This paper investigates the use of lossless and lossy records investigates and supply coding strategies for the compression of records and the coding of supply symbols. Similarly, the paper examines how some exclusive measurements may be used to evaluate the high quality of the information compression. The paper then explains the source coding techniques, along with run-period codes, Golomb codes, and commonplace codes, and gives an analysis of the way they can be used to reduce the scale of source symbols. In the end, the paper gives a top-level view of the sphere of statistics compression and supply coding and provides tips for further studying for those interested in further exploring the topic.

articleTitle: A novel Approach for optimizing the crop yield by considering climatic and soil features through fusion of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The agricultural sector is the scientific and artistic cultivation of plants and animals. Agriculture has an important role in India’s economy, which covers a significant 60.45% of the country’s land and stands as the world’s second-largest agricultural sector, driving economic growth through its diverse produce and associated industries. Soil composition really matters for growing stuff. Elements like Nitrogen, Phosphorous, & Potassium play a big role. The way you rotate crops, soil moisture, and even temperature all affect how well things grow. Rainfall is important too. Research has shown that using machine learning can help figure out the best crops to grow. They utilize methods that include Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for this. The study also looks into deep learning methods to make the model even better. In addition to predicting crop yields, it also provides detailed information on the required amounts of soil elements and their associated costs. The new model offers superior precision compared to the current one. The system examines the provided data and assists farmers in forecasting a crop, which subsequently aids in achieving financial gains. The prediction of a suitable yield takes into account the meteorological and soil parameters of the area. This Python-based system utilizes advanced algorithms to optimize decision-making, forecasting the most lucrative outcomes in various situations while streamlining costs and boosting productivity. The study employs Support Vector Machines (SVM) as an example of Machine Learning (ML) method, while Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are used as Deep Learning (DL) techniques.

articleTitle: A mathematical model for optimal scheduling of classes in a higher education institution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Timetabling is essential for the organization and functioning of higher education institutions (HEIs). This complex task requires balancing various factors such as availability of teachers, availability of halls, huge number of students in each specialty and course, preferences and satisfaction of students and teachers (agents). Although it may seem like a routine administrative activity, the compilation of a timetabling is indeed a multi-criteria task and requires the use of algorithms and optimization methods. The aim of the timetabling is to ensure the optimal distribution of learning activities in time and space, ensuring efficient use of resources, priorities and meeting the needs of all participants in the learning process, namely the agents. A properly designed timetabling not only contributes to improving the academic success of the students but also facilitates the work of the teachers and administration of the university. In this context, the development of mathematical models and computer systems for the automated compilation of timetabling is crucial for the modern management of the educational process. These tools not only optimize the process of composing timetabling, but also provide opportunities for adaptation to changing needs and conditions in HEIs.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection using CNN with attention mechanism of Transformer model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Driver drowsiness is a major threat to road safety, causing innumerable accidents globally. To effectively detect and analyze driver drowsiness, we employ a multi-stage approach leveraging the MediaPipe Face Mesh model and deep learning techniques. We apply a transformer attention mechanism in conjunction with convolutional layers to capture both spatial and temporal characteristics of the extracted facial features. This hybrid deep learning architecture allows for enhanced feature extraction and attention modeling, providing a thorough analysis of the driver’s state. We train and assess our model using the YAWDD dataset. By combining the robust facial landmark detection capabilities of the Face Mesh model with the powerful feature extraction and attention mechanisms of the proposed deep learning framework, our system can accurately identify driver fatigue. This comprehensive methodology ensures reliable drowsiness detection, ultimately contributing to improved road safety.

articleTitle: Optimizing Forwarding Strategies in Sparsely Delay-Tolerant Networks with Short Contact Durations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Delay-tolerant networks (DTNs) are specific settings that experience either instability or the absence of a complete path between the source and destination nodes. The contact lifetime between pairs of network nodes is constrained by the mobility of nodes and the restricted bandwidth of peer- to-peer wireless transmission. In sparsely delay-tolerant networks, the re-establishment of contact between pairs of nodes is significantly delayed beyond the duration of the initial contact. Hence, the need for careful thought in designing a buffer control forwarding policy arises due to the limited contact period. Although forwarding algorithms have been designed extensively, much research has not been done on forwarding when there is a short contact time. When the message exchange between the pairs of network nodes is not completed during the contract period, they must wait until they are within communication range once more. To tackle the issue, we have suggested an innovative forwarding policy in buffer management that considers the duration of interaction. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed effort, we utilized the Opportunistic Network Environment (ONE) networking simulator. The suggested approach is combined with the MaxProp routing protocol buffer control forwarding policy and evaluated using two distinct metrics: bundle delivery rate and average delivery delay. In addition, we evaluated the performance of the suggested work by considering the number of nodes, buffer size, and simulation time. Across all the trials conducted in this thesis, the simulation results consistently demonstrate that our suggested method beats the existing forwarding strategy.

Index Terms: Pairs Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Observational Study of the impact of profanity in Aggression Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent times with profuse usage of social media for communication and emotional content sharing, the need for effective control measures is required to prevent irrelevant and aggressive messages. The opprobrium of aggressive and offensive tweets, post and messages on the cyber platform is alarming. At times profane words are used to express the gravity of the aggressive emotions. The profane language dictionary varies with cultures and time periods. Our study focuses in observing the impact of profanity in social media texts for aggression classification. It calculates the frequency of profane words used in a text and analyses how the empirical findings help in classification of aggressive cyber texts from non-aggressive ones. The model presented in this study is simple and not computationally demanding. It uses a background corpus of profane words in English language and calculates the frequency of their occurrence in the text using unigram, bigram and trigrams. Along with this the intensity of the profane words is computed as a vector. After this novel feature extraction, it is passed to a Dense Neural network along with the word embeddings from the text for classification of aggressive texts. The empirical evidence suggests that reliance on profanity to identify aggressive texts may not be trustworthy. However, when compared with past studies on the subject our proposed model achieved much better results with a recall of 98%.

articleTitle: An Explainable Hybrid Learning Model for Indian Food Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As the prevalence of diet management applications continues to rise for personal health tracking, the need for accurate food image classification becomes paramount. While various food classification models exist, understanding and categorizing Indian cuisine remain challenging. Although, deep learning models provide state of the art performance, they lack interpretability in terms of identifying the significant features that lead to accurate classification. In this paper, we propose an Explainable AI backed classification model specifically tailored for Indian food images. We explore the efficacy of multiple deep features learned through standard CNN architectures in conjunction with machine learning algorithms for Indian food classification. In this regard we observe that the features learned from InceptionNet and MobileNet provided superior performance of around 89% with SVM as the classifier. Further we leverage Explainable AI frameworks such as SHAP and LIME to provide insights into the model’s decision making process. Through SHAP summary plots we provide understanding of the important deep features contributing for enhanced classification and LIME provides heatmaps that highlights the significant patches in the input image which contributed to the decision.

articleTitle: Enhancing Software Development with CCC: A Robust Tool for Code Complexity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research introduces the Code Complexity Calculator (CCC), an advanced tool designed to measure software code complexity effectively by integrating the Improved CB (ICB) metric. Acknowledging the growing intricacy of software systems, the CCC addresses the need for accurate and reliable complexity measurements, overcoming the limitations of existing tools which often suffer from inconsistencies and unreliable metrics. By incorporating factors such as inheritance, type and nesting of control structures, statement size, threads, compound conditions, and recursion, CCC offers a detailed complexity analysis, fostering a deeper understanding of software structures and facilitating improved software development practices. The tool’s application extends beyond simple analysis, empowering developers to manage and optimize software systems efficiently, thus enhancing overall software quality and maintainability.

articleTitle: Shielding Solutions: Evaluating Active PPE’s Efficacy Against Airborne Covid-19 Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study focuses on the integration of Engineered Nano Water (ENW) with smart personal protective equipment (PPE) systems to provide proactive protection against airborne dangers. The integrated system integrates aerosol detection technology, smart PPE activation mechanisms, precise ENW dispensing capabilities, and direction recognition technology to provide real-time detection and neutralization of airborne COVID-19 transmission. The results show exceptional sensitivity and accuracy in detecting airborne particles, with a detection rate surpassing 95%. The smart PPE activation mechanism responds quickly to detection, activating protective measures within milliseconds. The ENW dispenser provides accurate flow and direction control, ensuring that the protective layer is distributed optimally. Direction identification technology improves targeting accuracy, obtaining a directional precision of 98%. Also, the ENW layer effectively neutralizes identified pollutants, with a deactivation rate of over 99%. These findings highlight the system’s resilience in offering proactive protection against airborne COVID-19 transmission, which has tremendous promise for improving public health and safety measures in various contexts.

articleTitle: UNDERGROUND CABLE FAULT DETECTION USING IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proposed system is meant to solve the problem of accurately finding problems in underground cable lines, especially in cities where these lines are common. Using an Arduino microcontroller kit and a power source that has been connected, the system uses current measuring circuits that are connected to the microcontroller’s built-in Analog to Digital Convertors (ADC) device to get a precise reading of the wire length in kilometers. Switches are used to mimic faults, and relay circuit to controls the relays. A 16x2 Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) screen shows problem details in real time. The environmental possibilities like rain, underground pollution, drain leakage etc may cause short circuit faults in the underground cable. Various faults may occur in underground cable; this paper focuses on locating short circuit fault. The location of the short circuit fault is sensed as a voltage changes across the resistor and the distance is calculated from the source fed point and ADC digitizes it to display on the LCD. With the help of Wi-fi module 8266 the fault location details are stored in the cloud for further analysis. This lets the proposed Arduino microcontroller design to show exactly where the fault is (in kilometers) from the base station. A buzzer warning also lets field workers know that they need to take action right away if a fault happens. This novel method is a reliable and effective way to find and spot problems in buried cable lines. This makes servicing easier and cuts down on downtime.

articleTitle: Examining the Efficiency of Various Classification Algorithms in Spam Detection Datasets

abstract: This study investigates the relationship between the accuracy of Machine Learning (ML) models used to differentiate between Spam and Normal Messages for different dataset sizes. Efficiency evaluation of four classification models (Decision Tree, Passive Aggressive, Random Forest, and Regression) using 1500, 3000, and 5500 samples from three distinct dataset sizes is performed in this paper. The primary objective is to determine how variations in dataset size impact these models’ accuracy. This work not only quantifies performance shifts but also offers insights into how responsive these models are to changes in data amount through careful experimentation and analysis. These findings enhance understanding of ML model behaviour in identifying unwanted messages and provide practical guidance for selecting and configuring models based on available dataset sizes. They also help to improve the design of trustworthy and accurate categorization systems.

articleTitle: Detecting Mental and Cognitive Decline Using Diffusion Tensor Imaging

abstract: Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI) is a noninvasive, high-resolution imaging technique used to determine the microscopic residences of tissue through the use of an exam of the guidelines and costs of water diffusion in the brain. DTI reveals the fibers of white count inside the mind and has been used to research the decline of cognitive and intellectual health. DTI permits researchers to pick out adjustments in mind hobby and employer resulting from age, disorder, injury, or intellectual issues. By means of reading these adjustments, researchers can diagnose disorders like Alzheimer’s early and track the development of illnesses greater correctly, as a result offering the opportunity to increase more powerful interventions. In those cases, DTI may be used to discover thinning of specific white remember tracts or modifications in the intra-and inter-connectivity inside specific mind structures. It is able to additionally be used to reveal the outcomes of treatments on the brain and degree modifications within the white matter. Additionally, DTI can display important changes in brain development or decline in intellectual or cognitive health. The information from the DTI scans can then be combined with different to be had clinical records to create complete fashions for know-how of mental and cognitive decline.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accuracy and Prediction of Novel Convolutional Neural Networks Compared over ResNet Algorithm in Predicting Student Career Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our primary objective is to enhance the accuracy of student career prediction using Novel Convolutional Neural Networks (NCNN) as compared to the ResNet technique. This study compares the performance of two groups using a training and testing split: one group uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) with ten participants, and the other uses the ResNet algorithm with ten participants to forecast the future careers of high school students. The Gpower test, using the values α=0.05 and power=0.85, yields around $85 \%$. The accuracy of NCNN ($88.9400 \%$) is higher than that of the ResNet method ($84.8800 \%$). On top of that, to make sure the results were statistically significant, we calculated a $95 \%$ confidence interval. In this case, the significance values are 0.009 (p<0.05). The findings indicate that NCNN outperform the ResNet method in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploring Dynamic Analysis of Electromagnetic Compatibilities of Network Topologies

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Approach for Malware Analysis

The suggested methodology uses feature extraction, dataset curation, and model deployment to improve malware detection capabilities by utilizing machine learning methods. The solution that is being suggested has the ability to extract all features from malware samples, including both dynamic and static properties like API calls and file structures. articleTitle: Advancements in Automotive Power Electronics: A Novel Split Inductor Based Buck-Boost Converter for Enhanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Power electronics is widely used in many different fields, such as semiconductors, renewable energy systems, telecommunication, Aerospace, and hybrid electric vehicles. Since power electronics are essential to hybrid electric vehicles, it is crucial that power electronics technology advances as well. This article proposes a revolutionary fifth-order buck boost converter to address the difficulties and the latest developments in the DC-DC converter sector. The voltage transfer ratio of the converter has been determined by the application of Time-Domain analysis. Using state space analysis, the converter’s dynamic performance is evaluated. In order to facilitate additional investigation, a state-space averaged model has been created that assesses the transfer function for the suggested converter. Using MATLAB and the Ziegler-Nichols method for PID tuning, a control scheme has been designed for the output voltage regulation. To test and confirm the functionality of the converter under certain limitations, a simulation test model is built to buck from 24 to 12V and boost from 24 to 48V, 45W ratings to verify the converter’s steady-state and dynamic performance under specific conditions using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Human Pose Detection And Classification Using Movenet With Spatiotemporal Data

abstract: The evolution of human pose detection has seen significant growth with the development of numerous algorithms and the availability of vast datasets. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) algorithms offer diverse insights and prediction methodologies, contributing to the precision of pose detection rates. In this study, the focus is on analyzing the performance of the MoveNet algorithm in human pose detection. The MoveNet algorithm excels in extracting human pose keypoints from 17 locations on the body, including ears, eyes, nose, shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees, and ankles. Utilizing these detected keypoints, the algorithm estimates the human pose by generating predictions on the images.To enhance the computational efficiency of the model, the MoveNet algorithm is integrated with spatiotemporal data. The incorporation of spatiotemporal data elevates model accuracy by providing related images of the same event. Subsequently, the performance of the model is evaluated using standard metrics. This innovative approach opens new frontiers for exploring the relationships between human actions and their underlying intentions. The study contributes to the field by introducing a novel methodology that combines the MoveNet algorithm with spatiotemporal data, offering a promising avenue for improved human pose detection.

articleTitle: Applying Sentiment Analysis for Automatic Content Summarization

abstract: Sentiment analysis is an effective technique for computerized content material summarization, allowing computer systems to research the emotion of a huge frame of text in an effort to create a précis. This method may be used to create summaries of social media posts, news articles, and other kinds of textual content. In this paper, we discover how sentiment evaluation enables computer systems to automatically generate summaries, via studying the sentiment of every sentence and then the usage of this statistics to pick out the most applicable sentences for inclusion within the précis. We talk diverse methods for text sentiment category, consisting of supervised or unsupervised, and examine their performance. We additionally talk the importance of context whilst building a summary, and display how incorporating this concept into the summarization manner can improve the quality of the summary. We then gift a case look at summarizing a web-primarily based opinion article, and discuss a number of the challenges faced in summarization and capability answers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Patients Privacy in Healthcare Records with Blockchain Technology

abstract: Healthcare record administration faces many obstacles, including data manipulation, security vulnerabilities, and the risks associated with centralized storage. To securely store and manage health records, we provide an innovative system that uniquely combines blockchain technology with the Interplanetary File System (IPFS). In contrast to conventional methods, our strategy makes use of a private blockchain network that was created in collaboration with Ganache to establish a decentralized ledger that guarantees data integrity and immutability for each and every transaction through cryptographic security. This system is unique in that it uses IPFS for decentralized file storage, which makes it possible to distribute and retrieve big medical records quickly and efficiently while safeguarding sensitive data from single-point failures. Our front-end interface, created with Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, offers a user-friendly experience for both patients and healthcare professionals. Furthermore, the blockchain network and IPFS are smoothly integrated into our Node.js-built backend. The shortcomings of traditional health record management systems are addressed by this special combination, which improves security, accessibility, and transparency. Our technology protects the security and confidentiality of sensitive medical data while promoting interoperability and collaboration among healthcare stakeholders.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Scalable Routing Protocols for Large-Scale Communications

abstract: This paper proposes an evaluation of scalable routing protocols for huge-scale communications. Especially, it focuses on the two most important training of scalable routing protocols: distance vector routing algorithms and link-nation routing algorithms. Via simulation, the paper examines the scalability of these protocols for a ramification of big-scale verbal exchange topologies, together with hierarchical, mesh, hub-and-spoke, and digital personal network architectures. It evaluates their overall performance metrics, which includes route price and stop-to-end development time. articleTitle: Riddance of Weed Using an Agri-Robot Employed by Arduino and ESP32 CAM

abstract: This article presents the enhancement of a weed detection robot designed to automate the identification and riddance of unwanted vegetation in agricultural fields. The robot integrates a suite of hardware components, including an ultrasonic sensor, Arduino microcontroller, ESP32 CAM, robotic hand, L293D motor driver, battery, power supply module, Bluetooth module, and DC motor for locomotion. The DC motor is utilized to drive the wheels of the robot, enabling it to traverse the agricultural terrain efficiently. The ultrasonic sensor facilitates obstacle detection, ensuring safe navigation through the field while avoiding collisions. Meanwhile, the ESP32 CAM captures visual data of the surroundings, which is processed by machine learning algorithms to identify and classify weeds. Upon identifying weeds, the robotic hand, controlled by the Arduino microcontroller via the L293D motor driver, is deployed to remove the unwanted vegetation. The Arduino microcontroller acts as the central processing unit, orchestrating the operation of all components and executing decision-making algorithms. Additionally, the inclusion of a Bluetooth module enables remote monitoring and control of the robot, providing farmers with real-time updates on weed infestation levels and operational status. The weed detection robot offers a solution for weed management in agriculture and obtained 97% accuracy, promising increased crop yields and reduced labor costs through efficient weed riddance.

articleTitle: Role of Capsaicin as an algesic agent to evoke cardiogenic rectal responses
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Background: Heart failure due to Myocardial Ischemia is a major cause of death all over the world. The clinical presentation of this heart failure is often associated with different signs and symptoms like nausea, vomiting, urge to urinate, and passing of stool.Objective: The present study is undertaken to find out the neurophysiological basis of defecatory urge by applying a traditional algesic agent, capsaicin on the epicardial surface. The study thus may help in the management of cardiac ischemia-induced heart failure.Methods: The experiments were carried out on anesthetized, open-chested, and artificially ventilated cats of either sex. The capsaicin dissolved in physiological saline was applied on the epicardial surface and the motility of the rectum was recorded in intact, vagotomised, and sympathectomised animals.Result: Local application of capsaicin over the epicardial surface of the left ventricle caused a sustained contraction of the rectum which was totally abolished after desensitization of ventricular receptors by epicardial application of lignocaine. Bilateral vagotomy failed to abolish such response but sectioning of the left inferior cardiac nerve (LICN), arising from stellate ganglia, completely abolished such rectal response.Conclusion; From these observations, it is apparent that capsaicin can act as an algesic agent to elicit the cardiorectal reflex and the afferent pathway for such reflex is lying in the cardiac sympathetic nerve.

Author Keywords: Rectal response induced by epicardial capsaicin

Firstly, we introduce a pioneering multilingual misinformation dataset, spanning English and Hindi, developed from scratch to address the scarcity of resources in low-resource languages. Secondly, we propose an effective neural model that leverages Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) and mixture of 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1DCNN) and BiLSTM to identify fabricated information across languages. In a world where the accuracy of truth is constantly challenged by misinformation, our system emerges as a steadfast guardian, bolstered by innovative methodologies and linguistic inclusivity. publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article demonstrates techniques for enhancing the gain of a dual-band THz antenna based on metallic radiators. Operating in both fundamental and second-order modes, the antenna emits radiation in conical and biconical patterns. Reflective frequency-selective surfaces (FSS) were developed and incorporated with the antennas to increase the gain. According to the study’s findings, using a broadband FSS produces the best outcomes. As a consequence, a broadband FSS is put into practice and coupled with the antenna, increasing gain in the lower and higher bands by 0.8 and 2 dBi, respectively.

articleTitle: Techniques for Minimizing Bandwidth Bottlenecks in Wireless Networks for Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wi-Fi networks can face electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) issues due to bandwidth bottlenecks., various strategies were evolved to limit the bandwidth constraints while growing the throughput of Wi-Fi networks. These strategies vary from channel get admission to protocols, dynamic channel challenge schemes, and superior medium get entry to manage (MAC) protocols to radio resource management schemes (RRM) and active interference cancellation (AIC). Properly implementing those strategies can result in stepped-forward conversation overall performance and more advantageous network throughput. This paper presents a top-level view of the different strategies to reduce bandwidth bottlenecks in Wi-Fi networks, focusing on EMC. An analysis of the most enormous advocated techniques proposed for mitigating the clash between the electromagnetic environment and technological constraints is provided. In the long run, it’s proposed that after being carried out synergistically, strategies such as channel get right of entry to protocols, dynamic channel allocation schemes, RRM, and AIC protocols can enhance the throughput of Wi-Fi networks while keeping electromagnetic compatibility.

articleTitle: An improved visual reality experience for gaming applications using visual image processing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital and augmented truth has increased in recent years, with several packages in various industries. Gaming is one such industry that has benefitted significantly from those technologies, supplying customers with an immersive and interactive revel. But there’s nevertheless room for improvement, especially in visible photograph processing. Cutting-edge digital and augmented fact systems depend upon pre-rendered three-D picks, which could bring a lower fine and much less realistic visual experience. This is especially obtrusive in rapid-paced gaming packages, where photographs may appear pixilated or need more elements. To deal with this difficulty, our research proposes an advanced visual fact enjoyed by gaming applications using superior visible picture processing techniques. Our method mainly includes the realtime processing of visual data to create exceptional realism in the digital environment. This may encompass strategies, texture mapping, dynamic lights, and superior rendering algorithms.

articleTitle: Methodology for Determining Proper Tyre Pressure
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents the design & implementation of a Tyre pressure monitor system (TPMS) utilizing a BMP280 sensor for automotive applications. The TPMS is composed of a transmitter unit installed in tyre and receiver unit mounted inside vehicle. The transmitter end consists of a BMP280 sensor, a microcontroller, and control buttons. It continuously measures the tyre pressure and temperature, transmitting the data wirelessly to the receiving unit. The receiver unit comprises a microcontroller, a display screen, LED indicators, and a buzzer for alerts. Upon receiving data from the transmitter, the receiver displays tyre pressure and temperature readings in display. Experimental results demonstrate the functionality, accuracy, and reliability of the proposed TPMS, providing timely alerts to drivers, thereby enhancing vehicle safety and performance.

articleTitle: Classification of 5G Spectrum Sensing Signals Based on Visual Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The availability of spectrum for wireless communication has become a precious and costly resource in recent times due to the congestion of the spectrum with multiple applications. Hence, spectrum sensing can facilitate the optimal utilization of the spectrum paving the way for reliable communication. In this work, a spectrum sensing algorithm using a deep learning approach is presented. In recent times, deeper architectures trained on massive datasets are available and suitable for various scenarios such as image classification, object detection, Image segmentation, and visual question and answer. Received signals are usually contaminated with noise and it is difficult to differentiate between the signals and noise at low SNRs. One-dimensional data is converted to two-dimensional images (spectrograms) and the image embeddings are obtained from the deeper architectures. The spectrum sensing problem is mapped as an image classification problem in this scenario. The deeper architectures used in this paper are Contrastive Language Image Pre-trained models. The problem of identifying whether the received is a signal or noise is treated as a binary classification problem. Suitable metrics i.e., classification accuracy, precision, recall, and $F 1$ score are used for assessing the proposed algorithm. Cross-validations are also carried out to ensure the robustness of the proposed model. Even at low SNRs of -20 dB a classification accuracy of well above $84 \%$ is obtained on the Filter Bank Multi Carrier 5G data set.

articleTitle: Step response analysis for MEMS capacitive accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: MEMS capacitive accelerometer are used in many applications. In this paper MEMS capacitive accelerometer has been simulated using Simulink software for different device parameter (mass, Area, and $d_{0}$) values. The MEMS accelerometer is modeled as a spring mass system followed by a capacitance to voltage converter.
