The step response of the device has been analyzed and the relationship between $V_{o u t}$ and $\Delta C$ has been established. Such studies are useful in selecting device parameters for sensor design.

articleTitle: Analyzing Poisoning Attacks on Non-IID Federated Learning Systems for Credit Scoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a technique that allows decentralized model training on local datasets, removing the necessity to deliver the data to a coordinator. In contrast to conventional methods where data is collected and centralized, federated learning enables credit bureaus to construct credit ratings using a distributed approach. In this approach, a global model is trained by aggregating localized models from edge devices (smartphones or IoT devices located closer to the data or the runner). Despite the advantages of federated learning over centralized methods, the open training environment and exposed model parameters make it vulnerable to malicious poisoning attacks. Various poisoning attacks encompassing label-flipping, clean-label, model and data poisoning, have the potential to compromise the integrity and efficacy of federated learning systems. This research study sheds light on the utilization of federated learning for credit score prediction, highlighting the effects of poisoning attacks on learning metrics. By better understanding these attacks and their impact, enhanced strategies to detect and mitigate such threats, safeguarding the integrity of federated learning systems in various domains can be devised. A credit scoring system is implemented based on the decentralized approach of federated learning using a non-IID dataset. The impact of changing parameters, such as the quantity of runners and attack percentage on learning metrics for three types of attacks, viz., label-flipping, Byzantine, and data poisoning are observed.

articleTitle: Improving Educational Assessments: Question Difficulty Classification with DistilBERT and Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study addresses the critical need for automated question difficulty classification in educational settings. By leveraging the DistilBERT model and Explainable AI (XAI) techniques, we aim to enhance the accuracy and interpretability of classifying questions into three difficulty levels: simple, average, and tough. We trained and evaluated the model using a dataset of 9041 questions, measuring performance with metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, AUC, and cross-entropy loss. Our findings demonstrate significant improvements in classification accuracy with increasing data sizes, reaching an accuracy of 0.97 with 5000 samples. Additionally, we employed LIME to provide insights into the model’s decision-making process, enhancing the transparency and trustworthiness of the predictions. This research offers a novel approach to question difficulty classification, with potential applications in adaptive learning systems and automated assessment tools.

articleTitle: Real Time Diagnosis of Ocular Diseases using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ocular diseases can have a profound impact on a person’s vision and overall quality of life. Their diagnosis is often time-consuming. Therefore, computer-aided diagnostic systems are being developed to address this issue. In our work, we have developed a cost-effective fundus camera using a 28- Diopter condensing lens which will be used to capture a retinal image. This image will then be sent to the deep learning model, which has been developed using the CoAtNet architecture and has been trained using the images from the RFMiD dataset. The disease associated with the image is identified through a web application that acts as an interface between a user and the model. We have also compared the performance of three architectures - ResNet 152, Inception V3 and CoAtNet, of which CoAtNet provided the best results.

articleTitle: Mitigating Cyber Threats in Critical Infrastructure: A Technical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical analysis research the techniques and methods for mitigating cyber threats in essential infrastructure which include the electricity grid, transportation, and the water supply. It discusses the benefits of risk interception, the identity of attack strategies, and the implementation of countermeasures. The evaluation additionally provides perception into the significance of comfy network architecture, dependable patch management, and effective statistics safety regulations. Additionally, the paper considers latest advances in artificial intelligence, system gaining knowledge of, and block chain era, and the way these improvements may be used to bolster normal protection. Particular case studies illustrate the effectiveness of these solutions and highlight the importance of chance control and proactive safety features. In the long run, this analysis highlights the paramount need for vigilance and complete protection controls to ensure the integrity and stability of important infrastructure.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stroke Prediction: Leveraging Ensemble Learning for Improved Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Stroke, a potentially deadly medical disorder, requires excellent prediction and prevention measures to minimize its impact on individuals and healthcare systems. In this study, ensemble learning techniques are employed to enhance the accuracy of stroke prediction. The method combines four different machine learning algorithms, Adaboost, CatBoost, XGBoost, and LightGBM, to produce a strong predictive model. The data was composed of a rich set of demographic, medical, and lifestyle information. The data was preprocessed and features were engineered to maximize predictive performance. Results showed that the stacked ensemble model, which is composed of Adaboost, CatBoost, XGB, LightGBM, and Logistic Regression, meta-model, outperformed other models. The model has the potential to be used as a decision support tool in an early stroke risk assessment system, enhancing clinician decision-making and improving healthcare outcomes.

Index Terms: National Institutes Of Health Stroke Scale

articleTitle: Fruit - CNN: A Fruit Classification and Quality Assessment System Using Two-Stack Ensemble Method
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Growing demands for accurate fruit evaluation in agriculture has led to the requirement for exact fruit classification and quality assessment. Creating a system that combines deep neural networks and conventional machine learning models for precise categorization presents challenges. A Fruit Classification and Quality Assessment System is being developed as a solution to this problem. In addition to deep neural networks, it makes use of a two-stacked ensemble technique. Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Decision Tree models are all included, and each model brings a special strength to the classification problem. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are used because they are good at extracting features from visual input, and they work well for classifying fruit images in particular. Effective model architectures are identified by the project through thorough comparison analysis. The accuracy and reliability of various models are improved by combining them through ensemble learning approaches. With the goal of greatly advancing fruit classification and quality assessment, the resultant system delivers high accuracy and resiliency in demanding agricultural situations, guaranteeing dependability and efficiency in practical applications.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Remotely Sensed Images using Multisource Data: An Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Remotely sensed data obtained from diverse sensors provide rich information for a wide range of applications in remote sensing, such as land use and land cover mapping. Due to the availability of a large amount of data, advanced deep-learning techniques have been incorporated into this domain. However, these techniques require a significant amount of annotated data, which can be challenging to obtain for land-use and land-cover mapping. Multisource data fusion has become crucial in remotely sensed image analysis to overcome this challenge, providing significant benefits across various applications. This paper analyzes the fusion of multisource data tailored for land-use and land-cover mapping. The analysis showcases that incorporating the novel knowledge transfer approach from multisource data has helped to achieve a 1-6% improvement in mIoU for the Kaggle Aerial Image dataset.

articleTitle: Optimal Low Power Design Of PLL
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper elucidates the architectural blueprint and practical execution of a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL), integrating a Phase Frequency Detector (PFD), Charge Pump (CP), passive low-pass Loop Filter, and ring Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO) circuits.The designed PLL achieves a lock range of 854.83 MHz to 1.258 GHz, with a reduced lock time. The VCO’s oscillation frequency spans from 804 MHz to 1.52 GHz. Notably, the overall PLL power dissipation is enhanced through a reduction in inverter stages, facilitated by employing a 3 -stage ring oscillator as the VCO, in lieu of an LC-tank oscillator, supplemented by a 5 -stage ring oscillator. Implemented using 180nm technology and the “Cadence Virtuoso Visualization and Analytic tool”, operating with a 1.8V power supply, the PLL achieves a lock time of 38.76 ns with a reference frequency of 25 MHz and a power dissipation of 4.87 mW.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Long before the internet was invented, hoaxes and fake news existed. A widely accepted characterization of fake news online refers to fabricated articles intentionally crafted to mislead readers. Social media and news organizations at times spread false information to draw more readers or to meet some other objective. Catchy headlines or propositions that create interest in clicking on links to increase ad revenue increase complexity to the scenario. Spreading of fake news is a matter of great concern as the consequence of this is catastrophic if not dealt properly. Keeping in view the developments in the field of communication made due to the various social networking platforms, this paper explores the growing prevalence of fake news. The objective of this paper is to offer a resource enabling consumers to discern and filter out websites disseminating inaccurate or misleading information. In this paper, we use few basic, carefully selected titles and content elements to accurately identify fraudulent posts. The experimental setup makes use of state of the art classification algorithms for better results.

articleTitle: Smart Steps to Sporting Success: IoT-Driven Footwear Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using the cloud platform Blynk IoT, smart sneakers with built-in step and calorie monitoring were created with athletes in mind. The primary characteristic of the smart shoe is its ability to detect early signals of cramping in the muscles during athletic exercises. This allows for prompt response to protect the athlete’s foot and performance. It also acknowledges the vulnerabilities that athletes may encounter during training; this feature guarantees that athletes can notify the user by sending them messages in the event of any potential hazard. Beyond features for health and safety, the smart shoe calculates steps and tracks activity, giving athletes useful information for their training and recuperation regimens. With a focus on safety first, this project tackles important issues like sensor accuracy, device longevity, user comfort, and data security to produce a solution that improves athletic performance. By providing athletes with a comprehensive tool for health monitoring and personal safety, the smart shoe seeks to redefine wearable technology in sports.

articleTitle: Signal Quality Prediction for Cognitive Radio Networks using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cognitive radio networks (CRNs) are getting increasingly famous due to their potential to deliver excessive-bandwidth offerings to numerous users. Despite this, the signal satisfactory of those networks can be fantastically variable and hard to predict, leading to degraded communication. Currently, deep gaining knowledge of strategies had been proposed as a method to improve the capability of CRNs to correctly expect signal first-rate, allowing multiplied device reliability. On this paper, we gift an assessment of present deep gaining knowledge of tactics to be expecting signal excellent in CRNs, focusing at the structure and application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and deep reinforcement studying (DRL). The overview additionally examines the overall performance of those processes in terms of accuracy, scalability and generalization to new environments. Subsequently, we provide a survey of capability future guidelines for signal first-rate prediction in CRNs using deep getting to know.

articleTitle: Enhanced Method For Identification Of Alzheimer’s Disease Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An innovative approach for identifying Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) in MRI images using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is provided in this research. The approach is based on transfer learning and advanced deep learning techniques. The CNN model that has been trained on the Kaggle Dataset and outperforms conventional methods with an astounding 96% accuracy rate in classifying different types of AD. By showing the potential for wider applications in healthcare and medical monitoring, this technique is a noteworthy breakthrough in medical pathology.

articleTitle: An Efficient Emotion Classifier using Novel 2-D Convolutional Neural Networks for Twitter users comparison with Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to gain insights into the emotions, sentiments, and attitudes of individuals using Novel 2-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network for Twitter emotion identification for users who do not enjoy or own animals and comparison with Random Forest Classifier. The Random Forest Algorithm(N=10)and2DCNN(N=10)are computed using two groups, each of which consists of 5800 samples. In this study, the Gpower test is carried out at around 85% (power=0.80and α =0.05).According to the Findings The Novel 2D Convolutional Neural Network technique outperformed the Random Forest approach(86.7%)in terms of accuracy(93.6%).Group Statistics Results-2D CNN has a mean accuracy (93.6%).The independent sample t-test has a significant value p=0.001(p<0.05) indicating the study between the 2DCNNmodelandtheRandomForestalgorithmfor users without pet animals is statistically significant. Using a cutting-edge 2D Convolutional Neural Network algorithm, the prediction of emotions for social media users utilizing Twitter is being done, and the outcomes are being compared to Random Forest algorithm.

articleTitle: The smart Cross-Layer Design for Congestion Control in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The clever pass-layer layout for congestion management in wireless networks is a complete approach that leverages the interaction between community layers to develop efficient, dependable, and cozy Wi-Fi networks. This design combines the transport and MAC (media access control) layer protocols, which include TCP (transmission manage protocol) and IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) 802.11, respectively, so that it will manage the flow of records and decrease congestion. It considers both packet-stage information, including packet arrival, inter-packet arrival, and packet size, as well as bodily layer parameters, including channel country information, multi-user variety, and interference. Also, it addresses the ISPs’ necessity of changing transmission charges and granting the proper stability among throughput and honest distribution of assets to defend different programs. This layout should respond to modifications within the network quickly and efficiently to obtain the favored quality of service (satisfactory service). Additionally, the cross-layer layout needs to be flexible and sufficient to be extended to modern-day and future communique networks while configurable to specific varieties of networks for better deployment.

articleTitle: Applying Computer Vision and IoT to Livestock Management
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical abstract describes the software of computer imaginative and prescient and internet of fecundated (IoT) technologies up to date updated management. Up-to-date visions algorithms can be used to date generate snapshots of person animals in a herd that may then be used for tracking and fitness tracking. Facts accrued from IoT sensors may be analyzed in actual-time updated, become aware of ability fitness troubles in advance, and up-to-date account updated proactive fitness management. By making use of each up to date updated vision and IoT technology in conjunction, it is possible to update updated animal health and productivity while lowering the amount of manual hard work required in up to date management.

articleTitle: Helmet Guard: Engine Management and Accident Severity Assessment for Motorcycles
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Motorcycle safety systems traditionally face limitations in engine control, accident assessment, and rider protection. This paper introduces a solution that enhances engine management employs machine learning for accurate accident severity analysis, and incorporates alcohol detection with accelerometer-based tilt assessment designed for motorcycles. This project mandates helmet usage before the engine starts, ensuring the rider’s safety. The system concurrently monitors critical factors such as alcohol concentration and tilt angles and deactivates the engine upon detecting irregularities. This innovative approach helps make riding motorcycles safer and smarter by overcoming previous problems. It represents a significant advancement, promising enhanced security and intelligence on the road.

articleTitle: Quantum Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Overview and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emerging field of Quantum Machine learning (QML), which offers noticeably faster processing speed, is the result of the merger of Quantum Computing (QC) and Machine Learning (ML). Superposition and Entanglement are the fundamental concepts of QC, which increases computational scalability. This comprehensive overview examines QML foundations, algorithms, applications, and challenges of QML. When applied to the Cleveland Heart Disease Dataset, the Quantum Support Vector Classifier (QSVC) achieves an accuracy of 0.75 whereas the Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC) yields an accuracy of 0.62, thus showing that QSVC outperforms VQC. The main issue in QML that calls for effort and investment is noise. QML has the potential to advance technology and has its application in a variety of domains.

articleTitle: Estimation of Abnormal Crowd Density Using Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Accurate crowd counting in any major events are a big concern for the authority. Due to the mismanagement of the crowds, the world has experienced many unfortunate situations. Each year a number of people lost lives due to the situation where people gathered more than the capacity of the place. To avoid this kind of scenario in future it is necessary to develop artificial intelligence based models which will equip the authorities to enhance public security. In this paper, crowd density is estimated using the following convolutional neural network (CNN) models: ResNet50, InceptionResNetV2, Xception, NasNet, VGG19, MobileNet, DenseNet, ConvNeXtXLarge, and EfficientNetV2L. A comparison of nine transfer learning based CNN models are demonstrated on a publicly dataset available. Performance of all the nine CNN models are compared using coefficient of Pearson’s correlation (r) and mean square error (MSE). VGG19 model has achieved a lowest value of 6.3 for MSE and highest value of 0.9 for Pearson’s correlation coefficient in comparison to other eight models. Best performance of VGG19 model over other eight CNN models proves its potential to estimate the crowd density from the images over other CNN models.

articleTitle: An Automated Machine Learning Approach for 6G Radio Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: this technical abstract examines an automated system gaining knowledge of the method for 6 G radio aid allocation. In 6G networks, the need for efficient, useful resource efficiency can be elevated due to the anticipated better statistics prices enabled by using the usage of mm Wave frequencies. To address this project, the authors suggest an automated device gaining knowledge of methods that could optimize radio aid allocation while also supplying flexibility in phrases of generation, architecture, and network parameters. The proposed approach is based totally on the simultaneous optimization of deep reinforcement mastering and conventional optimization algorithms. The middle idea is to leverage the benefits of each process to locate the greatest radio aid allocation scheme for exclusive deployment scenarios. The authors also examine the performance advantages of their technique in a simulated 6 G community in the evaluation of existing techniques. The outcomes display that the proposed technique is capable of improving system throughput and providing latency profits by way of as much as 5% and eight% respectively. For this reason, this automated machine learning technique may be a promising answer for radio useful resource allocation in 6G networks.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Effect of Foot Trajectories on a Two Degrees of Freedom Robotic Leg
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Efficient locomotion is a crucial aspect of robotic design, particularly in bipedal systems where power consumption directly impacts performance and autonomy. Trajectory planning plays a prime role in determining energy efficiency and stability during locomotion. Trade-offs between trajectory types in terms of energy efficiency and performance remain inadequately explored, necessitating a comprehensive comparative analysis. This study aims to address this gap by analyzing rectangular trajectory and smoothed rectangular trajectory for a two-degree-of-freedom robotic leg. By evaluating power and torque consumption this work seeks to provide valuable insights into the efficiency and suitability of trajectory planning methods for bipedal locomotion. Optimizing trajectory planning based on energy efficiency not only enhances the operational endurance of bipedal robots but also expands their range of applications in diverse environments, ultimately advancing the field of robotics towards more practical and sustainable solutions.

articleTitle: Islanding Detection by Current Based Technique in Indian Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With rising electricity demand, distribution networks (DNs) are constantly subjected to increased stress, reliability, and power quality issues. The integration of Distributed Generation (DG) into distribution networks in existing electricity grids presents substantial technological, environmental, and economic challenges. Because of the interconnection of DGs in the distribution system, the direction of power flow varies depending on the operating circumstances, resulting in various technical issues such as an increase in system fault level, a delay in fault clearance, etc. DGs are used in smart grid technologies, where the microgrid concept has been used for some specific areas of DNs. The microgrid has two modes of operation - one gridconnected mode and another islanded mode. This study presents islanding detection (in microgrid) in DNs with DGs using the dq transformation technique. The simulation is done in PSCAD, and results are obtained for various fault conditions. The simulation uses practical data from Gujarat DISCOM, MGVCL’s Anand Karmasad 11 kV distribution feeder, and their covered area.

articleTitle: Exploring the Maze: A Comparative Study of Prims and Kruskals MST Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper offers a comprehensive study of minimum spanning tree (MST) algorithms, mainly focusing on Prims and Kruskals approaches. MST problems holds a fundamental role in combinatorial optimizations, because they help us find the shortest or least time-consuming paths with feasible costs. Due to which they have wide-ranging applications across various domains in real life like communication networks, power grids, transportation systems, piping, and more. The core objective is to find the minimum weight spanning tree, optimizing path selection. To facilitate a comparative study of Prims and Kruskals MST algorithms, we have created a hypothetical scenario utilizing the Traveling Salesman Problem. Our dataset comprises 20 locations (nodes) interconnected by 42 edges representing various distances between locations in kilometers. By applying various MST algorithms, we access and analyse their results and complexities ascertain their efficiency and efficacy under diverse conditions.

articleTitle: Challenges and limitations in the use of artificial intelligence in research and some options to overcome them
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly important in the field of scientific research, providing new opportunities for processing large amounts of data, automating routine tasks, and discovering new dependencies in complex systems. Despite these advantages, the use of AI in the scientific domain is accompanied by many challenges and limitations. This paper explores the current state of the problem, analyses the challenges facing the scientific community and examines the main limitations of using AI. The report includes a SWOT analysis of the deployment of AI in scientific research, summarizing the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats that accompany the use of AI technologies. Possible solutions to overcome these limitations are proposed, including the development of new methodologies for AI training, the creation of ethical and legal frameworks, and the training of professionals who can effectively use AI technologies. The report highlights the need for a coordinated effort between the scientific community, industry and regulators for the successful application of AI in research. AI has the potential to significantly improve the scientific process, but requires careful management of the challenges and risks associated with its use.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graphs on Medical Domain Using Mondo Ontology
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: According to the National Library of Medicine, the anatomical disease section includes 18 major categories with more than 26000 known diseases. Although medical domain knowledge is such an important pillar of modern human society, it still consists of a lot of textual medical knowledge. In a few recent years, knowledge graphs emerged as a solution to represent textual data in the form of graphs. In our work, we aim to develop a knowledge graph dedicated toward the medical domain, which will organize textual knowledge into a format that can be easily queried to produce knowledge both faster and in an efficient manner. The source data-set is chosen from Pub-Med, a subsidiary of National Centre of Biotechnology Information, alongside using Mondo ontology for rich structure of knowledge graph. Our framework consists of data preprocessing, entity extraction, relation extraction, triple construction and constructing a data set of RDF triplet. We then used RDF triplet to represent nodes and edges, which we subsequently deployed to Neo4J.

articleTitle: Discerning India’s Garlic Tapestry: Yamuna Safed, G-41 and G-282 Classification using CNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study examines the performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) in the automated classification of various species of garlic commonly found in India, such as Yamuna Safed, G-41, and G-282. Using a list of 14,000 clear pictures, carefully teach and test these models to find the small visual differences between different types of garlic. The models made are very good. They got 98.2% correct in placing different types correctly and can pick up the little details needed for perfect identification. The models are tested by measures like accuracy, recount, and F1-score. This shows how well they work with different types of pictures. The results not only show how smart machine learning methods are, but they also have real uses for farming. These models give farmers, scientists, and others a dependable automatic tool to make farming easier. They also help manage crops better and check if garlic types are real in the supply chain. Understanding the confusion chart points out possible improvements for models, focusing on ways to increase accuracy in the future. This study shows a big step forward for automated farm sorting systems in India’s wide garlic varieties. It helps improve farming, make trade easier, and save diverse crops of different types of onions found in the country.

articleTitle: Refining Autonomous Network Agents in Distributed and Cooperative Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a unique approach to refining self-sufficient network retailers inside distributed and cooperative networks. A dispensed reinforcement gaining knowledge of community (DRLN) architecture is proposed to refine a prototype autonomous agent in a distributed cooperative community. The DRLN consists of a set of unbiased getting-to-know sellers that together form a disbursed reinforcement gaining knowledge of the device. Each agent is accountable for refining an unmarried agent in the network, and the dealers cooperate and trade revel with each other. This paper examines the effect of the usage of multiple dealers to refine the independent agents and evaluates its efficacy. Effects display that the proposed DRLN appreciably advanced the selection-making and coordination of the autonomous agents in comparison to the unrefined model. Moreover, the DRLN was located to be sturdy to small modifications in the community structure and substantially better the reliability of the community’s autonomous behavior.

articleTitle: Validation of High Angular Resolution Diffusion-Weighted Imaging Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: High angular resolution diffusion-weighted imaging (HARDI) protocols are strategies used to growth the number of facts amassed about tissue microstructure in diffusion imaging. Current studies have sought to apprehend the validity of HARDI methods and their ability to reconstruct the underlying tissue systems accurately. The evaluation of HARDI reliability is accomplished thru 3 major classes: voxel-wise checks of methods, simulations to evaluate protocol efficiency, and human brain tract reconstruction. outcomes from these studies have tested that HARDI may additionally offer progressed visualization of mind microstructure and might higher differentiate between individual white count tracts and distinctive tissue kinds than conventional diffusion imaging. However, due to the complexity of HARDI protocols, further validation is essential to ensure accuracy and discover the strengths and weaknesses of the strategies.

articleTitle: Cohesive Heartbeat Monitoring for Geolocation and Log Correlation in Campus Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A campus network is made up of a dense interconnection of local area networks within a limited geographical area characterized by a centralized infrastructure that interconnects various facilities within an institution, providing communication and data exchange services to support organizational activities. In a campus network, relevant information about connected clients such as connection status, duration, and relative location has to be maintained and updated in real-time to facilitate availability, log correlation and monitoring capabilities. It is important to establish a multi-pronged system in place to combat security threats and potential data loss. In this paper, we examine several existing standard practices and identify the operational and functional bottlenecks associated with each implementation with respect to the campus network. The study underscores the critical need for robust and adaptive network architectures and practices to safeguard organizational communication and data integrity with emphasis on the dynamic landscape of campus environments. Finally, we propose a novel cohesive heartbeat monitoring system that leverages data from various sources to ensure connection availability and provide advanced logging capabilities.

articleTitle: Deep Ensemble Fusion For Enhanced Multi-Label Land Cover Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Accurate identification of land cover is an important step for determining the right management strategy, planning and environmental assessment. Remote sensing images depicting land covers generally parcel information that has spatial and temporal correlation which cannot be easily identified by classical techniques. This paper proposes a new type of multi-label land cover classification model based on RNN and CNN that can efficiently cover these problems. The suggested model, which uses Fastai library for training and prediction, is capable of capturing both spatial and temporal attributes with a high level of efficiency in dealing with the UCMerced Landuse dataset. The dynamics measured by the plugin prove that the use of the hybrid architecture where LSTM is integrated with ResNet34 as the CNN backbone helps in the identification of complex relation/dependency and patterns in the changes of land cover. Therefore, the degrees of accuracy and the F-beta scores are presented which are as good as experimental results confirmed the model’s robustness. The paper extends the methodologies for classifying land cover and provides a promising approach for those application domain, in which the temporal and spatial information needs to be used simultaneously.

articleTitle: Prediction of Personality based Rumor Propagation on Social Media using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social media platforms have evolved into fertile environments for the spread of gossip and false information. The rising prevalence of online social interaction among the general public contributes to this phenomenon, where user personality plays a pivotal role in forecasting how individuals engage with digital platforms. This research seeks to explore the influence of personality on the propagation of rumors and false information in the realm of social media. The study is divided into two sections. In the initial part, we examine human behavior concerning the propagation of rumors, categorizing Twitter users as either prone or resistant in accordance with their MBTI personality types. Subsequently, we predict whether a user is likely to be Susceptible or Resistant, and measure the proportion of a user’s account activity dedicated to false information. The proposed system has demonstrated notable results, surpassing existing models in both accuracy and prediction performance.

articleTitle: Investigating the Utility of Data Mining for Automated Credit Scoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Data mining is a powerful device for automatic credit scoring. This paper will look into the application of statistics mining for automated credit score scoring by discussing its advantages and downsides. The form may even look at cutting-edge research in the location and discuss the demanding situations that information mining techniques pose while used for automatic credit score scoring. Similarly, the paper will provide pointers on how statistics mining techniques can improve the effectiveness of computerized credit score scoring. Subsequently, a precis of the paper’s conclusions and implications for future studies could be supplied.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Framework for Robustness evaluation on Numeric data classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As its an era of Artificial Intelligence, and we have started relying on decisions made by machine in almost every domain. To do so, we need a framework on responsible AI which can help bring out better analytics on models’ decision. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for evaluating the robustness of classification models on numeric data. Robustness evaluation is crucial for ensuring model reliability in real-world applications where data distribution may vary. The framework encompasses a range of evaluation metrics and techniques tailored specifically for numeric data classification problems. It addresses challenges such as model sensitivity to data perturbations, generalization across diverse datasets, and performance under adversarial conditions. We have built a framework to analyze model’s behavior in most of the corner cases. Through extensive experimentation and analysis, the framework provides insights into model behavior, strengths, and weaknesses, aiding practitioners in selecting robust classification solutions for their applications. To evaluate the model, we have added data augmentation, counterfactual analysis, adversarial testing, randomized smoothing, and Out-of-distribution detection in the framework, so that we are able to do rigorous evaluation of any model. We have tested our framework on six different classification models working on six different datasets primarily on healthcare domain.

articleTitle: Artificial neural networks modelling for surface roughness in wire electrical discharge machining of Incoloy 800H
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of artificial neural networks (ANNs) in optimizing process parameters and model development has gained attention due to their ability to predict timely and accurate outputs. The current study uses ANNs to predict surface roughness during wire electrical discharge machining (WEDM) of Incoloy 800H. The prediction model utilizes a multilayer perception based on back-propagation neural network (BPNN). In neural network modelling, network weights and bias values were updated, and the process output was estimated using the Levenberg-Marquardt backpropagation training function (trainlm) and a hyperbolic tangent sigmoid (tansig) transfer function, respectively. The ANN model comprises one output neuron (surface roughness) and five input neurons (pulse on, pulse off, wire tension, servo voltage, and wire feed rate). WEDM experimental data is divided into training, testing, and validation in the ratio of 70%:15%:15%. The results show that the optimal ANN model with 5-11-1 topology provides an accurate estimate of surface roughness, with a correlation coefficient of 0.997. The proposed ANN model can predict WEDM process parameters quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: An Overview of Applications of Data Compression & Source Coding in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facts compression and source coding techniques are used in Wi-Fi networks for several packages. Those techniques may be used to lessen the size of transmitted information, thereby increasing the spectral performance of a community and improving the performance of the channel. In addition, fact compression can also be used for programs such as video streaming and voice verbal exchange. Records compression and supply coding strategies are often utilized in Wi-Fi networks to reduce the bit fee of a channel. By using efficient algorithms, facts may be compressed and transmitted without sacrificing first-rate. Compression algorithms can be used to reduce the facts fee and throughput of a wireless network without decreasing the best of the records. Through doing so, it is feasible to reduce the size of transmitted data while growing the performance and performance of the channel. Source coding is another technique used in wireless networks to optimize the performance of the channel. Supply coding algorithms are used to lessen the bit charge of a channel with the aid of the use of various techniques together with bitsensible coding and entropy coding. Those algorithms can assist in lessening the c of records that are dispatched over the air and can also help lessen the noise components. Statistics compression and supply coding can also be used to improve the performance of video streaming and voice communiqué applications in a Wi-Fi network.

articleTitle: Smart Data Analytics: Measuring ESG Impact and Banking Performance Through ROA in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We know that the performance measure of the banks is represented by return on assets (ROA), so this research has opted to use ROA to establish its relationship with the ESG score. Data on the ESG performance and ROA of Indian banks are anal ysed in this paper to regulate banking sector and improvise banking software using a range of statistical methodologies (Regression model using Python). According to the research’s results, there is a connection between a bank’s ROA and its ESG score. As a result, banks tend to have greater ROAs when they have lower ESG scores. The analysis alsore ve als that banks that are more vulnerable to environmental risks correlate more significantly with their ESG score and ROA. The research’s conclusions affect bank management, investors, and bank regulators. The results imply that regulators would find it helpful to consider ESG performance when determining how risky banks are. According to the findings, investors may find it be neficial to use ESG performance to select banks with outstanding financial performance. The results imply that ESG performance may be a means for bank management to enhance economic performance. According to the research, banks should consider ESG scores when running their operations. In terms of financial performance, risk management, and reputation, banks that enhance their ESG performance may profit. Keywords- ESG (environmental, social, and governance), ROA, Indian Banking, Risk Exposure, Performance of banks.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of a Cache Coherency Verification IP for AMBA ACE Protocol Using UVM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ever evolving architecture of SoCs has created the need for a robust communication protocol to maintain the data consistency and data integrity between multi-master SOCs. This obstacle has been overcome by the AMBA ACE protocol. In the proposed Verification IP, the AMBA ACE protocol has been verified with the help of a write-through, two-way set associative cache which has the cache line size of 32 Bytes, supports both read and write allocate. The VIP has been verified in three different phases defined as read phase, write phase and snoop phase. The simulation of the implementation was completed in Cadence Xcelium Logic Simulator tool.

articleTitle: Design & Implementation of Efficient Full Adder Cell Using Adiabatic & Reversible Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital circuits with improved power efficiency and lightning-fast performance are becoming more and more necessary. Processors, which are essential for day-to-day activities, carry out a variety of intricate arithmetic and logical operations, frequently involving adders. To solve this, a full adder that minimizes heat dissipation into the surrounding environment is implemented using reversible logic and adiabatic logic, greatly reducing energy loss. As a result, circuits using this logic will operate quickly and efficiently. The suggested adiabatic full adder has a novel architecture, two output bits that indicate the sum and carry, and an adiabatic charging method. In adiabatic logic, the power consumption of the full adder is reduced by $51.88 \%, 48.54 \%$, and 49.68%, respectively, compared to the 16T Pass Transistor Logic (PTL) with Transmission Gate (TG) full adder, 14T PTL with TG full adder, and CMOS full adder. The suggested reversible full adder is based on reversible logic, the information is lossless as the input vector can be recovered from the output vector. The delay time is slashed out by $90.33 \%, 85.97 \%$ and 98.29% respectively when differentiated with 16T PTL with TG full adder, 14T Pass Transistor Logic (PTL) with Transmission Gate (TG) full adder and CMOS full adder.

articleTitle: Classification of Coffea Liberica Quality Using Convolution Neural Networks (Slim-CNN, YOLOv5, and VGG-16)
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Coffee production stands as one of the most important agricultures globally, with the Philippines emerging as a significant producer. Among the locally cultivated coffee variants is Liberica (Coffea Liberica), commonly known as Kapeng Barako. However, a challenge arises during the export process, where any imperfection in the harvested raw coffee beans diminishes the overall quality of the beans. To address this issue, an image-based detection method was proposed to distinguish normal beans from defective ones. This research aims to devise an image-based coffee bean defect detection system, employing three distinct algorithm models to determine the most efficient model. The system considers five classifications of beans, namely: normal, black, ruptured, insect-infected, and fade. Utilizing Slim-CNN, YOLOv5, and VGG-16 along with dataset augmentation, three models were developed to detect coffee bean defects. Validation of the trained models was conducted using data separate from the training set, resulting in accuracies of $93.63 \%, 98.52 \%$, and $\mathbf{9 6. 8 9 \%}$ for Slim-CNN, YOLOv5, and VGG-16, respectively.

articleTitle: Fast and Secure Coding for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Speedy and comfy coding for wireless networks is an essential problem in the trendy computing landscape. Wi-fi networks have become increasingly commonplace in recent years, and they present specific demanding situations for code builders. To ensure certain cozy, reliable, and efficient overall performance of network applications, developers must be able to quickly and appropriately generate code for wireless structures. The way to meet these requirements, builders have to be capable of selecting the most appropriate coding approaches to apply if they want to limit errors and maximize security. The main venture to developing easy and reliable code for wireless structures is the complexity of the underlying structures. The ever-increasing complexity of underlying community technologies renders conventional coding techniques inadequate. The elevated demands for real-time records and connection transmission exacerbate this. To address this venture, rapid and at-ease coding strategies need to be carried out. Those strategies can encompass, however are not constrained to, principles including comfy coding, exceptional coding practices, and diverse safety protocols. Principals of comfy coding confer with a method that emphasizes comfortable practices at some point in the improvement and protection of the codebase. This consists of proper protection practices along with authentication, encryption, enter validation, error dealing, and malicious code prevention. This technique allows make certain that the code is written in a strong, comfortable, and efficient manner.

articleTitle: A Reliable and Soft Error Tolerant 12T Radiation Hardened SRAM Cell for Aerospace Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s state-of-the-art VLSI circuits, the SRAMs covers a greater part of the chip area. As technology scales down and moves into the nanometer regime, memory storage elements like SRAM cells are mostly affected by the impact of radiation. Therefore, the rate of soft error generation is enhanced with technology scaling. In this work, a reliable soft error tolerant 12 transistor RTSC-12T SRAM cell is proposed that provides good radiation tolerant capability and is completely immune to SEU and SEMNU. The proposed RTSC-12T has been compared with the existing RHD12T, QUCCE12T and EDP12T by considering the design metrics such as read delay, write delay, Static Noise Margin, critical charge, static and dynamic power consumption, total area and SEU occurrence probability. The simulation has been performed in UMC 65 nm CMOS technology at a temperature of $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. The Proposed RTSC-12T single cell SRAM exhibits $1.25 \mathrm{x} / 1.19 \mathrm{x}$ shorter $\mathrm{T}_{R A}$ than RHD12T/ EDP12T and 1.37x/ 1.03x lower write ability ($\mathrm{T}_{{wA}}$) than RHD12T/ QUCCE12T $\text{@}V_{D D}=1 \mathrm{V}$. Also, the proposed cell consumes 1.28x lower static power than QUCCE12T and 1.2x/1.32x lower dynamic power than QUCCE12T/ EDP12T respectively. However, these gains come at the expense of a slightly lower WSNM.

articleTitle: AMUBOT: An Intelligent A.I.-powered Chatbot for modern applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Chatbots are used in a wide range of online applications, most notably commerce and customer service. These chatbots offer many advantages, including personalisation and 24 -hour availability seven days a week. These benefits make chatbots particularly well-suited for usage in the educational sector. Chatbots are a novel type of human-machine interface that uses natural language. On the other hand, academic chatbots have received little attention in the academic community, for example, by providing organisational help for studies, courses, and tests. This research paper will focus on developing an AI-powered chatbot that will utilise A.I.M.L. (Artificial Intelligence Markup Language) to answer students, guardians, parents, and observers. AMUBOT is a university chatbot that can conduct amicable chats about courses offered, admission requirements, scholarships, career guidance, semester examination dates and schedules, and entrance examinations, among other things, and can also answer frequently asked questions (FAQs). The majority of existing chatbots lack empathy and cannot accommodate anything that deviates from the script. AMUBOT addresses these issues by incorporating active learning into the implementation of existing chatbots.

articleTitle: Distributed Yang Model Dependency Installation Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sysrepo is a YANG(Yet another next Generation)-based configuration and operational state data store for Unix/Linux based applications. Applications will be able to use sysrepo to store their configurations, provided by YANG model. Instead of using normal configuration files, sysrepo will ensure data consistency of the data stored in the datastore and enforce data constraints defined by YANG model. YANG is a data modeling language for the definition of data sent over network management protocols such as the NETCONF and RESTCONF. While installing the YANG models into sysrepo, each YANG model follows a set of preconditions. These preconditions can be like, before installing a YANG model a set of specific yangs has to be there in the system. These dependent YANG models can be the ones which users manually have to install or sometimes it could be the ones which are system defined. While installing these, if the dependent ones are not present in sysrepo, then installation process fails. Here in this paper, a new approach is proposed where in the dependent YANG models will be ordered properly and parallel installation will be done which will fasten up the sysrepo and netopeer processes to startup.

articleTitle: Optimizing FANET Performance using Realistic Mobility Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: FANETs, utilizing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), create decentralized communication networks, serving various purposes such as surveillance, environment monitoring and disaster management. Despite their potential, FANETs grapple with challenges such as limited battery life and high mobility. Simulation emerges as a vital tool for optimizing FANET performance. This paper utilizes a co-simulation platform integrating UAV and network simulators to develop realistic mobility models. Leveraging this platform, a mobility model for FANETs, merging simulated UAV trajectories with network communication has been proposed in this article. Results indicate the developed mobility model outperforms existing probabilistic counterparts in metrics like Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), End-to-End (E2E) delay, and Normalized Routing Load (NRL). Incorporating developed mobility model in the network offers enhanced network performance, particularly in scenarios with high UAV speeds, making it apt for real-world FANET applications.

articleTitle: Autonomous Drone Navigation Based on Real-Time Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Methods for globally optimizing the trajectory of a drone by entirely real-time global optimization allow drones to self-navigate. Based on this method, candidates will be required to use worldwide optimization strategies in combination with self-sufficient navigation algorithms (for instance, concerning terrain constraints) and other environmental for you to introduce improvements. Thanks to real-time global optimization, the vehicle can promptly and accurately determine a path that offers the least resistance while preventing impacts with any obstacles. The optimization may also consider other factors, such as wind speed and battery life, to ensure that the drone reaches its destination in the most environmentally friendly and safe way. This method can reduce the timing and enhance the navigation accuracy of drones.

articleTitle: 12-stage FFT Implementation using cordic-based pipelined SDF Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this present work, a high-speed cordic-based realtime Single-delay feedback FFT processor is realized on FPGA. The Cordic algorithm will eliminate the hardware complexity of the complex multipliers in the butterflies. The logic behind this implementation is to replace the twiddle factors in conventional SDF processors with recursive Cordic rotations thereby eliminating the usage of ROM. Cordic is utilized as it provides a simpler way of computing complex multiplications and it is considered the best alternative. The present cordic sdf architecture is proposed to implement and scale to the variable length of FFT size $N=2^{m}$. where $\mathbf{N}$ belongs to FFT size and $\mathbf{m}$ indicates no of stages. Memory utilization in cordic pipelined SDF fft is 4% as compared to conventional SDF fft which takes 21%. The maximum operating frequency in the case of Cordic-based SDF FFT is $\mathbf{1 2 8. 4 M H Z}$ resulting in low latency and high throughput. The present architecture offers a variety of applications in signal and communication systems where high speed is employed for faster data transfer.

articleTitle: Implementing AI-driven Diagnostic Decision Support Systems for Smart Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Clever healthcare has turned out to be an increasingly more crucial assignment inside the area of healthcare due to its capability to decorate affected person care transport. Using AI-driven diagnostic decision guide systems is one way to permit more green, correct, and regular healthcare decisions. The structures use records from clinical information to growth predictive fashions that may be used to help the analysis of numerous illnesses. With an AI-driven choice guide device, healthcare carriers can successfully select capability diagnoses based on an affected person’s medical information and other elements. The system also can offer hints for treatment plans primarily based on the analysis. AI-pushed structures can also provide actual-time remarks to clinicians, assisting them in improving accuracy and decreasing scientific mistakes. Via the use of AI-pushed preference help systems, healthcare carriers can optimize healthcare shipping, major to better affected person results.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Crop Disease Detection using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agriculture, deeply rooted in India’s history, remains as the root of the country’s economy and a primary source of employment. Despite the ageold practice, smallholder farmers in India sometimes face problems, especially in getting critical information that would allow them to make knowledgeable farming decisions. In this era of technology, knowledge is the foundation of advancement, farmers productivity and profitability could be impacted due to a lack of widely accessible agricultural knowledge. Crop health is an important aspect in productivity in agriculture. Crop diseases can have major implications for quality and quantity, as well as farmer’s livelihoods. This technology aims to assist farmers, increase productivity, and contribute to agriculture’s sustainability by providing up-to-date knowledge regarding crop health, disease identification, and optimal farming practices. Crop disease identification used to rely on digital image processing, but new advances in deep learning have exceptionally outperformed previous techniques. In this paper, we focus on the effectiveness of employing deep learning for crop disease identification. Our research is based on a database of images of diseased crop leaf and healthy leaf, with a focus on prevalent crop diseases in India. An application has been created with this ideology in mind to aid farming practices by detecting plant disease. There are two types of input format can be given to the application such as image and video of the diseased plant leaves. YOLO v8 is the deep learning model that is used in this application to effectively identify the disease.

articleTitle: Exploring Intelligent UAV Route Planning in Autonomous Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper gives a singular approach to permitwise unmanned aerial car (UAV) direction planning in self-sufficient telecommunication systems. The proposed technique utilizes the aggregate of heuristic algorithms, artificial intelligence, and dynamic programming strategies for unmanned airborne vehicles to determine the most useful route to supply the services correctly. The proposed technique is evaluated on simulated 3-D surroundings. It has proven its effectiveness in offering high-acting direction-making plans with quick flight routes and offers excellent real-time performance. The heuristics and synthetic intelligence strategies used in this method can efficiently examine the environment for higher route planning and allow the UAVs to evolve to extraordinary terrains, climates, and boundaries, which can affect the conversation shipping. The principle application of this technique is in offering reliable verbal exchange offerings via UAVs in antagonistic and indoor environments. Thru the proposed approach, this paper immediately explores the green routing solutions for practical deployment eventualities.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Adaptive Network Coding Algorithms for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper specializes in the layout and optimization of adaptive community coding algorithms for WiFi networks. The goal of those algorithms is to maximize the performance of network transmissions at the same time as heading off collisions and losses. We analyze the performance of numerous current network coding algorithms, examine their strengths and weaknesses and advocate techniques to optimize their performance. We also increase and compare new algorithms based on the adaptive network coding method. Those algorithms are designed if you want to mechanically adapt to the environment and take full benefit of the available assets to maximize the overall network’s performance. The results of our simulations endorse that the proposed adaptive network coding algorithms outperform conventional network coding algorithms in phrases of both throughput and latency. We further propose an optimized model of our adaptive network coding algorithms and evaluate its performance to that of the unique algorithms. Our results demonstrate significant performance profits in terms of both throughput and latency.

articleTitle: Enforcing Image Encryption using Cryptographic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology to ensure the user Image privacy in social media platform using image encryption method. Social media has long been a significant part of online communication. However, image and user privacy concerns soared due to the increasing sensitivity of social media users. The paper offers a new methodology that suggests using this encryption technique that ensure the privacy protection for images in social media platform. A client-side image encryption solution is integrated into a blog profile website. When a user wants to download someone else’s profile picture, the website uses an on-the-fly encryption algorithm like chaotic behaviour that shuffles the pixels of the original image before delivery. By making the downloaded images unusable in their original form, users are protected with their privacy while maintaining the browsing capabilities of the platform. The paper proposes on-the-fly image encryption algorithm in detail, including the a random pixel shuffling map and maps to generate the encrypted image. This ensures the CIA by performing metrics.

articleTitle: CAN: Communicator Assistance Network for Deaf-Dumb-Blind People
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Communication is an integral part of our daily life for interacting with others. However, it is challenging for differently-abled people like deaf and/or dumb. Hence, they are bound to use sign language for essential communication. The sign languages are still not adequate for blind people; they use braille script to read and their voice for communication. This research paper aims to develop a neural network based Communicator Assistance Network (CAN) for the interaction among differently-abled people like blind and deaf and/or dumb. The proposed model detects the sign poses by a deaf and/or dumb person through a webcam and results the corresponding words, which have to be converted to speech for blind people; the whole process would be reversed for responding to the conversation. The proposed network has been trained for 15 epochs with batches of size 20 (taking 1459 steps to finish an epoch), and results in 98% accuracy. Furthermore, the well-trained model has been tested on real and unseen samples and it results in 100% accuracy. Therefore, the model is useful where the interaction with/between challenged people is more likely to happen, like in schools for specially challenged people or workplaces. This application is an asset to them in communicating with others and expressing their voice.

articleTitle: Converting Regular Expressions to Non-Deterministic Finite Automata through an Automated Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A Regular Expression, often abbreviated as Regex, are a sequence of characters that define a search pattern. An Non-deterministic Finite Automata (NFA) is a computational machine which can be in any one of many finite states at any given point of time, and transitions between these states, allowing for non deterministic behavior. Regular expressions, while beneficial for defining string patterns, require human conversion into NF for identification. This project aims to build a compiler which converts Regular Expressions into NFA to bridge the gap between the theoretical and computing worlds. This would be achieved using a Python based framework.

articleTitle: Enhancing the QoS in Intelligent 5G Enabled IoT using Novel Convolutional Neural Network and Blockchain-Empowered Security Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aims to enhance the Quality of Service (QoS) in 5G- empowered intelligent Internet of Things (IoT) networks by deploying Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) compared with Dense Deep Neural Networks (DDNNs). The study utilized a total sample size of 5840 collected from Kaggle repository. With a G Power having $80 \%$ value of $\alpha$ being $0.05 \%$ and $\beta$ value $0.02 \%$ and a $95 \%$ confidence interval, the algorithms have been split into two groups of 20 iterations, with 10 iterations per group. Group 1 consists of Novel Convolutional Neural Networks and Group 2 consists of Dense Deep Neural Networks. The Dense Deep Neural Network’s accuracy is $75.13 \%$ compared to $81.27 \%$ using a convolutional neural network. This study has found that statistically there is no statistical significance variation among the study groups over a difference of 0.405 (P>0.05). This study thus confirms that using CNN provides better accuracy in QoS than deep reinforcement.

articleTitle: Comparison of Image Quality Estimation Methods for JPEG Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper gives a comparative check of modern-day photograph pleasant estimation techniques for JPEG Compression. The techniques in comparison consist of No-Reference (NR) and full-Reference (FR) best metrics. For the FR approach, the Structural Similarity (SSIM), peak sign to Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Mutual statistics (MI) are evaluated. For the NR method, the Blind/Reference less photo spatial first-class Evaluator (BRISQUE) and visible information constancy (VIF) are taken into consideration. The overall performance of the FR and NR methods are as compared on 3 synthetic photograph datasets and an unbiased database containing natural snap shots. The outcomes received from the evaluation of those databases display that the SSIM yields the most correct effects for each synthetic images and actual natural photos. In contrast, the NR strategies carry out better for artificial photos but yield poorer results for herbal pictures in comparison to FR strategies. The paper concludes with an advice that SSIM can be used for each FR and NR image estimation.

articleTitle: Design of MEMS based Piezoelectric Energy Harvester to Power WSN in HVAC Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study investigates the design and simulation of a lead-free bimorph piezoelectric structure for harvesting energy from ambient vibrations commonly found in Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems. The harvester utilizes the piezoelectric effect to transform these vibrations into usable electrical power. The focus is on creating a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) compatible energy harvester specifically tailored for HVAC environments. By employing lead-free piezoelectric materials and optimizing the harvester’s geometry, the aim is to achieve efficient energy conversion at a resonant frequency of around 50 Hz, which aligns with the typical vibration range within HVAC units. COMSOL Multiphysics software was used to simulate the harvester’s behavior using the Finite Element Method (FEM). The analysis evaluated both the mechanical and electrical characteristics of the harvester. The mechanical analysis revealed a maximum vertical displacement of 30 nm and a maximum stress of $6 \times 10^{\wedge} 8 \mathrm{~N} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$ at the resonant frequency of 52 Hz. Under an acceleration of 1 g (equivalent to $9.81 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$) and at the resonant frequency, the harvester achieved a maximum output power of $366 \mu \mathrm{~W}$ and a voltage of 2.9 V, which is sufficient to power various sensor and WSN applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Examination for P2P Communication in Multi-hop Overlay Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: P2P communique in multi-hop overlay networks has emerged as increasingly important because of the growing call for green and comfy information transmission in numerous programs, file sharing, actual-time streaming, and online gaming. The prevailing solutions for P2P communique in multi-hop overlay networks are regularly afflicted by boundaries consisting of low performance, network congestion, and vulnerability to attacks. To cope with these challenges, a comprehensive exam is proposed to research and compare the overall performance and security of P2P communique in multi-hop overlay networks. This examination will focus on various elements, including routing protocols, facts dissemination techniques, congestion manipulation, and safety mechanisms. By conducting experiments on actual international networks and simulations, this examination aims to pick out and benchmark the strengths and weaknesses of different approaches in P2P conversation. The EfficientNet-V2-B3 model was chosen for its efficiency and effectiveness in image classification, especially through transfer learning. During training, the model was trained on 24,000 images in training set and their weights were adjusted to learn the unique characteristics of Indian birds. The validation set contained 6000 images and was used to monitor the performance of the model and prevent overfitting. The pre-trained EfficientNetB3 model was adjusted throughout the training phase using stochastic gradient descent and backpropagation. Measurements like accuracy and loss were monitored throughout several epochs during the training and validation phases to get insight into the model’s convergence. A confusion matrix, which provides a thorough perspective of classification accuracy and misclassifications across species, was used to examine the model’s performance. The confusion matrix created from the test results provides information on performance standards for each bird species, including several performance metrics. In test phase, the model classified images of Indian birds by species with 97% accuracy. This result highlights the effectiveness of the transfer learning methodology and the EfficientNet-V2-B3 architecture’s adaptability for challenging classification problems. The implications for ornithology and biodiversity preservation are profound since this automated technique streamlines the procedures for identifying species and improves the productivity of research. This study essentially proves the powerful synergy between deep learning and digital image processing.
