To stay aggressive, banks are continuously in search of ways to enhance purchaser satisfaction. One powerful technique is through the use of synthetic intelligence (AI)-driven algorithm optimization. Conventional banking processes regularly need more vital velocity, accuracy, and personalization to meet customers’ wishes and alternatives. With AI-pushed algorithm optimization, banks can examine enormous amounts of patron facts, together with transaction history, verbal exchange alternatives, and comments, to create exceptionally customized and green banking reviews. With the aid of utilizing AI algorithms, banks can perceive styles and behaviors to offer focused product suggestions and customized customer service. It no longer improves client pride and will increase go-selling opportunities for banks.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Benefits of Ad-hoc Deep Learning Algorithms in 5G Network Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ad-hoc deep studying algorithms have received interest lately for their capability to improve the accuracy of network site visitor prediction in 5G networks. In this paper, we examine the blessings of the use of an advert-hoc deep getting-to-know approach for 5G network traffic prediction, focusing on the use of long brief-term reminiscence (LSTM) networks. We check out the purpose of using ad-hoc deep gaining knowledge of techniques and present our approach for the use of them for visitor prediction. We then compare the performance of our proposed ad-hoc deep learning version by way of evaluating it with classical methods used for predicting 5G community traffic. We display that our model outperforms the classical methods in phrases of prediction accuracy, with mean absolute mistakes (MAEs) being decreased by up to 17. Three. We also observe the effects of different parameters on the version’s overall performance, including the range of layers and the dropout rate. Our outcomes display that increasing the number of layers and the scale of the dropout charge both had an impact on prediction accuracy, with an increase of as much as 0.8% and zero.85%, respectively. We finish that ad-hoc deep getting-to-know algorithms are powerful in predicting 5G community traffic and that their use can offer extensive advantages in facts-driven choice.

articleTitle: Applying Formal Methods to Maximize Power Efficiency in Embedded Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the increasing demand to make electronics ever smaller and more electricity efficient, embedded systems architectures have continued to evolve requiring new techniques for ensuring power efficiency of devices. The basic approach of this painting is to introduce how formal strategies have been used to improve energy performance on embedded architectures. Model-based strategies are used to edition architectural behavior and characteristics, crash protection, predictability through engineering verification (either by workflow or simulation), power performance. The power architectural structure and consumption are optimized by making powerful trade-offs between cost and space efficiency using the results of formal methods. The method proposed in this work is suitable for a wide range of embedded systems architectures and can easily be adapted to be implemented elsewhere on different structures. Although the paintings were not used to produce any software in colors and also have merits for these classes, this formal method can be a money-saver of energy consumption during the embedded systems development process with a reliability and performance guarantee.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Pipelined MIPS Processor with Nested Vectored Interrupt Controller (NVIC)
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: MIPS (abbr. Microprocessor without Interlocked Pipelined Stages) based Pipelined Processor is a RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) Processor [1][2]. The Processor is a 32-bit RISC Processor with the Data and Address Bus of 32-bit width. The Processor uses five hardware stages for its operation - Instruction Fetch (IF), Decode (ID), Execution (EX), Memory Access (MEM), and Write Back (WB). Pipelining is used to increase the instruction throughput thereby achieving efficient Performance. The Instruction Set Architecture for the MIPS is divided into 3 categories of Instruction Format - Register Type (R-type), Immediate Type (I-type), and Jump/Branch Type (J-type) [4][5]. Each of these Instruction types is characterized by distinct opcodes, source/destination register fields, shift amount, function, etc. Although there are inherent advantages of Pipelining, it also introduces Hazards due to the dependencies that occur between stages such as - Data Hazards, Control Hazards, Structural Hazards, etc. A dedicated forwarding unit solves this problem. The RTL is written in the Verilog Hardware Description Language (HDL) for several different modules such as the Memory, Register File, ALU as well as other key modules such as Forwarding Unit, Hazard Detection Unit, Stall Control Unit, etc. for solving Hazards and numerous other modules for the realization of the Pipelined MIPS Processor. The simulation is carried out using a set number of Instructions to realize the proper operation of the Processor with Pipelined execution. The second part of this Project activity is the design of a Nested Vectored Interrupt Controller (NVIC) [3][7]. The NVIC is used to provide the Nested Interrupt support. The NVIC can be operated in the Default mode as well as the Priority mode. The Priority mode can be used to program all the Internal/External Interrupts to different Priority levels. The RTL is written for both the MIPS Processor and the NVIC in the Intel Quartus® Prime FPGA Design Software. The Simulation is carried out using ModelSim HDL Simulator. This Design supports building robust applications making use of the Processor. The realization of complex applications is destined to be the part of Future Scope for this particular Processor design.

articleTitle: DQN-based Multi-user Multi-task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proliferation of complex applications has resulted in a significant increase in energy-intensive apps, exerting substantial pressure on device battery life. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC), an emerging technology, addresses this challenge. This paper aims to enhance battery life by minimizing energy consumption through efficient offloading decisions in a multi-user edge computing environment. Given the NP-hard nature of this problem, we propose a Deep Q Network (DQN) model with a prioritized experience replay buffer to optimize the solution. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated through extensive simulations and comparative analysis across various realistic environments. Experimental results demonstrate an average reduction in energy consumption ranging from 9% to 22%.

articleTitle: Prediction of U2R attack in Wireless Networks using Novel CNN Alexnet in Comparison with Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The main objective of proposed research is to employ DL (Deep Learning) models to predict User-to-Root (U2R) attack using CNN (Convolution Neural Network) Alexnet. In this study, the dataset used was obtained directly from the Github. The estimation of User-to-Root (U2R) attacks was based on a sample size of 22543, with 15 iterations that are from $1^{\text {st }}$ and $2^{\text {nd }}$ group respectively. The sample size for this experiment is determined with G-power analysis, with the power value for ($1-\beta$) is 0.8, where $\alpha$ and $\beta$ values are 0.05 and 0.2, respectively, with the 95% confidence interval. Both Novel CNN Alexnet and Random Forest were employed for the prediction of U2R attacks using the same sample size ($\mathrm{N}=15$). The accuracy of the suggested approach is validated at 92.4060%, surpassing the benchmarks set by Novel Convolutional Neural Network Alexnet (CNN Alexnet) and Random Forest, which achieve accuracies of 85.5180% and 92.4060%, respectively. Notably, there is a significant difference between the two methods. This observation is corroborated by a significance value ($\mathbf{p}$-value) of 0.261, determined through the Independent T-test samples, with the value $\mathrm{pf} \mathbf{p}$ greater than $\mathbf{0. 0 5}$. Thus, our results are suggesting that the algorithm’s performance is statistically not significant. This suggested study method results states that it has been determined that the produced Novel CNN Alexnet model performs higher than the RF classifier in the prediction of User-to-Root (U2R) attacks using data banks.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Netwok Based Energy-Efficient Clustering Algorithm for Enabled Smart Cities Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s era, technology is being used in various fields. The exercise of making various cities more advanced has been done by the government for a long time. Efficient data communication and reliable network play an important role in these technological advances. It is very important for the network to be efficient to bring and carry data from one place to another and the efficiency of the network depends on the protocols being followed in the network. This paper explicitly focuses on the protocols of the Low-energy adaptive clustering hierarchy (LEACH) family such as traditional LEACH, LEACH-centralized (LEACH-C) and compared with LEACH-optimized (LEACH-OP), by which the shortcomings of Cluster Head (CH) selection, energy consumption in excess. The analysis shows that, LEACH-OP outperforms in terms of maximum alive nodes, least dead nodes, maximum transfer of data packets, maximum energy saving, and long term operation capability.

articleTitle: Automated and Simplified Waste Segregation System Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Python
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study introduces a novel strategy for waste segregation employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Python programming. By harnessing CNNs’ image feature extraction capabilities, the method aims to create a streamlined and automated waste segregation system. The process involves gathering image data of waste, preprocessing with CNN algorithms, and extracting features to distinguish various waste types. Statistical and machine learning algorithms are then utilized to analyze these features, facilitating precise waste classification and segregation. Python serves as the implementation platform, benefiting from its rich libraries in image processing, deep learning, and data manipulation. This approach offers flexibility and accessibility, empowering researchers and waste management professionals to craft tailored and efficient segregation algorithms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Trust in Wireless Ad-Hoc Network Applications Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This look investigates the utility of blockchain technology for reinforcing consideration in Wi-Fi networks. Networks are verbal exchange networks shaped on-the-fly, requiring no predefined infrastructure for dependable verbal exchange of facts. With the boom in IoT gadgets, wireless sensors, linked buses, and drones, the quantity of networks is anticipated to increase. The security and trustworthiness of networks rely on the trustworthiness of the nodes within the network, and this turns into a chief difficulty in ad-hoc networks. The proposed approach looks at the usage of the benefits of the blockchain era along with disbursed garages, clever contracts, and cryptography to enhance consideration in networks. The blockchain generation can validate the beginning and integrity of facts and assist an agreed/popular device, which would provide a straightforward manner for the nodes in an ad-hoc network to believe every difference. Wi-Fi ad-hoc networks are prone to malicious attacks because of the decentralized and allotted environment..

articleTitle: The Effect of Music Therapy on Elderly using EPOC EMOTIV EEG Signals for Healthy Happy Years
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Music relates to many healing solutions of the human brain. It is a known that the human brain signals are highly governed by music therapy for many solutions like depression, sleep problems, anxiety or, emotional set down. This paper is an approach to find out the music stimuli on older people for distinct frequencies of their emotional state. Ten elderly (8 males and two females, mean $78, \mathrm{SD}=5.4$) within normal conditions inappropriate eight times of meeting for 20 minutes at least. We acquired the EEG signals through the EPC EEG EMOTIV system with 14 channels. In all the sittings, the subjects were maintained at favorable positions focusing that the sound of the music was evident. The system was noticed to be forwarded with increasing sound levels and arousals with valence conditions. The analysis showed the system’s efficiency and a significant drop of alpha signals in the left lobe (p =0.00007), which may be identified as a decline in depression state. The subjects also indicated that there had been a gradual increase in their sleep activities too with the music.

articleTitle: Endpoint Detection and Response for Fileless Malware and LOLBin Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The escalating threat posed by fileless attacks and Living-off-the-Land (LotL) techniques underscores the need for advanced detection mechanisms in cybersecurity. Fileless attacks circumvent traditional antivirus detection by operating within system memory, leveraging trusted tools and evading scrutiny. Concurrently, LotL attacks utilize system-integrated binaries to infiltrate and persist within systems, challenging detection methodologies. This study addresses these challenges by proposing a novel method for identifying Living off-the-land binaries and fileless malware patterns. Leveraging behavioral analysis in conjunction with YARA rules, the approach involves developing a script, for malicious instances and events in the system. Executing the script in controlled environments with malware simulations, the script demonstrated promising capabilities in detecting the malwares.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Combinatorial Auction Mechanism and Fixed Price Mechanism in the Trading of Electronic Products in the Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emergence of the Metaverse has revolutionized digital economies, providing a virtual space where users interact, create, and exchange digital assets. In this paper, we investigate the application of Combinatorial Auction Mechanism (CAM) in the selling of electronic products within the Metaverse. We explore the efficiency and effectiveness of CAM compared to Fixed-Price Mechanism (FPM), considering the unique characteristics of the Metaverse environment. Through this comparative analysis, we aim to provide insights into the suitability of these mechanisms for electronic product sales in the Metaverse and offer recommendations for optimizing transaction processes.

articleTitle: Using CCTV Footage for Anamoly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The requirement for constant monitoring of CCTV surveillance footage becomes essential in response to the rising number of real-time incidents of fraudulent and offensive behaviours. The huge amount of footage that needs to be evaluated makes human surveillance unfeasible. Identifying and evaluating frames or segments of the recordings that exhibit unusual or suspicious behaviour should also be done promptly. In order to overcome these obstacles, this study uses a variety of Machine Learning models, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long-term Recurrent Convolutional Networks (LRCN), to identify violent indicators in real-time. On labelled datasets with instances of both violent and non-violent behaviour, the Deep Learning models are trained. The models are able to identify objects by using CNNs to extract pertinent data from video frames. In order to provide a thorough picture of the activities, LRCNs are utilized to evaluate the frame sequence and capture temporal dependencies. Through the use of these Deep Learning models, the project hopes to offer a quick and automatic way to recognize and report unusual or suspicious activity. By allowing them to concentrate on particular frames or segments of the recordings that call for quick evaluation or action, this technology helps security staff monitor surveillance footage more effectively. In real-time monitoring situations, the ultimate objective is to strengthen security protocols, enable prompt response, and raise public safety.

articleTitle: Effective Side-Channel Attacks for Cryptographic Keys
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical summary examines effective aspect-channel assaults for cryptographic keys. Facet-channel assaults involve acquiring cryptographic keys or other personal statistics by observing patterns in the target gadget’s conduct or the environment it operates. Generally speaking, side-channel assaults awareness on measuring or analyzing the goal device’s bodily or electrical traits, which include power consumption, electromagnetic radiation, or statistics transfers. Such techniques are normally used to acquire the keys used to encrypt or decrypt information on an at-ease gadget, as well as many other sensitive secrets. This technical summary affords an overview of the most commonplace types of facet-channel attacks, as well as how they can be averted and strategically mitigated. It highlights recent studies on the subject, including new strategies for attack resilience and the growing sophistication of attackers.

articleTitle: ASEGAA: Leveraging Attention in Emotion, Gender and Age Analysis from Speech
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper investigates the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in speech classification tasks for predicting age, gender, and emotion. Despite the success of attention in multimodal systems, its applicability to speech context preservation remains underexplored. We examine this using the SEGAA model alongside our ASEGAA (Attention in Speech Emotion Gender and Age Analysis) models. Experiments on CREMAD and EMO-DB datasets reveal challenges in capturing speech context due to limited MFCC correlation. Speech attention models struggle to maintain context, leading to reduced accuracy compared to non-attention speech models. The results highlight the significance of feature selection and advocate for further exploration of alternative mechanisms. In terms of F1 scores, the multi-output SEGAA model achieves relatively high scores across age, emotion, and gender prediction tasks. However, attention mechanisms such as ASEGAA attention at end and ASEGAA Interspersed Attention exhibit fluctuating F1 scores, suggesting differing impacts on context preservation across the prediction tasks.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for SMS Spam Detection: A Privacy-Focused Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Herein proposes a new classification technique of SMS spam within a federated learning system, based on which the process occurs on the user’s device. The objective is to realize the perfect balance of the two; on the one hand, it should be proactive with spam detection, and on the other hand, it should have the highest respect for privacy protection. Our research demonstrates that this method has significantly boosted classification accuracy without privacy issues by equating an appropriate evaluation technique for extensive testing and assessment. The statistical analysis shows that our federated learning algorithm significantly reduces loss; according to the statistical analysis results, this value increases from 0.267 to 0.389 from the first to the tenth epoch. Also, the system reveals that this mechanics remains excellent and keeps showing values of more than ${9 0 \%}$, and the third epoch shows nothing but a high accuracy value of ${9 8. 3 \%}$. In effect, we analyze the cornerstone of our knowledge based on the method of the critical priorities potentially tightened privacy protection for federated learning. The federated learning solution offers a transparent approach that enables users to access essential services directly on their devices, and then the trained machine learning models are merged securely. This study underscores the competency to differentiate spam from anything useful in electronic communication and considers it a significant issue as regards privacy protection. The outcome gives a sense of hope in the idea of federated learning to have specific SMS spam. It creates a good gap between effectiveness and privacy protection, which is especially important considering that mobile communication covers a vast territory today.

articleTitle: Identification of variables in algorithms for natural language processing in the field of biological text mining
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Herbal language processing (HLP) algorithms are increasingly being used to enable computerized text mining of organic texts. NLP algorithms allow the automatic preprocessing, feature extraction, and interpretation of biological texts, which could help in the identity of biological sequences, systems, and activities. One of the key components of effective NLP algorithms is the identity of variables that are applicable to the project at hand, including the varieties of organic entities and activities cited within the textual content. The identity of variables is essential to make certain that the text is efficaciously interpreted and represented and to permit accurate mining consequences. A number of techniques are to be had to become aware of such variables, which include using supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised getting-to-know techniques. For instance, supervised gaining knowledge of strategies, along with device getting-to-know algorithms, may be used to become aware of training and homes from a categorized dataset. Alternatively, unsupervised getting-to-know techniques, together with subject matter modeling tactics, may be used to perceive relevant training and houses from an unlabeled dataset. In addition, feature extraction algorithms, inclusive of element-of-speech (POS) tagging, may be used to identify relevant terms and phrases from the textual content.

articleTitle: On – Device Translation of Dynamically Typed and Interpreted Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: On Device - translation of expression form languages with dynamic nature and using interpreted languages like MATLAB and Python requires a precise and automated form of processing the error-free conversion. With the help of the automation, the code in MATLAB is well-defined to Python so that translation is precise and the originality as well as functionality is ensured. This paper describes a robust and redundant methodology for converting maintaining the functionality and originality of the MATLAB code helping in smooth transition of code from MATLAB to python. The procedure being entirely local also ensures to protect privacy of the code.

articleTitle: Refining X-ray Image Classification Using GANs and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Prediction and diagnosis of many medical conditions have leveled up with the introduction of medical imaging for diagnosis by improving the prediction and analysis of the patient’s issues at an early stage. One of the most used medical imaging techniques is X-rays which are used to detect bone fractures, ligament displacements, and other issues. This is one of the fastest methods to get the body part images and analyze them promptly. Here, the study focuses on categorizing the X-ray images as normal and abnormal by infusing synthetic data generated by Generative adversarial Networks, this is done by taking a sample of noisy data. Synthetic data helps in balancing the data. Thereafter CNN is deployed for building the model classifies the x-ray classes as pneumonia ‘170’ and normal ‘170’ with 84% accuracy, that is high when compared to the existing methods. The accuracy can be further increased by taking large data samples.

articleTitle: Effect of Nutritional Diet on Malnourished Pregnant Mothers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pregnancy is the most valuable event in a women life Malnutrition in the pregnancy time is the most important problem for the future development of the fetus. So for outcome of normal healthy baby a proper nutritional balance should be maintained by the pregnant mother. Present study aims to prepare a proper nutritional diet for the pregnant mother and explore the effects of this diet on pregnant mother (for outcome of a healthy baby.) Present study was conducted on the 50 mothers of Institute of Indian mother & child, Sonargaon, South 24 Parganas. Out of them 25 mothers were taken as control group and rest 25 were taken as experimental group. Experimental group was fed nutritional diet with normal diet but control group took only the normal diet. It was observed that the experimental group had much more weight gain and greater fundal height change than the control group. This study clearly shows the efficacy of a supplementary nutritional diet for pregnant mother and also proved the fact that Supplementary nutritional diet along with the normal diet will improve the pregnancy status of pregnant mother which will help for the outcome of a healthy baby.

articleTitle: Impacts of Fake Reviews on Dietary Supplements and Healthcare Products in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital landscape, the prevalence of misinformation is a pressing concern, particularly on social media platforms where approximately $42.8 \%$ of shared content is identified as inaccurate and fake, as highlighted by a 2019 study from Loughborough University’s Online Civic Culture Centre. This phenomenon extends beyond mere inconvenience, with false information on political issues and product reviews posing significant threats to societal trust, business integrity, and political discourse. Furthermore, “The State of Fake Reviews - Statistics and Trends” by InvespCRO (2023) underscores a concerning trend: the steady rise in fake reviews from 2019 to 2023, indicative of a persistent challenge in maintaining online authenticity. This article delves into the intriguing world of online reviews, focusing specifically on the impact of falsified reviews within the realm of supplements and health products. With the power to sway consumer opinions and shape company reputations, false reviews wield considerable influence, often distorting market perceptions and consumer choices. By immersing ourselves in a hypothetical scenario where a product garners an alluring yet deceitful review, we unravel the ripple effects across various sectors, illuminating the far-reaching consequences of deceptive practices.

articleTitle: Enhanced Task Scheduling in Cloud Computing: A Comparative Analysis and Hybrid Algorithm Implementation Using CloudSim
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Task scheduling is crucial in cloud environments to optimize resource allocation and performance. This research presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of task scheduling algorithms, that includes First-Come-First Serve (FCFS), Shortest Job First (SJF), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). FCFS schedules tasks based on their arrival order, SJF prioritizes tasks based on the shortest execution time, and GA and PSO use metaheuristic approaches that use evolutionary methods for optimization. The hybrid algorithm is proposed combining SJF and GA to improve scheduling efficiency. The main objective is to improve the performance of task-scheduling algorithms in cloud environments. The performance of the individual algorithms and of the proposed hybrid algorithm are analyzed under static and dynamic workload scenarios. Metrics such as makespan and response time are evaluated using simulations.

articleTitle: Proprietor: A Farmer Assistance Smartphone Application with Crop Planner, Crop Disease Help, Agri-expert Search, and Crop Suggestion Features
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Farmers contribute significantly to a country’s food security by producing fresh fruits and crops. Farmers are no longer profitable from crop cultivation due to a lack of funding, inadequate crop cultivation support from the government, rising crop cultivation costs, and frequent natural disasters. Previous farmer assistance papers did not include the development of an intelligent ICT-based smartphone application for farmers, which included an online crop selling feature, seed and fertilizer search, weather information, crop care alert, agri-expert search, agriculture training, farmer loan application, crop price listing, and crop seller store search feature. To obliterate the shortcomings, this work develops an intelligent farmer assistance smartphone application with online crop selling, crop planner, location-based seed and fertilizer seller search, weather information, location and expertise-based agri-expert search, online loan application, question submission, location- and topicbased agriculture training search, crop disease help, prioritybased crop suggestion, fertilizer recommendation, and crop price listing features. The farmer evaluation-based app practicality and feature adequacy analysis displays that at least 56 percent of users dispatch impressive remarks on the merits of our proposed farmer assistance application.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Advanced Algorithmic Solutions on Quality Control Practices of MNCs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The fast evolution of technology and the availability of huge datasets have enabled the improvement of extra sophisticated algorithms and equipment to improve the efficacy of best management practices amongst multinational corporations (MNCs). Advanced algorithms, which include system getting-to-know and synthetic Intelligence (AI), have been used to improve the effectiveness of first-class manipulation within MNCs by automating techniques, detecting anomalies, optimizing useful resource allocation, and more. This paper explores the impact of advanced algorithmic answers on best management practices within MNCs. The research objectives are to have a look at the consequences of the usage of superior algorithms on the processes and practice of best control within MNCs. A case study method changed into follows that specializes in 3 big MNCs. A survey was carried out with first-class manage employees at every organization to determine their perceptions of advanced algorithms’ impact.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based Security System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Face recognition technology has made incredible strides and is now widely used for security and surveillance applications. Traditional door locks, such as pin locks, RFID locks, remote locks, and fingerprint sensors, are more vulnerable to intrusion. These devices’ dependability is further compromised by issues like wet fingers or remote malfunctions. This research suggests a security mechanism that uses face recognition to get around these limitations. Users only need to stand in front of doors to easily unlock them. A Raspberry Pi 3, Pi camera, solenoid lock, and relay module make up the system. Using the OpenCV and Haar Cascade Classifiers techniques, the Pi camera records images for the face recognition model training. With the Raspberry Pi, automated unlocking is made possible after successful identification. Additionally, the system records the faces, dates, and times of any unauthorised entry attempts. To improve security, this data offers documentation and reporting. The suggested method can be used in homes, offices, labs, colleges, and other places with restricted entry.

articleTitle: AI based Frame Interpolation Using OneVPL
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing popularity of multimedia content, particularly videos, has highlighted the significance of compression methods like HEVC and H.264, which effectively reduce file sizes without compromising quality. However, in the encoding and decoding process, hardware malfunctions or other issues may lead to frame loss, affecting frame rates and overall quality. To mitigate this problem, interpolation techniques are utilized to insert frames and maintain smooth playback. This method employs Artificial Intelligence (AI), specifically a trained Frame Interpolation for Large Motion (FILM) model, to generate intermediate frames by analyzing pairs of input images. This technique ensures seamless motion and enhances video quality despite frame loss during encoding and decoding. This work develops a pipeline using the FILM model and hardware acceleration to generate smooth videos. Testing demonstrates a 4x improvement in visual quality over raw input, setting a new standard for video interpolation and processing in multimedia applications.

articleTitle: Enhanced Brain Tumor Segmentation Using Improved U-Net Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In medical imaging, precise brain tumor segmentation is essential for efficient diagnosis and therapy planning. In this regard, U-net based technique is proposed to improve brain tumor segmentation by architectural modifications to the U-Net. With the addition of characteristics including residual connections, attention mechanisms, and deeper network architecture, the proposed U-Net based technique produces a more reliable and accurate segmentation of tumor areas. The above added characteristics in the proposed U-net architecture help in dealing with challenges in capturing the intricate details and spatial complexities inherent in brain tumor delineation. The proposed modifications enhance the model’s ability to discern important features crucial for accurate segmentation. The popular Figshare brain MRI images dataset is utilized to train and assess the suggested architecture. Through experimentation, a significant improvement in segmentation accuracy is achieved as compared to conventional U-Net models. Also, various evaluation metrics including the Percentage of Misclassification (PM), Dice coefficient (DC), Variance of Information (VI), Model Accuracy, and Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) are evaluated to quantify the performance improvement, achieved with the proposed enhanced architecture. By focusing on the enhancement of the U-Net architecture specifically for brain tumor detection, this research contributes to the continuous evolution of methodologies that hold promise for improving clinical outcomes in neuro-oncology.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Fake News Detection Using LDA and QDA
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital age, the rise of online media has made information readily accessible, but it has also facilitated the rapid spread of fake news. This phenomenon undermines trust in reliable news sources and fosters confusion among the public. Consequently, individuals must exercise caution when sharing information, verifying its credibility to prevent the spread of false information and uphold the trustworthiness of reputable channels. A highly accurate system has been designed to detect fake news efficiently and with a high level of accuracy. In this paper, an enhanced approach is suggested for classification based on the Linear Discriminant Analysis and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis models, some advanced methods that help fight against fake media stories. A number of natural language processing techniques, including tokenization, stop word removal, and URL and HTML tag removal, were applied to a comprehensive dataset of fake news collections. For the purpose of classification, two models-Linear Discriminant Analysis and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis models-were applied for the correct detection of fake news. In order to evaluate effectiveness, performance measures such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, confusion matrix, and ROC curve were critically analyzed. The accuracy of LDA is 97%, while QDA achieves 67%. This paper attempts to provide a step toward efforts engaged in fighting misinformation in the digital age and trying to keep reliable news sources intact.

articleTitle: Bangla Hand-Written Digit Recognition Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There are a lot of works on English handwritten materials but not seen so much work on Bangla handwritten recognition. Bangla handwritten digits have more complex and diverse shapes and also have high inter-class similarities. So it is more challenging to recognize Bangla handwritten digits. The paper focuses on improving the lack of Bangla handwritten digit recognition approach using deep learning models. In the research, we have developed three deep learning-based models, CNN, DenseNet121, and ResNet50 to recognize Bangla digits. To make our work efficient we have used two existing BanglaLekha-Isolated-Numerics and Ekush datasets along with a new dataset that is collected by our team. We tested the three models on each dataset and achieved remarkable performance in all the datasets. Among the models, DenseNet121 outperformed on every dataset. DenseNet121 achieved 99.09% test accuracy on the Ekush dataset and 97.65% test accuracy on our developed dataset.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Tea Leaf Disease Detection: Comparing VGG16, Vision Transformer, EfficientNetB3, and Xception
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The need for efficient disease management in crop production is highlighted by the economic relevance of agriculture. Various leaf diseases cause major losses for tea, a staple product in many places. articleTitle: Linking Future Soil Erosion and Sediment Yield in the Upper Cauvery Sub-basin: A Modeling Framework Using CMIP6 Data

abstract: Soil erosion is an environmental threat resulting from the combined effects of geo-environmental factors and human activities, affecting the sustainability of land and water resources. This study focused on the climate change impact assessment on soil erosion and sediment yield by adopting RUSLESY (RUSLE-sediment yield) model in Upper Cauvery Sub-basin. The spatio-temporal variations are quantified using data from the global climatic models (GCMs) HadGem3-GC31-LL, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MIROC6, CMCC-ESM2, and BCC-CSM2-MR for the year 2050, for medium (SSP2-4.5) and high emission (SSP58.5) scenarios. Current soil loss and sediment yield rates in Sub-basin are $10,177 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{ha} / \mathrm{yr}$ and $1,842 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{yr}$ respectively. The projected severe soil erosion and sediment yield rates in the Sub-basin in 2050 for the two SSPs are $37,217 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{ha} / \mathbf{y r}$ and $\mathbf{6, 7 3 6} \mathbf{t} / \mathbf{y r}$; $38,253 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{ha} / \mathrm{yr}$ and $6,924 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{yr}$ respectively. The results show an increase in soil erosion rates compared to the current period, with amounts of $27,040 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{ha} / \mathbf{y r}$ and $28,076 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{ha} / \mathrm{yr}$. Sediment yields for two scenarios also will increase, with values of $4,894 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{yr}$ and $5,082 \mathrm{t} / \mathrm{yr}$ respectively. The study’s findings can help policymakers develop appropriate climate mitigation strategies for the impacted community. This study serves as a pilot project in the Western Ghats of Karnataka and can be replicated in comparable geo-environmental settings.

articleTitle: Predicting Hotel Booking Cancellations using Machine Learning Techniques

articleTitle: Gate controllability enhancement in various GAA MOSFETS and their dependence on various parameters

articleTitle: Multi-Label Remote Sensing Image Classification using MobileNetV2

abstract: Aerial scene imagery captured by remote sensing satellites are often tagged with multiple scene labels. In this paper, we suggest a deep learning framework based on the lightweight MobileNetV2 architecture that is pre-trained on millions of images from the ImageNet dataset, for classifying multi-label remote sensing images subsequent to haze removal, by the medium of transfer learning. The framework employs one-hot encoding of the multiple class labels associated with a satellite image during the training phase. At the network output, the threshold for posterior class probabilities associated with multiple scene labels is adjusted for optimal prediction. We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach on the Planet dataset using the F-beta score (beta=2), with comparisons to deep learning architectures such as Vision Transformer (ViT), Resnet-50, Inception-v3 and DenseNet-121. The proposed framework with MobileNetV2 as its backbone achieves the highest F-beta score of 0.9275, outperforming all other models for the multi-label remote sensing image classification task.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization of Fractional and Non-Linear PID Controllers for Trajectory Tracking of a 3-Link Robotic Manipulator

articleTitle: Joint Symbol Timing and Frequency Offset Estimation Using Zero Correlation Zone Sequence for RIS-assisted OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Every communication system necessitates synchronization between the transceiver pair to ensure optimal performance at the receiver end. Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems are also susceptible to the synchronization error, i.e., symbol timing offset (STO) and carrier frequency offset (CFO), Similar to conventional OFDM systems. Various techniques have been developed for estimating STO and CFO for OFDM systems. However, these existing methods do not specifically address the combined impact of STO and CFO in RIS-assisted OFDM systems. Motivated by this, we propose a joint STO and CFO estimator based on the zero correlation zone (ZCZ) sequence for RIS-assisted OFDM systems operating in a Rayleigh fading environment. The ZCZ sequences show ideal correlation properties in a zone. In terms of mean squared error (MSE), simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms other existing techniques. The bit error rate (BER) plot demonstrates that the proposed method is robust and effective against varying CFO and STO values after compensation.

articleTitle: Integrated Analysis of Remote Sensing Imagery for Geological Characterization of Volcanic Terrain: A Focus on Lithology, Geomorphology, and Structure

abstract: This study employs advanced radar imaging techniques to conduct a comprehensive analysis of a volcanic terrain, unraveling its geological intricacies through the lenses of lithology, geomorphology, and structural features. The research harnesses the power of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data to provide unprecedented insights into the Earth’s surface, facilitating a holistic understanding of the volcanic landscape. The investigation begins with the utilization of radar backscatter data to discern lithological variations within the volcanic terrain. Additionally, the analysis extends to geomorphological features, employing radar imagery to delineate landforms associated with volcanic activity such as lava flows, calderas, and volcanic cones. Furthermore, the study delves into the structural characteristics of the volcanic terrain, employing radar interferometry techniques to detect and quantify ground deformation associated with identification of fault lines, fractures, and other structural anomalies that contribute to the overall geological context. To achieve this, the study introduces a novel hybrid clustering model that enhances the integration of the Fuzzy Clustering Means algorithm, which is used for efficient clustering, with the Particle Swarm Optimization technique, which is utilized for feature optimization. This new method aims to improve the selectivity, responsiveness, and precision of the clustering process. The proposed model’s performance, in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity, was benchmarked against other state-of-the-art hybrid techniques, including K meansC4.5 and ANN+FNN.

articleTitle: An Intelligence Crop Recommendation System using Machine Learning that predicts crop suitability by various factors
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The importance of agriculture to India’s economy emphasizes the necessity of efficient crop-cultivation techniques. Older techniques, which mostly depend on farmers’ practical knowledge, are progressively going out of style. A system of recommendations that utilizes ML techniques including k-Nearest Neighbor, DT, Random Forest and GB has been created to get to address this. By helping farmers choose the best crops based on properties of the soil, this approach eventually increases agricultural yield overall. A hybrid Crop Recommendation System designed specifically for the states of South India has been created as part of a parallel research program. Numerous factors, such as soil type, rainfall, groundwater level, temperature, fertilizers, pesticides, and season, are considered in this extensive model aided by a classifier machine learning system, this hybrid strategy suggests crops that work well with the local climate and topography. The technology-driven method has practical significance beyond crop yield maximization. It does this by providing farmers with regular updates on crop yield production values, guiding agricultural decisions, and informing them of any changes in market rates. The efficacy of the suggested hybrid recommender model is applicable to a number of agricultural problems, such as a rating system for identifying crop quality and a group of classifiers for well-informed decision-making. These cooperative projects seek to enhance agricultural output, update crop selection techniques, and support India’s economic development.

articleTitle: Evolution of Incense Stick Holder Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Incense sticks, commonly known as agarbatti or joss sticks, have a rich history spanning various cultures and traditions, revered for their aromatic qualities and spiritual symbolisms. These slender bamboo sticks, infused with fragrant blends of gums, resins, essential oils, and spices, serve as potent tools for enhancing ambience and facilitating spiritual practices. Complementing the traditional use of incense sticks, the pebble incense stand presents a modern solution that amalgamates functionality and aesthetics. Featuring distinct pebbles for secure incense placement and elegant covering, the stand offers a harmonious balance of safety, convenience, and visual allure. Its innovative design facilitates effortless incense burning while minimizing the risk of accidents, making it an ideal choice for both practical use and decorative purposes.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Scour Depth Prediction and Pier Strength Assessment Utilizing Piezoelectric Sensor Data in Riverine Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Scour refers to the process of erosion or removal of sediment, such as sand or soil, from the riverbed around the piers. This can occur due to the force of flowing water, especially in areas with strong currents. Scouring around piers is a common concern in civil engineering and bridge design, as excessive scour can undermine the stability of the structure. Engineers use mathematical models and formulas to predict the potential depth of scour around piers based on factors like flow velocity and sediment characteristics. Structures such as riprap (large rocks), scour aprons, or other erosion-resistant materials may be used to protect piers from excessive scour. In this proposed work, piezo electric sensors used to measure the scour depth around piers in a river. The real time datas are collected through sensors and processed through Arduino UNO board. The collected data are processed at remote end and necessary decisions can be taken. Using this monitoring system the strength of the pillars of a bridge is ananlysed and accidents can be prevented.

articleTitle: Advancement in Virtual Fitting Rooms: Integrating AI for Enhanced Online Shopping Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This innovative research reveals a ground-breaking technique for creating an immersive virtual changing room experience using only the user’s supplied 2D images—no 3D components are required at all. This project offers a creative way to create a virtual dressing room experience at home using a particular technological stack designed for 2D view processing and the VITON dataset. Using deep learning techniques such as OpenPose, U2Net, and ResNet101, the system analyzes the user’s photos, identifying fine body details and carefully extracting them from the surrounding landscape. The user’s distinct body form is then rebuilt and the virtual drape of clothing is synchronized using these identified body landmarks as anchor points. The technology, which is controlled by a geometric module, creates a beautiful effect by enveloping clothes around the virtual outline of the user. This ensures that the clothing is accurately represented as it would naturally fit their body. The visual ambience of the virtual world is further enhanced by an inventive alias generator that adds contextual background information. With its innovative method, virtual fashion exploration enters a new era. Users will be able to try on a wide variety of outfits with unmatched accuracy and intuitive ease, all without the hassles and complexity of 3D modeling. The result will be a seamless and incredibly engaging virtual dressing experience. The user only has to take two pictures using a camera or smartphone as part of this easy, quick, and effective procedure.

articleTitle: Detection and Localization of Intracranial Vascular Occlusions Using 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Intracranial vascular occlusions (IVOs) are a main purpose of stroke and can result in intense disabilities or death. Early detection and localization of IVOs is critical to decrease destructive effects. The maximum commonly used modality for imaging of the intracranial vasculature is three-dimensional magnetic resonance imaging (3-D MRI). This modality allows for volumetric imaging of the vessels which permits the detection and localization of IVOs. In this examine, we’ve got evolved a novel approach which is predicated on 3D MRI images for the automated detection and localization of IVOs. We’ve got used a Convolutional Neural community (CNN) with a deep getting to know technique. This network was skilled on a database of 3D MRI pics, and turned into able to appropriately discover and discover IVOs. The results from our technique showed that it turned into capable of locate each unmarried and a couple of IVOs with an excessive accuracy charge. Moreover, our technique confirmed sensitivity and specificity above ninety four%, highlighting its precision for the detection and localization of IVOs. Our look at has shed light on the ability of automatic detection and localization of IVOs from 3-D MR pix.

articleTitle: Profiling Industrial 3D Parts with Complex Shapes Using 2D Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Commercial 3-D element profiling via second imagery is a modern technique to acquire the 3-D geometric characteristics of quite complicated shapes frequently encountered in industrial additives. articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Pipelined Wallace-Tree Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This brief presents, the pipelining concept to implement the Wallace tree multiplier based on area delay and power (ADP) efficient carry select adder as a final additive unit for high speed, low power, and area efficient applications. Compared to the previous BEC-1-based 4-bit Wallace tree multiplier; the employed 4-bit Wallace tree multiplier reduces the number of gates by 17.43%. Further, the pipelined architecture when compared with the traditional architecture is 40% delay efficient. Synthesis results show that the traditional 8-bit Wallace tree multiplier operates at a maximum frequency of 76.63 MHZ whereas the pipelined-based 8-bit Wallace tree multiplier operates at a maximum frequency of 126.73 MHZ. Thus, by employing the pipelined architecture a remarkable throughput rate is achieved.

articleTitle: Forgery Detection In Handwritten Documents
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article introduces a novel method for handwritten document forgery detection based on Siamese neural networks. By training on pairings of authentic and forged document samples, the network learns to extract discriminative properties for distinguishing real from counterfeit instances. Our approach achieves higher accuracy and processing efficiency in experimental evaluations conducted on a benchmark dataset compared to both state-of-the-art and conventional approaches. The proposed Siamese neural network shows promise in automatically identifying forgeries, offering a dependable solution applicable to a wide range of fields requiring document verification and authentication. This research advances the field of document forensics and provides a pathway to enhanced security and reliability by leveraging deep learning techniques to solve the challenges in handwriting forgery detection.

articleTitle: BER Performance of Polar-coded FBMC-OQAM and OFDM over Rician and Rayleigh Flat Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Polar-coded multicarrier modulation schemes, which are relatively new in the realm of digital communication, are the subject of this study. This article specifically examines two multicarrier modulation schemes: offset quadrature amplitude modulation-based filter bank multicarrier (FBMCOQAM) and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). Nevertheless, there is little study on the performance of polar-coded multicarrier systems, especially for FBMCOQAM, or it is not comprehensive for OFDM. This study’s methodology comprises using MATLAB software to analyze the system error rate of polar-coded multicarrier systems in the presence of two realistic channel environments: Rayleigh and Rician. In the presence of fading, an extensive bit error rate (BER) analysis has been carried out. The simulation results demonstrate that using Polar codes for both OFDM and FBMCOQAM significantly improves BER. It has also been demonstrated that using random code interleavers can enhance the error-correcting capabilities of Polar codes. In particular, additional coding gain of up to 2 dB can be obtained in fading channels by employing random code interleavers. The significance of this research is that it contributes to the development of polar-coded multicarrier modulation systems and provides a more comprehensive understanding of their performance in Rician and Rayleigh channel environments. The findings of this research suggest that polar-coded multicarrier modulation systems have promising potential for future wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Classification of Various Stage of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Yolov7 Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a prevalent retinal vascular condition that can lead to significant visual impairment. The early classification of DR and precise grading of DR are essential for maintaining eyesight and providing prompt treatment, which is known as DR classification. The images go through a preprocessing stage to reduce noise from the dataset that was obtained. Initially, the input image is initiated by a preprocessing technique. This process is handled by the spatial processing technique called the Wiener Filter, which lowers image noise and raises the visibility of hazy images. The following step sends the image to the areas for segmentation. Fuzzy C-means (FCM) segmentation is used to accurately determine the size and shape of the disease. The proposed research uses the Deep Neural Network based YOLOV7 (DNN-YOLOV7) classifier. All five stages of diabetic retinopathy (DR) can be identified with this method: no DR, mild, moderate, severe, and proliferative DR (PDR). This research provides a high degree of sensitivity and precision in identifying whether a picture has diabetic retinopathy or not. The work involved is implemented with MATLAB simulation software.

articleTitle: Insights Into Object Recognition: a Comparative Study of Feature Detection and Matching Algorithms Using Kinect Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s rapidly evolving technological landscape, object recognition is a critical component of computer vision, impacting numerous fields such as robotics, surveillance, and augmented reality. Object recognition involves identifying and classifying semantic objects within digital images and videos. A fundamental aspect of this process is feature detection, which is essential for accurate recognition and matching. This paper presents a comparative analysis of various image matching algorithms, categorized into template-based, texture feature-based, and intensity-based methods. Specifically, we examine the performance of Edge-Oriented Gradient (EOG) for template-based matching, Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF) for texture-based matching, and entropy and mean for intensity-based matching. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of these algorithms in detecting and matching features under different transformations and deformations. Our study evaluates each algorithm’s matching accuracy and computational efficiency, identifying the optimal approach for specific object recognition scenarios.

articleTitle: Different Mobility Protocol Overview for Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) are utilized in a ramification of programs inclusive of business sensing structures, clever houses and towns, and vehicular networks. To enable efficient communications in these networks, exceptional mobility protocols have been advanced to aid network nodes actions and to provide effective connectivity. This abstract presents a top-level view of numerous mobility protocols in Wi-Fi mesh networks addressing traits such as node mobility support, direction efficiency, scalability, and verbal exchange fee. First, advert hoc routing protocols are one type of mobility protocol used to maximize the throughput of WMN nodes and aid communique amongst nodes as they trade their area. The maximum used protocols on this class are the destination Sequenced Distance Vector (DSDV) protocol and the Optimized hyperlink nation Routing (OLSR) protocol. Each of them provides efficient link establishment and maintain a dynamic course desk by way of exchanging periodic routing messages to update locations of all nodes within the community.

articleTitle: Outage Performance Analysis and Power Allocation in Multiuser RF/FSO Relaying System with Proportional Fair Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper considers a proportional fairness scheduling (PFS) scheme in a multiuser dual-hop radio frequency (RF)/ free space optical (FSO) relaying system to ensure fairness among users. The RF and FSO channels follow Rayleigh and Fisher-Snedecor $({\mathcal{F}})$ distributions respectively. We consider independent-non-identically distributed (i.n.i.d) co-channel interference (CCI) at the relay. Using the decode and forward (DF) relaying protocol, we evaluate analytical and asymptotic expressions for outage probability of the considered system. Additionally, power allocation is conducted under total power constraints to improve system performance. The results indicate that power allocation leads to a significant enhancement in the outage probability performance, with improvements of 1 dB or more. Monte Carlo simulations are also presented to support the accuracy of the formulated expressions.

articleTitle: Improving the field service ability of home appliances through Smart Diagnostics.
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project focuses on implementing a smart diagnostic system for home appliances, employing advanced technologies to automate fault detection. Utilizing sensors and self-diagnostic features within Appliance Control Unit, the system enables precise fault detection, reducing errors in diagnosis. The integration of user-friendly interfaces facilitates remote issue resolution for both users and technicians. The proposed solution not only ensures accurate fault detection but also helps to improve the Serviceability.It Facilitates consumers with seamless appliance usage, ensuring flawless performance. It also prioritizes user-friendly interfaces and continuous development for smarter diagnostics in variety of home appliances.

articleTitle: Analyzing Feeding Techniques of Microstrip Patch Antennas for NavIC Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Proposed study analyzing the performance of a patch antenna with different feeding techniques designed for NavIC applications. The overall performance of a patch antenna depends on suitable design and dimensions, material, impedance matching, and feeding techniques, etc., according to the operating frequency. As NavIC applications are increasing day by day, especially on the L band, the need for a low-profile antenna is increasing. Microstrip patch antennas are suitable for this purpose. The proposed work aims to achieve optimum performance based on feeding techniques for a patch antenna. Design and performance evaluation are conducted using CST Microwave Studio software. The resonant frequency is set to NavIC L5 band frequency, i.e., $\mathbf{1. 1 7 6} \mathbf{G H z} . \mathrm{FR}-4$ dielectric substrate is used for all designs. All antenna input parameters are kept the same for all designs except feeding techniques.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Generative Adversarial Networks for Accurate and Timely Cancer Detection in Smart Healthcare Systems

abstract: This research proposes the use of device studying and generative opposed networks (GANs) for powerful and timely detection of most cancers in smart healthcare structures. Device gaining knowledge of allows for a highly rapid and automated technique which could fast hit upon and verify a man or woman’s danger of growing cancer. Moreover, GANs may be educated to pick out essential most cancers biomarkers from acquired healthcare data consisting of imaging scans. The combination of each tactics provides an improved system for correctly and quickly detecting cancer in clever healthcare systems. articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Prosopis Juliflora on Water Level Depletion: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Prosopis Juliflora is an invasive and evergreen tree native to Mexico, South America, and the Caribbean. Originally brought to various regions of the world to combat issues with soil erosion, it has since grown to be a significant invader. This tree is mostly found in arid and semi-arid regions where other vegetation cannot thrive and withstand harsh environmental conditions. In heavily Prosopis-invaded areas, the tree’s deep root system is the cause of the depletion of groundwater resources. In this article, the impact of Prosopis Juliflora on the ecological resources of the country is reviewed and a survey is done on applying machine learning and deep learning approaches for forecasting groundwater level. This article provides a systematic analysis of the Prosopis Juliflora plant and insightful explanations of the challenges associated with the information available on colonization.

articleTitle: AudioGuard: Deep Learning Based Telugu DeepFake Audio Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent advancements in deep fake audio technology have led to the creation of highly realistic synthetic voices that mimic human speech patterns. However, this technology raises ethical concerns due to its potential for misuse, including spreading misinformation, identity theft, and undermining trust in audio evidences. To address these issues, this research focuses on developing a method to detect deep fake audio specifically in the Telugu language. This research utilizes various Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures like MobileNetV2, ResNet50, VGG16, and AlexNet to enhance accuracy and resilience. MobileNet achieved the highest accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 5 \%}$ and was chosen for deployment. The model is integrated into a user-friendly website using Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MongoDB. This web application serves as a comprehensive solution for detecting Telugu deep fake audio, prioritizing user security, ease of use, and accuracy.

articleTitle: Investigating Applications of Run Length Encoding in Data Compression & Source Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Run period Encoding (RLE) is a powerful and efficient approach for fact compression and supply coding. It is generally applied to the lossless compression of grayscale or bi-tonal (black-and-white) photos and digital pix. Significantly, RLE decreases the statistics required to save and transmit virtual facts. That is completed by making the information greater compact and casting off redundancy. Typically, RLE counts the number of consecutive occurrences of a given image or sign and then encodes those occurrences into an unmarried cost. By encoding multiple repetitions of a symbol in this manner, RLE can reduce the entire quantity of statistics wanted for garage or transmission. The RLE set of rules works by looking for long strings of characters that may be compressed into fewer characters. Exploring the potential packages of RLE in supply coding and records compression is an ongoing study subject matter within the area.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Applying AI Technologies to Improve Information Capture and Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emergence and implementation of synthetic intelligence (AI) technology are swiftly impacting the manner records is captured and retrieved. AI can be used to growth the accuracy of records series and facilitate well timed retrieval of statistics. With the help of AI technologies, companies can lessen guide labor costs and growth productivity. AI also can provide insights into how pleasant to save and get admission to applicable facts, whilst helping to develop greater green and dependable information seize and retrieval system. This paper seems at the potential blessings of making use of AI technology to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of facts. Examples of applications encompass natural language processing for textual content-based queries, object detection and reputation for picture and video datasets, and predictive analytics to provide context-based totally suggestions for facts retrieval. articleTitle: Optimizing Liver Segmentation with Enhanced U-Net Model and Preprocessing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the human body, the liver is the second largest organ, playing many vital functions such as productions of albumin and bile, regulates blood clotting, process glucose, filters blood and many more. Therefore, diseases related to the liver require quick attention. Segmentation of liver plays a crucial role in diagnosing liver diseases. To address this issue, a new U-Net based liver segmentation technique is presented in this paper. The study primarily focuses on two factors: firstly, preparing the dataset with suitable preprocessing techniques to obtain better enhanced and noise free images, and secondly, developing an enhanced U-Net model by fine tuning the hyperparameters and adding an appropriate number of convolution layers. The experiment is carried out on the 3D-IRCADb-01 dataset, and the model’s performance is analysed using the dice similarity coefficient (DSC). The performance of the proposed model, which combines preprocessing techniques and an enhanced U-Net, has demonstrated promising result of DSC of 97.78%, in the liver segmentation task.

The many sounds in an environment setting are classified using Machine learning algorithms. articleTitle: Managing Network Requirements in Distributed and Cooperative Media Algorithms

articleTitle: Advancements in Wearable Sensors to Analyze Gait Phases: Towards Efficient Rehabilitation

articleTitle: Improving Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems Using Haar Cascades in a Cloud-Based Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The advancement of hardware and software program sources in cloud networks has ended in extended heterogeneity on the multi-agent device degree. Hence, the performance of heterogeneous multi-agent systems (MAS) can decline in unpredictable approaches, making them useless or no longer scalable on cloud-primarily based records centers. Recent paintings have proposed the usage of a supervised getting-to-know approach based on Haar Cascades for enhancing MAS overall performance. Haar Cascades are a mixture of mathematical algorithms and fashions, in particular, designed for detecting shapes and styles in huge data units. With this method, the features of the MAS are used to teach a model of Haar Cascades, which is then used to discover essential styles within the statistics that may be used to permit the MAS to behave greater intelligently. As an example, the model can identify sources greater correctly, supporting the gadget to direction requests better and enhancing scalability. Furthermore, this technique makes it possible to create robust MAS architectures that can be resistant to various environmental situations and enter resources. In a cloud-primarily based statistics middle, Haar Cascades may be used to improve heterogeneous MAS overall performance via a number of one-of-a-kind techniques.

articleTitle: LFRViT: Laplacian Filter Residual-based Vision Transformer for Multiple Image Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: When producing a manipulative image, a forger can alter an image through a variety of image tampering techniques. Due to the need to test for various image editing operations and alterations, there has been a significant interest in developing a universal image forgery detection approach that can detect multiple tampering operations performed over an image. This paper presents a comprehensive forensic method for detecting manipulation using Vision Transformer. We present a novel network architecture called Laplacian Filter Residual-based Vision Transformer (LFRViT) that can automatically learn features for detecting manipulation from training data. Vision Transformers, as they are now designed, primarily to learn features that represent the content of an image rather than features that detect manipulation. To address this problem, we have created a novel type of model specifically designed to suppress the image’s content and dynamically acquire features for detecting manipulations. By conducting a sequence of studies, we provide evidence that our proposed method can automatically learn the features to identify various image alterations. The experimental findings demonstrate that our proposed model, LFRViT, is capable of autonomously identifying various types of manipulations with an accuracy of over $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$.

articleTitle: LSTM-based Deep Learning Model for Cyber-attack Detection Systems in the Internet of Drones
