articleTitle: Autonomous UAV-based Network Path Optimization for Telecommunications Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Self-sufficient UAV-based community path optimization for Telecommunications structures is a revolutionary method to enhance community overall performance at the brink of cell telecommunications networks. This approach utilizes unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to discover the most suitable community paths, screen and discover community congestion and outages, and automatically reconfigure network bottlenecks in real time. UAVs equipped with radio-frequency sensors, cameras, and other generations can offer quite accurate metrics from their vantage point and feed these into a machine-mastering optimized computerized route optimization set of rules. This set of rules is designed to discover congestion inside the network and promptly alter the routing in keeping with the greenest paths to be had at the time. With the capability to dynamically adjust the ideal path selection in real time, networks are able to manage congestion and reduce latency in delivering offerings to their clients.

articleTitle: An Innovative Feature Fusion driven Multi Disease Diagnosis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work addresses the critical challenge of accurately classifying three debilitating diseases Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and Diabetic Retinopathy by leveraging the power of Deep Learning models, specifically Visual Geometric Group (VGG-16) and EfficientNetB0. The primary focus is on enhancing classification accuracy through a novel approach feature fusion. The accurate identification of these diseases is crucial for early intervention and personalized treatment strategies. The proposed solution involves extracting distinctive features from VGG-16 and EfficientNetB0 independently and then fusing these features to create a unified and more robust model. Feature fusion aims to harness the complementary strengths of each model, thereby maximizing overall classification accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving higher accuracy compared to ensemble of the models. The predictive outputs generated by the model are used to formulate input prompts for the Large Language Model (LLM), which is ChatGPT, focusing on gathering insights and providing prevention tips.

articleTitle: Embracing Neurodiversity: Leveraging Brainwave Entrainment to Cultivate Artistic Abilities in Kids with Attention Differences
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aimed to investigate whether brainwave entrainment(BWE) could improve focus and sketching abilities in children with attention problems. Many children struggle to sustain focus during detailed tasks like art due to difficulties with attention. Brainwave entrainment using binaural beats has shown potential for increasing focus by driving brain waves into specific frequency ranges. This study involved 20 children ages 9-12 who had been diagnosed with attention issues, seven of them diagnosed with Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). They participated in a crossover design where they completed an art sketching task for 30 minutes. In condition one, they performed the task without BWE, and in another condition, they listened to theta frequency (8 Hz) binaural beats for 30 minutes daily during the sketching activity for 15 days. This activity was conducted under the observation of an expert art teacher to monitor efficiency. The study revealed promising outcomes regarding the effectiveness of BWE in enhancing focus and task performance. Participants diagnosed with ADHD exhibited a significant 75% improvement in task completion efficiency during the 15-20 minute phase when exposed to BWE, compared to only 15% improvement in the non-BWE control group. Notably, even participants without ADHD symptoms demonstrated a 50% efficiency increase with BWE. Furthermore, EEG analysis revealed a remarkable 7.65% reduction in the Theta/Beta Ratio (TBR) for the ADHD group after BWE, indicating improved attention and focus. The non-ADHD group also showed a 5.39% decrease in TBR, while the non-BWE control group exhibited minimal changes. These findings suggest that BWE techniques could benefit children with attention difficulties, aiding in focus, learning, and emotional regulation during academic and daily activities.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access in Orthogonal Time Frequency Space Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid growth of wireless communication demands innovative solutions to enhance spectral efficiency and accommodate the ever-increasing number of connected devices. One promising approach is the integration of Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) with Orthogonal Time Frequency Space Modulation (OTFS). This project focuses on the implementation and analysis of NOMA within the framework of OTFS, aiming to exploit the benefits of both techniques for improved performance in next-generation wireless systems. OTFS offers distinct advantages in multipath environments by leveraging the time-frequency domain, enabling robust communication even in challenging channel conditions. By introducing NOMA into OTFS, the system can further enhance spectral efficiency by serving multiple users simultaneously on the same resources, exploiting differences in their channel conditions and quality of service requirements. The project involves designing and implementing algorithms for NOMA within the OTFS framework, considering factors such as user pairing, power allocation, and decoding strategies. Performance evaluation will be conducted through simulations and possibly real-world experiments to assess the system’s efficiency in terms of power efficiency, spectral efficiency, and BER vs SNR. The outcomes of this research are expected to contribute to the advancement of wireless communication technologies, providing insights into the practical implementation of NOMA in OTFS systems, thereby paving the way for enhanced spectral efficiency and improved user experience in future wireless networks.

articleTitle: A Secure Quantum Protocol for Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) connect numerous vehicles, allowing efficient vehicle-to-vehicle communication through a dedicated network. The dynamic connectivity of VANETs facilitates spontaneous communication among diverse vehicles, enabling real-time exchange of crucial information like traffic conditions, road hazards, and other pertinent data. This collaborative network enhances road safety and traffic efficiency by enabling vehicles to share information and adapt to changing conditions in their proximity, ultimately improving the overall transportation system. This paper proposes an authentication protocol designed to be unconditionally secure against quantum attacks. The research delves into integrating quantum authentication with blockchain technology to establish a secure framework for VANETs. We introduce a quantum blockchain framework focused on bolstering the security of VANETs. The paper provides a thorough analysis of the potential of quantum blockchain in addressing common security threats in VANETs, including data tampering, eavesdropping, and unauthorized access.

articleTitle: Exploring Network Paradigms: A QoS Analysis Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Peer-to-Peer and client-server network models have been investigated as data transfer methods, the literature has not yet completely documented their advantages and disadvantages, especially for stability. The primary objective of this study is stability restrictions in network systems, and it compares the Peer-to-Peer (P2P) and Client-Server architectures in great detail. By comparing the performance in important measures while maintaining stability limitations, the goal is to determine which design is better. In particular, the research examines the two designs bandwidth, throughput, packet loss rate, and retransmission rate. It shows that the Client-Server design performs better in terms of throughput, bandwidth, and retransmission rates, demonstrating reliable data handling and effective delivery within specified intervals. Peer-to-peer architecture, on the other hand, shows an advantage with a reduced packet loss rate, indicating potential resistance against interruptions during data delivery. The study’s final results helps in making accurate choices in choosing an architecture for network systems that best satisfies with stability criteria.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Classification of Indian Ridge Gourd Varieties: CNN-SVM Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study looks at three main types of ridge gourd-Pusa Nasdar, Pusa Chikni, and Arka Sumeet-in India by using Deep Learning models like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). A group of around 13,000 clear pictures was carefully gathered and labeled. It was used to teach a machine-learning model how to work correctly. The new CNN design, made for identifying different types of ridge gourds, used its ability to see features in a way that is arranged like steps. The SVM model, with its features taken out, went through tough training and testing. The study used $\mathbf{7 6 \%}$ of the data to make a model, 12% for checking if it works and another 12% was reserved for testing. The created models had a high overall correctness of 96.5%. A comparison between these classifications and previous methods proves that the new models are better than before. The talk shows how these models can be used in farming. It stresses the need to improve them more and think about real-world uses before they are put into practice. This study shows that CNN and SVM models work well for sorting ridge gourd varieties. It helps understand how to move farming automation forward, making it more precise when taking care of plants.

articleTitle: Dataset Generation for Stuck-at-Fault Detection in Array Multiplier Circuit using Multi-fold Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Faults are the defects in circuits that are also referred to as unexpected scenarios occurring in digital circuits. These give rise to errors or operations that result in unreliable outcomes. Thus, the detection of these faults is an important task that otherwise marks a compromise on acceptance of the circuits. Though automatic test pattern generators are the rescuers aiding in generating test patterns, the intervention of machine learning can leverage a better methodology to progress. This paper concentrates on the development of a dataset capable of classifying single stuck-at-faults in a 16×16 array multiplier. The dataset generated is for a fourfold fault classification technique to reduce the number of classes in each stage. The data is created using ATALANTA® software. The strategy has reduced the number of classes to 16 in the first fold, 15 in the second fold, 14 in the third fold, and 2 in the fourth fold as opposed to around 6000 classes if multi-fold was not incorporated.

articleTitle: Service Diagnostic of Home Appliances by Using Next Generation Service Module
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we aim to develop a smart service diagnostic module (SDM) capable of connecting with various kinds of home appliances, such as washing machines, through a single bus protocol interface and BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) integration to connect with a mobile app. The main objective of this project is to enable home appliances to be connected to a mobile application for easy monitoring, diagnosis, troubleshooting, and control. The proposed SDM consists of an ESP-32 microcontroller development board with BLE connectivity for the appliance and mobile application. The proposed innovative idea is to utilize BLE to connect with the appliance via SDM to obtain fault codes on a service technician’s mobile app. This will help service technicians identify the exact root causes of appliance faults. This paper describes the details of the GATT Protocol, in which we create a variety of services for BLE applications, and also explains the details of the single BUS protocol used to communicate with various appliances. Additionally, this paper discusses future scope implementations for a better diagnosis approach and concludes with the results.

articleTitle: Text and Audio based synchronous learning framework for students with Dyslexia
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Students with dyslexia have several obstacles in conventional classroom settings, especially when it comes to understanding text-based curriculum. A new Text and Audio-based Synchronous Learning Framework (TASLF) designed especially for students with Dyslexia symptoms has been created in response to this problem. TASLF incorporates both textual and auditory modes to help dyslexic kids acquire more comprehension and retain what they have learned. The design concepts, specifics of the execution, and assessment findings of the TASLF project are presented in this work with the attained accuracy level of 64.7% at learning and experience through TASLF. Research has shown that the use of TASLF enhances learning results and creates a more inclusive learning environment for children exhibiting signs of dyslexia.

articleTitle: Sorting Fact from Overstatement: Exploring Nutritional Claims via Smartphone Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study investigates the role of Smartphone data mining in interpreting and verifying nutritional claims regarding probiotic food purchases among management graduates. A comprehensive analysis of sociodemographic profiles and consumer preferences was conducted among 195 participants through a questionnaire administered via QuestionPro, encompassing 15 items, including demographic information and consumer perception about probiotic products in the era of technology. Specific probiotic-related claims, such as strains like the 20 billion LcS strain and the overall probiotic nature of the product are also investigated. Findings reveal that consumers demonstrate varying perceptions of healthfulness compared to non-probiotic food and regular soda due to their readiness using smartphone. The study underscores the significance of probiotic-related claims in shaping consumer preferences and purchasing decisions, offering insights for effective marketing and labeling strategies in the probiotic food market.

articleTitle: Object Based Terrain Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the realm of terrain classification, the motivation behind this project lies in addressing the persistent challenges associated with accurate mapping of diverse landscapes. Motivated by the need for advanced techniques in terrain classification, this project addresses the challenge of developing a robust deep learning model, specifically a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The goal is to enable accurate recognition and categorization of diverse terrain types through the analysis of visual information extracted from images. Existing methodologies often fall short in achieving precise terrain classification, leading to suboptimal decision-making in various domains. The proposed model aims to overcome these limitations by employing state-of-the-art architectures like the 19-layer Visual Geometry Group (VGG19) and Residual Network with 50 layers (ResNet50). The significance of this work lies in the improved accuracy achieved by the models, with VGG19 and ResNet50 demonstrating impressive accuracies of 97.67% and 97.59%, respectively. These outcomes underscore the effectiveness of deep learning in addressing the complexities associated with terrain classification. The results not only highlight the exceptional capabilities of the proposed models but also emphasize their potential applications in diverse fields. The potential uses span from monitoring the environment and responding to disasters to urban planning, where precise terrain classification plays a crucial role. Fundamentally, this initiative presents a groundbreaking answer to the current hurdles in terrain classification, supplying a potent tool with extensive relevance and significant societal influence.

articleTitle: The Impact Of Work Duration On The Cognitive Abilities Of Bus Drivers In West Bengal
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bus driving job is a part of public service industry. Bus drivers always need to show concern for the passengers in spite of the fact that they must be concentrating on bus driving. In driving performance, the physical and cognitive harmony of the bus driver is a vital factor. Many recent reports related with bus drivers indicate that public transportation employees are at high risk of experiencing traumatic psychological events during the course of their work, with serious threats and assault making up the majority of those reported. This phase of study focuses the changes cognitive ability with duration of working hours. According to year of exposure, 140 subjects were alienated into group 1 and group 2 respectively. Different physical parameter was measured and general questionnaire was administered to know their different responses. Single letter cancellation test, stick drop test were administered to all the subjects for cognitive assessment with different time of the work shift. It was observed from the study that number of incorrect letters was increased with increased duration of working time. As per the reaction time, this was also increased at the end of the shifts and found to be best before the shifts. From the study it can be concluded that their cognitive ability was decreased according to their age. Impairment of motor activity of both groups of drivers was highly related with the time of duration of work. It was also observed in the study that age is another cofactor for the development of that impairment.

articleTitle: Examining the Benefits of AI in Wearable Sensor-based Healthcare Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emergence of the AI generation has introduced adjustments to the manner healthcare solutions are advanced and applied. Wearable sensor-based total healthcare answers were revolutionized by leveraging AI in diverse packages. AI may be used to enhance the accuracy and precision of facts analysis, simplify information collection procedures, and pick out affected person-unique styles from the accrued data. Furthermore, AI can provide both actual-time and predictive analytics abilities, which are particularly useful for devising personalized healthcare offerings. Its provision of scalable systems hurries up the traits of various programs and has enabled personalized healthcare answers to be deployed in a shorter length. In spite of a number of the associated challenges, including data privacy troubles, AI-based wearable sensor-based healthcare answers can revolutionize patient tracking and timely detection of capability health conditions, improve preventive fitness care, and decrease healthcare fees.

articleTitle: Hybrid Cryptography Algorithms for Cloud Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital time, assuring the security and confidentiality of data transmitted over the cloud is of paramount importance. This project proposes a hybrid cryptography algorithm designed to enhance cloud security by integrating asymmetric and symmetric encryption techniques. Specifically, the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm is utilized at the sender’s end to encrypt data, while Elliptic Curve Cryptography is employed at the receiver’s end for key encryption and decryption.At the sender’s side, data is encrypted using AES, a widely adopted symmetric encryption algorithm known for its efficiency and robustness. However, to assure the confidentiality and integrity of the AES key during transmission over the cloud, an additional layer of security is introduced. The AES private key is encrypted using the Elliptic Curve Cryptography public key before being transmitted. This hybrid approach not only protects the AES key from unauthorized access but also facilitates secure key exchange between the sender and receiver. At the receiver’s side, the Elliptic Curve Cryptography private key is used to decrypt the encrypted AES key, thus enabling access to the encrypted data. By leveraging the capabilities of Elliptic Curve Cryptography, the project achieves scalability and maintains the availability of data transmission over the cloud.By adopting this hybrid cryptography algorithm, the project upholds the principles of the CIA triad-Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability-ensuring that sensitive data remains confidential, unaltered, and accessible only to authorized parties. Through rigorous testing and evaluation, this project demonstrates the efficacy and reliability of hybrid cryptography in bolstering cloud security, thereby addressing the growing challenges of data protection in the digital time.

articleTitle: Fusion of Lidar and Radial Optical Flow for Autonomous Drone Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Li motion and radial glide are the 2 strategies hired inside self-sufficient drones for navigation purposes. Liar is sensitive to short-range devices, and employs reflected laser pulses to measure the distance between a drone under control and stationary objects as well as nearby obstacles. Digital camera inputs are merged with movement based total estimation techniques to estimate the relative moment of the drone and they direct their execution (Navigation Path) using Radial Optical Flow. And an extra efficient protocol can be constructed by combining those navigation methods so that you can help perform self-sufficient navigation with more accuracy and better pace. By combining liar and radial optical drift, the self-sufficient drone can simply have a complete view of its environment, which ends up in the latest specific navigation choices. Moreover, this blend of navigation strategies increases the capability to navigate avoids barriers through a drone. So the average fused liar and radial optical flow works well for single drones in depositing water on navigation tasks.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for CKD Identification among HIV-Afflicted Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) exhibits a significant healthcare dispute globally, predominantly among individuals living with HIV, where its prevalence and severity are heightened. Early detection of CKD in HIV patients is crucial for timely intervention and improved outcomes. The paper proposes a novel approach leveraging machine-learning techniques for the identification and classification of CKD in HIV patients. Traditional diagnostic methods often fail to detect CKD in its early stages due to asymptomatic presentation, leading to delayed treatment and disease progression. By harnessing the power of machine learning and the wealth of pathology data available, the study aims to enhance CKD diagnosis efficiency and accuracy. The methodology involves the development and evaluation of machine learning models trained on diverse datasets encompassing clinical and demographic variables alongside specific kidney function metrics, such as glomerular filtration rate (GFR). The models enable the classification of CKD presence and staging, facilitating early intervention and tailored patient care strategies. Through rigorous evaluation and validation processes, the efficacy and reliability of the proposed machine learning-based approach are assessed, paving the way for its integration into clinical practice. By providing clinicians with advanced tools for CKD detection in HIV patients, this research endeavours to improve patient outcomes, mitigate disease progression, and alleviate the burden on healthcare systems.The algorithms utilized in this study include:1.KNeighbors classifier2.DecisionTreeClassifier3.RandomForestClassifier4.AdaBoostClassifier5.XgBoostThrough rigorous evaluation and validation processes, the efficacy and reliability of the proposed machine learning-based approach are assessed, paving the way for its integration into clinical practice. By providing clinicians with advanced tools for CKD detection in HIV patients, this research endeavours to improve patient outcomes, mitigate disease progression, and alleviate the burden on healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Design of Heptagonal-Shaped 2.45 GHz Omni-directional Antenna for RF Energy Harvesting Application
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work introduces a small omni-directional single band heptagon shape microstrip patch radiator antenna for the $2.45 \mathrm{GHz} \mathrm{Wi}-\mathrm{Fi}$ band. The heptagon is a polygon with seven sides obtained from basic circular shape. The antenna is constructed using an inexpensive FR4 substrate. The circular shape defects in the ground plane is beneficial in realizing required gain and impedance. This structure provides a suitable realized gain of 3.97 dBi at 2.45 GHz of resonant frequency. The Omni-directional radiation characteristics of the antenna enable to collect RF power available from different directions and is suitable for harvesting electromagnetic energy from various ambient RF sources. The entire antenna dimension is $70 \times 70 \times 1.6 \mathrm{~mm}^{3}$.

articleTitle: Real-Time Attendance System with Liveness Detection and Multi-Face Recognition using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Attendance is an integral part of maintaining the records and activities of an individual. The face, like the iris and the biometric is the identity of a person. The ways by which the human body has unique imprints in its physical feature is a great chance to apply image processing techniques. The documenting of attendance plays an essential role in recording the in and out time of an individual in a particular organization or a college. The traditional approach for attendance in an educational institution includes the professor calling student name and then, recording the attendance while maintaining manually for the same. It is a rigorous task each day to maintain the records of attendance. It approximately requires 5 - $\mathbf{1 0}$ minutes to record attendance manually. To avoid the time and energy loss, the paper proposes a method which uses automatic attendance process which is done by image processing. The paper proposes a system wherein the dataset i.e., the images would be captured, the face is detected by Single Shot Detector (SSD) and the person is recognized using PyTorch model of OpenFace. It aims to identify individuals accurately while ensuring their liveness. It employs facial landmarks detection, eye aspect ratio calculation, and deep learning-based face embedding. Therefore, by utilizing this automated system, time is saved and maintaining attendance becomes a hassle-free process. With the help of the system outlined in this paper, it is convenient to record attendance of multiple faces in real-time. The method proposes to detect and recognize multiple faces and maintain a record of the attendance automatically.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Examination Platform: A Secure Approach for Academic Assessments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional examination systems are riddled with challenges such as lack of transparency, susceptibility to fraud, and concerns regarding data security. Instances of unauthorized access, tampering, or manipulation of examination records raise doubts about the reliability and credibility of assessment outcomes. Moreover, the centralized storage of sensitive information exposes vulnerabilities to data breaches and compromises student privacy. To mitigate these issues, this paper proposes a blockchain-based examination platform. The platform aims to provide a user-friendly web application that seamlessly interacts with users, ensuring easy navigation and accessibility for different roles. It seeks to overcome the limitations of traditional systems by securely storing exam question data in encrypted form, leveraging blockchain technology to provide immutability, transparency, and verifiability of system activities. Furthermore, the proposed system intends to automate examination administration tasks such as registration, scheduling, and result dissemination, thereby reducing manual efforts and potential errors. This paper discusses the design and implementation of the proposed blockchain-based examination platform, highlighting its potential to address the challenges faced by traditional examination systems and improve the overall examination experience for stakeholders.

articleTitle: Botanical Differentiation: Indian Mint Types with CNN-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a novel classification framework utilizing a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) approach for the accurate categorization of three prominent mint varieties prevalent in India: Kosi, Sambhal, and Himalaya. A group of 10,000 carefully taken pictures of mint leaves was used to create and check a model. The mix structure got a very good total right rate of 95.7%. It proved it works well for finding out different types of mints that look similar but are not, with high precision. The study found that the models matched and remembered well, with equal balance F1-scores. It tells us how good they are at identifying these mint varieties correctly. It sets it apart for sorting coin types by kind. This study has big results for making farming more accurate, checking that products are real, leading programs to make new types of plants, and maybe even helping with problems caused by lots of different plant life. Working on a big leap in different groupings of mint types was needed to keep trying. This is important for making the model easier and bigger so it can be used practically. This study is a big step forward in farming methods called precision agriculture. It uses smart ideas from machine learning to solve problems like identifying plants and getting ready for new technology and inventions in the science of growing crops.

articleTitle: An Exclusive System for Labeling the Dog Breed for improved Accuracy using Convolution Neural Network in comparison with Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using a dataset of breeds of dogs that were handpicked, this research aims to improve the accuracy of Dog breed classification using a Convolutional Neural Network in comparison with Random Forest through the use of deep learning algorithms and a well-curated dataset. Both the Convolutional Neural Network and Random Forest used in this study contain 10055 dog images out of which 8044 images are used for training and the remaining 2011 images are used for testing. The G power test was used with a significance level of 0.05 and a power of 80%. Result: The results showed that CNN outperformed Random Forest with an accuracy of 93.94% compared to 91.39%. The statistical analysis showed a significance value of 0.002 (p<0.05), indicating that there is a significant difference between the two algorithms for the novel dog breed classification application. Conclusion: Therefore, it can be concluded that MobileNet is more accurate than Random Forest for dog breed classification

articleTitle: Detection of Mental illness from social media Text
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project aims how social media impacts on mental health, specifically focusing on depression, anxiety, and borderline personality disorder (BPD). A massive dataset from Reddit posts was used it was available in kaggel for download and to analyze signs of these mental health issues. Using various computational techniques like Natural Language Processing(NLP), machine learning(ML), deep learning(DL) and transformers we dug deep into the data to uncover meaningful insights. our initial literature study indicate a concerning trend on many social media users seem to be struggling with feelings of depression and anxiety. This highlights the need for proactive measures to promote healthier online behavior and support mental well-being. Understanding these patterns is crucial for developing effective intervention strategies and advancing our knowledge in computer science and engineering.

articleTitle: An Effective Method to Develop Pseudo Ntype-GNRFETs based Digital Circuits in Ternary Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ternary logic systems are predominantly intriguing for nano-scaling design because of various advantages, including increased density and faster operation which may be accomplished with emerging technologies. In this work, a novel unbalanced ternary circuit designs that makes use of graphene nanoribbon transistors (GNRFETs) are presented. The Pseudo N-GNRFET technique is used in the proposed inverters, universal gates and half adder, respectively. This approach ensures that ternary logic circuits perform properly by regulating the threshold voltages of P - and N - transistors. The threshold voltages of these transistors are determined by the GNR dimer line number. When compared to complimentary schematics the proposed ternary designs reduced power consumption by 39.78%, propagation delay by 47.22%, and power-delay-product (PDP) by 94.59%, respectively.

articleTitle: Developing Adaptive Deep Learning Strategies for 5G Network Management
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper affords a unique method for growing deep mastering strategies for 5G community control. It leverages state-of-the-art deep neural community architectures and superior technologies inclusive of hierarchical learning, reminiscence networks, and differentiable programming to allow the machine to operate more efficaciously in an ever-changing surrounding. The gadget includes two principal components: an offline schooling community and a web auxiliary network. Each additive is related, permitting the net network to refine the educated parameters to adapt to changing occasions. The gadget is designed to deal with some of the maximum hard issues in 5G community management, along with excessive degree choice-making, resource optimization, and exceptional service enforcement. Experiments and simulations are used to evaluate the performance enhancements finished via applying the proposed technique. The consequences display that the proposed method should improve the general overall performance of 5G networks drastically. The proposed method may be used in a selection of network management packages, which include network virtualization, visitor engineering, and self-organizing networks.

articleTitle: Punjabi Grammar Checker: Automatic Correction of Punjabi Language Sentences Using Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Language is an immense basis of information transmission in social life. Grammar checking is the basic requirement for writing any documentation in particular language. Much research work has been done on grammar checker for English language. There has not been much research work done in other languages like Punjabi, not due to lack of interest but due to lack of resources. In Punjabi language, there is need of more attention. Advancement in deep neural networks in specific to natural language processing has encouraged researchers to apply these practices in resolving various challenging problems like automatic grammar checking. In this paper, we address the comparison and analysis of two deep neural network models Encoder-Decoder with attention mechanism and transformer for the problem of Punjabi sentence correction. We proposed neural machine translation approach for task of Punjabi Grammar Checker where input sentence is potentially erroneous and target sentence should be correct form of the input. In this paper the proposed approach is implemented with encoder-decoder using attention mechanism, base transformer with self-attention layers and fine-tuned transformer. The proposed approach with such models is validated on the Punjabi Grammar error dataset. Experiments show that the encoder-decoder model with attention mechanism has a good performance on smaller sequences but for longer sequences it has shown poor results but in contrast base transformer model has shown good and our proposed fine-tuned model has shown better performance to correct Punjabi sentences of small and longer sequences. Based on different samples of Punjabi dataset we have trained and tested such models and found our proposed approach with fine-tuned transformer model achieved 63% test accuracy on real test dataset which is better than other implemented models.

articleTitle: Robust Color Classification for Autonomous Robotic Boats
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research focuses on developing a robust color classification system for autonomous robotic boats with applications in the context of buoy identification. The proposed methodology utilizes supervised learning techniques to classify buoy colors effectively, even under challenging and varying lighting conditions. I collect and label extensive datasets from real-world scenarios featuring various buoy colors and lighting conditions. Employing multiclass SVM and multinomial Naive Bayes algorithms, I achieve high accuracy rates, demonstrating its potential for real-time applications. Future milestones include data diversification and the incorporation of lighting direction as a feature, aiming to enhance the algorithm’s robustness and accuracy in practical deployment scenarios. Ultimately, this research improves the reliability of autonomous robotic boat navigation in competitions and beyond.

articleTitle: American Sign Language Alphabet Recognition Using Teachable Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sign languages play a crucial role in the lives of individuals with speech impairments, offering a unique way to communicate through gestures. However, the challenge lies in standardizing this visual language. American Sign Language is one of these rich languages, but each sign language has its own alphabet and unique expressions, reflecting diverse cultures.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effects of Network Latency on P2P Communication Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) communiqué is an essential issue of many allotted systems which includes document sharing and disbursed computing, and making sure its performance is of paramount importance to these structures. On this paper, we investigate the consequences of community latency on P2P performance. We degree the effect of the latency skilled by means of peers on the performance of the device in terms of throughput, latency, and scalability. The simulation results show that once peers experience excessive latency, the overall throughput of the device decreases. Similarly, the machine’s scalability is affected, as friends with better latency take longer to method requests. We additionally located that, at the same time as the overall latency of the gadget can be decreased by using growing the quantity of friends, the discount is insignificant for friends that enjoy high latency. Our findings offer perception into the effects of network latency on P2P performance, and can be used to optimize the layout and deployment of P2P systems.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT)-Based Smart Blood Bank Services: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This review includes various methods or concepts that have been proposed by various authors for enhancing the offerings of blood banks. Smart blood bank services have been the subject of a great deal of research. Authors from several fields have provided their suggested models. An automated blood bank that uses SMS was created by Dr. G. F. Ali Ahmed, Pavitra H. V., utilizing an embedded technology. By employing mobile applications and IoT cloud services, Saravanan Subbiah created an integrated circuit. Vandana Khare IOT-based blood bank services were provided by T. Sravani. Based on the suggested system for blood bank services, Fizakhan. On blood bank services, S.S. Thorat made a proposal.

articleTitle: Integrating 3D U-Net and Attention U-Net for Brain Tumor Segmentation: Performance Evaluation on BRATS 2021 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical image analysis for diagnosis and therapy planning relies heavily on brain tumor segmentation. With the BRATS 2021 dataset, we provide an ensemble method in this project for the precise segmentation of brain tumors by integrating 3D U-Net and Attention U-Net architectures. The 3D U-Net architecture excels at capturing spatial information, while the Attention U-Net focuses on highlighting relevant features, thereby complementing each other’s strengths. To offer a thorough examination of the ensemble model’s efficacy, we assess its performance using measures including accuracy, Dice coefficient, precision, sensitivity, and specificity. Our results demonstrate that the ensemble approach outperforms individual models, achieving superior segmentation accuracy and robustness in identifying brain tumor regions. The suggested ensemble achieved accuracy, dice coefficient, precision, sensitivity, and specificity of ${9 9. 7 9 \%, 8 7. 6 5 \%, 9 9. 8 9 \%, 9 9. 6 4 \%}$ and 99.96% respectively on the validation set, eventually providing a substantial contribution to the advancement of medical image segmentation approaches and has the potential to improve clinical decision-making in the field of neuro-oncology.

articleTitle: NOMA-MSR: Upgrading NOMA using multiple smart relay units with SIC capabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is an emerging wireless technology and serves as a valuable competitor to its orthogonal counterpart; Orthogonal Multiple Access. It focuses on transmitting signals through superposition while the receiving works through users performing successive interference cancellations to obtain their respective signals. This creates a need for the users to access the signals of other users to obtain their own signals. In this paper, we propose a scheme where the SIC is performed by a relay unit, not the users. This usage of such units not only increases the physical layer security of the network but also brings us the advantages of a $\mathbf{n + 1}$ order cooperative diversity which offers us a much lower bit-error rate (BER) than the existing NOMA scheme.

articleTitle: Analysing Emotional Drivers and Behavioural Patterns of Twitter Overuse in India During the COVID-19 Lockdown using ML and BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study delves into the emotional dynamics and user behavior observed on Twitter during the COVID-19 lockdown in India. Through sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and user tweeting frequency analysis, we explore the primary topics of conversation, and the impact of excessive Twitter use on emotional well-being. Leveraging machine learning models and deep learning approaches, we demonstrate the efficacy of automated sentiment analysis in capturing emotional expression in social media data. Our findings are focused between social media use, emotions, and mental health during times of crisis, aiming to understand and address the psychological effects of the pandemic on individuals and communities.

articleTitle: Secret Data Hiding in Digital Images Using Differences Between Adjacent Pixels
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emerging technology in data transmission, which is mainly based on using insecure public networks as a transmission medium, makes it imperative to protect confidential information from unwanted access. Data hiding, a general umbrella where steganography is counted, has been presented as a promising solution to data security. In digital images, steganography consists of a paradigm that conceals the bits of confidential information in the pixels making the image. Several previous studies have proposed using steganography in images for the sake of a covert transmission of sensitive data, though they present difficulties regarding the visibility of concealed data as the amount of hidden information grows. This research suggests a novel steganographic technique to integrate the secret data bits with the differences of adjacent pixels of an image to address the issue with the previous efforts. The experimental results demonstrate superior performance compared to the previous studies examined in this research, with a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) ranging from 40.77 to 65.27 decibels (dB) to indicate the stego image quality.

articleTitle: Single Notch UWB Bandpass Filter with Square Ring Resonators and CSRR
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work proposes an Ultra-wideband (UWB) bandpass filter (BPF) comprises of square ring resonators to integrate with UWB communication system. The UWB filter is designed implementing six square ring resonators which are excited by parallel coupled microstrip lines (PCML). Here, three identical square rings are placed at equal distance from the coupled feed line, and two rectangular-shaped Defected Ground Structure (DGS) are implemented on the ground plane below the parallel coupled lines. The filter has been designed on a lowcost FR-4 substrate with a dielectric constant of 4.4. The outer substrate dimensions of the filter are $30 \times 10 \times 1.6 \mathrm{~mm}^{3}$. The filter is intended to have a -3 dB passband from 3.06 GHz to 10.26 GHz with a fractional bandwidth of 108%. The filter design has succeeded in achieving an insertion loss of 0.46 dB and return loss of above 10 dB. Also, a flat group delay of 0.2 ns to 0.3 ns is observed throughout the passband which signifies minimum delay between ports. A notch band is generated using a Complementary Split Ring Resonator (CSRR) structure to reject the frequency band at $\mathbf{6 ~ G H z}$ to isolate interference from Wi-Fi 6. The proposed UWB filter has advantages such as simplicity, compact size, and low-cost which makes it a potential candidate for different applications like high-speed communication, radar systems etc.

articleTitle: Cross Domain Knowledge Utilization Using Transfer Learning to Enhance Domestic Audio Captioning Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automated audio captioning aims to generate text description of sounds. Present approaches deal with generalized soundscapes and hence generate captions with regularized vocabulary and sentence structures. However, applications in domestic settings require training on audio from indoor soundscape. To reduce the load on downstream applications, the captions should have restricted vocabulary and a consistent sentence structure. It is found that models trained on conventional datasets fail to identify indoor sounds accurately. This paper proposes the use of weakly-labelled datasets to train a model specialized for domestic audio with cross domain knowledge through text conditioning provided by a sound event detection model. This model is observed to better associate sounds with words and hence produce more accurate captions, with weak temporal ordering and constrained sentence structure and vocabulary. Finally the metrics chosen for evaluating such models should penalize fluency errors, superfluous words and extraneous sentence structure. The goal is to realize automated audio captioning as a reliable stage in an application-quality natural language processing pipeline.

articleTitle: An Efficient Model for Camera Mounted Helmet and Number Plate Detection on Custom Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The model is developed using YOLO v8 for detecting Motorbike riders who are violating road rules. Initially, the model differentiates motorbike riders who are wearing safety bike helmets from those who are not wearing them. Riders without helmets are marked and processed by OCR to detect number-plates. Images with helmets are checked if used with cameras attached to them. If detected, it is marked and processed by OCR to detect number-plates. Detected number-plates are classified under offense. articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Fuzzy Logic Controllers for Voltage Gain Optimization in Buck Converters: A Comparison with PID Controllers via Input Voltage Variation

A significance level of 0.004 was obtained in this study, which included fourteen samples produced using the Gpower tool. When operating with the FL controller, the proposed buck converter achieves a voltage gain of $1.4763 V$ whereas the Proportional Integral Derivative controller gives 1.3811 V voltage gain. A statistically significant result ($\mathbf{p}$< 0.05) was obtained using the independent sample t test, with a result of 0.004. The simulation results reveal that when it comes to managing voltage gain throughout a board range, the fuzzy logic controller outperforms the proportional-integral-derivative controller. articleTitle: SwiftFrame: Developing Low-latency Near Real-time Response Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s era, handling of big data poses significant challenges due to its massive volume and diverse formats. A rapid processing of such diverse data formats, spanning vast volumes, is essential for delivering swift and effective real-time responses. This paper proposes a near real-time response framework named as SwiftFrame for low-latency, high-speed applications. Leveraging Docker, the proposed architecture seamlessly deploys and manages Apache Kafka, Apache Zookeeper, and PostgreSQL. Apache Flink efficiently processes data streams from Kafka, orchestrates tasks, and stores results in PostgreSQL. Grafana enables real-time visualization, offering a comprehensive monitoring interface. The proposed architecture, SwiftFrame, is designed to handle modern data processing requirements, ensures low latency and high throughput, suitable for diverse high-speed applications. In the experimental setup, four different scenarios have been considered and each scenario has repeated 5 times. The experimental results show that the proposed architecture outperforms in terms of latency and throughput achieving an average latency of 0.13 sec and an average throughput of 8.7 records per second. The future research directions of this paper are also highlighted.

articleTitle: Assessing the Performance of Interference-Aware Routing Protocols in Wireless Mesh Networks

articleTitle: Development of Algorithm for Detection of Forest Fire in Himalayan Region using Sentinel-2 MSI Images

abstract: Forest fire is globally an important issue. Every year we have seen forest fire over worldwide which disrupt the biodiversity. To detect fire in starting phase with high accuracy is one of the major challenges. Sentinel-2 Multi Spectral Instrument (MSI) data can play an important role in detection of active forest fire due to its higher spatial resolution and less revisiting time. Data of Sentine-2 is openly available since 2015 and it is regularly updated by European Space Agency (ESA). For this study, we have used Sentinel Application Platform (SNAP) to run the algorithm for the detection of forest fire. Bands such as B4, B8, B11 and B12 of Sentinel-2 satellite are mainly used for this study. Bands B11 and B12 are highly sensitive to active fire whereas B4 is less sensitive. The false colour composite (FCC) of B12, B11 and B4 provide a fire view in the study region. The objective of this research is to detect the active fire in the region of interest (ROI) with higher accuracy so that the fire can be extinguished in time. This paper proposes the inclusion of NDVI band in the Hu et al., 2021 algorithm of forest fire to minimize the false alarm. The proposed algorithm determined the forest fire in $0.06 \mathbf{k m}^{2}$ and $0.04 \mathbf{k m}^{2}$ for the two different study areas. This research will be helpful in providing accurate and timely information of forest fire in the Pauri Garhwal district of Uttarakhand which is very sensitive for forest fire.

articleTitle: Integrating YOLOv8 and Cosine Similarity for Food Recipe-Specific Ingredient Collection and Recommendation

The paper aims to develop an innovative food recommendation system by integrating the YOLOv8, for object detection algorithm and the Cosine Similarity Algorithm, for ingredient detection and recipe suggestions. A system which the researchers have developed can identify ingredients and suggest corresponding recipes. A custom dataset was made consisting of twenty-one (21) ingredients for training the algorithm YOLOv8. For the Cosine Similarity, a dataset consisting of ten (10) dishes such as “Chicken Tinola”, “Chicken Adobo”, “Chicken Afritada”, “Chicken Curry”, “Sinigang na Baka”, “Nilagang Baka”, “Beef Kare-Kare”, “Sinigang na Baboy”, “Pork Humba”, and “Pork Menudo” was utilized. The results of the detected samples were then shown on 5-inch LCD Display. The accuracy of the system that yielded 84.76%, has been determined by using a confusion matrix. The precision of the system resulted in 91.75%, while the recall was 91.75%. The F1 score of the system is determined to be 91.75 percent Additionally, a percentage error formula was utilized for recipe recommendations, resulting in a 12% error rate.

articleTitle: Enhancing Rule-Based Methods for Pulmonary Effusion Diagnosis

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Cryptocurrency Prices Using Machine Learning Algorithms

Accurate price prediction is crucial for informed investment decisions. This study explores the feasibility of various modeling techniques on diverse data structures and features for predicting the prices of these cryptocurrencies. We utilize daily and high-frequency price data to classify and predict prices using deep learning and machine learning techniques, including LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, linear regression, and SGD regression. articleTitle: Optimizing IoT: Integrating Smart-Sensor Data Fusion on Mitsubishi RV-4FRL Robot Arm with Data Processing and Visualization

The framework integrates Python for data collection from a Bosch Rexroth CISS (Connected Industrial Sensor Solution) multi-sensor and utilizes a specialized switch mechanism within Node-RED, allowing topic-based categorization like Accelerometer for selective sensor activation or deactivation. The gathered data is systematically stored in a MySQL database, following predefined conditions and criteria. articleTitle: Query Based Multi-Domain Meeting Summarizer

abstract: Our main objective is to develop a model that we call the Query-Based Multi-Domain Meeting Summarizer. We’re employing a tool called FastAPI [8] to enable users to submit searches and receive interest-specific summaries. In order to ensure that the tool functions easily and effectively, particularly while handling a variety of meeting data we also use assembly code.Our project’s primary goal is to develop a tool that can summarise conversations from multi-domain meetings in a timely manner. This implies that it is able to extract the most salient features from all the data from these sessions, such as decisions taken or crucial subjects covered. Users can simply ask specific queries or enter keywords into FastAPI to obtain summaries that correspond to their search terms. Our method is trained and tested on the QMSUM dataset, which consists of numerous distinct meeting transcripts. articleTitle: Efficient Background Modeling and Subtraction for Video Segmentation

articleTitle: Design of web application for community answering using Long short-term memory compared over Hybrid Emotion Interface Model with improved accuracy

abstract: This study demonstrates a comparison of two different models for a web application for community answering. The materials used in the study included a web application for community answering, a large corpus of online community answers, and two machine learning models (LSTM and HEIM). The web application was designed to allow users to ask and answer questions, and also to display the results of the emotion detection algorithms. The LSTM and HEIM models were implemented using the Python programming language and the TensorFlow library. Both models were trained and evaluated on a dataset of community answers collected from a web application. The sample size consisted of 20 participants, divided into two groups of ten each. An investigation was carried out utilizing a G-power of 0.8, with an alpha of 0.05 and p =0.001(p < 0.005), beta of 0.2, and a 95% confidence interval. The results of this study demonstrated that the suggested LSTM model outperformed the traditional HEIM model in terms of accuracy. The LSTM model had an accuracy of 92% while the HEIM model had an accuracy of 87%. Since, there is a significant difference between two algorithms (LSTM and HEIM) hence p =0.001. Some design logic are Adiabatic logic, Domino logic, Dual mode logic, Dynamic logic and Pass Transistor logic are examined in terms of area, power and speed. articleTitle: Mitigating Interferences with Error Resilience Techniques for Optimal Electromagnetic Compatibility

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Prediction with XAI-Enabled Boosting Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast cancer poses a significant health threat to the growing population of the world and as such calls for innovative methods to improve early detection and improve patient safety. The existing techniques in the field have made use of techniques like various image processing models like RetinaNet, You Only Look Once, Convolutional Neural Networks as well as tree-based models like the J48, decision trees and Naïve Bayes to predict Brest cancer but most these studies focus on the accuracy of the predictions without providing a basis for explanation and understandability of the results. Therefore, to provide transparency, this study utilizes the Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME). This study investigated the performance of three boosting algorithms LightGBM, CatBoost and XGBoost in breast cancer prediction making use of the SEER dataset. The paper also makes use of SMOTE and the amalgamation of Tomek Links to handle class imbalance generally present with medical data to enhance the generalizability of the results. With hyperparameter tuning, the results show that LightGBM outperformed the other two in terms of accuracy as well as recall metrics. LIME explanations were then employed specific patient instances to understand the interplay of the various variables and how they contribute to the model predictions. These explanations highlighted the clinical relevance of variables such as T Stage and Grade of cancer, aiming to instill confidence among the clinicians. The research in all undermines the importance of integrating XAI methodologies in breast cancer detection, paving way for more clinically regulated and relevant models in the future.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents an investigation into the development of a brain tumor classification and treatment planning system leveraging Deep learning methods, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The research aims to enhance accuracy and efficiency in this domain by leveraging the capabilities of deep learning. An extensive assessment of the brain tumor classification model is carried out, showcasing its effectiveness in accurately identifying various tumor types, including glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumors, and cases without tumors. The model achieves high precision, recall, and F1-score values across these tumor categories, demonstrating robust performance in clinical decision-making scenarios. Leveraging Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) data, the CNNbased model achieves an impressive overall accuracy of 95%. Methodologically, the study involves preprocessing MRI images for contrast enhancement and noise reduction, followed by feature extraction using CNN architectures comprising convolutional and pooling layers. The model undergoes training on a sizable collection of annotated brain tumor images, with data augmentation techniques employed to enhance generalization and mitigate overfitting.

articleTitle: Cognitive Vision as an Emerging Tool in Autonomous Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cognitive vision is a rising utility of synthetic intelligence that permits machines to look and interpret pictures and movies like human beings do. Its miles proving to be a useful device in increasing the protection and protection of selfsustaining structures, particularly within the developing subject of self-sustaining security structures. This era has the potential to provide proactive protection in opposition to malicious activity with dependable accuracy and substantially reduce the want for human intervention. Cognitive imaginative and prescient takes benefit of a variety of advanced algorithms and technologies, which includes system getting to know, 3-D mapping, deep getting to know, item recognition, and photo processing. articleTitle: CORDIC Based Implementation of QPSK Modulator Using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital modulators have received great attention recently due to the tremendous progress in Radio Frequency (RF) front end terminals and system on chip industry. But with all the progress that has been made, the implementation cost still a challenge. This paper presents a new method of implementing Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) modulator in VHDL at the lowest possible implementation cost. Four different carrier signals were generated using CORDIC(COordinate Rotation DIgital Computer) algorithm. Two phase accumulators are included within the CORDIC processor to yield four sinusoidal carriers. The first accumulator has a zero starting phase, whereas the second one has a 180-degree phase shift compared with the first one. The whole implementation process was done directly in Very high speed integrated circuit Hardware Descriptive Language (VHDL) using XILINX Vivado without the help of any co-simulation tool such as Xilinx System Generator or DSP Builder Tools as in many papers. The implemented modulator uses 48 slice LUT,32 FF(Flip Flop), 9 input/output peripherals, and one buffer only.

articleTitle: Drug Addiction Analysis in Bangladesh Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The widespread problem of drug addiction remains a major public health issue in Bangladesh, demanding a thorough exploration of its root causes and predictive models. Data was gathered from 1104 individuals’ survey responses, covering diverse demographic and behavioral characteristics. To evaluate their predictive potential, the data was examined using machine learning methods such as Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) Classifier, Naïve Bayes Classifier, and XGBoost Classifier. Our results demonstrate that the machine learning models serve as effective tools for comprehending and forecasting drug addiction within the Bangladeshi context. The performance metrics for each algorithm are as follows: Decision Tree (98% accuracy), KNN (98% accuracy), Logistic Regression (92% accuracy), Naïve Bayes (88% accuracy), and XGBoost (98%). These models exhibit promising capabilities, with Decision Tree, KNN, and XGBoost notably achieving a 98% accuracy rate in predicting drug addiction. These findings establish a solid foundation for future investigations into the complexities of drug addiction and the creation of more sophisticated predictive models specifically tailored to the context of Bangladesh.

articleTitle: Classification of Land Cover using Machine Learning Models in Landsat Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this work, we examine the possibility of using cloud cover area analysis in Google Earth Engine (GEE) in conjunction with Landsat satellite data for classifying land cover in the Chennai region between 2023 and 2024. With the development of technology and the accessibility of satellite imagery, remote sensing data have provided invaluable insights into environmental dynamics and have become more important for tracking changes in land cover over time. The study area, Chennai, represents a rapidly urbanizing region where accurate land cover classification is crucial for urban planning, resource management, and environmental conservation efforts. To achieve this, we adopted a supervised classification approach, dividing the dataset into training and testing subsets with an $\mathbf{8 0 \% - 2 0 \%}$ split. Three distinct classification models were developed and evaluated: Classification and Regression Trees (CART), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Naïve Bayes (NB). Each model leverages the spectral information from Landsat satellite imagery to classify land cover types across the study area. Our analysis revealed varying degrees of accuracy among the models. The CART model achieved a classification accuracy of $\mathbf{7 5 \%}$, followed by the KNN model with 77.5% accuracy, NB achieved $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ and SVM performed with $\mathbf{7 2. 5 \%}$. Notably, the Random Forest model outperformed the others significantly, achieving an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{8 2. 5 \%}$. This indicates the efficacy of ensemble learning techniques, such as Random Forest, in handling complex spectral patterns and improving classification performance in urban environments like Chennai.

articleTitle: An Efficient Copy-Move Forgery Detection using Discrete Cosine Transform with Block-wise Peak-Pixel-based Block Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital images that are frequently encountered in day-to-day life can be easily tampered to mislead the information. One of the popular methods used to accomplish this unauthorized alteration is copy-move forgery. This paper presents a passive authentication scheme for copy-move forgery which uses discrete cosine transform (DCT) with block-wise peak-pixel-based block clustering. This scheme initially aims to obtain the features by implementing DCT on small, fixed image blocks and minimizes the size of feature vectors. The block-wise peak-pixel-based block clustering algorithm is used instead of the general lexicographic order technologies to enhance the detection precision. By comparing the feature vectors in each bucket, similar blocks will be obtained. Based on the experimental outcomes, the proposed scheme can detect multiple irregular and significant tampered regions. The duplicated regions detected in the distorted digital images can also be displayed by adding white Gaussian noise, Gaussian blurring and their mixed operations. By applying the above approach to the CoMoFoD - Image Database an accuracy of 99.99% has been achieved.

Author Keywords: Image forgery, Copy-move forgery, Discrete cosine transform, Block clustering

articleTitle: Designing Robust Spectrum Allocation Algorithms for 6G Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores the idea of the sturdy spectrum allocation algorithms for 6G cell networks. It proposes a framework based on a multi-goal optimization procedure to design disbursed spectrum allocation algorithms for the target 6G device. The proposed framework includes two elements, specifically, the modelling of goals and the optimization technique. For the modelling of goals, the paper discusses the characteristics of 6G networks relevant to spectrum allocation, consisting of conversation parameters, dynamic spectrum conditions, and bendy utilization of sources. Moreover, the paper also introduces a hard and fast mathematical optimization model for the spectrum allocation hassle. Subsequently, the paper considers the optimization manner, which includes multi-goal optimization algorithms, dispensed optimization algorithms, and simulations. The paper explores the overall performance of the proposed algorithms in a series of simulation experiments and the usage of community scenarios that replicate the traits of the 6G device. The consequences display that the proposed algorithms can efficiently enhance the overall performance of the spectrum allocation process in 6G mobile networks.

articleTitle: Transcribing Natural Language to Python Code: A Compiler Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

The research involves working with different phases of the compiler including the lexical analyser, syntax and the semantic analyser phase in combination with Natural Language Processing techniques. By automating this process, we aim to streamline programming for a wider audience, removing barriers to entry and making coding more accessible to all.

articleTitle: Enhanced Sports Performance Analysis: CNNLSTM Based Detection of Tennis Serve Variations

articleTitle: Software Fault Localization using CNN-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Software fault localization is a critical task which identify the faulty statements in a program. Traditional fault localization techniques are unable to capture complex relationships within program execution data. In recent years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) has shown promise in enhancing fault localization performance. In this paper, we propose a CNN-LSTM model for software fault localization. We perform extensive experiments on four programs and observe that proposed CNN-LSTM model consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher accuracy and reliability in localizing software faults.

articleTitle: Efficient Milk Packing Machine: Enhancing Delivery Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project offers an automated solution to conventional milk delivery technique’s inefficiencies, aiming to increase efficiency and preserve milk purity. The innovative aspect of the suggested method is how it incorporates state-of-the-art technology such as an automated milk packing machine to solve persistent issues facing the dairy sector. Precise control over milk volumes is achieved by utilizing sophisticated components including an Arduino micro-controller, keyboard interface, and continuous discharge pump, which ensure excellent packaging precision. The system also includes heat sealers powered by pneumatic cylinders to seal milk into covers, ensuring freshness and reducing the chance of contamination. The milk cover roll’s continuous operating mechanism further simplifies packing procedures and boosts productivity. This creative method raises the caliber and mobility of milk and provides an affordable, long-term fix that might completely change how milk is delivered.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Using openCV- use case on student attendance system

abstract: This is a modern approach to student attendance management using face recognition technology, powered by advanced techniques including Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Haar Cascade frontalface default algorithm. By leveraging OpenCV and these cutting-edge face recognition methods, the system offers a reliable and efficient solution for tracking attendance in educational institutions. Additionally, the system incorporates deep learning algorithms to enhance its accuracy and robustness in identifying students’ faces. Through practical implementation, the project demonstrates the effectiveness of using OpenCV and deep learning for automated student attendance management. By providing accurate and efficient attendance tracking, while improving operational efficiency in educational settings, this innovative solution marks a significant advancement in modernizing attendance management practices.

articleTitle: The Use of Autonomous Medical Assistants in Elderly Care and Disease Management
