articleTitle: Integration of IoT with Augmented Reality for Temperature and Humidity Monitoring: An Interactive approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The scope of integrating AR with IoT in temperature monitoring offers several advantages. Firstly, AR provides a visually immersive experience by overlaying digital information onto the physical environment, enabling users to interact with temperature data intuitively. This can enhance situational awareness and facilitate decision-making processes in real-time scenarios. The research aims to leverage the strengths of both AR and IoT to create a comprehensive and intuitive system for real-time temperature monitoring in various environments. By harnessing the portability and ubiquity of AR-enabled devices, users can access temperature data on the go, enhancing adaptability and responsiveness. The system will comprise IoT sensors deployed in target environments to collect temperature data, which will be transmitted to a centralized database or cloud platform for storage and processing. Users can then access this data through AR-enabled devices, where it will be displayed overlaid onto the physical environment intuitively and interactively. The reliability of the system is cross-verified and validated through manually obtained data.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Charging Technology (SCT) for EV
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The transition to electric vehicles (EV) has been assisted by advancements in battery technology along with methods of production in addition to the depletion of fossil fuel resources, energy dependence, rise in fuel prices, and environmental issues brought on by fossil fuel vehicles. Fast,affordable, and dependable charging infrastructure are necessary for the quick adoption of electric transportation and successful commercialization of the technology. This assessment assesses the technological preparedness of the various BEV technology components and identifies those areas where significant technological advancement is anticipated. Electric cars (EVs), a new class of customer loads in the electrical system, offer a variety of opportunities, including the opportunity to use EVs as storage devices via vehicle-to-home and V2G (vehicle to grid) choices rather than peak power purchase from the grid. The effort to achieve sustainable energy requirements is increasingly reliant on electric cars (EVs). Given the low on board batterycapacity of EVs, there is a growing demand for ubiquitous charging infrastructure. However, because of overloading at peak times, frequent power outages, and voltage sag, fast charging stations, in particular. Extremely Rapid Charging (EFC), may cause problems for the electrical system. As solar power systems are inherently unpredictable and fluctuating, photovoltaic (PV) systems always contain hybrid energy storage technologies, such as batteries and supercapacitors, to smooth out the power supply. This research suggests a multi-port DC to DC converter (MPC) with a bidirectional DC-DC converter for batteries ESS-integrated PV systems. Electric vehicles should be powered using three different charging techniques. PV panels should deliver ultraviolet radiation that was absorbed to the loadsin mode 1. The battery receives additional voltage from the PV in mode 2. In mode 3, EVs can be loaded utilising the extra power from the battery because there is no sunlight at night. This project suggests employing smart charging technologies to charge EVs.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches To Simile Detection: Insights From Bert and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A crucial component of natural language processing (NLP) is simile detection. NLP seeks to improve comprehension of figurative language, particularly similes which utilize the phrases “like” or “as” for comparisons, to evoke strong feelings and vivid imagery. Detecting similes is important as it enables more nuanced text analysis, improving applications such as sentiment analysis, literary analysis, and language translation. Our approach involves comparing LSTM networks and BERT models to distinguish simile sentences from non-simile sentences. The extensive experimentation revealed that the simpler custom BERT model outperformed the complex LSTM model in accuracy, recall, F1 scores and precision metrics by around 12%. The results validate the approach and highlight the capability of pre-trained transformer models in enhancing figurative language processing. The work provides a foundational step towards more advanced and comprehensive language understanding systems, contributing to the broader field of NLP and its applications.

articleTitle: Feature Enhanced Semi-Supervised Attention U-Net for Cell Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cell segmentation is crucial for accurately assessing disease severity. Despite advances in deep learning, there is still a gap in understanding how U-Net variants perform in addressing the issue of limited labeled data in cell segmentation. We compare various U-Net models to see how they fare with live cell images. We also examine how different feature extraction methods affect their performance. Using the Laplacian and Standard Deviation features improves performance by more than 3%, giving Attention U-Net mean Intersection over Union (IoU) scores of 0.7956 and mean Dice scores of 0.8844. In addition, we introduce a semi-supervised Mean Teacher Attention U-Net that leverages the same feature extraction techniques. Remarkably, it achieves an IoU score of 0.7908 and a Dice score of 0.8831, outperforming the existing approaches even with only 60% labeled data and utilizing limited computational resources.

articleTitle: Lung-Retinanet Lung Cancer Detection Using A Retinanet With Multi-Scale Feature Fusion And Context Module
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lung cancer identification is troublesome, on the grounds that blood tests and CT filters take time and require human mediation. Lung-RetinaNet, a lung tumour detection arrangement, resolves these issues. The RetinaNet model is increased with multi-scale feature fusion and a setting module. The Lung-RetinaNet model purposes a multi-scale highlight combination module to join neural network layers. This strategy further develops the model’s semantic data assortment, which is fundamental for lung tumor identification. Notwithstanding multi-scale feature fusion, Lung-RetinaNet utilizes an enlarged and lightweight setting module approach. This module utilizes context oriented data with each neural network layer to further develop feature extraction and lung imaging little cancer area. The task’s lung cancer detection technique is more proficient and precise utilizing these parts. Adding the Xception model boosts lung cancer classification accuracy to almost 100%. Likewise, YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 further develop lung cancer detection in photos. This complex strategy ensures a total lung cancer analysis, coordinating accurate classification and exact object recognition.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Data-driven approach for State-of-Charge estimation in Redox Flow Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Redox flow-based batteries (RFBs) are emerging chemistry-based energy storage devices with modular design, uncoupled energy, and power rating and are increasingly used in microgrid and household applications. The available battery management system for RFBs uses the conventional State-of-Charge (SoC) estimation method, increasing the complexity of multi-physical modeling and impeding the dynamic applications of batteries. Therefore, the present study provides a comprehensive framework for data-driven state-of-charge (SoC) prediction, including data generation and preprocessing stage, for allvanadium and zinc-bromine-based RFBs. The analysis included models like a multilayer perception (MLP), a Gated Recurrent Unit network, Long-short-term memory, and a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) to determine the most appropriate predictor. The TFT model proved to be highly accurate in the case of AVRFB, attaining a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 3.98e03 and 5.2e-03 in the training and testing dataset. Concerning ZBRFB, all models exhibited comparable performance, with LSTM achieving an RMSE score of 2.010e-03. In addition, this study also incorporated feature optimization to decrease computational overhead, a vital component for edge deployment. Using feature optimization, the MLP algorithm can accurately forecast SoC with negligible error while requiring less input.

articleTitle: Stress Level Diagnosis Using IoT And Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In light of growing health worries, this study introduces an innovative system for relating stress by combining the power of the Internet of Effects (IoT) and machine literacy (ML). The” Stress. lysis” collection includes essential data like moisture, temperature, way taken, and stress situations, which are the foundation of our study. By using three different detectors moisture, way taken, and temperature our system gathers instant health information, setting the stage for a thorough stress evaluation. Our approach combines advanced machine literacy ways to examine the data, similar to Naive Bayes, k-nearest neighbour (KNN), logistic retrogression, and support vector machine (SVM). These ways look at the complex relationship between health pointers and stress patterns, allowing for the categorization of stress into three situations low, medium, and high. The system has shown a delicacy range of 98.6 to 99.8 across colourful measures, demonstrating its trustability. This system provides a detailed sapience into the nature of stress, leading to better strategies for managing health. This study not only advances the field of stress identification but also offers the eventuality for perfecting healthcare operations through the use of data-driven knowledge.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Dual-band Microstrip Patch Antenna for Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Energy harvesting is becoming an ongoing focus in many technical and scientific fields. For energy harvesting, the design of rectennas is crucial. In this paper, two distinct rectenna systems are proposed using an optimized dual band microstrip patch antenna at 5.41 GHz and 7.36 GHz using computer simulation technology (CST). The 5.41 GHz band was especially chosen for energy harvesting in this study because of its widespread usage in 5G, satellite communication, and radar applications. The simulation results of the designed antenna at 5.41 GHz provide satisfactory performances in terms of return loss, gain, and radiation efficiency, which are $-30.04 \mathrm{~dB}, 7.64 \mathrm{~dB}$, and 93.55%, respectively. To design rectenna systems, a voltage doubler and a three-stage Dickson rectifier are used at 5.41 GHz for RF power harvesting. Advance design software (ADS) is used to create the equivalent RLC circuit of the proposed antenna, and LTspice is used to simulate the suggested rectenna systems. Using LTspice, the performance of the proposed rectennas is assessed in terms of input and output voltage, load resistance, and output power. The output power levels of the voltage doubler rectifier and the three-stage Dickson rectifier are 11.14 dBm and 11.98 dBm, respectively. According to this research, the voltage doubler yields lower output power than the three-stage Dickson rectifier at the same resistive load of $6.5 \mathrm{~K} \Omega$ and the same input voltage of 250 mV.

articleTitle: Comprehending Intelligent Systems with Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The complex ecosystems in modern life have started to deploy Artificial Intelligence leveraging the technological advancements in computing power and improvements in research. Given the scenarios of mistrust shown on these technologically advanced AI systems, there is an imperative need to address the concerns that meet the criteria of Fairness, Accountability and Trust. The Explainable AI techniques come to the rescue, giving respite by providing the required explanation in the outcomes of AI systems. This paper focuses on the SHAP approach to Explainable AI, which has been widely adopted due to its multi-faceted fitment in different methods of interpretability. The readily available Python software support to derive the meaningful explanation of the outcomes from different AI models. The paper uses the Call Quality data to assess the different aspects of SHAP for practical applications.

articleTitle: An Advanced Encryption Protocols for Wireless Network Security in Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The superior Encryption Protocols (AEPs) are specifically designed encryption algorithms for wireless networks that provide advanced safety for web applications. AEPs use special keys-based encryption strategies, together with public-key cryptography, to guard information communicated over Wi-Fi networks. This allows packages hosted on net servers to send and acquire information without worry of interception from accidental 1/3 events. AEPs perform at the Media get right of entry to manipulate (MAC) layer of the OSI (Open system Interconnection) model. The encryption process begins whilst statistics is obtained by means of a get entry to factor over the Wi-Fi network. The get entry to point then assigns appropriate encryption keys to the records which it forwards to the net server. The server then extracts the encryption keys from the facts and makes use of them to decrypt and study the statistics. The method is reversed for records dispatched from the web server to devices over the wireless network. With a purpose to provide the best degree of safety, AEPs hire both symmetric and asymmetric encryption strategies. Generally used algorithms consist of superior Encryption fashionable (AES) for symmetric encryption, and RSA or Megamall for uneven encryption. All communications among the get right of entry to factor and the internet server are encrypted with an appropriate encryption key and authenticated the use of virtual signature algorithms inclusive of SHA

articleTitle: Comparison of Novel Random Forest Algorithm over Gaussian Naïve Bayes for Improving Accuracy in Software Bug Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research work focuses on analyzing the performance of a proposed random forest (RF) method with that of Gaussian Naive Bayes in predicting software problems. The database utilized in this research was gathered from the Kaggle repository and contained information about software projects and their bug reports. A total of 20 samples were used in this study, with two groups formed and 10 samples randomly selected for each group. Group 1 was used for training and testing the Gaussian Naive Bayes algorithm, while Group 2 was used for training and testing the novel RF algorithm. Python and relevant libraries such as scikit-learn were utilized for implementation. The dataset was preprocessed to remove irrelevant features and perform feature engineering. The algorithms were tested on the training set, and their performance was assessed using accuracy metric on the testing data. A statistical power of 0.8 was set, and alpha and beta qualities of 0.05 and 0.2, respectively, were used with a confidence interval of 95%. The accuracy of the novel RF approach was 78.59% on average, whereas the accuracy of the Gaussian Naive Bayes approach was 75.57% on average. The p-value for the statistically distinct in accuracy among the both approaches was 0.001 ($\mathbf{p}\lt0.05$). The findings suggest that the novel RF approach could be a useful tool for software developers and project managers to predict and prevent potential bugs in their projects.

articleTitle: Nearest Neighbour Extraction for Multi-Camera Fusion in Low-Light Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nearest Neighbor Extraction for Multi-camera Fusion in Low-mild conditions is a computer vision method that seeks to create a fused illustration of multiple cameras operating in low-light conditions, which includes night-time and indoor scenes. The approach is based on extracting salient capabilities from each camera to shape a comprehensive view of the scene and then employing a nearest-neighbor search to locate the closest characteristic representations of most of the various cameras. The fused representation is subsequently used for further analyses, which include object recognition and scene information. The demanding situations with this method are the robustness of function extraction, correct becoming of the features among one-of-a-kind cameras and efficiently trying to find the nearest friends underneath varying illumination situations. Several algorithms have been proposed in this place, including edge detection, contour detection, function factor tracking, and other techniques. This technique has actual international packages together with surveillance, robotics, self-reliant driving, and three-D mapping.

articleTitle: Leveraging reinforcement learning for advanced financial planning for effective personalization in economic forecasting and savings strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There is rarely a single response that can be considered “right” when it comes to the domain of financial guidance and planning. Traditional algorithms have been successful in addressing linear issues; but, their performance is strongly dependent on selecting the “right” features from a dataset, which can be difficult to accomplish in complex financial settings. Machine learning (ML) is investigated in this research for its potential applications in financial forecasting, the prediction of economic indicators, and the development of strategies for personal savings. In order to assist customers in attaining their financial goals, the machine learning algorithm that Vanguard uses, which is based on deep reinforcement learning, determines the optimal savings rates across a variety of goals and income sources. These algorithms are designed to identify market indications and behaviors that are too complex to be captured by standard formulae and rules. They do this by modeling the financial success trajectories of investors as a Markov method of decision making. According to the findings of the study, reinforcement learning has the potential to significantly increase the value that financial advisors and end-investors receive by increasing efficiency, personalizing financial planning, and providing solutions that are data-driven and tailored.

Author Keywords: Machine Learning and Markov Decision Process

articleTitle: A Comparison of Word Embedding Techniques for Stress Identification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In stress analysis, the focus is on examining individuals’ language or voice for signs of stress. This study utilizes a dataset obtained from DravidanLangTech-2024 and employs various embedding techniques like Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF), Doc2Vec and Word2Vec. These techniques transform data points into numerical representations in a high-dimensional space, aiding algorithms in understanding relationships and similarities between them. Machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Naïve Bayes, and Logistic Regression, are crucial in stress analysis. In the Tamil dataset, Random Forest achieved impressive accuracies of 98%, 97%, and 99% for TF-IDF, Doc2Vec, and Word2Vec embeddings, respectively. Similarly, in the Telugu dataset, Random Forest consistently displayed the highest accuracies across all three embeddings. Particularly noteworthy is the exceptional performance of the Random Forest Algorithm with Word2Vec embedding, achieving an outstanding 99% accuracy in predicting stress for both Tamil and Telugu datasets.

articleTitle: Detecting Severity Level of Knee Osteoarthritis using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a condition where joints degenerate, leading to pain, stiffness, and decreased mobility. Identifying it early is crucial for timely diagnosis and management as persistent pain and limitations linked to knee osteoarthritis may contribute to mental health challenges like anxiety, depression, and stress. To exploit the continuous increase in medical patients con-cerning KOA and provide precise detection results, various studies employ machine learning analytics for KOA prognosis or treatment, however precise results are a concern. The purpose of this work is to analyze X-ray images for classification of KOA on their severity level. To this, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used as it is effective in image recognition and classification. For investigation purposes, PROTEC PRS 500E X-ray machine was utilized for collecting a dataset consisting of 1650 digital knee joint X-ray images. The data is split into training and testing sets. Then, the model is trained for $\mathbf{1 0 0}$ epochs with a validation split of 20%. For evaluation purposes, the grading of the dataset is done using Kellgren and Lawrence’s (KL) scheme consisting of doubtful, normal, mild, severe, and moderate knee arthritis X-ray images. Experimental results depict that the model successfully classifies X -ray results on the model with an accuracy of 89%.

articleTitle: Exploring Learning-based Approaches for Enhancing IoT Networking Through Big Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In current years, the internet modern day (Iota) has a visible fantastic boom. With the advancement of modern Iota technologies, new possibilities emerge for better and greater green networking and the usage of records analytics. This paper explores modern-day-based techniques so that it will leverage huge statistics processing for improving Iota networks. We have become aware of diverse approaches for community optimization, such as gadget cutting-edge algorithms, deep learning models, and different heuristics-primarily based strategies. We also define the advantages and downsides of contemporary techniques and discuss their capacity programs for Iota-like networks. We further analyze the capacity of those strategies in huge data processing and compare their overall performance and scalability. The paper concludes with a discussion of implications to the networking network and the way these methods can be implemented for higher performance in today’s Iota networks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Astute Infant Monitoring System Based on YOLO v8 Algorithm

abstract: Parents today have a greater workload because they are working hard at their careers. As a result, there is less opportunity of giving babies better care. Children’s health may suffer greatly as a result of this. Even if the infants are appropriately and consistently monitored, there is a risk of losing life. For this, we use cameras to monitor the external conditions. The system is designed to monitor and alert the baby emotions to the parents. The monitoring of baby’s motion, emotions and surrounding is done by the camera that is fixed in an angle that it can cover the baby to the maximum extend. The camera that are fixed turn according to the baby’s movement, so that it continuously monitors the baby. The system will alert the user if there in some negative emotion given by the baby. The system is trained in a way that it monitors the surroundings around the baby carefully. (eg: fire). This is done using YOLO v8. YOLO v8 is an anchor-free model.

articleTitle: Sinhala-Centric Java Assistance Tool for Entry-Level Programmers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Programming plays a significant role in computer science and information technology. For example, novice programmers often find it challenging to use the Java programming language due to language barriers. Creating a learning environment that considers the linguistic needs of students can be highly beneficial. By adapting our teaching practices to accommodate different types of learners, we can improve performance. Therefore, this study suggests methods for learning programming using Sinhala as the medium of instruction. Azure Translator is integrated to translate Sinhala questions into English and provide Sinhala explanations, enabling users to receive Java code customized to their specific needs. The system uses ChatGPT 4 integration to generate code. Additionally, the system can transform English code explanations into Sinhala, giving learners access to instructional material whenever they need it. The created tool explains programming principles, logic, and syntax in both Sinhala and English for Java code segments in a simple, concise, and thorough manner. Furthermore, the Java-based Sinhala assistance tool offers explanations of essential Java programming concepts in Sinhala, ensuring comprehensive coverage of both basic and more complex topics. After entering a question in Sinhala, the system displays the relevant Java code along with explanations in Sinhala.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Greener Healthy System For Data Center using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid expansion of data center resources, driven by the increasing demand for a variety of customer services, has led to higher energy consumption and the emission of heat and harmful gases, contributing to global warming. To tackle this pressing issue, the Greener Healthy System (GHS) has been developed to reduce the environmental impact of data center operations. GHS collects data from IoT sensors that monitor various harmful emissions within the data center. This data is then analyzed using machine learning algorithms to ensure high accuracy and reliability. Based on the analysis, the system autonomously implements energy-efficient strategies and optimizes cooling mechanisms, which helps to lower energy consumption. As a result, the release of harmful gases is reduced, mitigating the effects of global warming. Additionally, GHS utilizes machine learning techniques to refine predictive models for identifying and reducing harmful emissions within the data center, promoting a more sustainable and environmentally friendly operation.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Learning Approach for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Early detection of diabetic retinopathy (DR) is essential because it enables timely intervention to prevent vision loss, which is a common consequence of the disease. In this regard, an efficient deep learning approach based on MobileNetV2 is proposed for classification of DR. In this improved module is designed which is fused to the base MobileNetV2 to enhance the accuracy of DR classification. Experiments are conducted on MESSIDOR and IDRID datasets and shows better performance of proposed method. The proposed model got 83.14% accuracy with the dataset of referral/non-referral classes and with 4 classes it got 63.47% accuracy.

articleTitle: Improving Video Search and Retrieval Through Semantic Annotation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper affords a singular approach for enhancing video search and retrieval through the usage of semantic annotation. The proposed method includes levels of semantic annotation and semantic search and retrieval. Within the first level, semantic descriptors are mechanically generated from low-degree features of the video. Inside the 2 nd, those semantic descriptors are used to locate relevant films efficiently. Experiments are performed to evaluate the accuracy and performance of the proposed machine. Consequences indicate that the proposed gadget extensively outperforms existing techniques for video seek and retrieval, demonstrating the application of semantic annotation.

articleTitle: Utilizing Deep Learning Methods for Cancer Detection through Analysis of MicroRNA Expression Profiles
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Integration of cutting-edge computational methods and genomic data analysis has become crucial in the quest for early cancer diagnosis and enhanced diagnostic accuracy. The genomic sequences of microRNAs (miRNAs), which are important cancer biomarkers, provide important information for this. In this study, we propose a novel deep learning-based framework for cancer detection with a focus on FNNs and a hybrid DNN model with an accuracy of over 90.7%. Our method aims to identify detailed genomic patterns and features that improve the sensitivity and specificity of cancer detection by painstakingly curating and preprocessing large miRNA datasets gathered from various patient cohorts. This research sets the stage for further exploration of deep learning methodologies within the context of miRNA-based cancer detection, promising advancements in personalized diagnosis and prognosis. Our method aims to identify detailed genomic patterns and features that improve the sensitivity and specificity of cancer detection by painstakingly curating and preprocessing large miRNA datasets gathered from various patient cohorts. The amalgamation of social media’s immediacy with BERT’s analytical prowess empowers stakeholders to stay attuned to unfolding events in real-time, enhancing the ability to deploy resources and assistance where they are most needed. In essence, our proposal not only streamlines disaster communication but also holds the promise of saving lives through timely and targeted interventions. abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to enhance human activity prediction by integrating Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) with an Encoder-Decoder model within the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework. Our proposed model harnesses the power of spatio-temporal 3D convolutions to capture intricate patterns and temporal dependencies present in video data, thereby improving prediction precision and resilience. To showcase the effectiveness of our approach, we utilize the KTH dataset for action recognition tasks, demonstrating its utility in managing video data within deep learning pipelines. The KTH dataset serves as a valuable resource for simplifying data preprocessing and facilitating focused model development. At the core of our research lies the GAN-based model, which consists of a Generator and a Discriminator. The Generator is responsible for generating lifelike video frames from latent space representations, while the Discriminator guides adversarial training dynamics. By employing an encoder-decoder architecture augmented by TCN layers, our model adeptly captures both spatial and temporal information inherent in video sequences. Through extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets like KTH Action, we demonstrate the competitive performance of our model. Evaluation metrics including Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) highlight the superior accuracy of our approach compared to existing models such as FutureGAN, fRNN, and MCNet.

articleTitle: Analysis of Load Frequency Control in Two Area Power System by Using PID Controller at Different Load Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AGC, also known as Load Frequency Control (LFC), utilizes mathematical modeling to analyze the dynamics of power generation and load variations. Traditionally, a classical second-order system with a governor and turbine is a common model for managing single-area load frequency. However, this study explores a two-area electrical power system. Using a trial-and-error approach, the MATLAB/SIMULINK model incorporates PI and PID controllers to manage the frequency and tie line of the two-area system. Additionally, a comparative analysis of these controllers is performed with PID-tuning techniques to refine the accuracy of the system-stabilizing controller’s settings. The PID controller adjusts the output of generators, transformers, or other components to maintain optimal operating conditions. As a well-established feedback control method, the Proportional-Integral-Derivative controller is widely used across various fields. Despite its historical importance in control systems, its application is anticipated to evolve with technological and methodological advancements in the future.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Cricket Tweets using NLP++
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With increasing difficulty for statistical sentiment analysis models to handle linguistic ambiguity and adjust to changing linguistic trends. Prejudices are reinforced by biased training data, which reduces accuracy—particularly in multilingual environments. On the other hand, sentiment analysis that is human-based adds subjectivity and empathy, which are necessary for nuanced interpretation in challenging situations. People are quite good at reading sarcasm, figuring out cultural quirks, and interpreting subtle facial expressions, which greatly improves sentiment analysis’s overall accuracy. This contradiction draws attention to the shortcomings of statistical models and emphasizes how human-based methods can be transformative when traversing the nuances of sentiments in a variety of textual contexts. An advanced programming language designed specifically for natural language processing is called NLP++. It is distinguished by its exceptional capacity to eloquently combine syntax with semantics, akin to text-based languages like PHP or HTML. With the VisualText® integrated development environment, we can write programs that analyses text whether we’re a programmer, linguistics major, or just interested in building software. This paper proposes the idea of using of NLP++, as a human-based reader for the text provided through the cricket tweets, by defining various rules constructed on this text-based language and providing various sentiments for the tweets such as PlayerSentiments, TeamSentiments and so on.

articleTitle: Empowering IoT Security: Leveraging Deep Neural Networks Against Ransomware and DDoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using Internet of Things (IoT) devices has become more efficient and convenient, but it has also increased the potential of security breaches, particularly from ransomware and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) assaults. This study looks into the ever-changing threats posed by ransomware on the Internet of Things, emphasizing human-centered detection and mitigation techniques. It highlights attack methods like supply chain breaches and device exploitation that jeopardize privacy and service continuity. To enhance IoT security, a deep neural network-based approach is proposed for automated reaction and real-time monitoring. The superior precision and efficacy of the suggested approach in mitigating ransomware and DDoS assaults in contrast to existing techniques underscores the significance of robust security protocols and active stakeholder engagement. This paper’s goal is to provide a thorough study of these dangers along with a novel solution that will improve security protocols in IoT ecosystems. This study seeks to close the gap between sophisticated technological protections and workable, user-oriented tactics by highlighting the need of human-centered approaches, guaranteeing that IoT devices continue to be dependable and safe in an increasingly interconnected world. This study emphasizes the vital need for an integrated strategy to IoT security that incorporates both cutting-edge technology and proactive human engagement through thorough evaluation and suggested solutions.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Education:An Empirical Study on Evaluating LSRW Acquisition Through Active Involvement and Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent past Communication has played a key role in the job market and societal norms. Students with better communication skills are academically and technically smart, they communicate and understand their colleagues which creates a holistic work/study environment. The four main divisions of communication skills are LSRW (Listening, speaking, reading and writing). Each and every division is directly or indirectly dependent on each other. Improving these four skills are essential in today’s world. To foster these skills a new model has been proposed which is backed by AI (Artificial Intelligence). After each skill module this model tests a student’s communication skills and generates feedback which shows the interpretation level of the student. This data is given to an AI model which generates questions according to the understanding of each student. Each student gets a unique set of questions according to his/her understanding and interpretation skills. This model coerces a student to engage in advancing their communication skills. It strengthens one’s knowledge in each and every aspect of the communication skill as it has speaking and listening exercises incorporated in it. Hence, we can say that the proposed AI model has a $\mathbf{95\%}$ success rate as it has an optimistic effect in a student’s study and work-related aspects. Since it is easy and effective it can be incorporated in schools, colleges, universities, companies and various other institutions. The implementation of these AI tools shows a generative impact in the above-mentioned institutions.

articleTitle: Information Entropy and Audit Quality: Exploring the Role of Information Theory in Enhancing Audit Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Information is vital in reducing uncertainty in auditing, data analysis and interpretation. If somebody gets precise information, then the uncertainty in data interpretation will be reduced. Audit quality depends upon many variables. One of the variables is ‘Information Volume’. The auditor is not expected to check a hundred per cent of the data. He is an observer. With more information, the statistical probability of unverified information will be higher due to its output volume. This paper aims to analyse the relationship between various factors affecting the information system and audit quality in the light of information theory. Information theory assumes of the existence of uncertainty. It is called information entropy. Information Entropy can be further explained by using a formula. As there are multicollinear variable dependencies, it becomes more complex. So, the combined analysis and synthesis method is used to understand the dependencies in the variables for the study of information entropy in audit quality.

articleTitle: Distributed Ledger Based Educational Degree Authentication and Integrity System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital era, traditional methods of academic certificate validation are plagued by inefficiencies and vulnerabilities to fraudulent activities. To combat these challenges, integrating blockchain technology presents a promising solution. Originally designed for cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, blockchain offers a decentralized ledger system characterized by transparency, cryptographic security, and immutability. This research endeavors to explore the utilization of blockchain for the validation of student certificates. Our proposed system aims to develop a robust platform for issuing, storing, and verifying certificates, leveraging blockchain’s distributed consensus and cryptographic features to ensure integrity and authenticity. Additionally, the system will incorporate user-friendly interfaces, seamless integration with existing educational systems, and advanced security measures to enhance user experience and trust in the validation process. This innovative approach grants individuals’ greater control over their credentials while mitigating risks of fraud and manipulation, thus revolutionizing the landscape of academic certificate validation in the digital age.

articleTitle: Integrating Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Image Caption Generation: A Unified Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Within the realm of natural language processing and computer vision, the synergy between Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) systems has emerged as some powerful paradigm for image captioning. This paper presents a comprehensive solution for visual and temporal understanding in the image captioning domain by presenting a unified framework that efficiently blends the strengths of CNN and LSTM architectures. Our proposed model takes advantage of the spatial hierarchies captured by CNNs in images and the sequential dependencies modeled by LSTMs in natural language. The CNN component efficiently retrieves high-degree features to result in coherent and contextually rich image captions. The hybridization of both of these networks creates a symbiotic relationship, addressing the challenges associated with both spatial and temporal aspects of image interpretation. We carried out in-depth tests on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the superiority of our hybrid CNN-LSTM architecture over standalone models. Our results showcase improved captioning exactness, fluency, and contextual relevance. Our proposed model achieved highest BLEU score $\mathbf{0. 8 1}$ when compared with existing methods. In addition, we investigated the interpretability of our model, shedding light on the visual and temporal cues learned by the hybrid architecture.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Metal Surface Defect Identification Using Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Metal surface defect identification is a critical aspect of quality control in various industrial sectors, where the integrity and safety of metal components are paramount. Traditional methods of defect detection often rely on manual inspection, which is time-consuming, subjective, and prone to errors. In response to these challenges, this study investigates the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for automating and enhancing defect identification on metal surfaces. The CNN model is trained on a dataset consisting of images of metal surfaces with labelled defects, allowing it to learn and recognise patterns associated with various types of defects, including cracks, pits, corrosion, and surface imperfections. The training process involves multiple epochs, with the the model’s performance evaluated based on training and testing accuracy, as well as training and testing loss. The results demonstrate a progressive improvement in both training and validation accuracy over successive epochs, indicating the CNN model’s ability to effectively learn and generalize from the training data. Additionally, there is a notable decrease in both training and testing loss, signifying the model’s capacity to minimize errors and accurately identify defects on metal surfaces. The highest performance of the model has been analyzed at epoch 10 as 91.97% and 95.83% at the training and testing phases, respectively. Furthermore, the study discusses the implications of these findings for industrial applications, highlighting the potential of CNN models to revolutionize defect detection processes and enhance quality control measures.

articleTitle: Blind Signal Detection Using Modern Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores various applications of modern deep learning techniques in the communication domain to predict the blind modulation technique of great importance to many defence-related critical confidential communications. A CNN-based Detection Technique is proposed to determine the modulation of the blind signals so that information can be extracted from them. Several CNN Models were used in this work. The algorithm achieves the highest accuracy at 93%.

articleTitle: Design of a Chatbot Enabled Mobile Application for Real-Time Rice Leaf Disease Identification Using Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Rice leaf diseases pose a significant threat to rice production, affecting yield and quality. This research aims to develop an efficient method for detecting rice leaf diseases using deep learning models. We have implemented deep learning framework using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) ResNet50 and VGG16, Inception V3 to classify six common rice leaf diseases. The models were trained and validated using a benchmark dataset and later integrated into an Android application via a REST API for real-time disease detection. Our results indicate high accuracy and reliability, demonstrating the potential of mobile-based disease diagnostics in agriculture.

articleTitle: Integration of Non- Decimation and PCA in Wavelet Based Multi-Band Ear Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: Vemu S V S S Anandamai

abstract: Ear recognition has gained prominence as a reliable biometric modality due to its unique and stable features. This paper gives an approach for ear recognition using a nondecimated wavelet transform in a multiband framework, coupled with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction. The suggested technique for 2D-WMBPCA involves dividing the input image into wavelet subbands using a 2 dimensional wavelet transform that retains all of the wavelet coefficients. This wavelet transform avoids down-sampling, preserving more information and allowing for better feature extraction. The number of frames in each resulting sub band is divided based on the coefficient values. Equal size can be used to calculate the limits of multiple frame generation. The multiband wavelet coefficients dimensionality is then decreased by applying PCA. It helps in selecting the most discriminative features and mitigates the curse of dimensionality, contributing to improved recognition accuracy and faster computation.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Pedestrian Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a significant field within computer vision, closely related to object detection, with applications spanning surveillance, autonomous driving, optical character recognition (OCR), and face recognition. This paper focuses on detecting pedestrians and cyclists using images captured from surveillance cameras and vehicle-mounted cameras. Our application involves detecting objects in complex environments where the distinction between objects and the background is subtle. The detection model must achieve high accuracy and precision. We have employed the Faster R-CNN model for this task. Although Faster R-CNN offers higher accuracy compared to models like YOLO, it operates at a lower speed. The enhanced precision of Faster R-CNN makes it well-suited for our needs, despite the trade-off in processing time. Our implementation includes data preparation, model training with fine-tuning on a custom dataset, evaluation, and calculation of the mean number of bounding boxes. This approach ensures robust detection performance, which is crucial for the intended applications.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Three Phase Smart Electrical Consumption Monitoring System Using ADE9000
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s industries, optimizing energy consumption is critical, but outdated monitoring devices cause inefficiencies. Our paper proposes an IoT-based solution utilizing the ADE9000 chip for real-time monitoring of energy parameters like current, voltage, frequency, power, power factor and power quality. By leveraging the ADE9000’s high accuracy and unique power quality measurement capabilities, industries can identify areas of overconsumption and implement targeted efficiency measures. For example, real-time power quality analysis aids in detecting and mitigating issues such as voltage fluctuations, thereby reducing downtime. Data analytics enables industries to make informed decisions, optimize operations, and cut costs, demonstrating IoT’s transformative potential in improving industrial energy efficiency and sustainability. Our approach for this idea aligns perfectly with the capabilities of the ADE9000 chip. Overall the ADE9000 can provide real-time alerts in addition to sending data to the cloud for every 100 milli seconds, which is pivotal in bolstering the performance, efficiency, and sustainability of industrial operations. Our solution, powered by the ADE9000 chip, ensures industry-leading accuracy, with a precision rate of 99.89%, enabling precise monitoring of energy parameters. This high level of accuracy enhances decision-making and empowers industries to achieve unparalleled efficiency gains and sustainability objectives.

articleTitle: An Efficient Innovative Masked Face Recognition Using FaceNet Algorithm over Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) Algorithm for Better Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Aim: The COVID-19 virus has made wearing masks a habit for living beings, the objective of this project is to provide a system with better accuracy for masked facial identification using the FaceNet Algorithm in comparison with the Visual Geometry Group Algorithm. Materials and Methods: In a total of $\mathbf{1 1 2}$ samples, Each group has $\mathbf{5 6}$ samples and the number of iterations is $\mathbf{1 0}$ for each group. The $\mathbf{G}$ power for calculating statistical tests is set at 80%. A total of 2800 images which make 2240 training images and 560 tested images-make up the research dataset, which is obtained from Kaggle.com combined with self-obtained images. Results: The accuracy results for the Innovative FaceNet algorithm is (87.7%), and the Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) technique is ($\mathbf{9 0. 2 \%}$). The significance value is 0.001 ($\mathbf{p}\lt0.05$) which is statistically significant for the two algorithms considered for identity recognition of masked faces. Conclusion: The accuracy has significantly improved in the Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) algorithm compared to the FaceNet approach.

articleTitle: A Miniaturised Dual-Band Hexagonal-Shaped Frequency Selective Surface with Slot Loading
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Abstract- A very small FSS structure for the 6 GHz frequency is suggested in this paper. With a height of 1.6 mm, the suggested FSS measures $22 \times 22 \mathrm{~mm}$ in size. The proposed FSS comprises the combination of hexagonal shaped patch, plus shaped resonator and six inner circular shaped slots. The extremely small structure is manufactured on a FR4 dielectric substrate material, and a copper patch material is used for radiating purpose. The proposed FSS structure includes hexagonal and plus shaped patch with six circular slots on it. The inserted slots are responsible for dual band behavior. The proposed FSS provides better stopband results in both frequencies (5.2 and 8.3 GHz).

articleTitle: Probabilistic Sign Flipping Attack in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) has surfaced as a paradigm-shifting methodology in the field of machine learning (ML), operating on the principle that data privacy is maintained while a network of distributed clients train models collectively. FL is vulnerable to adversarial challenges, most notably sign flipping attack (SFA), in which malicious participants alter the direction of model updates on purpose. This paper investigates the effects of sign flipping attacks within FL, characterized by attackers who manipulate the parameters of the model based on varying probabilities $(\alpha)$ and percentages of attackers. By conducting a comprehensive simulation spanning 100 rounds with 40 clients per round, the resilience of the system is assessed in the face of attack probabilities $(\alpha)$ of 0.5,0.7, and 1.0, as well as attacker percentages of 10% and 30%. The impact on average training accuracy and loss for local models, as well as the test accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of the global model, is thoroughly assessed in the comprehensive analysis. The results validate the hypothesis that increased attack probabilities and percentages of attackers have a substantial negative impact on system performance. By providing insight into the subtle consequences of sign-flipping attacks and laying the groundwork for the creation of resilient defense strategies to protect FL systems from adversarial intrusions, this study adds to the expanding corpus of knowledge on adversarial tactics in FL.

articleTitle: Understanding the Trade-Offs between Communications Software Design and Network Services
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The layout of software to optimize community offerings can be a challenging venture. No c the blessings of extended bandwidth and stepped forward overall performance, there are numerous principal exchange-offs to remember while configuring communications software programs. Safety, scalability, compatibility, and usability should be considered when making layout alternatives. Moreover, it’s miles essential to recognize how every one of these factors impacts the general person revel in and how they interact with each different. By weighing the diverse exchange-offs between communications software layout and community offerings, a balanced gadget can be done, granting a reliable and fulfilling personal experience. Communications software should be designed and written to allow communication across the community among nodes while also providing essential safety and getting the right of entry to manipulate protocols earlier than statistics are exchanged. But community services have to be organized to successfully facilitate the shipping of statistics in an orderly style for the correct nodes at the given time, allowing the software and the network to work collectively efficiently.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency of Wind Farm Energy using Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using digital twin technology, the projectpresents a novel technique for wind farm monitoring and maintenance. This technique seeks to revolutionize wind farm management by assuring optimal performance, efficiency, and lifespan. The use of digital twin technology provides a virtual duplicate of the complete wind farm that isconstantly updated with real-time data from sensors located around the facility. This allows for a highly accurate depiction of physical assets and their operating condition, supporting real-time performance evaluation, predictivemaintenance, problem detection, energy optimization, and environmental impact reduction. The digital twin provides instantaneous performance evaluations by using sensor data, detecting underperforming turbines and forecasting possible breakdowns. It also plans maintenance tasks based on historical and real-time data, reducing downtime and operational costs while increasing dependability and safety. The digital twin improves defect detection by leveraging modern analytics and machine learning, hence increasing theoverall dependability of the wind farm.

articleTitle: Automated Image-Based Defect Detection for Semiconductor Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automated picture-at the complete-based sickness detection for semiconductor production is a completely unique approach for detecting defects in the production of covered circuits. It is achieved through the usage of computer imaginative and prescient algorithms to routinely study manufactured semiconductor wafers for each regular and irregular contamination. In region of using complex sickness recognition algorithms, which incorporates device imaginative and prescient and deep studying, this method greater correctly detects defects with the aid of way of the use of automatic photograph-based totally infection identity. The automated photograph-primarily based completely contamination detection technique uses predictor pixel values from close to-by way of picks to select out odd pixels and, subsequently, can as it should be recognize and isolate a huge form of defects from the output of a semiconductor wafer. This approach is more accurate and green as compared to particular present techniques of illness detection. Because of this, it may lessen the amount of time and fee associated with illness finding, sorting, and restore for semiconductor manufacturing.

articleTitle: Truth Tracker: Unveiling Fact From Fiction in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Rumor detection on social media is the process of identifying and verifying the accuracy of information or claims that circulate on the social media platform. Social media, with its rapid dissemination of information, is particularly susceptible to the spread of rumors and false information. Identifying rumors frequently necessitates the use of various machine leaning and natural language processing (NLP) approaches for assessing the content, information, and origin of tweets. Key steps in rumor detection on social media include identifying suspicious or unverified claims, assessing the credibility of sources, and determining the likelihood of the information being true or false. This procedure is vital in halting the dissemination of false information, maintaining the integrity of information shared on the platform, and ensuring that users have access to accurate and reliable information. In this paper, an extensive examination of a variety of rumor detection techniques on social media is provided. Firstly, an exhaustive evaluation of rumor detection methods on social media is conducted. Subsequently, a comparative assessment is carried out, highlighting their advantages and disadvantages to pinpoint challenges within these techniques. Finally, the paper concludes by offering suggestions for enhancing the effectiveness of rumor detection techniques.

articleTitle: Representation Learning Mixed with Semantic Reasoning for Zero-Shot Learning in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper examines a singular approach to 0shot getting to know (ZSL) through the aggregate of illustration learning and semantic reasoning techniques for laptop imaginative and prescient programs. ZSL is an undertaking in which a device learning system is required to classify objects and scenes that it has never seen before, primarily based on a pre-defined semantic description. This painting introduces a method that collectively learns an illustration for each photograph and enhances it with an extra vector to account for semantic facts, which enables the gadget to it should be generalized to unseen instructions. The illustration learning is applied using a convolutional neural network (CNN) trained with a couple of auxiliary losses, whilst the semantic reasoning is modelled through a linear transformation that maps a semantic description to the found-out picture illustration. The effectiveness of the approach is confirmed on widespread item popularity benchmarks, and consequences show that the proposed technique outperforms present ZSL tactics.

articleTitle: Facilitating Access to Banking Services with ATM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: ATM networks were an essential part of global banking offerings in view that their debut in 1967, imparting customers with speedy and convenient get entry to their cash. ATM networks facilitate the bodily exchange of price range at numerous locations and enable customers to carry out primary banking operations inclusive of depositing coins, checking balances, and finishing transfers. The allotted community of ATM machines makes banking offerings greater reachable to a much wider populace, such as the ones in faraway or underserved areas. ATM networks also make banking greater cozy, facilitating authentication approaches and providing higher physical protection than manual managing of coins. Because the banking enterprise maintains to conform, ATM networks continue to be an important part of providing clients access to banking services.

articleTitle: Applying Identity-Based Security Algorithms to Cloud Computing Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Identification-based protection algorithms are cryptographic algorithms that provide authentication and facts integrity by verifying the identities of customers or resources inside a gadget. Such algorithms may be applied to cloud computing networks in an effort to cozy cloud-based statistics and services. Identity-based algorithms use keys or credentials embedded in cryptographic messages to authenticate the sender or receiver and to offer non-repudiation of the message, statistics integrity, and relaxed access manipulation. Additionally, identification-based algorithms can be used to effectively bind digital certificates and personal keys to create sturdy digital signatures. It will be used to permit ease of message exchange between specific entities in a cloud computing community. Subsequently, identification-based total algorithms can offer an at-ease mechanism for facts sharing amongst one-of-a-kind users and nodes on a cloud network.

articleTitle: Enabling Secure Mobile Computing Through Advanced Security Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper examines the ability of advanced safety algorithms to permit at ease mobile computing. Using encryption in the transmission of information and application layer mechanisms are discussed with particular attention on relaxed authentication protocols. The capability of present day mobile device operating structures and platform architectures are explored to demonstrate how these algorithms can be integrated to shape relaxed cellular packages. The significance of modularization and distributed architecture is highlighted to increase the scalability and security of mobile applications, at the same time as similarly interest is paid to critical protection considerations along with the allowance of gadgets to authenticate and method statistics using substantial neighborhood cryptographic operations. The advantages of superior security algorithmic and of cozy cell packages are mentioned, such as ability packages inside e-trade, healthcare and government sectors.

articleTitle: Breaking Barriers: Bridging Communication Gaps in Virtual Meetings with ASL Integration for Google Meet
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital landscape, effective communication remains challenging for American Sign Language (ASL) users in virtual settings. This paper introduces a solution integrating ASL into Google Meet, enabling real-time ASL-to-text conversion for seamless communication. This study aims to address the following questions: How effective is the ASL-to-text conversion system in improving communication for ASL users in virtual meetings? What technical and ethical challenges arise during the implementation? How does the system enhance accessibility and inclusivity in online meetings? The system uses MediaPipe to detect hand signs, which are then sent to a browser via a socket connection to an extension that types the sign in the chatbox. Additionally, it incorporates text-to-speech synthesis for enhanced accessibility. User testing was conducted to validate the system’s efficacy, focusing on accuracy, response time, and user satisfaction. Data was collected and analyzed to identify areas for improvement. User testing demonstrated that the system significantly improved communication accessibility and efficiency for ASL users. The ASL-to-text conversion showed high accuracy rates, and the response time was sufficient for real-time communication. Users reported increased inclusivity and a more seamless virtual meeting experience. This pioneering approach effectively addresses communication barriers for ASL users, marking a significant stride towards creating inclusive virtual environments on Google Meet. The study highlights the system’s potential to enhance accessibility and inclusivity in online meetings, while also identifying technical and ethical considerations for further development.

articleTitle: Integration of Computer Vision and 4DOF SCARA Robot Arm for Tomato Sorting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automating fruit recognition and classification is an important computer vision application that can improve efficiency and consistency in the fruit industry. Manual sorting methods based on visual inspection are tedious, time-consuming, and prone to inconsistencies. This work presents the design and deployment of an automated tomato sorting system that integrates computer vision and robotics. The system classifies tomatoes into three maturity stages (Green, Half-ripe, Ripe) based on color using the YOLOv5 deep learning algorithm. A SCARA robot is used for picking and placing the sorted tomatoes into respective bins. The system demonstrates a fast inference time of 22.31 milliseconds for tomato detection and can sort three tomatoes of different maturity classes in approximately 1.2 seconds on average. This consistent and efficient sorting is based on objective color criteria rather than manual visual inspection. The system can help improve product quality, reduce labor costs, and increase throughput in tomato processing facilities. The approach can be extended to sorting other fruits and vegetables based on color attributes.

articleTitle: Geological Information Extraction from Satellite Imagery Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Satellite imagery offers extensive information that can be used for a variety of societal applications, from the number of buildings in a metropolis to the land cover types of a specific area. However, extracting such information is a difficult task. In the past, images were scanned manually by domain experts to extract features like buildings, infrastructure, and vegetation, which would take weeks or even months depending on the image size. To address this challenge, we trained our model using U-Net architecture, a deep learning model, because of its advantages in multiscale feature learning and faster processing. Data augmentation is done on the dataset in order to enhance the amount of data and prevent overfitting artificially. The trained model achieved an F1 score of 92% and an impressive precision score of 95%. This automated method can be scaled to large sets of data, reducing the need for human labeling.

articleTitle: An investigation of the use of cross-layer network coding algorithms in wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical summary provides an exploration of go-layer community Coding (CLNC) algorithms in wireless systems. CLNC is a coding technique whereby impartial packet transmissions from distinctive layers of the protocol stack are combined to create an unmarried packet. This is conceptually extraordinary from conventional community coding (NC), which handiest combines distinctive packets within the identical layer of the stack. CLNC aims to improve the efficiency of Wi-Fi transmission with the aid of lowering the overhead for retransmissions and, as a result, the electricity consumption of the gadget. The authors of this summary analyzed the performance of CLNC algorithms in IEEE 802.11 Wi -Fi structures. They studied unique CLNC algorithms: fountain coding and random linear network coding. Through their simulations, the authors determined that CLNC algorithms lessen the possible throughput and also reduce the robustness of the machine to packet losses. This summary introduces a theoretical framework for comparing the performance of CLNC algorithms in wireless systems. Primarily based on their findings, the authors advise that CLNC can be used to enhance the transmission performance of Wi-Fi hyperlinks, at the same time also supplying an extra layer of safety against packet losses. However, in addition research is needed to fully compare the trade-offs among performance and robustness for specific CLNC algorithms and specific Wi-Fi requirements.

articleTitle: A Unified Framework for Image Caption Generation Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a unified framework for picture caption generation with the use of deep reinforcement mastering (RL) that combines convolution neural networks (CNNs) with RL. The paper first introduces a country representation as a remark for RL by means of combining CNN-primarily based photo representation and natural language processing (NLP) natural language representation. Then, the paper describes an RL-based reinforcement mastering (RL-RL) set of rules which uses the statement to generate captions. Eventually, the paper shows the experimental consequences of the proposed RL-RL set of rules on real-world datasets and shows that the RL-RL set of rules outperforms the present RL-NLP and CNN-RL algorithms. The paper additionally demonstrates the very best overall performance on the benchmark dataset COCO with a BLEU score of 0.645 and a METEOR score of 0.348. The proposed framework affords a sensible technique to generate interesting and affordable captions for photographs.

articleTitle: Predicting Air Quality Index with Recurrent Neural Networks and Meta-heuristic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide suffer from the impacts of air pollution, a significant health risk. The metric Air Quality Index (AQI) serves as a crucial tool, providing valuable insights into current air quality conditions and potential health risks. This study utilizes two datasets: one from Wuhan City and the other from Shanghai. The features utilized for forecasting the AQI include PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NO2, O3, CO, l_temp, h_temp, temp, wet, wind, Hecto-pascal Pressure Unit (hpa), visibility, precipitation, and cloud content. This work focuses on developing models to predict AQI for a given data by comparing Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and its variants, including Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), Stacked LSTM, and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models. Additionally, Particle Swarm Optimization is utilized as an evolutionary feature selection method.

articleTitle: Multilingual Offensive Language Detection In Social Media Content Using BERT-Base-Multilingual-Cased Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rise of social media and online communication has fostered global dialogue, transcending linguistic and geographic barriers. However, it has also ushered in the use of offensive language, posing challenges to safe digital spaces. Addressing this in a multilingual context is crucial for a more inclusive online environment. This paper tackles the classification of offensive and non-offensive comments, delving into the complexities of multilingual offensive language detection. Utilizing a joint-multilingual approach-based BERT model, comments are classified across various languages. Experiments on a dataset featuring English, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Greek, and Russian comments yield promising results: 92.47% of accuracy and a confidence score of 51.60%.

articleTitle: Design And Analysis Of Soft Robotic Gripper With Different Materials For Object Handling
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Soft grippers have gained significant attention in robotics due to their ability to handle delicate objects and adapt to complex shapes. This project aims to conduct a comprehensive comparative analysis of various materials used in the development of soft grippers, including Natural rubber, Silicone, Thermoplastic elastomer, and EPDM. Employing a combination of ANSYS simulation and experimental validation techniques, the research endeavors to assess the mechanical performance and suitability of each material for soft gripper applications. Initially, a detailed 3D model of the gripper is meticulously crafted using SolidWorks software, serving as the basis for subsequent simulation studies. Through ANSYS simulation, critical parameters such as stress distribution, strain response, displacement characteristics, bending moment, and temperature stability are rigorously evaluated for each material under varying loading conditions. Concurrently, practical experimentation is conducted to validate the simulation results and assess real-world performance. A silicone-based gripper prototype is fabricated and seamlessly integrated with a FANUC ER4iA robot for compatibility testing, ensuring practical applicability and performance assessment in a robotic manipulation setting. Upon completion of simulation and experimental testing, comprehensive analyses are performed to identify the most suitable material for soft gripper development. Results indicate silicone as the optimal choice, owing to its exceptional mechanical properties, thermal stability, and compatibility with robotic systems. This research significantly contributes to the advancement of soft robotics by providing valuable insights into material selection and performance evaluation, ultimately facilitating the design and development of efficient and versatile soft grippers for diverse industrial and research applications.

articleTitle: Prediction of Wind Power Generation using Novel Linear Regression Algorithm Compared over Lasso Algorithm for Improving Accuracy Rate
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper is a novel approach to improving the accuracy of wind power generation predictions by using linear regression (LR) algorithm differentiated with the Lasso regression (LaR). The wind power generating data used in this investigation was collected from a coastal wind farm. A year’s worth of hourly data on wind speed and direction, humidity, and power generation are included in the dataset. The wind power generation dataset was separated into two groups, with 10 samples in each group. Group 1 was used to train the traditional LaR algorithm, and Group 2 was used to train the novel LR algorithm. The Lasso and LR models were implemented using the scikit-learn library in Python. The training data were utilized to build the models, and their performance was evaluated using the testing data, with accuracy being used as the metric. A power analysis was performed to identify the optimal sample quantity for the research study.. With a G-power $=0.8$, $\alpha=0.05$, and a beta value of 0.2, the study showed that a sample size of 10 individuals per group would be adequate. Additionally, a 95% confidence interval was calculated to ensure that the study’s results were statistically significant. After training and evaluating the LaR and LR models on their respective groups, the accuracy values were obtained. While the traditional LaR algorithm was determined to have an accuracy of 79.80%, a newly designed LR algorithm demonstrated an accuracy of 82.15% in the study. The results were statistically significant values with 0.000 ($p{\lt}0.05$). In conclusion, the novel LR algorithm was found to be more accurate than the traditional Lasso algorithm in predicting wind power generation.
