articleTitle: Automated Defect Classification in 3D Bioprinting using Liquid Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We propose a novel method utilizing Liquid Neural Networks (LNN) for defect detection in 3D bio-printed structures. By incorporating an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solver, the LNN architecture enhances modelling capabilities, achieving a remarkable 99% accuracy in analyzing complex structural patterns. Trained on data from publicly available Extrusion-Based Bioprinting (EBB) repositories, our model demonstrates robust adaptability in classifying 3D bioprinted structures into categories, including under-extrusion, over-extrusion, and good extrusion. By ensuring precise defect detection, we guarantee the structural integrity, mechanical strength, and biological functionality of 3D bio-printed structures. Through an $80-20$ train-test split, reliable performance assessment is ensured. Validation on an independent dataset, along with thorough metric analysis, reinforces the reliability of our approach. This research underscores the potential of liquid neural networks to significantly advance quality control in 3D bioprinting processes, paving the way for enhanced efficiency and precision in biomedical manufacturing.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning for Enhanced SensorPowered Green IoT with Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Federated getting to know (FL) is a gadget studying generation which allows a user to train a single model across more than one dispensed system, with none of the person systems having to transfer the statistics sets, nor the version, to a vital device for education. It allows disbursed schooling of an unmarried model throughout more than one disbursed net of things (IoT) gadgets or users. It makes it feasible to improve the accuracy and scalability of our Sensor-Powered inexperienced IoT applications. FL can consequently be instrumental in taking inexperienced IoT answers towards the character sources of environmental records, like air firstclass sensors, as opposed to amassing facts centrally.FL permits us to leverage powerful gadget learning models to enhance the accuracy and scalability of our Sensor-Powered green IoT systems. By using federated models throughout education, we will grow the accuracy of our predictions and decrease the amount of effort and time we have to acquire and store sensor facts centrally. Moreover, FL lets us improve the version overall performance of green IoT packages by dispensing schooling and predictions to a disbursed community of sensor-based totally IoT devices. We also can, in addition, reduce the reliance on central systems with the aid of transferring the middle of our Sensor-Powered inexperienced IoT packages from the cloud to allotted nodes.

articleTitle: Determining Factors and Correlation of Factors Influential for Student Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The involvement of students and their participation is indisputably considered the top factor contributing to the promotion of academic success and implementation of effective learning. The policy development should be done by educators and policymakers who have a strong foundation on the areas affecting student engagement, so as to come up with policies that enhance the quality of education and bring about positive academic goals. For the study of influential factors on students’ participation, and to find the relationships between the variables, this research takes a data-driven approach by using a dataset that includes 3000 individual observations as its main data source. Besides, it is the performance of five prominent machine learning algorithms, namely Decision Tress (DT), k-nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forests (RF), Support Vector Machines (SV), and Logistic Regression (LG) that is tested to find which method is the best in predicting student engagement. Accuracy can reach a 93% with the use of random forest. According to the findings of the study, student engagement may be defined as the level of interest, participation, and active involvement shown by students in the process of their education. Students that are engaged in their studies have improved academic performance as well as enhanced critical thinking and ability to solve problems. Considered to be potential factors in student engagement are aspects such as teaching strategies, the atmosphere of the classroom, the relevance of the curriculum, students’ levels of motivation and self-efficacy, the incorporation of technology, and the participation of parents.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of MEMS Sensor for HIV Virus Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The development of reliable and sensitive biosensors for HIV detection is crucial for early diagnosis and effective disease management. The paper presents the investigation of a MEMS cantilever-based biosensor for HIV detection utilizing Intellisuite software. The biosensor’s sample section is coated with antibodies that bind to antigens present in the patient’s sample, allowing for the identification of antigen presence through displacement. Five different models M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5 with various materials have been designed to improve the performance parameters: displacement, sensitivity, spring constant, and specificity. The best results have been achieved for Model M3 with PDMS material. Here, the displacement and sensitivity are found to be $2.811 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ and 147.4 $\mathrm{mm} / \mathrm{Pa}$ respectively and the% selectivity of the HIV against TB (Tuberculosis) and HBV (Hepatitis B Virus) are found to be ${9. 0 9 1 \%}$ and 36.352% from model M3 with PDMS material.

articleTitle: Automation of Network Security in Cloud Based Internet of Things Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

articleTitle: Design of Dadda Multiplier with Minimum Area Delay Power(ADP) Product by using an Approximate Novel Compressor
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The approximate multiplier that this paper presents employs new approximate 4-2 compressor, which is more power-efficient than the older approximate multipliers. In this work thorough comparison with earlier suggested approximation multipliers, taking into account a hardware implementation in 90 nm CMOS technology is done. This paper uses the suggested approximation compressor to create $8 \times 8$ multiplier. According to the experimental results, this design has reduction of 28% area and 30% power and 58% regarding area delay power(ADP) product in comparative with precise multiplier, and a ADP product reduction of 35%–40% when compared to the earlier related study with an identical accuracy. This research provides additional evidence of approximate multiplier’s efficacy using image processing application such as image multiplication.

articleTitle: Secure and Privacy-Preserving UAV-based Rescue Operations for Vehicles in Rugged Terrain
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional rescue efforts encounter difficulties in challenging terrain, hindered by obstacles and natural calamities. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) integrated with Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) present a viable solution, particularly in mountainous areas. UAVs function as airborne communication hubs, swiftly establishing temporary networks and overcoming geographical constraints. Their agility enables access to remote locations, offering vital assistance during emergencies. However, concerns regarding security and privacy emerge due to the openness of communication channels. To address this, we present a secure system for UAV-based rescue operations for vehicles. Our approach includes the application formal verification using “Scyther,” an informal analysis of other possible attacks towards the proposed scheme, and a comparative evaluation with existing solutions, ensuring security robustness in emergency scenarios.

articleTitle: Developing Autonomous Communications Systems to Enhance Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The development of verbal exchange systems has up to date be a vital research up-to-date with the upward push of latest styles of computing networks. Independent conversation systems offer the ability up to date updated network security via supplying comfortable and reliable conversation channels among or extra entities. Such structures depend upon machine gaining knowledge of algorithms updated understand and respond up to date network traffic up to date updated facilitate proactive security measures. With the creation of algorithms operating on the whole gadget, up-to-date communique systems can locate and deal with protection problems as fast as they stand up. Additionally, allotted consensus algorithms can be leveraged up to date make certain that security features across the whole network are consistent. In the end, the improvement of self-sufficient conversation systems can offer improved levels of scalability, because the community size may be adjusted dynamically up-to-date new computing necessities. By means of improving the security of community communications, self-sustaining updated verbal exchange structures can help protect cusupupdated and their statistics whilst paving the manner for the improvement of increasingly more sophisticated and relaxed networks.

articleTitle: Two Stage Non-Linear Pose estimation of Non-Cooperative satellites using Deep Keypoint Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We present a Two-Stage Non-Linear Pose estimation method based on computer vision algorithms specifically designed for docking applications and space debris removal for posture estimation of non-cooperative satellites. This overall approach first estimates the two-dimensional image projection of the three-dimensional object Landmarks and then applies a RANSAC Perspective-n-Point (PnP) algorithm over the set of 2D-3D correspondences to obtain the position and Orientation of the Satellite Image. Using Blender 3D modelling software, we created a vast diverse dataset of satellite Images, recording different Satellites, camera positions, and lighting conditions. All the Images used for training were labeled for Object Detection by creating Bounding Boxes around all the Satellite Images generated in Blender and are further being used to train for Satellite Detection using the HrNet Algorithm. The HRNet is then trained for keypoint regression using a cross-validation technique, which involves splitting the dataset into several training and validation sets to improve the IOU metric. The Perspective$\mathbf{n - P o i n t}$ (PnP) technique was used for pose estimation after the keypoint regression produced a 2D image projection of 3D Ground truth points. We included the solvePnP with an iterator argument which uses the Levenberg-Marquardt(LM) method for noise and outlier reduction to further improve the posture estimation. Our methodology offers significant improvements in the precision and efficiency of satellite docking procedures, providing a viable solution for autonomous space missions while further improving the domain adaptability of the model in the future with the development of unsupervised domain adaptability models.

articleTitle: Refined Neural Attention Network for Aspect Phrases Retrieval in Opinion Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have seen accomplishments in a variety of academic fields, notably text processing, image processing, machine translation, and social network screening. On numerous social media platforms, a lot of user-generated content is accessible. that can be applied to precisely analyze opinions in light of evolving market conditions. In sentiment analysis at aspect-level, the aspect phrase retrieval (APR) operation finds the users’ intended topics in the content of the document. The bulk of aspect retrieval techniques are context or domain dependent. Additionally, due to a lack of topical and situational expertise, it is challenging to pinpoint the most important domain-specific element phrases. Due to their inability to recognize noun phrase relationships as time passes, the present extraction techniques have no way to determine several essential aspect terms. This study suggests using linguistic patterns with deep attention network to improve the APR problem. Findings from investigations and tests are analyzed across a variety of factors on common review datasets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Skin Cancer Diagnosis using Dermoscopic Images: A Feature Fusion based Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin cancer, one of the most prevalent and potentially deadly forms of cancer, necessitates early and accurate detection to improve patient outcomes. Aspiration of this paper is to present an innovative deep learning model for the precise identification of skin cancer from dermoscopic images. Leveraging the strengths of three pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures VGG19, VGG16, and ResNet50-the model aims to achieve exceptional accuracy in skin cancer diagnosis. Trained on extensive datasets of skin lesion images and initialized with ImageNet weights, the model undergoes rigorous testing to demonstrate its effectiveness. Through meticulous evaluation using metrics such as F1 score, precision, and recall, our model achieves remarkable accuracy of 93.50%. This study highlights the significant potential of deep learning-based methods in revolutionizing medical diagnostics, particularly in detecting skin cancer from dermoscopic images. By improving diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes, our research contributes to the ongoing fight against skin cancer.

articleTitle: Delineating Emotions in Speech: Comparative Insights from Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study utilizes multiple machine learning algorithms to investigate Speech Emotion Recognition (SER). We examine how well complex patterns in speech data may be captured by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). In contrast, we assess classical machine learning models trained using Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) derived from speech, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees, Random Forests, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). To potentially achieve better performance, we examine ensemble approaches that combine standard machine learning with deep learning. A thorough study of these methods’ performance in SER tasks may be attained by testing them on the RAVDESS and TESS datasets. The results are intended to aid in the creation of reliable speech-to-text emotion identification algorithms for enhanced HCI (Human Computer Interaction).

articleTitle: APT Detection Using Memory Forensics: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Advanced persistent threats (APTs), significant risks in the digital security landscape, are typically conducted by high-level entities. These threats, which can target various organizations and government bodies, have the potential to remain undetected due to their substantial resource support. Their ability to evade detection for extended periods allows perpetrators to slowly infiltrate target systems. This empirical study advocates the use of memory forensic analysis, performed using Volatility, combined with network analysis as effective tools in identifying APTs. Through the application of memory forensics, analysts can uncover crucial evidence of these nefarious activities. By utilizing memory artifacts and Volatility plugins, significant information on malware traffic was discovered, highlighting the efficacy of these methods in APT detection.

articleTitle: Creating a New Way to Classify Squash Varieties in India by Using CNN and LSTM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study brings a new sorting system that uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). These help to correctly spot squash types common in India. The system has a big set of $\mathbf{1 2, 0 0 0}$ high-quality pictures and it’s good at recognizing them with an accuracy level of $\mathbf{9 5. 6 \%}$. The CNN part is very good at getting complex pictures. The LSTM model handles data in a sequence for different kinds of squash types. Accuracy, precision, recall, and $F 1$-score show how good the model is at making correct classifications. When comparing this method with the old ones, it shows how good it is. This proves that it could be helpful for farming activities. This shows how strong the system is at spotting small differences between squash types. It also means better protection of seeds, more effective farming methods, and meeting market rules. But, chances to make things better involve getting models more flexible with different weather situations and changes in genes. More studies on changing how the system works, using different types of information, and making it work anywhere will make the system bigger and more useful. Emphasizing how machine learning can change farming, it gives a new way to classify kinds of squash. Doing the task right is a big step forward for farmers and helping them make plant farming better in different parts of India.

articleTitle: AI Resume Parser: Augmented Business Process Management Systems (ABPMS)
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AI-augmented Business Process Management Systems (ABPMSs) are an emerging class of process-aware systems empowered by trustworthy AI technology. These systems aim to enhance the execution of business processes, making them more proactive, explainable, and context-sensitive. An instance of this technology is AI enabled Resume Parser, aimed to enhance the recruiting process in HR department. The AI driven approach ensures high accuracy and versatility in handling various document types and layouts, hence simplifying HR tech workflows. It can address challenges associated with accuracy, bias and privacy that need to be considered. The proposed resume parser employs natural language processing algorithms for comprehending the context of data within resumes. AI resume parser is an emerging trend in recruitment process but still human oversight is needed in process as language can be complex and ambiguous. HR department in most companies are adopting ABPMS in place of traditional methodologies for less human workload. Hence, it contributes valuable insights in leveraging AI for sustainable business growth and enhanced decision-making in today’s digital era.

articleTitle: Beyond Tears: An AI Framework for Automated Interpretation of Baby Cries
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study addresses the challenge of automatically interpreting and classifying baby cries to discern various needs such as hunger, burping, tiredness, discomfort, or belly pain. Existing research lacks precise differentiation among these states from cry patterns. To bridge this gap, our research employs advanced analytic tools on a dataset comprising recordings of baby cries. Initially, audio files are processed through an MFCC converter to extract relevant characteristics, followed by PCA for dimensionality reduction. Various machine learning models are then applied to classify cry patterns. The primary aim is to enhance caregiving practices by providing caregivers with a tool to better attend to infants’ needs. The novelty lies in achieving higher classification accuracy $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$ using a decision tree classifier compared to existing methods. This approach not only improves the newborn environment but also contributes to pediatric healthcare and early childhood development. Our methodology demonstrates superior performance in accuracy and efficiency, underscoring its potential to revolutionize how caregivers respond to infants’ cries, thereby promoting better overall caregiving practices.

articleTitle: A Review on IoT-Enabled Smart Homes Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Internet of Things (IoT) technology has revolutionized the concept of smart homes, paving the way for enhanced automation, efficiency, and convenience in residential living. This review paper examines the advancements, challenges, and future prospects of AI-controlled smart homes powered by IoT. Through a survey of the existing literature, we highlight the key components, functionalities, and benefits of such systems, including intelligent energy management, predictive maintenance, and personalized user experiences. Moreover, we came across the knowledge of various AI algorithms and techniques utilized for data processing, decision-making, and interaction within smart home environments, we present insights from selected research papers that contributes significantly to the understanding and development of AI-enabled IoT solutions for smart homes. Through this review, we aim to provide a comprehensive overview of the state-of-the-art in AIcontrolled smart homes and stimulate further research in this rapidly evolving field.

articleTitle: Outage Probability Analysis of IRS-Assisted NOMA System Over Rician Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, the outage probability (OP) of intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) assisted non orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) technique is derived using Rician fading channel model. NOMA has emerged as a promising technology for enhancing spectral efficiency in wireless communication systems, while IRS has shown potential in improving the overall system performance through intelligent signal reflection. By combining these two technologies, we aim to provide a comprehensive analysis of the outage probability, which is a crucial metric in assessing the reliability of communication systems. For this purpose the channel from base station (BS) to IRS and from IRS to users are considered as Rician fading channel. We consider the IRS as an array of reflective elements capable of intelligently adjusting the incident signals phase as well as amplitude. The analytical outage probability expression is derived for the proposed system model. The integrated NOMA-IRS system’s effectiveness is illustrated by the simulation results. The analysis of asymptotic outage probability is utilized to calculate the system’s diversity order.

articleTitle: Object Detection Using YOLO-V8
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing need for automated object detection and recognition in visual data has become crucial in various domains, including surveillance, autonomous vehicles, and image analysis. Traditional methods often struggle with speed and accuracy, making real-time applications challenging. The main objective of this experiment is to make the computers identify and detect objects in the visual data. The algorithm is used to detect the object with classification and localization based on visual inputs. This project uses YOLO(You Only Look Once) algorithm to detect the objects. YOLO v8 is known for its speedy and accurate object detection. This idea is used to identify multiple objects in images, videos, and live webcams. This algorithm adapts to various scenarios such as image analysis to dynamic object tracking.

articleTitle: Bagged Artificial Neural Network for Electricity Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) is essential for energy companies to make informed decisions. The accuracy of price forecasts has become increasingly important as energy systems become more complex due to the integration of renewable energy sources and smart grids. A new deep learning framework called “Bagged Neural Networks” has been introduced in this paper. The framework incorporates four different deep learning models to enhance price forecasting accuracy. The study’s findings show that the suggested framework efficiently forecasts power costs. By incorporating multiple predictive models and employing ensemble learning, the framework effectively addresses the uncertainties and challenges posed by the complex energy systems of the future. Consequently, deep learning algorithms, such as bagged neural networks, offer a promising solution for accurate electricity price forecasting in volatile and uncertain energy systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Traffic Efficiency with a Custom Verilog Traffic Light Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a traffic light controller system, aimed at optimizing traffic flow at intersections. The system is developed using Verilog HDL, and it features both automatic and manual modes to accommodate regular traffic patterns and emergency situations. The controller’s logic allows for dynamic changes in traffic signal timings, responding to real-time inputs such as safety and emergency signals. To validate the functionality and performance of the traffic light controller, the simulations were conducted using Cadence Xcelium and synthesis is performed using Vivado and Synopsys Design Compiler tool. These industry-standard tools enabled us to perform accurate testing under a variety of traffic scenarios, ensuring the system’s responsiveness and effectiveness. The simulation results demonstrate the system’s capability to manage traffic efficiently while adhering to safety requirements.. The final part of this research will focus on deploying the controller onto an FPGA platform, which will allow us to evaluate its performance in a real-world environment. This step will bridge the gap between simulation and practical application, providing insights into the system’s operational characteristics and potential improvements. Overall, the proposed traffic light controller system showcases a scalable and adaptable approach to traffic management, with the potential to significantly reduce congestion and enhance road safety. The use of advanced simulation tools and the transition towards FPGA implementation mark significant strides in the development of intelligent traffic systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Spacer and Extension variation on of GSDM-GAAFET for improved Electrical and Subthreshold parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this article, spacer and extension variation is studied on Gate stacked dual material (GSDM) GAAFET. The impact of spacer and extension on drain current characteristics is studied. The spacer length is varied from $2.5 \mathbf{n m}$ to $12.5 \mathbf{n m}$ whereas extension length is varied from 1 nm to 5 nm. Significant improvement is observed in terms of ON and OFF current. The ON current is almost doubled from spacer length $\mathbf{1 2. 5 ~} \mathbf{~ n m}$ to 2. 5 nm. The OFF current is increased by decreasing spacer length. Higher ON resistance is observed with minimum spacer length due to increased series resistance, but improved overall device stability. A spacer length of 6. 5 nm is chosen to have optimum ON and OFF current. Variation of extension also analyzed in terms of performance parameters. An extension length of $1 \mathbf{~ n m}$ is chosen to have optimum OFF current.

articleTitle: Improving Landslide Prediction through LSTM Networks and Antecedent Rainfall: A Case Study in Kamand Valley, India
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Himalayan region faces an escalating threat from landslides, a situation worsened by climate change. These events endanger human lives and valuable properties, underscoring the necessity for robust prediction and mitigation strategies. This research presents machine learning (ML) models to forecast slope movements in landslides, including Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional LSTM (Conv-LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (CNNLSTM), Encoder-Decoder LSTM, and a novel Multi-LSTM-SVM model. A key innovation in this study is incorporating antecedent rainfall data from the preceding three days, an element not previously explored in ML model development. Given that rainfall is a primary trigger for landslides, this inclusion enhances the understanding of landslides. The study focuses on Kamand Valley in Himachal Pradesh and collects extensive time-series data on weather conditions, soil parameters, and slope movements. The findings highlight the superior performance of the Multi-LSTM-SVM model, which achieved an F1 score of 0.703 in testing. This model consistently surpassed the others, demonstrating its potential in predicting landslides and mitigating risks.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Water Quantity of Kudikkadu river stretch using remote sensing & GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Water quality is a critical aspect of environmental health, particularly in river ecosystems that serve as vital sources for various human activities. This research focuses on the Akkarakori River stretch in the Cuddalore block, and it makes use of modern Remote Sensing (RS) and Geographic Information System (GIS) techniques. Technologies for comprehensive water quality mapping. In this block, Sampls taken from the river stretch of Akkarai Gori to Kudikkadu in the Gadilam basin. Gadilam river is the tributary of the Pennaiyar river which Originates from Thirukovilur and it flows through the Cuddalore & Villupuram districts. Field surveys are used to obtain ground truth data in order to evaluate and calibrate remote sensing results, ensuring the accuracy of the evaluation. The study examines various water quality parameters, including turbidity, dissolved oxygen, and pollutant concentrations, offering a detailed spatial representation of the river’s health.The results of this assessment provide a comprehensive overview of the current water quality status along the Gadilam River stretch. Temporal variations are analyzed to identify patterns and trends, aiding in the understanding of the river’s dynamic behavior and the impact of anthropogenic activities.

articleTitle: Assessment of a Novel Single-Channel EEG Method for Automated Recognition of Sleep Phases
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Assessing sleep stages is crucial for identifying and managing sleep disorders such as REM sleep disorders and narcolepsy. Automating this process not only expedites detection but also enhances diagnostic accuracy. Thus, this research used the discrete wavelet transform technique and a convolutional neural network to automate sleep stage identification. In this proposed method, the single-channel EEG undergoes decomposition into four levels via discrete wavelet transform, followed by extraction of statistical features from these levels. Subsequently, employing CNN, relevant features are selected and utilized as input to the model. The CNN model achieved high accuracies of $\mathbf{9 5 . 8 1 \%}$ five-class (five sleep stages). This proposed approach for automated sleep stage detection has the potential to expedite the identification of sleep stages and even sleep disorders, and it can accommodate large-scale EEG datasets. However, it’s important to note that this approach was solely evaluated on one dataset, underscoring the need for validation across other databases in future investigations.

articleTitle: GestureFlow: A Novel Hand Gesture Control System for Interactive Gaming
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study examines the idea of hand motion control in the busy game community using a novel method. This will help find a unique method to encourage talk among the game and computer vision community. articleTitle: Enhancing Classification Power: Tree Strength-Infused Enriched Random Forest

abstract: Over the last two decades, Random forest (RF) has been one of the well-known and most exploited ensemble-based machine learning approaches. It has been used for computer vision, pattern recognition, medical imaging, and many other fields. However, it has always been a challenging task to come up with an approach that will lead to constructing a more reliable RF. In this study, we used a concept of tree strength to construct the RF, called as Enriched Random Forest (ERF). As a feature extraction, Bag of Visual Words (BoVW) is used, and Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) as a feature selection during the construction of the ERF. The suggested method has been evaluated using the MNSIT, Caltech-101, Caltech-256, and UCI repositories—all of which are well-known and openly accessible. articleTitle: Artistic Transformation Of Architectural Images Using Neural Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, the convergence of computational artistry and architectural visualization has led to innovative techniques for infusing artistic styles into architectural imagery. This paper explores the fascinating intersection of art and architecture through the application of neural style transfer algorithms to urban landscapes and architectural compositions. Traditional image editing procedures or hand painting represent examples of style transfer methods with severe limitations. When applying style transfer to architectural images, structural details may be lost due to an overemphasis on artistic style, leading to unrealistic texture application and visual incoherence. Color distortion and the risk of the style overpowering the architectural content further compound these challenges. Additionally, inadequate hyperparameters may result in a loss of contextual understanding, where the algorithm fails to grasp architectural significance, leading to visually confusing compositions. In this work, various pre-trained models of CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) and their hyperparameters are compared. The study aims to evaluate the impact of different hyperparameters, such as style weight, content weight, and learning rate, on the quality and fidelity of stylized images. By systematically varying these hyperparameters and analyzing their effects on the output images, this research aims to identify the optimal combination that maximizes style transfer fidelity while preserving content details. Content preservation, geometric distortion, artifact reduction, and visual quality are important criteria for comparison. Metrics like the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), the Structural Similarity Index (SSI), and others are used to statistically assess these properties. The research attempts to determine the best pre-trained CNN model and the best hyperparameters for style transfer that are most suitable for architectural images.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Detection Through Spatially Attentive Enhanced Low-Mid-High Level Feature Modelling using Deep CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) severely affects patients and has become a warning concern around the world. Several AI-based solutions that have extensively explored convolutional neural networks (CNN) for diagnosis. Most of these approaches only utilise high-level features for diagnosis. However, to solve any non-linear and complex problem, the low-level and mid-level features are as important as the high-level features. Such an approach is missing in the AD classification. To solve this, we proposed a novel way to utilise low, mid, and high (LMH) features for classification. We design the suggested framework using the backbone of a multilayer atrous CNN. We enhance the LMH features by exploiting features from a multicolumn atrous convolution with varying kernel shapes, which can extract features at multiple scales. We adopt, modify, and apply a spatial attention mechanism over the enhanced LMH features to emphasise important features or attributes in the spatial domain. A multilayer of dense neurons receives the fused and enhanced spatially attentive LMH features for AD classification. We demonstrate extensive experiments using an open-source AD dataset available on Kaggle. The proposed framework achieves better performance than current best practices.

According to the 2023 World Health Report, there were 2.1 million global deaths attributed to heart arrhythmia in 2022, rising to 2.2 million in 2023, reflecting a 4.8% increase globally. Diagnosis typically involves an electrocardiogram (ECG), which measures the heart’s electrical activity and can detect various heart conditions such as arrhythmia, heart attacks, or heart failure. Our study focuses on categorizing five types of heartbeats using a dataset obtained from MIT-BIH through the application of ensemble learning techniques, particularly the Bagging Classifier algorithm. Our results demonstrate a remarkable accuracy rate of 99.67% in arrhythmia classification. By combining ensemble learning with feature normalization methods, we have achieved significant improvements in classification accuracy, leading to enhanced prediction of arrhythmia, proactive management of cardiac issues, and ultimately, better patient outcomes.

In particular, gadget learning can supply effective and personalized carriers to clients, allowing banks to provide greater tailored solutions to personal customers. At the same time, device studying can help banks automate and streamline many strategies. By automating the execution and interpretation of patron records, banks can serve customers quicker and greater appropriately. Moreover, the system getting to know can be used to locate anomalous activities and frauds, supporting banks in defending their customers from dangers and threats. Furthermore, system-gaining knowledge can empower banks to improve their consumer segmentation, marketing, and pricing. With the aid of leveraging the information they’ve available, banks can craft new techniques and techniques to better birthday celebrations for their clients. They are able to offer greater centered rewards to customers with healthy positive profiles, as well as extra tailored offerings and pricing. In precis, device studying can revolutionize customer banking. Through their predictive and analytical skills, banks can dramatically enhance the way they interact with customers.

articleTitle: Custom VR Chair with Synchronized Immersive Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The way people engage with digital surroundings has been completely transformed by virtual reality (VR) technology, which provides immersive experiences through sensory stimulation. It is still difficult to get VR hardware and software to move in unison, though. When it comes to VR creation, it’s imperative to make sure that personalized VR seats and their accompanying virtual worlds synchronize flawlessly in order to improve user immersion and minimize motion sickness. In this project, we created and put into use a unique VR chair system that can coordinate motion with virtual reality images. We created a smooth interface between the chair’s actual movements and the virtual sensations it offers the user by creating specialized software. Our tests show that the motion of the VR chair can be successfully synchronized with comparable images, increasing user immersion and decreasing disorientation. This study opens the door for more engaging and user-friendly VR experiences by demonstrating the viability and efficiency of combining tailored VR chair motion with virtual worlds. The potential for a range of applications, such as gaming, rehabilitation, simulation training, and architectural visualization, is demonstrated by the effective integration of synchronized motion between VR chairs and virtual surroundings. This could ultimately improve user experience and engagement in a variety of societal situations.

articleTitle: Decoding Animation Audiences: Exploring Customer Reviews and Sentiments in Animation Films
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Animation movies represent a distinct form of cinematic expression, characterized by the manipulation of images to create dynamic movement and vivid storytelling. Unlike live-action films, animation movies leverage digital or traditional techniques to bring characters and environments to life, offering a wide spectrum of creative possibilities. This paper explores the cultural significance and rising popularity of animation movies, emphasizing their ability to appeal to diverse audiences and tackle complex themes in imaginative ways. It outlines the objectives of a study aimed at analyzing customer reviews of animation movies, exploring underlying sentiments, and employing machine learning, specifically the random forest algorithm, for sentiment classification. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of 52,000 Animation Movie Details sourced from the TMDB API, the study employs a classification model based on the Random Forest algorithm to extract insights from the data. Despite encountering computational challenges, the Random Forest model demonstrates promising potential for enhancing customer feedback analysis and market sentiment tracking in the realm of animation movies.

articleTitle: Exploring Design Strategies for Interactive Communication Media Algorithms in Networking Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores design strategies for interactive verbal exchange media algorithms in networking applications. In particular, the authors compare diverse types of network conversation architectures with the targets of ensuring performance and scalability while making sure compatibility with more than one patron gadget. To perform this, they first broaden a formal framework with which to assess the distinctive architectures. This framework considers key parameters along with throughput, latency, and power efficiency, even as additionally considering scalability and compatibility capabilities. Additionally, the authors broaden some of the solutions to optimize factors of the information transmission and reduce bottlenecks, permitting green and dependable records transmission. Eventually, the authors demonstrate the validity of their proposed answers with the help of big simulations. Ultimately, the paintings afford a comprehensive answer that balances overall performance and scalability with compatibility and protection at the same time as also decreasing complexity.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Adaptive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reinforcement getting to know (RL) is a kind of machine getting to know approach that focuses on gaining knowledge of a policy that enables an agent to interact correctly in an environment if you want to maximize its reward. RL is being explored to be used in quite dynamic cloud computing environments because of its robust potential to provide regulations that could efficiently adapt to converting environments. The use of Adaptive Multi-Agent Reinforcement mastering (AMARL) in cloud computing environments is a promising method for reaching excessive ranges of device scalability, workload balancing, and fault tolerance. AMARL is an RL method that includes more than one marketer that could act independently to improve the general device performance. This method capitalizes on the strengths of the character agents, as well as the advantages of distributed architectures. Using AMARL in cloud computing environments remains an emerging region of studies; however it has the ability to revolutionize the way wherein cloud infrastructures are controlled. This paper presents an overview of AMARL and explores how it can be used to gain better levels of scalability, load balancing, and fault tolerance in cloud computing environments. Furthermore, a discussion of the challenges and research opportunities in this subject are supplied.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security Model For Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have emerged as a transformative technology with diverse applications across environmental monitoring, healthcare, smart cities, and industrial automation. However, the security of WSNs remains a critical challenge, particularly in heterogeneous environments where nodes possess varied capabilities and communication protocols. This paper explores the unique security challenges specific to heterogeneous WSNs and proposes an enhanced security model tailored to address these challenges effectively. The introduction highlights the vulnerabilities of WSNs, including broadcast communication exposure, making sensor nodes susceptible to attacks like jamming and data interception. The absence of centralized infrastructure necessitates decentralized and efficient security mechanisms to protect sensitive data and ensure network integrity. The literature survey reviews existing security models and protocols for WSNs, emphasizing the need for lightweight authentication, secure key management, intrusion detection, and secure routing. The proposed security model incorporates dynamic key management, lightweight authentication, secure data aggregation, and intrusion detection to fortify heterogeneous WSNs against emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Future research directions aim to develop scalable and adaptive security frameworks to withstand evolving threats in dynamic network environments. By exploring these challenges and proposing innovative security solutions, this paper contributes to enhancing the security posture of heterogeneous WSNs across various industries and applications.

articleTitle: VLSI Design of High Performance FIR Filter using High Speed Hybrid Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The demand for high-speed signal processing systems that are compact and consume less power has increased in the fields of mobile communication and portable multimedia systems. The multiplier, which is the fundamental building block, plays a critical role in determining the overall performance of the signal processing system, especially with the FIR filter. To improve the speed of the signal processing system, we developed a FIR filter with a hybrid multiplier that combines the advantages of two adder strategies Kogge Stone, Brent Kung adders. This hybrid multiplier has shown to perform better than the traditional ones. Direct form of FIR filter is designed with various multipliers along with the Hybrid multiplier. Each filter is generated and validated functionally using the Xilinx ISE 14.7 Tool. A comparison is carried out with the filters that use Vedic multipliers, Array multipliers, and Wallace-tree multipliers. The FIR filter that uses the suggested hybrid multiplier has a lower latency of 33.182 ns.

articleTitle: The Future of Smart Factories: Real-Time Automation and Big Data Analytics on the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The evolving future of manufacturing will be all about intelligent factories featuring state-of-the-art technologies. Smart factories combine connected automation and big data in the cloud to streamline production, increase productivity, and lower operational costs. Real-time automation utilizes state-of-the-art sensors, internet of Things (IoT) devices, and artificial intelligence (AI) technology to monitor and control machines or processes in real time independently. This results in faster potential decision-making and bright maintenance works, thus decreasing downtime risk and increasing overall productivity. Big data analytics in the cloud enables real-time collection and analysis of extensive amounts of production processes, machine performance, and supply chain management-related information. The data can then be utilized to discover areas that need improvement, predict maintenance requirements, and even optimize the level of inventories in the sense that it would save costs while at the same time becoming more efficient. Also, real-time automation combined with significant cloud data analytics results in improved communication and collaboration from one production stage to another, hence smooth operations. In other words, it helps create an even more agile and adaptable manufacturing environment where processes can be fine-tuned on the fly to deal with dynamic market shifts.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Gamer Landscape: A Statistical Analysis of Gaming Habits and Mental Health
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the intricate relationship between gaming behavior, mental health indicators, and demographic factors among gamers. Leveraging a rich dataset of 14000 gamers encompassing their responses to mental health questionnaires, demographic information, and playstyle preferences, we employ a variety of statistical methods and tests, including Cronbach’s Alpha method, Spearman, Pearson, and Kendall correlations. Our primary objective is to ascertain whether gamers exhibit signs of sadness and loneliness and to discern patterns based on their playstyle, age, employment status, and other demographic variables. Through this comprehensive analysis, we seek to analyze the complex interplay between gaming behavior and mental well-being, offering valuable insights for both stakeholders in the gaming community and researchers.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Ultra-Sensitive Optical Fiber D-Shaped SPR Sensor for Biomedical application
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Urea, a byproduct produced by the liver during protein metabolism, is eliminated from the body via the kidneys in urine. Monitoring urea levels is crucial for various medical and health purposes. This paper introduces a highly sensitive surface plasmon resonance (SPR) method utilizing an optical fiber for urea detection. The proposed sensor features a Dshaped optical fiber coated with Gold (Au) and Titanium dioxide $\left(\mathrm{TiO}_{2}\right)$, which facilitates the generation of evanescent waves by free electrons on the metal surface, thereby inducing surface plasmon waves. To enhance the SPR fiber sensor’s sensitivity and reduce transmittance, the thickness of the Au and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers, are optimized using the finite element method. Additionally, Sensitivity for different configurations with specified layer thicknesses is measured, and the sensor’s performance in detecting urea concentrations of 0.625,1.25, and $2.5 \mathrm{gm} / \mathrm{dl}$ is analyzed. The results indicate a maximum sensitivity of $2,857.14 \mathrm{~nm} / \mathrm{RIU}$ at a urea concentration of $1.25 \mathrm{gm} / \mathrm{dl}$. The sensor also achieved an outstanding sensitivity of $8,000 \mathrm{~nm} /$ RIU within the refractive index (RI) range of 1.33 to 1.40 and a measurement resolution of $1.25 \times 10^{-6}$ RIU.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-label text classification using adaptive promptify concepts
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In present days, Multi Label Text Classification (MLTC) has become an important research area in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Existing models of MLTC have been facing domain specificity and fine-tuning challenges. Hence a model is developed to overcome the above said challenges by introducing Prompt Engineering, GPT FineTuning methods and Pipeline algorithms. The experimental results are obtained based on the present Generative pre trained data produces labels for various text documents and files with an exceptional accuracy of 85%. The outcomes of the experiments reveal notable enhancements over the baseline models.

articleTitle: Investigating the Efficiency of Cloud Computing Algorithms in Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the performance of cloud-based algorithms over mobile ad-hoc networks. The authors present an ad-hoc set of rules that employs various scheduling algorithms to maximize the efficiency of cloud offerings deployment. Three of them are considered the most prominent scheduling algorithms, which are named Density-aware First Fit (DAFF), precedence-aware round-robin (PARR), and priority-aware Heterogeneous round-robin (PHEROR), and are compared with Dynamic Stateless Cloud Scheduling (DSCS) algorithm on basis of a simulation model on a mobile ad-hoc environment over real network topologies, to show the relative efficiency of them over one another. The writers confirm the effectiveness of the suggested rule set for job challenge time, aid usage, and resource allocation time and also evaluate their outcomes towards a recent conventional grasping mainly based total scheduling rule. The outcomes display that the proposed hybrid algorithm is considerably better for all the 3 metrics compared to the prevailing scheduling set of rules. Also, the authors show that the proposed algorithm allows more efficient handling of the use of assistance in the cellular nodes over various seminal networks.

articleTitle: Assessing the Utility of Logistic Regression Models for Pulmonary Effusion Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Logistic regression, a classifier algorithm that estimates the chance of an event being genuine, is widely employed in lots of fields in guide of selection making. In this look at, we discover the application of logistic regression fashions in the analysis of pulmonary effusions. We educate and examine logistic regression models with a Cagle dataset containing clinical photographs of numerous radiologic research, from which we extract the applicable features for prognosis. We compare our fashions with different well known gadget studying algorithms, like SVM and okay-NN, to decide the effectiveness for pulmonary effusion diagnosis. The effects of the assessment confirmed that, logistic regression had better accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity as compared to the opposite algorithms. These outcomes highlight the ability use of logistic regression fashions for pulmonary effusion prognosis to improve the accuracy of clinical choices.

articleTitle: Enhanced House Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Real estate is a crucial part of the global economy, contributing significantly to financial stability. A person’s decision to purchase or sell a home is a critical financial matter. Consequently, accurate house price predictions are essential. This research paper utilizes data and advanced machine-learning techniques to develop a robust and precise model for predicting house prices. The model provides valuable insights into the dynamic real estate market by examining numerous relevant attributes, including bathroom size and real-time economic data. Techniques such as Linear Regression, Decision Tree regression, and Lasso Regression were employed to make accurate price predictions-the proposed research utilized outlier removal, dimensional reduction, and feature engineering to enhance model performance. The novelty of this work lies in integrating detailed features and real-time scenario analysis, addressing gaps in existing studies. Finally, we deployed the model as a user-friendly web application on an AWS EC2 instance, allowing users to estimate property prices and make informed decisions conveniently. This comprehensive approach builds on previous research and significantly improves prediction accuracy and practical applicability.

articleTitle: Directed Adversarial Training for Comprehensive Robustification of CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), renowned for their high accuracy on clean datasets, remain notably vulnerable to adversarial attacks. This study assesses how the VGG16 and ResNet50 models withstand various white-box attacks when used for traffic sign classification. Despite their impressive standard accuracy, our findings reveal that these accuracies do not predict robustness against attacks. Techniques such as the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) substantially lowered model accuracy, while DeepFool and Carlini & Wagner (C&W) attacks were even more disruptive. In particular, ResNet50 was more prone to these attacks, with its accuracy dropping to as low as $\mathbf{1 2. 8 5 \%}$ under DeepFool and $\mathbf{1 7. 4 2 \%}$ under C&W at specific confidence levels. Retraining models with adversarial examples did enhance their resilience to certain attacks but at the expense of reduced effectiveness on clean data. These results highlight the critical need for developing more robust defense mechanisms that protect CNNs against a wide array of adversarial threats without compromising performance on standard inputs.

articleTitle: CNN based encoder and decoder model for sign language communication
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: World Health Organization’s report says that there are more than 466 million individuals worldwide who have hearing impairments, with 72 million of them experiencing deafness. In this paper, a model is proposed for two-way sign language communicationto assist these people.The proposed system consists of two components, one that converts image to voice and the other to convert voice back to an image. A dataset comprising 55,500 samples and 37 classes were used to train the proposed Convolutional Neural Networkmodel(CNN) to recognize 37 classes for.The model contains three convolutional layers and 2 hidden layers and output layer. The model was trained with a batch size of 32, to achieve a maximum accuracy of 98.84% in training and $\mathbf{9 6. 5 8 \%}$ in validation. For the voice to image conversion a pretrained open source model was used.

articleTitle: Advances in Medical Text Summarization: Comparative Performance Analysis of PEGASUS and T5
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Text Summarization in the field of Healthcare Domain helps medical information seekers avoid unnecessary information by reducing the length of the text data in the document and providing significant information in the context of the document. Summarization in the healthcare domain helps you in the summarization and the understanding of biomedical literature, vast information about the specific drugs can be summarized and can help in understanding the side effects of the drug. Even the summarization of the medical conversation between the patients and doctors can be used to provide care and help in focusing on the significant aspects. In this research, we have explored and compared two different techniques namely PEGASUS and T5. By fine-tuning PEGASUS on medical datasets like PubMed, we can get the abstractive summary of the document. The result of our research shows that PEGASUS outperforms T5 in producing contextually relevant summaries, which makes it a better choice for summarizing medical research models.

articleTitle: Building a Smarter Shield: Using Ensemble Learning for Multi-Class DDoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nowadays in this increasing population IBD has become a viral topic that is mainly discussing and implementing topics in both digital and intelligent industry fields. The security problems that widely occur in the signal processing of data streams is a most challenging problem in industries, detection of DDoS attacks in intelligent industrial applications is also highly dangerous. To ensure the security networks, DDoS attack detection is commonly used. Some are failed to detect unknown attacks; they are classical detection that are commonly known as signature-based attacks or explicit-behavior-based attacks. These are very hard to fulfill the requirements of SD-IOT networks. To detect DDoS attacks, the two machine learning algorithms implemented in this paper are Extra Tree and Random Forest. Extratree performed well. Random Forest’s Accuracy is 95.15% and Extratree is 95.59%. To get this accuracy we used UNSW_NB15 as a Dataset. After a target variable has been identified, the data will be divided into two sets: one for training and another for testing. Further it is applied to classification methods. Finally, apart from accuracy precision, recall, and F1-measure is found out.

articleTitle: Identification Of Malware Families Using Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of cybersecurity, where traditional methods often fall short against spyware threats, a novel approach is explored. By scrutinizing digital device power consumption patterns, this study categorizes spyware based on energy usage intricacies. The aim is to provide a timesaving tool for cyber forensics practitioners. Recognizing a gap in post-malware exposure research, the project underscores the importance of time in crafting effective responses. Employing tools like Intel Power Gadget and Cuckoo Sandbox, the study conducts power estimation on ten malware samples. The ultimate objective is to empower cybersecurity professionals with proactive measures, fortifying the digital landscape against covert threats and preserving information integrity.

articleTitle: RFID-Based Elevator Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) is a wireless, contactless data transfer technology that uniquely identifies items using radio waves. In certain organizations, lifts are designated for specific users to avoid wastage of precious time due to unnecessary usage. To address this challenge, we introduce a management system that prevents unauthorized access to elevators. Within the lift, a barrier controlled by NFC technology is installed, storing user data such as usernames, user IDs and their destinations. Authorized users with tags are permitted access, while unauthorized individuals are denied, ensuring controlled accessibility. Special guest tags are provided for guest usage. The ESP32 and Google AppScript facilitate data transfer to Google Sheets, serving as the database interface.

articleTitle: Identification of Candidate Lung Disease Biomarkers through Prediction Analysis Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This examine aimed to discover biomarkers associated to precise lung diseases from gene expression statistics thru the use of prediction analysis algorithms. To this end, the authors advanced a framework based totally on a Euclidean distance help vector machine (DSVM) and a recursive feature removal (RFE) manner. The dataset beneath evaluation changed into made from gene expression information from 380 bronchial brushings people- 188 of wholesome people and 192 of diseased individuals with muscular dystrophy, chronic obstructive pulmonary sicknesses, bronchial asthma and post-radio-chemotherapy. The DSVM version became able to achieve a mean popularity rate of ninety five. 6%, without compromising the specificity price at 88. n i n e %. The diagnosed biomarkers have been further enriched towards many databases and the authors located an association of a number of them with bronchial sicknesses. This result recommend the identification of potentially new biomarkers, supplying novel findings that is probably beneficial in future studies about lung diseases.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Horizontal/Vertical Stack Dielectrics on Temperature of GaAs based FinFET
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper analyses the enhance reliability and better performance of vertical stack gate dielectrics with higher dielectric constant GaAs based FinFET. For this purpose, this paper also performs a comparative analysis between horizontal stack of different dielectric materials and the vertical stack dielectrics. The reliability of the proposed value of DIBL, SS, and the highest value of Ion/Ioff ratio, work is analysed by varying over the wide range of temperature ($200 \mathrm{~K}-500 \mathrm{~K}$). Moreover, the proposed FinFET has the lowest making the device resistant to the leakage current in the subthreshold region. Due to the stack of HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in oxides the leakage current (Ioff) decreases and hence the device has lowest leakage current and SS.It means device has higher switching speed and makes it more reliable to the short channel effect during the subthreshold region. The reliability of the devices are compared and analyzed at different temperature for the different dielectric medium and the different fin materials.

articleTitle: An Empirical Method For Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study introduced a systematic approach to predicting chronic kidney disease using machine learning models. The dataset was sourced from Kaggle and underwent comprehensive preprocessing to address null values, feature encoding, and class imbalance. Several machine learning algorithms were implemented and fine-tuned, including KNN, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and ANN. The performance of each model was evaluated based on accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Ensemble methods, particularly Random Forest and XGBoost, consistently outperformed other models, demonstrating robustness across different proportions of training data. The accuracy of Random Forest reached 98.2%, and XGBoost achieved 96.7% accuracy. Furthermore, Accurate Positive and False Negative analysis and Receiver Operating Characteristic curves provided insights into the models’ effectiveness and discriminatory power. The findings contribute valuable insights into developing reliable predictive models for chronic kidney disease.

articleTitle: Data Compression Techniques for High-Speed NetworkCommunications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Data compression is an important factor of excessive-pace network communications, as it may lessen the number of facts that need to be transmitted over a given network. Facts compression techniques search to lessen the scale of data via encoding it in a more green format. Common compression techniques utilized in networks consist of static Huffman encoding, variable period encoding, arithmetic encoding, differential coding, run-period encoding, and compression with a chance distribution. Every approach has its personal deserves and boundaries, so the selection of a compression technique is dependent on the type of information and the network situations. Additionally, some of these techniques carry out better while implemented in aggregate with one another, offering a usual development in network throughput.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of IEEE 802.11ax Using Validated Propagation Loss Models for V2I Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless networks, especially IEEE 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), face greater demands for higher data rates, capacity, and performance. This paper evaluates the performance of IEEE 802.11ax networks in Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I) applications. Using the NS3 simulation framework and proven propagation loss models, such as the log-distance and Friis models, we analyse how different propagation environments affect network performance. Through simulations and extensive evaluations, we have gained better insights into IEEE 802.11ax behaviour in various conditions, crucial for optimizing network deployment and configuration in indoor and outdoor environments. we found that the three-log distance propagation loss model consistently showed better Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) compared to the others. Increasing the frequency band from 2.4 GHz to the 6 GHz resulted in improvements in SNR, delay, and throughput. Additionally, increasing the channel width within the 6 GHz frequency band enhanced throughput, SNR, and delay marginally. Furthermore, we explore the potential extension of IEEE 802.11ax for V2I communications, to enhance wireless connectivity quality and meet the challenges of evolving communication scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhanced Underwater Image Restoration: Optimizing Computational Efficiency with U-Net++ and CNN Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Restoring underwater images poses a significant computational challenge, often requiring more time and resources. U-Net and its variants are not much applied for the task of underwater image restoration so we propose a novel approach to make use of the U-net++ architecture. The aim here is to develop a U-Net++ model and a CNN model and analyze the quality of the restored images so they are capable of operating efficiently on systems with limited computational resources while significantly reducing the time required for image restoration. The dataset used for the task of underwater image restoration task in this paper is Large Scale Underwater Images (LSUI). This particular U-Net++ is computationally efficient in contrast to other state of the art models that were developed so far and this helps in saving a lot of time and speed up the process of restoring such images which makes it easier for research and analysis in underwater scenarios. From the results obtained, we conclude that the SSIM 0.9994 and PSNR 70.2617 dB values are higher for the U-net++ model and this architecture can be used for conducting research in underwater environments.

articleTitle: Radial Basis Function Neural Network Based PID Tuning for Trajectory Tracking in Robot Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The end effector of a robot manipulator needs to be accurately positioned in the workspace when it is used for automated applications. Manipulators are driven using the torque inputs supplied to the joint actuators based on the robot dynamics. Due to the effect of model uncertainties and payload variations, the actual dynamics will differ, resulting in end-effector positioning and tracking errors. The traditional fixed gain proportional integral derivative (PID) controller implemented by most manufacturers will not be able to correct this deviation completely. An online parameter tuning method can improve the tracking performance of the PID controller by updating the PID gains according to the deviations happening in the system dynamics. A radial basis function (RBF) neural network can approximate and predict the dynamics of a robot manipulator and update the gains of the PID controller. The controller design is simulated and validated using a 5-DOF ViperX 300 manipulator dynamics and kinematics. The trajectory tracking is validated by applying a payload weight to the manipulator and following the reference trajectory in the 3D cartesian space.

articleTitle: Estimation and Importance of IPP Distribution for NavIC System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ionosphere is a highly variable region existing in upper atmosphere of earth, showing notable physical and structural dissimilarities in electron concentration and ion composition. These dissimilarities cause delay in reception of radio signals travelling through ionosphere, which finally affects accuracy of satellite based navigation and positioning systems like NavIC. For modelling and reducing the effects of ionospheric delay on NavIC signals considering the comprehensive study of Ionospheric Pierce Point (IPP) distribution is very important. It is also responsible for enhancing accuracy and reliability of navigation and positioning of NavIC system by including precise positioning algorithms into actual/real-time IPP data. This paper presents approach for IPP calculation, evaluating the effect of geostationary and geosynchronous satellites on IPP distribution. For real-time monitoring and calculation of ionospheric parameters over particular regions geostationary satellites are found more beneficial in calculating IPP as there are less variations in latitude and longitude coordinate values of IPP as shown in this paper. Thus the system can correct ionospheric delay and enhance positional accuracy of NavIC system more effectively by using real-time IPP data specifically in tough conditions such as equatorial and low-latitude regions where ionospheric irregularities/space weather activities are more active. Moreover, paper also investigates future studies directed at improving IPP calculation methods and enhancing NavIC positioning algorithms for tough and authentic positioning in various operational environment.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Usefulness of Applied Cryptography Algorithms in Securing Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Carried-out cryptography algorithms are seeing increased use in securing block chain technologies due to their ability to provide at-ease encryptions, which might be proof against compromise. Cryptographic algorithms are primarily based on mathematical concepts of cryptography, which can be used to create secure communications and verify authenticity. Those algorithms offer a ramification of critical cryptographic features, which include key technology, garage, and cryptographic hashing (e.g., elliptic curve, RSA, etc.). Applied cryptography algorithms can be used to prevent malicious actors from tampering with virtual records stored on the block chain with the aid of supplying a shape of Encryption that should be penetrated first before any tampering can occur. As a consequence, the usefulness of those algorithms in securing block chain technology is imperative for protecting these technologies from malicious actors. However, it’s far more important to ensure the algorithms being used are frequently updated and implemented properly in order that those technologies continue to be relaxed. As there is limited cryptographic knowledge in the block chain and crypto currency groups, extra studies have to be conducted to make sure these algorithms are offering first-class security viable.

articleTitle: The intelligent optimization of AI/ML framework to Detect Network Abnormalities via Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent optimization of the AI/ML framework to detect network anomalies via time collection analysis. The proposed framework entails leveraging an $\mathrm{AI} / \mathrm{ML}$ version to manner the time series facts and to identify community anomalies. Traditional methods of describing the information through time variety or histogram analysis are then improved by introducing a supervised schooling set of rules for higher accuracy. The methodology is similarly validated using a real-global dataset. The result of the preliminary analysis famous that the $\mathrm{AI} / \mathrm{ML}$ model trained with the proposed framework enables efficient detection of extraordinary network sports. The findings of this examination underscore the benefits of using AI/ML models for the timely detection of community anomalies. The painting affords an intelligent optimization of AI/ML frameworks to locate community abnormalities via time collection evaluation.
