The proposed framework is evolved through leveraging a hard and fast of features, consisting of topology, via graph-primarily based strategies, an excellent way to seize the worldwide behavior of the community and trigger alarms in case of ability network anomalies. The time series evaluation is then achieved to extract and model features from the monitored traffic information to discover patterns and insights, also used in labeling and predicting a suitable elegance for each traffic file. In the end, the AI/ML model skilled the use of the categorized statistics to locate any ability community abnormalities and cause alarms to inform of such unusual behavior. The proposed framework, as a result, presents an automated solution for network anomaly detection and acts as a powerful tool in mitigating security threats for businesses and companies that rely heavily on their community infrastructure…

articleTitle: High Fidelity Reversible Data Hiding For Color Images using CNN Predictor and Reference Error
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the field of reversible data hiding, both prediction and embedding techniques play an important role in defining the overall effectiveness of a data hiding scheme. A lot of efforts have been invested by the research community to improve the embedding performance. However, the prediction area is still evolving, wherein the Convolutional neural network (CNN), with its capability to consider long-range dependencies, has shown a new direction to the researchers. This paper proposes an error adjustment strategy with a CNN-based predictor for color images. The proposed strategy utilizes the inter-channel correlation of the three channels to enhance the prediction performance. Experimental results show that the prediction accuracy achieved by the proposed method is significantly higher than the state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, using the proposed predictor, the Peak signal-to-noise ratio achieved for the embedded images for most of the standard test images is better than the known state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Dynamic Identity-Based Cryptography using RSA
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dynamic identification-based cryptography is a rising shape of cryptographic era that makes use of best an identity in place of a pair of public and personal keys to encrypt facts. This technology is based totally at the RSA cryptosystem and makes use of the identity of a person to generate an ephemeral public key for each verbal exchange session. By using utilizing the identity of the person, dynamic identity-based totally cryptography can decrease the quantity of computational resources had to authenticate and encrypt messages for the duration of communiqué. Furthermore, this technology lets in for more potent encryption on the grounds that a person’s identification changes over time so that the public key ought to be re-generated for every communiqué consultation. This method of encryption has the ability for use in more than one program, which includes mystery communication between government agencies and people, monetary applications and e-trade transactions.

articleTitle: Comparing Visual and Auditory P300-based Brain-Computer Interfaces: An Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have traditionally focused on visual paradigms, with the P300-based EEGBCI being a common approach. However, auditory BCIs are gaining traction, particularly for assisting visually impaired individuals. This study compares the efficacy of visual and auditory BCIs using the P300-based EEG-BCI paradigm. P300 signals were elicited through an oddball paradigm, and support vector machines (SVM) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) algorithms were employed for signal classification. Our results suggest that, in most scenarios, visual P300 performs better than the auditory counterpart. Additionally, we conducted neural network modeling of the human brain to provide theoretical insights. This research not only sheds light on human cognitive abilities through BCI technology but also paves the way for future investigations in this domain.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach to Heart Disease Prognosis using XG Boost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heart disease remains a critical public health challenge, responsible for a high mortality rate and significant socio-economic burdens, including substantial healthcare costs and productivity losses. This study explores the application of advanced computational techniques, specifically deep learning and machine learning models, to enhance the prediction accuracy of heart disease. The focus is on the XGBoost algorithm, renowned for its superior performance in classification tasks. By leveraging a comprehensive dataset comprising diverse patient information, this research aims to improve the precision and efficacy of early heart disease detection. We rigorously evaluate XGBoost’s predictive capabilities against various other machine learning and deep learning models to identify the most effective approach for early diagnosis. The findings of this study have the potential to contribute significantly to the development of reliable predictive tools for heart disease, ultimately aiding in better clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy in the Age of AI: Cybersecurity Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the quest for sustainable energy solutions, the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and cybersecurity within renewable energy systems, particularly microgrids, is increasingly pivotal. Our review offers a critical examination of the challenges and advancements in AI-based energy management to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), focusing on SDG7, SDG11, and SDG13. We delve into the limitations and potential pitfalls of current AI and cybersecurity approaches in renewable energy, categorizing microgrid issues into optimal power flow, peakshaving, and optimal network configurations. Our discussion extends to the promise and constraints of metaheuristics, reinforcement learning, and blockchain technology for decentralized energy management and cybersecurity, highlighting the need for a nuanced understanding of these technologies’ environmental impacts and ethical considerations. Through detailed analysis of various case studies, we scrutinize the specifics of system size, grid connectivity, and the types of AI/cybersecurity measures implemented, enhancing their generalizability and applicability. This review synthesizes findings from 20 research studies, providing a comprehensive perspective on the synergistic role of AI and cybersecurity in advancing renewable energy systems while critically evaluating the field’s current state and suggesting directions for future research, policy, and industry practices. By explicitly linking these findings to the achievement of the SDGs, we underscore the importance of high-resolution, accurately cited images to convey our message effectively and advocate for the thoughtful integration of AI in renewable energy systems to ensure their secure, efficient, and sustainable operation.

articleTitle: Autonomous Ground Vehicle Trajectory Tracking using Adaptive Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Trajectory tracking is crucial for an autonomous vehicle’s ability to navigate complex paths, ensuring both overall functionality and maneuverability. This paper proposes an adaptive Model Predictive Control (MPC) for autonomous ground vehicles. The performance of the proposed controller is evaluated across various trajectories and the results are compared with traditional MPC. The findings demonstrate that adaptive MPC significantly reduces tracking errors, thereby improving the vehicle’s trajectory tracking precision. Furthermore, a lane change maneuvering scenario is also analyzed utilizing the dynamic bicycle model. The simulation and validation of the proposed approach are conducted using MATLAB, showcasing the effectiveness and robustness of the adaptive MPC in diverse driving scenarios.

articleTitle: Navigating the Ethical, Social and Legal Implications of Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of virtual reality world like metaverse can alter the way industries have operated and functioned in the past. Though the Metaverse holds significant potential to drive positive change, both virtually and in the physical world., it has brought forth several legal, environmental, social, and ethical concerns that demand attention. The main objective of this research was to examine the aforementioned issues stemming from the Virtual Reality Revolution. An analysis revealed the presence of numerous legal challenges concerning data protection, cyber security, consumer protection, ownership rights and contractual relationships. In order to facilitate the integration of virtual reality applications across different sectors, an evaluation of current legal frameworks is imperative to determine the need for any adjustments.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Management in Serverless Computing: A Dynamic Adaptive Scaling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Serverless computing, recognized as Function as a Service (FaaS), represents a revolutionary shift in cloud computing, placing a focal point on code-centric development and seamless automated infrastructure management. This paper presents a novel Dynamic Adaptive Resource Scaling Model designed for serverless computing environments, addressing the need for efficient and cost-effective resource management. The model leverages real-time workload monitoring, machine learning algorithms, and predictive analytics to dynamically adjust resource allocation in response to fluctuating demand.. Our findings reveal that the proposed model not only enhances operational efficiency but also substantially reduces costs. Key metrics demonstrate up to 30% improvement in resource utilization and a 25% reduction in operational expenses. The model’s adaptability to diverse workloads makes it a robust solution for modern cloud architectures. Insights from this study are vital for developers, cloud architects, and IT managers seeking to optimize resource management in serverless environments. Future research directions include integrating advanced machine learning techniques and expanding the model’s applicability across different cloud platforms.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Resurgence of Folsom Lake: Exhaustive Analysis of Spatial Transformations through Planetscope Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The longest dry spell in its history, with 212 days without a single drop of rain, Sacramento, California, experienced an extraordinary meteorological event. The city recorded its highest ever single-day rainfall, receiving a staggering 5.44 inches (approximately 13.8 cm) of rain. This sudden deluge had a significant and immediate impact on the nearby Folsom Lake, which had been nearing record-low water levels due to the prolonged drought. The influx of rainwater, channelled through the North and South Forks of the American River, led to a dramatic rise in the lake’s water level, approximately 18 feet (around 5.5 meters), within a short period. The images, dated October 10 and October 27, 2021, provide a detail of the lake’s expansion due to the influx of rainwater. However, despite this significant increase in water level from the storm, Folsom Lake’s overall water storage remained substantially below the historical average. This situation underscores the severity of the drought conditions the region has been facing and highlights the challenges of water management and conservation in the face of increasingly erratic weather patterns brought on by climate change. Grey level occurrence matrix (GLCM) based change detection have been used in the study to perform a quantification of the changes occurring in the late.

articleTitle: Multi-view Event Recognition in Crowd Scenes using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been gaining big interest in packages related to video reputation. This abstract focuses on their application to the recognition events in crowd scenes. Multi-view event popularity is proposed, with the CNN receiving a concatenated two-flow input contemporary pictures and optical waft-primarily based 3-D data from a couple of digi cam views. The CNN parameters are trained and tuned with the use of a multi-view low-stage feature aggregation level. The experiments performed on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach gives advanced performance over current algorithms. The improved overall performance is attributed to the blended impact of state-of-the-art multi-view information and stepped forward CNN schooling. Moreover, it is verified that the low-level feature aggregation considerably improves the event’s reputation and overall performance.

articleTitle: GnBERT: Graph Neural Networks over BERT for Knowledge Graph Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Many disciplines depend on knowledge graphs to represent and arrange organized data. Nevertheless, understanding knowledge graphs is still quite difficult because of their intricate relationships and great importance. The work develops a new framework named GnBERT by fusing Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Knowledge graph representations are able to be obtained via this approach. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide relational semantics; GnBERT improves the representation of entities and relationships in knowledge graphs by combining the hierarchical structure of BERT’s pre-trained language model with it. We have shown, using benchmark datasets, that GnBERT achieves the best degree of performance in knowledge graph completion, entity linking, and connection extraction over earlier techniques.

articleTitle: Formal Verification for Logical Circuit Design Optimization in Computer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Formal verification is the process of proving a digital logic design’s accuracy by checking whether it mathematically follows specific requirements (or classical properties). Its basic philosophy is to precisely and strictly demonstrate that a design must meet its needs. The systematic construction of reliable and efficient computer architectures is paramount. When checking correctness and optimality, such methods as abstraction and symbolic model-checking, automatic theorem proving, and proof methods are adopted. Automatic techniques for handling large complex designs that require quick design generation, followed by manual methods, can be used to double-check the automatic ones. Still, testing and simulation are essential steps in the design process to locate errors hidden in the design that may not otherwise be apparent. In this fashion, one can design a logical circuit that satisfies specified performance standards before implementing it in natural systems.

articleTitle: Evaluating Transformer Models for Legal Judgement Prediction: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Current developments in natural language processing (NLP) show that there is great potential in the area of law. This study investigates the performance of six transformer-based models BERT, XLNet, RoBERTa, DeBERTa, ELECTRA, and BigBird in predicting legal decisions using ILDC (Indian Legal Documents Corpus)-single dataset. Given the complexity of Indian judiciary, our study examines how recent advances in transformer technology can enhance classification accuracy. Our preliminary findings indicate that the best performance from the newer models (DeBERTa, ELECTRA, BigBird) reaches 80% accuracy, while the old models peaked at 76% accuracy, which is almost a 4% increment. This paper provides a detailed comparative analysis of each model, focusing on their respective merits and potential for automating legal judgements. In addition, we address the shortcomings of our work and make recommendations for further research.

articleTitle: CardioScan: On-the-Go Heart Health Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) continue to pose a large worldwide health burden, needing appropriate cardiac monitoring systems for early identification and intervention. Portable cardiac monitoring devices have emerged as promising instruments in this attempt, providing easy and accessible ways to examine heart health. CardioScan is a ground breaking innovation in this field, combining stethoscope, electrocardiography (ECG), and echocardiography capabilities into a single compact instrument. CardioScan uses non-invasive techniques and modern CMOS-based chipsets to provide accurate and dependable heart diagnostics with exceptional comfort and efficiency. In this study, they conduct a thorough analysis of CardioScan’s performance metrics across its core features. They evaluate the device’s ability to capture heart sounds record ECG waveforms, and generate echocardiographic pictures using rigorous testing and analysis. The findings reveal CardioScan’s capacity to provide high-quality cardiac data, reinforcing its promise for improving patient care, boosting diagnosis accuracy, and optimizing treatment methods for cardiovascular disorders. They also examine the practical implications of CardioScan’s performance indicators in clinical practice, emphasizing its appropriateness for a variety of contexts, including primary care and remote monitoring programs. Furthermore, they investigate future research options and CardioScan’s overall impact on improving cardiac care and supporting proactive heart health management. Overall, this work sheds light on CardioScan’s capabilities and future uses, thereby contributing to current efforts to combat CVDs and enhance cardiovascular healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Analysis of Indian Electoral Manifestos using Text Mining and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study explores how text mining and NLP tools can help in textual analysis of political documents, particularly the political manifesto of Indian political parties.The objective is to identify party’s biases and inclinations. Here we employed NLP to analyze the sentiments of N-Grams extracted from the party’s manifesto. This study revealed that by comprehending sentiment-wise term frequency, voters and political pundits can extract significant insights from the manifesto to understand the political landscape thoroughly. Furthermore, such analysis can help think tanks, businesses, voters, media agencies, and political analysts to better understand any party’s priorities and their level of commitment with respect to a particular issue compared to other parties. The objective of this study is only to propose a method hence authors has restrained from providing political opinion on the basis of result generated from the study.

articleTitle: Real Time Voice Translator Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Devices that translate text to speech instantly mark advancements in speech and intelligence. By quickly translating words between languages, this innovative technology seeks to end linguistic barriers. This program makes communication between speakers of different languages easier by swiftly processing, recognizing, and translating words using machine learning and neural networks. Instant translation systems have been developed in response to the growing need for cross-cultural communication in an increasingly globalized society. These gadgets are employed in customer service, business, travel, healthcare, and education, among other fields. It has numerous applications. Language barriers can now be removed through integrated and user-friendly translation systems, facilitating efficient and effortless communication between individuals speaking different languages Furthermore, translation devices are going to experience poor sound quality and background noise, which will reduce their usefulness in noisy locations. Furthermore, this tool’s speed can change based on things like your computer hardware and network connection. Communication delays can occasionally result from delays in real-time translation.

articleTitle: Employing Hyper Spectral Image Analysis to Assess Wind and Rain Damage to Crops
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wind and rain damage can cause sizable losses in agricultural productivity and require substantial attempts for early detection. Hyper spectral analysis can be a powerful tool to detect wind and rain harm to crops and enable well-timed and powerful interventions. Hyper spectral imaging uses multiple interventions of electromagnetic radiation to create targeted spectral signatures of floor capabilities. It may be used among herbal and artificial objects, up with lifeless crops and healthy ones. It can help discover wind and rain damage at early ranges even as it’s far nonetheless not seen to the bare eye, hence enabling extra efficient and accurate interventions. It can additionally enable greater efficient use of resources and chemical substances up to fertilizers with a view to providing more focused treatments-affected regions. Hyper spectral evaluation can also be utilized in combination with different tactics, which includes far-off sensing to increase more correct fashions of crop health and wind and rain damage. It will assist yield predictions and sell sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Detection of Defects in Processed Metals Through Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Photo evaluation plays a critical function within the detection of defects in processed metals. The aim of such evaluation is to discover and quantify any floor imperfections or defects that can reduce the product’s structural integrity and result in rejected components or an improved hazard of failure. The analysis manner commonly entails radiographs, optical or X -ray images taken from a pattern of the processed steel. This photo is then processed the usage of laptop imaginative and prescient algorithms to perceive and classify any defects. Those algorithms, including pattern popularity and segmentation techniques, are capable of discover surface qualitative (e.g. cracks, pits) and quantitative (e.g. thickness) defects. Outcomes can then be used to identify regions that require re-processing, and additionally to make sure rigorous satisfactory manage. Image analysis is a critical and reliable technique for the detection of defects in processed metals; enabling great manage selections and the detection of regions of the fabric that require re-processing, ultimately resulting in more secure and longer-lasting products.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Efficiency of Applied Cryptography Algorithms for Blockchain Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: this work specializes in the optimization of applied cryptography algorithms for block chain networks. By means of utilizing multivariate optimization techniques, the researchers have evolved strategies that lessen the computational complexity in block chain networks. That is achieved by means of utilizing measures including parallelism within the protocol, green internal scheduling, and storage sharing. Furthermore, the improvement of a nested optimization strategy helps optimize the aid usage for a couple of cryptographic primitives at the same time. The assessments display that, when compared to traditional cryptosystems, the techniques proposed right here can reduce the overall computational overhead. Subsequently, those methods display potential for scalability and better performance for block chain networks.

articleTitle: 2D Rises Wavelet Transform for Multiscale Texture Enhancement in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper affords and evaluates the utility of second Rises wavelet transforms for multiscale texture enhancement in scientific imaging. The proposed wavelet is based totally on a -dimensional Rises rework, which is a frequency-domain spatial filter out. The blessings of this approach include the capacity to beautify texture functions in clinical images with greater performance and precision than conventional strategies. Assessments of the proposed method on a hard and fast of medical pictures demonstrate that the 2d Rises wavelet remodel produces sharper details and better texture functions within the greater photographs. The results acquired display that this method can enhance the exceptional of medical imaging and help within the diagnosis of sicknesses.

articleTitle: Smart Annotation And Anonymizer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces the Smart Annotation and Anonymization tool, a sophisticated software application developed using PyQT5, aimed at optimizing object detection and recognition processes. The tool seamlessly integrates manual and automated annotation, anonymization, and segmentation techniques for both images and videos. By harnessing advanced deep learning algorithms, the Smart Annotation feature enables users to label images and videos manually or automatically, streamlining the creation of precise datasets for object detection and recognition tasks. The paper emphasizes the tool’s prowess in automatically recognizing and tagging objects in images and videos, presenting a significant time-saving advantage. The Anonymizer feature addresses privacy concerns by automatically blurring or obscuring faces and other identifying features in images and videos. This functionality is crucial for upholding the privacy of individuals captured by sensors or cameras, especially in applications such as Automatic Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). Furthermore, the paper underscores the inclusion of Instance and Panoptic Segmentation, dividing pixels in images into regions or contours and assigning a class to each, thereby enhancing object detection and recognition.

articleTitle: A Multipath Routing Approach for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks with Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile advert hoc networks (MANETs) are self-organizing, infrastructure-less networks together with cellular nodes that talk with each other without delay over wireless links. In spite of the numerous benefits they offer, MANETs need more bandwidth and strength assets and numerous inherent obstacles such as route preservation price and transmission reliability. To address those issues, this paper gift a routing method based on multipath routing and community coding for MANETs. Multipath routing is based on packet-degree duplication to stabilize the traffic load among multiple paths to be had in the network. In contrast, network coding combines more than one packet at community interface nodes, which will increase throughput and reduce manipulation overhead when packets traverse intermediate nodes. The proposed routing method combines each of these techniques, which ends up in efficient and dependable information transmission, even as concurrently decreasing the stress on the network sources. The proposed approach changed into simulating the usage of an OMNeT++ simulator and evaluated in terms of shipping ratio and common stop-to-give-up postponement. The simulation outcomes confirmed that the proposed technique outperforms multipath routing without network coding and single-direction routing in phrases of delivery ratio and average end-to-give-up delay.

articleTitle: AIoT for Smart Homes: Real-Time Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facing rising energy demand, we need smarter solutions for conservation. Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) offers a cost-effective way to track energy usage, but current methods struggle with real-world implementation. This presentation introduces a novel AI-powered approach to NILM using Deep Neural Networks (DNN). We convert power signatures from appliances into image representations, allowing our DNN to accurately classify which appliances are active. This breakthrough addresses key challenges, including the need for manual training and limited data availability. Our research paves the way for practical NILM solutions, enabling homeowners to gain real-time insights into their energy consumption and make informed decisions for conservation.

articleTitle: Wireless Process Control For Monitoring Level and pH of Water
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project introduces an innovative o industrial process control using Programmabl Controllers (PLCs) - an mication. The primary goal is to create a system that can monior and manage various physical parameters in real-ime, thereby optimizing industrial processes. The andes data acquisition, interfacing with sensors such as float sensors for level measurement, pH sensors, and temperature sensors. It also controls digital outputs like pumps and buzzers based on predefined thresholds. When parameter deviations are detected, this information is wirelessly transmitted using Zigbee technology. On the receiving end, another Zigbee module is connected to a PIC microcontroller linked to a PLC. The PLC processes the incoming data and, based on pre-programmed logic, provides instructions to control the pump or activate the buzzer, thus regulating the industrial process. This setup enables real-time data transmission, allowing for rapid responses to parameter deviations. The wireless communication eliminates the need for extensive cabling, simplifying system expansion and reconfiguration. By integrating these technologies, the project aims to optimize industrial processes, enhance safety, and reduce operational costs. In conclusion, the project demonstrates the potential of wireless automation in industrial settings. It streamlines data exchange and enables efficient control of critical processes, providing a practical application of modern automation technologies and serving as a foundation for further research and development in the field of industrial process control.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 for Vehicle Detection: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper evaluates the performance of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 in real-time object detection tasks within computer vision applications. The study focuses on the architecture and advancements of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8. YOLOv8 demonstrates superior performance compared to YOLOv5, attributed to its advanced architecture. However, both models exhibit competitive performance. Concluding remarks summarise key findings and suggest future research directions in object detection and computer vision. This study contributes insights into the comparative performance of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8. After evaluation over all the classes the YOLOv5 got 0.593 mAP@0.5 and 0.454 mAP@05:95 which YOLOv8 has overcome these values with 0.626 and 0.494 on mAP@0.5 and mAP@05:95 respectively. The results of the research clearly show the efficacy of YOLOv8 in object detection tasks.

articleTitle: The Prediction of Mental Health Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Depression is the mental health condition that affects many people around the world. In order to find and treat depression and other mental health conditions, it is important to find those who are at risk so that they can be helped as soon as possible. The early diagnosis and prevention have been the help of the machine learning techniques to the prediction of depression. The different machine learning models and datasets used, and the current literature on depression prediction have been thoroughly inspected. In the project, we gathered data from employees and visualized it using KNN algorithm. Finally, the layout of the heatmap, the confusion matrix, pie chart, bar plots and the forest of the data was drawn. After that, we used KNN and logistic regression to the data and the accuracy was 0.825 and 0.73333, respectively. The KNN algorithm was more accurate, i.e. the number was 0.825 (82. 5%).

articleTitle: Solar Based Battery Efficient Robot Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As technology develops, researchers are focusing more on using robots to improve human lives. These devices are difficult to use and require electricity to run. There are power outages all over India, especially in the summer, and most robots are useless. To address these challenges, this research focuses on developing affordable, user-friendly, and battery-efficient robots, with a particular emphasis on solar-powered alternatives. The proposed robotic system is designed to be autonomous, utilizing a Raspberry Pi as its primary device. The ultrasonic sensor is used for obstacle detection and collision avoidance. It operates by emitting ultrasonic waves and receiving the echo waves reflected from obstacles. The time taken for the echo to return is used to calculate the distance to the obstacle. Raspberry Pi processes the input from the ultrasonic sensor and controls the robot’s movements accordingly. The servomotor, which assists in the robot’s rotation, is coupled to the ultrasonic sensor. The LCD provides real-time feedback on the robot’s operations, including distance measurements. Additionally, the status of the battery is displayed continuously on the mobile. The purpose of the research is to monitor the battery voltage continuously, ensuring effective management and optimizing the charging process of the battery. The robot with the capability to autonomously navigate through dynamic environments, facilitating applications in various domains such as robotics research, industrial automation, medical applications, and service robotics.

articleTitle: Convergence in Design: Bottle Opener and Lighter Integration for Enhanced Utility
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Today’s engineering technology sectors are heavily focused on inspiring and motivating students to apply their theoretical knowledge in practical settings to meet the ever-increasing needs of the global technology industry. This essay investigates how a project weaved across the Engineering Technology curriculum might be utilized to develop a product that can be sold in the current market to perform and simplify common domestic tasks. The primary purpose of the bottle openers currently on the market is to open particular types of bottles. If they are used for other purposes, they require separate items, which will limit their portability and practicality because more products will be needed to complete the same tasks. Therefore, the project’s goal is to create a multipurpose bottle opener that can be used to open any kind of bottle that is on the market to solve this issue. This device will operate using fundamental mechanisms such as stress bending, cork plugs, and rack and pinion mechanisms. In their investigation, numerous researchers compared the forms and mechanisms. Although there are comparable works, in the present work casts a unique design and has a functionality difference which makes this project exclusive from other projects. This project yielded the optimum shape of a common product, a multifunctional bottle opener that can be used to open various bottle caps with varied styles.

articleTitle: Enhance the Voltage Gain of PV Array Fed Modified Boost Converter under Variable Duty Ratio and compare with Cuk Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The principal emphasis of research in the domain of sustainable power electronics is the development of novel modified boost converters that exhibit superior voltage gain performance compared to cuk converters when powered by PV arrays and functioning under shifting duty ratio conditions.Methods and Supplies: We got fourteen samples of voltage conversion ratios by adjusting the duty cycle. Two sets of seven samples each are used to get the voltage conversion ratio. Two groups have converters: one uses a Cuk design, while the other uses a newly updated boost converter. Findings: This research proves that the unique modified boost converter powered by PV is the best way to increase the voltage gain of a PV array without using a Cuk converter. Aside from its enhanced overall performance and functionality, in contrast to the Cuk converter, the newly enhanced boost converter exhibits superior performance in voltage conversion ratio, measuring 0.5182 as opposed to 0.4002. By employing the independent sample t test, a result of 0.000(p<0.05) was determined to be statistically significant. We may estimate the G power to be 0.8. In conclusion, the PV-powered modified boost converter may achieve a higher voltage conversion ratio than the cuk converter. Consequently, this is the optimal platform for boosting voltage gain and satisfying load requirements.

Author Keywords: Sustainable power electronics include solar photovoltaic (PV) array

articleTitle: Identification of hate speech from social media using GoogleNet classifier in comparison with KNN classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The goal of this project is to use Innovation’s ML classifiers to filter out hate speech on social media. The two most recommended and widely used methods for understanding realtime datasets are Google Net Classifier and K Nearest Neighbor. To predict hate speech on social media, we use Google Net & KNearest Neighbor with separate training and testing sets. On average, the test measures G power at about $85 \%$. Google Net has a greater accuracy ($91.9520 \%$) This difference is significantly different when compared to the k closest neighbors ($90.7700 \%$) ($\mathbf{p}=\mathbf{0 . 0 0 1;} \mathbf{p}\lt \mathbf{0 . 0 5}$). Google Net is more accurate than K-Nearest Neighbor when tested side by side.

articleTitle: Detection Of Subtle Musculoskeletal Injuries Using 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Detection of subtle musculoskeletal injuries has been traditionally tough in medical exercise because the clinical imaging modalities employed most effectively offer second records. With three-D magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), subtle musculoskeletal accidents can now be detected greater correctly and continuously, main to progress affected person care. MRI is a medical imaging modality that uses magnetic resonance indicators to generate go-sectional three-dimensional images of the body. MRI can offer precious facts approximately the size, location, and volume of damage, in addition to precisely mapping anatomical systems. The use of 3-D MRI enables the Detection of diffused musculoskeletal injuries by way of permitting the certain evaluation of smooth tissue structures. MRI can come across adjustments in the musculoskeletal anatomy, along with muscle stress, ligament harm, tendon connects injuries, and joint capsule tears. Superior software can be used to measure the thickness of character muscle fibers, locate microstructural modifications in synovial tissue, and analyze the integrity of cartilage layers. MRI can also be used to hit upon bone abnormalities, such as fractures, stress reactions, and bone marrow edema. The use of 3-D MRI to detect diffused musculoskeletal injuries presents numerous blessings to clinicians and patients.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Prediction Model for Heart Disease Data Based on Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Growing health risks has brought up remarkable impact in the mind of people to find the most important factors responsible for diseases like diabetes, heart disease and so on. In this study, authors have gone through a set of factors associated with daily habits of people around us and used those factors to classify the risk of heart diseases by introducing feature engineering concepts in the form of grouping of categorical and numerical features. the paper focuses on the improvement of results in the form of accuracy through the introduction of a new model framework whose mathematical expression and detailed explanation is described in Methodology section. Apart from classification, it has also been studied about the inter-dependence of available attributes in the data. The grouping of features have been done through a well-defined algorithm described in this study.

articleTitle: Medical Image Recognition for Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical image recognition with Android Studio is a cutting-edge field that uses mobile technologies to better diagnosis and patient care. The objective of this research project is to develop an accurate, dependable, and userfriendly Android application for analyzing and interpreting medical images, such as CT, MRI, and X-ray scans. The system will employ a variety of deep learning algorithms, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to detect irregularities and anomalies in the images. This will identify irregularities and abnormalities in the photos, which will assist medical experts in making critical judgments. A user-friendly interface will be part of the application, enabling fast diagnosis feedback, real- time processing, and picture input. By increasing diagnosis speed and accuracy, this state-of-the-art Android-based medical photo recognition app has the potential to revolutionize healthcare delivery. Modern healthcare now relies heavily on the ability to identify medical images, as this enables more accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. The Proposed method CNN Shows accuracy of 98.3% for Medical Image Recognition for Diagnosis.

articleTitle: How to Foster Safe and Engaging Social Media Experiences for Children: A Comprehensive Study on Design, Content, and Safety Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ubiquitous nature of social media platforms raises a pertinent question: can these platforms be leveraged to benefit children aged 7-12 years while mitigating potential risks? This paper posits that the development of dedicated social media platforms designed explicitly for this age group is a viable solution. Paper hypothesizes that such platforms, meticulously engineered with age-appropriate features, robust content moderation mechanisms, and comprehensive safety measures, can offer a myriad of advantages. These advantages encompass fostering positive social development, promoting creativity, and enriching educational experiences within a controlled and secure online environment. The research addresses critical concerns pertaining to cyberbullying, excessive screen time, and data privacy. The paper proposes the implementation of safeguards that prioritize the well-being of children in the digital realm. By acknowledging these concerns and implementing effective solutions, dedicated social media platforms have the potential to become a conducive and enriching space for children to engage in online activities. This research study provides a foundational framework for the creation of such platforms, paving the way for a future digital ecosystem that empowers young users to thrive within a safe and enriching online environment.

articleTitle: Cacao Beans Moisture Tester Using Parallel-plate Capacitance Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The moisture content of the cacao beans is an important factor to consider in developing its flavor during the drying process and maintaining its quality during its storage. The most common way of monitoring if the cacao beans are on the right moisture content is by observing their texture and color. This opens the opportunity to develop a design that provides accurate real-time percentage of the moisture content of cacao beans. The designed device uses a parallel-plate capacitance sensor made of copper sheets that are connected to an Arduino UNO microcontroller with an ATmega328P chip. The capacitive sensor with the cacao beans as the dielectric will serve as an RC integrator for a pulse generator and its peak voltage output will be computed to get the moisture content percentage of the sample. The moisture content can be viewed from the LCD, or, with the use of the Bluetooth module, the readings can be viewed and archived through a GUI. To test the accuracy of the device, a paired t-test was done comparing it to the traditional oven-drying method. The statistical treatment shows that there is no significant difference between the traditional method to the developed system. Therefore, all the objectives of the study were accomplished, and the researchers were able to measure the moisture content of cacao beans in real time and accurately.

articleTitle: Deepfake Image Forgery Detection using Local Feature Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deepfake Image Forgery,generates fake images after manipulating the original source images. This increases the risk of losing trust in images or videos. This paper proposes an efficient methodology to detect Deepfake images from real images. The methodology involves extracting Local Feature De scriptors(Local Binary Pattern (LBP),Frequency Decoded Local Binary Pattern (FDLBP),Binary Gabor Pattern (BGP)). The fusion of these features are fed to the DenseNet to classify the image as fake or real. The model uses Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture that utilizes all three Local Feature Descriptors that extract features of the images. The model has an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 3. 6 5 \%}$ which is performing better than Deep learning models.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Designing of Low Noise Amplifier for High frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive review of Low Noise Amplifiers (LNAs) using various topologies. In recent years, several articles have been published on the mathematical analysis of LNA. To improve the Figure of Merit (FoM) and performance characteristics of LNA, researchers have suggested different topologies. The growing demand for Internet of Things (IoT) devices requires receiver circuits that consume low power, operate at high speed, and are compact in size. The 5G network operates at two frequency bands: sub 6 GHz and 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz (millimeter wave). As a result, there is a high demand for circuits that operate at high frequency and low voltage. However, the decreasing feature size of devices limits the use of circuit topologies at high frequency. Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) devices face limitations such as high output conductance, velocity saturation, and deterioration in mobility. The Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) is a critical component of the receiver circuit, and its performance has a significant impact on the overall system. LNA requirements include low Noise Figure (NF) to improve signal quality, good input-output impedance matching to reduce return losses, low supply voltage to lower energy consumption, and small area for low cost and size. A comparison chart is provided in the manuscript.

articleTitle: Improving Coverage Efficiency with Autonomous and Adaptive Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a method to improve coverage efficiency in Wi-Fi communication systems by leveraging self-sustaining and adaptive communication systems. The approach seeks to exploit machine getting-to-know and related optimization techniques to enable network nodes to autonomously adjust electricity stages, pick out adjacent nodes, regulate transmission stages, and other parameters to acquire progressed insurance and higher record rates. Self-reliance getting to know an algorithm primarily based on reinforcement gaining knowledge of is used to pattern the surroundings, optimizes variables, and permit gadget adaptation even as minimizing human intervention. The paper discusses the structure and an algorithm evolved and explores the blessings of self-sufficient and adaptive communication systems over conventional non-autonomous systems.

articleTitle: Explainable AI-based Model Interpretability for Tomato Leaf Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Tomatoes are one of the most widely produced, nutritionally dense crops. However, their cultivation is frequently hampered by a variety of viral and bacteria-borne illnesses. To overcome this issue, Deep Learning based on Convolutional Neural Networks has been created to give effective leaf disease detection. This research describes an innovative AI-based farmer support system capable of swiftly detecting diseases and monitoring crops to ensure food security. The system incorporates a model based on modified DenseNet 121 and XAI algorithms to precisely identify diseased tomato leaves, facilitating disease detection, soil analysis, and yield prediction. The system has shown an accuracy of over 99% after testing on real-world datasets, which greatly promotes sustainable agriculture practices and guarantees the supply of food services.

articleTitle: Spam Message Classification Using C4.5 and Steepest Ascent Hill Climbing and Genetic Algorithm for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Text messaging is a feature of the mobile industry that is frequently utilized. The purpose of text message is to generate revenue for its creators. Spam is the colloquial word for unsolicited bulk messages containing commercial content. Spam via text message is used to spread phishing links and for commercial gain. The user’s phone alerts them to incoming messages every time text message spam reaches their inbox. In addition to taking up space on the user’s phone and wasting time, text message spam leaves the recipient disappointed when it becomes apparent that the message is unsolicited. These days, there are several developed algorithms accessible to detect spam text messages. even if text message spam still has an impact on users. The mobile sector must implement the finest text message filtering possible. The suggested study uses C4.5 decision tree in conjunction with a steeepeset ascent hill climbing and genetic algorithm to identify spam in text message. The suggested approach used decision trees to classify the optimal characteristics after they were discovered using metaheuristic methods. Comparing this hybrid strategy to the current classification methods, performance was superior.

articleTitle: Indian French Bean Varieties: CNN vs. Decision Trees Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There is no doubt that crop variety improvement and the use of efficient analytical methods that contribute to high agricultural production and food security are crucial. It is research focused on the Comparison of Indian French bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) varieties: Selection-9, Pusa Parvati, and Arka Suvidha using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Decision Tree (DT) model. The major aim, therefore, is to assess the effectiveness of this integrated model in correctly sorting and forecasting the yields of these bean types under various agroecological circumstances. This dataset includes observational field data along with morphological and phenological characters of plants collected from various experimental sites. Thus, the proposed CNN-DT model embeds the feature extraction capacity of CNNs with the interpretability and decision-making effectiveness of DT. It is this integration that would endeavor to utilize the inherent advantages of the two approaches to improve the classification of the crops and profitability of crop selection and management. This suggests that the hybrid model improves the classification accuracy and reliability better as compared to the traditional isolated models. The assessment of the model in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score highlights a performance enhancement when differentiating the three types of French beans. Moreover, the present work suggests the use of state-of-the-art methods in machine learning for agricultural studies and can be useful for the improvement of decision-making mechanisms used by farmers and agronomists. From the findings of this study, it is clear that this is a need to combine modern learning techniques with ordinary farming practices when it comes to picking the right crops and improving production. Altogether, the study provides significant recommendations for AI-domain application in agriculture to increase the effectiveness of crop cultivation more efficiently.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Kalman Filter with the MPU6050 Accelerometer and Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Abstmet -Reliable sensor measurements are essental for autonomous navigation, control systems and various other applications. We studied a model of a gesture controlled wheelchair. A key finding is that the processing unit must be able to filter out noise so that the efficacy of the wearable device is improved. In this paper, we demonstrate the application of the Kalman filter to combine measurements in the presence of noise or drift, to calculate the orientation from the inertial measurement unit, MPU6050. We report the behoviour of the gyroscope and accelerometer by measuring their output values individually first, and then passing them through the Kalman Filter. Alternatives such as the recursive average and moving average filters are also discussed. The characteristics of the filter for different parameters such as the standard deviation are plotted. Finally, the Kalman gain convergence for a steady state is verified.

articleTitle: Enhancing BER Performance in Phase Noise using KNN-based Symbol Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The performance of a wireless system is directly dependent on the accuracy of retrieving the transmitted message from the noisy signal received at the demodulation end. Over the years many methods have been developed to reduce the Bit Error Rate(BER) at the receiver. Recently, machine learning algorithms have been explored as an alternative to traditional symbol detection methods to enhance overall performance. M-ary QAM is a popular digital modulation scheme used in Wireless communication owing to its high data rate. Nevertheless, for a given signal-to-noise ratio, the BER for QAM is higher than the BPSK or QPSK systems, which provide a lower data rate. The BER can be reduced using ML classifiers such as the K-Nearest Neighbours Algorithm (KNN) to leverage the high data rate of QAM and have more efficient symbol detection. This paper describes the implementation of KNN to QAM symbol detection and the resultant decrease in BER is observed to be around 4-6 dB.

articleTitle: Enhancing Investment Decision-making: Leveraging Smart Machine Learning Models for Risk Profiling and Portfolio Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study wishes to use smart Machine Learning (ML) models to make it easier to understand how risky investments are and decide where to put money. First, we look at things like age, money situation, and feelings about risk from a big collection of surveys. Then, we use special math to group people based on how much risk they’re comfortable with, and give them scores. Next, we teach a ML model to pick the best places to put money depending on each person’s comfort with risk—getting better over time as this ML model learns from its successes and failures. Therefore, this study shows it’s possible to use ML models to figure out how much risk someone is okay with and where they should invest, without needing people to do it. But we say we still need to make the models better by switching some things to make it more accurate and helpful for everyone.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Powered Predictive Analysis for Stress Detection during Pregnancy
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this work, we developed a non-invasive maternal health monitoring system using wearable sensors to collect real-time physiological data, including heart rate, body temperature, and EEG signals, from pregnant women. The primary objective is to accurately predict stress levels using K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) and Naive Bayes algorithms based on these physiological inputs. Our validated outcomes demonstrate a high accuracy of 96% in training and 91% in testing phases, confirming the reliability of our approach. This method holds significant implications for antenatal care, offering timely and actionable information to healthcare providers to better assist and support expectant mothers. By integrating non-invasive sensors and machine learning via Python programming, this research enhances maternal health monitoring and could substantially benefit both healthcare providers and pregnant women.

articleTitle: Task Offloading and Scheduling in Osmotic Computing-Based Health Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The advent of osmotic computing has brought significant advancements in health monitoring systems (HMSs). Osmotic computing explores and leverages the synergy between the Internet of Things (IoT) and edge tiers, edge and cloud tiers, for dynamic and adaptive management of tasks and resources. In this paper, we introduce task offloading and scheduling algorithms (i.e., emergency level-based task offloading (ELTO) and osmotic task scheduling (OTS) algorithms) within an osmotic computing framework aimed at reducing latency, optimizing resource utilization, and enhancing the scalability of HMSs. Our proposed task offloading algorithm, ELTO, ascertains the dynamic movement of tasks to either the edge tier or cloud tier from the IoT tier, assuring prompt processing of critical healthcare tasks, such as real-time monitoring of vital signs, data analysis and emergency response. On the other hand, our OTS algorithm is used to utilize the edge tier resources efficiently. Through rigorous simulations, we illustrate the effectiveness of our algorithms in enhancing system responsiveness and reliability compared to baseline algorithms.

articleTitle: Robotics Process Automation Technologies for Data Collection and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Data collection and analysis are critical aspects of various business processes. However, these tasks can be time-consuming, prone to errors, and delays employee productivity when done manually, especially when we have to deal with huge data. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technologies offer a promising solution in form of a BOT, by automating tedious tasks related with data handling. A survey by The Economist corporation believe that automation kick launches digital transformation, robotic process automation (RPA) has evolved from an emerging technology to a must-have digital transformation tool for enterprises to compete globally. An increasing number of companies are now using RPA to automate normal business processes in a non-intrusive and cost-effective way. On the other hand, decision-making, pattern recognition, and many other business-related tasks benefit greatly from the use of big data and analytics. This paper explores the application of RPA in data collection and analysis, examining its functionalities, benefits, and limitations. In practical, Bot produces error-free work and takes 94.44% less time for data collection compared to a manual process, which encourages all firms to adopt to RPA technologies.

articleTitle: A novel Cross-Layer Protocols for Resource Allocation in Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cross-layer Protocols for proper resource Allocation in Mobile Networks are a singular technique to enhance the efficiency of wireless networks. The method utilizes multiple layers of the radio protocol stack better to coordinate cell node scheduling and resource allocation. Using combining communication, routing, and scheduling functionalities in an unmarried protocol, pass-Layer Protocols for proper resource Allocation can offer a sizable will increase in the number of facts that may be transferred and the overall latency and throughput of the community. This technique can also enhance the radio interface’s operation by lowering interference and encouraging collaborative communications. Eventually, by using facts and managing records from the communique and routing layers, go-Layer Protocols for proper resource Allocation can reduce the complexity of the community, even offering greater scalability. This paper affords unique cross-Layer Protocols for resource Allocation in Cellular Networks. The proposed protocol permits integrated resource allocation in the cell network environment, considering communication and computation layers.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effects of Alpha Variation in Exponential Linear Unit Activation Function for Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper immerses into the subtle effects of varying values within the Exponential Linear Unit (ELU) activation function, altering from 1 to 0.10. Activation functions take an important role in deep learning models, impacting their training dynamics, convergence behavior, and stereotypical capabilities. Focusing specifically on ELU, which describes advantages over conventional activation functions like ReLU, this study aims to interpret the inference of adjusting its alpha parameter. Through a meticulous relative investigation, this paper presents a comprehensive analysis of ELUactivation function with varying alpha values. Firstly, we demonstrate the relative performance of ELU activation with varying alpha values against other conventional activation functions. Secondly, we analyze the relationship between alpha values and training loss, manifesting how habituation in alpha influences the convergence behaviorof neural networks. Thirdly, we analyze the concussion onvalidation loss to determine the effect of alpha values on the model’s ability to establish unseen data. Moreover, we analyze the correlation between alpha values and all-inclusive model performance, considering measures such as accuracy, precision, and recall by comprehensively.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning for Detecting Rice Leaf Diseases in Jhum Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Rice leaf disease poses a significant challenge to Jhum cultivation, making early and accurate detection vital for effective disease management. This study examines two cutting-edge deep learning models, VGG19 and DenseNet201, to identify and classify diseases in rice leaves. Our collection includes images of rice leaves that have been meticulously classed as bacterial blight, blast, brown spot, and the tungro. The diagnostic efficacy of each model was assessed after training with this dataset. Our findings reveal that the DenseNet201 model outperforms with a test accuracy of 99.63% and outstanding ROC-AUC scores across all disease categories. While the VGG19 model also demonstrates commendable performance with a test accuracy of 89.53%, it falls short of the DenseNet201 model. The findings highlight the potential of utilizing deep learning to transform disease detection in Jhum rice farming, providing valuable advantages for managing crops and optimizing yield.

articleTitle: Coding Solutions for Robust Performance in Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wi-Fi structures require reliable coding solutions to ensure robust overall performance. Latest advances in wireless technologies have accelerated the want for reliable coding strategies to catch up on signal losses because of shadowing, fading, and imperfect channel situations. Traditional coding techniques, together with forward mistakes correction (FEC) and variety coding, conflict to hold strong performance underneath challenging conditions. New coding strategies are needed to ensure a reliable Wi-Fi communiqué in difficult propagation environments. Recent research in coding answers for robust wireless systems has explored a selection of methods, such as faster codes, Low-Density Parity-test (LDPC) codes, and area-time coding. LDPC codes offer extended code lengths, which boosts coding benefits and features quite low computational complexity. Area-time codes are a block coding method that improves blunder resilience by utilizing a couple of antennas and transmitting the identical sign in more than one direction simultaneously. These coding answers were implemented to provide improved overall performance in diverse Wi-Fi systems, which include cell, WLAN, and satellite TV for PC communiqué networks. Particularly, turbo codes, LDPC codes, and area-time codes have been used effectively in WLAN networks to reduce channel mistakes and growth records prices, in addition to in mobile networks to enhance spectral efficiency and offer better throughput.

articleTitle: Exploring Sentiment Analysis Algorithms for Brand-Product Reputation Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper affords an overview of sentiment analysis algorithms for boosting brand-product reputation. The point of interest is on supervised and unsupervised systems getting to know strategies, which might be usually used for predicting sentiment. Specifically, the authors examine 4 forms of algorithms - Naïve Bayes classifiers, support vector machines, recurrent neural networks, and sentiment analysis with deep mastering - and how they can be used for boosting emblem-product popularity. Moreover, the look evaluates the constraints of the algorithms, in addition to capacity destiny studies instructions. The authors finish that while sentiment analysis with deep getting to know can also be the maximum accurate choice, cautious consideration must be made while choosing an algorithm as specific algorithms may also produce distinctive outcomes. This paper presents an informative and comprehensive assessment of sentiment analysis algorithms and their usefulness for boosting logo-product reputation.

articleTitle: Audio Encryption Using AES and Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Securing digital audio data during any transmission or storage is essential for ensuring privacy and confidentiality. Traditional encryption techniques like Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) offer high security, but they might be vulnerable to attacks that exploit encrypted data patterns. Cellular automata, on the other hand, exhibit complex and challenging behavior, making them attractive for introducing additional layers of security in encryption schemes. However, integrating these techniques effectively remains a challenge. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a novel audio encryption system that combines the features of AES and cellular automata. A pseudo-random number sequence produced by Rule 30, a chaotic cellular automaton rule, is XOR-ed with the AES-encrypted audio data. This disrupts potential pattern recognition attempts, significantly enhancing the overall security of the encryption process. The system operates on WAV format audio files and ensures the confidentiality and integrity of the data by preventing unauthorized access and manipulation. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach by comparing the characteristics of original and encrypted audio files. The results demonstrate significant alterations in the audio data, rendering it unintelligible without the decryption key. Additionally, the system utilizes the well-established AES algorithm, maintaining efficiency during encryption and decryption. This system defeats other methods in terms of security, complexity, and computational efficiency making this a reliable and efficient method for securing audio data transmission and storage where audio privacy is essential.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Accuracy in Chess Game Outcomes through the Utilization of AlexNet Classifier Compared to Stochastic Gradient Descent for Increased Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The objective of this research is to explore and analyze chess game winning predictions utilizing two separate Innovation Machine Learning (ML) classifiers. Novel AlexNet and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) are the most extensively used and recommended algorithms for better understanding of real-time datasets. This process includes choosing the data collection, training the data, and testing the data using suggested classifiers. The proposed ML classifier model is trained on 80% of the dataset volume, while 20% is used for testing. The data for SPSS analysis comprises two sets of 10 output values each from different classifiers, totaling 20 values obtained through various functional operations. In the SPSS calculations, a G power value of 0.85 is applied, and the significance level is set at 0.01 ($\mathbf{p} \mathbf{0. 0 0 5}$). The accuracy improvement between both classifiers is compared throughout the experimental investigation using the Python compiler. The accuracy of the chosen AlexNet classifier, which increased winning prediction of chess game players, was 99.92%, compared to the SGD classifier’s accuracy of 96.61%. Most of the analysis identified strength and skills of a player with previous moves. Some other earlier research predicted the next move of a player. This proposed game engine can predict the winning ratio of a player with higher accuracy rate. Among the selected classifiers, the proposed AlexNet classifier recommended a game prediction model which can identify the winning ratio of multiple player games with higher accuracy rate

articleTitle: Comparing Transformers and CNN Approaches for Malware Detection: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Detecting malicious software, known as malware, is crucial in cybersecurity due to the constantly evolving threats and the ways in which malware tries to avoid detection. This research investigates the efficacy of deep learning models for multi-class malware classification using the MaleVis image dataset. Research on using transformer architectures for malware detection and classification is limited. The proposed study explores using the Convolutional Vision Transformer (CvT) for detecting malware, comparing its performance with the Vision Transformer (ViT) and the pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network, EfficientNet B0. Each model is fine-tuned on the MaleVis dataset to distinguish between different malware categories and benign samples. A comprehensive assessment using multiple evaluation metrics suggests CvT outperformed the other models, with an F1-Score of 0.96054. ViT followed closely with a score of 0.95821, while EfficientNet B0 scored 0.87386. The research aims to contribute to cybersecurity advancements by leveraging modern deep learning techniques for enhanced malware detection.

articleTitle: Object Detection for Remote Sensing Images Using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Applications including environmental monitoring, disaster response, and marine traffic management depend heavily on object detection in remote sensing images. This paper introduces a novel approach for object detection(ship) in high-resolution satellite imagery utilizing the YOLOv8 i.e You Only Look Once version eight architecture. YOLOv8 is used for its real-time processing capabilities and superior accuracy in object detection tasks. The methodology devised in this study customizes the YOLOv8 framework to effectively address the intricacies of ship detection within the DIOR dataset with a mAp@50 is $91.4 \%$.This dataset encapsulates a wide array of maritime scenarios characterized by diverse scales, orientations, and complex backgrounds. To capitalize on the rich features learned from large-scale datasets, transfer learning techniques are employed, leveraging pre-trained models. Subsequently, fine-tuning on the DIOR dataset is performed to specifically enhance the model’s detection capabilities.

articleTitle: Real-Time Adaptive STFT-CNN Fusion for EW Passive Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Passive guidance systems in Electronic Warfare (EW) encounter challenges stemming from modern radar techniques like Pulse-on-Pulse (POP) signals and environmental interference. Detecting intra-pulse modulated signals necessitates real-time Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), particularly crucial due to maneuvering challenges when the EW system is in close proximity to the radar. To address the computational latency inherent in radar parameter extraction, our approach integrates Machine Learning (ML) based signal recovery with a Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) empowered STFT solution. This framework encompasses signal recovery, STFT processing, and simultaneous input into a CNN model for predictive analysis. Initially, test data undergoes STFT and prediction logic, with discrepancies prompting data inclusion into the training dataset. This adaptive strategy leverages processing time for analysis, augmenting fault tolerance without additional hardware. Our proposed design surpasses other software-based CNN implementations by 2X and 19.27X, respectively. Furthermore, our STFT hardware implementation achieves a 2X higher clock rate and 5.33X lower DSP utilization compared to other FPGA implementations.

articleTitle: CNN and Transformer based Brain Tumor Detection and Classification System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A brain tumor, also recognized as an intracranial tumor, develops as an anomalous mass of tissue wherein cells proliferate and multiply without restraint. Detection and classification of tumor in the brain is of paramount importance for effective treatment of the patient. CNNs and Vision Transformers are the popular techniques that have been used in the past for classification of images. Both the techniques have performed extraordinarily in the task of image classification. So here we have introduced a new approach where we fused VGG16 with the Vision Transformer (ViT) for brain tumor detection and classification. We have also compared the performance of our approach with other robust approaches such as ResNet50, VGG16, InceptionV3 and a pre-trained Vision Transformer that is GViT. Our approach has outperformed the other approaches during the comparison. Testing accuracies of pre-trained ResNet50, VGG16, InceptionV3, GViT are 90.18%, 90.04%, 74.96%, 72.38% respectively. The testing accuracy of our approach is 93.31%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Representation for Caption Generation Using Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
