abstract: Cricket, a sport loved worldwide, often presents challenges for aspiring players due to limited access to infrastructure and coaching resources. Cricket’s automated learning solutions are still largely unexplored, despite its popularity. By concentrating on the application of cricket shot detection, a crucial component of the game, this research fills this gap. One essential component of computer vision that becomes apparent in deciphering the subtleties of cricket shots is human stance estimate. Pose estimate provides a detailed examination of batting skills and footwork by tracking important areas on the batsman’s body, such as joints and limbs. MoveNet is a significant framework in this domain that has garnered accolades for its real-time performance and lightweight architecture, which enable accurate identification of human poses, which is a crucial requirement in the dynamic world of cricket. This study explores the combination of deep learning techniques and human pose estimate for cricket shot recognition. More precise and reliable cricket shot identification and classification are made possible by the model’s ability to extract complex patterns and features from the input data by utilizing deep learning techniques. Our goal is to automatically identify and classify cricket shots based on players’ minor motions through theoretical investigation, empirical validation, and real-world applications. Through the integration of cutting-edge technologies, such as deep learning, with traditional cricket analysis, our goal is to gain a deeper understanding of the game and discover new avenues for sports analytics, coaching, and broadcasting.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Real-Time Exercise Monitoring with MediaPipe and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Physical fitness and exercise play pivotal roles in maintaining a healthy lifestyle, and technology integration has revolutionized how individuals approach their fitness regimes. This study focuses on developing an AI-enabled real-time exercise monitoring system using MediaPipe for pose estimation and OpenCV for angle calculation. By analyzing video inputs, the system accurately identifies key anatomical landmarks and calculates joint angles in real time, providing immediate feedback on exercise form. This technology enhances the precision and reliability of exercise monitoring, supporting fitness enthusiasts and trainers in optimizing workout routines. Operating effectively across various lighting conditions and backgrounds, the system promotes proper exercise execution to improve training outcomes and mitigate injury risks in gym and home settings. Incorporating AI-based pose analysis represents a significant advancement in fitness technology, showcasing AI has potential to enhance exercise monitoring and facilitate safer, more effective workouts. This research underscores the practical application of AI in fitness, offering insights into its role in promoting overall fitness and well-being through innovative real-time exercise analysis.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Vehicular Networks with Prioritized Traffic
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study leverages Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) based on IEEE 802.11p for communication to improve the safety of road transport through vehicle navigation, particularly in emergency situations and high traffic loads. Immediate delivery of the safety message is difficult where a vehicle must encounter an emergency and there are significant traffic volumes. To meet this challenge, a priority call admission monitoring policy is suggested that ensures the timely transmission of vital safety messages. The research aims at developing a model for the management of message priorities, as well as implementing two Call’s admission control policy. To provide a general basis for analysis of performance, an analytical Markov Chain model has been developed. Furthermore, practical performance results obtained through simulation are compared with the theoretical model to evaluate the efficacy of the proposed approach in enhancing vehicular network performance and safety.

articleTitle: Skin Disease Detection and Diagnosis Using Deep Neural Network

By scrutinizing parameters such as lesion size, color variations, and surrounding tissue health, these models can predict the progression of skin conditions. Such insights not only inform treatment strategies, guiding medication intensity and surgical interventions but also enable clinicians to monitor patient progress, ensuring adaptive and personalized care plans.

articleTitle: AST-Based and Token-Based Neural Networks for Source Code Classification: A Comparative Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Programming languages function as a medium for expressing instructions in the context of computer program creation. A prevalent convention in programming is categorizing source code into fragments, a strategy that enhances understanding and simplifies the upkeep process. This research study presents a comparative examination of two distinct models utilized to classify source code. The first model employs a neural network approach that heavily relies on Syntax Trees (ASTs). In contrast, the second model is built on a neural network framework that utilizes the tokenization process. The AST-based model employs a methodology that entails decomposing extensive ASTs into smaller clusters of statement trees. These clusters are subsequently transformed into vectors by capturing the lexical and syntactical characteristics of the statements. The naturalness of certain statements is captured by employing a bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model, which utilizes a collection of statement vectors. In contrast, the token-based paradigm diverges from ASTs and emphasizes tokens obtained through tokenization. The tokens undergo preprocessing and vectorization before inputting into a bidirectional RNN model to evaluate the naturalness of the statements. To choose the optimal model, the accuracy of the two models are compared.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization in Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning on Cloud-Based Platforms

articleTitle: Ransomware Detection in Healthcare Organizations using Supervised Learning Models: Naive Bayes Classifier.

abstract: Ransomware attacks are a big problem for healthcare organizations. They cause major disruptions in important tasks and ask for money in exchange for fixing access to servers that have been compromised. This paper introduces a fresh approach that uses static analysis to detect and prevent ransomware attacks more effectively. Instead of relying on time-consuming dynamic analysis like usual, this approach offers a faster and stronger defense against ransomware attacks. Many current classification algorithms struggle to effectively detect and stop ransomware infections in computer systems due to their poor performance. It’s critical to quickly evaluate how effective the current machine learning classification algorithms are at detecting ransomware. By undertaking this task, we can develop algorithms that are both stronger and more efficient, capable of overcoming the limitations of current approaches. Our model doesn’t just find ransomware attacks; it also stops them and prevents bad stuff from happening, making healthcare cybersecurity stronger. This research is an important move in making healthcare systems stronger against the changing cyber threats. What sets our method apart is that it skips the disassembly step, which is unique. This study assessed how well certain classification algorithms, like Naive Bayes and Random Forest, performed. The algorithms’ performance was measured based on Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F-Measure using these machine learning methods. Based on our experiments, we found that the Naive Bayes algorithm achieved the highest accuracy, reaching 99.2 percentile. This suggests that Naive Bayes performs well in detecting ransomware malware attacks with high accuracy rates.

articleTitle: Enhancing Named Entity Recognition with a BERT-DQN Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a fundamental task in natural language processing (NLP) that involves identifying and classifying proper nouns into predefined categories such as names of people, organizations, locations, etc. This paper proposes an advanced NER model by integrating Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) with Conditional Random Fields (CRF), further enhanced with Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning within the CRF layer. Utilizing the CoNLL 2003 dataset, our model aims to leverage the powerful feature extraction capabilities of BERT along with the structured prediction advantage of CRF. The DQN integration aims to optimize the sequence tagging decisions dynamically, addressing limitations found in traditional NER models. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in precision, recall, and F1 score, highlighting the efficacy of incorporating reinforcement learning into the BERT-CRF architecture for NER tasks.

articleTitle: An Exploration of the Impact of Using Formal Methods on Power Optimisation in Embedded Computational Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Formal techniques were established to be effective in the strength optimization of embedded computation architectures. This summary gives an investigation into the consequences of the usage of formal methods to optimize the power intake of embedded computation architectures. The research assesses the power optimization effectiveness of formal strategies versus present conventional techniques by evaluating the effects of implementations: a non-formal and a proper technique. Both implementations are examined using a fixed of evaluation tools and systems, which include strength-conscious compilers, simulators, and analytical fashions. Results of the investigation advise that formal techniques can offer huge energy and strength financial savings for embedded computation architectures.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy by Comparing with CatBoost Classifier Algorithm over Multilayer Perceptron Classifier Algorithm for Predicting the Air Pollution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Aim: This effort aims to determine the type of air pollution quality. Through a comparison study of the catboost Classifier procedure and the MLP classifier method, it has been found which algorithm is the most accurate in forecasting air pollution. Materials and methods: The Kaggle website is used to obtain the dataset required for finding the air pollution quality type. The algorithms for the Novel Cat boost algorithm and Multilayer perceptron are tested when the dataset is imported and data mining can be done. The G power test with $\alpha=0.05$ and power $=0.85$ was employed in this study. For two algorithms, there are two groups. Each group sample size iteration 10. Results: Accuracy for the supplied inputs is acquired as the results. The results are obtained using the IBM SPSS software. According to findings, A statistically significant distinction exists between the Novel Cat Boost Classifier Procedure, which has an accuracy of 83.11 %, and the MLP Classifier Algorithm, which has a $77.76 \%$ accuracy. The Statistically Novel Gradient Boosting Classifier Algorithm was significant with p=0.002(p<0.05) by Independent T-test analysis. This suggests that the two algorithms differ statistically significantly from one another. Conclusion: Innovative Cat Boost classifier algorithm has more accuracy than the MLP classifier algorithm in this study.

articleTitle: Virtual Trial System using Haar Cascades Classifier Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In shopping, many still prioritize the traditional in-store experience, often hindered by long queues for trial rooms. However, the introduction of Virtual Mirrors offers a transformative solution through Virtual Trial Rooms, enabling customers to effortlessly try on a diverse range of clothing items without the need for physical fitting, revolutionizing the shopping process.The “Virtual Trial Room” employs a Kinect Sensor to enable a real-time virtual fitting experience, where the system captures the user’s skeletal data and utilizes it within Unity to overlay clothing onto the user’s image. This live streaming video displaying the user adorned in the selected clothing is then presented as the output on the screen.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Stress Detection and Management Using Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Chatbot Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern era, mental health issues are increasing rapidly. That is why we need a strong and precise stress detection and management system to resolve the issue from the root. This research paper proposes an extensive approach combining machine computational power, software, technology, and sympathetic care to meet this requirement. The paper’s approach is based on speech analyses and looks for similarities in frequency patterns to determine the stress level. This paper leverages tools like machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and chatbots. By merging these technologies, it can bridge the research gaps and create an extensive framework for stress detection and treatment. This paper discusses the methodology, technologies, and algorithms that are used in this paper and achieves an accuracy rate of $95 \%$, which is a testament to its practical applicability. It also discussed the ethical connotation of such technology and realized its potential application across multiple regions. We hope this research paper will mark a significant contribution to health technology and stress-bursting mission.

articleTitle: Optimizing Plant Health with Q-Learning: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Optimising Plant Health with Q-Learning: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach” introduces a novel approach to plant care, leveraging deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms, such as Q-learning, to simulate diverse plant growth scenarios. The research aims to develop a system that provides a tailored approach to determine the best-case scenario for plant species’ maximum or optimum growth or development. The system integrates a comprehensive PlantVillage dataset with approximately 54,000 plant species covering 14 significant crops. This dataset is well labeled and considered as it fulfills the set environment for our agent to produce rewards on. The research contributes significantly to environmental sustainability and ecological awareness, fostering a deeper connection between humans and the natural environment by providing AI-powered cultivation strategies.

articleTitle: Synthetic Image Generation for Improved Detection of Bone Defects Using GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automated Fractures of Bone Detection in orthopedic radiographs is crucial in assisting doctors to correctly and properly diagnose fractures. For this assignment, we investigate a Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)-based solution that employs sophisticated artificial intelligence models capable of producing realistic photos while detecting anomalies. It display efficiency of GAN-based models in boosting fracture detection performance by applying multiple assessment criteria, such precision, accuracy, and F1-score, and detection speed, through thorough testing and evaluation of musculoskeletal radiograph datasets (MURA). GANs function by retraining networks of generators to produce artificial pictures and a network of discriminators. This antagonistic process encourages the formation of realistic radiography with fractures, enabling precise and automatic detection. Our proposed approach makes use of GANs’ capability to produce artificial pictures with cracks and recognize, abnormal patterns, thereby improving fracture diagnosis These findings highlight the prospect of introducing GANs into automated evaluation, which might assist with develop fracture detection systems in orthopaedics. Our findings advance fracture detection approaches, paving the way for improved and more accurate orthopaedic diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Design of Novel CPW fed High Isolation Quad-Port MIMO Antenna with Dual-Band Resonance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this article, a Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) can provide a stronger, more focused signal, improved signal quality, and increased data rates. However, designing MIMO antennas poses challenges such as narrower beam width, alignment issues, and high isolation. This proposed system is a dual-band microstrip patch antenna that has conductive material mounted on a dielectric substrate, such as FR-4. The single element has a dimension of $32 \times 22 \mathrm{~mm}^{2}$, and the MIMO structure is created by duplicating the single element with a compact size of $54 \times 54 \mathbf{~ m m}^{2}$. It is useful for various applications like wireless sensor networks, WLAN, Wi-Fi, and cellular networks. It can overcome these challenges as it provides two independent and dedicated networks, allowing more flexibility, bandwidth, and support for various wireless applications. The ports are aligned orthogonally, which increases isolation.

articleTitle: Low Power TGFF Using Static and Dynamic Pulse Generators
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Transmission Gate FlipFlop (TGFF) is one of the most commonly used flipflops in circuits. In this paper, we aim to create a low power version of TGFF. A static and then two dynamic pulse generator architectures are proposed which when integrated with TGFF, provides low power dissipation. The pulse generator generates a pulse from the clock signal using either combinational logic, transmission gates, inverters or a hybrid of these. It is designed in 90 nm CMOS technology and for Inverter based TGFF there is a reduction in pulse power dissipation by 61%, for DXPG based TGFF there is reduction in pulse power dissipation of up to 91.46% and for CSDPG based TGFF, there is a reduction in pulse power dissipation of up to 75%.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Cloud Platform: Amazon Web Service, Microsoft Azure, And Google Cloud Provider: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces the topranked Cloud providers and delivers a detailed overview of their Infrastructure as Service solutions. A Cloud-based service is any program or resource that is made available to consumers through an internet connection from a Cloud platform. A network that shares processing power, software, and big systems among numerous computers is referred to as Cloud computing. Nowadays, every business is moving toward computerization. Not every startup has the resources to spend a large sum of money on servers and hiring IT personnel to maintain them. For this paper, three top Cloud service providers-Amazon Web Service, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Provider(GCP)-were selected. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the chosen service providers from multiple angles. There are numerous options when selecting a Cloud service provider. This review paper gives a brief overview of Amazon Web Service, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Provider(GCP) with a brief survey.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Coding Methods in Wireless Mesh Networks Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Community coding algorithms purpose to enhance the performance of wireless mesh networks by allowing nodes to mix and decode information to boost its fe eof transmission. This performance analysis of network coding algorithms makes a specialty of comparing the effect of these algorithms on a couple of overall performance factors of Wi-Fi mesh networks, such as throughput, delay, energy consumption, and packet loss. With the aid of the usage of a ramification of metrics, simulation experiments were carried out to compare the performance of several community coding algorithms in opposition to traditional routing protocols. The consequences of the experiments showed that community coding algorithms can considerably enhance the overall performance of Wi-Fi mesh networks in phrases of throughput by means of as much as 50%, put off by up to twenty%, power consumption via upto70%, and packet loss byway of as much as $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$. Moreover, the experiments additionally determined that the effectiveness of those algorithms depends on the network length and node density. In summary, this performance analysis of community coding algorithms indicates that they offer several blessings in numerous Wi-Fi mesh community eventualities, which makes them suitable for further studies and alertness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Traffic Patterns and Optimization of Routing for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cognitive radio networks (CRNs) had been developed to satisfy the demands of contemporary communiqué structures. CRNs are characterized by way of their adaptability to dynamically change their operational parameters and configurations for you to meet the converting wishes of customers. To do that, CRNs must be able to investigate the cutting-edge visitors styles to be able to optimize their routing based on the to be had resources inside the device. This paper offers a observe of visitors patterns and an optimization of routing for CRNs. We analyze the community site visitor’s styles and use the patterns alongside the network’s resource optimization methods to generate most advantageous routes on the way to maximize throughput and limit put off. Via simulations, we evaluate the overall performance of our proposed gadget and examine it to other existing routing procedures. The simulation outcomes display that our machine achieves an improvement of 7-14% in throughput. Additionally, our proposed gadget reduces the average cease-to-cease put off by way of 10-20%. These effects suggest that our proposed system is an effective technique to routing in CRNs.

articleTitle: A Smart Assistive System with Face Recognition, Emotion Detection, Age and Gender Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blindness is a person’s impairment to sight. Our sense of sight is responsible for most of the information from the five senses. We develop a prototype of our idea of a new person based on the initial meeting, taking cues from the tiny behaviors and continuously refreshing our understanding of that person. A blind person cannot perform these. For this reason, there is a need to design such a system that is capable of collecting fundamental information from the instant a new person appears and is portable for convenience of operation. The information we can extract includes but is not limited to-gender, age, and emotions at the moment of conversation. Hence, we have utilized the Haar cascade approach in conjunction with a face recognition module to detect faces using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to train models that can do age detection, gender detection, and sentiment analysis. To make it portable, we have modified our models to run on edge devices such as Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, Intel Neural Compute Stick, Nano Pi, Etc. At its core, our project is about aiding people with visual impairments. We want to make sure they can gain a deeper grasp of the people they interact with, such as knowing their age, gender, and even how they are feeling. We are using cutting-edge technology and making it run steadily. so that it is easy for them to utilize.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Machine Learning Algorithms for Cancer Prediction in Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Neural community-based, totally machine-getting-to-know algorithms provide an effective device for predicting most cancers in recommender systems. These algorithms leverage large datasets of affected persons’ medical facts to study predictive models of most cancer chances. With the aid of leveraging statistics from both retrospective and prospective research, these algorithms are able to become aware of and study patterns in the records that can be indicative of cancer chance. The usage of these algorithms and recommender structures can recommend personalized healthcare selections and interventions for most cancer prevention or early detection. Moreover, these algorithms are able to combine the danger profiles of different people to expand fashions that account for the variety of character chance profiles. Additionally, these models may be utilized to evaluate the probability of cancer occurrence in positive patient populations. In the end, these algorithms may be used to increase predictive structures, which can refine and improve cancer-associated remedies.

articleTitle: Enhanced Thermal Object Detection and Classification with MobileNetV3: A Cutting-Edge Deep Learning Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Object detection and classification have become significant areas of interest in the domains of image processing and computer vision. Their widespread adoption extends to various application domains, including face detection, autonomous vehicles, pedestrian detection, and security surveillance systems. Conventional methods such as support vector machines (SVM), Gaussian mixture models (GMM), and background subtraction have been around for a while. However, they have limitations such as object overlap and are prone to distortion caused by ambient factors including smoke, fog, and changing illumination conditions. In this research, the performance of a pre-trained deep learning model MobilNetV3 was evaluated on ground-based thermal images consisting of persons and cars through a thermal camera. The detection is not affected by smoke and poor weather conditions. The optimized thermal imaging dataset’s test and validation data were used to assess the model’s performance. Our results demonstrate consistent accuracy for both person and car classes. Notably, the model exhibits superior performance in classifying the person class, achieving a higher recall value of $\mathbf{9 8. 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: Towards Comprehensive Breast Cancer Detection: Fusion of Dense Layer Model Features
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For an early diagnosis and successful treatment, ultrasonography image analysis is essential for identifying breast cancer. In this discipline, deep learning has become a powerful tool that has demonstrated notable success in several medical imaging tasks,regarding the identification of cancer in the breast. In order to achieve accurate identification, our suggested model combines characteristics from three pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models: DenseNet201, DenseNet169, and DenseNet121. In this study, we use ImageNet weights and ultrasound image datasets to evaluate these models’ performance. After extensive testing, our model reached 94.57% accuracy, which is astounding. The model’s performance was evaluated through the use of confusion matrices and metrics such as precision & F1-score, which we determined using the Adam optimizer. The efficacy of deep learning-based techniques in identifying breast cancer from ultrasound pictures is highlighted by this study. It illustrates makes major contributions to medical analysis and helps discover breast cancers early.

articleTitle: Enabling Scalable Analog/Digital Conversion and I/O Expansion over Ethernet for Intelligent DAQ Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a scalable DAQ system using a 12-bit DAC, Op-Amp, and I/O expander connected to an ESP32 via Ethernet. Prioritizing its precision and amplified voltage control, component selection considering DAC linearity (INL, DNL) and rail-to-rail operation. Proteus simulations aided design, and hardware followed datasheets. Challenges in DAC selection highlight the importance of rigorous evaluation. This work offers a method for scalable DAQs with integrated functionalities, paving the way for intelligent applications. In conclusion, the evaluation confirms excellent DAC linearity, ensuring accurate voltage control for each digital input.

articleTitle: Lightweight Real-Time C&C Detection using Deep Learning for Zombie DNS Queries
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The effective coordination of attacks between malicious actors and compromised devices via Command and Control (C&C) communication channels presents a substantial cybersecurity threat. These channels often exploit legitimate protocols like the Domain Name System (DNS), making their detection challenging amidst regular network traffic. This paper introduces a unique approach to identifying C&C communication concealed within DNS queries in real-time. Our system employs deep learning techniques for accurate and efficient anomaly detection while conserving resources. Utilizing a pre-trained deep learning model trained on the CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020 dataset, we distinguish between legitimate DNS traffic, encrypted DNS over HTTPS (DoH) traffic, and malicious C&C communication masquerading as DNS queries. To ensure lightweight operation suitable for resource-constrained systems, we implement the entire workflow, from data capture to model inference, as a Rust binary. This methodology provides a novel combination of real-time detection for prompt response to C&C activity, lightweight operation for widespread deployment, and high accuracy leveraging deep learning capabilities. By proactively identifying and mitigating C&C communication linked to zombie DNS botnets, our proposed system shows potential for significantly bolstering network security.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Analysis and Implementation Strategies For Targeted Advertising on Diverse Social Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the current state of targeted advertising on various social media platforms using algorithmic analysis and implementing strategies. Social media plays an increasingly important role in modern marketing, especially in the wake of COVID-19, which hastened the transition to online platforms. Drawing on advances in technology, including machine learning and natural language processing (NLP), we demonstrate the value of personalized advertising in increasing user engagement and brand affinity. Drawing on recent research and case studies, we highlight the need to balance targeted advertising with user privacy. In summary, we call for innovation and ethical considerations as we navigate the ever-changing advertising landscape.

articleTitle: Analysing Switching States on the Ground Plane of a Frequency Reconfigurable Cognitive Radio Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Design and optimization of antenna for Cognitive Radio (CR) applications is proposed. The utilization of PIN diode is explored, offering switching states make it ideal for reconfigurability. It aims to address the challenges posed by the complex design systems used in CRN antennas. The design process involves the creation of antennas with different number of diodes (one with five PIN diodes, other with two PIN diodes) to achieve desired frequency response. The antenna with two PIN diodes provides return loss of -17 dB, good gain of 4.01 dB. It operates in wideband 2.8 GHz-10.3 GHz (UWB) in one state which will be used for channel sensing and operates in sub bands like $2.9 ~\mathrm{GHz}-6.1 ~\mathrm{GHz}$ (Satellite communication), $7.1 ~\mathrm{GHz}-7.7 ~\mathrm{GHz}$ (weather radar systems), 8.8 GHz -9.8 GHz (Satellite communication uplinks and downlinks, Military and defense applications for target tracking and surveillance), $7 ~\mathrm{GHz}-8.4 ~\mathrm{GHz}$ (Radar systems for air traffic control, Telecommunication), $9 ~\mathrm{GHz}-10.2 ~\mathrm{GHz}$ (radar systems used in aircraft for terrain mapping and weather detection).in the remaining states which will be used in communication, makes it suitable for cognitive radio applications.

articleTitle: Autonomous Arduino Based Solar Rechargeable Navigating Water Monitoring Boat for Taal Lake
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research introduces an autonomous water monitoring system for Taal Lake, Batangas, utilizing an Arduino-based solar-rechargeable navigating boat equipped with $\mathbf{p H}$, turbidity, and dissolved oxygen sensors. It aims to provide insights post-eruption to aid local decision-making. The study details the prototype development, programming, and comprehensive water quality testing over three months. Statistical analysis will compare boat-generated data with BFAR data. Ethical considerations and recommendations for the community and BFAR are included, with expected contributions to freshwater monitoring and future research.

articleTitle: Investigating Distributed and Cooperative Media Algorithm Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Exploring the Dynamics of allotted and Cooperative Media Algorithms, research how disbursed and cooperative media algorithms may be used to enhance media management and shipping in distributed structures. It examines the development of allotted media computing because it applies to multimedia packages and explores the optimization strategies of algorithms used in disbursed media structures, together with streaming or peer-to-peer systems. Moreover, the paper identifies and analyses key technology, consisting of network Coding, allotted source Coding, and Peer-to-Peer media streaming, which facilitate green implementation of disbursed media structures. It additionally evaluates and discusses the trade-offs of a number of those algorithms, including between aid intake and delivery performance. Eventually, the paper presents a top-level view of the latest research within the field and suggests destiny instructions for research.

articleTitle: The Future of Risk Management in Finance: An Algorithmic Approach to Portfolio Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Risk management in finance has undergone significant changes with the growing need for better portfolio optimization. This has given rise to algorithmic approaches in managing risks and optimizing portfolios. These algorithms are designed to analyze large amounts of data and make informed decisions based on statistical models and historical trends. The future of risk management in finance will heavily rely on these algorithmic approaches, as they offer a more accurate and efficient way of managing risks. These algorithms continuously monitor market conditions and adjust investment strategies accordingly, improving returns and risk management. Using artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to develop these algorithms will further enhance their effectiveness and adaptability to changing market conditions. This will enable financial institutions to better manage risks and make more informed investment decisions, improving overall portfolio performance. Integrating algorithmic approaches in risk management is a promising step toward achieving more stable and prosperous financial portfolios.

articleTitle: Improving Patch Antenna Performance Utilizing Defected Ground Structure (DGS) for Wireless Applications at Ka-Band
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Within the scope of this research, a defected ground structure (DGS) slotted microstrip antenna is presented and constructed. This antenna has the potential to be utilized in forthcoming wireless communication systems. The antenna base was constructed using Fr-4 material, which has a dielectric permittivity of 4.7, a thickness of 0.5 mm, and a loss tangent of 0.02. These characteristics were used in the fabrication process. A transmission line with $50 \Omega$ transmissions is used to supply the patch. Computer simulation technology was utilized to reproduce the antenna after it was completed. By utilizing the antenna, it is possible to achieve high data speeds while simultaneously reducing the costs of shipping and increasing the level of consumer interaction. It is possible to improve the return loss, voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR), and bandwidth of a normal rectangular patch microstrip antenna by incorporating a slot into the patch. The return loss of the antenna is precisely -76.198 dB, its VSWR is precisely 1.0003, and its bandwidth is precisely 1.769 GHz. The proposed antenna has two basic goals: the first is to improve return loss by employing a typical VSWR, and the second is to improve antenna bandwidth, ultimately making it suitable for use in wireless applications.

articleTitle: Volumetric Analysis of Soft Tissue Pathological Processes with 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using three-D magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for volumetric analysis of soft tissue pathological strategies is a promising method for the prognosis and remedy of musculoskeletal issues. This technique gives excessive decision snap shots presenting distinct records approximately the anatomy and composition of tender tissues consisting of skeletal muscle groups, tendons, and ligaments. With 3D MRI, specified tests of anatomical changes and pathologic approaches may be captured and analyzed, offering a useful tool for clinicians to identify and screen disease development. The software used for 3-D MRI volumetric analysis permits accurate size of tissue volumes, outlines of tissue systems, and parameters describing the structural composition of tissues. Those parameters permit for quantification of morphological variations between healthful and diseased tissue, in addition to the detection of adjustments in tissue architectural features over the years. Furthermore, one-of-a-kind MRI contrasts and imaging strategies consisting of diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) are used to assess the distribution and integrity of tissue fibers inside diverse tender tissues. The mixing of 3D MRI with computer-aided diagnostics (CAD) and three-D reconstruction further enhances the value of three-D MRI for clinical applications. This integration affords effective gear to resources inside the evaluation of extraordinary structures and tissue homes.

articleTitle: Investigating the Security Considerations of Interactive Communication Media Algorithms for Networking Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical abstract discusses the safety considerations of interactive verbal exchange media algorithms for network programs. The focal point is given to have a look at the algorithms used for authenticating, figuring out, and authorizing user-level sports. The research concentrates on analyzing the design goals, information float, consider fashions, and network protocols that comfy the interactive verbal exchange media algorithms to defend personal facts and interactions. In addition, important protection controls are recognized and mentioned, which include authentication, confidentiality, right of entry to manipulate integrity, availability, and non-repudiation. Lastly, the paper concludes with an evaluation of satisfactory practices for growing cosy algorithms to shield system convergence and get entry to assets over a network.

articleTitle: Prediction of Low Complexity Regions in Protein Sequences Using Integrated Features and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low Complexity Regions (LCRs) plays a significant role in the cellular mechanisms of proteins, such as evolutionary processes and the regulation of protein activity. These regions are characterized by repetitive amino acid sequences and varied subtle properties, making LCR identification a computational challenge. Traditional methods for LCR detection, while informative, are labor-intensive and lack the scalability and specificity required for rapid analysis across exponentially growing protein sequence databases. Addressing these limitations, the paper proposes a deep learning framework that utilizes a pre-trained BERT model and K-mer analysis for feature extraction, combined with a BiLSTM network, to precisely predict LCRs within protein sequences. By adapting advanced natural language processing techniques to the unique challenges of protein sequence analysis, our approach significantly outperforms other machine-learning models, as evidenced by an MCC of ${0. 2 4 5 4}$ and an AUC of 0.8627. This advancement opens new avenues for understanding protein function and pathology, offering a robust tool for the accelerated discovery of protein dynamics elucidation.

articleTitle: Prospective investigation on colorectal Cancer with SMOTE on Machine learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A person’s life expectancy is typically influenced by the foods they eat because certain foods can induce fatal illnesses like colorectal cancer (CRC). One million people died worldwide from colorectal cancer in 2020, making up 10% of all cancer-related deaths. The most prevalent cancer in human beings is colorectal cancer. Individuals are affected by CRC according to their lifestyle and dietary choices. Maintaining a healthy diet and engaging in regular physical activity will prevent nearly 50% of occurrences of colorectal cancer. To identify CRC patients, this prospective cohort study used 231 food items and their variations as input features. Before designating any food as carcinogenic for colorectal cancer, it is necessary to examine information such as the recommended daily and weekly food intake in grams. K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF) and Logistic Regression are the four classification methods that are investigated in this study using real-time datasets. The SMOTE algorithm is then used to address and locate data imbalances. In our study, consuming more than 10 grams of low-fat butter in bread in a week increases the risk of CRC. When including dairy and beef into your diet regularly, to be monitored.

Author Keywords: Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique-SMOTE, Logistic regression, Random forest

articleTitle: An Adaptive and Priority Improved Task Scheduling Model for Fog Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fog computing is a lightweight distributed environment that ensures the IoT-based service distribution. The real-time connectivity and response are the key challenges for this environment. As the environment is connected with large number of users, the task execution within timeline is the primary challenge in this environment. In this paper, an adaptive and priority-driven task scheduling method is integrated to optimize the resource allocation and execution of tasks within deadline. The focus of this model is to reduce the execution delay and failure rate in real-time. Task priority and the application adaptive challenges are the key aspects considered in this work. The functional process of this model is divided into three stages. In the first stage, requests are analyzed respective to adaptivity and priority of tasks. In second stage, the resources are shortlisted based on history performance, reliability and load. In the final stage, the rule-based task selection is performed and mapped to the available resources. The objective of the work is to minimize the makespan, failure rate, and execution delay. The model is analyzed against FCFS, SJF, LFJ, PEFT, HEFT, MOPT, and SDBATS model. The analysis results confirm and validate the reliability and effectiveness in the real environment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Brain Tumor Detection Using a Modified EfficientNet Model with MRI Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical imaging is crucial for detecting and treating brain tumors. Abnormal growth of malignant or nonmalignant brain tissue can cause significant long-term brain damage. This research paper introduces a modified EfficientNet model designed for the precise classification of brain tumors using MRI images. The EfficientNetB0 model was enhanced through architectural modifications, including layer customization and hyperparameter tuning, to optimize its performance for this specific task. Data augmentation techniques were employed to increase the diversity of the training dataset, and regularization methods such as dropout layers were applied to prevent overfitting. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model, which achieved a remarkable 98.47% accuracy in detecting brain tumors, surpassing existing CNN models. These findings highlight the potential of the modified EfficientNet model as a valuable tool for healthcare professionals, enabling prompt and accurate diagnosis of brain tumors and thereby facilitating timely treatment interventions.

articleTitle: Optimal Node Deployment and Coverage in Next Generation Wireless Sensor Networks Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sensor nodes deployment is very critical in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) to cover a set of predetermined locations called “targets” in the region of interest (ROI), and to enhance the coverage area, optimal position of sensor nodes in ROI is essential. The aim of sensor nodes deployment and coverage in WSNs is to compute sensor node’s locations in the given network terrain such that they effectively detect the events as well as maximize the network lifetime. Battery depletion at sensor nodes creates coverage holes in ROI and it mitigates the network coverage. The objective of this paper is to define optimal locations of sensor nodes prior to their deployment and enhance the coverage area in the given geographical location using an improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm. The experimental results showed superior coverage and faster convergence rate with the IPSO algorithm-than random deployments and grid-based deployments of sensor nodes.

articleTitle: Link Tone Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The topic of this essay is remotely operating household appliances from any location in the globe. This makes it easier for those with physical disabilities to use their phones to control household equipment. There’s a chance that you might occasionally forget to turn off your home appliances, wasting electricity. Therefore, To address the above described problem, dual tone multiple frequency controlled home automation is the solution. The DTMF-based automation is run by the mobile signals. The DTMF approach may be used to link the DTMF decoder to the relay that is controlled by the mobile phone by making a call to the other phone that is connected to the decoder.As a result, mobile phones and DTMF decoder output allow for the control of household appliances without the need for microcontrollers. The seamless combination of mobile phones, relay controlled appliances, and DTMF technology is a state of the art solution that enables people all over the world to effectively manage their homes while also encouraging accessibility and energy conservation.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Diagnosing Diabetic Retinopathy in Retinal Fundus Images using an Adaptive Canny Edge Detection approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Individuals diagnosed with diabetes are susceptible to developing diabetic retinopathy (DR), a degenerative eye condition that affects the retina. When blood vessels in the retina get damaged, it can cause permanent vision impairment or even blindness if the underlying condition is not addressed quickly enough. Early diagnosis and treatment of this disease can save a patient’s eyesight and prevent blindness. Successful medications for DR are available, but people with diabetes need to be identified and monitored early on. In order to diagnose diabetic retinopathy, many physical examinations have to be conducted; however, these types of exams require more time to complete. Adaptive Canny Edge Detection Training using Adaptive Skipping technique (ACEDIAS) is used in this research to speed up the detection process of diabetic retinopathy by detecting the edge and boost diagnostic accuracy. The study team chooses to use a 2063image dataset compressed from Kaggle’s library. The suggested ACEDIAS model is evaluated for its performance using the measures such as accuracy, recall, precision, and F1score. It has been demonstrated through simulation that the suggested ACEDIAS model outperforms the existing models.

articleTitle: Image Denoising using Multiscale Transforms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A crucial step in multimedia processing is image and video denoising, which aims to eliminate undesirable noise while keeping significant image properties. This research investigates the use of four distinct multiscale transforms for picture denoising: ridgelets, shearlets, curvelets, and wavelets. To capturing and displaying visual structures at different scales and orientations, each transform offers special features. Through studies on artificial and real-world noisy images, examine each method’s denoising performance and compare its capacity to reduce noise while maintaining image information. The outcomes demonstrate the advantages and disadvantages of each strategy and shed light on how well they work with various kinds of noise and image content. This study investigates the effects of four different multiscale transforms (ridgelets, shearlets, curvelets, and wavelets) on the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) in addition to examining their denoising capabilities. SNR values are important measurements for assessing how well denoising works since they offer measurable information on how to strike a balance between noise reduction and detail preservation in the image. Through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world noisy photos, this study evaluates the effectiveness of every denoising technique over a range of noise kinds and image contents. The abstract also emphasizes the distinct qualities that every multiscale transform offers in terms of capturing and expressing visual structures at different scales and orientations. By means of a thorough examination, the research reveals the benefits and drawbacks of every technique, providing significant understanding regarding their appropriateness for various denoising situations.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Integrate the Sensor Technologies for Enhancing the Compressive Strength of Bricks in Mixing Process
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The bricks manufacturing industry relies heavily on manual labor for the mixing of raw materials, leading to challenges such as inconsistent quality and wastage of resources due to irrelevant ratios. To address these issues, automation is proposed in the form of integrating load cells and an automatic water pump into the pan mixer system. Load cells enable precise monitoring of material weights throughout the mixing process, ensuring accurate ratios and consistent quality of the final product. Additionally, the automatic water pump facilitates consistent water addition, further enhancing the uniformity of the mixture. By leveraging these automated solutions, the bricks manufacturing industry can improve efficiency, reduce resource wastage, and achieve higher levels of product quality and consistency.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Radar Signal Processing Techniques for Target Detection and Range Estimation Using MATLAB

abstract: This research introduces a MATLAB-based simulation framework tailored for the analysis and optimization of monostatic radar systems. Through meticulous modeling of signal generation, propagation, target interaction, and signal processing, our framework provides a comprehensive platform for radar system exploration. With a focus on parameter optimization, including pulse width, pulse repetition frequency (PRF), and target radar cross-section (RCS), our simulation framework enables in-depth analysis of system performance metrics such as detection probability, false alarm rate, and range resolution. Through rigorous examination of simulation results, valuable insights into the influence of different parameters on radar system behavior are uncovered, facilitating informed system design decisions. Our research contributes to advancing the understanding of monostatic radar behavior and offers practical insights for radar system design and optimization. Future work will extend the framework to incorporate advanced signal processing techniques and address real-world deployment challenges, further enhancing its utility in radar system development and optimization endeavors.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Atherosclerosis in the coronary arteries is the cause of heart disease (CAD), which is a consequence of coronary disappointment and blood vessel failure. To establish that CAD is present, a procedure known as angiography is used. It is invasive, expensive, time-consuming, and remarkably accurate. Thus, experts are advised to employ alternative techniques, such as artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms that can analyze cardiac illness and evaluate its veracity using non-nosy clinical data. In this work, we provide a novel cream strategy for CAD end employing K-Means clustering algorithms and relationship-based correlation-based feature subset (CFS) selection with particle swarm optimization (PSO) search method. CAD examples are shown using supervised learning methods such as fuzzy unordered rule induction algorithm (FURIA), multinomial logistic regression (MLR), multi-layer perceptron (MLP), and C4.5. Our approach was assessed using clinical data (consisting of 335 incidents and 26 characteristics) from the Department of Cardiology at the Indira Gandhi Medical College in Shimla, India.

articleTitle: Non-proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy(NPDR) using Deep learning approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy (NPDR), a frequent eye problem in diabetics, can result in vision loss. For prompt treatment and prevention, early detection is essential. Promising outcomes in NPDR detection have been observed in recent breakthroughs in computer vision and deep learning systems. In order to detect NPDR utilizing retinal fundus pictures, a unique deep learning-based approach is proposed in this study. The approach employs a fully connected layer for classification and a pre-trained convolutional-neural-network for extraction of feature. The algorithm performs better than state-of-the-art techniques by accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, and under the (ROC) receiver operating characteristic curve, according to experiments conducted on a publicly accessible dataset.

articleTitle: Dielectric Resonator based Four-Port MIMO Antenna with Polarization and Pattern Diversity Characteristics

abstract: The article discusses a MIMO system featuring a four-port cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna (CDRA) with bidirectional pattern diversity for wireless communications. The generation of orthogonal modes and diverse (bidirectional) radiation patterns of the antenna provides high isolation, leading to improved MIMO antenna performance. All the MIMO parameters are within acceptable limits. The proposed antenna is helpful for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Communication.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Fetal Brain Ventricle Segmentation and Size Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical diagnostics with the segmentation and analysis of fetal brain ventricles assumes paramount importance in the prediction and management of neurological disorders. This paper focus on the segmentation and analysis of fetal brain ventricles using four deep-learning models: U-Net, VNet, ResNet, and DeepMedic, on the Feta 2022 dataset of T2weighted MRI scans. Saliency maps were used to visualize key areas in the decision-making processes for these models, which helped clinicians verify the AI output to ensure that it focused on the relevant anatomical features. The results showed very distinct strengths and trade-offs among the models, where ResNet and V-Net generally provided the best segmentation accuracy. This work not only enhances the fetal brain imaging analysis through the integration of and underlines their potential to improve diagnostic workflows for the early detection of fetal brain abnormalities.

articleTitle: Evaluating uniXcoder Embeddings for Automated Grading: A Study Across Varied Code Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automated grading systems play a pivotal role in modern educational settings, offering efficiency and scalability in assessing student submissions. In this study, we investigate the potential of uniXcoder embeddings of C language codes. A comparative analysis across four scenarios: code-only, codequestion, code-question-comment, and code-question-comment-reference is conducted. The dataset deals with C programs that are evaluated by Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This study explores the analysis of code embeddings using K-Means approach and to determine the influence of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and scaling techniques. The study compares clustering outcomes with and without PCA, with and without scaling techniques looking at measures including silhouette score, Davies-Bouldin index, Kullback-Leibler divergence and visualization techniques to draw conclusions. The findings suggest that uniXcoder embeddings demonstrate that “code-question-comment-reference” scenario is best suited for automated grading tasks. It also looks into the ability of the embedding to capture the level of error present in the code. This research contributes to the advancement of automated grading systems by providing insights into the suitability of uniXcoder embeddings for assessing student code submissions in educational environments.

articleTitle: Simplifying Digital Streaming: An Innovative Cross-Platform Streaming Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our research aims to investigate how reinforcement learning methods can be applied to develop a movie recommendation system. We frame the issue of interactive recommendation as a contextual multi-armed bandit, where the system learns user preferences by suggesting new movies and receiving feedback. Through reinforcement learning, we address challenges such as balancing exploitation and exploration and tackling the coldstart problem. Additionally, we incorporate the novelty factor of movies into our model. We evaluate both content-based and collaborative filtering approaches which achieved accuracy 72.33(%), both of which demonstrate effective recommendation outcomes.

articleTitle: Mobi-Effb0: Dual convolutional neural network fusion approach for automated diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Detecting Alzheimer’s disease presents a formidable challenge for neurologists due to the time-intensive and sometimes imprecise manual diagnostic procedures. Given the profound impact of Alzheimer’s on the brain, adopting a classification framework based on brain imagery could offer more accurate diagnostic outcomes. Deep Learning has gained popularity for its ability to analyze unstructured data and identify intricate patterns for sophisticated decision-making. We propose a fusion model aimed at classifying Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) utilizing sagittal MR images sourced from the ADNI dataset. Our model showcases commendable performance, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 92%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Deepfake Detection: Leveraging Deep Models for Video Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research endeavors to revolutionize deepfake detection by achieving unparalleled accuracy with a modest dataset. Leveraging CNN-based feature extractors and either CNN or MLP as high-level architectures, the methodology prioritizes precision in discerning authentic from fabricated content. Remarkably, both the InceptionV3 and InceptionResNetV2 models, employing Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) as their highlevel architecture, demonstrate outstanding accuracy rates, of $\mathbf{84.6\%}$. Moreover, the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) for InceptionResNetV2 stands at an exceptional 0.99, while for NasNetLarge, it reaches $\mathbf{0. 9 8}$. Additionally, the MLP InceptionResNetV2 model demonstrated exceptional performance with 12 True Negatives (TN) and only 1 False Negative (FN). These findings underscore the efficacy of the proposed approach in combating the proliferation of deceptive media content.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effects of Power System Harmonics on EMC in Industrial Environments

The important outcome of this research is anticipated to offer deeper perception into the have an impact on of power machine harmonics on EMC in industrial environments and perceive capability manipulate strategies to reduce the associated dangers.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Patient Centric Medical Records Sharing With Privacy Preservation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Individual health records (IHRs) hold paramount significance for individuals, serving as vital tools for the management and oversight of their medical data. Through electronic platforms, IHRs empower patients by granting them authority over their health information, thereby revolutionizing the conventional dynamics of the healthcare provider-patient relationship. Nonetheless, existing systems for managing IHRs face obstacles in providing patients with dependable, trackable, and secure control over their medical records, potentially compromising their authenticity and precision. Furthermore, the prevalent centralized methods of IHR management hinder the seamless exchange of medical data and introduce the risk of a singular point of failure.To address these challenges, a proposal is presented to utilize Ethereum blockchain-based smart contracts, providing patients with decentralized, immutable, and transparent management of their medical data. This solution also incorporate the decentralized storage feature of interplanetary file systems (IPFS). These integrated components collaborate effectively to securely access, store, and exchange patients’ medical information, with the overarching goal of enhancing the integrity and security of patient-controlled health records.

articleTitle: Investigation and analysis of 2D perovskite material for Solar cell application
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research explores the potential of a new lead-based 2D perovskite material, $\left((4 \mathrm{~F}-\mathrm{PEA})_{2}\left(\mathrm{FA}_{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{MA}_{1-x}\right)_{4} \mathrm{~Pb}_{5} \mathrm{I}_{16}\right)$, for use as an absorber layer in perovskite solar cells. The advantages of 2D perovskites, such as enhanced stability, flexibility, and ease of processing, make them an attractive option for photovoltaic applications. Our simulations demonstrated a high efficiency of 23%, indicating that this perovskite composition has significant potential for improving solar cell performance. The results underscore the material’s excellent optoelectronic properties and ability to tolerate defects, suggesting it can play a crucial role in developing high-efficiency, next-generation solar cells. This study emphasizes the importance of fine-tuning material properties to achieve optimal solar cell efficiency and supports further experimental efforts to validate and apply this promising perovskite material in practical solar energy solutions.

articleTitle: Applying Image-Based Modeling Techniques to Extract Geometric Features

This kind of modeling is likewise useful for 3D reconstruction, which includes in medical imaging, satellite imagery, commercial robotics, 3-d printing, and other packages. articleTitle: Study of K-string Hydraulic Manifold for Optimal Control and Efficiency on Fluid Powered Vehicle

abstract: In a world where the pursuit of sustainability and environmental consciousness has taken center stage, the search for cleaner and more efficient means of transportation has never been more critical. This study uses principles of fluid power, its historical context, applications for vehicles, potential for environmental sustainability, integration with renewable energy sources, and practical applications in daily transportation. Through this holistic examination, we aim to shed light on how fluid power can steer us toward a cleaner, more sustainable future on the roads ahead with the design of a vehicle that is fully powered by hydraulic fluid. To comprehend the complexity of fluid power-driven vehicles, we use hydraulic manifold for reduced weight and size but with consequent compromised pressure drop in the system. To counteract it a Computational Fluid Dynamics analysis is carried out to predict pressure losses. For alleviating uncalculated pressure drops and to bypass the need for additional components the K-string factors in to optimize control and efficiency. The modified control systems and feedback mechanisms ensure that the system operates safely and efficiently, with the pressure relief valve and accumulator providing safeguards and performance enhancements as needed. The hydraulic fluid circulates, and the cycle continues to provide the necessary power for vehicle movement. The entire assembly is then mounted on a bicycle and tested for optimal performance. The experimental setup uses a bike prototype with bidirectional motor, pump, and hosing to withstand a 3000-psi pressure, with a pre-charged accumulator. The vehicle is then tested for improvement in regenerative power, endurance, and efficiency and results are recorded for evaluation.

articleTitle: Enhanced Fish Species Identification Using Transfer Learning on Balanced Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study aimed to enhance the accuracy and reliability of automatic fish detection and species classification from aquatic images and videos. Traditional manual methods are time-consuming, and existing automatic systems struggle with challenges such as environmental lighting fluctuations, fish camouflage, dynamic backgrounds, murky water, low resolution, shape distortions, and subtle differences between species. To address these issues, the proposed model leveraged the MobileNet V2 architecture for transfer learning and fine-tuned it by incorporating edge detection, texture detection, and shape detection techniques. The integration of these transfer learning methods was critical in achieving the study’s objective. Through meticulous preprocessing, balancing the dataset, and effectively applying transfer learning, the model achieved an impressive accuracy of 99.83%. This high accuracy underscores the model’s effectiveness and reduced reliance on high-quality images typically required by other detection models. The results indicate significant progress in automated fish detection and species classification, offering a promising tool for marine scientists and conservationists to monitor fish populations more efficiently.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Multicast Protocols over ATM Networks

The paper investigated mechanisms, multicast, and point-to-point (P2P) and in comparison their overall performance in phrases of throughput, total delay, and packet loss charge when beneath various community conditions. It turned into located that multicast had benefits in terms of total throughput and postpone while compared to P2P in phrases of cost of bandwidth for larger variety of receivers. Further, the multicast method had a lower packet loss charge than P2P in all situations. This paper concluded that no matter the complexity related multicast, because of its inherent blessings, is taken into consideration a better answer for multimedia programs that require a large number of receivers. Average, its miles counseled that multicast is the era of desire over ATM networks when the number of receivers growth.

articleTitle: Road Helmet Detection with YOLOv3: Ensuring Rider Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work addresses the significant issue of safety helmet recognition in industrial settings using deep learning models, with a focus on YOLOv3 architecture. Since it takes a lot of resources, it is challenging to verify helmet compliance in real time, even with CCTV cameras. Several object identification models are assessed using numerous benchmark datasets, including SSD, RCNN, YOLOv3, YOLOv4, and YOLOv5. A novel method called FD-YOLOv3 M combines YOLOv3 with a fuzzy-based photo enhancement module. It expands on YOLOv3’s success. The performance of the model is enhanced by this fusion, particularly in identifying safety helmets in noisy CCTV footage and distinguishing them from other kinds of headgear. The results of the study show the benefit of the FD-YOLOv3 model above its prior versions and show that it may be applied in practical industrial settings. The study’s findings demonstrate how useful YOLOv3-based models are for automatic number plate and helmet recognition in industrial environments. By offering a stable and cost-effective solution, these models significantly contribute to guaranteeing worker safety through the early and accurate identification of safety equipment.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of 32-Bit Parallel LMS Adaptive Beamforming Architecture using Two 8-Bit Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research project analyses a hardware pipelined reduced complexity parallel least mean square (RC-pLMS) implementation for adaptive beamforming. Our proposed RCpLMS algorithm (DRC-pLMS) will utilise a pipelined hardware architecture because to this approach alongside the delay and sum relaxation approach. At the end, this work was translated into Verilog HDL, produced on a Xilinx Vertex-5 FPGA, and all the parameters related to area, delay, and power were compared.

articleTitle: Leveraging Distributed Quantum Computing for Effective Optimization Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Disbursed quantum computing (DQC) is a singular computational paradigm for optimizing complicated optimization problems. It takes advantage of the velocity and c of disbursed computing by combining quantum algorithms with clever use of disbursed computing sources. It affords a novel method for fixing state-of-the-art optimization issues, which are commonly hard to version or remedy with a single laptop. DQC offers the capacity to offer a more efficient and sturdy manner of handling optimization issues in a spread of domain names, which includes finance, logistics, engineering, and machine studying. In DQC, some algorithms exist that incorporate quantum computing techniques for answer discovery (i.e., quantum annealing, variational quantum Eigen solver, and many others.). Quantum computing-based total optimization solves complex problems that are regularly too difficult or too computationally luxurious for an unmarried computer.
