publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emergence of 5G mobile technology facilitates human and non-human communications at different quality of service demands such as industrial/logistics, human and forest rescue, and remote driving/flying services. These services and qualities can be assisted and made more efficient by means of the 5G private campus networks, since the 5G networks can be customized to fit the business needs of stakeholders. Despite the benefits of private 5 G networks, the complexity of bringing them into practice is not trivial as the stakeholders and vertical industries have no experience in the deployment. In telecom industry, cellular network deployment is undertaken by public network operators. Therefore, this paper bridges the gap between vertical industries and 5G campus networks providing technical advice. This work aims to widely spread the literacy about campus networks installation, configuration and customization for use cases such as remote driving and flying. In this work, we reveal technical aspects for realizing 5G campus network starting from the choice of hardware kit, over radio planning until the installation, and testing. We show a live example for conceptualizing the network infrastructure, choosing a suitable propagation model for the radio planning, considering antenna radiation pattern and other radio parameters in the radio planning. We also validate the network modelling with field trials.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Solutions for Real-World Traffic Sign Recognition: A Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study addresses the optimization of deep learning and transfer learning models for Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) under diverse environmental conditions and class imbalances. Traffic Sign Recognition Database (TSRD) is used in this research study. Despite the widespread application of transfer learning in various domains, its implementation in TSR has been relatively unexplored. This research evaluates the efficacy of transfer learning in TSR using three neural network architectures: ResNet-18, ResNet34, and VGG-19. The study’s findings reveal that ResNet-18 outperforms others, achieving an accuracy of $88.47 \%$, precision of $85.20 \%$, and recall of $80.55 \%$, while requiring only 254.136 seconds for training on the A100 GPUs. ResNet-34 also demonstrates considerable efficiency with an accuracy of $87.47 \%$, but at a longer training duration of 372.95286 seconds. In contrast, VGG-19 shows limited suitability for TSR tasks, with a much lower accuracy of $5.32 \%$ and the longest training time of 1256.9595 seconds. The results underscore the potential of ResNet-18 and ResNet-34 in TSR applications, highlighting the need for a balanced approach towards accuracy, computational efficiency, and robustness in varying conditions. These insights are significant for advancements in autonomous navigation systems and enhancingroad safety.

articleTitle: Malaria Cell Image Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study we are going to have the deep learning system doing the classifying work for blood slides of cells either infected with malaria or not infected. The foundation of our method involves reflection on the data before processing to enhance quality of images and also in identification of the target cells through extraction of specific features. A model that is fine-tuned to classify blood smears through images with malaria or without is the basis for the early detection. The possibility of this revolutionizes the diagnostics is incredible, especially in conditions of scarcity. With the use of these technologies, we can be able to turn the diagnosis from long and error-prone diagnostic procedures to faster and precise ones. Such improvement will boost the whole malaria control and the managing health sector. We have developed an approach the goal of which is to be open to innovations with a possibility to update variables to the different settings of health care. With the aim to increase its scalability and useability, we develop an AI- powered deep learning-based diagnosis to popularize its among people. Furthermore, we are still working to make our models much stronger and immune to any forms of errors, thus becoming significant assets in the anti-malaria campaign.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Semantic Segmentation Using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Experts in remote sensing have focused a lot of effort on the extraction of geographical objects from high-resolution aerial data using supervised semantic segmentation and deep neural networks. Unfortunately, the extraction procedure frequently produces imperfect results because of the complex structure of geographical information, sensing resolution constraints, and scene occlusions. In this study, we propose the integration of a generative model to post-process deep neural network segmentation outputs. To achieve higher computational efficiency, we specifically use a conditional Generative Adversarial Network that is based on Pix2pix. When paired with basic pre-processing methods like edge-preserving filtering, our suggested strategy shows significant improvements in road network segmentation over current approaches. Trial assessments carried out on the Massachusetts road image dataset provide encouraging outcomes, as the suggested method attains an precission of $81.9 \%$ and recall of $69.3 \%$. These findings translate into an F1-score of $91.2 \%$, and a Intersection over Union (IOU) of $57.4 \%$. Comparative studies show that our GAN-based framework outperforms conventional CNN-based methods, especially when it comes to edge information preservation.

articleTitle: Synergical Model for Proactive Intrusion Detection System in Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In Software Defined Networking (SDN), the Intrusion Detection System (IDS) dynamically analyzes network traffic and detects the presence of suspicious activities or potential security breaches. Leveraging SDN’s centralized control and programmability, the IDS can promptly respond to threats by enforcing security policies and reconfiguring network elements as needed. In the SDN framework, the IDS employs Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to examine network traffic patterns and detect anomalies that could signal potential security breaches. Through continuous real-time monitoring and analysis, the system automatically alerts administrators to suspicious behavior, thereby improving overall network security. Integrating real-time SDN data collection with the InSDN dataset enables the creation of a pseudo-labeled dataset, facilitating semi-supervised learning approaches for improved network intrusion detection. This novel approach leverages both real-time observations and historical data to improve the precision and adaptability of IDSs in dynamic network environments. The primary emphasis of this research work lies in binary-level classification, with multi-label classification being beyond its scope. The novelty resides in devising a model adept at handling both static and dynamic datasets seamlessly. Through the fusion of quadratic discriminator analysis and autoencoder techniques, the proposed system achieves an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 5 \%}$ in classification tasks. This outcome underscores the efficacy of employing discriminative and generative approaches for robust data analysis.

articleTitle: Exploring the Integration of Reinforcement Learning for Enhancing Game Performance: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reinforcement learning, a subset of machine learning, encompasses the process by which an agent learns through trial-and-error feedback to anticipate its subsequent actions. Its versatility extends across various domains, with gaming being a prominent application. Success in gaming often pivots on the formulation of effective strategies, a task that necessitates repetitive game play, consuming valuable time, energy, and resources. This study aims tointegrate a reinforcement learning agent into gaming scenarios, replicating game dynamics and progressively refining outcomes with each iteration. By mimicking the agent’s performance, human players can augment their likelihood of success. This document highlights the utilization of reinforcement learning techniques, focusing on the application of Value-based methods (Q-learning, Deep Q Network (DQN)), and Model-based methods(State-Action-Reward-State-Action (SARSA)). Q-learning from Value-based methodis designed as an off-policy algorithm, whereas SARSA from Model-based methods functions as anon-policyalgorithm.The outcomes presented encompass insights from previous research on Q-learning and SARSA across diverse test fields or settings. Furthermore, the proposed reinforcement learning methodologies address key facets such as data comprehension, problem categorization, algorithm identification, and algorithm implementation.

articleTitle: Advancements in Graph-Based Machine Learning for Electronic Health Record Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed significant progress in applying graph-based machine learning techniques to analyze Electronic Health Record (EHR) data. These methods leverage the interconnected nature of EHR data to extract valuable insights and make predictions at various levels. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in graph-based machine learning approaches for EHR analysis. Specifically, we examine eight models from the literature, comparing their performance on the eICU-CRD dataset. These models encompass a range of techniques, including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM), self-attention mechanisms, and reinforcement learning. Additionally, we introduce a novel algorithm designed to address specific challenges posed by EHR data, such as class imbalance and erroneous entries. Our comparative analysis demonstrates the proposed algorithm’s effectiveness relative to existing models, highlighting significant improvements in predicting in-hospital mortality. Furthermore, we outline future research directions, including synthesizing existing approaches to develop more generalizable frameworks for EHR diagnosis tasks. This survey provides insights into state-of-the-art methods and potential avenues for advancing graph-based machine learning in EHR analysis.

articleTitle: Money Laundering Detection in Banking Transactions using RNNs and Hybrid Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The financial sector has witnessed significant transformations due to the emergence of financial technology (FinTech), transitioning from traditional paperbased processes to a dynamic digital ecosystem. Despite the industry’s advancements driven by FinTech innovations, concerns persist, particularly regarding financial fraud, notably money laundering. Perpetrators exploit modern technologies to launder illicitly obtained funds, posing a global threat to economies. Effective detection mechanisms for money laundering are crucial. This paper introduces a novel approach utilizing a recurrent neural network (RNN) for detecting money laundering in banking transactions. The proposed framework exercises standalone RNN models such as LSTM, GRU, BiLSTM, and stacked RNN models for the detection. Additionally, the effectiveness of hybrid ensemble models combining RNNs with XGBoosts is investigated. The evaluation achieves standard performance metrics, with the stacked RNN model achieving 92% accuracy. Surpassing it, the ensemble model achieves an impressive 95%. These results underscore the superiority of hybrid ensemble models over standalone RNNs, particularly in accurately detecting money laundering activities.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Flow Optimization with IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traffic signal optimization is crucial for the effective traffic management within cities with the primary goals being the reduction of bottleneck occurrences, avoidance of the extension of travelling time, and improvement of overall city street network function. Historically used approaches can hardly be adjusted to fluctuating traffic situation. Hence, a new methodology involving the use of machine learning-based traffic signal control with the assistance of the IR (Infrared) /UV (Ultraviolet) sensors for traffic flow sensing in real-time environment is introduced in this study. The UV sensors make congestion distance measurements in real time which are assisted by IR sensors for traffic information acquisition. Historic data with data gathered from the traffic sensors are used to train the machine learning model to predict traffic. The strategy employs the use of heuristic search methodologies in the determination of signal timings with reference to congestion information that has been forecasted as well as congestion information that is being experienced. This paper discusses the fact that machine learning-based approaches, supported by sensor technology, can be used for effective traffic management systems that modify with the help of data. The success of this traffic management system is proved by its ability to minimize the MSE (Mean Squared Error) of congestion predictions to an average of 0.69.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security in Internet of Vehicular Things (IoVT) through Blockchain-based Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the current situation, it has been confirmed that VANET, which is used to communicate between vehicles, has more capacity than MANET, which refers to conventional mobile ad-hoc networking. Therefore, the ongoing development of VANETs is the fundament for enhancing the performance of traffic management systems, reducing crashes, upgrading road safety, and wisely handling emergency cases. Modern cars are composed of various new instruments that gather millions of information about features, fuel needs, and, eventually, destinations and have become the core of the global car-sharing application. Through these wide storage units, sudden changes in plans by travelers and the need to go online for immediate preparations to travel are helped, which is the basic principle of ambient intelligence stipulated under the Internet of Things (IoT) architecture. When there is an emergency, time is crucial. For this reason, the first important step to identifying the nearest emergency facility is to conduct a rapid examination of vehicle reports. By implementing the machine learning approach that places a high focus on the anonymity of users, this paper introduces a new method of predicting vehicles’ positions based on enormous data sets. Finally, the experiment has been proven to be the most effective technique for exact vehicle position forecasting and data protection. The results clearly showed that the modeling accuracy was immensely enhanced by the prediction, which introduced a marked $12.2 \%$ improvement when compared with the previous models. Consequently, the data was calculated within $40 \%$ less time by applying the federated learning method and edge computing. Furthermore, blockchain ensures data protection and integrity, reducing the number of security vulnerabilities and attacks cases to less than $\mathbf{2 0 \%,}$ making the system safer against future cyber attacks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Digital Currency Pricing with Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Machine learning has emerged at the forefront of technological innovation with vast potential to transform and disrupt various industries and landscapes, particularly digital pricing and cryptocurrency. This paper has examined the futuristic impacts of machine learning on these landscapes, focusing on dynamic pricing strategy, personalized pricing, fraud detection, market analysis, algorithmic trading, risk mitigation, and regulation compliance. ML improves the dataset’s efficiency and data processing rate. This advanced technology helps companies develop better pricing plans, detect fraud and theft, predict market trends, automate trading strategies, develop risk management, and assist with other compliance regulations. Ultimately, this work has uncovered the various opportunities and challenges of the implications of ML on digital pricing and cryptocurrency landscapes.

articleTitle: Personality Based Text Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rise of chatbots in applications like customer service and companionship highlights the need for personalized experiences. Current limitations often cause user frustration and disengagement. This work proposes a novel approach to enhance chatbot interactions by dynamically adapting text generation to the user’s personality using the Big Five personality traits (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extroversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism). The proposed approach involves multiple stages, starting with data acquisition and preprocessing. A large text dataset annotated for the Big Five traits forms the foundation for training a personality analysis model. Neural network models such as GPT-3, CTRL, and GPT-Neo 2.7B are evaluated for personality-based text generation. Among these, GPT-Neo 2.7B shows the best performance, with a BLEU score of 0.65, in capturing personality nuances. Evaluating the system’s effectiveness involves human assessment of the generated text to ensure accurate translation of personality indicators into appropriate communication styles. Additionally, user studies will measure satisfaction and engagement during interactions with the chatbot. The primary goal is to develop a functional chatbot prototype that personalizes responses based on the user’s personality, leading to improved engagement and satisfaction, thereby significantly advancing the field of human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Reputation-based Resource Allocation Prioritization in 6G: A Coalitional Game Theoretic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Exploiting the 0.1-10 THz spectrum range in sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks promises significant advancements; however, it presents challenges in resource allocation (RA) and security to meet diverse user demands. This paper introduces a novel approach integrating blockchain technology (BCT) and deep learning (DL) for small base station (SBS) coalition formation (CF) and RA. We address critical challenges in dynamic RA and CF, presenting a comprehensive framework grounded in both theoretical and simulation-based analyses. By leveraging BCT, secure retrieval of reputation data is ensured, thereby establishing trust within the network. Our proposed algorithm dynamically optimizes the reputation-to-demand (R/D) ratios, prioritizing SBSs with higher R/D ratios for RA, thus enhancing network efficiency. Further, notable improvements in network performance metrics, validated through extensive simulations and theoretical calculations. The adaptability of the algorithm allows SBSs to enhance their reputation via increased upload capacity and coalition participation. Utilizing Shapley values and network monitoring, the algorithm optimizes CF and the operational status of SBSs. The stability and reliability of the network are assured through Nash equilibrium checks and reputation integrity verification. This comprehensive implementation illustrates that our proposed methodology offers an efficient solution to dynamic wireless challenges, optimizing RA and CF in evolving environments. The integration of DL and BCT provides a robust framework for efficient wireless network management. Our simulations lay a strong foundation for future research in 6G network optimization, emphasizing the proposed solutions’ practical applicability, scalability, and resilience. Key innovations include dynamic R/D ratio optimization, blockchain-based secure reputation data retrieval, adaptable reputation improvement algorithms, efficient coalition formation using Shapley values, Nash equilibrium checks, and adaptive RA mechanisms.

articleTitle: ECG based Heart Disease Detection: Current State and Technological Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores the fusion of deep learning, IoT, and state-of-the-art algorithms to enhance heart rate detection and analysis, crucial for addressing the global surge in cardiovascular diseases through early and precise detection for better preventive healthcare outcomes. It offers a comprehensive review of recent advancements and methods, highlighting the integration of computational and technological progress in improving cardiac health monitoring. The paper identifies and discusses significant research gaps such as the interpretability of deep learning models, the computational intensity of algorithms, and the need for diverse datasets for effective model training, along with challenges in integrating IoT for efficient, real-time cardiac monitoring. Emphasizing the importance of adaptive feature selection, and the utilization of machine and deep learning models for ECG signal analysis, it also points to innovative strategies like transfer learning for boosting detection accuracy. Stressing the need for cross-disciplinary efforts to close these research gaps, this study advocates for the development of more interpretable, efficient, and widely applicable heart rate detection systems, contributing to advanced cardiac health monitoring and fostering proactive, personalized healthcare to combat cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Bitcoin Price Prediction Models: LSTM, BiLSTM, ARIMA and Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proposed work explores the significance of Bitcoin in today’s financial landscape and its role as a decentralized store of value and hedge against economic uncertainty. The diverse forecasts for Bitcoin prices are proposed and the importance of accurate prediction models. Specifically, it emphasizes the effectiveness of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) models in capturing the complex dynamics of cryptocurrency markets, offering insights for traders, investors, and researchers. The growing importance of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is highlighted by analyzing historical market data and forecasting future price movements. The proposed work concludes by underscoring the evolution of Bitcoin price prediction methodologies from traditional models like ARIMA to advanced techniques like Bi-LSTM, and Auto-regressive EncoderDecoder Transformer, enhancing financial security and decision-making in the cryptocurrency market. The Bi-LSTM worked by providing a 0.9832 R2 score.

articleTitle: The Study of Securing Big Data Networks of Business Education Organizational
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern day, the incorporation of big data into business education organizations has brought about a revolution in the decision-making processes as well as the operational efficiencies. On the other hand, the development of big data networks has simultaneously increased the vulnerability to cyber threats, which calls for the implementation of comprehensive security frameworks. The purpose of this study is to investigate the essential ways in which business education organizations may ensure the safety of their big data networks. In doing so, it detects prevalent security concerns that pose a danger to the availability, integrity, and confidentiality of big data. These challenges include data breaches, illegal access, and cyberattacks. Through the utilization of a multi-layered security strategy, the research investigates the utilization of advanced encryption methods, access control mechanisms, and real-time threat detection systems as essential tactics for the purpose of strengthening large data networks. Furthermore, it highlights the need of creating comprehensive cybersecurity policies and conducting frequent security audits in order to maintain a data environment that is resilient. For the purpose of elucidating best practices and new solutions for protecting big data infrastructures in business education settings, this research conducts a thorough review of the current literature and case studies. The findings are intended to serve as a guide for educational institutions to improve their cybersecurity posture. This will ensure the safe management and usage of massive data resources while simultaneously fostering an atmosphere that is favorable to learning and development..

articleTitle: Cloud Computing and Simulation Paradigms: A Technical Exploration and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing has arisen as a transformative force in current information technology, revolutionizing the way businesses and individuals access, store, and manage data and applications. Its dynamic scalability, cost-efficiency, and on-demand resource provisioning have changed traditional computing paradigms. Nevertheless, the complexity of cloud-based systems shows challenges in testing, evaluation, and development.Cloud simulators have emerged as essential tools for researchers and developers to simulate and examine cloud environments in a managed and cost-effective way. This paper provides a detailed duscussion of cloud computing and its connection with simulation technologies. This research discusses the background technologies and delves into the domain of cloud simulators, classifying them into various types and exploring their features and abilities.

articleTitle: Navigation Assistance for Visually Impaired People using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Navigational aids for visually impaired individuals have seen remarkable advancements owing to the integration of cutting-edge technologies. This paper introduces an innovative approach aimed at enhancing blind navigation systems by using computer vision, depth estimation, and auditory feedback. The proposed system leverages the robustness of the YOLOv3 object detection model for real-time localization and identification of surrounding objects. Concurrently, depth estimation is achieved through a U-Net architecture, providing essential spatial information vital for navigation assistance. YOLOv3 (You Only Look Once version 3) is a fast and accurate object detection algorithm that scans an image once to identify and locate objects by predicting bounding boxes and class probabilities for different regions. U-Net is a neural network for image segmentation, classifying each pixel in an image. Its U-shaped structure with encoder and decoder paths allows it to effectively capture and reconstruct image details, making it suitable for detailed analysis tasks. The integration of Raspberry Pi, Pi Cam, and audio output complements the system, delivering real-time auditory cues to users about detected objects and their estimated distances. The smooth integration of these technologies provides a thorough and pragmatic answer to help visually impaired individuals navigate their environment with increased safety and independence.

articleTitle: GSM-Powered Gas Leak Detection: A Modern Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Global systems for mobile communications (GSM) Powered Gas Leakage Detection system aims to prevent gas leakages, especially from inflammable sources like LPG, which poses great risk. This presents a gas leakage detection system utilizing Arduino and Global systems for mobile communications (GSM) modem. Here, the system uses MQ-9 sensor to detect the gas leakage and triggers an alarm which is comprised of a buzzer and activates the safety measures like turning on the exhaust fan. And also, the Arduino UNO board initiates a GSM modem which sends Short Message Service (SMS) alerts to pre-specified mobile numbers, thus helps in prevention of dangerous situations. This approach helps to minimize potential gas leakage accidents, protecting lives and properties by ensuring quick response and proper precautionary measures.

articleTitle: AI Dermatologist: Skin Cancer Detection with Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores the application of deep learning technologies in the detection and diagnosis of skin cancer, leveraging advanced convolutional neural networks (CNNs) such as VGG-16, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2. Given the increasing incidence of skin cancer worldwide, there is a critical need for more accurate and efficient diagnostic methods. Our study employs transfer learning to enhance the capability of these networks, enabling them to detect skin cancer from dermoscopic images with a high degree of accuracy, often surpassing human expert performance. We detail the process of data collection, preprocessing, model training, and evaluation, emphasizing the adaptation of these models to skin cancer detection. The results demonstrate significant improvements in diagnostic accuracy, with MobileNetV2 showing notable efficiency in processing and resource utilization—qualities that are ideal for real-time diagnostic applications. In MobileNetV2 we achieved 97% accuracy. Furthermore, the study addresses the challenges of adversarial attacks and the integration of non-image data to refine diagnostic procedures. Our findings highlight the transformative potential of AI in medical diagnostics, suggesting that deep learning could become a cornerstone in the early detection and treatment of skin cancer, thereby improving patient outcomes substantially.

articleTitle: Signature Forgery Detection and Verification using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Signature Verification plays a vital role in this current digital era. This work is aimed at studying how signatures can be verified using image processing and Deep Learning methods for forgery detection. We implement Sobel edge detection techniques to allocate the features coming from original signature images and then fake ones, followed by the statistical analysis that inquires the color channels, shape and the average pixel values. Besides that, we do the LSTM and CNN models, which are used to recognize if the given signature is real or forged. LSTM model bases on the finding of flattened images, instead the convolutional layers are being applied for the feature extraction in CNN model. In this process, we plan to create a way to examine images and signatures in order to ensure the safety and higher level of security. We have attained a good accuracy by using the Convolution Neural Network.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing HRM: A Comprehensive Survey on AI-Integrated Motivational Enhancement through KPIs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work examines current Human Resource Management (HRM) practices. It identifies areas for improvement and introduces an innovative approach using Artificial Intelligence and Key Performance Indicators for motivational enhancement. This paper explores the intricacies of AI-driven KPI tracking, monitoring, and analysis to elevate the precision of performance evaluations. Machine learning algorithms are employed to discern patterns in employee behaviour, offering insights into motivation and engagement factors. The proposed approach also delves into the psychological aspects of motivation, grounding interventions in established theories. Interdisciplinary collaboration among psychology, data science, and HRM experts enriches this survey’s comprehensive approach to motivational enhancement. This paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of AI’s role in HRM and offers a forward-looking perspective on workplace motivation.

articleTitle: Graph-Based Approaches to Detect Network Anomalies and to Predict Attack Spread
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Real world applications of data structures is enormous. Queues, stacks, trees, and graphs are commonly applied and implemented across various fields. To improve the efficiency of such implementations, optimisation through the underlying data structure can be considered. Computer networks inherently are based on graphs with communicating systems as nodes and communication channels as edges. Information flows between the communicating systems through the communication channel. To detect suspicious connections and information flow, an optimal graph structure is implemented by modelling the information flow as edges, and retaining the communicating systems as nodes. Graph analytics is performed to capture graphical relationships, and the final graph structure is formed with the features of the information flow split into node features and edge features. Then this graph structure is passed to Graph Neural Networks (GNN) that captures hidden relationships of the graph, and transforms these graph features in such a way that basic Machine Learning models like k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and Random Forest can train themselves and model into better anomalous connection classifiers. Eleven baseline models are trained using the traditional way, and using GNN transformed embeddings, and their performances are observed. Testing shows that all models show an improvement in the evaluatory scores. Finally, a logic is provided to build an attack sequence graph to track the route in which the attack spreads among infected systems.

articleTitle: Authentication in IoT Networks via Machine Learning and Deep Learning: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The area of Internet of Things (IoT) is expanding rapidly and raises numerous issues related to security. In general, IoT devices are resource-constrained, that frequently lead to the attention of cybercriminals. Thus, generating increasingly difficult circumstances in real time. For a reliable IoT system, the threat mitigation tasks are not adequately addressed by the current approaches. The present framework is insufficient to identify the authorized person’s proxy in the connected smart devices. This paper presents an overview of the various threats that can target a particular IoT authentication mechanism at each tier of the architecture. We have analyzed the advancements and inventions made in this discipline. A comparative analysis of the well-known recent ML and DL based authentication techniques, combined with an emphasis on the specific benefits along with drawbacks of every approach has been presented. We have given the suggestions for improving the IoT authentication system for secure communications and offered a strategy for further studies to tackle and overcome these limitations.

articleTitle: An improved SSH optimization model for wireless security in Complex networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The SSH (Secure Shell) protocol has been widely utilized for secure and remote access of devices over a network. However, as wireless networks become more complicated, there is a requirement for an enhanced optimization model that can take care of the security challenges that these networks impose. This paper extends the SSH optimization to accommodate characteristics of complex wireless networks and puts forward a novel framework for its application. Second, our model is based on SSH communication with complex algorithms for key exchange and authentication, making your data more secure. The model also works with the present security mechanisms on wireless networks, like encryption methods and intrusion detection systems, to offer an allinclusive solution for enhanced security. Our model is also designed to be robust and resourceful against adversary behavior by utilizing learned dynamic parameters from wireless network environments. We evaluate the performance of our model through experiments and simulations in different complex wireless networks. Our optimization model can be optimal in terms of security, efficiency, and adaptability by comparing it with existing models. The model can be deployed to different Wireless Networks and offers a reliable solution for securing remote access & management.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Real-Time Eye Disease Detection and Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this project, we introduce an affordable and user-friendly system for classifying eye diseases, specifically targeting children in underprivileged areas. By leveraging the VGG-19 Convolutional Neural Network, our system achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.10% in categorizing fundus images into classes such as Cataract, Diabetes, Glaucoma, Normal, and others. Complementedby a ReactJS-based graphical user interface anda Python backend, the system ensures seamlessuser interaction. In addition to image classification, the system offers personalized dietary recommendations, significantly enhancing its user-centric impact. Our approach represents a substantial advancement in early eye disorder detection, addressing healthcare disparities and promoting visual health among underserved communities, particularly children.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Arrhythmia Using XGBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases, and arrhythmia in particular, have become more common in recent years. Timely diagnosis and efficient medication administration depend on prompt detection, which is why arrhythmia is commonly detected using electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. Automatic process of identifying and then classifying these signals can enhance the quality of treatment and efficiency of diagnosis. Researchers have investigated a number of deep learning and machine learning models for arrhythmia classification, with SVM and CNN proving to be more effective than others. In our research, we examine the results of our foundational analysis, which shows that while SVM with a radial-basis-function kernel achieve a commendable accuracy of 91%, the ensemble technique we employed, specifically XGBoost, yields superior results. Furthermore, we rigorously tested the model across four distinct datasets to validate the robustness and generalizability of the findings.

articleTitle: Addressing the Cold Start Challenge through the Implementation of Content-based Filtering and Hybrid Filtering for Movie Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recommender systems are of great significance for the difficulty in increasing speed as well as the amount of online information of the users to sort out the relevant content as they offer personalized suggestions. Content-based filtering and collaborative filtering are the two very common types of recommender algorithms, but they are still facing some issues, e.g. sparsity and cold-start problems. To cope with these limitations and increase recommendation accuracy, this study proposes a new form of recommendation system that combines collaborative filtering and content-based filtering to form a hybrid recommender system. The system proposed integrates the advantages of both methods and, therefore, offers more precise and individualized recommendations. As an illustration, the hybrid method shows superiority compared to the traditional methods, which proves that deep learning might be the key to advancing recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Advancements in Underwater Image Enhancement Techniques using UFPN-ESRGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Underwater images suffer from poor visibility due to absorption and scattering of light, resulting in low contrast, blurred details, and color distortions. Image enhancement techniques can improve visual quality before further analysis. We propose a novel attention-guided UNet architecture with a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) for underwater color enhancement followed by an ESRGAN model for 4x super-resolution. Our color enhancement UNet selects the most relevant features via a dual spatial and channel attention mechanism to restore color balance and lost details while preventing common CNN artifacts. The FPN captures features at multiple scales for optimal color and detail correction. Next, an ESRGAN model trained on corrected underwater data performs super-resolution, further sharpening critical image components. We demonstrate that this model cascade can significantly boost underwater image quality on a benchmark dataset versus state-of-the-art methods alone. Quantitative metrics validate reduced color error and higher similarity to reference images.

articleTitle: Evidences of AI powered Use Cases and Challenges in E-tailing from leading Indian E-tailers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper highlights the usage and challenges of artificial intelligence in etailing, citing use cases from leading Indian etailers like Amazon and Flipkart. Both organizations have embraced artificial intelligence in a number of ways to improve its operations and enhance customer experience. AI has emerged as a powerful tool that has significantly impacted etailers throughout the globe and especially in India. The results of the study show that both etailers have harnessed the transformative capabilities of AI to secure a strong market position. While Amazon employs machine learning, chatbot assistants, product recommendations, and generative AI, Flipkart applies AI for customized search, issue detection, Microsoft partnership, project Mira to name a few. This article is a reflection of how these leading Indian e-tailers has devoted resources to developing AI capabilities and also exposes the challenges involved like security risks, perception regarding ethics, technology integration, culture wars and quality of data.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical VQA with Self-Attention Based Multi-Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the medical and healthcare fields, the integration of clinical images and question-answering systems is believed to be a powerful tool that has the capacity to change the pattern of diagnosing. The proposed model introduces an innovative approach using CNN and LSTM with self-attention for medical Visual Question Answering (VQA). Our approach serves the role of feature extraction and question embedding. The achieved results reveal the efficiency of the model in interpreting the VQA-RAD dataset, which mainly consists of radiology images. The baseline model obtained an accuracy of 70.71% without self-attention and 71.97% with self-attention. Additionally, the DenseNet Pretrained Model with self-attention scored an accuracy of 74.89%, and without self-attention, it achieved an accuracy of 73.22%, showing reliable performance against existing solutions. This paper contributes to the development of medical VQA systems and proposes avenues for future research and adjustments in the applications of healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models for Sentiment Analysis: State of the Art and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is one of the prominent and emerging research area in the domain of natural language processing. This paper explores the field of sentiment analysis using machine learning (ML) models. It aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art, applications, limitations, and future directions of SA. It identifies various ML models like Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, and Naïve Bayes used for SA. It also discusses various applications of SA across different domains like product reviews, social media monitoring, financial forecasting, recommender systems and crisis management. While acknowledging the limitations of SA like linguistic barriers, sarcasm detection, and noisy data, the paper proposes future research directions to address these challenges and improve the accuracy and efficiency of SA models.

articleTitle: Enhancing Dysarthria Diagnosis With Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dysarthria is characterized by delayed, slurred speech that can be challenging to comprehend. This condition is frequently brought on by nerve injury that affects the muscles used to produce speech. Depending on which muscles are affected and the underlying cause, symptoms can differ greatly. Talk therapy can help with early detection and intervention, which can enhance treatment outcomes. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the method suggested here for detecting dysarthria from audio data. The method highlights the distinctions in speech patterns between people with and without dysarthria by using feature extraction, notably Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC), and audio visualization approaches. These properties are used in the development and training of several neural network models, such as CNN, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Bidirectional LSTM, SimpleRNN, and Deep Neural Networks (DNN). These models’ performance is assessed with the use of confusion matrices and classification reports. This all-inclusive dysarthria detection pipeline includes advanced deep learning approaches for evaluation, model training, and data preprocessing. The objective is to develop a trustworthy dysarthria detection system that will help healthcare professionals identify and treat the ailment early on.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Feature Matching Detection: ORB and HDBSCAN algorithm integration
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper explores the integration of the Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB) algorithm and the Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) algorithm to enhance image feature matching and detection. ORB, known for its speed and accuracy in key point descriptor extraction, is combined with HDBSCAN, a robust clustering technique capable of identifying complex clusters, resulting in an innovative approach for accurate and efficient feature matching. The study rigorously evaluates this hybrid method on scientific image datasets, like microscopic images, blots, and graphs. The comparative analysis demonstrates the superior performance of the ORB-HDBSCAN combination from Homography-RANSAC integration. The proposed approach exhibits significant promise in real-world applications, including similarity detection systems. The OpenCV library is used in the design and implementation of the suggested algorithm. This research provides a valuable contribution to the field of computer vision, offering an advanced solution for image feature matching that addresses the complexities of modern environments.

articleTitle: Sea Surface Temperature Prediction using Sample Convolution and Interaction Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predicting oceanic phenomena plays a very important role in ensuring maritime safety, managing coastal areas and preparing them for any disasters like cyclone or tsunami. There are several factors that contribute to these severe weather events among which Sea Surface Temperature(SST) is a crucial one. Warmer oceans can often lead to stronger storms or even frequent heavy downpours, highlighting the importance of accurately forecasting SST. This study explores the performance of a deep learning model called Sample Convolution and Interaction Network (SCINet) in forecasting SST. This model follows a decompose-downsample-convolve-interact architecture that helps in learning complex trends in the data. On comparing SCINet’s performance with well established time-series models like Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) network, it was able to achieve almost 4% - 20% lower Mean Absolute Error (MAE) than LSTM on various testing points. This highlights SCINet’s potential effectiveness in time-series forecasting, contributing to the ongoing development and revolutionary advancements in deep learning models for time series prediction.

articleTitle: Protecting Sensitive Data in the Cloud: A Network Security Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud Computing adoption has increased dramatically over the past few years, making the protection of sensitive data on the cloud a major concern. In this paper network security is presented as an effective way to ensure the security of data on the cloud using methods like encryption, access control, and DLP. The method concentrates on the security of the network infrastructure, and also the internal cloud environment security controls. This methodology combines internal and external security measures to provide an overall protection of data housed in the cloud. Conclusions The work is mainly intended to increase the understanding of the need for network security and shielding data in the cloud, and someways to enhance data security in the cloud for businesses and organizations.

articleTitle: Threat Modeling and Attack Simulation of Charging Infrastructures in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) have emerged as a prominent technology in addressing energy management and environmental pollution concerns. As EVs become increasingly integrated into our transportation ecosystem, the security of their charging infrastructures becomes paramount. The dynamic nature of EV charging processes involves intricate communication and data exchange between vehicles, charging stations, and backend systems, exposing them to various security risks. This has attracted significant attention from researchers, leading to the identification of security challenges inherent in this technology. This paper comprises work on three main sections: Threat Modeling for the entire EV ecosystem, Attack Simulation, and Proposing Mitigation Techniques. The goal of this paper is to provide insights into identifying potential threats and understanding the impact of attacks on the functionality and security of EV charging infrastructures. By leveraging threat modeling, attack simulation, and proposing mitigation techniques, this research aims to contribute towards enhancing the security and resilience of EV charging systems in the face of evolving cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Outage Analysis of STAR-RIS-NOMA Aided V2V Communication Systems Under Energy Splitting and Time Switching Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper investigates the outage performance of vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communications within wireless networks empowered by simultaneous transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (STAR-RIS) in a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) framework. Specifically, we examine a scenario where a mobile access point (AP) transmits a composite signal to two NOMA vehicles, facilitated by a STAR-RIS-equipped vehicle. Given the practical limitations of the mode switching (MS) protocol of STAR-RIS, our study focuses on the time switching (TS) and energy splitting (ES) protocols. We derive exact and approximate outage probability (OP) expressions under double Rayleigh fading channels with single and multiple elements STAR-RIS for near and far NOMA vehicle users individually. Furthermore, we conduct a comparative analysis of each user’s OP under the ES and TS protocols of STAR-RIS for V2V communication. Our findings demonstrate that the TS protocol outperforms the ES protocol regarding outage performance for both vehicular users. The efficacy of our analytical results is validated through numerical simulations.

Author Keywords: simultaneous transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface

articleTitle: Hate Speech Analysis And Moderation On Twitter Data using BERT And Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Twitter, a popular social media platform, has become a platform for spreading hate speech, racism, sexism and other sentiments. This has raised ethical, social, and legal concerns, and researchers have developed methods to identify and classify hate speech. This paper investigates Twitter discourse with a focus on detecting hate speech, a prevalent form of online expression. The study utilizes a curated dataset to analyze negative tweets, employing the BERT model and ensemble techniques in the model, trained to detect and classify hateful content. The best classification results were achieved by BERT and CatBoost with hyper-parameter tuning, yielding an accuracy of 92% and 91.1% on the test data, respectively. Additionally, response strategies are devised to moderate content and foster constructive engagement among users. Sentiment analysis is employed to explore the emotional landscape of Twitter discourse. Furthermore, the research is expanded by utilizing clustering to classify hate speech, aiming for a detailed characterisation of online hate speech to enhance our understanding. The analysis encompasses a dedicated exploration of racism and sexism detection, identifying tweets exhibiting bias. The study culminates in providing a comprehensive understanding of online discourse, with potential applications spanning content moderation, user engagement strategies, and the cultivation of a more positive digital space.

articleTitle: Augmented Data Protection: Fortifying Confidentiality through CBBPH approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The foundation of contemporary data security, guaranteeing integrity and confidentiality in digital communications, is referred to as cryptography. On the other side, image steganography strengthens data security by providing a stealthy way to hide information within seemingly same images. A new level of data camouflage is added by the tactile writing system Braille, whose small representation makes effective use of pixel components for storage. Columnar transposition is also applied to improve security by further obscuring the contained data. To improve data security, this paper presents the Columnar Binary Braille Pixel Hiding (CBBPH) approach, a revolutionary technology that combines Braille encoding, image steganography, encryption, and columnar transposition synergistically. The proposed method involves encoding plaintext messages into Braille, transposing them using columnar transposition, and then embedding them into the pixels in the least important portions of the image. The CBBPH strategy represents a significant breakthrough in data security techniques as experimental results show that it generates higher values in Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) metric computations, indicating superior visual fidelity.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on Dental Patients with Medical Co-Morbidities Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: From the eve of the advancement of medical science, oral and dental health care has gained importance with severe medical health issues and medical disabilities. The dentist must be careful about any medically compromised patient providing dental or oral treatment as that should be safe and effective. In this paper, we have explained dental patients with medical co-morbidities for a real dataset to study the pervasiveness of medical co-morbidities in patients who need dental treatments. We have collected around 3600 instances with multiple comorbidities of patients visited for dental treatment and regular check-ups from January 2020 to February 2022 in three different hospitals in Bangladesh. From 3600 patients, more than $30 \%$ patients aged above 30 years had co-morbidities in this study. The absolute view of this study is to preprocess the data and then show correlations among them. Our target is to improve the performance using machine learning classifiers and create a training data set. We have used artificial neural network (ANN) and random forest (RF) classifiers and got accuracies $\mathbf{9 8 . 6 3 \%}$ for ANN and $\mathbf{9 7 . 4 5 \%}$ for RF. Co-morbidity is a co-existing medical condition distinct from a focal state, making the patient look for medical services. Unpleasant health condition is related to complex clinical management and that may increase healthcare costs. This paper also described the relationship between dental patients with medical co-morbidities like hypertension (HTN), Diabetes, Asthma, hypothyroidism, cardiac complications, renal diseases, liver disease, and some oro-pharyngeal complications related to dental diseases, etc.

articleTitle: Tasks Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing Network using Meta-Heuristic Algorithms - A Study of Selected Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: By utilizing the computational resources at the network edge, Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) has become a viable paradigm to handle the computational demands of developing vehicular applications. A key component of VEC, task offloading seeks to improve vehicle services’ Quality of Service (QoS) and maximize resource efficiency. This paper provides a thorough analysis of recent developments in VEC framework task offloading strategies, with an emphasis on the incorporation of meta heuristic algorithmic techniques. The review explains the opportunities and challenges in this field while delving into the basic ideas of task offloading and VEC. It looks at different meta heuristic algorithms such as Simulated Annealing (SA), Ant Colony optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm optimization (PSO), and Genetic Algorithms (GA) and how to use them to optimize task offloading choices in VEC settings. This review also identifies emerging trends and challenges in the integration of meta heuristic algorithms for task offloading in VEC, as well as highlighting current research efforts in this area. It talks about important performance metrics like latency, energy efficiency, and reliability and assesses how well meta heuristic-based methods work to improve these metrics. In addition, it addresses open research questions and possible future paths towards the advancement of task offloading methods in VEC. Overall, this review offers practitioners and researchers useful insights into the role of meta heuristic algorithms in task offloading processes optimization in vehicular edge computing environments, guiding the development of dependable and effective vehicular edge computing systems.

articleTitle: Code Clone Detection using Machine Learning: Brief Overview and Latest Developments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As software engineering progresses and the demand for code increases, code clones have become more prevalent. Vulnerability propagation is one of the risks posed by this phenomenon, which highlights the increasing significance of code clone detection techniques. It is a highly prevalent method of source code reuse and duplication in source code development. When a bug is detected in a specific snippet of code, it becomes necessary to examine all similar snippets for the presence of the same bug. As a result, this replication procedure may result in the propagation of bugs, which has a substantial impact on maintenance expenses. Owing to this, Code Clone Detection (CCD) emerges as a dynamic field of study. As a result, there is an urgent requirement to examine the most recent methodologies and developments within the field of CCD. In this paper we exhaustively examine the most recent techniques employed in the identification of clones in source code using Machine Learning. The field of Machine learning (ML) has become a preferred approach in the field Artificial Intelligence (AI), and specifically Deep Learning in the field ML, for the development of practical software in numerous fields; detection of source code clones as in our case of study.

articleTitle: Enhanced Predictive Modeling Techniques for Early Detection of COPD Utilizing 1D Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) breakthroughs have created new opportunities in the field of medical diagnostics, especially for the early identification of respiratory conditions like Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), the most prevalent respiratory condition, is characterized by breathing difficulties, mucus (sputum) coughing, and wheezing. Early verification is critical for efficient administration. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) model for COPD detection, optimized using Adam and RMSprop algorithms is proposed for this purpose. Utilizing the ICBHI 2017 dataset, the performance of each optimizer based on training and validation accuracy is evaluated. The Adam optimizer achieved a training accuracy of ${9 4 \%}$ and a validation accuracy of ${9 0 \%}$. In comparison, the RMSprop optimizer yielded a training accuracy of ${9 2 \%}$ and a validation accuracy of ${8 8 \%}$. These results demonstrated that the Adam optimizer surpassed RMSprop in terms of accuracy. It showcased the potential of the proposed 1D CNN model as a reliable diagnostic tool, contributing to the advancement of respiratory health analytics.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning’s Impact on Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This survey paper investigates the profound influence of machine learning (ML) on reshaping digital marketing strategies and practices. As ML technologies evolve rapidly, they are revolutionizing how marketers understand, engage with, and convert consumers. The paper comprehensively analyzes the key ML algorithms and their applications in the digital marketing landscape, including predictive analytics, personalized recommendation systems, sentiment analysis, and customer segmentation. It explores how ML-driven approaches empower marketers with actionable insights, enhance customer experiences, and drive business growth. Additionally, the paper discusses emerging trends, challenges, and future directions in the integration of ML with digital marketing strategies, highlighting the importance of ethical considerations, privacy protection, and ongoing innovation to harness the full potential of ML in shaping the future of marketing.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Early Disease Detection: A CNN Approach to Classify Potato, Tomato, and Pepper Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Early disease detection is crucial for maximizing crop yields and minimizing financial losses in agriculture. In order to categorize leaf diseases in pepper, tomato, and potato plants, this study suggests a revolutionary CNN design. The algorithm collects disease-specific features from input photos by using data augmentation techniques to artificially enlarge the training dataset. ReLU-activated convolutional layers gradually capture features at different levels, from low to high, while max pooling layers minimize spatial dimensionality. After the characteristics are extracted, a fully-connected layers with a SoftMax activation function classify them into illness groups. A well-chosen dataset containing labelled healthy and sick leaves is used to train and validate the model. Generalizability to untested data is ensured via performance evaluation on an independent testing set. The field of deep learning for agricultural applications benefits from this research. This strategy has the ability to revolutionize agricultural practices by enabling automated disease identification. This might result in early interventions, better crop health, and eventually sustainable agricultural production.

articleTitle: License Plate Detection using YOLO v8 and Performance Evaluation of EasyOCR, PaddleOCR and Tesseract
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: License plate recognition is critical to the functioning of the control and surveillance systems. Vehicle identification is based on number plates, which are made up of a certain arrangement of letters and digits. However, manually identifying every number plate is a laborious and difficult task. The majority of earlier automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) systems were restricted in how they could operate. These conditions included being limited to fixed illumination, background noise in the vehicle image. The primary goal of this project is to develop a reliable number plate recognition model that functions with the help of YOLO v8 for license plate segmentation followed with a comparison model of EasyOCR, PaddleOCR, Tesseract models based on best model for character recognition of license plate. The steps involved include processing of vehicle image, segmentation of license plate from the image, followed by internal segmentation of characters on the plate and pattern matching. Data pre-processing is finally performed in order to read and process the license plate. Problems like background noise in image like characters apart from the license plate and number-based characters being wrongly predicted as alphabets have been tackled.

articleTitle: Music Genre Classification Using CNN and MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper represents a significant advancement in the field of music genre classification and recommendation by harnessing the power of MobileNet’s transfer learning capabilities and custom-designed CNN architectures. By leveraging a diverse dataset and transforming audio samples into spectrograms, the system achieves robust feature representation for input. Through extensive training and fine-tuning processes, both MobileNet and the specialized CNN model are optimized to accurately classify music genres. Evaluation metrics such as accuracy, loss, and confusion matrices provide insights into the performance of the trained models. Upon deployment, the system seamlessly integrates into digital music platforms. Overall, the results demonstrate the efficacy of transfer learning and CNNs in improving genre classification accuracy and enhancing the user experience in discovering and enjoying music. We have achieved remarkable success in music genre classification, with the CNN model attaining an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 0. 2 7 \%}$ and the MobileNet model reaching an impressive $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$.

articleTitle: Power Factor Improvement using Modified STATCOM in Power System Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With increasing demand for reliable and highquality power sources, utilities face significant challenges in maintaining power quality standards. Power quality issues such as voltage fluctuations, harmonic distortions, and reactive power imbalances can lead to equipment failures, inefficiencies, and increased operating costs. The static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is showing promise to address these issues by providing support for dynamic reactive power and voltage control. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the application of STATCOM to improve power quality in power systems. The basic principles of STATCOM operation are discussed, emphasizing its ability to regulate voltage and mitigate power quality disturbances. Various control strategies used in STATCOM systems are reviewed, including voltage control, reactive power compensation, and harmonic elimination techniques. In addition, STATCOM integration into power systems is explored, including considerations for its location and size.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Quantum Key Distribution Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) represents a revolutionary mechanism ensuring secure communication amidst the quantum computing era. With the evolving threat landscape due to quantum computing advancements, there’s an urgent need for a comprehensive review and assessment of existing QKD protocols and implementations. This paper systematically explores the QKD landscape, focusing on protocols, security models, practical implementations, and recent progress. We commence by elucidating the foundational principles of QKD and its pivotal role in establishing verifiably secure communication channels. Based on their underlying principles, we then categorize and scrutinize various QKD protocols, like BB84, BBM92, CV-QKD, etc. We delve into the security models utilized in QKD protocols, evaluating their strengths and limitations. Additionally, we evaluate practical QKD system implementations encompassing both fibre-based and free-space setups. We shed light on crucial technological challenges, advancements, and recent developments in quantum repeaters, memories, and network architectures aiming to enhance the reach and scalability of QKD systems. This systematic review provides insights into the current state of QKD technology, identifies research gaps, and discusses potential pathways for future progress. Our analysis is a vital resource for researchers and practitioners who are engaged in quantum cryptography and secure communication protocols.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Performance of Autonomous Communications System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical abstract discusses studies associated with the performance of self-sustaining communications systems. Independent communications systems are a wireless conversation gadget wherein all components are self-configuring and self-adjusting. This study makes a specialty of analyzing the overall performance of such systems with respect to robustness, reliability, energy performance, and value performance. The performance metrics are assessed by measuring the achievement costs of diverse transmission eventualities, where activities together with mobility, shadowing, and interference are taken into consideration. An evaluation of adaptive and static strategies is likewise made. The studies evaluate the overall performance of various conversation algorithms, which include channel-hopping and spread-spectrum, and present a proof-based strategy for selecting the quality parameters and protocols for self-sustaining conversation systems. Furthermore, a metric for evaluating the overall device strength performance is proposed. The research findings are anticipated to help improve the performance of independent communications structures and beautify their reliability and robustness.

articleTitle: Implementing Deep Learning models for Lower Limb Activity Prediction with sEMG signal Using Various Window Sizes
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The classification of surface electromyography (sEMG) signals has numerous applications, including the kinesiological research, diagnosis related to neuromuscular,, and human-machine interfaces. However, various artifacts introduced during signal recording can complicate the interpretation of sEMG data. This study investigates the utilization of several deep learning models and the impact of window size for detection of lower limb activity utilizing sEMG signals from the leg muscles of persons with both healthy and impaired knees. A total of eleven individuals, comprising both those with and without knee problems, participated in three distinct activities: walking, standing, and sitting. The raw EMG signals were initially pre-processed using a bandpass filter with a range of 20 to 460 Hz. Additionally, a Kalman filter was applied. The signals were then segmented using an overlapping windowing technique with various window widths. Four separate deep learning model architectures were assessed in order to forecast lower limb activity. The performance parameters of the models were calculated for three different scenarios: (1) healthy participants, (2) people with knee problems, and (3) pooled data. The hybrid CNN+LSTM model attained the greatest classification accuracy, reaching 98.89% for pooled data, ${9 8. 7 8 \%}$ for healthy participants, and ${9 7. 9 0 \%}$ for subjects with knee abnormalities. The results validate the efficacy and usefulness of the proposed approach, which employs several windowing methods, in accurately recognizing lower limb activity from sEMG signals. Significant obstacles involve reducing signal artifacts, adjusting the window size for segmentation, and ensuring the model’s ability to generalize over a wide range of subjects and activities. The paper makes two significant contributions. Firstly, it conducts a thorough assessment of how different window sizes impact the performance of a model. Secondly, it demonstrates that a hybrid CNN+LSTM model outperforms other models in classifying sEMG signals. This research contributes to the field of sEMG signal categorization by tackling these issues and offering a strong methodological framework. It has the potential to enhance diagnostic and rehabilitative treatments.

articleTitle: A Study on Evaluation Techniques for Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective evaluation of machine translation (MT) systems is critical for cross-lingual communication. Current methods like BLEU, METEOR, and BLEURT often fail to capture linguistic nuances. This paper examines the limitations of popular MT evaluation techniques and proposes two new methods to improve accuracy. We analyze current evaluation methods, identify their shortcomings, and develop RTN-Method and SAA-Method to address these issues. Our methods show significant improvements in capturing linguistic nuances and provide a more robust assessment of MT quality. The proposed methods offer a more reliable evaluation framework, enhancing the development of effective MT systems for better cross-lingual communication.

articleTitle: Advanced Integration of Graph Neural Networks for Collaborative Interfaces in Immersive Virtual Reality Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Users could interact and have shared experiences in immersive virtual reality (VR) settings, which have great potential for collaborative interfaces. The collaborative interfaces in immersive virtual reality (VR) environments, this research presents an enhanced integration of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). This approach starts with investigation of the difficulties involved in group interactions in virtual reality environments, highlighting the advanced techniques to capture the subtleties of user behaviour and spatial dynamics. GNN architecture designed for cooperative VR interfaces is shown, enabling real-time analysis and adjustment in response to user input. The GNN-based model creates a dynamic graph of the immersive world by integrating multi-modal input such as, spatial coordinates, and social cues. The GNN enhances user engagement by dynamically adjusting the virtual scene based on patterns of collaborative learning. A range of cooperative situations highlight the model’s flexibility and show how well it can adjust to different human. The integration of reinforcement learning methods, which enable the system to adapt and improve its answers in response to user feedback and task objectives. The effectiveness of this approach is validated by the experimental findings offer, which show increases in overall system performance, cooperation efficiency, of 89.5% when compared with previous methods.

articleTitle: Transformer-based Transfer Learning for Enhanced Speech Dysarthria Severity Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
