The usage of these combined techniques permits for minimal deterioration of verbal exchange performance because of packet losses, whilst retaining a green network layout. Simulations had been conducted to evaluate the overall performance of the proposed method in assessment to previous works. The effects showed that the proposed method outperformed the other techniques in terms of multicast message transport fee. The proposed approach is also proven to reduce overhead site visitors because of retransmissions while as compared to previous works. The proposed method affords a suitable and efficient solution for reliable multicasting in loss wireless ad-hoc networks.

articleTitle: Advanced Multi-Model Approach for Robust Image-Based Fake News Detection: A Comparative Study of Different Image Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fake news that is propagated in this era is a very important issue. It has widespread effects on denorphising the public trust, transmitting wrong or false information, damaging the stability of society as whole. These type of news are shared easily in a short time, which is seen in the social media platforms. There can be misinformation and manipulation of a massive number of people. To address this issue, we primarily focused on the fake news detections with deep learning models. In this work we investigate using five most image models which are Swin, ConvNeXt, VGG-19, BEiT and ResNet-50, which can be helpful in linear or non-linear ways for fake news detections, it can be a feature extraction process also, which might help in improving the detection performances of anti-fake news detectors and it also can be helpful to see the data easily and introduce experiments that might improve the robustness. Here, we are reporting this methodology to detect the fake news using these five image models for extracting the features and feeding the extracted features into the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to classify the given news is either real as fake or not. We performed experiments using the IFND dataset and tested our multi-faceted feature extraction strategy which has proven to be effective. Each model has its own potential and it makes a difference in itself, producing it’s unique manufactured model and it could represents it’s own diverse visually rich representations which can be very useful in discriminating fake news. To show the proof of concept, improving the impicity of discriminating towards detecting fake news by using different image models, we extensively performed a comparison analysis for the state-of-the-art image models. By these extensive analysis, we attained the test accuracy of 88.66% on using Convnext-Tiny architecture and 91% F1 score while using the swin transformer architecture. The extensive analysis provides the relative advantages and disadvantages of the image models. This work gives a solid and powerful approach to tackle the spreading of fake news and sets a new benchmark to the research community in future research related to fake news detection. The work demonstrates the robust and effective fake news detection methods for precise information diffusion.

articleTitle: Novel Applications of Cloud Computing and Deep Learning Techniques for Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, cloud computing and deep getting to know strategies have emerged as effective gear for information analysis. This combination permits for the efficient processing of large amounts of statistics, permitting researchers to gain precious insights and make informed selections. This technical abstract will talk the unconventional packages of cloud computing and deep learning strategies for statistics evaluation and how they’ve revolutionized the sphere. Cloud computing has made it feasible to save and get admission to big amounts of statistics from any region, eliminating the need for costly and cumbersome hardware. This has opened up new possibilities for data evaluation as researchers can now access and examine information from a couple of resources: social media, medical studies, and monetary statistics. Deep studying techniques, then again, have proven terrific fulfillment in processing complicated and unstructured statistics. Via mimicking the shape and functions of the human brain, deep mastering fashions can identify styles and traits in information that traditional methods may additionally leave out.

articleTitle: Towards Real-Time Human Activity Recognition: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a crucial component in the development of intelligent systems, ranging from healthcare monitoring to smart environments. While existing HAR systems achieve promising results, limitations arise in handling a diverse range of activities and differentiating each activity accurately. This research addresses these challenges by proposing models to enhance activity recognition accuracy. The paper presents a comprehensive exploration of HAR using a diverse set of machine learning and deep learning models, aimed at improving accuracy and real-world applicability. This approach involves using the HAR dataset from the UCI ML repository which is a popular benchmark dataset for the same. The pipeline includes data preprocessing, handling outliers, and adding noise to better approximate real-world scenarios. To tackle the inherently complex and dynamic nature of human behavior, a wide variety of techniques from Machine Learning models like SVM with K-Means clustering to sequential models in Deep Learning were implemented. Impressive accuracy scores of 93-94 percent were achieved using linear models like multinomial logistic regression and SVM with K-Means clustering. The sequential Deep Learning models like LSTM and GRU produced a decent accuracy of 80-85 percent, but lesser than their Machine Learning counterparts primarily because of limited data samples. The best-performing model in the study was found to be the multinomial logistic regression model. All the models have been extensively evaluated using different metrics and techniques. The analysis revealed some powerful insights regarding the data of each activity and how to further improve the classification, for the sake of better activity recognition.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach towards Stratification of Opioid Patients Based on Data Analysis—A Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work investigates machine learning and deep learning methods for drug categorization in order to address the urgent problem of opioid abuse. Because of the intricacy of the issue, many approaches to anticipate opioid prescribing have not produced adequate results in terms of accuracy. The goal of this study is to use structured and unstructured data from the MIMIC-III database to categorize patients who are opioiddependent. To distinguish between purposeful and inadvertent opioid users, 41 pertinent variables were included in both classic machine learning and deep learning models. The findings show that deliberate users from structured data and inadvertent users from unstructured data may be predicted with greater accuracy. Furthermore, encouraging outcomes were obtained from the integration of these models via knowledge distillation. Additional clarification on the categorization of opioid patients was provided by ablation analysis. Utilizing cutting-edge methods such as knowledge distillation and attention processes, this study improves the accuracy of drug categorization and provides insightful information for managing the opioid problem.

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy using the Application of Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy is a major cause of blindness, especially among working-age adults globally. Early detection is crucial to prevent vision loss. However, diagnosing DR through color fundus images is challenging because of the need for the experienced clinicians to identify subtle features and navigate complex grading systems. This paper proposes a novel approach for the diagnosis of the occurrence of diabetic retinopathy based on the retinal fundus images of the patients using Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs) and deep learning. Our approach utilizes data augmentation with CNN architecture to effectively classify the severity of Diabetic Retinopathy from the given retinal fundus images. CNN in the proposed model is trained on a high-end graphics processing unit (GPU) to identify intricate features like micro aneurysms, exudates and hemorrhages. The proposed model provides a more reliable and generalizable solution compared to existing software-based methods enabling early diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy, thereby potentially saving eyesight in many individuals. This System has given the potential to improve diagnosis of patient outcomes and revolutionize DR diagnosis, particularly in resource-limited settings. The results of applying this model have shown higher accuracy of around 90% in the identification of the stages of diabetic retinopathy for retinal fundus images of a given patient.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Dynamic Pricing Optimization in E-commerce Marketplaces
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pricing transparency is essential in online commerce to drive transactions and influence customer decisions. Dynamic pricing, a strategy to optimize sales and profit margins, remains crucial for online merchants. Questions/purposes: This study proposes a novel deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for dynamic pricing optimization in e-commerce, aiming to maximize revenue and profitability. Utilizing the Online Retail II Data Set, which includes diverse product categories and customer segments, we developed a DRL framework that adapts prices based on temporal data dynamics, market conditions, competitor actions, and customer preferences. The state space incorporates key features like product demand, inventory levels, competitor prices, and time-based variables. An agent is trained through a deep reinforcement learning architecture to learn optimal pricing strategies that balance long-term revenue and ethical considerations such as price fairness. Experimental comparisons with baseline models demonstrate the proposed framework’s superior performance in enhancing revenue and profitability. The data-driven and automated approach enables e-commerce businesses to respond flexibly to market changes, improving competitiveness and customer satisfaction. The proposed DRL framework represents a significant advancement in dynamic pricing strategies, offering a flexible, responsive, and autonomous approach to pricing optimization in the digital marketplace, ultimately enhancing revenue and profitability while maintaining ethical standards.

articleTitle: Multi-Path Routing in IoT Network Using a Hybrid Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multipath routing in IoT networks represents a sophisticated approach to enhance the efficiency and reliability of communication by leveraging multiple paths for data transmission. In the context of 5G and 6 G, which is expected to deliver ultra-high data rates and support a massive number of interconnected devices, multipath routing becomes crucial for optimizing network performance. Hence in this Paper a multipath routing technique is devised that utilize newly developed optimization model, namely Tunicate swarm grey wolf optimization (TSGWO) in IoT Network. Initially, the simulation of nodes is done in IoT Network. Thereafter, the choice of cluster head (CH) is performed with Fractional Gravitational Search algorithm (FGSA). Furthermore, the process of multipath routing is performed using developed TSGWO wherein the routing path is chosen by employing the fitness attributes such as trust factors and QoS parameters. The QoS parameters involve link lifetime, delay, energy and distance. The path having less distance is chosen as optimum path with fitness. The developed technique effectually performs multipath routing by combining the benefits of both optimization techniques. Thereafter, the maintenance of route is done in IoT network for recovering fissure of link with DRINA. The proposed TSGWO outperformed other methods with maximal average Residual energy of 2.17 J, maximal link lifetime of 0.077 sec, maximal PDR of $\mathbf{9 7. 9 8 \%}$, and maximal throughput of 430.50 Kbps.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Dropout: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Student dropout is a pervasive problem in the education system, with a significant number of students failing to complete their studies due to various reasons such as academic difficulties, financial issues, personal problems, and more. Dropout not only affects the student’s academic and career prospects but also has significant financial and social costs for educational institutions and society. Identifying at-risk students and providing targeted interventions to prevent dropout has been a longstanding goal of educational researchers and practitioners. In recent years, machine Learning algorithms have emerged as a promising method for predicting student attrition and pinpointing the primary elements that contribute to it. Predicting student attrition and pinpointing the primary elements that contribute to it. This research paper offers an extensive investigation of the application of machine-learning algorithms-in-predicting student attrition. The study is based on dataset of student’s academic and demographic information collected from a major university in the Bangladesh. The dataset comprises information on over 400 students who enrolled in the university between 2015 and 2020, including their academic records, demographic characteristics, and enrollment history. Analyze datasets utilizing a variety of machine learning approaches such as support vector machines, random forests, logistic regression etc. Evaluate the performance of these algorithms using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Our study finds that machine learning algorithms can effectively predict student dropout with high accuracy, precision, and recall. The best-performing algorithm is Random Forest with a precision of 0.78, recall of 0.78, and $F 1$-score of 0.78. Logistic regression and KNN algorithms also perform reasonably well, with a precision of 0.75 and 0.76, respectively.

articleTitle: RBFN-Augmented DDoS Detection with CNN-GRU Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) assaults represent a substantial menace in contemporary security of networks, demanding effective detection mechanisms to mitigate their escalating impact. Despite notable progress in related research, the diverse attack modes and fluctuating scale of malicious traffic continue to challenge the development of detection methods with optimal accuracy. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a comprehensive DDoS attack detection approach leveraging deep learning methodologies. The NSL-KDD Dataset serves as the experimental foundation for training, testing, and validating deep learning algorithms. The proposed method integrates the Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (MRMR) feature selection algorithm, enhancing model performance, mitigating overfitting, and reducing computational complexity. The classifier comprises Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) components. CNN excels at object detection and localization within images or videos, while the GRU provides a dynamic mechanism for selectively updating the network’s hidden state, effectively managing flow information. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in achieving improved detection accuracy and robust performance against DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: Remedial Effect of Curcuma Amada Rhizomes on Steptozotocin Induced Diabetes Linked Oxidative Stress Mediated Male Gonadal Dysfunctions in Albino Rat: Pre-Treatment or Pre-Treatment Cum Co-Treatment Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Curcuma amada is used as an herb plant for its biological activities in the Ayurveda and Unani medicinal systems in different parts of India. The study was performed to investigate the protective effect of the most potent ethyl-acetate fraction of Curcuma amada rhizome whether is more effective in pre-treatment or pre-treatment cum co-treatment regimen for diabetes linked oxidative stress-mediated testicular damage management in rats. Regarding this, different domains such as glycemic, spermiological, oxidative stress, toxicity markers, and lipid profile along with viable sperm quantification and sperm mitochondrial integrity assessment by flow cytometry along with phytochemical screening by chromatographic study were performed. For searching the above queries, the ethyl-acetate solvent fraction of hydro methanol extract ($60: 40$) of Curcuma amada rhizome at 2.5 mg dose/ 100 g body weight was used as pre-treatment or pre-treatment cum co-treatment way. It was noted that pre-treatment cum co-treatment of said potent fraction can able to improve glycated hemoglobin, sperm count, hypo-osmotic swelling coiled tail spermatozoa, activities of androgenic key enzymes, and antioxidant enzyme significantly ($\mathrm{p}\lt0.05$) than the pre-treatment group. Ethyl-acetate fraction pre-treatment cum co-treatment also rectified ($\mathrm{p}\lt 0.05$) the lipid profile such as plasma triglycerides, total cholesterol, low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol, and high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol levels near to vehicle treated control. So, from the above study, it may be stated that ethyl-acetate fraction of hydro-methanol extract (60:40) of Curcuma amada rhizome pre-treatment cum co-treatment can able to rectify diabetes-induced male gonadal impairments by improving the sperm antioxidant activity through its free radical scavenging ability.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Swarm Algorithms for Enhancing Communication in Drone Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The introduction of drone technology has transformed a variety of businesses, from surveillance and monitoring to delivery services. However, effective communication among drones is critical for guaranteeing smooth operations, particularly in tough areas. This research study provides a comparative analysis of swarm intelligence algorithms for improving communication in drone networks. The study focuses on comparing the performance of various swarm algorithms in terms of communication count, with impediments represented by forest density ranging from 0 to 50 percent. Performance indicators, notably communication counts, are used to evaluate each algorithm’s success in facilitating drone communication. The major performance statistic is communication count, which is defined as the number of drone interactions. The study tries to determine the most effective swarm intelligence algorithm for drone communication in forested situations by examining how each method’s communication count changes as forest density increases. The discoveries will help to construct stable and communication-efficient drone networks for a variety of applications including forestry, search and rescue, and environmental monitoring. Understanding the impact of forest density on communication and the efficiency of various swarm algorithms provides a way to optimize drone network communication strategies for real-world circumstances.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Intrusion Detection using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Intrusion detection is a critical cyber security project that entails figuring out and stopping unauthorized admission to PC systems. Conventional approaches to intrusion detection rely upon rule-based total systems and system-gaining knowledge of algorithms, which require a giant quantity of domain knowledge and won’t be appropriate for managing new and unknown assaults. On this look, we endorse a singular technique for intrusion detection: the usage of reinforcement learning (RL), a kind of artificial intelligence that learns the most advantageous rules through trial-and-blunder interactions with the surroundings. Our approach makes use of a deep reinforcement mastering agent, which is trained on a combination of community traffic statistics and recognized assault styles. The agent is accountable for evaluating the incoming community traffic and classifying it as regular or malicious. By using reinforcement studying, our method is capable of adapting to new and unknown assault patterns without the need for guide updates. Furthermore, the agent can examine its errors and improve its detection skills over the years. Our preliminary experiments display promising results, with the agent achieving high detection accuracy and minimal false alarms.

articleTitle: Exploring Visibility-Based Shading Methods for Graphics and Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Visibility-based shading techniques for laptop snapshots and Visualization can provide realistic and perceptual shading consequences with the aid of utilizing data from the scene’s visibility shape. Those methods comprise visibility statistics to compute the approximate illumination of an object or scene, thinking about occlusion consequences from other objects. Visibility-based totally shading algorithms permit more practical actual-time renderings that extra accurately fit the way people perceive the illumination of scenes. Moreover, these techniques offer performance blessings over global illumination-based total methods, such as improved memory burden and faster computation instances, making them appropriate for plenty of applications. Popular visibility-based strategies, including ray casting and direct illumination, are based totally on the idea that each surface is ideally diffuse and homogeneous, which means their absorption and reflection coefficients are constant. To overcome this issue, a range of new techniques integrate visibility and physics-based total fashions, accounting for fabric homes (such as specular highlights) in the illumination computation. This combination of visibility and physics-based fashions can be, in addition, improved via incorporating mild shipping simulation strategies, inclusive of bidirectional reflectance distribution features and course tracing, to capture better and predict the rendering of actual international materials and surfaces.

articleTitle: An Approach for Early Detection of Schizophrenia
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Schizophrenia is a chronic mental disorder with distorted thinking, hallucinations, and social difficulties. Early diagnosis is vital, but current methods are limited. This research proposes a web-based application integrating machine learning, emotion recognition, and game-based elements to track symptoms and aid in early diagnosis. Interactive exercises focus on specific symptoms like cognitive evaluation, emotional analysis, and memory assessment. By combining computer science, psychology, and machine learning, the project aims to improve early detection and ultimately enhance the quality of life for affected individuals. Key components include using Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) architecture for recognizing facial and physical expressions associated with schizophrenia with an 87% accuracy rate, and utilizing Vector Regressor (SVR) with a 93% accuracy rate, along with Vision Transformer (ViT) and Custom CNN models for cognitive assessment, achieving accuracy rates of 99% and 98%, respectively.

articleTitle: Early System Failure Detection through System Log Analysis: An LSTM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital age, the creation of an intelligent forecasting system within digital devices is essential. Predictive maintenance for digital devices leverages data analytics and monitoring technologies to predict and prevent device malfunctions proactively. This study focuses on utilizing log data to analyze patterns within log files, incorporating various crucial parameters like application performance, security events, and memory usage, each timestamped to identify potential failure triggers. Key parameters include Word2Vec embeddings from the gensim library, enriching our understanding of the semantic relationships between Log Messages and Log Levels. This enhanced dataset is then input into a Long-Short Term Model (LSTM) trained on contextual embeddings to establish meaningful connections between log messages and levels. By employing advanced data extraction techniques and deriving valuable insights from log data, the aim is to construct a predictive model capable of anticipating issues such as unexpected failures, improving performance, and addressing security vulnerabilities. The methodology involves a systematic approach encompassing data collection, pre-processing, and the application of natural language processing to handle textual data. Various methods, including log data collection, pre-processing, and the development of a deep learning-based prediction model, are executed to diagnose system failures effectively. Validation of the model is conducted through experiments on a test bed comprising systems with diverse configurations. The ultimate objective is to enhance user experience by ensuring a smooth and secure computing environment through proactive issue anticipation and prevention. A test bed is established for experimentation, connecting systems with different configurations to capture and analyze real-time log data for system health assessment. Deep learning techniques based on the LSTM model are employed to analyze sequential logs efficiently.

articleTitle: Fortifying Artificial Pancreas: A Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation Study of Cyber-Attacks and Defense Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial Pancreas (AP) is a recent technology developed to aid type-1 diabetic patients in maintaining their recommended blood glucose levels. It mimics the function of the natural pancreas by continuously monitoring the patient’s blood sugar level and delivering an adequate amount of insulin to their body. AP is a closed-looped system involving several device components communicating over wireless protocols. Anomalous behavior of any device component or communication protocol due to a cyber-attack can be life-threatening. Hence, it is essential to make the AP system resilient against cyber-attacks. This paper presents the development of a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation of AP using the Bergman Minimal Model (BMM), which is then used to simulate the responses of two common but potentially catastrophic (to the patients’ health) cyber-attacks, viz., template attack and denial-of-service (DoS) attack. The paper also presents the development of detection and mitigation algorithms against these attacks.

articleTitle: SafeHER: A User-Friendly Wearable Gadget to Enhance Women’s Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: SafeHER, a wearable gadget created especially to ensure the safety of women. This gadget employs cutting-edge technology to give women immediate assistance when they’re in danger. Women’s psychological states can be identified and thus, distressing situations can be identified by monitoring their temperature and pulse rate. The device will activate automatically without manual intervention after meeting a predetermined threshold. This device will trigger an alert and generate shock to ensure safety of women. Advanced features on this device include precise Global Positioning System (GPS) tracking of the device’s location and real-time alerts to emergency contacts. The Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) is utilized by the system to guarantee wide-ranging and worldwide coverage. Additionally, a shock will be produced, which will prompt the woman to leave and put her in safety. To handle any unintentional activations, there is also a manual reset option. This gadget runs on a battery. An app associated with the device can transmit the user’s location to already programmed contacts when the GPS signal is lost. This feature boosts overall performance and offers an alternative means to get assistance when needed. Since there isn’t a direct connection between the main device and the application, it can be viewed as a device for transmitting location data. In addition to all this, there isa backup device to ensure uninterrupted protection. In the event of a failure of the main device due to any reason, this dedicated backup device will get activated automatically. This fail-safe mechanism has been implemented to raise user confidence. The integration of this backup functionality is a testament to our commitment to providing a fail-proof women’s safety solution. This gadget puts women’s safety first so they can live confident, independent lives.

articleTitle: TweetSense: Navigating Disaster Signals Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A disaster is a sudden, catastrophic event that causes significant damage, destruction, and disruption to the normal functioning of society, often resulting in loss of life, property, and livelihoods. Disasters can be natural (earthquakes, floods, wildfires) or human-made (industrial accidents, terrorist attacks, wars). Disasters can have wide-ranging impacts on communities, economies, and the environment, requiring emergency response and recovery efforts to mitigate their effects and restore normalcy. With disasters being too frequent in the modern world, the analysis of tweets cannot be an easy task for manual analysis. To overcome this, an automated model is to be built, which can reduce the manual analysis time for emergency responders. Socialmedia, with Twitter being a prime example, acts as a primary channel for disseminating information regarding disasters. The ability to predict relevant tweets holds immense potential in the development of early warning systems, facilitating timely actions by authorities and emergency responders to mitigate the impact of disasters. The approaches followed to achieve the tweet classification are Bag of Words, Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency, Word2Vec, followed by machine learning & deep learning methodologies. The CNN model is notably achieving a higher accuracy of $\mathbf{8 4 . 1 \%}$ compared to other models.

articleTitle: Adversarial Auto-Encoders Based Model for Classification of Speech Dysarthria
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Communication is effective based on various parameters, out of which phonetic or oral communication plays a vital role. Slurred speech or improper speech will lead to misunderstanding in speech, which could toss up any situation. There are many people, ranging from children to adults, who are affected with slurred speech, which is technically termed as Speech Dysarthria, a disease which tampers effective oral communication. Distinguishing between people affected with dysarthria and people with normal speech will be tedious process manually. Machine Learning (ML), and Artificial Intelligence (AI), can be pitched in to solve the problem. There are existing methodologies which classify people affected with speech dysarthria and people who communicate in a normal way. Some of the existing technologies used are Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and so on. This paper aims at distinguishing between people affected with speech dysarthria and people with normal speech, using Adversarial Auto Encoders (AAE), a model which has its roots from Variational Auto Encoders (VAE) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). This paper brings out a good result and proves to be effective.

articleTitle: Exploring the Approaches to Secure Mobile Devices in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores various approaches used to relaxed mobile devices from intrusions in wireless networks. The contemporary strategies contemporary security, inclusive of encryption, authentication and authorization strategies, is discussed in detail. The advantages and downsides latest approach are mentioned to decide the satisfactory technique for mobile tool safety. Furthermore, numerous emerging security measures such as the ones primarily based on biometrics and context-consciousness are evaluated and compared. The abilities and obstacles trendy method are analyzed relative to these options. These research paper goals to discover new possibilities for security contemporary cell devices in $\mathrm{Wi}-\mathrm{Fi}$ networks for reinforcing relaxed facts transactions and conversation. The paper outlines the contribution contemporary security methods to enhance the security degree cutting-edge cellular devices, and suggest effective strategies to defend towards capability security threats. Similarly, the paper will offer an in-depth survey present day security technology and their implementation challenges in the wireless domestic community surroundings.

articleTitle: User Specific Real-Time Noise Cancellation using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Noise cancellation is a critical concern in various domains, from personal audio experiences to professional settings. This paper presents a novel approach utilizing machine learning, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) trained on urban sound datasets and Yet Another Multilayered Network (YAMNet), to identify and cancel real-time noise. Note that the system is designed as an anti-mechanism for rather repetitive sounds and not for those which vary unpredictably. The methodology involves converting sound inputs into 2D arrays and extracting Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) features, conducting pattern recognition, and employing inversion techniques for noise cancellation. The results exhibit promising noise reduction, showcased through visual representations of input and output sound waves. The potential implications and prospects of this approach are also discussed.

articleTitle: Investigating Various Autonomous Vehicle Technologies for Automated Steering
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper investigates the ability for using diverse self-sufficient vehicle technology for computerized steering. The studies specializes in two precise technology, Optical waft Estimation (OFE) and Inertial size devices (IMUs), to assess their suitable levels of accuracy and reliability for controlling steering in real-international scenarios. For each era, the paper offers a top level view of its operating precept and a dialogue of its modern-day competencies, detailing its benefits and limitations. The experimental effects of each era are offered to evaluate its steerage overall performance in various riding situations, and an ensemble device combining the 2 sensors is used to demonstrate potential with progressed accuracy and reliability. Ultimately, the paper delves into the consequences of self reliant car technology for automated steerage and offers pointers and avenues for in addition studies.

articleTitle: Computational Psychiatry: Leveraging Deep Learning for Depression Detection in Social Media Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide suffer from depression, a common psychiatric disorder that has a significant impact on both individuals and society. For management and treatment to be effective, timely detection and intervention are essential. Recent developments in machine learning techniques have demonstrated potential for enhancing conventional diagnostic approaches. This work presents an extensive overview and analysis of current studies devoted to applying machine learning methods for depression identification. The review starts off by looking at the different approaches and data sources used in studies on depression identification, such as voice recordings, social media texts, electronic health records, and physiological signals. It then examines the various machine learning approaches employed, such as supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning, and discusses their advantages and disadvantages. In addition, the research addresses interpretability problems, algorithm bias, and data privacy, as well as the difficulties and ethical dilemmas involved in using machine learning models for depression identification. Proposals are made for strategies to deal with these issues, stressing the significance of multidisciplinary cooperation between computer scientists, psychologists, and medical experts. This work identifies promising directions for future research through a critical examination of previous findings. These include the creation of interpretable machine learning models, the integration of multimodal data sources, and the investigation of novel biomarkers for depression. In the end, this paper’s insights are meant to support ongoing efforts to improve depression diagnosis techniques and mental healthcare outcomes through the use of machine learning technologies.

articleTitle: IoT for Sustainable Resource Allocation in a Federated Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This abstract provides a top-level view of the use of Internet of Things (IoT) technology for sustainable, useful resource allocation in a federated studying environment. It outlines the distinctive additives worried within the architecture, such as the brink customers, the Federated gaining knowledge of Server, the Feed-forward network, the gadget studying Orchestrator, and the MQTT Protocol-based conversation Stack. Those components are used to facilitate green aid sharing and usage among more than one user in federated learning surroundings. Additionally, the paper offers the idea of community cutting and how its miles used to optimize resource usage and ensure fair allocation of assets. Moreover, it discusses exceptional techniques and tools, including resource allocation algorithms, high-quality service (quality of service) tracking equipment, and block chainenabled safety features for secure transactions and information privateers. The paper concludes with a dialogue about the potential for IoT packages within the near destiny and how this technology can enable responsible resource allocation in federated mastering surroundings.

articleTitle: A Regulatory Framework for Improving E-banking Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This review paper delves into the intricate realm of e-banking security, examining regulatory frameworks, authentication methods, and emerging technologies. Through an extensive review of the literature, including multiple research papers and industry reports, common vulnerabilities and challenges in e-banking security were identified. These vulnerabilities are demonstrated through real-world case studies, which highlight the possible dangers connected to electronic financial transactions. The methodology involved in this review consisted of analyzing various scholarly articles, reports, and publications related to e-banking security, identifying recurring themes, and synthesizing key findings. The results of this review highlight the importance of understanding and addressing evolving security challenges in e-banking, ultimately equipping stakeholders with a holistic understanding to enhance security measures and mitigate risks effectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Automated Production through Real-Time Vision Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Computerized manufacturing methods contain the usage of automated machines and device to offer gadgets or services with out the direct involvement of human beings. these procedures can considerably grow performance and productiveness; but, additionally, they come with their set of challenges. One such task is the want for real-time tracking of the manufacturing line to ensure that the machines are functioning well and producing merchandise. real-time imaginative and prescient monitoring is a technology that mixes pc imaginitive prescient and synthetic intelligence to continuously display screen and observe photos or video images from the manufacturing line. The system may be educated to understand and find abnormalities or defects in the products and any anomalies inside the production method. By imposing actual-time vision tracking, producers can quickly become aware of and address any issues at the manufacturing line, decreasing downtime and growing generic productiveness.

articleTitle: Enhancing of Night Time Vehicle Images using CLAHE Method
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the surveillance cameras, there are already many manually labeled ground truths in daytime images for training CNN, while there are fewer manually labeled truths in nighttime images. In this paper, we focus on the research to make the images that have low contrast or low light conditions by enhancing these images possess, a unique set of challenges resulting in reduced visibility and detail, one promising method is Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) stands out as a powerful tool for enhancing image contrast while preserving essential details. The human eye struggles to discern objects in low-light conditions, making it difficult to identify vehicles on dimly illuminated roads. CLAHE provides a promising solution by adaptively adjusting image contrast, thereby enhancing object visibility against dark backgrounds. This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of the CLAHE method in enhancing nighttime vehicle images and improving vehicle detection system performance. By leveraging CLAHE’s adaptive nature, our research seeks to overcome the limitations of existing enhancement techniques and offer a robust solution for enhancing visibility in low-light conditions. In this introduction, we provide an overview of the challenges associated with nighttime driving and emphasize the importance of effective image enhancement techniques. We introduce the CLAHE method and explore its potential applications in enhancing nighttime vehicle images. Additionally, we outline our study’s objectives, scope, and the paper’s structure. Through this research, we contribute to advancing image processing techniques to identify nighttime vehicle images.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Automated Classification of Wildlife Camera Trap Images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Camera traps play a crucial role in wildlife research and conservation, as they provide invaluable insights into animal behavior and population dynamics. However, the manual analysis of the extensive image data generated by these traps presents a significant challenge. Deep-learning models offer a promising solution for automating image classification and facilitating efficient wildlife monitoring. In this paper, a novel hybrid object classification model for wildlife image classification in camera trap data has been proposed. This model combines the strengths of two well-established deep learning architectures, ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121, with an ensemble-learning approach using logistic regression. The data was acquired from camera traps deployed in wildlife habitats and pre-processed it to enhance image quality and facilitate model training. The pretrained ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 models on the wildlife image dataset were fine-tuned and the ensemble approach combined the feature vectors extracted by both models and uses logistic regression for final classification. The performance of the model was evaluated using metrics such as $\log$ loss and accuracy. The results show that the proposed hybrid object classification model achieves high accuracy of $\mathbf{89\%}$ in classifying wildife species from camera trap images. Th advances automated wildlife image classification and supports conservation efforts by enabling efficient species identification and population monitoring

articleTitle: Generating Robust Cryptographic Keys using Crossover Ring Oscillator PUFs: Resilience against Machine Learning Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) facilitates internet connectivity for all electronic devices, providing broad access and enabling the sharing of vast amounts of data in the cloud. This data, however, can become a prime target for hackers. To safeguard data integrity, various cryptographic methods employing secret keys for encryption and decryption are utilized. Nonetheless, if the security of these keys is breached, hackers can easily acquire them and access sensitive information. Although Physically Unclonable Functions (PUFs) are employed to generate unique secret keys, they remain vulnerable to extraction via machine learning-based modeling attacks if they lack sufficient robustness. In this paper, we introduce a robust key generation approach using a Crossover Ring Oscillator (CRO) PUF, coupled with an optimal secret key selection strategy. We evaluate the resilience of these secret keys against modeling attacks using two prevalent machine learning algorithms: Logistic Regression (LR) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Our findings show that the optimally selected secret keys exhibit significant resistance to these widely used machine-learning techniques.

articleTitle: A Rectangular Patch Antenna Design for Wireless Applications at S Band
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study, a microstrip patch antenna operating at a frequency of 2.45 GHz was built, simulated, and examined. The primary objective during the initial design of this antenna was to cater to S-band wireless communication applications. The antenna base was constructed using Fr-4 (lossy) material, which has a dielectric permittivity of 4.3 and a loss tangent of 0.025. The completed antenna was modeled using Computer Simulation Technology, and the simulation results were seen using Origin Pro. Following the simulation, the antennas exhibited a directivity gain of 5.6 dBi, a return loss of -39.80 dB, and a voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of 1.0206. The primary objective of this study was to enhance the overall efficiency of the antenna by reducing its return loss and boosting its directivity gain, hence achieving a reduced VSWR. The objective of formulating this comprehensive technique was to enhance the performance of the antenna, which will be utilized in wireless applications.

articleTitle: A Graph Based Approach For Detecting Sybil Node In Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sybil attacks pose a significant threat to the security and integrity of online social networks by allowing malicious actors to create multiple fake identities to manipulate network behavior. The abstract outlines a method for detecting Sybil attacks in online social networks using graph analysis. It involves constructing a graph representation of the network, calculating node centrality measures such as in-degree and out-degree, and setting a degree threshold to identify potentially malicious nodes. Additional parameters like clustering coefficient and community structure are also considered to improve detection accuracy. The proposed approach aims to enhance the security of online social networks by identifying and isolating Sybil identities, thus preserving network integrity and trustworthiness. The authors’ firmly assert that employing graph-based theory for Sybil node detection in online social networks stands out as one of the most effective methods. This approach not only offers robustness but also scalability, allowing for efficient detection even in large-scale networks. With its ability to unveil intricate relationships, anomalies, and patterns within the network, graph-based theory emerges as a cornerstone in the fight against Sybil attacks.

articleTitle: Many-objective Extractive Document Text Summarization using NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Extractive document text summarization plays an important role in obtaining relevant information from a large article. It finds application in social media analysis, news, legal documents and email summerization. In this manuscript this task is formulated as a many-objective optimization problem by simultaneously minimizing four objective functions: reciprocal of coverage of summery, redundancy of information, reciprocal of proper noun count score and reciprocal of numerical value count score. Along with these four objectives a fixed length of the summery is taken as a constraint. Popular Multi-objective Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-II (NSGA-II) is employed to perform the optimization task. The simulation is carried out on two case studies CNN-Daily mail data set. Comprative analysis has been carried out using text summarization with K Means, Fuzzy logic and Fuzzy C-Means method. Performance evaluation using precision shows better results with proposed NSGA-II, whereas using F-measure the results are second best among the four algorithms.

articleTitle: Automatic Test Case Generation For Safety-Critical Software Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automatic test case generation streamlines the creation of test cases for programs or systems, eliminating manual intervention and relying on predefined criteria or models. This approach ensures adherence to safety and reliability requirements while reducing testing costs. Our paper explores test case generation for safety-critical programs using Dynamic Symbolic Execution (DSE) and Genetic Algorithm (GA-ma-co). Safety-critical software is crucial for human safety in sectors like aviation and healthcare and follows strict programming conventions such as avoiding features like variable-length arrays and recursion. This paper provides evidence that we can successfully generate test cases for the two safety-critical programs considered, a continuous infusion insulin pump (CIIP) software and a cabin pressure control system (CPCS) software. The proposed Genetic algorithm (GA-ma-co) includes techniques like mutation analysis (ma) and crossover (co). The results found in this paper show that both DSE, which is a state-of-the-art approach, and GA-ma-co can be used to generate test cases to achieve complete line coverage of the code. However, GA-ma-co achieved similar performance with fewer test cases making it more efficient.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Blockchain based Framework for secured Cryptocurrency Exchanges to Detect Fraudulent Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the course of the past several years, the swift growth and widespread use of cryptocurrencies have altered the face of the financial industry, presenting both opportunities and concerns. Alongside the expansion of cryptocurrency exchanges, there has been a rise in the number of fraudulent activities that take place within these exchanges, notably in networks such as Bitcoin. In this work, we report the findings of an exhaustive examination into the identification of fraudulent transactions within these exchanges, with a primary emphasis on Bitcoin. In order to accurately identify potentially fraudulent transactions, we plan to utilize a variety of Machine Learning (ML) techniques and ensemble techniques. One of these methods is the hard-voted ensemble model, which has been noted for its exceptional 99 percent success rate in previous implementations. In addition, we investigate the possibility of incorporating the hybrid SMOTE data balancing system and LSTM for the processing of time-series and edge-based transactions, which would further improve the efficiency of the model that we have presented. The findings of our research make a significant contribution to the development of strong and interpretable models, which are an essential component in the process of strengthening the integrity and security of the ecosystem of cryptocurrency.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis on Drug Reviews Using Fined Tuned Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Main goal of this work is to analysis the drug review by using sentimental analysis. Nowadays we can see media platforms has become a portion of everyone’s lives, they share most of their views and interest in social media platforms like review sites, twitter etc. As social media has become an easier way to communicate, many individuals are posing their opinions in it which also include drug related reviews like providing useful remedies and providing valuable understandings which makes pharmacological companies more useful. In this work, we are mainly targeting on finding the sentiment score of drug reviews which are acquired from ‘drugs.com’ and ‘drugslib.com’ sites. Here we performed some preprocessing techniques on the data and then calculated the accuracy of each model LSTM, RNN, CNN and BERT, on comparing the accuracy we proposed that LSTM is giving the best accuracy when compared to other models with the accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Image-Based Segmentation Algorithms for Computer Vision Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Photo-based totally segmentation algorithms are an important place in trendy research in laptop vision for an extensive variety of trendy applications together with item popularity, facial recognition, and autonomous navigation. Such algorithms normally hire strategies that contain reading pix to understand edges, shapes, and different features in the surroundings. By means of making use of these techniques, scene objects may be diagnosed and segmented into distinct parts, making an allowance for further analysis and programs. This paper discusses the development and packages of brand new photograph-based segmentation algorithms, with an emphasis on algorithms based on pattern recognition and machine learning. Examples are supplied to illustrate the present-day country’s contemporary art and provide insights into the destiny development of those algorithms. This analysis helps to discover capacity areas for development and provides a top-level view state-of-the-art the overall performance of present-day current algorithms.

articleTitle: Investigating Fake Job Descriptions with TF-IDF and Word Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fraudulent actions have increased as a result of the growth of online recruitment platforms, especially when it comes to the creation of false job descriptions intended to trick prospective employees. This study tackles the important problem of recognizing and categorizing fraudulent employment advertisements. By utilizing an extensive dataset of annotated fraudulent job descriptions, cutting-edge classification methods are utilized to construct a strong model that can discern between authentic and fraudulent job postings.TF-IDF, a feature extraction method is used to assign numerical weights to words based on their frequency. Several word embeddings, such as BERT, GloVe, and Word2Vec, were employed in this study to enhance the job descriptions’ feature representation for fraud detection. To overcome data imbalance, the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) is also used in combination with TF-IDF. 5-fold cross validation is applied to the different classifiers to study the performance of the system. By merging numerous embeddings and resolving class imbalance, this ensemble model demonstrated a significant boost in fraud detection accuracy over extended testing, demonstrating the usefulness of doing so for robust categorization of misleading job descriptions.

articleTitle: Resource Discovery Model for Optimized Performance in P2P Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents an aid discovery model for optimized overall performance in P2P communications. The model is designed to lessen the hunt time for resource discovery and to boom scalability in P2P networks. It addresses the issue of resource discovery in P2P networks by using introducing modules: dense neighbor selection for optimum discovery overall performance and a dispensed consensus protocol for aid availability updates. The proposed technique combines several present technologies, along with remarkable-peer clustering, distributed hash table-primarily based caching, and dispensed consensus, to provide a powerful useful resource discovery. As a result, the version offers a consistent and fast resource search throughout the entire community, while reducing the conversation overhead. The proposed model has been evaluated the use of a simulator to examine its overall performance with a traditional seek and a gossip search. Results indicate that the proposed method outperforms the conventional seek and offers a massive development over the gossip seek. The proposed resource discovery model is anticipated to permit a higher implementation of huge-scale P2P communications with advanced overall performance.

articleTitle: RIP based Knowledge Graph construction for Prescription Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A piece of processed information is interpreted as knowledge, and the human brain connects this knowledge in multiple ways, which helps us understand and assimilate the real-world objects we see around the world. A similar method is a knowledge graph, where the information or data is stored in a graph database and visualized in a graph data structure, which stores data in the form of nodes and relationships instead of tables, without any constraints in the way they can be interpreted. A knowledge graph utilizes the graph-data structure, which contains the data in nodes and forms connections between these nodes based on the semantics or context. A Medical Knowledge Graph (MKG) is the application of Knowledge Graphs specifically for applications in Medicine. Knowledge Graph is used in many places, especially in search engines like Google, Yahoo, Microsoft Edge, etc. Existing methodologies use type-constrained negative sampling or random negative sampling techniques, which generate a lot of negative predictions. The proposed methodology uses a reasoning implementation path (RIP) over MKG, which uses medical prescription in reasoning the diagnosis, which focuses on the finer granularity of features with lower computational cost and improves the overall performance and interpretability of the model.

articleTitle: A Predictive Analysis-Based IoT-Enabled Smart Bins for Waste Management in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Waste management is a critical issue in smart cities. Improper management of the wastes leads to unsanitary conditions and escalates operational costs. Efficient techniques reduce environmental pollution and enhance citizens’ overall health and well-being. However, several challenges are associated with waste management: timely waste collection, adequate response to dynamic waste generation patterns, and underutilized/overutilized usage of bins and human resources. Recently, researchers have used Internet of Things (IoT) devices (sensors and actuators) to deal with these challenges. However, their data is frequently pushed to the cloud server without edge processing, which leads to unnecessary delay, bandwidth consumption, and untimely decisions. This paper presents a predictive analysis-based IoT-enabled smart bins (PISB) system using IoT devices. Here, the processing is performed on edge devices to improve energy efficiency, and predictive analysis is performed in the cloud server using a fitness function for proactive decisions. Specifically, each smart bin is equipped with HC-SR04 ultrasonic, methane quality (MQ)9, MQ135 and passive infrared (PIR) motion sensors, an Arduino Uno Rev3 microcontroller, a JHD162A liquid-crystal display (LCD), and an Espressif (ESP)01 wireless fidelity (WiFi) module. The proposed system regularly monitors bin levels, hazardous gases, and air quality and uses the Thingspeak platform to store and analyze the collected data. Moreover, the proposed system offers an efficient route for waste collection using the vehicle routing problem. We compare our smart bin with recently developed smart bins to show its efficacy in hardware and software complexities and costs.

articleTitle: Securing PHP code: A Parsing Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Securing PHP code: A Parsing Approach aims to design PHP source code particular parser with the help of Python Lex-YACC to identify the security flaws in PHP Source Code. This tool is used to recognize general threats like, SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting, Remote Code Execution, XML External Entities, and Objects Injection by analyzing scripts with defined lexers and parsers for each threat. The embodied features and components of the software system consist of input and output directories for scripts and script parsers dependent on the security risk, and the security analysis toolkit. Through the application of early detection during the development process, the tool provides the following benefits: improving the security of the developed software and also helping in the prevention of potential threats by cyber attackers thus encouraging the development of more secure applications. Considering the security analysis of the PHP files After the completion of security analysis on the PHP files, output reports for each PHP file are prepared.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Classification using Phase Space Reconstruction Integrated Fine-tuned VGG19 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective fault detection in rotating machinery is essential for ensuring industrial systems’ reliability and operational efficiency. In this work, we proposed a method for fault detection using image matching technique. The continuous images generated from rotating machinery part are considered for experimentation. Traditional signal processing algorithms may fail to extract meaningful information from signals, particularly early in the fault growth process, they might miss the subtle changes that occur during the early phases of fault development. To address this problem an image-matching technique using Visual Geometry Group 19 (VGG19) is adopted. The fundamental benefit of this approach is its ability to deal with the complexities of non-stationary chaotic line images, which frequently display temporal changes and noise interference of the expected fault. In the proposed technique, vibration signals are transformed into chaotic line images and VGG-19 architecture is employed to detect the fault from these images. The proposed technique enhances the sensitivity to faults while accommodating the complexities of non-stationary signals and noise by comparing generated images with the pre-stored images of normal and faulty occurrences. The approach showcases its capability to offer advanced warnings of potential malfunctions, enabling maintenance personnel to take proactive measures and prevent costly downtime. The proposed technique exhibits the advantage of improving the reliability and efficiency of industrial systems by enabling timely intervention and preventive maintenance.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Parkinson’s Disease Detection from Acoustic Features using Machine Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Parkinson’s Disease is a neural disease that causes brain function disorder. Reduction in dopamine levels cells is the primary causes of Parkinson’s disease. Dopamine is a neurotransmitter that helps the brain to communicate with the body and to govern body movements. Ninety percent of people affected by Parkinson’s disease had speech disorder in the early stages of the disease. Hence the speech characteristics namely jitter, shimmying, stuttering and fundamental frequency parameters are analyzed in this study. Non-motor symptoms such as hyposmia, unintentional weight loss, mood disorders and Osteosarcopenia show symptoms well before many years rather than motor symptoms. So, early and accurate detection and diagnosis of Parkinson’s Disease is an important step to reduce the progression of the disease. The machine learning model of autoencoder is built. The mRMR algorithm is used for feature extraction in the proposed work. The occurrence of Parkinson’s Disease is detected early using several well-known classifiers. The proposed method of feature selection using mRMR algorithm gives an accuracy of 93.83% for KNN when compared to existing classifiers.

articleTitle: Application of Advanced AI Algorithms for Fintech Crime Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Considering the formidable challenge of detecting financial crimes, particularly money laundering, in today’s global context, we have proposed methodology combining supervised and unsupervised machine learning (AI) techniques to identify suspicious transactions with minimal human intervention. Key contributions include enhanced data pre-processing, auto-labelling, and anomaly detection to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.

articleTitle: Human Detection and Tracking for Drone based Marine Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective object detection and tracking are essential for prompt and precise rescue operations in water-based emergency response scenarios. Acknowledging this necessity, this paper introduces an innovative method using deep learning methodologies. At the heart of this project is the MobDrone dataset, selected to document various situations that occur during water crises. By carefully reannotating a subset of this dataset, new labels of swimmers, rescue victims, and deceased individuals were generated, making it more useful for training and assessing. In this context, the research assesses the effectiveness of YOLOv9 using this specific dataset. By conducting thorough experiments, the study highlights YOLOv9’s exceptional accuracy and resilience, particularly in comparison with its predecessor YOLOv8. This research highlights the possibility of combining advanced object detection algorithms such as YOLOv9 with effective tracking methods like BoT-SORT to transform autonomous systems in water-based emergency response, leading to improved and quicker rescue operations.

articleTitle: ANSAN: Utilizing Inception V3 for Glaucoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The progressive deterioration of the optic nerve, which results in irreversible vision loss if left untreated, is the hallmark of a group of eye illnesses known as glaucoma. High intraocular pressure (IOP) is a significant risk factor, but normal IOP is not always necessary for the development of normal-tension glaucoma (NTG). Even so, glaucoma can occur in the absence of high blood pressure. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) [6], in particular, are deep learning models that have recently demonstrated potential in the diagnosis of glaucoma. These models are capable of detecting minute patterns suggestive of glaucoma by examining massive collections of retinal fundus images. The efficacy of the Inception V3 model [20] in automated glaucoma diagnosis was demonstrated by its 88 % accuracy in separating glaucomatous from non-glaucomatous images after it was trained with a large amount of data and enhanced methodologies.

articleTitle: Examining the Role of Guardian Communications Software Design for Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Network protection is a crucial region of generation and PC technology, and numerous equipment and techniques help ensure comfy conversation and records switch. Mum or Dad Communications software program (GCS) is a product suite that gives customers an answer for securing their networks. GCS offers an interactive person interface to facilitate configuration, analysis, and optimization of a community’s safety architecture. The suite carries three core components, supplying an excellent and specialized feature. These additives are the mum or dad Firewall, the guardian Host Intrusion Prevention System (HIPS), and the father or mother community protection appliance (NSA). Each component works independently and in concert with each other to provide comprehensive network security. The Guardian Firewall is an application-level firewall that provides a secure edge to the network by controlling all incoming and outgoing traffic and packet communications. It dynamically updates its rules database to recognize and block malicious traffic while allowing access to known secure applications and services. The Guardian HIPS is an internal network monitoring system that can detect and respond to unauthorized intrusions while providing the administrator with real-time alerts and intelligence about the nature of any malicious activity. Finally, the Guardian Network Security Appliance is a hardware-based appliance that can be configured with firewalls and.

articleTitle: The Necessary Requirements for Utilizing AI in Data Access Setting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AI has been an increasing number of adopted in records get admission to settings to improve the overall performance of statistics get admission to and extract significant insights, using extended productiveness and value-effectiveness. However, the success implementation of AI calls for positive essential requirements to be met, together with facts accuracy, connectivity, security, and scalability. First, facts accuracy is critical for AI applications in facts get entry to settings. Information gathered need to be of excessive quality and accuracy, as AI working on erroneous facts can yield unreliable and probably harmful effects. Records should be of suitable granularity, taking pictures the most relevant elements, to make certain a complete and steady training performance.2nd, linked statistics assets, networks, and services are had to leverage the capability of AI in information get entry to settings. This gives an interconnected and up to date dataset at scale, while requiring included answers for uninterrupted get entry to. Moreover, single sign-on and alertness orchestration abilities are vital to decorate user revel in.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning for Dyslexia Identification through Heterogeneous Cognitive and Behavioral Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dyslexia is a neurological condition, that involves cognitive challenges in processing written languages, impacting reading, writing and spelling abilities. Given that it affects over 10% of global population, early detection of dyslexia in children is crucial. This research proposes an automated system leveraging multiple modalities of data including Electroencephalography (EEG), Eye Tracking (ET) and Handwriting Text images (HTI) for enhanced generalizability. After rigorous preprocessing of data, clean data were used for feature extraction that led to data splitting. For broader understanding, this study employed both Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) architectures and analyses the outcome. A hybrid CNN-BiLSTM DL model was proposed for early detection of dyslexia as it showcased remarkable performance across all modalities, attaining accuracies of ${9 6. 5 7{\%}, 9 7. 6 2{\%}, 9 5. 8 1{\%}}$ on EEG, ET and HTI dataset respectively. The proposed model secured its superiority over traditional ML and DL models after thorough hyper parameter tuning, including assessment of various optimizers. The robustness was validated through cross validation with multiple-folds and inspection of Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curves, Confusion Matrix and Accuracy-Loss curves were accomplished for meticulous evaluation. Furthermore, this research compared the proposed model against various Late fusion techniques and Ensemble Learning techniques, in which the proposed model held its consistent superiority. Consequently, the CNN-BiLSTM hybrid model was proposed as a tool for early detection of dyslexia.

articleTitle: Securing Smart Home IoT devices using Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid growth of Smart Home applications has broadened the scope for a wide range of security concerns. Blockchain technology, specifically Hyperledger Fabric, offers a promising solution. The proposed model explores its application, leveraging the Fablo toolkit to enhance the security of Smart Home IoT devices. The decentralized nature of Hyperledger Fabric, with features such as its consensus mechanism and chaincode, helps mitigate common security issues like unauthorized access and device tampering. The resultant tamperproof network, coupled with favorable metrics like latency and transaction throughput, underscores the robustness of the proposed model. Our model promises low latency and high transaction throughput. The metrics assist the model in securely and efficiently handling a large number of transactions without compromising on speed and security.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Malware Classification using NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Malware classification is a crucial aspect of cybersecurity, vital for recognizing and addressing potential threats. This study introduces a fresh perspective on malware classification utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods in conjunction with Deep Learning. We propose the use of n-grams of API call sequences, including both API names and their arguments, as a means to characterize malware behavior. By employing Deep Learning techniques, we can effectively capture the nuanced patterns and distinctions in malware behaviors, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of malware characteristics and facilitating accurate identification and classification of diverse malware strains. The key contributions of this study include leveraging n-grams of API call sequences as a novel feature representation, developing a Deep Learning-based classification model, and evaluating the proposed approach on a large-scale malware dataset, demonstrating significant improvements in classification accuracy and robustness compared to traditional methods. The findings of this research present a promising avenue for improving malware classification, ultimately strengthening the overall cybersecurity landscape by combining the strengths of NLP and Deep Learning to combat evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: An innovation analysis of Machine Learning model to Automate Network Anomaly Detection through Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores the potential of machine-mastering models to automate network Anomaly Detection (NAD) through Time series analysis. We employ a two-level method wherein the primary degree entails function selection thru foremost component analysis (PCA), accompanied by gadget mastering (ML) model choice from more than a few supervised studying algorithms. The second stage evaluates the overall performance of the numerous selected ML models and optimizes theirhyperparameters when necessary.
