articleTitle: Enhancing Security in Lightweight Healthcare Wireless Body Area Networks: Lattice-Based Cryptography framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Real-time patient monitoring is a new age in healthcare, brought about by the widespread use of Healthcare Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs). However, as progress has been made, there is an increasing need to strengthen the security and privacy of the vast and private health data that is being shared. This study introduces a novel and all-inclusive architecture designed to surpass current limitations and raise the security of Lightweight Healthcare WBANs to previously unheard-of heights. The key to this framework is the harmonic combination of two state-of-the-art technologies: Physically Unclonable Functions (PUFs) and Lattice-Based Cryptography (LBC). The time required for communication of sensor node is 120 ms which is lower than other approaches including Ban Logic, PUF-based SUKA Protocol, and Lightweight Protocol-based PUF by a significant margin of 1.47%, which shows its greater efficiency. This framework’s painstaking implementation in Python software highlights both its applicability in many healthcare contexts and its real-world usefulness. The research’s contribution to a setting where trust and dependability are essentials makes Lightweight Healthcare WBANs capable of smoothly adjusting to the changing needs of contemporary healthcare while maintaining the highest levels of security for patient data privacy.

articleTitle: DeeplabV3+ for precise GI Tract segmentation in MRI images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical image processing has revolutionized the way in which healthcare professionals diagnose and treat various diseases and conditions. GI cancer is the fastest-growing cancer in recent times with an estimated 5 million new cases annually. Radiation therapy is a successful treatment option, but it requires precise targeting of high X-ray beam dosages to the tumors while protecting the surrounding healthy organs. Daily tumor positions are viewed by the latest MRI modality called MR-Linacs. From the obtained medical images, the radiologist has to manually segment the healthy organs at risk like the stomach and intestines. It is a time-consuming process that can drag the treatment time and increase the suffering of the patients. In this study, we use the DeepLabv3+ model, a cutting-edge convolutional neural network architecture for semantic segmentation, to present a unique method for GI tract segmentation. Leveraging its powerful features, including atrous spatial pyramid pooling (ASPP) and encoder-decoder architecture, the DeepLabv3+ model demonstrates remarkable accuracy. The loss function Sparse Categorical Cross Entropy is employed in this study. Its accuracy is 0.9892, and its IOU Mean score is 0.5678.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Bidirectional Medical Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Despite the valuable insights offered by both MRI and CT scans for brain diagnosis and treatment, limitations like cost, radiation exposure, and modality unavailability can restrict their combined use. This work addresses this challenge by proposing a novel unsupervised deep learning framework for the bidirectional synthesis of brain cross-sectional images between MRI and CT modalities. The method is evaluated on a large dataset of 2500 unpaired CT and MRI brain images. This research aligns with advancements in medical image translation, holding immense potential to streamline diagnostics, improve treatment planning, and enhance patient care by revolutionizing how medical professionals interpret diagnostic imaging and potentially reducing repeat scans and unnecessary radiation exposure.

articleTitle: Techniques for Optimal Frequency Allocation in Autonomous Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Standard frequency allocation is essential for autonomous communique systems due to its capability to improve spectral efficiency, boom throughput, and increase insurance. Cutting-edge processes to frequency allocation encompass fuzzy common sense, simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, sports ideas, and particle swarm optimization. Those methods are searching to optimize the project of channels based totally on various factors, which include availability, route loss, and interference, and therefore offer a better performance than random get entry to techniques. Fuzzy common sense considers available frequency with admiration to the cooperation of a given machine. In this technique, rules are formulated for the premier frequency venture with the attention of all the prevailing requirements of a conversation device. The goal of fuzzy rule-primarily based structures is to maximize community performance by way of deciding on the maximum appropriate channels. Simulated annealing is a meta-heuristic technique that calls for the choice of an initial set of frequency channels and the application of successive optimization runs till the most useful frequency allocation is generated. This method regularly determines the best frequencies primarily based on the minimization of neighborhood or total correlation while additionally accounting for constraints along with hyperlink budget and allotted load. Genetic algorithms are primarily based on the theory of evolution and herbal selection.

articleTitle: Essence of Internet of Medical Things in Geriatric Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The healthcare is a notable discipline towards continuous inventions and sustainable developments worldwide. articleTitle: Machine Learning Vulnerabilities at the Edge: A Study of Multi-stage Gray-box Attacks*
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing use of machine learning (ML) models at the network edge has created new opportunities for adversaries to exploit vulnerabilities. Adversarial machine learning (AML) attacks manipulate input data, causing misclassification in sectors such as healthcare, autonomous vehicles, and finance. This research provides a pre-emptive analysis of a multi-stage gray-box attack, which can achieve results similar to a white-box attack. Unlike white-box attacks, this gray-box attack uses real-time edge data to train a surrogate model from the targeted ML model. The adversary then adjusts input data for the surrogate model to identify classifier weaknesses and design a more potent attack. Detection of this attack is challenging because it does not require full access to the targeted classifier’s parameters or training data. We examine a real life scenario, each reflecting distinct adversarial real-time data instances. The surrogate model is chosen from six ML models trained on the complete dataset. Simulations show that the multi-stage gray-box attack misleads the ML classifier, achieving a high evasion rate with less data compared to a white-box attack. Our findings reveal the susceptibility of ML classifiers at the network edge to multi-stage gray-box attacks, highlighting potential impacts on performance and reliability. We also evaluate strategies to address these vulnerabilities, including robust encryption algorithms and advanced anomaly detection techniques.

articleTitle: Classification and Determination of Parameters for 3D-SEM Images using Deep Learning and the Novel Algorithm CompEx
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With an emphasis on Field-Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM) images, our goal is to enhance, classify, and segment 3D images acquired using a Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM). Based on the kind and concentration of doping present in the samples, these images are divided into three groups: Nd (Neodymium) doped cobalt chromite, La (Lanthanum) doped cobalt chromite and cobalt chromite in pure form. Our dataset includes ninety-three photos taken at different magnifications, offering a wide variety for additional processing and analysis. The effectiveness and appeal of the images are improved by the use of augmentation techniques. We use a new technique and pre-existing classical Deep Learning (DL) models to classify SEM pictures into different classes. While the 3D Residual Networks (3D ResNet) model achieves 40% average testing accuracy, the 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) model shows 50% accuracy. But the categorization procedure is complicated by the similarities and complexity seen in each class of images as well as the inclusion of different magnification levels. We provide a unique algorithm ‘CompEx’ (Integrated Image compression and Feature extraction), a approach based on modular arithmetic to to identify unique characteristics from the pictures and to overcome these difficulties. In addition, we evaluate Cobalt Chromite samples and assess factors like porosity, particle size, and distribution using a variety of computer vision and image processing techniques.

articleTitle: Optimizing Hyperparameters of Deep Learning Models for Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A Time Series data refers to a collection of observations taken in chronological order over time. In the era of Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning(DL) has achieved enormous milestones in time series forecasting like stock price prediction, weather forecasting, etc. Hyper-parameter tuning is an essential step in DL model development, as it can significantly affect the model’s performance. In this research work, optimisation techniques such as Randomised search, Grid search, and Bayesian optimisation are used to optimise the performance of DL models(Long short term memory(LSTM), Bi-Directional LSTM(BiLSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU)) via hyperparameter tuning. The proposed model is evaluated and compared with existing methods on various datasets of historical stock prices to demonstrate its effectiveness in predicting future stock prices. The research investigates the impact of the selected features on prediction accuracy and the contribution of the different optimisation techniques in tuning models. The GRU model has been found to be the best performer in training time and prediction errors among all search models. On the other hand, Bayesian search converges more quickly when compared to grid search and random search. The research will provide valuable insights into the use of technical indicators and multivariate timeseries analysis for stock price forecasting.

articleTitle: Localization through RGB-D Camera for the Quad-rotor
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a thorough investigation into the implementation of a localization system using a RGB-D camera that prioritizes computational efficiency. The study focuses on utilizing the Oak D Pro depth camera, which includes an in-built Inertial Measurement Unit. Visual Odometry is used to estimate the camera pose which is lighter in computation than other algorithms like Simultaneous Localization and Mapping. The IMU is used to obtain the camera pose due to the presence of drift during the camera’s fast motion. The readings are fused together to get the correct camera pose by employing the Extended Kalman Filter for sensor fusion, achieving seamless integration of VO and IMU. This research explores the adaptation of Visual Inertial Odometry system for an autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles applications, specifically for a quad-rotor/drone.

articleTitle: Creating Realities: An In-Depth Study of AI-Driven Image Generation with Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The field of artificial intelligence has witnessed significant advancements with the advent of Generative Adversarial Networks, revolutionizing image generation techniques. The literature review covers seminal works and recent advancements, highlighting the evolution of image generation techniques. Taxonomy is developed to classify methods based on their underlying principles and applications across various domains including art, fashion, healthcare, and entertainment. Comparative analysis evaluates the effectiveness, efficiency, and applicability of different models, utilizing metrics corresponding Inception Score and Frechet Inception Distance. By conducting a thorough review of existing literature and technologies, we explore the evolution of GAN architectures, from their inception to the latest innovations. We examine various GAN models, including DCGAN, StyleGAN, and CycleGAN, assessing their effectiveness in generating high-fidelity images across diverse applications. In addition to this comprehensive analysis, we present our own implementation of a GAN model tailored for specific image generation tasks. Our model is tested on multiple datasets to evaluate its performance, highlighting improvements in training stability and image quality. We discuss the architectural choices, optimization techniques, and training procedures employed in our implementation. Furthermore, we address the challenges faced in the field, such as mode collapse, training instability, and the need for largescale datasets. Our findings offer valuable insights into optimizing GAN performance and propose potential directions for future research. This comprehensive analysis serves as a foundational reference for researchers and practitioners aiming to leverage GANs for advanced image generation tasks, pushing the boundaries of what is visually conceivable through artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Exploring Multi-vectorization Approaches for Suicide Ideation Detection in Tweets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Suicidal ideation (SI) poses a significant public health concern, emphasizing the need for early detection to potentially save lives. Social media sites—Twitter in particular—have become important data sources for locating possible SI cases. This study investigates the efficacy of various vectorization techniques and machine learning models for classifying suicide-related tweets. Four vectorization techniques, namely BERT, Glove, Bag-of-Words (Bow), and Word2Vec, were employed, alongside TF-IDF. Eleven machine learning models were assessed, including Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, XGBoost, Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), K-Fold Cross-Validation, Ada-boost, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Multi-Layer Perceptron. The BoW vectorization method combined with the Logistic Regression classifier produced the best results, according to the data, with an accuracy of 92%. This combination demonstrated notable precision, recall, and F1-score for both suicide and nonsuicide tweets. The findings suggest that the Bow vectorization technique, paired with the Logistic Regression classifier, effectively classifies suicide-related tweets. This approach holds the potential for identifying individuals at risk of suicide, facilitating timely interventions and support.

articleTitle: Structured Approaches to Fostering Robustness in Engineering of Systems for the Digital Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Crafted under the umbrella of the DARPA Cyber Assured Systems Engineering (CASE) initiative, BriefCASE emerges as an open-source model-centric engineering environment designed to shape cyber-resilient system blueprints. Its arsenal of instruments generates meticulous substantiation upheld by the framework. This evidence compilation serves as the foundation for substantiating assurance claims. This paper outlines a hierarchical pattern taxonomy tailored to attain cyberresilience assurance, seamlessly instantiated by briefCASE throughout system development. The amassed evidence corpus within the framework undergoes automated evaluation within the ensuing assurance discourse, confirming the fulfillment of cyberresilience goals.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification of Histopathological Image for Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of most prevalent types of cancer and the main reason of fatality for women is breast cancer. Mammography images of the breast are used by radiologists to search for indications of potential tumor development, such as breast masses, tissue lumps that may be the result of cancer cells, and micro-calcifications, which are tiny calcium deposits that collect around aberrant tissue. Machine learning algorithms, which learn from historical data and can anticipate the category of fresh input, are used to classify benign and malignant tumors. Pre-processing, feature extraction, selection, and classification are the four steps in which the breast detection system is implemented in this paper. This paper introduces the Random Forest classifier which employs feature selection and transfer learning to identify and classify breast cancer in histopathological images. The suggested approach classifies benign and malignant cells by feeding features extracted from pictures into a fully connected layer using VGG-16 and Densenet 121. This classification is an excellent attempt that successfully detects using feature extraction and selection.

articleTitle: Utilizing Real-Time Tracking with RFID Technology

abstract: Radio Frequency identification (RFID) generation is an innovative solution for coping with the tracking of items in real-time. This era lets in for quick and accurate tracking of individual objects as they are transferred between places. By using utilizing this era, companies have the talents updated optimize their up-to-date management, process control, and logistics operations. FID era works by using attaching a tag up-to-date each object using a special radio frequency signal. This lets in the up to detail up-to-date capture, music, and record each item in its database because it actions through manufacturing, in-up-to-date purchases, and shipments from one place up-to-date some other. Through integrating RFID in up-to-date those tactics, businesses have the potential updated better track their gadgets and inform the person in their popularity. Additionally, it streamlines the up to date updated control manner, as managers now not up to date updated manually maintain records and update their up to date. articleTitle: Holographic Video Surveillance Systems: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Holographic video surveillance systems are an emerging era that can revolutionize the safety industry. This technology utilizes an aggregate of optics, electronics, and computer vision to create a three-dimensional photograph of the surroundings. By taking pictures from a couple of perspectives of the environment, the device can appropriately locate objects and events in real-time. This era has been used in an expansion of applications, starting from military and regulation enforcement to business and business protection. This paper offers a comprehensive analysis of the technology, including its advantages and downsides, applications, and modern research. The paper also examines the capability destiny of holographic video surveillance structures and their ability to affect the safety enterprise.

articleTitle: Heart Attack Risk Prediction Using Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Addressing the urgent global health challenge of cardiovascular diseases, particularly heart attacks, this research paper explores proactive healthcare solutions driven by effective predictive strategies. Machine learning and data mining methodologies play a pivotal role in navigating the dynamic landscape of heart attack risk prediction. Emphasizing accuracy and personalization, we conduct a meticulous examination of innovative datasets and employ advanced algorithms. Our comprehensive evaluation spans four distinct machine learning approaches-Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), XGBoost, and the Stacking Classifier ensemble, specifically incorporating Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and k-Nearest Neighbors as base classifiers. This strategic combination captures their individual strengths to optimize predictive performance and create a more robust final model, providing a nuanced comparison of their predictive capabilities.Utilizing four datasets, our study reports the highest accuracy achieved by each algorithm: XGBoost at 97.5at 97insights to the ongoing discourse, fostering the refinement of predictive models and propelling forward preventive healthcare strategies for enhanced patient outcomes within the complex landscape of cardiovascular challenges.

articleTitle: From Conversations to Knowledge: Enriching Movie Datasets with Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Knowledge graphs are invaluable assets for facilitating the dissemination of structured and semantically enriched data to both humans and machines while ensuring its accuracy and reliability. However, it has been observed that a direct approach of generating knowledge graph from existing benchmark data sources such as ReDial, DBPedia, etc. fails to highlight many crucial relationships between entities. In this work we proposed a strategy to enrich a knowledge graph by resolving multiple entity relationships generated from the ReDial movie dataset. First the missing entities and their corresponding relationships were identified. Subsequently, the publicly available large TMDb dataset is leveraged to align additional information such as genre, director, actor, writer, and year as nodes. Bidirectional links are then introduced to semantically enrich the knowledge graph. Validating a knowledge graph is considered as another important step. In this direction, we extract triplets in (movie, relationship, genre) format from the knowledge graph. The triplets are validated using IMDb which is a vast repository of movie details, and the Gemini Generative AI model. We compute accuracy of the extracted triplets and the results indicate improvement in the knowledge graph generation strategy and the IMDb as an efficient validator for our approach.

articleTitle: Smart Alarm System for Crime Hotspot Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing number of surveillance cameras to watch over human activities necessitates the development of a system that can automatically identify violent and suspicious events. This is an essential piece of equipment for smart buildings. The average yearly death toll from acts of human aggression worldwide is 7.9 per $\mathbf{1 0, 0 0 0}$ individuals. The majority of these acts of violence against people happen suddenly or in remote places. One of the main obstacles to halting these activities is the information delay in this case. In this work, the real time violence detecting technique is employed to thrive on this issue. Certain deep learning algorithms are applied in computer vision to anticipate and identify actions and attributes in videos. When police arrive at dangerous locations in real time, they analyze CCTV footage and begin an investigation before moving further. In smart buildings, this technology is mandatory. Violence Detection in real time will prevent any mis happenings from taking place by raising alerts to the security guards. Our model also has YOLO object detection inculcated in it in order to recognize any weapons or tools that an attacker may be using against people and the security guards will act accordingly.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing for Climate Change: A Comprehensive Review of Current Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The need for creative ideas to address the growing challenges posed by climate change has become critical. This paper explores the various uses of quantum computing for mitigating climate change, with an emphasis on energy optimization, improved climate modeling, and weather forecasting. Environmental modeling, chemistry, material science, carbon capture techniques, and other significant applications have also been discussed. Finding important approaches, results, and associated technological constraints is the current state of study. Examining relevant case studies, the review suggests strategic directions for future research on climate change enabled by quantum computing. It serves as an essential tool for scientists, policymakers, and researchers, enabling a deeper comprehension of the potential of quantum computing in environmental science and encouraging multidisciplinary cooperation for the long-term mitigation of climate change.

articleTitle: Achieving Grid Resilience and Stability with Horizontal Federated Learning Based Energy Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing popularity of electric vehicles is set to transform the dynamics of energy consumption. Demand forecasting of electric vehicle charging stations guarantees effective distribution of the available power supply. It helps to control the power demand of several charging stations to maximize their use. The power demand may outweigh the supply when several electric vehicles charge concurrently at a charging station or a collection of charging stations. Thus, the work suggests a horizontal federated learning method for energy demand forecasting to guarantee the effective and smart distribution of electric power to all active charging stations. Using horizontal federated learning, in which charging station data remains at the stations themselves, the model guarantees accurate demand forecasts and enhances grid resilience and stability. Using this distributed method, the smart grid can dynamically adjust to demand fluctuations, ensuring the best use of the available electricity resources and reducing the risk of system overload.

articleTitle: Interpretable AI Insights in Fake News Detection: A Comparative Analysis of CNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the major concerns in today’s world is fake news when the majority of people spend most of their time online on social media. People come across various fake news and false information. It is important to acknowledge how such fake news spreads, and it must be prevented. This project combines text processing with the utilization of relevant machine learning techniques, like categorization based on various text features. The model has undergone training using both traditional machine learning algorithms and deep learning techniques, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier, Naïve Bayes Classifier, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Logistic Regression and CNN have exhibited the highest model accuracy, achieving 95%. Evaluations have been conducted to make comparisons about the efficacy of the machine learning and deep learning approaches utilized. Explainability techniques like Local Interpretable Model Agnostic Explanations (LIME) have been applied to discern the keywords influencing the classification of data into fake or genuine categories.

articleTitle: Enhancing Diagnosis of Infectious Skin Disease: A Professional Approach using Deep Learning for Leprosy Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Leprosy remains a significant public health challenge, particularly in India. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment and preventing nerve damage. This study explores the potential of deep learning techniques to improve leprosy diagnosis, specifically focusing on tuber-culoid leprosy. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) were investigated for leprosy detection using skin lesion images. A comparative analysis was conducted using VGG16, MobileNet v1, Xception v1 and EfficientNet B0 models. With a recall of 0.9298, an F1 score of 0.9217, and an accuracy of 0.9138, EfficientNetB0 performed the best. This indicates that EfficientNetB0 is suitable for leprosy diagnosis due to its ability to balance precision and recall. The study highlights the potential of deep learning for improving leprosy diagnosis and paves the way for more accurate, reliable, and accessible diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Unauthorised Activity Detection during Online Exam
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The surge in online education has necessitated the development of robust systems to maintain academic integrity during remote assessments. This project introduces a comprehensive solution for monitoring unauthorized activities during online exams. A software platform will be engineered to facilitate secure online examinations, mandating the activation of camera and microphone access throughout the assessment period. Leveraging real-time monitoring via these channels, the system continuously observes and analyzes student behavior to detect any suspicious activities or attempts at academic dishonesty. The software enforces stringent measures, limiting students to a single tab to prevent the unauthorized access of external resources. Additionally, the implementation of a lockdown browser further fortifies the exam environment, restricting potential avenues for cheating. Students found engaged in any irregular behavior are issued warnings, in the form of popup, while the pop-up is present student will not be able to access the exam, ensuring a fair evaluation process. This project aims to not only detect but also deter dishonest practices during online examinations, fostering an environment conducive to academic honesty and upholding the credibility of remote assessment procedures.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of Histogram Equalization for digital images using modern imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Histogram equalization is a method of contrast adjustment in image processing using the image’s histogram. However, as modern imaging systems become more complex, these traditional algorithms for histogram equalization are no longer efficient. In response to this problem, researchers have studied several strategies for improving the performance of histogram equalization in digital images. An option is to use parallel processing and multi-threading approaches to distribute the computational burden, thereby speeding up the execution of histogram equalization. Another methodology includes using machine learning algorithms to adapt histogram equalization parameters according to the input image. Furthermore, using advanced hardware architectures like Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA), Graphic Processing Units (GPU), or Application Specific Integrated Circuits can significantly enhance the speed and efficiency of a Histogram Equalization. The performance optimization techniques have provided encouraging results, which significantly refine image processing time and visual perception. Modern imaging systems may benefit tremendously from their use in the new age.

articleTitle: Enhanced Prediction of Fetal Hypoxia Through GAN-Synthesized Data and Advanced Ensemble Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fetal hypoxia, characterized by reduced oxygen supply to the fetus, presents significant risks to fetal health, including the potential for severe organ damage. The early and accurate diagnosis of hypoxia is critical for timely intervention and the improvement of fetal outcomes. In this study, we address the diagnosis of fetal hypoxia through the analysis of Fetal Heart Rate (FHR) signals, overcoming the prevalent challenge of dataset imbalance by using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to generate synthetic data. This study employs feature extraction techniques, including linear features, Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), and 1D-ResNet, to capture comprehensive signal characteristics. The enriched data features are fused and subsequently analyzed using the XGBoost classifier, a sophisticated decision-tree-based ensemble machine learning algorithm. Our methodology demonstrates exceptional diagnostic performance, achieving an overall accuracy of 91.94%, with sensitivity and specificity rates of 91.34% and 92.48%, respectively.

articleTitle: Harmony in Agriculture: Crafting an Integrated Framework for Optimal Crop, Irrigation and Fertilizer Recommendations - A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This comprehensive review paper synthesizes a variety of research findings in the domains of crop recommendation, fertilizer application, and water management. The aim is to offer a holistic perspective on the integrated approach to optimizing agricultural productivity. The review explores the intricate relationships among these three fundamental components, investigating synergies and trade-offs within their application. In the first section, the review navigates through studies on crop recommendation systems, examining advancements in precision agriculture, machine learning, and data analytics. It evaluates the effectiveness of various models in predicting suitable crops based on soil types, climate conditions, and historical data. Special emphasis is placed on the evolving landscape of digital agriculture and the role of emerging technologies in shaping modern crop recommendation frameworks. Moving forward, the review explores the complex dynamics of fertilizer application, encompassing studies on nutrient management strategies, soil health considerations, and the ecological impacts of different fertilization practices. Attention is given to sustainable approaches that balance high yields with environmental stewardship, considering the long-term viability of agricultural systems. The third section of the review focuses on water recommendation systems, analyzing research on efficient irrigation methods, water use efficiency, and technologies for real-time monitoring of soil moisture. It assesses evolving strategies to optimize water resources, particularly in regions facing water scarcity and climate variability. Throughout the review, critical insights are drawn from key research papers, addressing gaps in existing knowledge and identifying avenues for future investigations. By combining information from these three crucial domains, this review contributes to the development of a unified framework for sustainable and precision agriculture, enhancing our understanding of the complex interactions between crop selection, fertilizer application, and water management.

articleTitle: Gender-Based Diagnosis of Frontotemporal Dementia Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A clinical illness called dementia causes a continuous decline in cognitive and emotional capacities severe enough to affect day-to-day activities. Frontotemporal dementia (FtD) is characterised by frontal and anterior temporal brain atrophy, primarily impairing personality and social abilities. The fast development of electroencephalogram (EEG) sensors has made the EEG a practical, precise, and robust biomarker for detecting neurodegenerative disorders. The Rudiment Densely-Coupled Convolutional Gated Recurrent Unit (RDCGRU) deep-learning model is proposed for gender-based diagnosing FtD. Two brain regions were considered when selecting the EEG electrodes to detect FtD. The frontal-temporal ($\mathrm{F3}, \mathrm{Fz}, \mathrm{F4}, \mathrm{T3}$, and T4) area is the first, and the parietaloccipital (O1, O2, P3, Pz, and P4) part is the second. Three gender-based data file groups have been created to train the deep learning model: male group-01, female group-02, and mixed-gender group-03. Only five critical EEG channels were considered in the data files of two brain regions, and extra electrodes were eliminated. The parietal-occipital electrodes are more critical than the frontal-temporal electrodes in diagnosing FtD. The proposed RDCGRU model achieved the greatest f1-score, 71.0 0%, for the female group-02 with frontal-temporal electrodes. In addition, the model attended the highest f1-score (92.57%) for the female group-02 with the parietal-occipital electrodes. The gender-based categorisation is more accurate in identifying Frontotemporal Dementia (FtD) than the mixed-gender classification. In the examination of FtD, the parietal-occipital brain region is more critical than the frontal-temporal region.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Battery Charging: From Prediction to Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research study endeavors to explore the prediction and classification of charging time lithium ion cell 3350 mAh and 3.6 volt. The focus lies on contemplating the battery capacity and charging rate as crucial factors. In order to achieve this, two distinct machine learning methodologies, namely linear regression and decision tree classification, are utilized to scrutinize the charging time and categorize the charging behaviours correspondingly. Furthermore, to gain deeper insights into the charging dynamics of these devices, the study employs the employment of k-means clustering to establish discernible patterns in the charging data. This proactive methodology aids in unraveling the various complexities involved in device charging dynamics.

articleTitle: The Impact of Industrial Automation on the Manufacturing Industry in the Era of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the dawn of Industry 4.0, industrial automation has become one of the most disruptive technologies in the manufacturing industry. It encompasses the use of innovative technology and methods to automate different processes related to production, which decreases dependence on human laborers and ensures increased production results with greater efficiency. It was a game changer for the industry - industrial Automation that transformed product design, production, and delivery. A significant positive aspect of using industrial Automation is that it improves the speed and accuracy at which production occurs. Robotization, artifidal intelligence, and modern equipment combined to allow manufacturing to continue mumuchquicker while being more accurate. It helps reduce production time, bringing down wastage and errors due to cost-saving, leading to better quality control. The integration resulted in Industrial automation leading towards Smart Factories where machines & systems are interconnected and communicate banks on each other. This has enabled the manufacturers to monitor and optimize their production processes, ensuring their organization planned maintenance over preventive repairs, avoiding machinery failures, or putting suppliers in check with plummeting demand. Industrial Automation Increasing Potential Job Displacement and Reskilling/Upskilling of Workers.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Airline Tweets Using Word Embeddings and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project deals with the testing of different word embedding, deep learning techniques, and XAI tools for text classification tasks. It talks about the effect of Word2Vec embeddings in CNN models on text context and shows their capability of grasping it. Furthermore, this research sees the application of BERT and RoBERTa embedding and shows their influence on CNN and BiLSTM models and their comparable performance. Besides, this project also proves the significance of transformer-based embeddings in the information extraction from texts with various contextual nuances and points to their possible to increase the text classification accuracy on different deep learning architectures. We lastly, look into the function of eXplainable AI tools in the interpretation of model decisions, which ultimately helps to understand and support the model prediction outcomes in the field of text classification.

articleTitle: Assessing the Multifaceted Determinants Shaping Sustainable Construction Material Adoption: A Holistic Investigation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study figured out the factors substantially affecting the Indian Construction industry to leverage Advanced Sustainable Construction Materials. A model was developed to find out the factors that significantly impacted the adoption of these materials- age, product awareness, accessibility and reach, government incentives, and hearing of positive news together enable the masses to prefer advanced sustainable materials over conventional ones. Age is a crucial demographic factor affecting the willingness to adopt the materials. No impact of Gender on the adoption made the preference for these materials gender-neutral. These materials are price-sensitive, and successful market penetration is possible with awareness, accessibility and reach. Government incentives and the hearing of positive news would enable the widespread adoption of the materials.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Satellite Imagery Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using satellite TV for PC imagery has been an essential device for tracking and expertise Earth’s floor and surroundings. However, the increasing quantity of satellite TV for PC imagery records has posed a challenge for traditional methods of picture analysis and category. That is where gadget mastering (ML) techniques come into play, supplying a green and correct means of satellite imagery type. ML algorithms use statistical models and algorithms to mechanically learn from statistics and make predictions or choices without specific commands. In satellite imagery classification, ML strategies can examine large datasets and identify styles in the imagery, leading to correct identity and classification of land cover, land use, and modifications over the years. The mixing of ML in satellite TV for PC imagery type has appreciably stepped forward the rate and accuracy of classification responsibilities. For example, ML algorithms can differentiate among different forms of land cowl like forests, water bodies, and cities with better accuracy than conventional guide techniques.

articleTitle: Texture-Auditory Analysis Through Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In order to investigate the complex link between surface texture and auditory signals, this research integrates machine learning approaches. Texture perception, influencing quality, safety, and comfort in various environments, has traditionally focused on visual and tactile cues, but the role of auditory stimuli is gaining traction. Leveraging sound analysis, the study aims to understand and enhance sensory experiences. A comprehensive analysis of how well different machine learning (ML) models perform in two distinct tasks: image classification and sound feature extraction. The accuracy and loss metrics are examined for each model to provide insights into their effectiveness in capturing patterns and features from the respective data types. Models like Mobilenet for image classification and Cross Gradient Booster for sound feature extraction demonstrate strong generalization capabilities, indicating their potential suitability for real-world applications and diverse datasets.

articleTitle: Detection and Characterization of Thyroid Cancer Nodule Using Deep Neural Networks -A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Thyroid cancer is a butterfly-shaped gland located at the throat caused by genetic or environmental factors. The detection of thyroid cancer is normally followed by ultrasound imaging. The inclusion of automation and intelligence-based CAD (Computer Aided Diagnosis), including deep learning, is an emerging technology with greater accuracy. This paper proposes a review of thyroid cancer nodule detection. CNN is a commonly used method with various architectures like VGG 16, Res Net, etc. and GAN, LSTM, RNN, Auto Encoders, and deep belief networks are used for thyroid cancer detection. Additionally, the study accumulates the different deep-learning techniques applied in the classification of thyroid cancer. The accuracy parameters and conflicts faced in the CAD system incorporating AI, which restricts performance, are discussed in this work. This research effectively explored the different deep-learning techniques used in thyroid cancer detection and diagnosis. Novel techniques that fuse GLCM and transfer learning features and classify them using machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Exploring Modern Cryptographic Algorithms: An Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern era dominated by digital communication, security of data is of utmost concern. Modern cryptographic algorithms plays an important role to secure the communication channel. This paper provides an experimental analysis of various contemporary algorithms, aimed at addressing their performance, strength and suitability. Our methodology involves implementing these algorithms and performing various tests to evaluate their strength, efficiency and security. The findings of our analysis provide useful insights into the efficacy and resilience of cryptographic algorithms, which helped in developing a new algorithm. By identifying potential vulnerabilities and opportunities for development, this study adds to the ongoing evolution of cryptographic algorithms. A new algorithm is developed based on substitution and permutation operations. On the basis of experimental results, developed algorithm is better in terms of throughput, efficiency and speed as compared to previously developed algorithms.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction Analysis for Retention Using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the 21st century, there is a handful of information on the Internet. It is easy for customers to switch to a competing company in any sector. It is important for a company to retain its existing customers rather than secure new ones. So, customer retention becomes an essential part of an organisation’s business. Customer churn prediction is a type of data analysis based on the historical data of any organization. It helps to predict whether the customers are going to leave the organisation or not in advance. Also, it helps the organisation predict what customers are expecting from them and where they are lacking. There are a wide range of algorithms used for churn prediction. However, there is no agreement on choosing the best one. Therefore, this project presents customer churn prediction using the ensemble method in the telecommunications sector. The ensemble approach amalgamates predictions from base classifiers such as decision trees, random forests, gradient-boosting machines, and support vector machines. By studying the strengths of these models, ensemble techniques like bagging, boosting, and stacking mitigate individual model biases and variance, leading to improved predictive performance. We are using the XGBoost and Random Forest methods to predict the churn. It is a type of ensemble method. The ensemble method is used to increase accuracy by combining multiple models rather than using a single model. From the result, we have observed that the proposed model, XGBoost and Random Forest, attains 99% accuracy. Overall, the project adds significant value by enabling proactive churn management, customer-centric strategies, and sustainable business growth.

articleTitle: Automated emotion identification system utilizing EEG bands extracted via wavelet filter banks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, a new framework in order to identify the human emotions for three classes using the electroencephalogram (EEG) signals has been proposed. It is difficult to reliably and effectively identify different kinds of emotion from nonstationary EEG data. With the EEG recordings, appropriate signal processing and machine learning techniques can be used to design an automated system in order to identify human emotions. The proposed framework is evaluated through extensive experiments utilizing the SJTU Emotion EEG dataset (SEED). The EEG signal is decomposed into several bands by the wavelet filter banks technique. Then from each band, two features are computed which are wavelet energy and Shannon entropy, and then both features are fused to obtain a combined feature. By using support vector machine (SVM), the features are classified into various different emotion states such as positive, neutral, and negative. An accuracy of $\mathbf{8 4. 8 \%}$ is achieved for human emotion detection using EEG signals in the proposed framework. The proposed human emotion recognition algorithm finds applications in brain-computer interface, psychology, and human-machine interface fields.

articleTitle: Web-Based Facial Emotion Recognition System for Enhancing Social Interaction in Autistic Spectrum Disorder Children Using CNN & Flask Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The children with ASD have difficulty in showing empathy and also in recognizing and identifying emotions. This research introduces a web-based facial emotion recognition system designed to assist ASD children in recognizing and understanding emotions in others, ultimately enhancing their social skills. The system is implemented using the Flask web framework & CNN, providing a user-friendly interface for both children and caregivers or therapists. This study employs deep learning to detect face and analyze facial expressions and accurately classify emotion out of 6 emotions i.e., fear, angry, joy, natural, sadness, surprise displayed by individuals with ASD A CNN-based FER model trained on an autistic children dataset helps children with ASD recognize and understand facial emotions, a skill crucial for successful social interactions, targeting 6-12 year old. The CNN model has potential applications of FER in real-time social scenarios comparing with the existing methods like facial coding system, local binary pattern etc. our model aims to provide personalized and interactive learning environment where the facial emotions of children with ASD are detected through web cam during a learning session and unique emotion is detected which is graphically represented at the end of the session with the benefit of web based flask framework to assist educators, therapists to improve learning techniques, social skills among ASD children. Ultimately promoting a better quality of life for people who belong in the autistic spectrum.

articleTitle: Leveraging Large Vision Models for Terrain Classification in HiRISE Mars Orbital Images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmarking and comparative analysis of state-of-the-art Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures, including ViT, BEiT, DeiT, LeViT, and SwinV2, for the classification of HiRISE landmark images. Our study aims to evaluate the performance of these pre-trained models in categorizing images into seven predefined classes, with an additional “unknown” class to account for images that do not fit into these categories. By leveraging the advanced capabilities of transformer-based models, we seek to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of classifying high-resolution satellite imagery, a critical task in remote sensing and planetary exploration.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Advanced Large-Scale Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deep getting to know techniques have become increasingly more popular due to their potential to improve huge-scale records processing performance. Leveraging specialized hardware which includes GPUs, deep getting to know algorithms can attain mind-blowing pace will increase compared to traditional algorithms. further, deep gaining knowledge of fashions can discover complicated non-linear relationships in big datasets, permitting greater accurate overall performance and less fake predictions. Latest advances in deep mastering have enabled it to be implemented to remedy a plethora of information processing duties, from photo recognition to natural language processing. CNNs, RNNs, and GANs are a number of the maximum famous deep gaining knowledge of fashions used in tackling complex data processing obligations. agencies consisting of Google, fb, and Amazon use these sophisticated frameworks to build predictive models that help improve numerous programs. Deep getting to know strategies offer exquisite ability to take massive-scale information processing to the following stage. corporations are increasingly more becoming privy to the emerging opportunities, and actively investing in deep mastering to liberate the untapped strength of their information.

articleTitle: Optimizing Urban Transportation Using Big Data and Reinforcement Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There is no surprise that it is known that there have emerged several benefits as well as drawbacks with the progressive growth of industrialization, vehicles-be it public or private, as well as urban transit systems. Obviously, this issue is addressed to requite frustrating especially when there is a need to travel from once place to another within a particular period of time. Thankfully, this is where big data emerges into the frame to help reduce congestion and traffic problems in order to improve the approaches and efforts made towards optimizing transport by proposing a framework that makes use of collecting, aggregating and disseminating data from various kinds of sources. The fundamental approach towards achieving this is making use of reinforcement learning techniques-particularly the application of Deep Q Network Based Scheduling algorithm. By harnessing vast datasets, this algorithm dynamically optimizes traffic signal control, route planning, and resource allocation in real-time.

articleTitle: Secure Authentication Mechanism for AMF in 5G Nb-IoT devices
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the era of widespread data sharing and seamless connectivity facilitated by 5G networks, securing the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) has emerged as a critical imperative. With the proliferation of Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) devices, the vulnerability of the AMF poses high risks such as unauthorized access, data breaches, and service disruptions. This research addresses these challenges by devising a robust security mechanism utilizing asymmetric encryption, focusing on enhancing the authentication process for NB-IoT devices within 5G networks. [1] This study aims to fortify the AMF’s defenses against intruders by employing the RSA algorithm for asymmetric encryption, considering factors such as computational efficiency, scalability, and interoperability. By leveraging the robust security properties of RSA, the proposed mechanism ensures that only authorized devices can access the network, thus preserving the integrity and confidentiality of the data being transmitted. Additionally, this approach is designed to seamlessly integrate with existing 5G standards, providing a scalable and efficient solution for the ever-growing landscape of connected devices.

articleTitle: Automatic Assessment of Quadratic Equation Solutions Using MathBERT and RoBERTa Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This project aims to create a machine learning classification system that classifies solutions to quadratic equations into three different groups: ‘Incorrect,” ‘Partially Correct,” and “Correct.” MathBERT and RoBERTa embeddings are utilized in this system. A multi-class classification technique is used by the system, with an emphasis on feature engineering, data preparation, and model selection. To improve model performance, methods like Principal Component Analysis (PCA), LIME (Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations), and ensemble meta models with Boosting, Voting, and Stacking are used. The efficacy of many classification models in correctly classifying quadratic solutions is examined in this work. To evaluate the performance of the model, evaluation measures including F1-score, accuracy, precision, and recall are used. The results show that MathBERT embeddings outperform RoBERTa embeddings. Ensemble models, especially those that include SVM and MLP classifiers, achieve the best performance, with the stacking approach yielding an accuracy of approximately 65%. This model accurately classifies solutions into the correct categories, demonstrating the potential for practical applications in mathematics education.

articleTitle: Proactive Market Crash Prediction: Investigating GNN-LSTM Networks for Early Detection in Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study examines the combination of graph-based representations with sequential modeling approaches to improve early detection mechanisms, with a focus on the possibility of GNN-LSTM networks for proactive market crash prediction in stock markets. The purpose of this research is to determine if Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) combined with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can effectively anticipate market crashes in advance in stock markets. The necessity for strong early detection techniques is underscored by the substantial dangers that market collapses represent to investors and financial stability. The stock market is represented as a graph using GNNs, with each stock being a node connected to other nodes depending on interactions like co-movements or correlation. GNNs learn embeddings for every node through iterative updates, capturing the inherent characteristics of the stocks as well as their interactions with one another within the market. In the meanwhile, temporal relationships and sequential patterns in stock market data are modeled using LSTM networks. Because LSTMs are so good at capturing the many temporal patterns and trends found in time-series data, they are a good choice for predicting future moves in the market. Combining GNNs with LSTMs provides a complementary method for anticipating market crashes in advance. The study employs historical stock market data to train and evaluate the GNN-LSTM model, utilizing appropriate evaluation metrics to assess its performance. The proposed method is implemented in Python software and has an accuracy of about 99.12% which is 1.49% higher than other existing methods like Conv-LSTM, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-LSTM, and CNN-GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit). The findings of this research have implications for investors, financial institutions, and policymakers, providing insights into proactive risk management strategies and decision-making processes in response to evolving market conditions. Overall, the investigation contributes to the advancement of predictive modeling techniques for early detection in stock markets, enhancing financial stability and investor confidence.

articleTitle: Employing Algorithms For Machine Learning, Anomalies in Automated Contexts Can Be Detected
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In multiple industry domains, the analysis of time series information gathered by autonomous vehicles is receiving greater scrutiny. Recognizing how a specific vehicle senses the external environment is crucial when multiple ones move around a space to carry out certain tasks. This study examines how algorithms for machine learning can be employed for analyzing autonomous input that includes different viewpoints of the environment. A deposit of contraption learning algorithms have been used to classify autonomous settings using information collected by the sensors mounted on the bodies of autonomous vehicle, and their performances have been compared. Using a test environment where some of the stuff are shifted around or taken out of their intended locations, the contraption learning model is tested.

articleTitle: Study of Direction of Arrival Estimation with a Differential Microphone Array using MVDR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Directional reception of a radiating source using beamforming algorithms and microphone arrays is a popular approach used for a wide range of real-time applications such as speech acoustics, source localization, teleconferencing, hearing aids, etc. The compact microphone array is gaining increasing relevance within the realm of consumer electronics. However, the limited aperture of this compact array often constrains the effectiveness of traditional Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation techniques. In contrast, there has been a recent surge of interest in the Differential Microphone Array (DMA). The DMA provides miniature dimension, high directionality and boasts frequency-independent beampatterns. In this paper, we present a comprehensive analysis of the minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) technique for a linear DMA geometry in the context of DOA estimation. For narrowband tonal signals, a single source-single interference scenario has been studied with respect to a number of performance metrics. The inverse relationship between mean square error (MSE) and input SNR (iSNR) is discussed and validated through simulations. Furthermore, a case study for DOA estimation of a realistic broadband speech application using DMA geometry is presented which has not been studied earlier in our knowledge. Simulation results show that DMA offers a substantial reduction in overall array size as compared to linear arrays with similar DOA performance.

articleTitle: Enhanced Slicing based Deep Learning architecture for 5G networks in Distributed Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper gives a distributed deep getting-to-know (DDL) architecture for 5 G community cutting. DDL is an allotted method which has been a success in schooling massive-scale deep mastering fashions. It applies the ideas of disbursed computing to reduce the dimensions of the statistics being trained at the same time as education samples in parallel on different computing assets. The proposed solution in this paper exploits the improvements in 5G networks’ virtualization skills, which include community cutting, to provide a green architecture which allows DDL fashions to be taught with dispensed resources to limit the training time. The proposed structure consists of three predominant modules: a useful resource-cutting manager, a dispensed training cluster, and a dispensed inference cluster. The resource-reducing manager allows dynamic aid cutting throughout numerous assets (e.g. GPU, CPU). The distributed schooling cluster includes workers distributing the training duties across the sources. The allotted inference cluster is used to perform inference on the trained fashions throughout more than one allotted computing source. The advantages of the proposed structure are that it allows green disbursed schooling, green disbursed inference, and value-green education of complex deep gaining knowledge of models. As such, it may be used to educate huge and complex models with decreased prices and also boost the schooling throughput. Additionally, 5G community cutting presents flexibility in useful resource provision.

articleTitle: Advanced Handwriting Recognition System for Handwritten Scripts With AutoCorrect Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The goal of this project is to accurately digitize a variety of handwritten texts in order to address the problem of handwriting recognition (HR). Because handwritten scripts are inherently complex and handwriting styles vary widely existing HR systems frequently face challenges. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are used for accurate feature extraction and recurrent neural networks (RNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) cells are used for effective sequence learning in our sophisticated HR system. Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) improves the system even more by facilitating efficient alignment of text sequences. With the addition of AutoCorrect features our study shows a noteworthy improvement in HR accuracy with a character error rate (CER) of 8% and a word error rate (WER) of 12%. This is a significant improvement over the initial 15 percent CER and 20 percent WER before AutoCorrect was integrated. The robustness and efficiency of the system were demonstrated by these metrics which underwent extensive testing on a complex and diverse dataset.

articleTitle: Ameliorative effect of Curcumin on sodium arsenite-induced uterine-ovarian toxicity in rats: An in vivo dose dependent manner
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Arsenic is a deadly poison that affects millions of people world-wide. Inorganic arsenic exposure results in a variety of health problems, including skin lesions, hypertension, haematological instability, female and reproductive problems and cancer. Curcumin a significant phenolic compound, has a variety of pharmacological actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and free radical scavenging properties. The present study investigated effects of Curcumin at different doses against sodium arsenite (SA)-induced uterine-ovarian and hemato-toxicity. Thirty (30) Female Wister rats were randomly assigned into five groups of six rats each. Group 1 received normal water and Group II rats were given the sodium arsenite ($10 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{Kg} \mathrm{BW}$) orally for 8 days. Animals in Group-III, Group-IV and Group-V were treated sodium arsenite with curcumin at the different doses of Cur ($15 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{Kg}$ BW, ($20 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{Kg}$ BW) and $25 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{Kg}$ BW) respectively for 8 days. Here the most effective doses at Curcumin (20 mg and $25 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{Kg}$ BW) significantly improved SA induced uterine lipid peroxidation state and ROS generation by the re-establishment of Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities. Furthermore, Curcumin improved SA-induced steroidogenesis activities, alteration in haematological and histopathological parameters by controlling LH, FSH and estradiol levels and reduced SAinduced elevation of serum LDH activity. Our results suggest that Curcumin at the doses at Curcumin (20 mg and $25 \mathrm{mg} / \mathbf{K g}$ BW) inhibits SA-induced uterine-ovarian- and hematotoxicity through reducing oxidative stress.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quality Control in the Age of Industry 4.0 through Real-Time Automation and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Industry 4.0 has transformed industries, with intelligent and automated systems introduced into the manufacturing process on a larger scale. But this shift introduces problems of scale that still need to be solved using traditional quality control measures - manual inspections may take time and leave space for human error. Summary: This paper introduces a new solution for improving quality control in the era of Industry 4.0 using real-time automation and extensive data analysis as an abstract. This eliminates human error and ensures that all inspections are performed in the same way to produce consistent and accurate results. Moreover, the information from these automated activities can be examined in genuine time for repetition and real-time anomaly identification, helping to maintain adequate quality control action. To sum up, using real-time automation and big data analysis can significantly improve quality control by ensuring that products are sent off on time in top working conditions under Industry 4.0 methodological processes. This benefit is a better quality product and more productivity and cost-effectiveness for industries from manufacturing the products.

articleTitle: SightSpeak Object detection and speech generation for visually challenged people.
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This novel approach is to enhance accessibility for visually impaired individuals by integrating object detection and speech generation using YOLOv5 model on the COCO dataset, along with gtts for speech generation. The proposed system, named SightSpeak, aims to assist Konkani speakers in Goa by providing real-time auditory feedback about their surroundings. Through extensive data collection and analysis, the system identifies various common objects crucial for navigation. Employing YOLOv5 for object detection enables efficient processing and accurate recognition of objects in images. The system further utilizes Google Text-to-Speech to generate spoken descriptions of detected objects in Konkani, ensuring usability for the target user group. Evaluation metrics including precision, recall, and mean average precision (mAP) and MOS which validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in delivering timely and relevant auditory cues to aid navigation and enhance the independence of visually impaired individuals in Goa.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cloud Resources using Algorithmic Approaches in Serverless Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Serverless computing is a cloud computing model that lets applications development process to center on the development of the business logic and no longer concern with managing the underlying infrastructure which allows developers to innovates and to deploy the application functions faster to customers. The property in use by serverless systems, along with AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, and Microsoft Azure functions can be made extra green while optimizing via algorithmic methods with the goal of the higher overall performance of the function for decrease value. To make the best use of resources in a Cloud, and keep the cost to as low as possible, individual scheduling on each cloud resource would be identified as a limited amount of code on the Cloud resource will be executed to support a programming language. Moreover, other algorithms such as K-means clustering, queuing algorithms, as well as assignment scheduling, and cargo balancing can also be used for event allocation and scheduling in the cloud. Heuristics, such as gripping algorithms, simulated annealing and genetic algorithms can also be used to reduce the serverless computing costs. Ultimately, algorithmic techniques can be applied to serverless computing to maximize what the cloud does best and minimize the price.

articleTitle: Sustainable Climate Change Predictions: Linear Regression Modeling of Temperature Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Among the most urgent problems confronting humanity today is climate change. Climate change is a pressing global issue, with the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) estimating that human activity is responsible for over half of the observed rise in global temperature between 1951 and 2010. By the end of the 21st century, the IPCC predicts a 1.5 to 4.5 degree Celsius rise in global surface temperature, depending on greenhouse gas emissions. Time and temperature are the relevant variables in this scenario. Future temperature changes can be predicted by fitting a linear regression model to historical temperature data. To forecast future climate change, a number of studies have used linear regression modeling. Linear regression analysis is a method for forecasting future climate change, involving finding relationships between variables such as time and temperature. Studies have shown that even with significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions, the average global temperature is predicted to rise by 2.2 degrees Celsius by the end of the 21st century. If emissions are not reduced, the average global temperature could rise by up to 6 degrees Celsius by the end of the 21st century. However, linear regression modeling’s accuracy depends on factors such as past data accessibility, assumptions about temperature-time relationships, and the model’s ability to consider additional variables like shifting ocean currents and land use. Despite these limitations, linear regression modeling remains a useful tool for projecting future temperatures and understanding the potential consequences of climate change.

articleTitle: Unraveling Diabetes Detection: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The core focus of our work has been the utilization of Machine Learning (ML) to examine healthcare, with the main aim of recognizing early diabetes cases. Giving an early diagnosis of diabetes to prevent the growth of serious complications is the main task to achieve for a thorough treatment of the problem. Diabetes, being a chronic and enduring condition, presents a significant global challenge, being a primary contributor to premature mortality. In this work, we employed ML and statistical methodologies namely Decision Trees (DT), k-Nearest Neighbours (kNN), Naive Bayes (NB), Random Forest Classifier (RFC), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to conduct a comparative evaluation of these modeling forecasts as an essential tool for diabetes diagnosis. While keeping the experimentation and evaluation rigorous, we study how successful the models are and their advantages and disadvantages within the healthcare field. We aim to disseminate findings that represent the practical applications within a real-world healthcare system. Moreover, it forms the foundation for individualized blood sugar diagnosis and therapy, ultimately enhancing mental well-being. By accomplishing these steps, personalized medicine could potentially offer a solution for diabetes treatment in the future.

articleTitle: Exploring the Possibilities of Benchmarking Deep Learning Algorithms for Natural Language Processing in Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical abstract explores the possibilities of benchmarking deep getting-to-know algorithms for herbal Language Processing (NLP) in scientific programs. When exploring the capacity of NLP in medical packages, deep getting-to-know algorithms, including recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are carried out especially properly. Such algorithms cannot best apprehend textual content in its entirety; however additionally account for textual variances, with the intention to produce accurate output for each express and implicit capability within a dataset. This takes a look at the benchmarking of deep studying algorithms, and their performance in scientific packages is explored as regards primary assessment standards: the effectiveness and efficiency of the set of rules. To this quit, more than a few benchmarking equipment are used to talk about the outcomes from numerous experiments performed successfully. Through measuring the performance of the algorithms on various datasets, the most reliable algorithm for a selected clinical utility may be determined. This look provides the know-how of benchmarking deep getting-to-know algorithms and the use of these algorithms in scientific applications.

articleTitle: Mitigating the Proliferation of Counterfeits using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the field of store networks the board has long wrestled with issues in regard to overt repetitiveness in administrations, absence of coordination among different businesses, and an absence of normalization, essentially because of the innate absence of straightforwardness.
