articleTitle: Exploring Data Mining Techniques for Early Autism Detection using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Autism, a neurological disorder, manifests uniquely in areas such as verbal and nonverbal communication, social interactions, behavioral adaptability, and specific interests. The results collected indicate that health professionals should receive more training in areas like psychology and developmental disorders and be able to detect Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) at a much earlier stage. They also provide pertinent information for reflection on the methods currently employed in evaluating children’s development and diagnosing ASD. This study collects information from a specific set of children with autism spectrum disorder from kaggle and is based on real, up-to-date facts. The input and output dataset will have certain common characteristics that will determine whether or not a child currently has ASD or has any signs of the same shortly. Random Forests, also known as Random Decision Forests, is a widely used ensemble learning method for tasks like classification and regression. This technique operates by constructing numerous decision trees during the training process. This classification is used to classify the dataset collected, into categories and hence segregate the children examined as “with” and “without” ASD with high accuracy about $88 \%$.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Viability of Blockchain Adoption for Healthcare: A Feasibility Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blockchain technology holds several exciting features such as security, decentralization, data integrity, access control, consent management, etc. The healthcare industry can reach its peak with the emergence of blockchain technology in terms of an efficient Electronic Health Record (EHR) Management System. This research paper explores the feasibility of implementing blockchain to improve the existing healthcare record management system and enable better data security, interoperability, data integrity, and patient consent management. The research thoroughly addresses issues in various articles, including data privacy, regulatory compliance, and scalability, and proposes blockchain recommendations. The paper will feature a comprehensive analysis of the prospects of decentralization, which can facilitate data exchange and improve interoperability among various systems. By thoroughly analyzing the potential advantages and vulnerabilities in the existing system, this research will provide a holistic understanding of the blockchain’s contribution to bringing about a revolution in the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Classification using Multi-Sequence MRI’s: An Ensemble Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Epilepsy is a major threat, when it comes to human health. Classifying brain anomalies on MR images as a pathological clue of Epilepsy is crucial for diagnosis. Electroencephalography (EEG) and Magnetic resonance (MR) imaging are only two of the diagnostic tools that have been proposed for use in screening for epileptic seizures. The diagnosis can be made with the use of many MR images taken at different times by a neuroradiologist. The dataset under consideration is comprised of axial multi-sequences of MR images, and it features both epileptic and nonepileptic aberrant brain structures from a wide range of people. This article performs a comparative study among the models - CNN, MobileNet, InceptionV3, VGG16, VGG19, LSTM, GRU and also the Ensemble models - ‘CNN + MobileNet’, ‘VGG16 + LSTM’, ‘VGG16 + GRU’, ‘VGG19 + LSTM’ and ‘VGG19 + GRU’. The Epilepsy prediction for user upload images is achieved through an ensemble approach. We have demonstrated the effectiveness of these models in correctly detecting epileptic patients based on multi-sequence MRI data by achieving extremely accurate and robust classification findings through extended experimentation. The experiments demonstrated the classification best accuracy of 97.16% for ‘VGG19 + LSTM’, while the lowest score was 69.93 for InceptionV3 among all the twelve models.

articleTitle: Global Stock Market Prediction Using Transformer-Based Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deep learning approaches’ use in financial market forecasting has recently drawn a lot of attention from both investors and scholars. The Transformer framework, initially created for natural language processing, is used in this study to propose a revolutionary approach for forecasting the stock market indices of seven different economies: China, Canada, India, Japan, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The well-known Transformer architecture, which excels at capturing complex non-linear patterns, is modified to study the unique dynamics of each nation’s stock market. The model successfully determines the basic principles driving market behavior by using an encoder-decoder structure and a multi-head attention mechanism. The aforementioned indices are used in back-testing trials, which cover a variety of economic environments. The outcomes demonstrate that the Transformer performs better than conventional techniques, with Mean Squared Error (MSE) acting as a crucial evaluation criterion. Notably, the model shows promise for investors in these widely separated markets to receive excess profits. This study offers a thorough analysis of stock market forecasting, expanding its relevance to a wider global context. comprehension of how this strategy might adjust to various financial ecosystems is improved by the addition of seven unique economies. Future research may go more deeply into applications that are industry-specific and investigate potential extensions to additional international markets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Identifying and Validating Document Authenticity
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The aim of the study is to identify and validate information authenticity using machine learning (ML). The primary objective is to develop a robust model capable of accurately distinguishing between authentic and fraudulent documents. To achieve this, the study employs advanced techniques such as Res-Net 50, a deep learning architecture renowned for its image classification prowess, and SHA-256 cryptography, a secure hashing algorithm. The impressive outcomes of the model are showcased by its remarkable achievements, boasting a $99.26\%$ accuracy level. This accomplishment is clearly reflected in both the confusion matrix and the classification report. This study underscores the potential of combining Res-Net 50 and SHA-256 cryptography in crafting a potent solution for identifying and validating document authenticity, with far-reaching implications for fraud detection and document verification processes.

articleTitle: Scale Invariant Feature Modelling with Integrated Transfer Learning for Parkinson’s Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A common brain illness known as Parkinson’s Disease (PD) has been a topic of research for decades. The disease, well known for causing several impairments, affecting daily life activities of the sufferers need promising treatments to reduce the agony of the patients. Since, there are no known cures and proved underlying causes for this disease, diagnosing it at an early stage becomes a challenge. AI based solutions have proven out to serve as a potential approach for the early-stage diagnosis of the disease. Several types of datasets comprising of genetic data, clinical data, medical image, voice samples and hand-drawings are being utilized for training these AI based solutions. However, there exists a few problems which are not yet addressed: a. lack of models trained on hand drawings dataset having different categories of shapes, b. lack of scale invariant feature modelling, c. lack of study combining high level features and scale invariant features. This work proposes a solution to these issues by employing a model capable of extracting both scale invariant and high-level features from a hand-drawn image dataset having various shapes which are finally classified using a dense layer. When evaluating, the model has outperformed the existing best solutions for the considered performance metrics.

articleTitle: Track Damage And Obstacle Detection Using Multi Sensor Fusion Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into railway track monitoring systems marks a pivotal advancement in ensuring the safety and efficiency of railway operations. Through strategic deployment of sensors along the tracks, this innovative system offers real-time detection of obstacles, furnishing vital data for timely intervention to avert potential accidents. This capability not only elevates passenger and crew safety but also bolsters the reliability of railway transportation systems as a whole. The system constantly scans the track ahead of the train for any anomalies using sensors positioned toward the front of the vehicle. The system immediately notifies the application faults it detects, enabling prompt action. Additionally, it updates the status of an IoT platform and displays it for personnel on board via an LCD panel. An audio alarm is generated in the event of critical sensor readings to ensure prompt attention. By lowering potential risks and responding quickly to track problems, This IoT-based solution holds the promise of revolutionizing railway operations by furnishing augmented safety, efficiency, and reliability, thereby addressing the burgeoning demands of contemporary transportation infrastructure.

articleTitle: From Perception to Action: Building a Robust AI System for Safe and Adaptive Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study explores the development of a self-driving car using a combination of deep learning (DL), machine learning (ML), computer vision (CV), and convolutional neural networks (CNN). The proposed system aims to simulate human-like decision making in response to external conditions encountered during autonomous driving. The approach involves real-time on-road testing and a self-training mechanism to enable the car to continuously learn and adapt. Furthermore, the text suggests an investigation into the fundamental principles of artificial intelligence (AI) and their role in the autonomous car’s functionality.

articleTitle: Enhanced Keyword Search Optimization in E-Learning Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multi-keyword search functionality as an enhancement to e-learning systems may facilitate the retrieval of instructional resources more efficiently, according to this study. It is more essential than ever for students to be able to efficiently navigate digital materials, as an increasing number of institutions offer online courses. To achieve this, researchers employ a combination of sophisticated machine learning models and preprocessing techniques, including TF-IDF and Named Entity Recognition (NER), as well as Decision Trees (DT), Random Forest (RF), and Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM). The efficacy of the Decision Tree model, which integrates TF-IDF and NER, has been ascertained through exhaustive testing and evaluation. The system attains an exceptional accuracy rate of 98.45%. The results of the research are additionally corroborated by the high $\mathbf{F 1}$ scores of $\mathbf{0. 9 3}$ for overall model performance, $\mathbf{0. 9 6}$ for precision, and 0.98 for recall. The results of this study underscore the importance of integrating sophisticated search techniques into e-learning platforms to guarantee that users can obtain tailored and efficient learning experiences. The findings from this research enhance the visibility and pertinence of scholarly materials, thereby supporting the continuous expansion of online education platforms.

articleTitle: Quantum and AI-Enhanced Digital Twin Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital computers have transformed human contact, employment, and time management, yet they have limits in drug development. Classical computers can only hold one piece of data at a time, making it impossible to replicate complicated chemical and biological processes. In contrast, quantum computing constructs physical theories with particles such as electrons or photons. Despite these limits, digital computers continue to play an important role when paired with AI, machine learning, and quantum computing. Digital Twin Systems (DTS) are more extensive and integrated uses of digital twin technology that include entire systems or networks rather than just one physical object. This paper compares various DTS and highlights challenges with those DTS.

articleTitle: A Novel approach for detecting Fibroids in Uterus using Deep Learning models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Uterine fibroids are non-cancerous growths in a woman’s uterus and are estimated to occur in 70-80% of women by age 50. Symptoms include heavy menstrual bleeding, pelvic pain, and frequent urination, with complications of anemia, infertility, and reduced quality of life. Deep learning models are being used in many fields like health care, education and so on. Our project, therefore, will focus on the detection of uterine fibroids using deep learning models: CNN, ResNet50, VGG16, InceptionV3, and DCGAN. Although imbalance in the dataset is a problem, we handle it using balancing via SMOTE. They are heterogeneous in appearance, which challenges their detection. Uterine fibroids are thus among the most common complaints for women. We thus employ a variety of deep learning architectures and dataset balancing techniques in order to increase fibroid detection accuracy. Looking at the results, there is promise with increased accuracy and sensitivity-an encouraging sign of our approach in improving diagnostic outcomes for uterine fibroids. Based on the results the most accurate model after balancing the dataset is CNN with an accuracy of $94.843 \%$.

articleTitle: Bridging the Language Gap: Enhancing English-to-Telugu Translation using NMT and Encoding Decoding Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Language translation, particularly in the context of natural language processing, involves converting text or speech from one language into another while preserving its meaning, context, and cultural nuances. This task is critical for enabling communication across different languages and is a significant area of research and development in artificial intelligence. Machine translation has a wide range of real-time applications that have significantly impacted various fields by bridging language barriers. Some of the real time application includes Google Translate, Microsoft Translator, Skype Translator. NMT has revolutionized language translation with models like Google’s Transformer, OpenAI’s GPT, Facebook’s BART, and Google’s T5. Development of a machine translation system to translate English sentences into Telugu. The system utilizes a neural network model based on an encoder-decoder architecture with attention mechanism. Preprocessing techniques are applied to the dataset, including lowercasing, removal of special characters, and tokenization. The sparse categorical cross-entropy loss function and Adam optimizer are used to train the model. The actual vs. projected output is used to evaluate performance. Pre-trained GloVe word embeddings are used in the implementation to improve the model’s capacity to extract semantic information.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Approach to Tuberculosis Prediction using Shenzhen and Montgomery Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Chest X-rays are critical for detecting a variety of lung disorders, with tuberculosis (TB) being a particular priority due to its global impact on public health. TB must be identified quickly and accurately using medical imaging to begin treatment and stop the spread of the illness. This work examines the importance of chest X -ray analysis and its role in TB identification. A novel convolutional neural network (CNN) based ensemble approach is proposed, thoroughly investigating the performance of state-of-the-art sophisticated deep learning models, such as Xception, InceptionV3, DenseNet201, ResNet50, EfficientNetB2, ResNet50-InceptionV3, EfficientNetB2-Xception, DenseNet201-Xception, and DenseNet201-InceptionV3, for differentiating between normal and tuberculosis-affected chest X-rays. The standard Shenzhen and Montgomery datasets were used for training and testing the efficacy of the proposed model. The findings of this study promote the development of accurate and effective TB detection technologies, ultimately enhancing global efforts to combat this deadly illness. Notably, the DenseNet201InceptionV3 ensemble produced the best results for TB detection, achieving a precision of 0.91, a recall of 0.85, an F score of 0.89, and an accuracy of 95.14%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Road Safety Through Intelligent Lane Detection and Driver Drowsiness Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The innovative system outlined in the provided research demonstrates a significant stride towards addressing the growing concern of road safety. Lane departure and driver drowsiness are two major causes of road accidents. In this paper, we present an observation of road lane and drowsiness detection system that uses a camera to capture real-time video footage of the road ahead and applies image processing techniques to detect and track road lanes. The system’s road lane detection module employs the canny edge detection algorithm and Hough transform to detect lane lines accurately. The drowsiness detection module of the system analyzes the driver’s facial features and tracks the driver’s eye movements, blink frequency to identify signs of drowsiness. If the driver found to be sleepy, it issues an audio alert to the driver. The system’s capability to detect and track road lanes with precision, along with its ability to identify signs of driver drowsiness, underscores its potential as a promising solution for enhancing road safety.

articleTitle: Perception System of Autonomous Vehicles: Sophisticated Attacks, Defense Strategies, and Future Directions

The security of perception systems against malicious attacks is a critical concern. This work thoroughly analyzes the vulnerabilities inherent in the perception systems of autonomous vehicles, examining the multifaceted threats posed by adversaries. The crucial need for ongoing research in AV security is underscored and a framework for future investigations to develop more secure and trustworthy autonomous vehicles is provided. The analysis emphasizes the importance of a proactive approach to security, advocating for integrating advanced defense mechanisms as a fundamental component of autonomous vehicle design and development and future research challenges.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effects of AI-Driven Systems on Data Science Automation

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Type- II Diabetes Mellitus in Young Adults using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus Type II (T2DM) is a major global health concern, with a growing prevalence among young adults. Early detection of T2DM is imperative for mitigating long-term complications and the conventional diagnostic methods often lag in the prediction of T2DM leading to T2DM progression. Therefore, it is necessary for advanced techniques in early and non-invasive prediction to be implemented for early prediction of T2DM. Leveraging Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, this research explores the efficacy of deep learning in T2DM prognosis among young adults. For this objective, real-world datasets from young adult populations were employed for evaluation, demonstrating compelling results with a training accuracy of 1.0 and 0.98 for the testing dataset. The results displayed significant potential of LSTM networks in the early T2DM detection. Present work adds to the growing database of research related to the application of deep learning for decisive disease detection with opportunities for better investigation into the integration of various biomarkers and deep learning architectures. Lastly, the study focused on the incorporation of clinical decision support systems and assists in the process of empowering healthcare practitioners with actionable insights for personalized interventions in young adults at risk of T2DM.

articleTitle: Improvising energy efficiency of heterogeneous servers using AWS services and Machine Learning approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid expansion of data centers has led to a substantial increase in energy consumption, prompting a need for more energy-efficient solutions. This paper presents a comprehensive approach to enhancing the energy efficiency of heterogeneous servers by leveraging Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Our proposed solution involves developing an ML model that uses a dataset of VM cloud which consists of various parameters like the cloud ID, timestamp, CPU performance, memory usage, network traffic, energy efficiency and so on. The model uses regression algorithms like Linear Regression, Decision Tree Regressor, K-Neighbor Regressor, Polynomial Regression, and AdaBoost Regressor to predict the energy-efficiency of a system based on the relevant features. The model will be evaluated on the basis of Mean Absolute Error, Mean Squared Error, Root Mean Squared Error, R2 Score, and Mean Absolute Percentage Error and Linear Regression model is noted to provide the least error scores. This model helps in reducing server workloads and dynamically manages resource allocation to minimize energy usage while maintaining optimal performance. The developed ML model is then deployed on the AWS EC2 free tier instance by encapsulating the ML models within a Docker container. This study provides a scalable and economical approach to enhance the energy efficiency in the data centers, with a potential impact on the wide range of cloud -based infrastructures.

articleTitle: Secure Data Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Ad Hoc Networks using Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wi-Fi Sensor advert Hoc Networks (WSANs) are susceptible to facts tampering attacks due to the big scale and open verbal exchange between specific nodes. An aggregator node collects records from multiple sensor nodes in a WSAN, and this information can be tampered or manipulated if the aggregator isn’t secured efficiently. On this paper, we suggest a secure information aggregation protocol the usage of homomorphism encryption (HE) for WSANs. The proposed protocol utilizes the additive homomorphism homes of HEs to soundly combination the sensor facts in an allotted fashion without losing confidentiality. The benefits of the proposed protocol encompass the capacity to defend against records tampering, confidentiality, and scalability to large wide variety of nodes. The capability applications of this protocol range from relaxed facts series in crisis relief operations, to massive data analytics in net of factors (IoT). We additionally speak the capacity demanding situations associated with implementing the proposed protocol.

articleTitle: Examining the Impact of Information Security Models on Resilience of Networked Applications

articleTitle: Optimizing Real-Time Process Control through Cloud-Based Automation and Big Data Analysis

articleTitle: From Problem Descriptions to User Stories: Utilizing Large Language Models through Prompt Chaining
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In software development, generating user stories from problem descriptions plays a key role in understanding and implementing user needs. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task holds immense potential in streamlining the process and improving the accuracy of user story extraction. This paper presents a novel approach, utilizing prompt chaining with LLMs to transform problem descriptions into user stories. The primary focus is extracting the ‘who,’ ‘what,’ and optional ‘why’ components of user stories from specifications of the domain written in natural language (NL). The proposed method involves a four-step prompt chaining strategy that includes identifying roles, grouping functionalities based on roles, determining the rationale behind each role’s functionalities, and, finally, crafting user stories in the Connextra notation. Evaluation of problem descriptions of five different systems demonstrated the effectiveness of the approach in accurately extracting Roles and Functions of user stories. The results showcased high average precision (94%), recall ($\mathbf{8 9 \%}$), and F1 scores (91%), indicating a strong alignment between the extracted user stories and the Gold Standard. The results indicate that the proposed method holds significant promise for expediting requirement analysis and software development processes.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Sensor Data using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our research investigates the application of single-class Support Vector Machine (SVM) for anomaly detection, which is critical for predictive maintenance. The study utilizes real-world datasets to validate the effectiveness of these methodologies in accurately distinguishing between normal and anomalous data points that indicate potential machine health issues. It examines the effects of varying anomaly proportions and noise levels, one-class classifiers, and anomaly scoring thresholds can significantly enhance predictive maintenance capabilities. The results demonstrate that these approaches facilitate early fault detection, allowing for timely interventions and reducing unplanned downtime, ultimately improving machine reliability and maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: IoT and Tele-Communication Networks: Opportunities for Industry 4.0

articleTitle: Resilience in Remote Sensing Image Classification: Evaluating Deep Learning Models Against Adversarial Attacks

abstract: In the domain of Remote Sensing Image Classification, achieving high accuracy is of utmost importance. This proposed article embarks a wide-ranging comparative study, employing the state-of-the-art deep learning models including ResNet, DenseNet, EfficientNet, VGG16, and InceptionV3, precisely evaluated on the remote sensing datasets such as EuroSAT, UCMerced-LandUse, and NWPURESISC45. Traditional evaluation metrics, including Accuracy, Precision, F1 Score, Recall and Loss are used to evaluate the test data. The study reveals that DenseNet model achieves the highest accuracy across all datasets with an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 8 8 \%}$ on EuroSAT, 95.95% on UCMerced-LandUse, and $89.80 \%$ on NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrating its robust performance without attacks. Extending the analysis, adversarial attacks such as Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM), Iterative - Fast Gradient Sign Method (I-FGSM), Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), and Carlini and Wagner (C&W) are introduced to assess the deep learning-based models’ robustness. The attacks on the aforementioned datasets reveal insights into the models’ vulnerabilities and resilience. The DenseNet model that performed well before attacks was compromised after the attacks with an accuracy of $54.14 \%$ on EuroSAT, $75.29 \%$ on UCMerced-LandUse, and $41.20 \%$ on NWPU-RESISC45, revealing its vulnerability to attacks. The other models also show a significant decrease in accuracy after attacks, highlighting the need for robustness enhancement in remote sensing image classification. This research forms the groundwork for establishing the fact that the introduction of adversarial attacks reduce the classification accuracy considerably and enhancing the classification accuracy in remote sensing images by fortifying model robustness is an important pursuit in a period where remote sensing technology expands its role in environmental monitoring, calamity management, urban planning and development, climate change studies and other applications demanding reliable and accurate classification systems.

articleTitle: Balanced Truncation Constrained Order Reduction of Complex Power Systems using Moth Flame Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this article, a novel methodology has been proposed which combines the advantages of the Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) and the classical balanced truncation technique, in reducing the order of complex high-order power systems. Firstly, the balanced truncated model is obtained whose coefficients serve as base values and allows selecting lower and upper bounds for the MFO algorithm in a well-defined way. The MFO algorithm optimizes the coefficients of the desired reduced-order system. Further, the gain adjustment is performed to avoid any steady-state error in the desired reduced-order system. The proposed strategy has been tested on $4^{\text {th }}$ and $6^{\text {th }}$ order power system models which exhibit complex poles and combination of real and complex poles, respectively. The high-order models have been reduced to their respective $2^{\text {nd }}$ order models which are proven to be efficient in terms of lowest integral square error, better matching of time and frequency domain specifications and preservation of stability. Further, the proposed methodology takes very less simulation time and maintains steady-state response close to that of the original system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agricultural Quality Control: Freshness Detection in Root Vegetables Through Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In monarchy agricultural technology, this research pioneers the classification of freshness in root vegetables, a field that has been abruptly neglected in earlier research on a variety of vegetables. This study addresses this research gap and employs a transfer learning-based system to swiftly determine the freshness of root vegetables through images. To conduct this research, we create our own dataset which contains six different vegetables, “Potato”, “Radish”, “Carrot”, “Onion”, “Taro”, and “Turnip”. Vegetables were collected from the local market and clicked manually by personal mobile phone, giving the dataset authenticity and real-world application. In total we collect 6384 images, divided into 3 classes: “Fresh”, “Aged” and “Rotten” based on their physical attributes and texture. Different types of transfer learning model VGG19, ResNet50, InceptionResNetV2 and DenseNet201 used to classify freshness of root vegetables. Although every model achieved decent accuracy, DenseNet201 achieved a remarkable result. DenseNet201achived highest accuracy 98.75% where data loss was 0.02%. Conversely, though ResNet50 achieved lowest accuracy 60.97% among all models. The variety of algorithms used seeks to determine the best course of action for this particular agricultural setting in addition to precisely classifying freshness. This research not only defines a novel benchmark but also sets the stage for future explorations in agricultural technology, ushering in a new era of precision farming for root vegetables

articleTitle: Steganographic Data Encryption Technique using Hyperspectral Imaging: A Deceptive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this age of rapid digitalization, secure storage and transmission of sensitive data have become crucial. This study introduces a novel encryption technology that embeds critical data within a hyperspectral image (HSI) to ensure secure storage and transmission. The technology takes advantage of hyperspectral images’ complex, high-dimensional nature to conceal the underlying data, successfully shielding it from unauthorized users. By combining encryption and steganography, sensitive data is masked so that even if the image is intercepted, it seems to be a typical hyperspectral image with no visible anomalies. This deceptive strategy confuses attackers, making it extremely difficult to determine the presence of encrypted data, let alone where it’s located within the image. Furthermore, the data is connected to a unique key, providing an additional layer of protection. Without this key, any attempts to decode the data will fail, adding an extra layer of security against unauthorized access. This research investigates the use of hyperspectral images as a medium for secure data transmission and storage, presenting a strong solution for protecting sensitive information in various applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Content Security Policy Generation at Client-Side to Mitigate XSS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks are a major threat to web applications and have consistently ranked among the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Attackers can inject malicious scripts that execute within a user’s browser. Server-side Content Security Policies (CSPs) offer some protection, but their static nature makes them ineffective when dealing with dynamic content and a very small percentage of web application use. This paper explores dynamically generated CSPs on the client side. This approach overcomes the limitations of traditional CSPs and provides a more robust defense against XSS attacks.

articleTitle: Modified Shuffled Complex Evolution Algorithm for Energy Efficiency in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Energy consumption stands as a pivotal factor in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), drawing significant attention across multiple domains. Recent studies find that, the limited availability of vital resource has been one of the challenges posed by energy consumption in WSNs. The operational functionality of sensor nodes depends on the energy reserved in WSN. Maximizing the network’s lifespan necessitates effective mitigation of energy consumption. In clustered WSNs, the cluster head, serving as the leader, undertakes various tasks including data collection from member nodes, data accumulation, and communication with the base station. Consequently, ensuring the load balancing within WSNs emerges as a crucial task for extending network longevity. To tackle this challenge, this paper employs the modifications in the Shuffled Complex Evolution (MSCE) algorithm. Additionally, a novel fitness function is designed to assess the effectiveness of solutions generated by the SCE algorithm. Through simulation, the proposed MSCE algorithm is compared against existing state-of-the-art algorithms. Experimental results shows the out performance of the proposed MSCE in terms of energy efficiency, and stability of the network.

articleTitle: AI based Solar Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Maintaining equilibrium between generation and load is crucial for maximizing economic scheduling in smart grids. As solar energy forecasting gains importance due to its sporadic nature and climatic dependencies, this study leverages advanced machine learning and deep learning models for accurate prediction. Specifically, we use XGBoost and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models to analyze data from two solar installations in India over a 34-day period. Our approach enhances the efficiency and reliability of solar energy utilization in smart grids. Evaluated over a 3-day test period, the LSTM model achieved an RMSE of approximately 2870 kW, a 22% improvement over a baseline model with an RMSE of 3699 kW. These results highlight the potential of machine learning and deep learning to improve solar power forecasting accuracy, thereby facilitating more effective energy management in smart grids.

articleTitle: Unmasking Audio Deception: Performance Analysis in Machine Learning Models with Mel-Frequency and Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study delves into the pervasive issue of audio deepfakes and their societal implications, emphasizing a Machine Learning (ML) approach for detection. Employing the Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC), the research utilizes the FOR (FAKE or REAL) Dataset to evaluate the efficacy of various models, including XGBoost, Ada Boost, SVM, LightGBM, Logistic Regression, Extra Tree, Gaussian Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree, MLP Classifier, Linear Discriminant Classifier, and Quadratic Discriminant Classifier. The study critically assesses the potential of MFCC and GFCC features in discerning synthetic audio data and employs accuracy, precision, and recall as evaluation metrics. The results highlight nuanced distinctions in the performance of each model, shedding light on their respective capabilities in distinguishing genuine from deepfake audio content. This research contributes valuable insights into the ongoing efforts to fortify societal resilience against the escalating threat of audio deepfakes, offering a comprehensive evaluation of ML models and emphasizing the significance of MFCC and GFCC features in addressing this burgeoning concern [1]

articleTitle: Information Extraction From Tweets for Disaster Damage Assessment Using Rule-based NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A natural disaster is an unanticipated incident that affects society. Disasters such as earthquakes, cyclones, floods, tsunamis, landslides, etc., are detrimental to the world. For a society to be prepared to save as many lives as possible the disasters must be monitored and evaluated. The government disaster management personnel generally do the damage assessment in post-disaster scenarios by using a damage assessment form that includes a set of information related to the disaster. They fill up the form manually by roaming the disaster-affected area and enquiring the victims and rescue workers. However, this process of manually collecting disaster information is time-consuming and laborious. To solve this problem, in this work, we propose an automatic approach to fill the damage assessment form using social media data, i.e. tweets that have been posted during or after a disaster event. To do that, Firstly, we identify the classes in which the tweets can be divided based on the damage assessment form; next, we preprocess and classify the collected tweets into different categories; and finally, we propose a rule-based information extraction strategy utilizing NLP to answer the questionnaires related to the damage assessment form. The evaluation of our approach reveals that it can outperform the baseline approach to answer the questionnaires.

articleTitle: AI and Consumer Behavior: Innovations in Marketing Strategy and Consumer Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study paper focuses on the groundbreaking impact of artificial intelligence on customers and marketing techniques. The study uses quantitative data, including analysis of social media analytics and any information from the customers on the social media platform, the results from the AI market research tools, and lastly, analysis of case studies from the industry. The statistics studies prove the effectiveness of AI’s integration into the marketing sphere and the improvements in its outcomes. Regarding the effectiveness of AI-led promotion, it was found that ‘ads placed using AI had a 25 per cent increase in click-through rates compared to the traditional models. Using the chat bots enhanced the general customer satisfaction level, which improved from 69.85 to 84. 89. These results point out how AI seems to improve people’s level of engagement or happiness and how it can offer deeper and more accurate customer insights and more specific marketing encounters. The paper examines the use of AI in segmentation and targeting. It reveals how the technology could revolutionize marketing procedures by enabling the right identification and management of valuable customer segments. The article also outlines the limitations in the current marketing activities and some ideas for further research, including a shifted ethical use of AI and AI in developing countries. This study, therefore, brings important findings to the existing literature about how knowledge of AI’s role in DM can aid in improving marketing strategies during digital transformation. Managers are encouraged to adopt new technological inventions to warrant fairness and accomplishment within their organizations.

articleTitle: Securing Images: Cryptographic Approach in Big Data Scenario
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital Image as a form of data is a critical component of the digital age. Therefore, Image Encryption and Decryption is one of the important aspect for modern communication. Image security for such digital images remain one of the important questions to be answered [14][15]. Among all the advanced Encryption and Decryption algorithm, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) and Chaotic Map Algorithm remains the prominent approaches for image security through advanced encryption and decryption approaches. This Study undertakes these two algorithm for encryption and decryption approaches for image. AES on one hand is considered for its strong security and consistent performance whereas Chaotic Map is considered for its dynamics for encryption. In a Big Data scenario, performance efficiency, scalability, and robustness of these algorithms are critical factors due to the large volumes of image data involved. Further statistical analysis including Entropy, Mean Squared Error (MSE), Correlation Coefficient, Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) are considered for both the algorithms. Additionally both the algorithms are further evaluated on the basis of encryption and decryption time and key sensitivity for the security reasons.

articleTitle: Smart Security: Unmasking Face Spoofers with Advanced Decision Tree Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Face spoofing, the act of supplying unreal face photos to deceive facial recognition systems, poses a significant chance to protection programs. This paper proposes an Advance Decision Tree (ADT) Classifier Algorithm for Face Spoof Detection with the usage of Local Binary Pattern (LBP) functions. This method enhances conventional Decision Tree strategies by introducing advanced splitting criteria and optimization strategies to improve category performance. Firstly, in this work extract LBP features from face photos, converting every pixel right into a binary wide variety to capture important texture facts. The resulting LBP codes are then used to create a histogram function vector for the category. ADT Classifier set of rules proceeds with the development of the decision tree, beginning with dataset initialization and node splitting primarily based on the most suitable splitting standards. Work incorporates advanced strategies, which include Cost-Complexity Pruning, Random Feature Selection, and Optimal Split Search, to enhance decision-making and improve generalization. The study additionally outlines the model evaluation procedure, including classification function definition, performance metric calculation, and cross-validation. Our set of rules achieves robust face spoof detection by effectively leveraging LBP capabilities and ADT technique, ensuring excessive performance and generalizability in actual global situations.

articleTitle: Integration of Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Systems in Mobile Commerce Strategy: Enhancing Customer Relationship Management through Personalized Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) through Personalized Recommendations involves tailoring product or service suggestions to individual preferences. In Mobile Commerce Strategy, the need to enhance CRM through personalized recommendations arises from the growing demand for a more personalized and engaging user experience, fostering customer loyalty and satisfaction. The study presents a novel approach leveraging Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Systems (ANFIS). The methodology encompasses pre-processing through Z-Score Normalization and Missing Value Handling, followed by the application of ANFIS for CRM enhancement. Criteria for error analysis assess the model’s performance. This approach ensures improved recommendation accuracy and adaptability, addressing the shortcomings of traditional methods. Results of this study are implemented in Python tool. The average increase in accuracy of the proposed ANFIS Model ($99.3 \%$) compared to Conventional Regression and Random Forest is $32.4 \%$. This substantial improvement underscores the efficacy of the ANFIS approach in achieving significantly higher accuracy levels in the predictive modelling task. The proposed ANFIS method outperforms Conventional Regression with a substantially lower Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.013, indicating superior predictive accuracy. The study contributes to advancing CRM strategies in Mobile Commerce, offering a comprehensive solution to personalize recommendations and elevate the customer experience.

articleTitle: Zero-Lock: Revolutionizing Mobile Security with an Enhanced Pattern Lock Method
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile Security is at the core of our digital lives, and the pattern lock has been a dependable guardian. Imagine a leap beyond reliability—a transformation into something smarter, stronger, and altogether revolutionary—a groundbreaking advancement in pattern lock methodology, poised to redefine how we protect our mobile devices. Mobile security stands at a pivotal crossroads in the age of digital dependency. Traditional pattern lock methods, once considered a reliable barrier against unauthorized access, now confront escalating threats. The problem lies in their susceptibility to predictable patterns, putting an array of personal and sensitive data at risk. In this era, where smartphones are integral to everyday life, the security of millions is threaten. While substantial research has been devoted to enhancing mobile security, much work remains. The existing body of research has explored advanced pattern lock methods that harness biometric data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. However, the success rate of these innovations varies. Some have demonstrated robust security enhancements, while others still grapple with usability issues and false positives. Researchers’ critical challenge is striking a balance between enhanced protection and seamless user experience. Mobile security needs to change to meet current challenges. The security of pattern locks is no longer sufficient, and we require fresh solutions to safeguard the data and privacy of smartphone users. The proposed methodology is a unique way for enhancing the Pattern Lock in Circular Form, which provides a wide variety of patterns, which makes it difficult to crack it assuring high security.

articleTitle: Edge Computing for Distributed and Cooperative Media Algorithms in Connected Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Side Computing is a rising technique used for connected networks’ allotted and cooperative media algorithms. Part Computing refers to processing operations being carried out near the source of the facts, generally close to the edge of the network, in place in a centralized cloud. It allows information to be processed quickly, securely, and reliably in remote or low-connectivity locations, allowing dispensed computing operations inside connected networks. This distributed machine enables latency when working with significant facts sets and enhances security and reliability. Cooperating media algorithms, including laptop vision, audio processing, or natural language processing, are frequently optimized using aspect Computing in related networks. The advantages of facet Computing allow for progressed scalability, green helpful resource utilization, and better latency performance, mainly in areas that suffer from restrained or negative networking situations and bandwidth. Moreover, aspect computing enables enhanced privacy, protection, and personal revel when handling sensitive information and data stored within the cloud.

articleTitle: An Automated Glaucoma Detection using DenseNet for ANSAN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma, a sight-threatening condition, results from heightened pressure on the optic nerves due to fluid accumulation in the eyes. This pressure damages optic nerves crucial for vision, emphasizing the urgency of managing fluid build-up to prevent irreversible vision loss. To improve detection accuracy and reduce human error, we propose an automated glaucoma detection method using deep learning techniques. By employing a pre-trained DenseNet-121 model and data augmentation techniques to achieve a remarkable accuracy of 93% in effectively discerning between healthy and glaucomatous retinas. This demonstrates the potential of deep learning models such as DenseNet in revolutionizing glaucoma diagnosis by providing reliable and timely detection by paving a way for early intervention strategies that can significantly enhance patient outcomes

articleTitle: ML-Enhanced Mental Health Assessment: Optimizing Machine Learning for Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Machine learning techniques have emerged as revolutionary tools in enhancing mental health diagnosis and evaluation. This research investigates the use of ensemble approaches to improve the diagnosis of mental illness and evaluation. Due to their subjective and complicated character, mental health diseases pose substantial obstacles that sometimes lead to delayed or incorrect diagnoses when utilizing traditional methods. Using an ensemble model that combines three sophisticated machine learning algorithms—Logistic Regression, random forests, and GradientBoostingClassifier, this work shows how machine learning may enhance the accuracy of diagnosis and treatment planning in the fields of psychiatry and psychology. The ensemble model identifies complex combinations of variables that lead to improved diagnosis accuracy by analyzing a variety of datasets, including genetic, neuroscientific, digital biomarkers, and clinical, and behavioral patterns. The model is noteworthy for achieving an excellent success rate of 98%, highlighting its effectiveness in attempts to diagnose and treat mental health illnesses early on. The integration of machine learning technology into clinical workflows holds promise for driving personalized mental healthcare and charting future research avenues aimed at improving diagnostic accuracy and treatment efficacy.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Different ImageDenoising Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This investigation embarks on a thorough exploration of image processing, specifically delving into the intricacies of image de-noising. The investigation spans a spectrum of de-noising methodologies, encompassing not only traditional techniques like Mean and Median Filtering but also advanced methods such as Improved Median Filtering, Threshold with Wavelet Transform, and Wavelet and Non-Moment Mean Filtering. Each approach is applied with meticulous precision to a diverse collection of images, each undergoing the de-noising process to enhance visual quality and eradicate unwanted artifacts. The evaluation of these de-noising techniques is conducted through the implementation of rigorous quantitative metrics, including Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). These metrics serve as robust benchmarks, enabling a comprehensive assessment of the effectiveness of each method in preserving image fidelity. This research aims to unravel the de-noising method that emerges as the most promising and efficient through a meticulous comparison and in-depth analysis of the de-noised outputs.

articleTitle: Implementation of XOR Gate using AOI model by Reconfigurable Artificial Neural Network on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we utilize a reconfigurable artificial neural network (RANN) to design digital logic gates, which serve as the fundamental components of a digital subsystem. We achieve hardware implementation of AND, OR, and Inverter (AOI) gates through both single and multi-layer perceptron models using feed-forward neural networks (FFNNs). The FFNNs are trained using Python and MATLAB. We apply the proposed AOI gates methodology via RANN to design the XOR gate, considering it as a combinational circuit. This technique is developed in Verilog for testing using Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). Additionally, we present the register-transistor logic (RTL) design results for the individual gates and the AOI model to investigate resource utilization—including DSP slices, LUTs, flip-flops—and the dynamic power consumption of the ZYNQ ZedBoard. Furthermore, our methodology offers a foundation for generating new methods for VLSI system design on dedicated hardware like FPGA in the future, providing a more flexible and efficient system design approach with reduced development time.

articleTitle: Predicting Customer Churn in E-commerce Subscription Services using RNN with Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In e-commerce subscription services, predicting client attrition is essential for businesses trying to boost sales and enhance client retention. This article proposes a unique approach for accurate churn prediction: recurrent neural networks (RNNs) plus attention mechanisms. By taking advantage of the temporal dependencies found in subscription-based interactions, the RNN model dynamically learns and concentrates on important features. This enables it to detect minute patterns that can point to potential churn behavior in the future. This study thoroughly examines churn characteristics in e-commerce subscription services in order to determine the effectiveness of the proposed RNN architecture in anticipating client attrition. Experiments on real datasets show that the model works better than traditional methods, achieving notable accuracy and predictive power. Moreover, the attention processes in the model allow it to rank the informative traits in order of importance, providing insight into the fundamental causes of customer attrition. The results of this study establish a solid framework for proactive churn control and long-term growth, which has important ramifications for e-commerce companies. Businesses may maximize resource allocation, raise customer happiness, and develop enduring connections with their subscribers by utilizing the predictive powers of RNNs with attention mechanisms. Python is used to implement the suggested work. The accuracy of the suggested study is ${9 7 \%.}$

articleTitle: Advanced and Secure Data Sharing Scheme with Blockchain and IPFS: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the ever-evolving information age, the challenges posed by the exponential growth of data have led to innovative solutions that leverage the power of technology. This paper introduces a comprehensive data sharing platform that seamlessly integrates blockchain and InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) technologies to address the complex issues of data sharing and storage. The approach begins by establishing an alliance blockchain, employing a consensus mechanism rooted in computing power competition to maintain data integrity within the blockchain. Simultaneously, the IPFS system is harnessed for data storage, utilizing distributed storage, file splitting, and splicing techniques. The resultant data sharing platform consists of distinct modules, including blockchain, IPFS, encryption and decryption, and fast retrieval, providing end-to-end data security and accessibility. Furthermore, the paper delves into the practical implementation of this technology by examining a course sharing project that leverages IPFS and Ethereum blockchain. By utilizing IPFS as an access medium, the paper efficiently reduces storage costs and enhances storage efficiency, effectively addressing the challenge of managing extensive course data. The incorporation of Ethereum blockchain technology ensures the elimination of single points of failure and establishes a robust transaction mechanism that incentivizes course users to engage in sharing and enhances course liquidity. This innovative amalgamation of blockchain and IPFS not only resolves the data sharing conundrum but also guarantees secure, decentralized, and efficient data storage and exchange in an era defined by the relentless growth of digital information.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Document Management and Monitoring in the Department of the Interior and Local Government Negros Occidental
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proponents propose a document management and monitoring system in light of the challenges of poor document management in the government sector. Agile Scrum methodology guided the system’s functionality and features development. The selected beneficiary of the target system was the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Negros Occidental. The system has four modules: user access role, document management, document tracking, and reports modules. It was then presented to the administrators and staff of the DILG Negros Occidental. According to the major stakeholders, the developed system has successfully reduced the organization’s workload and document retrieval time. Indeed, a well-designed document management and monitoring system is significant in enhancing and digitalizing public services while ensuring quality and public-friendly processes. The system effectively addressed the challenges faced by traditional document management. It improves collaboration and document version control through cloud-based storage and incorporates an access control module that ensures document security and compliance measures. To further this study, researchers should undergo a comprehensive quality evaluation process and deploy the system in DILG offices in other regions. Government and non-government organizations can use the system developed in this study to streamline the document management and monitoring process. This system is a response to the government’s call for digitalization. Moreover, the developed system contributes to the United Nations’ sustainable goal of promoting innovative digital technologies and infrastructure to improve government services and operations.

articleTitle: Identification of Hub Genes Indicating Association of Atherosclerosis with Rheumatoid Arthritis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a prevalent autoimmune disorder that is distinguished by the gradual development of polyarthritis, which is characterised by progressive and damaging joint inflammation. Nevertheless, the aetiology and molecular mechanisms causing rheumatoid arthritis (RA) remain elusive. In this study, an integrated bioinformatics approach was employed to identify hub genes that are specifically expressed in different tissues and are implicated in rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Furthermore, potential associations between these hub genes and atherosclerosis were investigated. Atherosclerosis, a persistent inflammatory disorder, exhibits shared pathogenic mechanisms with arthritis. In order to gain a deeper understanding of the molecular interactions between these disorders, we performed a GEO2R study on gene expression profiles that are linked to arthritis in atherosclerotic tissues. By utilising publicly available databases, our research has successfully discovered a distinct group of genes that exhibit differential expression in both disorders. The application of functional enrichment analysis has shown significant pathways that establish a connection between arthritis and atherosclerosis, thereby providing valuable insights into prospective targets for therapeutic intervention. The utilisation of an integrative strategy serves to augment our comprehension of the intricate molecular mechanisms that establish a connection between arthritis and atherosclerosis, hence facilitating the development of focused therapies.

articleTitle: Advancing Outdoor Landmark Detection: A Vision Transformer Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Outdoor landmark identification is a critical aspect of applications like tourism and navigation. This paper presents a novel approach based on Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture, to tackle the problem of outdoor landmark detection. Accurately identifying landmarks from images is the research challenge; this is an essential function for tourism, navigation, and cultural preservation. This approach is implemented using a state-of-the-art neural network architecture to effectively capture long-range relationships in images. The results highlight that the ViT model outperforms conventional convolutional neural networks in challenging outdoor conditions by having a higher accuracy rate when identifying landmarks. The research strengthens the potential of ViT models for outdoor landmark detection. The effective application of ViT has applications in the fields of smart city technology, tourism, and cultural heritage protection in addition to advancing computer vision.

articleTitle: Efficient Intelligent Network Intrusion Detection for SDN Using XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Networking defined by software (SDN) has arisen as an encouraging path for the internet’s future expansion, providing enhanced flexibility and transparency to centrally managed networks. However, these advantages come with inherent vulnerabilities, posing significant risks such as network disruptions, system paralysis, and cybercrimes like online banking fraud and theft. Addressing these challenges is paramount for organizations, enterprises, and economies. In recent times, the incorporation of clever machine learning techniques goes into systems for detecting intrusions (IDS) through SDN has garnered considerable interest. In this manuscript, we introduce a fresh IDS called XGBoost tailored to SDN environments. Initially, a hybrid feature selection and extraction algorithm are employed to reduce data dimensionality and acquire an optimal feature subset. This approach involves utilizing a correlation-based feature extraction (CFE) algorithm followed by random forest recursive feature elimination. Subsequently, the XGBoost algorithm is employed for the detection and classification of varied forms of attacks. Experimental findings conducted on the dataset NSL-KDD illustrate that the suggested system surpasses current methods in F-measure, recall, accuracy, and precision.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Security Opportunities of Optimized Network Security Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This technical abstract describes the capability safety opportunities associated with optimized community protection algorithms. Security algorithms can be optimized via the improvement of ultra-modern algorithms that focus on particular responsibilities and capabilities contemporary the general network security gadget. By way of contemplating the person additives modern the system inclusive of authentication, authorization, encryption, and intrusion detection, the algorithms may be tailor-made to attention on unique problems and deliver solutions primarily based on real-time consequences. The optimized algorithms also permit the machine to react to adjustments inside the system extra fast, increasing the effectiveness of the latest safety machine. The optimization of modern-day safety algorithms affords brand new some state modern safety opportunities together with stepped-forward detection time, accuracy, and scalability. In addition, they could enable the device to perform more efficiently to intrusion tries, reduce the effect of ultra-modern false positives, and decorate safety posture. Optimized algorithms can offer multiplied system security with minimal increases to operational expenses, permitting the network to remain at ease at the same time as lowering charges.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Prediction on IoT-Driven Precision Location Using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A whole new era of connectedness has begun with the introduction of the Internet of Things (IoT), which makes it possible for inanimate objects to speak with one another in a straightforward manner. Within Internet of Things frameworks, accurate position has become a key component as a result of applications such as asset tracking, navigation, and environmental monitoring. When it comes to accuracy, scalability, and the ability to react to changing environments, the solutions that are currently available for IoT-driven precise positioning present some limits. When the precise location of something is of the utmost significance, it is necessary to have a solution that is both effective and flexible. The purpose of this research is to investigate the IoT precise location and to provide a novel approach that makes use of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to enhance both efficiency and accuracy. For the purpose of achieving pinpoint accuracy in locating, the proposed method integrates PSO algorithms into the existing framework of the IoT. Through a series of simulations and tests, we will evaluate the performance of the PSO-enhanced system in comparison to that of traditional methods of localization.

articleTitle: Implementing Deep Learning and Machine Learning Technologies In Brain Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The early identification of brain diseases is important for prompt clinical intervention and effective treatment. Manual detection of brain tumors is complex and heavily reliant on specialized expertise. With the emergence of new brain diseases, the variability among these conditions poses a significant challenge for current diagnostic systems, making it a continuing focus of research. Detecting brain diseases promptly greatly impacts treatment success. The rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in neurology has revolutionized disease prediction and detection accuracy. This review delves into present growths in Deep learning (DL) and Machine learning (ML) approaches specifically aimed at the detection of brain tumors. It examines numerous studies that employ diverse techniques, modalities, and datasets. The overview provides a comprehensive look at the range of techniques utilized in diagnosing brain diseases. Summarizing important results from these studies, it addresses significant issues concerning ML and Deep Learning methods for diagnosing brain diseases. The ultimate goal is to pinpoint the maximum precise method for detecting a variety of brain diseases, thereby paving the way for future advancements in diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Graph Database Interaction through Generative AI-Driven Natural Language Interface for Financial Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid evolution of financial services has led to an increase in fraudulent activities, necessitating advanced detection methods. Traditional techniques often struggle with the volume and complexity of financial transactions, leading to inaccuracies and delays. This research addresses the enhancement of graph database interaction through a generative AI-driven natural language interface for more accurate fraud detection. We employ the T5 and LLaMA-2 models, trained on a balanced dataset of financial transactions, to recognize fraud patterns. The $\mathbf{T 5}$ model handles natural language queries, extracting key details such as transaction amounts and account numbers. The LLaMA-2 model generates predictions on the likelihood of transactions being fraudulent. The system then converts these processed queries into Cypher queries for the Neo4j graph database to retrieve relevant transaction data. This approach enables efficient pattern analysis and interactive data exploration. Experimental results demonstrate that our system accurately identifies fraudulent transactions, significantly reducing the time and expertise needed for detection. This approach makes use of Neo4j’s powerful features to increase the efficacy and precision of financial detection systems for fraud.

articleTitle: Advancing Tennis Analytics: A Hybrid CNN-SVM Approach for Serve Action Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study seeks to determine the effect of blending the eradicate CNN-SVM model on accurately identifying tennis serve shot movements. The model utilizes a large dataset of high-definition video recordings of professional tennis serves to categorize serve motions into five distinct types: flattening, slicing, front, under the arm, and regular serves. The CNN-SVM method consists of an attention mechanism and the SVM classifier that produces high precision in identifying the frame type and the video clip. The analyses of the model indicate that the model possesses a Macro Average, recall, and F1-Score of ${91.96 \%}$ (yt.), ${92.28 \%,}$ and ${91.95 \%,}$, respectively. The Precision-Recall-Trapezoidal results indicate that the model is highly accurate, with 92.44% accuracy, 92.01% recall, and an F1-Score of 92.06%. At the same time, the Micro Average is registering a huge score of 92.01% in all three ranges in its criterion. The model shows how good it is in correctly diagnosing serve shot motions even from different situations, indicating that it can be used effectively as a crucial instructional and analytical tool in tennis. The proposed study will also involve data acquisition from non-professional players in the short term. Thus improving the model potential in a wide range of situations. Further, the research aims to be at the forefront of developing a real-time serve shot action detection method that can assist coaches in training players professionally and supporting the analysis of live matches.

articleTitle: Performance Metrics of T2SAM Model for Abstractive Text Summarization on different Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the field of natural language processing, text summarization plays a pivotal role in summarizing large volumes of information into concise and informative summaries. Conventional ways of summarizing frequently depend on extractive techniques, which only choose and rearrange alreadyexisting phrases from the original text. However, the limitations of extractive summarization in capturing the essence and context of the original content have motivated the exploration of abstractive techniques. This study investigates the abstractive text summarization model termed the Transformer Technique with Self-Attention Mechanism (T2SAM). The model’s performance is evaluated on various datasets, including CNNDM, DUC, XSum, WikiSum, Gigaword, Multi-News, and Inshorts News. The evaluation centers on the effectiveness of T2SAM, using ROUGE metrics (including ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L) to compare the model’s outputs across various datasets. The analysis also considered the model’s proficiency and the datasets’ quality based on their ROUGE scores (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGEL, ROUGE-SS). Among all the datasets, the Inshorts News dataset demonstrated the highest performance for this model.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning to Improve Network Efficiency in Mobile Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Device studying (ML) is becoming more and more popular as a way to improve network performance in cellular satellite TV for PC networks. ML may be used to optimize network parameters along with routing algorithms, visitor styles, and radio propagation, even as also making diversifications primarily based on changing conditions in the environment. This abstraction allows the network to continuously adapt to address distinctive network situations and reservations, allowing the community to be distinctly green when dealing with fluctuating network parameters. Additionally, ML allows for the automation of a variety of capabilities, which include automated community management. Network operators can take the benefit of ML to optimize network efficiency for specific duties and SLAs with minimal manual intervention. Furthermore, ML strategies may be used to pick out patterns and overall performance troubles in the network network structure earlier than those issues become patron-affecting, greatly improving faster reaction time and normal community optimization.

articleTitle: AI based Unauthorized Person Identification and Reporting using Pynq FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Now-a-days passwords are the most often used identity verification method in home security. However, its simplicity makes it open to imposters, including shoulder surfing, spyware, social engineering, and guessing. Combining biometric technology and passwords can enhance overall security. Biometrics are ideal for identity verification as they cannot be lost, stolen, or overheard. In the absence of physical harm, they provide a reliable method of verifying someone’s identification. This project develops a security system using the Xilinx PYNQ-Z2 FPGA, interfacing with a camera module for facial recognition and GSM for alerting, employing Python for high-level control, OpenCV for image processing, and Arduino libraries for peripheral interactions, signaling authorized access with a green LED and unauthorized entry with a red LED. A radial grid mapping is then used to focus on the feature vector generated using nose within the circular boundary. The returned feature vector is scale-normalized with the predicted face size, determined by the breadth of the color segmented region. The feature vector is fed into a trained neural network classifier that can identify faces. The technique was tested with 20 people face as sample of various sizes and postures taken against a variety of complex backgrounds. Despite all of these improvements, the face detector proved to be extremely durable. The face recognizer performed well, with the exception of sensitivity to small-scale face photos.

articleTitle: Gait Pattern Recognition via Fusing Static and Dynamic Features in Single Stream Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gait refers to the walking and motion characteristics of an individual. In this paper, we suggest a unique method for analyzing human gait patterns using static as well as dynamic features passing through the same convolutional neural network. Generally, the gaits are processed using contour detection and segmentation to perform time series analysis with extracted features. Furthermore, machine learning models such as decision trees, support vector machine are also utilized for the gait classification. We initially trained our model on both cropped average images and optical flow of each gait independently. Subsequently, we fused the average image of each gait (building static information) with its corresponding optical flow (dynamic information). This novel fusion approach facilitated the training of a single stream convolutional neural network model.
