Our findings reveal a notable accuracy of ${9 8. 7 5 \%}$ in successfully recognizing individuals based on their gait patterns. Simplicity of the model and succinct fusion of static and dynamic features produce improved results with very less computational time.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human-Machine Interaction: A Study on Deployment of LLM and Gen AI Hybrid Models in Responsible Humanoids for Human Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study explores the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI (Gen AI) in humanoid robots to enhance human-machine interaction. The deployment of advanced AI capabilities in humanoids has revolutionized various fields, including healthcare, education, and industry. The study highlights the potential benefits of AI in humanoids for vulnerable populations, such as the elderly and disabled, including companionship, assistance with daily tasks, and improved quality of life. However, it also addresses the ethical considerations and challenges associated with AI deployment, such as job displacement and income inequality. The study emphasizes the importance of responsible AI deployment, advocating for transparency, accountability, and fairness in AI algorithms. Furthermore, the research discusses strategies for maximizing the positive impact of AI deployment while mitigating negative consequences, such as investing in education and training programs and implementing regulations and policies for ethical AI use.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-Based Early Blight and Late Blight Disease Detection in Potato
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agriculture serves as the backbone of India’s economy, engaging over 80% of its population and contributing significantly to GDP growth. India, ranking as the second-largest producer globally, relies on potatoes to address hunger issues and improve agricultural productivity. This highlights the significance of prioritizing potato cultivation to address food security challenges and assist plans for economic development in India. In recent years, potato yields have faced a severe hindrance in the growth process attributed to two major diseases namely, Early Blight and Late Blight. If left undetected in their early stages, crops can undergo serious damage resulting in decreased production as well as substantial losses. The proposed framework utilizes YOLOv8, an enhanced technique for efficient analysis of potato leaf images. Using the PlantVillage dataset as a guide, we have fine tuned the YOLOV8 model to make it more sensitive to the distinct characteristics of early and late blight. The suggested approach enhances the efficiency and accuracy of image analysis, facilitating faster as well as precise identification of diseases. The results have demonstrated the high efficiency of modified YOLOv8 in terms of key statistical metrics including detection accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score yielding values of $\mathbf{9 9. 7 9 \%}$, $\mathbf{9 8. 9 0 \%, 1 0 0 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 9. 4 8 \%}$, respectively. Experimental findings reveal that optimized YOLOv8 outperforms other existing target detection and identification networks, including CNN, VGGNet16, ResNet-50 and YOLOv8. Consequently, this research is anticipated to reduce the workload of farmers and facilitate swift identification and detection of potato leaf diseases, thereby mitigating economic losses.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Thermograph Classification Using MLP Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Carcinoma of the breast, a highly lethal disease in the present era, necessitates thorough examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the tumor, particularly in its early stages, to enhance posttreatment life expectancy. The utilization of thermal imaging stands out as a commendable approach for the early detection and screening of breast cancer, devoid of radiation exposure. The thermograph, employed in various nations for cancer screening, is esteemed as a straightforward non-invasive technique, albeit incapable of replacing Mammogram. Discrepancies exist between breast cancer screening via Mammograms and Infrared thermal images. An infrared (IR) breast image is evaluated based on the red patterns depicted on the thermograph in contrast to the blue and yellow hues observed in the adjacent tissues. Presently, deep learning has emerged as a prevalent method for breast cancer detection, applicable in medical investigations irrespective of being image-based or text-based. Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) falls under the category of Deep Learning models. This study aims to employ MLP classifiers for the classification of Normal (noncancerous) or Abnormal (cancerous) breast cancer thermographs. Initially, MLP is trained on visuals of both cancerous and noncancerous cases. Subsequently, test images are fed into the MLP model. Finally, the experiment’s accuracy is documented in the classification report. The accuracy of the proposed neural network model stands at $60 \%$, with six out of ten test images exhibiting abnormality.

articleTitle: Fault Classification & Detection in IEEE 34 Bus System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach by means of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for fault classification and detection in the IEEE 34 bus system, which serves as a representative model for distribution networks. The IEEE 34 bus system is known for its complexity, featuring multiple buses, branches, and loads, making it an ideal testbed for evaluating advanced fault management techniques. The proposed CNN-based methodology leverages the ability of CNNs to automatically learn hierarchical features from system data, such as voltage and current measurements, without the need for manual feature extraction. The key contributions of this paper include the development and implementation of a CNN architecture tailored for fault classification and detection tasks in the IEEE 34 bus system. The CNN model is trained using labeled data sets containing information about different fault scenarios, including 1-phase, 2-phase, and 3-phase faults. The training process involves optimizing the network parameters to improve accuracy and robustness in fault identification. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the CNN-based approach in accurately classifying and detecting faults in the IEEE 34 bus system. The CNN model shows high accuracy rates in distinguishing between different fault types and provides rapid response times for fault detection, thereby enhancing the overall reliability and resilience of the distribution network. The implications of this research extend to the broader context of intelligent fault management systems in power engineering. By harnessing the capabilities of CNNs, power system operators can benefit from more efficient and automated fault management processes, leading to improved system performance, reduced downtime, and enhanced grid reliability.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition for Identifying a String Within a Text File Using Finite Automata
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pattern recognition is crucial across diverse domains, including retrieval of information, data mining, and bioinformatics. Numerous algorithms exist for string matching, and finite state machines (FSM) provide a robust framework for implementing these pattern recognition algorithms. This study introduces an efficient pattern recognition application utilizing a finite state machine, using the SSFSM library in Python. The SSFSM library facilitates the creation and management of FSMs, offering methods to define states and transitions efficiently. An algorithm is proposed, that identifies strings within a text file with the help of the SSFSM library in Python. It employs deterministic finite automata (DFA) for pattern recognition, scanning text files word by word and then character by character, and recording execution times to evaluate efficiency. The algorithm’s effectiveness is demonstrated through a comparative analysis of its performance for the number of characters and size of the input file. Results demonstrate the algorithm’s effectiveness in accurately identifying and quantifying specific string occurrences within large text files. It also shows that the search time of a string increases with an increase in the frequency of the character, size of the text file, and length of the search key, underscoring its potential for broader applications. Further, our results also show that there is approximately a 20% increase in search time when the search key length increases by 1. Future enhancements may include extended functionalities, support for additional document types, and improved complexity management.

articleTitle: A Quantum Computation Language-based Quantum Compiler
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Quantum computing is a revolution in computational theory that uses the principles of quantum mechanics to perform computations that are beyond the capacity of classical computers. It works with the special features of the quantum bits or qubits to encode and transform the information in manners conventional bits cannot imagine. A quantum compiler is a software tool designed to translate high-level quantum language code into executable quantum instructions. This paper aims to develop a quantum compiler for translating Quantum Computation Language source codes into quantum bytecodes which can later be executed on a Quantum Virtual Machine. This compiler will have a combinational structure that includes a frontend for interpreting the QCL code, an intermediate representation for optimizing quantum algorithms, and a backend for generating efficient quantum bytecode. Optimization techniques will be applied to improve the functioning of the quantum circuits. The compiler will also include an error handling module to handle the errors. The successful deployment of a quantum compiler for QCL has many implications and unlocks opportunities for advancements in quantum technologies.

articleTitle: Transforming Vitiligo Care with AI-Powered Psychosocial Assessments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The psychological well-being of individuals with vitiligo, a persistent skin illness marked by prominent white patches on the skin and a lack of pigmentation, is severely compromised. Conventional methods for classifying the quality of life impairment and predicting the psychological effects in patients with vitiligo often fall short of capturing the complex, non-linear connections seen in the data. This paper explores the use of deep learning models to overcome these limitations. We developed neural network architectures that are used to predict Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Scale (DASS) scores using regression models and classify Dermatology Life Quality Index (DLQI) scores using classification models. DLQI scores are divided into three impact categories by the categorization model: “Low,” “Moderate,” and ‘Migh.” Continuous DASS scores are predicted using the regression model. Our results demonstrate that deep learning models can effectively capture complicated patterns in the data, achieving above 98% accuracy in classification and a MSE of 1.6 in prediction. Both classification performance and prediction accuracy are much higher with this than with traditional methods. Deep learning architectures therefore provide a solid basis for understanding and treating the psychological impacts of vitiligo and may lead to enhanced patient management and targeted therapy.

Author Keywords: Depression Anxiety and Stress Scale (DASS) scores

articleTitle: Advancing of Microservices Architecture with Dockers
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Docker has revolutionized web hosting. It offers efficiency, scalability, security, and automation. With Docker, businesses and individuals can simplify their hosting. With the help of Docker, the development process is simplified via managing to package the application into standardized units called containers. They can enhance website performance and contribute to a sustainable digital ecosystem. Micro-service architecture might be adopted for smooth flow for the development process. Resource optimization might get improved. Security measures could be bolstered. Multi-cloud deployment strategies may be explored. Server-less computing integration is a possibility. Containerized data storage solutions might be explored.. In the future, Docker based hosting could involve Kubernetes for container orchestration. Machine learning capabilities could be incorporated. Green computing initiatives might be implemented.

articleTitle: Empowering Abusive Language Detection in Low-Resource Scenarios: A Dynamic LSTM-Based Abusive Content Detection with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In India, with its rich linguistic landscape, abusive social media remarks that attack individuals or communities based on protected attributes provide serious difficulty. Research in this area is hampered by the lack of digital resources for low-resource Indian languages like Assamese, which exacerbates this complexity. The goal of this research is to close this gap by creating a system that can accurately identify abusive remarks made in Assamese on social media. The experiment produced promising results by leveraging the highlighted capabilities of deep learning techniques, namely Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks enhanced with attention mechanisms. The accuracy of the LSTM model was 71.97%; however, by incorporating attention processes, performance was dramatically increased to 75.22%. The results demonstrate how well attention mechanisms and deep learning techniques work together to enhance the detection of abusive comments in Assamese on web-based platforms. Particularly given the limitations of low-resource languages, this research provides important insights meant to foster a more safe online environment.

articleTitle: Real-Time Streaming in Distributed and Cooperative Sensing Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Actual-time streaming in dispensed and cooperative sensing networks is a vital software program area for wireless networks because it allows transmitting, storing, and conveying significant volumes of real-time information. This period provides an opportunity to expand its functions, including environmental monitoring and control, business Automation, and Surveillance. In a distributed and cooperative sensing network, the nodes for sensing are coupled to a not uncommon communication community, and its standard realtime stream enables data streaming to be implemented through the shadow of a sluggard river. Most of the time, messages across the switch at a This results in that any message can be sent to be processed repeatedly before moving out of date in a very short time. Various methods can be used in a distributed and cooperative sensing network to ensure successful actualtime streaming. These include the Pub/Sub communication pattern, which enables nodes to subscribe to events and be notified when new events occur. Mirroring is used to ensure that each node is always given the latest data. At last, digital signal processing methods are used to reduce latency and increase the accuracy of specific data. These techniques support the performance and scalability required for an extensive application to provide real-time streaming in a distributed and cooperative sensing network.

articleTitle: Automated Lesion Segmentation and an Ensemble Approach to Retinal Image Classification through Quantitative Feature Analysis and Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Retinal image analysis using machine learning is key to ophthalmic disease diagnosis and screening. Classifiers are still possible with limited training data, but they are not accurate. The aim is to identify optimal subsets of discriminative features in retinal images so that classifier performance can be enhanced. In order to gain insight into their predictive power, pixel intensities, texture patterns, vessel morphology are analyzed clearly. Optimal feature subsets from fundus images are identified using machine learning. Preprocessing, segmentation, feature selection, and classifier modeling are all included. A new method for dimensionality reduction quantifies feature importance by using Double Input Symmetrical Relevance (DISR). A comparison of artificial neural networks, recurrent neural networks and ensemble voting models has been conducted. With decision trees and probability voting, the ensemble model achieved 99.5% accuracy, 99.4% precision, and $\mathbf{9 9. 1 \%}$ recall. Utilizing limited training data effectively required advanced feature selection. Quantitative metrics can be used to identify discriminatory features to guide the development of accurate prediction systems.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Spontaneous Volunteers During Emergency Response
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Disasters affect a large number of people yearly and recurrently at many locations. Emergencies compel the local community to participate in disaster response; they are mostly the first responders during any disaster. Hence, it is necessary to devise solutions to support the local community and enhance their resilience. This work proposes a comprehensive platform for the victims, administrators, and volunteers during a catastrophe. It encourages the participation of the local community in managing local resources, requesting help, and getting acknowledged for the service they lend. The platform helps recognize the local community’s strengths and provides a method to receive information from disaster managers. The platform will also bring more situational awareness to disaster managers and volunteers. It also helps disaster managers assess the disaster’s potential impact and vulnerability levels of the community at an early stage. The platform envisions providing a decision support system for the spontaneous volunteers to co-work with disaster managers in a regulated fashion by eliminating fake volunteers and messages. The research also focuses on the characteristics of technology adoption for the widespread acceptance of the solution.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Strategies for Telecom Churn Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ability to predict customer churn represents a critical component in the telecom industry’s quest for enhanced customer retention and long-term viability. In this research, several standalone machine learning algorithms, including gradient boosting and decision trees, have been applied to a dataset comprised of customer demographics and service usage patterns. The application of rigorous hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation processes has significantly improved the performance metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and $F 1$ score, of these models. Furthermore, the study incorporates two advanced ensemble techniques to refine the prediction accuracy. The combination of Random Forest and Gradient Boost achieved an accuracy of 85.7%, while the integration of AdaBoost and CatBoost resulted in an accuracy of 87.3%. This approach provides telecom operators with a potent tool to proactively identify and engage customers at risk of churn, thus enabling timely and targeted retention strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and contribute to the sustainability of telecom enterprises.

articleTitle: Investigating Spectrum Sharing Algorithms for Capacity Optimization in 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Network congestion in 6G networks is pressing trouble because of the surge of wireless gadgets. A spectrum-sharing algorithm is a useful resource management technique used to optimize the utilization of spectrum sources within a 6G network environment. This paper examines diverse spectrum sharing algorithms and their capability ability optimization abilities. In particular, it investigates and compares the spectrum sharing techniques consisting of synthetic neural network-based total spectrum sharing, deep reinforcement mastering spectrum sharing, and recreation-theoretic spectrum sharing. Simulation outcomes exhibit the progressed overall performance of the proposed algorithms in phrases of the done throughput, ability, and equity metrics. The results recommend that the proposed spectrum-sharing algorithms offer promising alternatives to enhance the overall performance of the existing community ability optimization techniques.

articleTitle: A Study on Future Data Science and its Impact in Health Care Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As a new scientific discipline, Data Science need a re-examination and re-design of both established pedagogical practices and current curriculum in order to meet its unique demands and those of the rapidly developing Big Data and data-driven technologies upon which it relies. In today’s data-driven research and digital economy, there is a need of a standardized, harmonized instructional model for the education and training of Data Scientists. Data science is a broad field that makes use of scientific methodologies, data mining techniques, machine-learning algorithms, and large amounts of data to draw conclusions and make predictions. The healthcare sector produces copious amounts of valuable data on patient demographics, treatment plans, medical examination outcomes, insurance coverage, and more. Data scientists are interested in the information gathered by IoT gadgets. The vast amounts of disparate, structured, and unstructured data generated by healthcare systems require assistance in processing, management, analysis, and integration. This study explores the emerging field of data science and its potential impact on healthcare organizations in the future. With the advent of advanced technologies and the exponential growth of data, the healthcare sector has witnessed a paradigm shift towards data-driven decision-making. The objective of this research is to examine how data science can revolutionize healthcare organizations by enhancing efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and optimizing resource allocation.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Visual Debugger For Error Resolution in C++
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a sophisticated visual debugger that seamlessly integrates $\mathrm{C}++$ code analysis with $\mathrm{C} \mathrm{\#}$ WPF visualisation for an enhanced debugging experience. The tool operates by extracting symbol information from target $\mathrm{C}++$ source files during debugging sessions, utilizing PDB files, specifically tailored for the Visual Studio environment. The core functionality of the tool involves the extraction and storage of symbol information within a meticulously designed stack frame and stack trace classes. Leveraging C++ capabilities, the project captures not only call stack information but also variables and data structures associated with each stack frame, providing a comprehensive view of the program’s execution state. To facilitate interoperability and visualization, the project employs a marshalling mechanism to seamlessly transfer the extracted data from the C++ backend to a C# WPF frontend. The Windows Presentation Foundation application serves as an intuitive and interactive interface, presenting the call stack alongside associated variables and data structures in a visually appealing manner. This tool is positioned to significantly enhance the debugging process for developers working in $\mathrm{C}++$ within the Visual Studio environment. By seamlessly integrating symbol extraction, data structuring, marshalling, and visualization, it provides a holistic and efficient solution for diagnosing complex code scenarios. The resulting visualization aids developers in gaining a deeper understanding of their code’s execution flow, enabling quicker identification and resolution of issues during the debugging process.

articleTitle: Generalized Early-Stage Depression Detection Using Federated Clustering on Mobile Usage
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article presents a novel approach for identifying early-stage depression by utilizing Federated Clustering on mobile usage data of subscribers. Loneliness stemming from workplace stress, relationship challenges, divorce, and ongoing personal issues can contribute to stress and depression. Stress is a common experience for almost everyone, and numerous studies have established connections between stress, depression, and adverse health conditions, as well as feelings of isolation. Coping strategies for loneliness include participating in classes or clubs with shared interests, seeking online support, or consulting with a therapist. Presently, there is a lack of effective techniques for detecting early-stage depression. Research suggests that changes in human behavior are reflected in their patterns of mobile usage. Examining an individual’s mobile usage patterns enables the establishment of a correlation with their behavior and the prediction of early stages of depression using artificial intelligence (AI). The aggregation of mobile usage data, encompassing elements like location, activities, and phone usage, proves to be an effective screening method for depression. The proposed methodology advocates utilizing the user’s mobile usage pattern and applying machine learning algorithms to discern changes in these patterns over time. This shift in mobile usage is then employed to identify whether a user is gradually entering a depressive state, prompting a warning to the individual or relevant authorities for intervention. Given challenges such as variations in data distribution, privacy concerns, and legal constraints associated with diverse medical data types, this area remains a significant focus of research. Consequently, machine learning (ML) algorithms encounter difficulties in adapting to the diversity among datasets sourced from various organizations, hospitals, locations, or devices. The concept of federated learning (FL) emerges as a solution to overcome these challenges, enabling algorithms to learn from diverse medical datasets across different countries through collaboration via a central server. This paper outlines how a federated learning architecture can contribute to the development of a generalized model for depression detection.

articleTitle: Preventing Accident Through Blockchain and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s changing world, the rise in car accidents and deaths on the road is an outcome of increasing traffic and population growth. The World Health Organization (WHO) states that a concerning 1.35 million lives are lost each year due to road accidents with factors like alcohol use, reckless driving and speeding playing roles. To make matters worse a significant 55 percent of road fatalities remain unreported leading to delays in emergency responses and sadly more deaths. To solve this issue, an effective solution emerges through the merging of the Internet of Things (IoT) and blockchain technologies. The proposed system for warning about car collisions combines an Arduino controller with sensors such as accelerometers and vibration sensors. These sensors quickly identify dangers activating the emergency system that uses GPS to pinpoint locations and a GSM module to communicate with emergency services. Immediate alerts are then sent out to designated contacts for help. By incorporating technology into the mix, the efficiency of emergency alerts is further boosted by ensuring communication between vehicles and medical facilities. This integration promotes trust and transparency through encrypted data sharing and verification methods thereby enhancing the reliability of the system. This novel approach significantly reduces fatalities by creating a transparent environment, for emergency assistance. Moreover, the system’s cost and easy availability make it suitable for use in all types of vehicles irrespective of their brand or design. Choosing this budget option has promise not just in lowering the number of deaths but also, in improving overall road safety worldwide.

articleTitle: Next-Gen IoT: 5G Realities and 6G Possibilities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In a world where technology reigns supreme, the Internet of Things has taken center stage, revolutionizing our lives in countless ways. Augmented reality, crystal-clear video streaming, self-driving cars, intelligent environments, and advanced healthcare are just a few examples of the IoT’s widespread impact. With these groundbreaking ideas in mind, the IoT demands faster data rates, wider bandwidth, increased capacity, swift data transmission, and minimal delays. Addressing these requirements head-on, this paper introduces 5G as the leading-edge technology capable of meeting these challenges. The fifth-generation cellular networks, known as 5G, offer a host of vital features that facilitate the widespread adoption of IoT. These features include device-to-device communication, where devices can directly exchange information without relying on a central server, coordinated multipoint processing to enhance network efficiency, massive machine type communication that enables seamless connectivity for countless IoT devices, ultra-reliable low latency communication to ensure critical data is transmitted swiftly and reliably, and extreme mobile broadband to support high-speed, uninterrupted connectivity on the go. It has paved ways for innovative wireless architecture and intelligent services and 6 G which will be the next step in this evolutionary cycle of wireless networks is expected to amplify this development to new and unimaginable levels. This article gives an extensive overview of the IoT technology, outlining its statistical and architectural trends, application scenarios, challenges and its potential. The research also offers a thorough and in-depth analysis of the current 5G-IoT environment. The use cases for 5 G in IoT systems are also emphasized. As a result, we discuss some of the key 5G IoT research directions and trends. After which we highlight the challenging areas of 5G-IoT and where special emphasis will be a necessity in paving the way for 6 G enabled IoT.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medium-Sized Sentence Translation In English-Hindi NMT Using Clause-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The issues of structural divergence, ambiguity, low resource language, and lack of training data are present in neural machine translation from English-to-Hindi and Hindi-to-English. This paper explores a comprehensive approach to tackle these challenges in English-to-Hindi and Hindi-to-English neural machine translation. Through a thorough examination of the identified challenges and the proposed solutions, with consideration for the nuances of Hindi language usage and structure, this research aims to open the path for more reliable and accurate machine translation systems tailored to the nuances of Hindi language structure and usage [1]. This study presents the work on English-Hindi Parallel Corpus developed by IIT Bombay. This study reports an updated baseline NMT translation result and a clause-based NMT translation result on this corpus using open-source NMT. Prior to translation, this study focuses on breaking down longer input sentences into smaller clauses hoping that it may increase the quality of the translation and lessen the likelihood that crucial context will be lost in the process. An experiment with different clause lengths is done to find the sweet spot for this model and analyze how they affect translation quality. The final results are obtained by using Open NMT which gives approx 3% increase for English to Hindi translation and significant improvement is achieved for Hindi to English translation [2].

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of User Generated Reviews of Online Education Applications Using Deep Learning and Transformer Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Educational online platforms have become vital resources for students looking for flexible and accessible ways to acquire knowledge and build skills. These platforms include a wide selection of courses and materials in a variety of areas and fields, appealing to students of all ages and backgrounds. So students and teachers are using these platforms a lot nowadays. Sentiment analysis is a vital component of analyzing user opinion on educational platforms. This study focuses on sentiment analysis of user evaluations from the Google Play Store for educational platforms. This study uses deep learning and transformer algorithms (RoBERTa, CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, Hybrid CNN-LSTM, Hybrid LSTM-BiLSTM) to extract patterns influencing user satisfaction, preferences, and complaints from a amount of 59391 dataset collected from nine popular educational platform Google Meet, Edureka, Duolingo, Coursera, Programming Hub, BYJU’S, TED, Udemy and 10 Minute School. The findings demonstrate that the two hybrid models perform better than other models in terms of accuracy: hybrid CNN-LSTM and hybrid LSTM-BiLSTM have the accuracies of 93.28% and 93.15% respectively. BiLSTM, LSTM, CNN and RoBERTa all have accuracies of 90.42%, 90.34%, 89.85% and 83.90% respectively.

articleTitle: Silver- TiO2 Nanoparticles Enabled Fiber Optic Sensor for Biosensing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Localized Surface plasmon-based sensors offer distinct advantages over traditional Surface Plasmon resonance-based sensors due to their enhanced sensitivity. Silver-TiO2 is chosen as the material composition for the LSPR-based sensor due to its higher precision, high chemical stability, low cost, and environmental friendliness which is ideal for optical sensing applications. By varying the size, metal filling fraction, dielectric constant, and using blood as the sensing medium, the optical properties of an LSPR-based Silver-TiO2 sensor are determined using Maxwell Garnett’s Theory and the Extinction Coefficient. Based on this, the peak of the extinction coefficient for a diabetic blood sample was found to be $1.7164 \times 10^{-16}$. Based on the data collected, the study reveals that the LSPR-based Silver-TiO2 sensor is effective for detection of sugar concentration in human blood.

articleTitle: An Ensembled Real-Time Hand-Gesture Recognition using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hand sign recognition is a vital technology in the human-computer interaction, enabling individuals to communicate with machines naturally and effectively. An innovative approach for real-time hand sign identification with the help of CNN and OpenCV is introduced with the fusion of computer vision and deep learning that can accurately interpret and classify an extensive range of hand signs and gestures. This research contributes significantly to the fields of computer vision and human-computer interaction, offering a practical and efficient solution for hand sign recognition. The combination of CNN and OpenCV presents a promising avenue for enhancing accessibility and communication, especially in environments where verbal communication is limited or non-existent. The model is trained with multiple data so that the system can recognize the hand gestures more precisely. Pre-trained architectures like ResNet and MobileNet are combined with the CNN model using ensemble learning and the performance is improved when compared to all the three CNN architectures individually. The ensemble model provides better accuracy of 96 %. The potential applications of this technology are vast, from assisting the hearing-impaired in understanding sign language to more immersive and intuitive interactions. Overall, the approach holds the promise of bridging the gap between human gestures and machine understanding, opening new doors for meaningful interactions between individuals and intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Solar Panel Images using a novel feed-forward based CNN model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing dependence on renewable energy highlights the critical need for efficient and reliable maintenance strategies for solar panel installations. A key aspect of maintenance is early detection of faults in individual solar panels, which results in reduced energy production and increased maintenance costs. In this paper, we proposed a novel approach for fault detection in solar panel images. The proposed novel Feed-forward based CNN architecture utilizes the ability to automatically extract features from images to accurately identify faults in solar panels. The proposed CNN model trained on a small, annotated dataset of solar panel images, which includes clean and faulty panels. The Experimental results show the superiority of Feed-forward based CNN model in fault-detection compared to traditional CNN methods, achieving higher precision and recall rate in a wide range of fault types. The proposed approach not only significantly reduces the time and resources required for manual inspection, but also enhances the effectiveness of identifying faults within the solar energy systems. In conclusion, this paper introduces a novel Feed-forward based CNN for fault detection in solar panel images, which provides a solution to enhance the efficiency of solar power installation.

articleTitle: Exploring Neural Connectivity in Autism: Insights from Nonlinear Functional Connectivity Matrix and Graph Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research introduces an approach to functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) analysis, focusing on Nonlinear Functional Connectivity (NFC). Traditional linear correlation methods in fMRI studies may fail to capture the intricate nonlinear relationships inherent in neural dynamics. By employing a kernel function, we explore these nonlinear dependencies, transforming the data to reveal hidden patterns. Our methodology delves into the nonlinearity of brain images using the kernel function, encompassing preprocessing of fMRI data, generated a brain graph, extraction of relevant graph features, and application of kernel techniques to quantify the communication and interaction between brain regions. The binary classes of Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) are used for the experimental analysis. The experiment showed that this kernel-based strategy, which may be overlooked by conventional linear methods, reveals unique and biologically meaningful connection patterns.

articleTitle: A Framework for Fleet Management using IoT and Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of IoT (Internet of Things) technology in vehicles has become increasingly imperative in today’s rapidly evolving automotive landscape. IoT empowers vehicles to become more intelligent, transforming them into interconnected nodes capable of real-time data exchange. This capability is essential for enhancing road safety, as IoT-enabled vehicles can communicate with one another. In an era of data-driven decision-making, IoT in vehicles is not just a convenience but a necessity for safer, more efficient, and environmentally responsible transportation. In cosmopolitan cities like Bengaluru, the city’s roads, once renowned for their tree-lined beauty, now find themselves choked with a relentless surge of vehicles. There is heavy traffic throughout the city with the air quality deteriorating in the city. Despite efforts to expand infrastructure and promote public transportation, Bengaluru’s traffic remains a formidable challenge. This work proposes a simple framework for an IoT enabled visualization and predictive analytics in the context of fleet management in Bengaluru’s scenario. This architecture could be further enhanced using various other sensors and machine learning models. This framework was implemented, simulated and analyzed using MATLAB and ThingSpeak application.

articleTitle: Optimizing Fashion Recommendations for Diverse Body Types: An Epsilon Greedy Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As the fashion industry evolves, the need for sophisticated recommendation systems on e-commerce platforms becomes increasingly critical. This paper introduces a novel reinforcement learning-based recommendation system tailored for diverse body types using the Epsilon Greedy algorithm. Our dual-layered model architecture integrates content-based filtering to precisely identify user body types through innovative physical measurements and photographic analysis. This groundwork allows for a dynamic reinforcement learning strategy to refine and personalize fashion recommendations. Statistical analysis confirmed that our system significantly enhances recommendation precision, achieving a novelty score of $\mathbf{84\%}$ and a click-through rate of 46%, surpassing traditional static models. The adaptive reinforcement mechanism demonstrated robust generalization across various user interactions without significant deviation in performance. By personalizing fashion recommendations to individual user preferences and body types, our system facilitates more accurate and engaging shopping experiences, effectively addressing the challenges of personalization in the fast-evolving e-commerce sector.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multilingual Communication Enhancement Using Transformer Model for Social Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social media platforms have become integral to global communication, connecting individuals from diverse linguistic backgrounds. However, the language barrier remains a significant challenge, hindering effective cross-cultural interaction. This paper introduces a real-time multilingual communication enhancement system for social media platforms, leveragingBidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERTs). This approach addresses these drawbacks by employing a pre-trained Transformer model, fine-tuned on a comprehensive dataset curated from the platform itself. The novelty of this system lies in its real-time capabilities and the utilization of cutting-edge Transformer architectures, enabling users to engage in instantaneous multilingual conversations. By integrating this model into the social media platform’s infrastructure, they provide a user-friendly interface that allows individuals to select their preferred language, with automatic language detection for incoming messages. They evaluate the system’s performance using established metrics, including translation accuracy, response time, and user satisfaction. Continuous monitoring and a feedback loop are implemented to iteratively enhance the model’s performance over time. The proposed system represents a significant advancement in overcoming language barriers on social media platforms, fostering a more inclusive and globally connected online community with accuracy 92.3%. Through empirical evaluation and user feedback, they demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the approach.

articleTitle: Exploring Differential and Extractive Based Approaches for Zero-Shot Learning in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Zero-shot getting to know (ZSL) is a framework in laptop vision in which a system is anticipated to recognize or classify new items that are not visible in its training information. To effectively generalize to new unseen facts, two most important approaches are being investigated; the first being a differential primarily based method and the second being an extractive primarily based technique. The former is based on getting to know a comprehensive discriminative mapping of a hard and fast of prototypes to the supply and target domain names. At the same time, the latter specializes in identifying the maximum informative subspace that exploits facts from both domains. Differential-based strategies were usually carried out for ZSL tasks by learning a multi-undertaking discriminative model consisting of the convex generalized linear model. This technique entails using a set of classified pictures from the labeled set and an unlabeled set from the target domain, after which mapping each domain name to a not-unusual characteristic space. This allows the model to learn the inherent variations among the categorized and unsupervised domain names and then to expect unseen class labels with the aid of assimilating extensive correlations between the unique set and unseen instructions. Extractive-based totally techniques, alternatively, cognizance on extracting sufficient discriminative records from both the labeled and unlabeled units.

articleTitle: Developing a Conveyance App for Organic Grains
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Delivering the Goodness: A Versatile App Revolutionizing Natural Grain Conveyance. This proposition diagrams the advancement of a portable application, “Conveying the Goodness,” planned to bridge the hole between health-conscious shoppers and the world of natural grains. Recognizing the expanding request for sound and economical nourishment alternatives, this app will give a helpful and user-friendly stage to browse, select, and arrange a differing choice of high-quality natural grains conveyed straightforwardly to consumers’ doorsteps. Joining forces with nearby ranches and wholesalers will guarantee the freshness and quality of the items advertised, whereas supporting maintainable agrarian hones. Clients can helpfully browse point by point depictions, dietary data, and formulas for each grain assortment. Moreover, the app will permit clients to track their orders in real-time, plan conveyances at their comfort, and get to instructive assets almost the benefits of natural grains, counting data on their predominant taste, natural affect, and potential wellbeing advantages.

articleTitle: Internet of Thing Centred Restaurant Automation System using CRM
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The goal of such undertaking is to create new Touchbased meal payment system than will replace the current ordering process. Using the majority of eateries, the food request procedure is truly presented in catalo card layout, meaning the client must first choose extremely item from the menu before the server can arrive and collect the payment. It’s very time-consuming process. Therefore, we created a contact-screen-based meal ordering app allowing users to immediately submit requests simply pressing meals shown on mobile tablets, smartphones, and other suitable gadgets. The equipment accomplishes information exhibit, receiving, transmitting, storing, and analyzing instantly. It offers several benefits including exceptional usability and Savings on time, money, portability, less human errors, adaptability, and client feedback, among other things. The setup needed a lot of staff to manage client reservations, food orders, food inquiries, placing orders on tables, and asking customers to bring their plates. The goal of this “Intelligent Automatic Restaurants” is can link each the numerous contact-points, exchange data, streamline procedures, and personalize experience. In this instance, data can be sent through a reader via one RFID chip. E-menu represents an engaging ordering platform that offers clients an entirely fresh digital restaurant.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cardio Vascular Disease prediction model using Contextual Feature Learning approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardio Vascular Disease poses a substantial worldwide health problem, highlighting the urgent requirement for the development of precise and more efficient diagnostic techniques. Existing studies have provided useful insights in this area, but there is still a need to improve the models for prediction and fill the gaps in the current detection methods. Traditional models often overlook the subtle nuances and interdependencies between different health determinants. The Contextual Feature Learning model introduces a sophisticated advancement in Machine Learning, tailored to elevate the accuracy of Cardio Vascular Disease predictions. This study aims to introduce a prediction model for Cardio Vascular Disease using the deep Contextual Feature Learning techniques. The proposed Cardio Vascular Disease model achieves the accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score and AUC of $100 \%, 95.7 \%, 97.6 \%, 96.3 \%$ and $96.9 \%$. The findings exhibit that Contextual Feature Learning model effectively captures and use complex feature interferences, prompting highly accurate predictions.

articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Machine Learning Algorithms in Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of device mastering algorithms has become increasingly popular in text type. The essential benefits of using these algorithms are their ability to perceive trends in text statistics and examine the information they may be uncovered. Textual content classification entails sorting textual content into predefined categories or lessons using diverse algorithms. Specific device studying strategies, including assist vector machines (SVMs) and artificial neural networks (ANNs), have been carried out for textual content class duties. Those algorithms help identify the applicable topics in extensive text collections and allow the categorization of files into nicely-defined topic clusters. This paper explores the software of machine studying algorithms in text category obligations. Further, a number of the popular algorithms and their applications on this subject and their blessings and limitations are discussed. Sooner or later, conclusions and destiny paintings are discussed.

articleTitle: Optimizing Road Extraction in Remote Sensing Imagery: A Lightweight Dilated Inception Deep Residual U-Net with Channel Attention (LDIDRU-CAN) Model and Pruning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The major challenge in Road Extraction is to extract accurate and complete road network and to get high accuracy while minimizing computational power and ensuring faster prediction. It plays important role in urban planning, disaster management, automatic vehicle navigation and GPS navigation. Several earlier studies used complex deep networks that required large amounts of computational power and large storage. In order to address issues such as high storage requirements, computational load, access to memory delays, and low hardware deployment efficiency this research work presents a novel network model called LDIDRU-CAN. The proposed model is fast, compact, and efficient and requires less storage. The objective of this work, is to compress the original model using structured pruning strategy. This strategy simplified the original model and reduced their computation cost as well as storage requirements. For the reduction of the parameters, we focused on the Row Scale Regular Pruning (RSRP) and Low Learning Rate (LLR) retraining. After applying RSRP pruning approach it reduces storage requirements, parameters, and also contributes to a more than 50% reduction in hardware resource consumption and successfully enhances the parallelism of the model. Testing and validations are performed on the Massachusetts Road Dataset. With only 45 M parameters and 180 MB model size, the suggested network achieves remarkable performance with 87.91% precision, 85.51% recall, 86.69% F1-score and 98.91% accuracy.

articleTitle: Cervical Cancer Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cervical cancer, a major cause of female cancer deaths globally, shares epidemiological similarities with low-infectious venereal diseases. Risk factors like early intercourse and multiple partners strongly influence its incidence. Screening advancements have reduced its impact, but shifting sexual behaviours hint at rising risks. Smoking and HPV 16/18 contribute to its multifaceted development. Prevention focuses on societal measures, HPV vaccination, and screening techniques like high-risk HPV genotyping and liquid-based cytology. The proposed paper begins with an overview of cervical cancer epidemiology, risk factors, and existing screening methods. It then delves into the utilization of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised for analysing the data source containing multitude of attributes that contribute to the risk of cervical cancer. A comprehensive strategy could make cervical cancer the first conquerable cancer through prevention and control measures. In this work, the performance of eight classification techniques for the prediction of cervical cancer has been assessed. They include k-nearest Neighbours (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, Decision Trees, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Naïve Bayes, Kmeans and Logistic Regression. Preliminary analysis of the dataset on cervical cancer risk factors reveals a diverse array of attributes such as sexual partners, contraceptive use, duration of smoking (years), quantity of smoking (packets), HPV infection status, Intra uterine device (IUD), history of sexually transmitted diseases, presence of other viral infections, history of syphilis, cytology. Among the tested algorithms, Decision Tree exhibits the highest accuracy at 99.65%, closely followed by Naïve Bayes at 97.93%. KNN achieves a commendable accuracy score of 98.96%, while Random Forest and SVM perform similarly well, with accuracy scores of 98.76% and 98.96%, respectively. Logistic Regression demonstrates a slightly lower accuracy of 98.45%. Notably, XGboost stands out as the most effective method with an outstanding accuracy score of 99.48%. However, Kmeans lags behind with an accuracy score of 49.89%. These findings highlight the varying predictive abilities of different machine learning algorithms in cervical cancer risk prediction, with some methods showing notably superior performance over others.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Derivative Market Predictions with Hybrid EGARCH-ANN Models: Embracing Machine Learning for Better Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The derivative market offers a dynamic platform for trading various instruments, including exchange-traded and over-thecounter derivatives. Amidst financial crises, regulatory efforts emphasize risk management and international oversight. Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) revolutionize machine learning, enhancing predictive capabilities in diverse domains, notably finance. Effective market movement forecasting is pivotal for maximizing returns and managing risks. Input variables, ranging from historical data to economic indicators, play a crucial role in predicting derivative movements. The EGARCH-ANN hybrid model integrates EGARCH with ANN, demonstrating superior forecasting accuracy. ANNs excel in approximating complex target functions, leveraging non-linearity, continuous learning, and parallel processing. Learning algorithms like Gradient Descent and Backpropagation optimize ANN training, enhancing performance in diverse tasks. Configuration of ANNs for stock market forecasting involves training on historical data, with refined models exhibiting promising results. The comparative analysis underscores the efficacy of the fuzzy-EGARCH-ANN model in forecasting volatile market behavior. Overall, ANNs offer a potent toolset for forecasting derivative movements, with hybrid models like EGARCH-ANN showing significant promise in financial prediction.

articleTitle: Secure Data Embedding using Fourier Transform-based Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The process of watermarking involves the incorporation of a distinct identifier into digital media. By embedding a watermark one can prevent unauthorized access and establish ownership. The main aim of this paper is to combine the watermarking algorithm with multimedia data. The fundamental approach of this method is the application of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for both embedding and extracting watermarks from images and videos. The combination of watermarking methods and FFT gives several benefits like copyright protection, content authentication, and identity verification. The main reason for the use of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) in this paper is the fact that it is resistant to common attacks and its media characteristics are compatible with it. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of this approach and show its unprecedented feature in watermark embedding and extraction. The ultimate goal is to strengthen the security and authenticity of digital material. When compared to other methods like the Fourier-Mellin, DFT, DWT-DCT-SVD, and QDFT, this FFT approach produced better results and outperformed existing methods.

articleTitle: Farmoline - The New Age Agro Drone in Modern Embedded Agriculture to Spray Healthy Organic Pesticides
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The utilization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), popularly known as drones, in the agricultural sector has garnered notable attention as a possible means of enhancing efficiency and productivity in crop care and management. Therefore, this research project proposes the creation of an atmospherically regulated automotive spraying mechanism utilizing drones for agricultural applications. The principal objective of this study is to replace manual labour with an automated and eco-friendly solution that promotes sustainable farming practices. To tackle the challenge of accurately and precisely spraying the required quantity of enzymes to crops, this research project has implemented a wired configuration, which comprises poles and pulleys to create a stable spraying system. This approach guarantees meticulous and controlled movements of the drones while simultaneously reducing the payload by providing wired supplies in place of heavy batteries. By utilizing tethered drones with a remarkable payload capacity of 5-liters, the research project aims to extend flight time and coverage area, thereby enabling efficient spraying over vast agricultural land. Furthermore, the replacement of chemical fertilizers and pesticides with enzymes and natural agents minimizes environmental pollution and reduces chemical dependency, thereby creating a cleaner and greener farming ecosystem. The proposed drone-based spraying system offers a practical and sustainable solution for small-scale farming, thereby enabling farmers to automate crop care operations and decrease reliance on harmful chemicals. With autonomous operation and minimal human intervention, farmers can allocate their time and resources more effectively while ensuring efficient and effective crop management. This research project contributes to the advancement of agricultural practices by integrating the capabilities of drone technology and considering environmental factors into crop care operations. The following sections delve into the methodology, advantages, and limitations of the proposed system, providing insights into its potential applications and impact on the agricultural industry.

articleTitle: Harnessing Artificial Neural Network Model to Anticipate Housing Market Rates
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predicting house prices is a vital issue in real estate market analysis, having important ramifications for homeowners, buyers, and investors. Amidst this exploration, we utilize an innovative artificial neural network (ANN) approach for predicting house prices, applied to the housing sales data specifically gathered from Chennai. The information includes many parameters, including area, the number of lavatories and bedrooms, the house’s quality rating, and other features. Our initial steps involve data preparation, encompassing tasks such as managing missing data, encoding categorical variables, and standardizing numerical features. Next, we use a sequential architecture with multiple dense layers and dropout regularization to build a deep learning model. Metrics like mean absolute error, mean squared error, root mean square error, mean absolute percentage error, R-squared, and root mean squared log error are used to assess the algorithm’s efficacy after it has been built with the Adam optimizer with mean squared error loss. The results of our experiments underscore the efficacy of the proposed methodology in precisely forecasting house prices. We achieve superior performance levels, and the capacity of the model to effectively discern new data is demonstrated by low error metrics values. Furthermore, epoch-by-epoch preparation and evaluation loss visualizations shed light on the model’s learning dynamics. Overall, this research contributes to the field of real estate market analysis by providing a reliable and efficient method for house price prediction. The discoveries hold tangible significance for homeowners, purchasers, and investors aiming to make decisions in the housing market. Future research directions include exploring alternative model techniques, incorporating additional features, and investigating the consequences of external factors on property prices.

articleTitle: Adaptive Random Evolution Whale Optimization Algorithm (AREWOA) Based Workflow Scheduling in a Virtualized Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud workflow task scheduling refers to assigning workflow tasks submitted by users to appropriate computer resources for execution. The workflow scheduler assigns the user request to the available Virtual Machine (VM) hosted on cloud servers during scheduling. However, while limiting energy consumption, the workflow application processing schedule length (makespan) and associated costs must stay within the users budget and deadline. The tasks are chosen using the optimal scheduling technique to reduce Energy Consumption (EC) and maximize Resource Utilization (RU) without compromising system performance. In this paper, Adaptive Random Evolution Whale Optimization Algorithm (AREWOA) based scheduling is proposed to reduce EC, maximize RU, and workflow execution time. AREWOA is performed based on the dual-operation strategy partnership. Initially, the Gaussian distribution is used in the randomization procedure to raise the variety of the population. Secondly, a new skip step factor is introduced to enhance the optimizer capability to solve local optimum, and specific reinforcement is applied to the hunter process to enhance the whale’s exclusive exploration or exploitation skills. An adaptive weight factor is applied to maintain algorithm stability and a balance among exploration and exploitation. Dynamic provisioning of infinite heterogeneous resources, AREWOA is thought to demonstrate cloud-based Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS). This approach is simulated in Cloud Simulator and the results shows that the efficiency of the methods.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Random Evolution Whale Optimization Algorithm (AREWOA)

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DCGAN and WGAN in Synthesizing Brain MRI Scans for Alzheimer’s Disease Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline and memory impairment, affecting millions of individuals worldwide. Accurate diagnosis is crucial for timely intervention and improved patient care. In this realm, the role of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in addressing class imbalance and enhancing model performance has come to the forefront. In this project, we embarked on a comprehensive exploration of GAN-augmented MRI scans and their impact on Alzheimer’s disease detection models. Leveraging the power of DenseNet169, DenseNet-121, and a deep CNN model, we crafted a robust ensemble framework, and our results suggest a potential influence in the field of Alzheimer’s diagnosis. We harnessed the prospect of GANs to generate synthetic images, and subsequently retrained our classification model using the augmented data. Our endeavor serves as a validation to the transformative influence of GANs in enhancing the reliability of diagnostic models while ensuring equitable representation across classes, by mitigating class imbalance issues. This study not only highlights the effectiveness of GANs in addressing data scarcity issues in AD diagnosis but also further contributes to the broader understanding of the synergistic relationship between generative models and medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics Model for Heart Disease Prediction with Personalized Recommendation Systems using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the era of rapid technological advancements, the persistent challenge of heart diseases, including sudden cardiac incidents, remains a pressing concern worldwide. Despite the potential of early warnings, these conditions continue to contribute significantly high mortality rates. This study involves machine learning (ML) techniques to forecast heart disease occurrences, enabling early awareness and intervention. Beyond mere prediction, this research innovates by integrating a system that provides personalized diet and exercise recommendations. Predictive analytics models such as Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, XGBoost and Random Forest are used for the prediction. K-means clustering for diet recommendation and ontology-based programming is used for exercise recommendation. This study identifies XGBoost as the best performer among other predictive analytics model in predicting heart disease. This study implements not only heart disease prediction but also gives personalized recommendations for the users which fosters proactive health management through personalized advice, marking a significant step in stopping high mortality rates due to heart disease.

articleTitle: An Efficient Task Scheduling for Latency Sensitive Tasks in Edge - Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With an emphasis on fulfilling deadlines, this study presents an efficient method for workload scheduling in edge-cloud collaborative computing settings. It optimizes task distribution taking into account variables like task arrival rate and resource availability. A genetic algorithm-based approach is suggested to improve the procedure of scheduling further. It makes use of task prioritization, mutation, and solution encoding. To achieve deadline fulfillment and resource optimization in edge-cloud collaborative computing systems, this method successfully tackles the problems of fluctuating user demands and resource constraints. It also provides an effective solution for dynamic task scheduling.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Management of Big Data Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: (DRL) has emerged as a promising strategy for autonomous management of Big Data infrastructures. It has the potential to optimize resource allocation, increase system performance, and boost scalability. DRL has emerged as a promising approach. In this work, an overview of recent developments in the use of DRL approaches to meet the issues of successfully managing large-scale data infrastructures is presented. In this article, we will cover the fundamental elements that make up DRL-based systems. These elements include the modeling of the environment, the selection of actions, and the reward mechanisms that are adapted to the specific features of Big Data settings. In addition, we investigate a number of other DRL methods, including (DQN), (PPO), and (DDPG), as well as their applicability in Big Data systems when it comes to tasks such as workload scheduling, resource provisioning, and defect detection. Additionally, we address the advantages and limits of DRL techniques in managing Big Data infrastructures, including scalability, robustness, and interpretability. These are some of the benefits that we highlight. Our goal is to give insights into the potential of DRL for autonomous administration of Big Data infrastructures by conducting a complete analysis of relevant literature along with case studies. Additionally, we want to propose viable avenues for future research along with development in this rapidly developing subject.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quadcopter Navigation with Energy-Efficient Obstacle Avoidance Using the KNN Algorithm and Distance Deviation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One particular kind of UAV that is frequently employed for searching and rescue, reconnaissance, and other purposes is the quadcopter. To reduce the amount of human oversight during quadcopter navigation, an obstacle avoidance system is required. With obstacle dimension information, obstacle avoidance systems can be designed to select avoidance paths. Energy efficiency must be taken into account while determining the avoidance direction of quadcopter flights due to power limits. The obstacle avoidance system in this study assesses an object’s dimensions, energy consumption, and distance from the quadcopter before determining which direction to avoid it-upward, leftward, or rightward. The quadcopter navigates in a three-dimensional environment. With 98.7% accuracy and 0.0062 s of computing time, KNN (K-Nearest Neighbor) generates effective avoidance judgments. According to the simulation, the quadcopter may arrive at the desired location without running into any stationary obstructions. When impediments are detected, the quadcopter can also select the most effective avoidance direction.

articleTitle: Developing a Deep Residual Network For The Early Identification of Adult-Onset Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels, resulting in progressive damage to essential organs such as the heart, blood vessels, eyes, kidneys, and nerves. Primarily affecting adults, type 2 diabetes, the most common form, emerges when the body exhibits resistance to insulin or fails to generate a sufficient quantity. The past three decades have witnessed a substantial rise in the prevalence of type 2 diabetes globally, spanning nations with diverse income levels. In the quest to improve patient care through the early detection of diabetes-related complications, this study employs machine learning (ML) models to identify and classify type 2 diabetes. The research evaluates the effectiveness of five ML models-K-nearest neighbor (K-NN), Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), decision trees (DT), logistic regression (LR), and support vector machines (SVM)-as well as three deep learning models-Res-Net, MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)-in identifying individuals with diabetes.Using a Kaggle-hosted dataset that includes information from 2768 patients, both with and without diabetes, the study considers various factors such as previous pregnancies, blood glucose levels, diastolic blood pressure, skinfold thickness, body insulin levels, body mass index, genetic background, family history of diabetes, age, and ultimate outcome. The results indicate that the deep learning models demonstrated notable performance. The Res-Net model, with a success rate of $98 \%$, emerged as the most effective in diabetes identification, closely followed by the MLP and LSTM models with success rates of $\mathbf{9 4. 2 \%}$ and $87.2 \%$, respectively. In summary, the use of deep learning models for early diabetes detection shows significant promise, as evidenced by the favorable performance of the ResNet model in this investigation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Feature Scaling in Time Series Forecasting: A Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Electricity Pricing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The volatile nature of electricity markets presents a considerable challenge to accurate price forecasting, which is crucial for energy companies, policymakers, and consumers. Traditional models often fail to adapt to rapid changes in the market, leading to significant discrepancies in price forecasting. To address this, our study introduces hybrid machine learning (ML) technologies, combining the strengths of random forest and deep learning networks to enhance predictive accuracy and responsiveness to market changes. The cornerstone of Dynamic Feature Scaling Techniques for Time Series is dynamic feature scaling, which intelligently adjusts the input features based on the evolving data stream, ensuring the model remains sensitive to the latest market trends. This adaptability is critical for maintaining forecast accuracy in an environment where traditional static models fail. Our hybrid model incorporates a finely tuned Random Forest algorithm optimized through extensive hyperparameter tuning. A planned approach is used in this optimization process to look at several configurations. In the end, the setup that lowers the RMSE to an impressive 0.0496 while maintaining cross-validation scores above 0.982 is found. Furthermore, the model’s architecture allows seamless real-time data integration, empowering it to adjust predictions instantaneously as new information becomes available. Cloud technologies enhance this capability by providing the computational power to process large datasets quickly and efficiently, enabling real-time analytics and decision-making. The results affirm the model’s robustness and potential to revolutionize energy price predictions, offering a valuable tool for market participants navigating the complexities of electricity pricing.

articleTitle: Image Based Bangladeshi Bird Detection and Classification through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Birds, as a diverse and integral component of the natural world, play a pivotal role in maintaining the balance and health of ecosystems. Their presence influences not only the environment but also various aspects of human life, making the accurate identification and understanding of birds crucial. Bird detection and classification from images is a challenging task with diverse applications, ranging from wildlife conservation and ecological studies to urban planning and agriculture. This research paper aims to explore the use of deep learning techniques for accurately detecting and classifying birds in images, as identifying native birds is vital for maintaining ecological balance, advancing scientific knowledge, preserving cultural heritage, and enhancing recreational activities. Deep learning is used in many fields [1], like speech, image recognition, drug discovery and toxicology, customer management, recommendation systems, bioinformatics, NLP, etc. This paper delves into various state-of-the-art deep learning architectures, including EfficientNetB7, MobileNetV3, and ResNet101. The research involves the preparation of a comprehensive dataset of bird images and evaluates the performance of different models based on various metrics, such as precision, recall, and F1-score. By enhancing the capacity to identify and comprehend birds, one strengthens the ability to protect and conserve the intricate web of life on our planet. Furthermore, challenges encountered during the process were discussed, and potential avenues for future research to enhance bird detection capabilities in real-world scenarios were proposed.

articleTitle: Real-Time Webcam-Based Eye Tracking for Gaze Estimation: Applications and Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
