abstract: The early and remote identification of chronic diseases is now achievable for the first time. In this study, mammography images from the Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) were used to build a deep transfer learning (DTL) model for an autonomous breast cancer diagnostic system. The enhanced medical treatment supplied by the smart healthcare system can benefit modern e-healthcare. Accurate diagnoses based on Internet of Things-based medical images are required for early detection and effective treatment of breast cancer. However, noise in these images can significantly reduce the precision of the diagnostic process. In this paper, we propose a new Triplet Attention Model (TAM) to improve the accuracy of breast cancer diagnosis from noisy medical images. The TAM use attention mechanisms and triplet loss to learn distinguishing features from noisy images. The triplet loss ensures that related images are closer together in the learned feature space, and the attention mechanism assists the model in focusing on those areas. As a result, categorization accuracy improves. Extensive tests are run on a large and diverse dataset of noisy breast medical images, and the results are compared to state-of-the-art approaches. As demonstrated in our trials, our proposed Triplet Attention Model surpasses earlier techniques in a number of significant ways, including its capacity to accurately classify noisy breast medical images for cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Multi-Class SVM & Random Forest Based Intrusion Detection Using UNSW-NB15 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Intrusion Detection or malicious node detection (IDS) show a important role in safeguarding computer networks system from security threats. However, traditional IDS methods often struggle with high false positive rates and limited detection accuracy. This paper presents an advanced IDS that harnesses the power of a multi-class support vector machine (SVM) and integrates random forest technique for feature selection, specifically targeting the UNSW-NB15 dataset. The motivation behind this research is to enhance IDS performance by leveraging robust machine learning techniques. The research problem centers on improving the accuracy and efficiency of detecting various network attacks while reducing false positives. Our approach involves meticulously preprocessing network traffic data to extract relevant features, utilizing random forest to identify the most informative ones, and then employing these features to train a multi-class SVM classifier. This classifier effectively categorizes network traffic into different attack types. The results demonstrate a significant improvement in prediction accuracy and a decrease in rate of false positives, thereby enhancing the overall effectiveness of IDS in protecting computer networks against security threats.

articleTitle: Smart Education Resource Management System: A Federated Game Theoretic Approach on Metaverse with Strict Preferences
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the domain of smart education resource management, utilizing Game Theory with Metaverse is crucial for improving allotment strategies and acquiring optimal results. Our research expedition concentrates on the distribution of eduresources, for example, teaching services and classrooms, which undertake an important position in lowering traditional allotment methodologies and enhancing efficiency. In this paper, we employ a strict preference allotment of instructors over a fixed number of available classrooms, which are considered for different subject teaching. We employ this by utilizing Metaverse, a lively virtual ecosystem where the real-world participants function via avatars presents a promising venue for resource allotment in education. Allowing the instructor with their first preference of classroom in random allotment becomes a difficult task to achieve, our research suggests a preference-fostered algorithm employed in this context. Here, we will explore the architecture of the algorithm and demonstrate its outcomes compared with random allotment. Alongside this, we have also proposed a homogeneous federated game theoretic approach to render the allotment among numerous systems, gathering their results and proposing the best outcome via voting mechanism.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing E-Commerce Security: A Secured Infrastructure Utilizing BlockChain
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the increase in technological advancement in the world, there is a huge shift going on as everyone wants to shift online and have a broader market available to them. E-commerce websites are a platform where a lot of orders and transactions are being made daily. Nowadays the market is shifting to an e-commerce platform for a bigger market and profit their business. With this technical advancement, there comes a threat to the information and data that are available, since most of the transactions are being recorded online. Thus, there is always a concern related to the security of user data, which can also be resolved using blockchain. Blockchain Technology which was proposed by Satoshi Nakamoto as a decentralized currency component of bitcoin technology. It also provides security to store data as it is immutable in nature. The main idea is that all the data of the user will be stored on blockchain so that it cannot be breached and all the information about the user remains preserved. In this article, a preliminary analysis is performed on existing work to understand the different types of security issues in the E-Commerce Sector. Further, the applicability of Blockchain is explored to provide a more secure infrastructure for the users and administration using E-Commerce services. To showcase the applicability of blockchain, here an E-Commerce platform is also developed using ShopKart, where the product information and transaction information is kept secure using Smart Contract in Blockchain. Furthermore, the cryptocurrency-based payment gateway is also introduced for the worldwide acceptability of payments.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Skin Lesions Using CNN-SVM: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Efficient diagnosis of skin cancers is a prerequisite that is aimed at timely coping with and direct treatment and control of cancer, which is the leading type of cause of death on a global scale. A hybrid Convolutional Neural Network and Support Vector Machine (CNN-SVM) model is introduced in this study to facilitate the classification of five distinct categories of skin lesions: blotches, actinic keratosis, melanoma, as well as the nevi. The model has been built upon the SVMs’ strong classification ability and CNN’s excelling feature extraction prowess. In this work, we employed a dataset of 2356 images drawn from repositories of dermal lesions available to the public. The models to generalize well are the data imbalance rectification and the various processes like rotation, rotating, magnification, and contrast adjustment. The trial model belongs to the CNN-SVM group, and it reached a wonderful performance with a precision of 92.13%, recall of 92.01%, F1-score of 91. high performance with 99% and 92% of the precision. 00%. These metrics outperform conventional models by a substantial margin: In the event CNNS are purposed individually, the outcomes to them were the following: 90.25% precision, 91. 30% recall, 90. 77% F1-score, and 91. 50% precision efficiency; LSTM models offered 58.75% recall, 89. 12% F1-score, and 90. Human mistakes; GAN computation could reach 92.00% precision, 92.00% recall, 91.50% F1score, and 92. 25% accuracy, and indeed, SVM models demonstrated 87% fully. 75% precision, 88.90% recall, 88. $32\% \mathrm{~F} 1)$.

articleTitle: Aerial Intelligence for Precision Monitoring and Fault Identification in Large-Scale Solar Farms Using Advanced Drone Technology and Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Solar energy is a promising source of renewable energy, and large-scale solar farms are becoming increasingly popular. However, the maintenance and monitoring of these farms can be challenging due to their size and the distributed nature of the solar panels. Traditional methods of inspection and maintenance are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to human error. This project proposes an innovative solution for precision monitoring and fault identification in large-scale solar farms using advanced drone technology and image processing techniques. The methodology involves collecting high-resolution thermal images of solar panels using a drone equipped with a thermal camera. The YOLOv5 object detection algorithm is then used to detect and classify diode issues, Multi-cell hotspots, and hotspots in thermal images with high precision and recall. The proposed methodology consists of five major stages: data collection, model development, model training, model validation, and model testing. The model is trained and validated using a labeled dataset and then tested to automate the process of detecting and classifying defects or issues in real time. The use of drones and thermal imaging enables non-destructive and contactless inspection, reducing the risk of damage to the solar panels. Overall, this project demonstrates the potential of using advanced drone technology and deep learning algorithms for precision monitoring and fault identification in large-scale solar farms, contributing to the development of more sustainable and efficient solar energy systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches in Seedling Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The agricultural sector is very important for the economic development of any country and it is still facing problems. In order for the crops to grow well, it is necessary that the information about the plants and seedling is known. This information is important for biodiversity preservation, weed removal and for successful cultivation of crops. Plant seedling classification plays a crucial role in agriculture, aiding in the identification of different plant species and facilitating tasks such as weed control and crop management. Deep learning methods have demonstrated encouraging performance in picture classification tasks, such as the classification of plant seedlings, in recent years. For the purpose of classifying plant seedlings, this research compares and contrasts many deep learning models, including CNN, ResNet, VGG16, Inception3, and YOLO. The dataset used for this has about 5500 images which are divided into 12 categories of different plant species. The images are preprocessed by resizing, normalization to enhance the quality of the dataset and then it is used to training to obtain better results. The comparison is done using accuracy and loss.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Autonomous Routing Algorithms for UAV-Enabled Telecommunications Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Self-sustaining routing algorithms for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAVs) enabled telecommunications structures can offer a low-cost and strength-efficient answer for community controllers. However, these algorithms ought to be evaluated so as to discover their weaknesses and strengths and to understand their viability to be used in such networks. This paper provides an assessment of numerous autonomous routing algorithms with admiration for their overall performance measures associated with the hyperlink pleasant, latency, and packet transport ratio. The authors investigated and compared the performance of numerous routing algorithms, inclusive of the Dynamic supply Routing (DSR), the Ado On-demand Distance Vector (AODV), the Optimized link state Routing (OLSR), and the area Routing Protocol (ZRP) for UAV-enabled telecommunications networks. To assess these algorithms, the authors hired actual-world datasets of UAV trajectories obtained from the NRMA visitor’s Telematics Dataset in combination with the COMSNET simulator. The effects of the have look showed that the DSR executed better than the AODV and the OLSR in phrases of latency and packet shipping ratio, at the same time as the ZRP executed first-rate in phrases of hyperlink best measurements. However, further evaluation discovered that the AODV and the OLSR had superior overall performance beneath varying mobility styles. In addition, the authors discovered that the wide variety of nodes and the terrain analysis of the community affected the performance of the algorithms differently.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Formal Methods on Enhancing Performance in Computer Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Formal strategies are a powerful tool used to design and verify software program systems. They provide a rigorous mathematical approach to model, examine, optimize and verify device behaviour below diverse working conditions. The capacity to apply formal techniques in laptop architecture studies is using a brand new studies path into exploring how to enhance the overall performance and reliability of computer structures. on this paper, we talk the capability of applying formal techniques in improving performance and reliability in computer architectures by way of specializing in its utility for the modelling and verification of computer gadget overall performance. We gift associated work and speak experiments that study the application of formal techniques in enhancing overall performance and reliability in computer architectures. Specifically, we discover the challenges of the usage of formal methods within the context of the upcoming generations of pc architectures that hire heterogeneous processors, facts-intensive packages and nice-grained parallelism. Subsequently, we offer an outlook of how formal techniques can be further applied to reinforce pc architectures reliability, scalability and programmability.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Stock Prices Using Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Technical analysis of stocks is crucial in the finance industry to make investment and purchase decisions. Forecasting the patterns of the stock market is a complex task as it’s erratic in nature. The stock prices exhibit non-stationarity and are subject to significant noise due to the influence of several factors. Commonly held beliefs propose that investing in the stock market entails notable risks, often discouraging many from considering it as a viable investment option. However, leveraging Time Series Analysis on historical stock data presents an opportunity to construct predictive models capable of predicting future trends in the closing prices of individual stocks. Traditionally, trend forecasting or stock price forecasting has been a tedious task with little accuracy. However, current technological advances and new techniques offer the opportunity to use historical data to make accurate predictions. Despite the challenges posed by using elements like investor behavior, government policies, global events and geopolitical tensions that make accurate predictions difficult to obtain, this paper contributes to the development of foundations for long-term stock price forecasts. This research specializes in the prediction of stock price to help investors in making informed decisions in this ever-changing market. Unique to this study is the comprehensive evaluation of multiple models - Exponential Smoothing, ARIMA, SARIMA and VAR - conducted on the Facebook stock data. By evaluating these models based on various metrics and comparing their results, this research provides a detailed analysis of their capabilities within the dynamic panorama of the stock marketplace.

articleTitle: Detection of Malware Utilizing Neural Networks and Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digitally interconnected landscape, the omnipresence of malware presents a significant threat to electronic devices, including computers, laptops, and mobile phones. Safeguarding against malware is essential to prevent unauthorized harm and exploitation of these devices. This study investigates the efficacy of various methodologies utilizing the NSL-Knowledge Discovery in Databases dataset from the University of New Brunswick to forecast malware attacks. Techniques such as K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Trees, XGBoost, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) are applied and evaluated for their predictive performance. Additionally, an Apriori model is deployed to uncover frequent itemsets within the dataset, exploiting inherent associations and correlations. A comprehensive examination of these approaches is presented, offering insights and conclusions regarding their effectiveness in combatting malware threats.

articleTitle: VU-NET: An Explainable AI Approach For Liver Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical image segmentation, particularly in tumor identification, is a critical aspect of modern healthcare. In this study, we propose our own VU-Net model to address liver tumor segmentation, utilizing the LiTS17 dataset and GradCAM visualization to provide insights into the model’s decision-making. Our contributions include a fine-tuned VU-Net model, extensive performance evaluation, and application of Grad-CAM for interpretability. These findings enhance understanding of deep learning models in medical imaging, promising advancements in tumor segmentation methodologies and contributing to improved patient care.

articleTitle: Explainable AI for Glaucoma Detection: Integrating Alternet-k and LIME
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma, a progressive eye disease known as the “Silent thief of sight,” poses a significant challenge in early detection and treatment. The conventional method of diagnosing glaucoma involves manual evaluation of retinal fundus images by trained ophthalmologists, which is not only time-consuming but also prone to human error (inter-observer variability) The aim of this study is to propose a novel approach for glaucoma detection utilizing a deep learning architecture called AlterNet-k. The key innovation lies in leveraging the AlterNet-k model, which is specifically designed to capture intricate patterns in medical images. By leveraging deep learning techniques, we pre-process raw retinal images and apply data augmentation to enhance model performance. The segmented AlterNet-k model effectively distinguishes between healthy and glaucomatous retinas, achieving a remarkable accuracy of 96.67%. This demonstrates the potential of deep learning models, such as AlterNet-k, in revolutionizing glaucoma diagnosis and improving patient outcomes by enabling early intervention strategies.

articleTitle: Innovating Software Complexity Measurement: A New Dimension in OO-Based Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel software complexity metric tailored for object-oriented programming called the Weighted Complexity (WC) metric. Addressing the growing intricacies of modern software systems, the WC metric integrates multiple dimensions of complexity, including structural, data, control, systemic, and cognitive aspects. By considering factors such as the nesting level of control structures, type of control structures, try-catch blocks, threads, and dynamic memory access, this metric offers a comprehensive evaluation of code complexity. The WC metric is demonstrated through a detailed computation example illustrating its practical application and benefits. The proposed metric not only enhances the understanding of software complexity but also provides actionable insights for improving code maintainability and reliability. Integration with continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines, static code analysis tools, and agile development practices further underscores its utility in real-world software development environments. By offering a multifaceted approach to complexity assessment, the WC metric aims to enrich the toolkit of software engineers, promoting robust development practices and higher quality software systems.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis and Likes Prediction from Social Media Comments: An ML approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The era of social media connectivity has produced a situation where people have platforms to receive approvals from the whole world whereas they used to be restricted to their local community, and in this work, a detailed analysis of the automated analysis of user-generated content on social media platforms with a primary focus on sentiment analysis of the comments on the posts will be presented. In the current era of social media dominated digital arena with people visiting social media for approval and in need of others’ advice, it will not work to manually analyze the bulk of conversation. To address this challenge of sentimental analysis, we proposeLinear SVC, Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting Classifier, Ada Boost Classifier, HistGradient Boosting Classifier with lexical analysis. Out of all HistGradient Boosting Classifier is the best model for sentiment analysis, with the highest accuracy mean of 0.935700 and ROC AUC mean of $\mathbf{0. 9 0 5 6 8 5}$, indicating superior performance in classification accuracy and class distinction. It is effective to use this method in analysis of the content of live social activity, and this allows to understand the emotions of the people and their engagement with the content, and this leads to the content optimization and the enhancement of the strategies of audience engagement.

articleTitle: IoT Sensor Data Stream Compression with Hybrid Compression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The recent world advancement in technology especially in the use of IoT devices has posed some serious complications in terms of how effectively we can convey data, this is normally a result of the limited bandwidth and power capacity. In this paper, we look into the need for efficient data compression in IoT devices and come up with a new approach to compress the data stream needed for IoT sensors. In this paper, we propose to integrate Dynamic Huffman Coding with Run Length Encoding smoothly as one novel network coding strategy to decrease the load carried by the communication channels and at the same time ensure the originality of the transmitted data. The proposed method is based on the use of RLE to remove a lot of redundant data and dynamic Huffman coding for further data compression. When compared with other central algorithms like dynamic Huffman, static Huffman, RLE, LZW, ZLIB, LZMA, and BZ2 this hybrid approach provided more efficient compression ratios and consumed less power. Compression can be considered an essential paradigm for IoT devices because it can minimize the restrictions associated with the prevention of limited bandwidths and power sources that are characteristic of such devices, which results in improved data sending and a longer lifespan of devices. As substantiated by the findings from our experiments, this approach holds a high degree of effectiveness and, therefore, is suitable for the IoT domain with a scarcity of resources in particular. The contributions of this research support the promotion of compression strategies while considering the IoT-specific needs thus enhancing standard system outcomes and durability.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cryptographic Protocol for Secure and Efficient Data Transmission for Wireless Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless Body Area Networks are a revolutionary advancement in modern healthcare that enable the continuous and real-time monitoring of patients’ physiological data using wearable and implantable sensors. Securing data transmission in WBAN is essential for reliable and effective healthcare monitoring. This work utilized a hybrid cryptographic model known as Secure End to end Emergency Network Data Transmission (SENDT) that incorporated Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) and Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA). The suggested solution integrates ECC and ECDSA algorithms to efficiently preserve data privacy and guarantee the integrity of transferred data among nodes. The approach utilizes AES-128 for encryption, SHA-2 for hashing, and ECDSA for authentication and verification, guaranteeing strong security with minimum computation overhead. This research compares HECC, CLAKA, and SENDT cryptographic protocols. The proposed technique exhibits exceptional performance, with an impressive throughput of 85%, a packet delivery ratio of 95%, a reduction in latency by 30%, and a decrease in energy usage by 25% when compared to alternative protocols. The results emphasise the effectiveness and dependability of SENDT in ensuring secure data transmission for WBAN applications. Keywords— WBAN, Data Security, ECC, ECDSA, AES

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Fractal and ArUco marker for Navigation and Landing of Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The detection and pose estimation of markers are increasingly crucial across various domains, including human-robot interaction, UAV navigation, robotic grasping, and underwater navigation and many more. This paper evaluates the robustness of two prominent fiducial markers ArUco and Fractal marker, under diverse environmental conditions. These conditions include static and dynamic platforms, varying light intensity, occlusion, reflection, distortion, and detection through glass medium and many other situations considering the area of both markers identical. Detection rates for all conditions were calculated for each marker by analyzing the proportion of detected frames out of approximately 1800 total frames per condition. The study reveals that Fractal markers outperform ArUco markers. They demonstrate faster detection, greater resilience to occlusion, better resolution handling, and consistent performance across multiple scenarios. These findings suggest that Fractal marker could significantly enhance the reliability and efficiency of marker based detection systems in complex real-world applications. The dataset will be made accessible to the general public, facilitating additional investigation and verification of the conclusions reported in this work.

articleTitle: Ergonomic Tremor Control Spoon for Parkinson Disorder
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a neurological disorder, it occasionally begins with a barely perceptible tremor in just one hand and progresses gradually. It usually strikes the elderly and is caused by significant damage to nerve cells that impairs mobility and day-to-day activities. Initial symptoms may include involuntary tremors and shivering in the hands, making it difficult for the patient to do daily activities like eating from a bowl. With the help of the provided utensil, this work essentially provides a non-invasive method that enables the patient to consume the food. A working prototype for a stabilizing spoon was created with the goal of serving as a supplement for individuals who require aid when eating. The suggested system is constructed using sensor, Controller and actuator as a significant element. This was made feasible by the employment of a sensor that integrated accelerometers and gyroscopes to determine the direction and rate of tilt of the device’s handle. Two servo motors are set up orthogonal to one another to give two axes of freedom in order to develop a system The spoon was intended to maintain its utensil basin horizontal using this method. The work revealed that the spoon’s vertical and horizontal accelerations vary significantly depending on the type of food, with dry food showing a mean vertical acceleration of $15.1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$ and horizontal acceleration of $12.89 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$, whereas wet food demonstrates higher variability in vertical acceleration (mean of $15.5 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$) and lower mean horizontal acceleration $\left(8.95 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}\right.$). This indicates the spoon’s movement is more consistent with dry food and more erratic with wet food. The spoon is designed with precise dimensions $(27 \mathrm{~cm}$ in length, 9 cm in width, and 1 mm in thickness) and a total weight of 130 gm, which are optimized for comfortable and effective use by Parkinson’s patients. The measurements ensure the spoon’s stability and usability.

articleTitle: Attention-based Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Detecting Hateful Tweets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The spread of hate speech on the internet makes it difficult to create safe online groups. Because harmful language is ever-evolving and has subtleties and contextual dependencies, automated hate speech identification is an intricate task. Identifying hate speech is essential to preserving a secure online environment. We introduce a hybrid neural network architecture that integrates Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and attention mechanisms to enhance hate speech identification. While CNNs are good at capturing local n-gram characteristics, BiLSTMs are better at modeling long-range dependencies in text sequences. The attention mechanism dynamically highlights the most prominent textual portions that appear to be hate speech. Our experimental evaluation of the Davidson dataset shows that the proposed hybrid model achieves greater accuracy in identifying offensive language, hate speech, and neutral content compared to baseline techniques. Our model reaches a noteworthy 93% accuracy. This study advances the creation of more reliable and comprehensible instruments for reducing hate speech online.

articleTitle: Applying Face Recognition Technology to Monitor and Analyze Student Behavior in Higher Education through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a term that refers to computers’ ability to move or do something. The goal of Joy Buolamwini, a computer scientist, is to make society more accountable and equitable through the use of technology. She had to start Algorithmic Justice League. This implies that AI is having a significant impact on the labor market as most tasks traditionally performed by humans such as reasoning and decision-making are now being done by machines. AI has been largely responsible for replacing human labour with automation in back-office operations and bringing about rapid change especially in routine based low skilled jobs. Its increasing productivity leads people to worry about losing their jobs. Identity theft is an increasing problem with grave implications for both individuals and financial institutions. Hence, banks must be adaptive given the sophistication of fraudsters. Buolamwini also stresses how important it is not to lose sight of our humanity in the face of technological progress. Monetary losses are among consequences resulting from identity theft.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Detection of Diabetic Foot Ulcer using Foot Thermography Images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) are a serious consequence for diabetes individuals, frequently resulting in amputation. Early identification is critical in averting such results. This study looks at the effectiveness of deep learning models in recognizing DFUs from foot thermography photos. We evaluate the performance of several deep learning architectures against more contemporary models. The models will be trained and assessed using a publicly accessible foot thermography picture collection that includes both healthy and DFU patients. Each model’s performance in DFU identification will be evaluated based on accuracy, precision, recall, and $\mathbf{f 1}$ score. We intend to find the deep learning model with the greatest accuracy,f1 score, and robustness in DFU classification, which would pave the way for a computer-aided diagnostic tool that uses thermography to detect DFU in diabetes patients early. This research shows potential for enhancing patient care and lowering amputation rates.

articleTitle: RLAD: Reinforcement Learning based Anomaly Detection system for IoT devices in smart homes
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), smart homes have become a cornerstone of modern living, offering convenience, energy efficiency, and security. The extensive connectivity within these networks brings forth security challenges, making the detection of anomalies a critical aspect of IoT network security. Anomalies encompass a wide array of unexpected events, from irregular data patterns to communication anomalies, power fluctuations, behavioral deviations, security breaches, and environmental variations. This paper underscores the pivotal role of anomaly detection in securing IoT networks, highlighting its significance in identifying both known threats and emerging risks. Anomaly detection in IoT relies on machine learning and statistical techniques, encompassing data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, real-time anomaly detection, and responsive actions. Reinforcement Learning(RL), a subset of machine learning, emerges as a formidable tool in enhancing IoT network security. RL models continuously observe and adapt to device behavior, identifying anomalies and security breaches in real-time. RL offers adaptability in rapidly changing IoT environments, proactive responses to anomalies, and the ability to learn and evolve against new threats. RL strengthens network security without compromising individual device data. Our advanced security system that refines its understanding of the smart home environment, collectively learns from anomalies, and bolsters network security. Synergy of IoT and RL is reshaping IoT network security, promising not only seamless device functionality but also the safeguarding of sensitive data and personal spaces.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resource Allocation for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research article puts forth a new approach towards dynamic resource allocation within edge computing. As edge computing tries to make computational power closer to where data comes from, it has caught a lot of attention since it could improve time-sensitive applications. Here is an edge computing simulation framework that unites quantum algorithms, game theory-based resource allocation, cross-layer optimization as wells as collaborative scheduling techniques. The framework includes Deutsch-Jozsa quantum algorithm implementations for function evaluation, game theory-based resource allocation, cross-layer optimization, and collaborative multi-edge scheduling algorithms. Also, there are visualization modules for analyzing simulation results including bar charts, pie charts, and heatmaps. The main goal of this framework is to optimize resource usage and satisfy quality of service (QoS) demands in rapidly changing edge environments. Simulation results demonstrate that proposed methodology can improve the efficiency of a dynamic edge computing system by resource utilization enhancement and decrease of latency. Simulations on a real edge computing environment, clearly shows the effectiveness of the proposed framework in improving resource utilization as well as adhering to QoS requirements as opposed to traditional methods. Significant improvements in experimental metrics such as resource utilization rates, task completion times and fairness indices validate the efficiency of the framework for practical implementations.

articleTitle: Smart Climate Comfort System for Good Sleep
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sleep is essential to human health and has a significant role in many aspects of our lives. Improving sleep quality requires the right sleeping environment, and indoor temperature is a major factor in this. Personalized comfort is frequently not achieved by traditional means of controlling room temperature and ventilation, such as manually operating fans or depending on fixed HVAC systems. This shortfall is especially noticeable for people with physical limitations, such as the elderly or the disabled, who may find it difficult to manually regulate fans, which can cause disturbances in their sleep cycles. Wearable technology has made significant progress recently, providing encouraging answers to this problem. The ability to measure body temperature and vital indicators like heart rate in real-time makes thermal comfort and sleep quality assessments possible. These devices are lightweight and flexible. These gadgets use wireless communication protocols to send data to automated systems that change the temperature and airflow in the room in response, providing ideal sleeping conditions without the need for human interaction. In addition, the use of artificial intelligence algorithms facilitates proactive actions to mitigate disruptions in sleep. For instance, interventions like playing soft tunes to encourage relaxation and increase sleep onset can be triggered by unusual heart rate patterns that indicate anxiety or tiredness. These specific strategies reduce the negative impacts of stress and sleep deprivation, improving the quality of sleep while also improving general well-being. Moreover, the integration of electronic devices into ceiling fans presents a more dynamic method of temperature control. Through smart regulation of fan speed and airflow in response to current temperature fluctuations, these systems maximize thermal comfort levels while reducing energy usage. This reduces the financial burden associated with excessive energy consumption and lowers the environmental effect, making sustainable sleep options more widely available. Accepting these developments has the potential to improve everyone’s sleep habits and meet a variety of requirements, including those of those who have physical disabilities.

articleTitle: CTG-Based Fetal Health Prediction: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study explores the use of machine learning approaches for fetal health classification utilizing Cardiotocogram (CTG) data to improve prenatal treatment and maternal-fetal health. The study systematically examines five machine learning algorithms: Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Logistic Regression, using an extensive record with 2,126 well-annotated CTG recordings. This work is peculiar since it uses a wide range of feature extraction and preprocessing techniques to ensure high model correctness and dependability. With a 95% accuracy rate, the Random Forest algorithm proven to be the most effective, surpassing the other models by far. This study emphasizes how machine learning, especially ensemble approaches, may effectively predict health problems in fetuses. The study lays the groundwork for future developments in fetal health detection using cutting-edge technologies and machine learning algorithms by emphasizing interpretability and transparency.

articleTitle: Enhanced State of Charge Estimation for Lithium Ion Batteries with Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Accurate estimation of the State of Charge (SoC) in Lithium-Ion Batteries (LIBs) is crucial for the efficient and reliable operation of electric vehicles. There is a noticeable gap in recent research work for integrating Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Machine Learning (ML) methodologies for SoC prediction to satisfy the critical need for higher accuracy, transparency, trust, and reliability. Hence, to address this gap, we present the approach of integrating ML techniques with XAI to enhance SoC prediction accuracy and transparency. In the proposed work, we have compared the performance of the four popular models, Support Vector Regression (SVR), Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), Random Forest (RF) and Long ShortTerm Memory (LSTM) using standard NASA’s battery dataset. The rigorous evaluation using four different evaluation matrices shows LSTM with higher accuracy, having Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of $\mathbf{0. 0 0 7 4}$, Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.352%, Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.0088, and Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.0006. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis identified time, voltage, and temperature as the primary factors influencing SoC estimation results of the LSTM model. XAI revealed that the LSTM model considered important features highlighted by SHAP that were overlooked by other models, resulting in improved accuracy. Therefore, in terms of results, the proposed work shows improved accuracy with enhanced explainability compared to the previous work.

articleTitle: Survey of Covid Vaccine Hesitancy
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vaccination serves as vital for strengthening immunity to illnesses and diseases that occurred amid the COVID-19 pandemic. There is a significant reluctance on the part of the general public as well as medical professionals to get vaccinated despite the affordability and availability of numerous licensed vaccines. This reluctance mainly causes worries about possible problems and negative effects. The keyword “Vaccine hesitancy during COVID-19” was the primary search keyword on the Google Scholar platform. Seventeen studies that were published recently on the COVID19 pandemic that reported vaccine reluctance were found via our search, and these have been included in this review. During this survey, we found that the acceptance or rejection of vaccines was influenced by several criteria, such as income, education, gender, age, politics, religion, work position, and ethnicity. The vaccine was frequently refused for several reasons, which involve a general dislike of vaccinations, safety concerns or the belief that a rapidly developed vaccine may be too risky, the belief that immunity already exists or that the vaccine is unnecessary because COVID-19 is relatively harmless, a general lack of trust, doubts about the vaccine’s efficacy, and distrust about the vaccine’s origin. This review emphasizes the factors influencing COVID-19 vaccine acceptance and participation in clinical trials globally. It also presents strategies to enhance attitudes toward vaccination drives in the future. Additionally, governments and health authorities need to improve communication efforts and build public confidence.

articleTitle: Enhancing DDoS Attack Detection: A Hybrid SVM-Decision Tree Ensemble Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A DDoS attack overwhelms a network or server with an excessive amount of traffic, disrupting its normal operation and rendering it inaccessible to legitimate users. DDoS attacks involve coordinated efforts from multiple compromised devices, known as botnets, flooding the target with traffic simultaneously. This flood of data exhausts the target’s resources, causing service disruptions. Machine learning aids in DDoS attack detection by analyzing network traffic patterns. It learns to differentiate between normal and malicious activity by studying features such as packet rates, traffic volume, and protocol anomalies. By training on labeled datasets containing both benign and attack traffic, machine learning algorithms can identify deviations indicative of DDoS attacks, thereby enhancing network security. The hybrid machine learning model combines the precision of Support Vector Machines with the decision-making clarity of Decision Trees to effectively combat DDoS attacks. This innovative model achieves an impressive accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 8 \%}$ against the CICDDoS2019 dataset, demonstrating its exceptional performance in detecting various DDoS attack vectors.

articleTitle: Fake Social Media Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and others have become an integral part of our lives, facilitating global connectivity. But the proliferation of fake profiles on these platforms poses serious risks, including the spread of false information, phishing attacks and identity theft. This research project focuses on identifying fake Twitter profiles using machine learning techniques to distinguish them from genuine accounts. In the dataset used in this study, Twitter profiles are classified into genuine accounts (TFP and E13) and fake accounts (INT, TWT and FSF).. The main objective is to evaluate the effectiveness of the ensemble learning technique Random Forest algorithm in classifying social media profiles. In-depth discussions include algorithm architecture, hyperparameters, and selection of critical features such as follower and friend counts, status changes, and other relevant features. Additionally, alternative classifiers including neural networks, LSTM, XG Boost and others are briefly discussed in the summary. The Random Forest algorithm has a commendable 95.54% accuracy after rigorous training. This high accuracy underlines its ability to effectively distinguish between real and fake Twitter profiles. By assigning a value of 0 to genuine profiles and 1 to fake profiles, the algorithm provides a practical solution to detect and mitigate fake accounts, thereby solving the cyber security issues associated with social media. This research contributes to ongoing efforts to create a safer online environment by identifying and removing fake profiles.

articleTitle: Diagnosing Different Grades of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a widely prevalent complication associated with diabetes, which, if not detected and managed promptly, may lead to vision impairment. This paper presents an innovative approach for the precise diagnosis of various grades of diabetic retinopathy, utilizing ensemble learning techniques. Feature extractors, namely ResNet-50 and VGG-16, which are pre-trained models, capture essential image characteristics. These extracted features are then used by base models such as AdaBoost, Random Forest, and Gaussian Naive Bayes, integrated into a stacking framework to learn from the features and make predictive classifications. Additionally, a meta-model based on Gradient Boosting is employed to refine the predictions from the base models. The ensemble model has achieved exceptional diagnostic performance, with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics exceeding $92.6 \%$. Specifically, the ensemble model has achieved $92.61 \%$ accuracy, $92.74 \%$ precision, $92.61 \%$ recall, and a $92.65 \%$ F1 score. These remarkable results highlight the effectiveness of ensemble learning and the meta-model in accurately identifying various grades of diabetic retinopathy. This methodology holds significant promise for enhancing early detection and management of this vision-threatening condition, ultimately improving healthcare quality for individuals with diabetic retinopathy.

articleTitle: Integration of AI tools in learning pedagogy for L2 Learners in Engineering Education: Impacts, Challenges and Possibilities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For instance, AI (artificial intelligence centric tools have been integrated into educational technology networks, especially within the engineering department. This integration aims to support the personalized and interactive learning needs among second language learners (L2). Implementing AI resources like chatbots, virtual tutors, and interactive games/simulations allows L2 learners to receive the personalized service they need according to their language level by computing student performance levels and acting directly on learning feedback. These resources are also interactive tools, providing L2 learners an opportunity to work on their own time while being supported in real-time as needed. Using our AI tools in learning pedagogy for L2 learners in engineering education has been effective. Research shows that AI tools can potentially enhance language skills, critical thinking, and problem-solving among L2 learners. It also boosts students’ engagement and motivation, which results in superior learning outcomes. However, AI integration presents challenges, including potential time and resources for internal training and support of instructors using such a platform and learners engaged with it, content accuracy/relevance, and privacy compliance. Educators must find a happy medium between AI tools and classroom-based teaching when using Artificial intelligence for education. In this context, AI tools can be successfully integrated into learning pedagogy for L2 learners in engineering education and are likely to enhance their academic performance overall. If successfully applied and appropriate issues considered, it can improve the teaching-learning process, enabling better preparation for their engineering-based career $\mathbf{L} 2$ learners.

articleTitle: Curtailing Copying: Crafting an Advanced Textual Integrity Assessment System for Detecting Plagiarism
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Plagiarism, the unethical appropriation of others’ work without acknowledgment, undermines academic and intellectual integrity. Its diverse forms, from direct copying to subtle paraphrasing, necessitate sophisticated detection solutions. This paper presents a comprehensive exploration of advanced textual integrity assessment systems designed to detect and deter plagiarism. By scrutinizing existing tools, algorithms, and their efficacy, we offer insights to empower stakeholders in combating plagiarism proactively. Our research emphasizes the importance of maintaining academic honesty and intellectual integrity through the development of cutting-edge detection methodologies. We delve into the evolution of plagiarism detection, from traditional methods to modern approaches leveraging machine learning and natural language processing. Additionally, we outline the data preprocessing, feature extraction, and model development processes integral to our proposed system. The study highlights the significance of ethical considerations, privacy safeguards, and the continuous improvement of detection algorithms. Through these efforts, we aim to enhance the accuracy and reliability of plagiarism detection, fostering a culture of originality and ethical scholarship in the digital age.

articleTitle: Footwear-Based GAIT Analysis: A New Frontier in Parkinson’s Disease Research
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Plantar pressure sensors in insole of footwear is designed for enhanced GAIT analysis in Parkinson’s disease patients. Parkinson’s disease often associated with significant alterations in gait patterns, necessitating the monitoring for effective management and intervention. Conventional gait analysis methods comprise high end video surveillance system with a GAIT platform that captures the movement of limbs by specific markers listed on the body. Though it is clinically used by many researchers, it is cumbersome and limited in their real-world applicability. Three Force Sensitive Resistors (FSR’s) are incorporated under the shoe in-sole and interfaced with a microcontroller to acquire the plantar pressures (PP) while walking in a specific pattern. The plantar pressure data further analysed to derive the GAIT parameters such as Gait velocity $(\mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}$), Stride length (m), Step length (m), Stance phase (s), Swing phase (s), Cadence - fast walking (steps/min), Single support (% of stride), Double support (% of stride). The device was tested for its functionality by acquiring the plantar pressure data from 20 normal volunteers. This plantar pressure data is analysed to derive the GAIT parameters. The results shows that the Gait parameters found are in total agreement with the standard gait parameters listed in the literature. This innovative approach provides detailed insights into the gait abnormalities associated with Parkinson’s disease, facilitating early detection, monitoring of disease progression, and the customization of therapeutic strategies.

articleTitle: Machine Intelligence at the Crease: A Quintuple-Class CNN-LSTM Model for Umpire Gesture Recognition

articleTitle: WiFi for Privacy-Friendly Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the ongoing debate between surveillance necessity and privacy concerns, WiFi sensing emerges as a promising solution for efficient data monitoring while safeguarding personal privacy. Unlike traditional surveillance methods relying on camera recordings, WiFi sensing utilizes Channel State Information (CSI) data to detect specific movements, offering advantages such as reduced data storage and processing time. This paper explores the effectiveness of WiFi CSI data in detecting human interactions within radio waves, highlighting its practical usability and enhanced accuracy compared to Received Signal Strength (RSS) measurements. Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a blind machine learning paradigm, this study demonstrates the potential of WiFi sensing for human activity recognition (HAR). While previous HAR research predominantly focused on camera feeds and wearable devices, this study pioneers the application of CNNs to WiFi CSI data analysis, showing promising results for occupancy detection, activity recognition, and gesture identification. Although there is room for further improvement in accuracy, this research lays a solid foundation for future studies in the burgeoning field of WiFi sensing-based surveillance.

articleTitle: Advances in Yoga Training Tools: A CNN-RF Based Pose Identification System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A hybrid model that is presented in this article is called CNN-RF which uses convolutional Neural Networks in conjunction with Random Forest algorithms. There is a novel model that supports the task of yin yoga from the video motion data in real-time, with precision and speed. The model deals with the problem of accurate identification of body images in yoga due to the ease of its solution. It uses a deep learning approach in order to extract distinctive features, which are combined and further categorized by the ensemble learning algorithm. With these techniques, a situational quotient of 94 is reachable. 115%. The sum of the performance of the five two poses was excellent (The maximum accuracy of 94). Surprisingly, the MNEs have shifted the marketing of their goods and services according to China’s new domestic market (with a $75 \%$ market share), focusing on recall (with a $98 \%$ effectiveness rate). The outcomes obtained at the confusion matrix prove we have a good classification accuracy and, mostly, observed confusion between postures that are similar is little. They call attention to the issues to improve the future services. Error rate showed a considerable decrease during the training stages, from the error rate of $18 \%$ dropping to $4 \%$, demonstrating very high quality of the training in 10 epochs. The model’s reliability in statistical and the speed of gaining training points makes it feasible to be applied in yoga training systems, health monitoring, and rehabilitation machines. This brings the essential e-bikes features, user motivation and accident reduction. The above work provides a solid basis for AI and physical wellness to merge by proposing an approximation method that can enhance safety and effectiveness in yoga training with the help of technology.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Improved Performance of Interference-Free Multi-User Multiple Access (MUMIMO) Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multi-person multiple get admission to strategies are usually used for Wi-Fi communications. MUMIMO is a verbal exchange technique that lets in multiple customers to share the same communiqué medium, making an allowance for stepped forward spectrum performance. Stepped forward interference and throughput in MUMIMO structures have been demonstrated in more than one research. This abstract makes a specialty of the evaluation of improved performance of interference-free multi-person a couple of access (MUMIMO) techniques. Specifically, this summary discusses how recent advances in MUMIMO generation have progressed the machine’s performance in terms of channel capacity, sign detection, and spectral performance. Additionally, this abstract discusses the effect of interference cancellation strategies on the performance of MUMIMO systems. In end, it’s miles proven that MUMIMO generation has made terrific strides in phrases of overall performance improvement, mainly in phrases of its channel capability, signal detection, and spectral performance.

articleTitle: Network Resilience and Secure Confidentiality in Industrial-IoT through Software-Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ever-expanding Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) demands highly resilient and secure network architectures. While the execution of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) tackles the issue of heterogeneity in IIoT networks by the provision of centralized control and programmability, its scalability is exacerbated in large-scale IIoT deployments. This paper highlights the vitality of a distributed control plane architecture for SDN to overcome the scalability issues, thereby bolstering its efficiency. Furthermore, we propose a (t, n) threshold paradigm which ascertains that only authorized entities can access private data. The proposed protocol promotes reliability and data privacy, paving the way for secure operation within convoluted IIoT networks.

articleTitle: Crop Prediction Based on Factors of the Agricultural Environment Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agriculture is a critical sector that supports human life by supplying food, fiber and other necessary goods. It is essential to the world economy and directly related to food security and environmental sustainability. Predicting crop outcomes in agriculture is essential for maximizing yield, relying heavily on environmental factors like temperature, rainfall, and soil conditions. Machine learning (ML) has become a valuable tool in agriculture, transforming traditional farming methods with innovative solutions to tackle these challenges. This study focuses on applying machine learning approaches to crop outcome prediction in agriculture. The dataset, which includes data on weather conditions, soil properties, and crop characteristics, was analyzed. After data preprocessing, feature selection methods were used to identify the most influential variables for predicting crop yields. Subsequently, machine learning models were created and trained using the selected features to forecast crop outcomes. The models’ performance was then assessed, and optimization strategies were implemented to improve their predictive accuracy. Through this research, the project aims to offer valuable insights into the factors that impact crop outcomes, ultimately leading to enhanced agricultural practices and productivity.

articleTitle: Secure Authentication Scheme for Internet of Battlefield Things
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Future military operations will increasingly depend on interconnected technology, using advanced embedded systems and AI to improve defense capabilities and technology. The Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) will link soldiers with smart battlefield equipment such as armor, radios, and weapons, reducing decision cycle times, improving tactical analytics, and delivering precise AI support where needed. Authentication plays an important role in IoBT, as confidential information generated from battlefield devices needs to be secured from enemies. We propose a novel authentication approach designed to address the particular constraints of the IoBT, utilizing fuzzy extractor and geometric secret sharing techniques. This approach overcomes the weaknesses caused by dynamic and hostile combat situations, in which standard authentication methods may fail. The proposed scheme is based on fingerprint biometrics and fuzzy extractors, enabling reliable authentication even when dealing with noisy biometric data. Moreover, geometric secret key sharing improves security by providing secure key establishment. Also, the suggested methodology is ideal for resource-sparse Internet of Things (IoT) devices which are commonly found in military situations. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed authentication design are shown by exhaustive analysis employing Scyther tool and simulations, illustrating its ability to resist numerous security attacks prevalent in IoBT environments.

articleTitle: Analyzing GNN Models for Community Detection Using Graph Embeddings: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Graphs are effective models for illustrating complex connections in various contexts, including social networks, citation networks, and biological systems. In this study, the performance of Graph Neural Networks(GNN) for two main tasks is being explored: Node classification and Community detection. Community detection on complex networks is an emerging area that helps to understand the underlying structures and functions of interconnected systems across various domains. The structural and semantic information are captured using the various GNN models. This paper uses four GNN models for node classification: GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, and Deep Graph Infomax. The embeddings of these models are clustered to detect the communities by using spectral clustering, k-means clustering, and the Louvain algorithm. The GNN model’s performance was assessed in terms of computational complexity, accuracy of clustering, and modularity. The results demonstrate that GNN models, particularly GCN, yield competitive performance in community detection tasks on citation networks. The effectiveness of each model varies across different datasets and community detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Optical Character Recognition for Robust Real-World Conditions: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper offers a comprehensive comparative analysis of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) techniques, spanning from traditional methods to advanced deep learning models such as Transformers, BERT, and Bi-LSTM. OCR serves as a pivotal tool for converting printed or handwritten text into digital formats, facilitating applications in document digitization and text analysis. Our analysis provides valuable insights into the strengths and weaknesses of each approach, thereby elucidating their practicality in real-world scenarios. In the domain of information retrieval, a novel approach entails leveraging bidirectional LSTM for semantic search, harnessing deep neural networks to comprehend textual content nuances beyond mere keyword matching. This study serves as an indispensable resource for researchers, practitioners, and developers interested in OCR technology, furnishing a comprehensive overview of OCR techniques and their applicability across various domains. Furthermore, we delve into the adaptation of Transformer models, including BERT, to the OCR domain, assessing their efficacy in handling diverse text types and discussing their potential to enhance OCR accuracy and robustness. We also explore ensemble techniques that amalgamate multiple OCR approaches to exploit their complementary strengths, thereby augmenting overall performance. Moreover, our exploration extends to emerging trends and future directions in OCR research, encompassing the integration of multimodal information and the exploration of self-supervised learning paradigms for OCR model training. These advancements hold significant promise for further elevating the accuracy, efficiency, and versatility of OCR systems across diverse domains.

articleTitle: Securing IoT Networks: Leveraging Big Data for Enhanced Resilience
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Keeping IoT networks secure and resilient has become more difficult as the number of connected devices continues to rise. Everything is happening in a world where connections are strengthening. Due to the ever-growing and changing nature of IoT ecosystems, there are substantial security concerns and vulnerabilities associated with volume, variety, along with velocity of data generated by these devices. This is why big data-driven security solutions have surfaced as a promising tactic for bolstering the safety of IoT networks and reducing the impact of possible dangers. In order to protect and enhance the integrity of IoT networks, this research will examine current breakthroughs in security solutions that are driven by big data. Examining the many methods and technologies that detect, avoid, and address security breaches in IoT environments via use of big data analytics is goal of this research. Moreover, we analyze challenges and opportunities associated with implementing these solutions, while also highlighting present trends along with future directions in the field of robust along with secure IoT networks. Using cutting-edge, big data-driven security technologies, this study lays out a methodical way to protect and guarantee the resilience of IoT networks. Data collection, compliance, and reporting are all essential parts of the process flow, which provides a thorough framework for reducing risks and protecting against new threats.

articleTitle: Empowering Maternal Health in Bangladesh: Advanced Risk Prediction with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Maternal risk prediction is a critical component of prenatal care aimed at mitigating adverse outcomes for pregnant individuals and their babies. In this research, we have employed machine learning algorithms to forecast maternal risks using a comprehensive dataset that has 3097 data points and 9 features. Eight algorithms showed notable different accuracies -AdaBoost 80.24%, XGBoost 93.97%, GBoost 88.84%, SVC 73.52%, KNN 84.85%, Naive Bayes 70.94%, Decision Tree 91.93%, Random Forest 94.15%. Here XGBoost and Random Forest achieved the highest accuracies of 93.97% and 94.15% respectively, with high precision and recall. These findings develop machine learning in maternal risk prediction with highlighting the potential for improving prenatal care through personalized risk assessment and targeted interventions.

articleTitle: Exploring the Benefits of Text Mining for Automated Information Discovery
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Textual content Mining is a procedure used to discover beneficial statistics from large textual content corpora mechanically. Through leveraging natural language processing (NLP) strategies, which include term file frequency (TF-IDF), textual content mining can extract ideas from unstructured data to present analyst’s and researchers’ treasured insights about the corpus. In this paper, we discover text Mining as a device for automated statistics Discovery. We talk about the possible advantages of text mining, inclusive of its ability to synthesize and summarize vast quantities of information, its capacity to discover hidden insights, and its potential to combine and synthesize related subjects from textual content statistics. We additionally take a look at diverse techniques to be had for textual content mining and how they may be implemented to different obligations. Moreover, we discuss the capability barriers of textual content Mining, along with the need to evaluate the fine and reliability of located insights manually. Subsequently, we detail how text Mining may be helpful in a mixture of different statistics processing strategies to acquire better results.

articleTitle: Review of IoT-enabled Smart Cities: Cybersecurity Threat Detection Using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A smart city is a digitally enhanced urban environment to improve current facilities and services for the benefit of persons and organisations. Smart cities have significantly improved quality of life and services by enabling real-time control of physical objects and providing intelligent information to people in a variety of sectors, including transportation, healthcare, smart parking, public safety, smart buildings, traffic systems, as well as smart farming. However, because these applications collect sensitive data, it is critical to address security concerns at various architecture levels. Critical infrastructures are networked in smart cities, allowing for enhanced data flow across municipal domains, leading to automation in city government and service optimisation. However, due to a lack of defined principles or standards for modelling these data flows, limited systems scalability with different requirements has resulted. As cyber threats become more organised, diverse, and sophisticated, there is a need to be aware of cybersecurity in smart cities with measures to protect people’s privacy as well as security. This study aims to help policymakers comprehend the serious situation and to act as a helpful resource for the scientific community by analysing the state of the art. It discusses the primary applications tackling the major risks in design. The study aims to provide an outline of cyber threats, attacks, and countermeasures in the principal smart city sectors. This review adds to a better knowledge of potential threats and solutions, ultimately assisting in the construction of secure and resilient smart city settings by thoroughly assessing the current status of cybersecurity in IoT-enabled smart cities.

articleTitle: The Intersection of Computer Engineering and Intellectual Property Law
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

articleTitle: Security Implications of 5G in Modern Health Care Management Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: 5G has emerged as a chief fashion in modern healthcare management models. In this context, the safety implications of 5G are getting more vital than ever earlier. 5G networks have the potential to offer many extra comfy surroundings for the transfer of touchy healthcare statistics. To this end, 5G networks are predicted to offer more potent consumer authentication, progressed physical security, advanced encryption protocols, progressed manipulation over get admission to manipulate, and more desirable actual-time facts analytics. Furthermore, 5G networks are anticipated to reduce the overall value of turning in fitness care services, particularly for decrease-profits segments of the population. Furthermore, 5G networks can also allow far-flung patient tracking, reducing the want for in-person visits to fitness care facilities. As a way to ensure the security of 5G networks and fitness care records, healthcare companies must put in force rigorous protection controls throughout the network. For instance, companies should make certain of the use of strong authentication protocols for customers and superior encryption for statistics in transit. Furthermore, vendors ought to monitor user and information entry to and hobby for suspicious activity, in addition to implementing robust entry control measures to reduce the chance of unauthorized entry to fitness care facts. Moreover, carriers must take steps to ensure the integrity of healthcare statistics by means of the use of both hardware and software-based solutions

articleTitle: An Efficient Data Management Policy For IoT Application with Tangential Data Control System in a Cloud Fog Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has spurred a surge in data-driven applications, presenting challenges in processing, storing, and managing IoT data within fog and cloud computing environments. To address these issues, we propose the “Foggy Weather Architecture with Tangential Data Control System.” This architecture utilizes fog nodes as intermediaries, employing a Tangential Data Control System to supervise and filter IoT data, allowing only changed information to enter fog nodes. Additionally, our approach includes an algorithm that dynamically determines whether to use fog or cloud for data processing, prioritizing cloud processing during rapid data alterations and opting for fog computing during stable data periods. This integrated system optimizes resource usage, enhances scalability, and improves responsiveness for IoT applications within cloud environments.

Author Keywords: Fog Computing, Fog to cloud computing(F2C), Quality of service

articleTitle: Application of Generative Adversarial Network for Data Augmentation in Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image generation through generative adversarial network (GAN) has been a well-studied problem. It has been specifically implemented in medical domain for a number of use cases but training GAN has its own challenges. Application of GAN on generation of eye fundus images for the disease diabetic retinopathy (DR) has not been explored in depth. This paper shows a novel approach to generate low resolution eye fundus images for DR using GAN and validate it though a CNN classifier using samplers and schedulers module. The proposed approach beats the current benchmark in terms of generated image quality as well as classification accuracy. The low-quality generated images of 224*224 pixels manages to retain the key aspects of DR which aids in identifying the DR grade during classification predominantly from generated images only.

articleTitle: Enhancing railway operations: machine learning approaches for stopping distance prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ensuring railway safety systems advance is vital for protecting passengers, pilots, and assets. This study concentrates on creating an automatic braking system for Indian Railways to improve safety by accurately forecasting stopping distances during braking maneuvers. Utilizing the Indian Railways dataset, a thorough analysis of braking data is conducted, emphasizing instances of loco pilot intervention in brake deployment, covering normal braking scenarios and emergencies triggered by the Kavach system. The proposed approach entails filtering the dataset to identify braking instances where loco pilot intervention affects brake application. Subsequently, machine learning regression techniques are utilized to forecast stopping distances based on the filtered brake deployment data. Various regression methods, including linear, polynomial, support vector, and random forest regression, are applied and assessed for their efficacy in accurately predicting stopping distances. The outcomes of this research not only aid in the development of an automatic braking system for Indian Railways but also offer valuable insights into selecting optimal regression methods for forecasting stopping distances in real-world railway operations.

articleTitle: Impact of uses of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Textile Industry in India
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
