abstract: India has made remarkable strides in its digital transformation journey creating an impressive global presence with its futuristic digital innovations, supporting technologies and scalable architecture. India’s flagship program ‘Digital India’ along with ‘India stack’ have been instrumental in accelerating the development of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in India. Even though digital commerce has a huge potential to fuel economic growth, current penetration stands at only seven percent of overall market, restricted by multiple barriers. In 2021, India launched its ambitious plan to democratize e-commerce with Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC). This initiative was envisioned to create an inclusive ecosystem for e-commerce that facilitates even the smallest start-ups and merchants to reap benefits of e-commerce. ONDC seeks to dismantle digital monopolies and create a level playing field with greater inclusivity. Startups can leverage ONDC to reach a broader customer base, reduce operational costs, and enhance their technological capabilities. ONDC can act as a promising platform to accelerate the growth of startups and drive a more inclusive digital economy, by fostering innovation and democratizing access to digital markets. ONDC which was incorporated in 2021 as a Section 8 company launched its pilot phase in 2022. Although there has been an increased presence, its growth lags behind major e-commerce platforms. In order to establish itself in the market place, ONDC need to tackle numerous challenges. This study attempts to identify and rank the challenges faced by seller network nodes in the adoption of ONDC using fuzzy AHP methodology. Key challenges identified include technical and operational issues, seller participant awareness and acquisition, overall cost of adoption, competition from established giants, as well as scalability issues. In order to unlock its full potential and expand market share across India, the government must collaborate with ONDC leadership to address these critical roadblocks promptly. The success of this unique, tech-based open e-commerce network could serve as an exemplary model for other nations and start-ups facing similar challenges.

articleTitle: Efficient Fault Detection Methods in Printed Circuit Boards using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Printed circuit boards (PCBs) becoming more complex as technology advances, adding new components and changing their architecture. One of the most crucial quality control procedures is PCB surface inspection since even little flaws in a signal trace may have a significant detrimental effect on the system. It has always been difficult to determine the pass/fail criteria in traditional machine vision systems based on small failure samples, despite the advancements in sensor technology. Suggesting a sophisticated PCB inspection method built on a skip-connected convolutional auto encoder to address these issues suggested to enhance the PCB inspection system by using convolutional autoencoders. The original, fault-free photos and the damaged ones were used to train the deep autoencoder model. The defect location was then located by comparing the decoded images with the input image. Using proper image augmentation to enhance the model training performance in order to get over the tiny and uneven dataset in the early phases of production. Printed circuit boards, or PCBs, are essential parts of electronic gadgets and are very significant to the electronics sector. While ensuring PCB quality and reliability is crucial, manual inspection techniques are often labour and error-intensive. The proposed novel machine learning (ML)-based method for identifying PCB defects demonstrates a significant improvement in detection rates compared to traditional methods, offering a promising solution for the electronics manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Safeguarding Audio Integrity: Ensemble Architectures for Real-World Fake Audio Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Through this research, we introduce a unique Audio Spoof Detection System for distinguishing between actual, fraudulent, and generated audio recordings. Strong detection algorithms are required since the spread of audio modification techniques poses a major threat to the integrity of audio-based systems. Combination of 7 key voice features from cepstral coefficients and spectrograms were used to cover all possible spoofing. We are proposing ensemble methods to enhance the accuracy of conventional machine learning models such as Random Forest, State Vector Classifier (SVC), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) etc. and deep learning models such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Time-Delay Neural Networks (TDNN), SqueezeNet etc. The proposed model is evaluated using the ASVspoof 2021 logical access (LA) and Deep Voice dataset. Experimental results show that our proposed model significantly elevates performance compared to the baseline and state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Bangladeshi Rice and Tea leaf disease detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the heart of Bangladesh’s agricultural landscape, where the cultivation of rice and tea supports both livelihoods and food security, the constant danger of crop diseases is a substantial obstacle to economic stability. This research project aims to develop innovative disease detection models specifically designed for rice and tea leaves in Bangladesh. The study will utilize deep learning with sophisticated image analysis methods. Early detection of diseases is essential due to the extensive intake of these basic food items. Additionally, the initiative seeks to advance precision agricultural techniques, decrease the reliance on pesticides, and improve food security. The MobileNetV3 Large model stood out with its remarkable accuracy of $\mathbf{9 3. 2 0 \%}$ and required minimum training time, even though it was trained on a very small dataset gathered from real-world scenarios. This project seeks to modernize the agricultural sector in Bangladesh and empower smallholder farmers by transferring technology, promoting sustainable farming practices, and aligning with government objectives. The project aims to utilise the capabilities of MobileNetV3 Large and include a small amount of field data to reduce farming losses and significantly contribute to the resilience and profitability of Bangladesh’s important agricultural industry.

articleTitle: An Ensemble of InceptionNet and MobileNet Pretrained Deep Learning Models for Classifying Stages of Dementia
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dementia is a growing brain disorder, with Alzheimer’s disease accounting for 60-70% of cases. By 2050, nearly 10 million people may be affected. To help early detection, we proposed an ensemble of pretrained deep learning models using InceptionNet and MobileNet. Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) dataset is used and the models InceptionNet, MobileNet and EfficientNet is trained and tested to choose the best two models for ensembling and achieved 75%, $81.6 \%$ and 64% of accuracy respectively. The models with high accuracy is chosen for ensembling by concatenating the features extracted from InceptionNet and MobileNet followed by classification layer to classify stages of dementia as demented and non-demented. The proposed model achieved a classification accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: Investigating the Vulnerabilities of Encapsulating Security Payload in Wireless Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Encapsulating protection Payload (ESP) is a safety protocol used to provide authentication, integrity, and confidentiality in Wi-Fi networks. A latest research has explored the diverse vulnerabilities that exist in ESP, which can be exploited to gain get admission to confidential information. The principle awareness of the study become to perceive the weaknesses and strategies used to attack ESP implementations in a Wi-Fi network. the security of ESP become evaluated by using looking on the distinctive sorts of get right of entry to control techniques carried out, the energy of encryption algorithms used, and the trying out of the protocol’s resiliency to positive attack scenarios. It was concluded that despite the fact that ESP is a powerful and cozy protocol, it nevertheless lacks in certain regions which need to be addressed if you want to make sure more safety in Wi-Fi networks.

articleTitle: Smart Signals: Real-Time Traffic Adjuster
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The omnipresent problem of traffic congestion in cities, even those well equipped with traffic lights and cameras, causes daily trouble to one person or another. In this research paper, we have created a better traffic management system using a object detection-based and time series analyzer-based traffic light controller that can automatically adjust to the volume of vehicles at the traffic signal in order to reduce congestion. Hence, a system to reduce wait times and prevent traffic jams is required. The proposed methodology predicts the expected traffic intensity, and detects the real-time traffic intensity; and thus makes sure that the direction with more traffic receives a green light for a longer period of time in an appropriate proportion compared to the way with less traffic. This approach utilises YOLOv2 for image detction of vehicles - including cars, trucks and bikes. This has resulted in almost 33% savings in terms of wait times, and thus will enable traffic to move efficiently through intersections without human interference and will also aid in minimizing pollution.

articleTitle: Exploring the Development of Flexible Network Subsystems in Communications Software Design
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The development of cutting-edge telecommunications systems more and more call for the implementation of community subsystems which might be bendy and can unexpectedly reply to modifications in user visitors. Such flexibility requires the layout of a structure able to scaling to distinctive gadget demands while nevertheless being capable of maintain excessive overall performance, reliability, and availability. This paper gives a systematic exploration of the strategies, gear, and ideas important in designing a bendy community subsystem for telecommunications software. We speak the necessities and challenges of developing network structures, and have a look at the feasibility of employing current trendy protocols which includes SIP, SDP, and RTP as a part of a usual structure. Furthermore, we speak the advantages and downsides of using software program-defined networking (SDN) as a part of a flexible community subsystem, along with issues for deploying it. Updates to present community control structures to assist dynamic reconfiguration are explored, in addition to an assessment of in-house and $1 / 3$-celebration answers for integration into a bendy community subsystem. Sooner or later, key layout issues for deploying and managing a flexible community subsystem are discussed and summarized.

articleTitle: Implementing Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval Systems to Enhance Resource Accessibility in English Language Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research explores the implementation of Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval (CLIR) systems to improve resource accessibility in the context of English language learning. The increasing demand for English language proficiency has led to a growing need for diverse and effective learning resources. The study investigates the integration of CLIR technologies to bridge these gaps and facilitate improved access to educational content. The research methodology involves the development and deployment of a CLIR system designed to enable learners to retrieve information in English from resources available in their native languages. Leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques, the system aims to enhance the efficiency of information retrieval by considering multilingual queries and diverse language structures. The evaluation of the system’s effectiveness involves user testing, feedback collection, and performance metrics analysis to measure its impact on resource accessibility and language learning outcomes. The findings of this study contribute to the understanding of how CLIR systems can be tailored to meet the specific needs of English language learners from diverse linguistic backgrounds. the proposed CLIR method outperforms all others with an exceptional accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 . 8 2 \%}$ and robust values in recall, precision, and IF1-score, suggesting its effectiveness in enhancing resource accessibility in English language learning.

articleTitle: Ablation studies towards interpretable ensemble deep neural networks for mental health classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Post-pandemic, the prevalence of mental health issues has markedly increased within the IT sector due to the extensive implementation of work-from-home protocols. In response to this trend, various industries have instituted an array of wellness initiatives for employees, aligning these efforts with global sustainable development goals. Multiple factors impact mental health, including family history, interactions with colleagues, and current mental health status, encompassing personal, professional, and social dimensions. The exceptional flexibility and adaptability of ensemble methods and deep learning models have facilitated their widespread application in mental health research. This study presents an ensemble bagging deep learning approach employing recurrent neural networks (LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), and BiRNN (Bidirectional RNN)) to evaluate the current mental health of IT professionals. The proposed methodology is applied to the publicly accessible open-source Mental Illness $\mathbf{2 0 2 1 + 2 0 2 2 + 2 0 2 3}$ dataset pertaining to IT industry employees. This research revealed that among the selected 37 features, the proposed ensemble deep neural network method achieved a final performance metric (accuracy) of approximately 90.13%. To tackle the interpretability challenge inherent in deep learning models, ablation studies are performed to elucidate the model’s behavior, analyzing the impact of individual hyperparameters on model predictions and exploring the interconnections between feature importance and performance metrics. The investigation describes that augmenting the values of the features, dropout layer, and epochs contributes to enhancing the model’s performance. However, variations in hidden units did not yield significant improvements.

articleTitle: Dissecting Digital Dangers: A MITRE-Aligned Analysis of Two Prominent Malware Instances
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing complexity of malware requires a more thorough comprehension of how they operate. Using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, this project delves into the TrickBot and AsyncRAT malwares, offering a thorough examination of their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) across the cyber kill chain. This study uncovers trends in how these malicious software gain entry, carry out tasks, remain active, and extract information from a network by correlating TTPs with ATT&CK methods. Key analyses indicate that TrickBot utilizes elevated entropy values to avoid being detected, incorporates modular structures to enhance its capabilities, and utilizes spear-phishing and network spreading to achieve broad infection. Asyncrat is found to employ sophisticated anti-analysis methods, reflective code loading, and achieves persistence by altering the system registry while avoiding sandbox environments. Additionally, it establishes command and control (C2) connections to maintain long-term access over compromised systems. The observations uncovered in this research emphasize the importance of having strong cybersecurity policies and comprehensive threat intelligence to combat changing threats effectively. Understanding the complex behaviours and evasion methods of these malwares is crucial for creating specific defences and improving security overall.

articleTitle: Advancements in Animal Tracking: Assessing Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the rapidly advancing field of computer vision, object detection has become crucial for various applications, including animal tracking, face detection, and surveillance systems. This study investigates the efficacy of contemporary object detection methodologies by evaluating the performance of the You Only Look Once (YOLO) models and TensorFlow Model Zoo architectures for animal tracking. YOLO models, known for their ability to process entire images in real-time and predict bounding boxes and class probabilities simultaneously, offer significant advantages over traditional methods such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Fast R-CNNs. This paper compares the performance of YOLOv5 and YOLOv7, alongside TensorFlow-based models like Faster R-CNN ResNetv152 and SSD ResNet101, using a dataset of animal images. Our findings reveal that YOLOv5 outperforms other models with a mean average precision (mAP) of 9 7.5%, demonstrating superior accuracy and efficiency in object detection tasks. YOLOv7 also shows strong performance with an mAP of 96.7%, while TensorFlow Model Zoo’s Faster R-CNN and SSD models lag behind with mAPs of 81.9% and 81.6%, respectively. The results highlight the significant advancements in deep learning and object detection algorithms, particularly the advantages of YOLO’s architecture in handling complex detection tasks in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Market Segmentation Using Machine Learning and Data Analysis: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research explores the integration of machine learning into market segmentation, a strategy traditionally reliant on demographic, geographical, and psychographic traits. With the rise of big data, machine learning offers enhanced precision by uncovering intricate consumer behavior patterns often missed by conventional methods. The study involves reviewing relevant literature, preprocessing datasets, and developing machine learning models to evaluate their effectiveness in segmenting markets. Findings indicate that machine learning significantly improves segmentation accuracy, enabling businesses to predict behaviors and tailor marketing strategies more effectively. This research contributes by highlighting machine learning’s potential to transform market segmentation and drive business growth. Future work should focus on real-world implementation of these models to validate their practicality and impact.

articleTitle: An improved AI-driven Data Analytics model for Modern Healthcare Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AI-driven statistics analytics is a swiftly advancing and impactful era that is transforming the face of healthcare. By leveraging the energy of AI computing and gadget studying, healthcare organizations can speedy gain insights from their huge datasets, offering a greater comprehensive and personalized approach to hospital therapy and populace health management. This paper explores the advantages of AI-driven statistics analytics in healthcare settings, masking key benefits along with progressed analysis and treatment, better-affected person effects, and financial savings. Moreover, this paper addresses the main challenges associated with AI-pushed analytics and offers potential solutions to enhance accuracy and relevance. In the long run, statistics analytics powered by way of AI gives powerful opportunities to improve healthcare outcomes, and its use is expected to expand within the coming years.

articleTitle: Partial Convolution U-Net for Inpainting Distorted Images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image inpainting is a domain in which researchers have shown considerable interest, and when it comes to deep learning techniques, realistic problems become interesting and challenging. In image inpainting, a corrupted facial image with missing holes or significant holes can be restored and compared to the original image to see if it is real or fake. In addition to fixing the texture of the image and getting the image’s high-level abstract properties, it may also recover semantic images such as human faces. In the field of image-inpainting models, the Attention model with features learned through semantic approaches and progressive networks has become particularly popular. The proposed model introduces (i) Attention blocks in each decoder layer of U-Net architecture and (ii) a hybrid loss function leveraging both Mean Square Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The proposed Attention-based U-Net showed remarkable performance with SSIM and PSNR by 0.1067 and 13.63, respectively, compared to the previous approaches.

articleTitle: XAI – Empowered Ensemble Deep Learning for Deepfake Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent technologies have evolved rapidly, allowing the creation of fake videos/images that are realistic. These artificial media pieces have provoked grave worries about the possibilities of their misuse in different areas like politics, journalism, and communication. Consequently, the demand for deepfake detection methods is increasing. In response to this growing threat, there is an increasing demand for robust deepfake detection methods. This paper proposes an ensemble-based approach for deepfake detection, leveraging deep learning techniques. Specifically, we employ a combination of CNN models, including VGG, Xception, RegularizedConvNet, and RegularizedConvDenseNet, designed for image classification. Our approach integrates predictions from multiple models to enhance detection accuracy and reliability. Specifically, the base is formed by the ensemble of RegularizedConvNet and RegularizedConvDenseNet, which cooperate to prevent the spread of deepfakes and protect digital integrity. Experimental results show that our Ensemble method achieve better detection values with accuracy of 94.5% and AUC of 0.98.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Knowledge Management to Enhance KM Practices in Nursing Education at Tobruk University, Libya
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective knowledge management (KM) practices if applied effectively are crucial elements to enhance nursing education. The study’s main objective is to utilize bibliometric analysis to propose a targeted KM practice relevant to the College of Nursing at Tobruk University. The outcome is expected to help develop an adaptable KM initiative for the College and enhance the current practices. Bibliometric analysis was employed in the study to explore a comprehensive literature review on KM in nursing education. Lens database was used to identify relevant publications using a search string and applying selection criteria for filtering in the data extraction process. Date of publication from 2014 up to the present and document types like journal articles, conference proceedings, books, and book chapters are the major inclusion criteria. Presentation of results included the growth of literature, citation analysis, top institution and country contributors, and visualization of co-occurring keywords using VOSviewer. Network, overlay, and density map visualization revealed that the type of research particular to the field is qualitative using surveys and questionnaires. In practice, delivery of health care, KM, leadership, cooperative behavior, attitude, knowledge, and practice of health personnel are among the recurring themes. The focus on humans, gender, and age are also of great consideration. The analysis revealed global trends and knowledge gaps in KM practices within nursing education. The result of the study provided initial and valuable insights for the development of KM strategies at TU’s CON and a guiding factor for eventual implementation.

articleTitle: AgroTech: Optimizing Farm Management with Data-Driven Insights and Relational Database Integration through Web Application for Enhanced Soil Analysis, Weather Projection, and Crop Yield Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In modern agriculture, the integration of effective data analytics and web applications has the potential to revolutionize agricultural practices. However, Bangladesh’s agricultural sector encounters notable hurdles like delayed information, insufficient issue identification, and communication gaps between farmers and agricultural experts. Moreover, the failure to detect and address potential problems early worsens crop damage and losses. This paper explores a web application with an integrated relational database designed to address critical challenges in agriculture, aiming to enhance productivity and sustainability. The study utilizes data from Kaggle datasets, including soil pH, temperature, moisture, nutrient levels, crop data, and weather information, for informed decision-making. A comprehensive literature review were conducted to support the research and development of this web application. Alerts triggered within the web application enable proactive intervention when data surpasses predefined thresholds, enabling timely issue resolution. Field officers and farmers in designated areas can continuously monitor farm data and engage in real-time communication via smartphone integration. In instances where farmers lack smartphones, field officers facilitate communication and collaborate with agronomists to address concerns promptly. The main goal of this paper is to enhance productivity, sustainability, and data management in Bangladesh’s agricultural sector. Upon implementation, the web application is anticipated to make an immense impact on society by improving agricultural practices, increasing crop yield, reducing losses, and fostering better communication and collaboration between farmers and agricultural experts.

articleTitle: A deep dive of deep learning models to Emotion Detection using weighted emotions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper explores different types of deep learning architectures for emotion detection through the use of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The main focus in this analysis is LSTM, a recurrent neural network (RNN) which can be used to understand cultural context due to its ability of capturing time dependencies in sequences. This study also looks into Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), CNNs and RNNs one after another, independent CNNs and RNNs, and CNNs integrated with LSTM layers. Special attention here is given to the highly flexible and effective LSTM networks that incredibly capture even the most subtle emotional parameters as well as contextual information essential for improving accuracy in detecting emotions.

articleTitle: A Review on VIRTUAL TRY-ON
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Virtual try-on systems have emerged as pivotal tools in the realms of e-commerce and the metaverse, revolutionizing the way consumers engage with fashion and online shopping experiences. This paper presents a comprehensive review of recent literature and innovations in virtual try-on technology, focusing on methodologies aimed at enhancing realism, accuracy, and user engagement. The review begins by discussing the evolution from early 3D modelling techniques to more recent image-based approaches, highlighting the influence of seminal works such as Pix2pixHD in enabling high-resolution image synthesis. Challenges related to paired image requirements are addressed, leading to the introduction of novel methodologies like Outfit-VITON, which utilizes individual 2D training photos to simplify data collection and enhance scalability. Furthermore, the paper explores the paradigm shift introduced by multi-stage designs like those employed in VTNFP, emphasizing the critical role of components such as the geometric matching module (GMM) and body segmentation maps in achieving precise garment warping and fine-scale image synthesis. The review also discusses recent advancements in virtual try-on systems, such as ACGPN’s Content Fusion Module (CFM) and Clothes Warping Module (CWM), which preserve human identification features and clothing attributes to enhance realism and user satisfaction. Similarly, CP-VTON+ addresses challenges related to dataset representation and network architecture optimization, demonstrating superior performance in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations. The paper further examines emerging trends in virtual try-on technology, including the integration of textual inversion techniques in models like LaDI-VTON, which map visual garment characteristics to token embeddings to preserve texture and details. Overall, this review provides insights into the state-of-the-art virtual try-on systems, highlighting key methodologies, innovations, and challenges. By elucidating recent advancements and future research directions, this paper aims to contribute to the continued evolution and enhancement of virtual try-on technology in the context of e-commerce and the metaverse.

articleTitle: Enhanced EEG Signal Spectral Visualization for Imagined Speech Task Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The evolution of the brain computer interface (BCI) has led to direct communication between the human brain and external devices. Within BCI, one exciting research area is the use of imagined speech. In imagined speech data, subjects think of words or sentences in their minds without vocalization. The analysis of imagined speech is challenging due to the nonstationary nature of the electroencephalogram (EEG) signal, complexity, signal quality, and noise. Thus, the relevant features for subsequent processing can be better captured by transforming the EEG data into a spectral representation. This paper introduces a novel approach for analyzing EEG signals related to imagined speech by converting these signals into spectral form using an enhanced signal spectral visualization (ESSV) technique. A novel convolutional neural network (CNN) based architecture is also proposed to classify the resulting spectral images. This method demonstrates the powerful feature extraction capabilities of CNNs, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of imagined speech recognition. The paper compares various spectral techniques, machine learning models and the effect of different frequency ranges on imagined speech classification tasks. The results are analyzed in terms of accuracy, f1 score and kappa.

articleTitle: Unveiling The Evolutionary Dynamics And Molecular Similarities Of Acquired Aminoglycoside Resistance Single Genes Through Advanced Phylogenetic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Backgrounds: The phenomenon of antibiotic resistance has undergone rapid evolution over the past few decades, emerging as a prominent and formidable public health concern in the 21st century. Undoubtedly, the prevalence of untreatable infections resulting from the multidrug resistance exhibited by the infecting organism has witnessed an increase within clinical environments. In order to effectively address this issue, it is imperative to significantly enhance and bolster research and development endeavours. Gaining a comprehensive comprehension of the mechanisms through which bacteria develop resistance to antibiotics is of utmost significance in order to formulate innovative approaches to address the challenge of resistance. There is a pressing need to advance the development of antibiotics, taking into consideration the anticipated response of microorganisms to these drugs and the subsequent emergence of resistance, which is an established evolutionary phenomenon. Objectives: This study has tried to establish the evolutionary relationship among large varieties of antibiotic resistant genes Materials and Methods: The analysis has been performed through several phylogenetic tools such as MEGA, CLUSTAL-W, i-TOL and CLUSTAL OMEGA. Result: After analysis it is cleared that there is some portion of similarity from genetic and molecular level of the respective genes against each antibiotic resistance. Several phylogenetic parameters have similarity of the antibiotic resistant genes. Conclusion: This analysis may open a new vista in the computational biology research related to antibiotic resistance and several new molecules can be synthesized for better antibiotic resistance.

articleTitle: Using Deep Learning to Unlock Data Science Insights: An Exploration of Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores deep getting-to-know-in records technology, introducing the numerous techniques that can be used to unlock information science insights. Deep learning is a subset of machine-gaining knowledge that specializes in using neural networks to increase representations of statistics. These representations can encode know-how about a machine or surroundings, making applying the representations to derive beneficial insights feasibly. The paper focuses on various deep getting-to-know strategies, inclusive of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), and generative opposed networks (GANs). The paper also discusses the potential packages of deep getting-to-know statistics science, such as predicting time-collection statistics, detecting anomalies, and automated characteristic engineering. ultimately, the paper outlines how data technology professionals can leverage deep mastering to discover treasured records insights.

articleTitle: Utilizing Natural Language Processing for Improving Cancer Prediction in Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recommender systems are gaining growing popularity in the area of medical care as they enable the personalization of disorder remedies for male or woman sufferers. For instance, most cancer-affected persons may also benefit from personalized guidance from a recommender device regarding their treatment options. However, recommendation structures for this reason are confined in terms of studying affected person information. While based records inclusive of clinical history, images, and laboratory outcomes may be accumulated, building a personalized recommendation for each man or woman calls for processing big quantities of unstructured information, along with patient scientific data or texts from physicians. Herbal Language Processing (NLP) gives a way to this problem. NLP technologies, inclusive of text analytics, herbal language understanding, assignment-orientated dialogue structures, and speech popularity, have been used to expand the diffusion of programs for stepping forward most cancer prediction. As an example, NLP can be used to extract applicable information from the affected person’s clinical data, which allows you to classify cancers into different sorts. NLP has also been hired to automatically locate and classify clinical entities and members of the family from medical reports, as well as to generate sickness progression and treatment prediction fashions primarily based on the extracted statistics. Furthermore, NLP may be used to develop greater comprehensive recommender systems for most cancer care.

articleTitle: Plagiarism Detection in the Digital Era: A Systematic Review of Tools and Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The research performs a systematic review of plagiarism, addressing the prevalence and challenges in the digital era. It investigates into the various types of plagiarism and examines various tools and methodologies, encompassing syntactic and semantic level analysis. Prominent plagiarism detection methods, considering both monolingual and cross-lingual contexts, and offers insights into the advancements in machine learning applications are examined. A comprehensive overview of web-based plagiarism detection tools is provided, emphasizing their strengths and limitations. The study points out current issues in plagiarism detection, promoting for continued research activities to refine precision and comprehensiveness within the domain.

articleTitle: Morphogenesis of Images using Neural Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The examination of image morphogenesis, an intricate phenomenon characterized by the gradual metamorphosis of visual representations, stands as the central focus of this scholarly investigation. Within this context, the research endeavor delves deeply into the complex interplay between Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) and Deep Neural Networks (CRNN). An integral component of this inquiry revolves around the enhancement of the training procedure by incorporating a composite loss function, notably the Huber Loss. Moreover, the study is enriched by the extensive utilization of the Noto Color Emoji collection, which encompasses a vast array of over 2500 emojis meticulously classified into various geometrical forms such as “Circular,” “Bilateral,” and “Asymmetrical.” These diverse emojis function as stand-in for in-real-life images with a more complex color palette. At the core of this research lies the fundamental NCA system with the integrated loss modification, showcasing a remarkable ability to initiate developmental processes from a given seed pixel as compared to the original system. Through thorough experimentation and systematic analysis, the effects of both balanced and unbalanced stimuli on the regenerative capacity of the system were meticulously scrutinized. In the pursuit of broadening the horizons of image manipulation methodologies, a comprehensive evaluation framework was adopted to rigorously assess the performance of the modified model. This framework places emphasis on key metrics, particularly growth and regeneration, with the goal of surpassing the initial outcomes and establishing new standards in the realm of image morphogenesis research. By establishing interdisciplinary connections between developmental biology and computer science, this research not only advances the comprehension of image morphogenesis but also unlocks novel avenues for practical applications. These discoveries carry significant implications across various domains, spanning from educational and visual learning to satellite imaging, digital content creation, security protocols, and data transmission, thereby paving the way for revolutionary progress in the field of bioinformatics.

articleTitle: Review on Machine Learning-Based Mock Interview Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective interview preparation is becoming increasingly important as the requirement for excellent communication skills grows in numerous professional fields. This study provides a detailed assessment of the existing literature on the use of Machine Learning techniques to improve mock interview systems, with an emphasis on Speech Recognition skills. The paper investigates various research methods, tactics and technology used to develop realistic interview simulators. The findings show that these systems provide useful insights on interviewee performance, boosting communication skills for more effective real-world interviews. Furthermore, the paper discusses difficulties, trends and possibilities in this sector, providing a thorough review for academics, practitioners and educators. The proposed method investigates Speech Recognition skills to understand new techniques and their influence on the development of realistic and adaptable interview simulations. By focusing on technology and strategy, the paper offers insights into prospective improvements to communication skills and overall platform efficacy.

articleTitle: Smart and Quick Parking Spot Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid expansion of urban areas has intensified the challenge of finding parking spaces for drivers. Intelligent parking systems emerge as a crucial solution by providing real-time detection of available spaces. While various methods exist, from basic magnetic sensors to advanced computer vision algorithms, their effectiveness can be hindered by environmental factors. Recognizing the importance of automated systems, this paper focuses on implementing an image processing approach for parking space detection. By strategically placing cameras in parking lots, the system identifies vacant spaces and transforms images to determine availability. Integrating these techniques into mobile applications could further aid drivers in locating parking spots, improving their overall experience. Ultimately, accurate and efficient parking space identification is vital for reducing congestion, enhancing air quality, and improving urban environments.

articleTitle: Single-Sided Auction based Multi-Channel Allocation with Spectrum Reuse in CR Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cognitive Radio (CR) is an advanced wireless communication technology that intelligently senses its operating environment to identify available licensed spectrum gaps and adaptively operate on these vacant bands, thereby enhancing spectrum utilization efficiently. Allocation of these free bands to unlicensed users is becoming an inherent necessity in order to overcome the issue of adequate spectrum while satisfying their requisite spectrum demands. Hence, with an intent of enhancing radio spectrum usage, this paper proposes a channel allocation method which carries out single-sided auction in CR networks. Channels are sold out at appropriate prices using the single-sided auction to achieve finer spectrum use, along with reuse of the unused spectrum amongst non-interfering users. Further, with the CR limitations, multi-channel allocation can relevantly improve the channel utilization by performing multiple auction rounds with regard to channel availability time. Rate of data transfer over the heterogeneous nature of channels specifies the bidding language. Reuse of idle bands is provided through a group formation approach following which winning bidders decide their payments. Finally, theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate the improvements in performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Advanced Skin Disease Classification with VGG19, YOLOv3, and MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin diseases are classified into various types hence proper classification of the disease is very important because its determination of the type of treatment to offer the patients will highly determine the results of the patients. This research paper presents an advanced approach to skin disease classification by employing three state-of-the-art deep learning models: VGG19 – a convolutional model that is 19 layers deep, YOLOv3 – an improved version of the YOLO algorithm, MobileNet – a lightweight neural network designed for mobile devices. The performance of these models will be assessed and compared to identify the most effective way of categorizing numerous skin diseases using a large data set. ResNet and VGG19 are employed based on their resilience in feature extraction, and despite the model’s complexity, it is rather accurate. When it comes to the detection of skin abnormalities, object localization is critical, for which YOLOv3 is used because of its high accuracy. MobileNet is evaluated for its applicability in real-time classification for mobile and integrated embedded device applications. The dataset is composed of skin lesion images and has high resolutions and dermatoscopic images, which means that the models had a diverse set of skin conditions on which to train. Metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are used to assess and rank the efficiency of one specific model with another. In highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each model, the findings help in informing studies applying such frameworks in real-world practice contexts. This present comparative study intends to Provide an Improved understanding in the field of dermatology With Better Machine Learning Algorithms to Automate skin Disease Identification, with an impressive patient care impact.

articleTitle: Influence maximization in evolving graphs using reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Influence maximization (IM) aims to maximize awareness in a social network by selecting the optimal set of individuals to start information diffusion. Traditional heuristic IM algorithms struggle with evolving networks, requiring frequent reapplication due to changes in structure. To address this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that leverages edge-based graph neural networks (GNN) and double deep Q networks (DDQN) for influence maximization in dynamic social networks. We tested it on Wiki-vote and fb-food-pages datasets, our framework, trained with 20% of edges randomly removed, effectively generalized to the full graph, achieving an influence spread difference of 8% compared to a heuristic IM algorithm. This study demonstrates the potential of RL-based approaches in optimizing information dissemination in evolving networks.

articleTitle: Streamlining Rescue Efforts: A Study on the Impact of Organizational Coordination in Animal Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study looks into how organizational coordination affects the effectiveness of rescue groups for dogs and cats and suggests a full web application as a solution. The tool simplifies volunteer organizing, gift administration, and animal adoptions. By efficiently managing data and facilitating communication, it improves operational efficiency while catering to the various requirements of animal welfare groups. Important results show that the number of animals rescued and the range of services offered are positively correlated. This study emphasizes how crucial creative, technologically advanced solutions are to raising the effectiveness of animal rescue efforts. Three primary criteria were the focus of the literature review for this study: (1) coordination procedures; (2) coordination operations, such as shelters, foster care, and adoption programs; and (3) empirical proof of coordination outcomes.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction With Effective Feature Engineering Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes, lung disease, and heart failure are common health problems that require effective treatment techniques and early detection everywhere. We have developed a novel method in our study that incorporates machine learning approaches to improve the prediction accuracy for these scenarios. Recognizing the importance of complementary therapies such as exercise in addition to medication, our approach uses patient health metrics analysis to enhance the identification of diabetes, lung disease, and heart failure. We used a novel Principal Component Health (PCH) feature engineering technique to identify the most impacting features after conducting extensive research with nine machine learning algorithms. Better predictive performance was made possible by the feature set that was enhanced as a result of this optimization. With a score of $80 \%$, our suggested decision tree method significantly outperformed other models in terms of accuracy. Cross-validation methods of validation strengthened the validity of our results. With the ultimate goal of improving patient outcomes and saving lives, this research offers cutting-edge techniques for the early identification and management of diabetes, lung disease, and heart failure. It constitutes a significant scientific contribution.

articleTitle: Detection of AI-Generated Image Content in News and Journalism
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper explores the application of deep learning techniques for the detection of AI-generated images within the context of news and journalism. In response to the escalating risk posed by the pervasive use of sophisticated AI-generated content, particularly in the dissemination of fake news and disinformation, this study endeavors to develop a robust solution. The proposed approach involves the deployment of a high-accuracy deep learning model trained on a diverse dataset encompassing both authentic and synthetic images, with a focus on content generated by advanced AI tools such as diffusion models. The ultimate goal is to equip journalists with a tool that enables them to identify and avoid the incorporation of AI-generated images, thereby fortifying media integrity and bolstering public trust.

articleTitle: Identification of Natural Compounds as P-Glycoprotein Substrates and its Effect on Drug Distribution: An In-Silico Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Introduction: P-glycoprotein, an integral membrane transporter, is a critical gatekeeper in the absorption, distribution and elimination of a wide range of drugs and xenobiotics. Identification of natural compounds as substrates for this transporter, expands our understanding of their potential impact on drug interactions and pharmacokinetics. Objectives: This in-silico study aims to identify natural compounds from spices as p-glycoprotein substrates and to investigate their possibility of being effluxed by the multidrug-resistant transporter. Methods: Molecular docking-simulations are employed to screen a diverse library of natural compounds for their potential interaction with p-glycoprotein. Results: Identified several natural compounds with high binding affinities for p-glycoprotein, suggesting their potency as good substrates. Vitexin showed the highest binding affinity for p-glycoprotein followed by gamma-glutamyl-S-allyl cysteine, apigenin-7-O-glucoside. Conclusion: Vitexin may act as lead p-glycoprotein substrates. The study provides insights into their interactions and potential alteration of drug distribution patterns. Further research is needed to confirm these findings.

articleTitle: “User AR” — Leveraging AI Based Augmented Reality for User Manuals
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The objective of this research is to propose an AI based novel augmented reality (AR) software to assist users in operating a wide range of technical and non-technical devices. The project’s aim is to make this AR application, which provides detailed explanations of all the device’s functions, more widely used than traditional user manuals. Augmented reality, which overlays digital information onto the real world, can be employed to develop an AR-based user manual for products or devices. Mobile applications that use a camera to recognize a product or device and display dynamic graphics, such as 3 D models, animations, or text, are one example of AR user manuals. These augmented reality user manuals enable consumers to quickly and easily learn how to operate, assemble, repair, or troubleshoot their purchased products. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm was able to recognize the object accurately with a percentage of 95.2%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Contrast: A Novel Approach using Modified Transfer Function and Energy Curve Equalization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Enhancing image contrast plays a pivotal role in improving the visual perception of low-contrast images. This paper introduces a novel and advanced method to take this crucial image-processing task to new heights. This innovative adaptive image contrast enhancement approach utilizes energy curve equalization and modified transfer functions. While various methods related to histogram equalization exist for image enhancement, the proposed method distinguishes itself by integrating energy curve equalization within a modified transfer function framework. The process involves deriving the energy curve of the input RGB image by combining energy calculations at different intensity levels. Subsequently, the clipped energy curve is calculated and divided into three segments. Each segment undergoes equalization, followed by the calculation of the transfer function. An innovative enhancement parameter is introduced to precisely control the input image’s contrast enhancement. By applying the enhancement parameter to the transfer functions of each segment, modified transfer functions are obtained. The resulting output image is reconstructed by combining the modified transfer functions from each region. The proposed method’s performance is thoroughly evaluated both qualitatively and quantitatively.The results highlight the effectiveness of the approach, showcasing enhancements in both visual quality and objective metrics. The source code is available at: https://github.com/Tracksubmission2024/Image_Enhancement.

articleTitle: Energy and Delay Optimization of Routing Protocols for Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper provides an electricity and postpone optimization of routing protocols for Vehicular advert-hoc Networks. It specializes in the improvement of power performance to overcome the scalability demanding situations inherent in implementing VANETs. The authors examine four existing routing protocols, namely AODV, DSR, OLSR and ZRP, and suggest a dual-level optimization method for stepped forward power performance. The proposed technique considers both the electricity consumption of routing protocols and their response time in opposition to packet shipping delay. On one stage, a power consumption threshold is employed to become aware of the most desirable routing nodes and discard ineffectual information packets. On any other degree, the paper proposes a collaborative based technique for lightweight packet forwarding via most effective forwarding the nearby data packets of the same vacation spot. The simulation consequences display that the proposed approach effects in superior power efficiency and reduced response time for packet shipping compared to present protocols, making the proposed approach green and effective in VANETs.

articleTitle: Cloud-Native CDN Monitoring Using CI/CD
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In a time where digital content consumption reigns, it is essential to efficiently deliver multimedia resources. This research seeks to transform how content is delivered by implementing and overseeing a secure, monitored Content Delivery Network (CDN) on a scalable Kubernetes cluster, managed through a secure CI/CD pipeline built on Jenkins, using the Amazon Web Services (AWS) and essential DevOps tools like Docker, SonarQube, Trivy, Prometheus, Grafana, Argo CD and Helm. The results obtained in this study are derived from an emulation of a CDN. The SonarQube analysis confirms whether the system meets all code quality gates, Trivy identifies and resolves critical container vulnerabilities and OWASP vulnerability checks identify and mitigate security risks in software dependencies. The system is monitored by analyzing the performance metrics visualized in Grafana dashboards, which offer detailed insights into metrics including and not limited to: active jobs, job queue duration, queued rate, memory usage, CPU usage, executor health metrics, system load, RAM usage, root filesystem usage, disk space usage, disk I/O activities, time synchronized drift and time synchronized status. Additionally, SMTP e-mail notifications are configured to improve responsiveness to anomalies identified via monitoring. This study emphasizes making content delivery mechanisms more robust, providing advanced tools for developers, and enabling easy access to digital resources for the community.

articleTitle: Attribute Inference on Multilevel Attributed Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multilevel attribute inference for attributed networks is essential in network analysis with applications in various fields such as social networks, biological networks, and recommender systems. Attributed networks contain structural information expressed as network topology and attribute information characterized by node-level features. The task of multilevel attribute inference is to predict the missing attribute values of a node based on the network structure and the attributes of neighboring nodes. This paper employed various machine learning algorithms: Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Feed Forward Neural Network (FFNN) to predict the missing attributes at all levels. A novel hierarchical inference algorithm, the HierarInfer algorithm, which exploits attributed network properties to infer attributes at multiple levels, was proposed in this paper. Through experiments, it is seen that our algorithm outperforms existing methods regarding attribute prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Neuro-Wave Controlled Wheelchair Combined with Gesture and Voice Control
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a neuro-wave-controlled wheelchair with a gesture and voice control system. This research includes the Gesture Controlled Wheelchair (GCW), Voice Controlled Wheelchair (VCW), and Brain Controlled Wheelchair (BCW). The GCW uses a pseudo glove carrying an accelerometer as input, while the VCW uses a microphone for voice input. Arduino Integrated Development Environment (IDE) develops the necessary software. BCW scheme utilizes a Bluetooth-connected Brainwave sensor module to send neuro-wave data wirelessly to a laptop for processing. The data is being processed using MATLAB Simulink Digital Signal Processing (DSP) toolbox to generate commands for the movement of the wheelchair. Implementing the self-controlled automatic wheelchair provides an essential solution for paralyzed patients to control their movements independently, thereby increasing their mobility and independence. The proposed design shows promising results and provides a solid foundation for integrating more advanced artificial intelligence technologies in disability assistance. The combination of neuro-wave, gesture, and voice control offers a holistic approach to disability assistance, increasing the wheelchair’s usability and ease of use for physically disabled individuals.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Enhanced Emotion-Based Music System with Age and Language Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Music plays an important role in understanding human mood, and the facial expressions acts as a quick way of non-linguistic communication. The emotion-based music playing system provide users with options to choose his/her preferred age and language. Uses deep learning techniques and detects seven emotions from a person’s face using a web camera. Based on the three aspects age, language, and detected emotion the song playlists are recommended. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model is trained on a dataset to achieve the accurate emotion detection. The designed System allows the users to interact with website and view their identified emotions ensuring enhanced user experience.

articleTitle: FedGB: Federated Gradient Boosting for Robust Autism Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) presents substantial problems in cognitive, language, and social skills. Early detection is critical for effective intervention, spurring research into Artificial Intelligence (AI) approaches for ASD detection. Federated Learning (FL) is a promising way to improve accuracy and privacy by training models jointly across distributed datasets. This study presents “FedGB,” a Federated Gradient Boosting (FedGB) strategy that addresses the drawbacks of existing methods and improves ASD identification. Using FL and Gradient Boosting methods, “FedGB” combines GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tweaking to ensure optimal performance and secrecy. Extensive experimentation on varied ASD datasets demonstrates higher performance compared to existing approaches, demonstrating “FedGB”’s effectiveness and dependability in improving ASD detection while maintaining privacy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Agent for Multimedia Information Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our multimedia information retrieval Agent handles dynamic online material using an inventive method. It gathers processes, and stores current information in a variety of forms, including text, images, and video, using text queries given by the user. By using sophisticated web scraping methods with Google as the main source, user interests are accurately represented. The main feature of the system is its ability to use MongoDB to smoothly integrate several multimedia formats into a single storage structure. Google changes their data on a scheduled basis to ensure accuracy and relevancy. With its user-friendly interface for natural language searches and visually appealing results presentation, the system effectively arranges and retrieves data. Robust authorization and authentication processes guarantee the emphasis on security, privacy, and ethical use. With an emphasis on scalability, dependability, and ongoing improvement, the design accounts for potential expansion while guaranteeing that it will always be a state-of-the-art and trustworthy multimedia retrieval technique.

articleTitle: Empowering Linguistic Diversity: Bridging Cultures through Neural Machine Translation from Dzongkha to Hindi
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bhutan and India have enjoyed longstanding friendly relations, fostering significant travel between the two nations. However, linguistic differences often impede visitors’ comprehension of cultural beliefs, particularly between Dzongkha, Bhutan’s native language, and Hindi, widely spoken in India. This paper presents an innovative language translation solution leveraging Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models which is the first and only solution to overcome these barriers. The goal is to enrich tourists’ experiences by providing comprehensive insights into the cultural intricacies of both countries. Through extensive testing, the proposed methodology achieves a promising BLEU score of 0.416, offering an effective means to bridge the linguistic gap and foster cross-cultural understanding.

articleTitle: Reduction of Electromagnetic Problem for Antenna Design Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electromagnetic optimization problems entail the fine tuning of electromagnetic systems across various domains. In many applications such as antenna design, microwave circuits, and metamaterial configuration, a large number of parameters must be finely tuned to achieve the desired device functionality. Given the complexity of real systems, analytical solutions are often unavailable, making the computational cost of a single analysis prohibitive. Therefore, an effective and flexible design strategy is crucial. This paper investigates the application of electromagnetic (EM) simulators in ML and DL for antenna configuration within electromagnetic optimization challenges. Various optimization strategies are reviewed in this work based on literature from comprehensive searches in IEEE Transactions and IEEE Access. From 24 identified studies, 8 key studies were selected to illustrate recent research trends, challenges, and opportunities in optimizing antenna design. Additionally, the paper introduces a novel deep learning approach for addressing electromagnetic problems in antenna design.

articleTitle: Investigating Decentralized Governance Models for Crypto currency Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Decentralized governance fashions for crypto currency networks provide a manner to set up a machine of protocol bylaws and rules that govern the network. those models rely on a consensus-based totally set of rules that enables a distributed machine of nodes, inclusive of miners, software builders, and users, to make decisions about how the community have to function. The intention of decentralized governance for crypto foreign money networks is to offer a reliable way of controlling protocol enhancements, community guidelines, and roles. Decentralized governance models can assist maximize credibility, decentralization, and security whilst minimizing the hazard of centralization and the capability for misbehavior. Similarly, the decentralized technique to crypto forex networks allows users to take a greater active function in establishing policies and protocols for their networks. This study reviews specific decentralized governance fashions, their capability applications, and their benefits and downsides. It also seems at latest traits toward implementing such models on distinct crypto forex networks. Sooner or later, they have a look at discusses key demanding situations and possibilities for a hit and at ease implementation of decentralized governance models for crypto foreign money networks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Android-Driven Smart Farming Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Smart Farming Assistant project is a helpful friend for farmers, using modern technologies to make farming easier and smarter. It’s an Android app that uses advanced technologies like deep learning to give farmers important insights and help them manage their crops better. One of its main features is the ability to recognize diseases in paddy fields, helping farmers identify and diagnose issues through analyzing pictures. Additionally, the app provides access to many helpful articles and resources, offering educational content to improve farmer’s knowledge and practices. These resources include tips and tricks for cultivation, fertilizer calculator, ensuring farmers have the latest information and tools to improve their farming methods.

articleTitle: Emotion Analysis of English-Translated Tamil Literature
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Focus of this study is to investigate the nuanced world of emotions in English-translated Tamil literature through the lens of sentiment analysis. The dataset consists of poems expressing a range of emotions including joy, sadness, love, anger, pride, courage, and fear. To effectively analyze and classify these emotions, we utilized cutting-edge transformer-based models, like BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to conduct our analysis. The outcomes of our study showcase the exceptional capabilities of these models in effectively analyzing emotions within poetic expressions. RoBERTa, in particular, emerged as a standout choice, consistently achieving high accuracy, precision, recall, and $F 1$ scores across all emotion categories. Its extensive pre-training and dynamic masking techniques allowed itto excel in capturing the intricate emotional nuancesembedded in the translated poems. DistilBERT demonstrated commendable efficiency without compromising accuracy, making it a practical option for real-time sentiment analysis. BERT, although a strong performer, showcased marginally reduced efficiency compared to RoBERTa and DistilBERT.

articleTitle: The smart optimization model for Supply Chain Management using IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: this paper explores the theoretical capacity of the Internet of Things (IoT) to optimize delivery chain efficiency. IoT structures permit exceptional records collection and communication capabilities and guide statistics-pushed choices for the greenest supply chain operations. The paper outlines various potential use instances showcasing how IoT may be used to optimize exceptional delivery chain strategies, including stock and asset control, orders, computerized success, and predictive upkeep. The paper then offers an outline of diverse IoT architectures, additives, security standards, and protocols that can be required for the success design and implementation of an IoT platform for supply chain optimization. Sooner or later, the paper provides suggestions for deploying and dealing with IoT delivery chain initiatives.

articleTitle: Wireless ECG Monitoring and Automated Heart Diagnosis: A Mobile App Solution Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research presents a novel solution to the serious global health issue of cardiovascular diseases. The suggested technology revolutionizes remote cardiac monitoring by combining wireless Electrocardiogram sensors and powerful deep learning algorithms. A user-friendly mobile application acts as a center for data collection, storage, and analysis in real time. More importantly, a convolutional neural network can be used for the automatic detection of cardiac problems by pattern extraction from Electrocardiogram readings. The system enables immediate action by sending real-time notifications for detected anomalies, while also keeping a detailed historical record for long-term monitoring. Prioritizing data security, messages are encrypted, and the system contains user authentication mechanisms that are in line with healthcare standards. Engaging individuals in proactive health management, this proposal aims to foster cooperation between users and healthcare providers for better patient outcomes. The suggested system shall offer accessibility, accuracy, and user centricity, coupled with a new approach toward solving the global cardiovascular disease crisis using wireless Electrocardiogram monitoring and deep learning technology.

articleTitle: ScrapeAI: A Multi-Modal Approach to Detect Dark Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study proposes a multi-modal architecture to detect dark patterns, leveraging the usage of textual, visual, and temporal contexts. Dark patterns are deceptive elements used in websites and apps that manipulate users into making decisions that benefit the company, often at the expense of the user. In today’s world, with a significant rise in the adoption of technology across the globe, detecting dark patterns becomes important. This study is more focused on the dark patterns in the e-commerce space. We propose using three modules to detect this task, each of which processes different types of data. For textual data, we leverage Large Language Models to detect potential dark patterns. For visual data, we use object detection models to detect any visual cues that might reveal potential dark patterns. For the temporal context, we track and analyze the states of the website. Using these three modules makes our detection process robust and versatile. Furthermore, we created an image dataset DarkPattern-Capture (DPC), which has images of potentially deceptive elements; our object detection models are trained and tested on this dataset.

articleTitle: Neural Machine Translation Using a Pivot Approach: Dogri to English
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The progress of Neural Machine Translation for Indic languages is gradually achieving a noteworthy result in terms of translation accuracy. However, its advancement is impeded by the lack of rich parallel corpora, a limitation not shared by non-Indic languages. As a result, most languages of India are still categorized as low-resource or zero-resource languages. Various state-of-the-art architectures have been developed to address these challenges, with the predominant approach being the pivot-based technique. This technique, rooted in transfer learning, utilizes an auxiliary language as a pivot to assist in translation. In this study, a pivotbased Neural Machine Translation (NMT) architecture is designed for translating Dogri to English, with Hindi as the pivot. Dogri, being a low-resource language, shares linguistic similarities with Hindi. Furthermore, Hindi-to-English state-of-the-art models are accessible, ensuring high translation accuracy. Through the implementation of this pivot-based translation model, a BLEU score of 20.97, SacreBLEU of 21.54 and chrF of 50.01 is attained.

articleTitle: NLP-Driven Video Transcription: A Comprehensive Survey and Innovative Office Meeting Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach for automating office meeting summarisation, leveraging OpenAI’s Whisper ASR model and ChatGPT capabilities to enhance language processing. The Whisper ASR model adeptly transcribes spoken words from meetings into written text, effectively capturing the primary ideas exchanged during discussions. Subsequently, ChatGPT utilizes this transcribed text to generate concise and coherent summaries, emphasizing key points from the conversations. The system adeptly produces precise and meaningful meeting summaries through the synergistic integration of advanced speech recognition and language modelling, facilitating the extraction of crucial insights from spoken content. The system is thoughtfully crafted as a user-friendly web application, employing straightforward technologies such as HTML, CSS, and Flask for accessibility and ease of use. The intuitive interface enables participants to effortlessly upload video content from meetings, allowing the system to transform spoken words into easily comprehensible summaries in real time. Beyond the automation of summarization tasks, this proposed approach signifies a significant advancement in applying language technologies to enhance communication efficiency in professional settings. By seamlessly combining cutting-edge video transcription, text summarization, and web development, the project not only streamlines the summarization process but also paves the way for more dynamic and effective information sharing within office environments. As this work is part of a survey paper, the proposed idea contributes to the broader exploration of leveraging language technologies for improved communication and information exchange.

articleTitle: Significance of Feature Selection on IoT-based Botnet Attacks Identification Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid spread of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has introduced various issues in ensuring network security. One major issue with the integrity and availability of IoT network systems is botnet attacks. In this context, effective botnet detection strategies are crucial for safeguarding IoT networks. Feature selection (FS) emerges as a fundamental process in network traffic analysis, with a significant impact on identifying botnet activities amidst the vast and complex data streams generated by IoT devices. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of FS methods and explores how these techniques affect the efficiency of detecting botnets in IoT networks through machine learning (ML) methods. The significance of FS lies in its ability to improve the efficacy of machine learning algorithms employed in botnet detection systems. Furthermore, we conduct experimental analysis using N-BaIoT, a standard IoT network traffic dataset, to assess how FS affects the efficiency of botnet detection models.
