In such cases, traditional analytical approaches fall short in calculating the inverse kinematics, necessitating the use of soft computing methods. To tackle this challenge, the application of the ANFIS technique has been explored to compute the inverse kinematics. To make a meaningful comparison between the ANFIS method and the analytical approach, we focus on the behaviour of only three links of branch five. Based on our findings from the fifth branch of the PCSM, it can be inferred that the ANFIS technique holds promise for addressing the inverse kinematics when more than one branch of PCSM navigates simultaneously.

articleTitle: Legal Implications of Self-Driving Cars in Computer Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Self-riding vehicles, additionally referred to as autonomous cars, are technological advancements that have the potential to revolutionize the transportation enterprise. They use sensors, cameras, and algorithms to navigate roads without human intervention. At the same time, those automobiles provide numerous blessings, including accelerated safety, progressed traffic drift, and reduced emissions; they also boost critical criminal implications that want to be addressed. One main concern is the liability in case of accidents related to those automobiles. If a self-using car causes a twist of fate, who’s accountable - the producer, the proprietor, or the software program developer? Increases questions about coverage coverage, contractual duties, and ability complaints. Additionally, moral concerns include programming a car to pick out the lesser of evils in a twist of fate state of affairs. There are also criminal questions about information privacy and protection. Self-using vehicles acquire vast quantities of statistics, consisting of non-public passenger records, which may be at risk of cyber attacks. This data’s ownership and utilization raises privacy and possession rights problems.

articleTitle: Advancing Sustainable Development and Technical Efficiency in India’s Textile Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article explores the challenges faced by the Indian textile sector in incorporating sustainable development practices and technological efficiency advances. Given that the textile industry is one of the most significant sectors of the Indian economy and, at the same time, one of the most environmentally detrimental industries as it requires massive consumption of water and energy, generates considerable volumes of chemical garbage, and pollutes the environment with greenhouse emissions, various innovative approaches are implemented. In particular, the use of materials and water-saving systems and energy in the form of renewable sources, while some even apply the most advanced technologies such as digital printing and automation, enabling limited waste and energy use. Moreover, some companies are certified and are thus encouraged to adopt these practices further. The study demonstrates that there is indeed substantial progress, although the implementation speed and rate vary drastically between different scales. The paper concludes with recommendations for stakeholders to foster a more sustainable and efficient textile industry in India, emphasising the need for an integrated approach that combines technological innovation with environmental stewardship.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Generative Adversarial Networks for Graphics and Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Generative adverse Networks (GANs) are an effective magnificence of gadget getting-to-know fashions that have been efficiently utilized in a variety of programs, inclusive of picture technology, photograph-to-image translation, and text-to-picture synthesis. In this paper, we explore the capacity of GANs for graphics and visualization. We introduce a brand new GAN architecture for images and visualization that’s primarily based on the Generative hostile Autoencoder (GAE) model. We discuss the benefits of the usage of GANs for pix and visualization and gift several experiments to illustrate the effectiveness of our method. We additionally talk about the challenges and possibilities for similar research on this location. Our consequences show that GANs may be used to generate graphics and visualizations and may be used to enhance the performance of existing snapshots and visualization algorithms.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Federated Learning Strategies for Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional healthcare systems utilize centralized approaches for building machine-learning models for disease diagnosis. It requires sharing raw data to the centralized server, which is practically difficult due to patient’s privacy. This leads to significant vulnerabilities and challenges. As a result, switching to approaches for scalable and distributed AI at the network edge for privacy-preserving smart healthcare applications is essential. Deep learning models need to train on data, on any nodes, in a privacy-preserving manner, but not give up the distinction of patients. This paper aims to investigate the application of FL in providing health diagnosis while enhancing the patient’s data privacy, by adopting the Flower platform. It employs the following four algorithms for federated learning that can facilitate collaborative model training with shared patient data: FedAvg, FedProx, FedAdagrad, and FedAdam. To evaluate FL’s effectiveness, deep learning models trained on decentralized COVID-19 and Pneumonia datasets are used from different sources. FL methods were compared to a Centralized Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to check the performance. The analysis shared in this paper shows that implementing FL contributes to establishing the subject’s accurate diagnostics concerning the patient’s data protection in the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Approach of “KNN LSTM” for detection of Brain Tumour in MR images
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Now a days, more existing techniques are available to found tumours on brain from MR images. But still the researchers are concentrated on to detect the brain tumour accurately with less time. So, this work proposed the hybrid machine learning algorithm of “K-Nearest Neighbour - Long Short-Term Memory” (“KNN-LSTM”) with increased ‘accuracy’, ‘sensitivity’, ‘specificity’, with less ‘time consumption’. In this work, the brain tumour is identified by predicting the MR images from huge dataset with usage of machine learning approach of “KNN-LSTM”. Brain tumour detection is difficult when to compare the abnormal and typical tissues of large capacity. In order to enable a speedy recovery following therapy, brain tumours should be identified as soon as feasible. If the brain tumour is discovered early on, patients can benefit from improved care. Due to the irregular spreading of the abrasions, brain tumours are still difficult to identify even with intensive study. Sometimes the tiny tumours look like normal, but it is challenging to find it. So, the techniques are need to increase the classification accuracy, and selecting the useful features. This paper proposes a hybrid machine learning model “KNN-LSTM” for categorizing the tumours with predicting through MR images. MRI brain imaging collection is used for our experimentation. The “KNN” algorithm usage is to extract the important characteristics from pictures once the data has been pre-processed effectively. The proposed work predicts the brain tumour with 99.15% of ‘accuracy’, 98% of ‘sensitivity’, 97.12% of ‘specificity’ and testing time consumption of 0.5 minutes.

articleTitle: Transformative Insights into Pneumonia Detection with a Novel Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pneumonia is a prominent cause of illness and death worldwide. The early and precise diagnosis of the disease remains essential for effective treatment of the patient. Traditional methods of diagnosis, while effective, often involve significant time and expertise, that can pose numerous challenges and difficulties during situations with limited resources and in peak demand times. Many recent advances in deep learning and artificial intelligence have shown positive findings in the processing of medical pictures. Chest radiographs have been extensively studied for different purposes, especially in the diagnosis of diseases like Pneumonia, Tuberculosis, Asthma, Bronchitis, Pneumothorax, and many more. This paper focuses on using many Deep Learning architectures and Artificial intelligence concepts, such as explainable AI, to use patients’ chest X-rays to detect pneumonia in patients in its early phase.

articleTitle: Baby Monitoring Using IOT and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The way parents watch over and take care of their infants has changed dramatically as a result of the Internet of Things (IoT) integration with baby monitoring devices. This technical innovation provides real-time information into the baby’s surroundings and behaviors by utilizing a network of interconnected sensors, devices, and cloud-based platforms. The core functionality of IoT baby monitoring systems includes real-time environmental monitoring, sleep pattern analysis, audio and xv surveillance. Customizable alerts and notifications empower parents to set personalized thresholds, receiving timely updates on changes in temperature, unusual movements, or the baby waking up.This research focuses on baby monitoring using three methods: Whether the child is weeping or not, urine should be monitored, and the child’s emotions should be identified. When a baby cries, the cradle automatically moves to stop the baby’s cry; if the infant stops crying, the movement will cease for the cry. This allows caregivers to keep an eye on the child regardless of whether they are crying or not.The child’s voice will be recorded using a monitoring microphone, and its output will be compared to the weeping sound that the Arduino code will already provide. In order to monitor urine, a soil moisture measuring sensor is placed under the cloth used in the cradle. If the cradle is wet, the soil moisture sensor detects the cloth is wet, and an alert is sent. The deep learning (DL) algorithm is used to detect the child’s emotions. The DL algorithm receives an image as input and matches the child’s face emotions with the ESP 32 camera module. The DL algorithm then predicts the child’s emotion and sends the emotion to the parent mobile.

Author Keywords: IoT components, Emotion Detection, Deep Learning Models, Image Classification

articleTitle: Navigating the Transition: An In-Depth Examination of Anxiety and Coping Mechanisms Among First Year College Students
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study investigates the intricate relationship between anxiety levels, coping mechanisms, social anxiety frequency, and academic performance among first-year college students. Through meticulous data collection and rigorous statistical analysis, three hypotheses are explored, each shedding light on different aspects of this complex dynamic. Hypothesis 1 examines the negative correlation between anxiety levels and academic performance. Pearson correlation coefficients reveal moderate to strong negative correlations between various anxiety-related variables (anxiety level, social anxiety frequency, excessive worry, feeling anxious) and academic performance. Higher levels of anxiety are consistently associated with lower academic performance among first-year college students. Hypothesis 2 delves into the impact of coping mechanisms on academic performance. A significant $\mathbf{t}$-statistic of $\mathbf{- 2 4. 3 4}$ and an extremely low p-value of $1.89 \mathrm{e}-96$ indicate a substantial influence of coping mechanisms on output grade. Effective coping strategies play a crucial role in facilitating academic success among students. For Hypothesis 3, regression analysis demonstrates the detrimental effects of social anxiety frequency on academic performance. The model exhibits a commendable fit, with social anxiety frequency and social avoidance frequency significantly predicting output grade. Higher levels of social anxiety frequency and social avoidance frequency are associated with lower academic achievement among first-year college students. Overall, the findings underscore the pervasive influence of anxiety-related factors on academic outcomes, highlighting the importance of targeted interventions and support mechanisms. Learning Analytics, Academic Success, Anxiety, Educational Data Mining, Academic Performance.

articleTitle: Zero-Shot and Few-Shot Learning for Telugu News Classification: A Large Language Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Telugu news classification involves categorizing news articles written in the Telugu language into five categories: business, editorial, entertainment, nation, and sport. Zero-shot classification enables categorization into unseen classes without any prior training on those specific classes. Few-shot classification generalizes with minimal training data by leveraging a limited number of labeled examples per class. This work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) such as mBERT, Indic-BERT, XLM-Roberta, and Flan-T5 Large for zero-shot classification. For few-shot classification, models like Flan-T5 and BART are used in 1 -shot, 3 -shot, and 5 -shot scenarios. Traditional machine learning models including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Naive Bayes, AdaBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression are also explored for comparison. Prompt engineering is employed with various prompts to enhance zero-shot classification performance. Among the LLMs, mBERT achieves the highest F1-score of 0.58 in zero-shot classification. For few-shot classification, Flan-T5 achieved an F1-score of $\mathbf{0. 2 3}$.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform Based Feature Extraction for Fault Diagnosis in Machinery
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The wavelet remodel is a popular sign-processing technique used for feature extraction in fault prognosis in equipment. In this paper, we present an outline of the wavelet transform primarily based on function extraction techniques for fault prognosis. We discuss the standards and advantages of the wavelet remodel and its applicability to machinery fault diagnosis. We gift an in-depth evaluation of the diverse stages of feature extraction along with de-noising, time-frequency distribution, characteristic selection, sample popularity, and category. We additionally talk about the application of the facts-driven methods along with clustering techniques and neural networks for special equipment fault diagnosis troubles. Finally, we provide an outline of numerous case research that has used the wavelet rework based totally feature extraction for fault diagnosis in diverse styles of machinery. This evaluation highlights the usefulness of the wavelet remodel for extracting fault capabilities from equipment with the purpose of, in the long run, helping to enhance the accuracy of fault prognosis and to lessen protection prices.

articleTitle: Improving Market Efficiency and Profitability in High-Frequency Trading Using Neural Network-Based Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The financial markets have witnessed the rise of High-frequency trading (HFT), which is distinguished by the quick execution of deals encouraged by algorithmic methods and advanced technological infrastructure. This paper suggests a unique way to use deep learning techniques, namely Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural networks, to improve market efficiency and profitability in HFT. By using the non-linear patterns and temporal dependencies seen in high-frequency market data, the method seeks to enhance trading strategy optimization and forecast accuracy. A comprehensive analysis of historical market data, including price movements, volume dynamics, and order book information, is conducted to train and evaluate the LSTM and GRU models. Through rigorous experimentation the effectiveness of the proposed approach in generating profitable trading signals and mitigating risks associated with high-frequency trading is assessed. Additionally, the interpretability of the neural network models is explored, providing insights into their decision-making process and identifying key factors influencing trading performance. These findings contribute to ongoing research efforts aimed at harnessing the power of deep learning for enhancing HFT capabilities, offering valuable implications for market participants and regulators navigating the complexities of modern financial markets. Python is used to implement the suggested work. By comparing the proposed study with the present RNN, BiLSTM approach, 98% accuracy is achieved.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Autonomous Landing of AirSim Simulated Quadcopter in Unreal Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for landing an autonomous quadcopter using reinforcement learning (RL) in the AirSim simulation environment running on Unreal Engine. The complicated dynamics and unpredictability of quadcopter landing procedures make them difficult to execute and frequently reduce the efficacy of conventional control techniques. In order to overcome these difficulties, the suggested RL model interacts with an incredibly lifelike simulation to learn the best landing techniques, which faithfully replicates physical principles. Impressing with notable improvements in landing precision and resilience in many scenarios, this model holds potential to improve unmanned aerial vehicle operations. By utilizing reinforcement learning within a practical simulation setting, this study advances the creation of more effective and flexible autonomous landing systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), potentially leading to benefits in practical uses.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Low-Light Images using Structure-Aware Illumination Mapping: A LIME Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low-light image enhancement is a fundamental task in computer vision with numerous real-world applications. This paper presents a novel approach to low-light image enhancement based on the estimation of the illumination map using a Retinex-based method. Unlike traditional Retinex-based approaches, which decompose an image into reflectance and illumination components, our method focuses solely on estimating the illumination, thereby reducing computational complexity. The proposed algorithm begins by constructing an initial illumination map based on the maximum intensity of each pixel across RGB channels. Subsequently, a structure-aware smoothing technique is applied to refine the illumination map, improving its accuracy. Two algorithms are developed to solve the refinement problem: an Augmented Lagrangian Multiplier (ALM) based exact solver and a sped-up solver for reduced computational load. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method, showcasing significant improvements in low-light image quality compared to state-of-the-art methods. This approach offers a promising solution for enhancing low-light images in various scenarios, with potential applications in surveillance, photography, and medical imaging.

articleTitle: Live Transcription and Closed Caption
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This innovative study proposes a novel tool targeted at addressing communication issues for people with hearing impairments. This improvement focuses on smart glasses with real-time captioning for improved accessibility.The main components are a powerful microphone array, a cloud computing platform driven by Raspberry pi zero w, and an advanced Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system. These components work together to enable the smart glasses to detect spoken language, process it using cloud-based algorithms, and display accurate captions in real time inside the wearer’s field of view.The primary purpose is to improve communication accessibility for those with hearing impairments by providing timely, accurate, and prominently displayed captions. Beyond personal relationships, the impact extends to a variety of settings, including educational institutions, workplaces, and public spaces, where good communication is essential for involvement.

articleTitle: An Efficient Framework for Transliteration Sentence Identification of Low Resource Languages Using Hybrid BERT-BiGRU
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In natural language processing (NLP), text categorization is a significant field of study that has drawn a lot of interest from scholars lately. Transliteration, expressing one language using an alphabet of different languages while preserving its phonetic pronunciation, presents unique challenges in language identification due to the difference in representations of languages across different writing systems. In this study, we addressed this issue by leveraging the power of deep learning on four languages which are Bangla, Hindi, Tamil, and English. We proposed a novel method transliteration language dataset. Here, at first we created a transliteration language dataset of 4 different languages by extracting languages from 12 distinct datasets, after that we utilized a hybrid architecture combining BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) with a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU). The BERT-BiGRU model achieves exceptional performance metrics, including 98.77% accuracy, 97.57% F1 score, 99.15% specificity, and 96.74% Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC). The findings show benchmark performance. This hybrid model performs better than baseline models in terms of performance. We employed Layer Integrated Gradients to analyze the model’s decision-making process and provide insight into the linguistic elements that support language identification in order to improve the explainability of our model. This confirms the effectiveness of our model as well. With the rapid advancement of text classification in low-resource languages, this work provides a useful framework for improved accuracy in transliteration tasks.

articleTitle: Enhanced Multi-Model Feature Fusion for Categorizing Diabetic Retinopathy Severity level
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), is a major concern for long-term diabetic individuals, leading to damage of eyesight if diagnosis is delayed. In this study, it aims to propose a multi-model fusion of two pre-trained models VGG19 and ResNet50, that leverages important details from the retinal fundus images. These are fused using a cross-pooling technique to capture significant image details, which are crucial for precise diagnosis. A neural network architecture is employed to classify DR severity levels with remarkable accuracy. This proposed model is experimented on the Kaggle APTOS 2019 dataset, which is a benchmark dataset. The results of Proposed model were impressive, achieving an accuracy of $83.33 \%$. This high accuracy demonstrates the effectiveness of our methodology and shows the potential of fusion-based method in diagnosing DR.This proposed model offers a promising path for early intervention and preserving vision in diabetic patients and also demonstrates remarkable performance, especially in categorizing normal, mild, and moderate stages of retinal fundus images.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model Based Criminal Identification System for Law Enforcement Department
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: CrimeNet is an innovative automatic criminal identification system developed for law enforcement agencies to streamline and enhance the classification of criminals. Leveraging Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms, this system aims to significantly improve the efficiency and effectiveness of identifying individuals involved in criminal activities. The proposed methodology involves creating a comprehensive database containing both full images and sliced images of criminals, along with their personal and criminal information. Through advanced facial recognition technology powered by deep learning methods, CrimeNet compares captured images of individuals with the stored criminal data, enabling law enforcement to accurately identify suspects. Utilizing YOLO v8, CrimeNet maps facial features to pinpoint specific facial points, facilitating the accurate identification of individuals. By automating tasks and utilizing cutting-edge technology, this system elevates the capability of law enforcement in spotting criminals, ultimately enhancing public safety. Furthermore, CrimeNet provides customizable notifications and alarms based on various detection or recognition events, enabling law enforcement to swiftly respond to potential threats. Automated security response workflows, as well as SMS and email notifications, further streamline the process of apprehending suspects and preventing future crimes.

articleTitle: Examining the Performance and Reliability of Wireless Sensors for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper will study modern-day Wi-Fi sensors’ overall performance and reliability in agricultural programs. An outline of the modern country’s modern wireless era in agriculture will be supplied, consisting of the use instances for Wi-Fi sensor networks (WSNs) and how they offer improved productivity and fee savings. Wi-Fi sensor networks are getting more popular for use in agricultural and environmental sensing, especially in precision farming and agricultural robotics, and this paper will explore the benefits and disadvantages of ultra-modern using WSNs as well as the significant challenges and possibilities for improvement. Moreover, performance standards and reliability criteria for comparing wireless sensors for agricultural applications will be compared to conventional stressed-out technologies. In the end, recent advances in Wi-Fi technologies and strategies for enhancing the reliability of modern-day agricultural WSNs can be mentioned. The statistics presented in this paper assist researchers, farmers, and industrialists in making a knowledgeable decision on adopting brand-new Wi-Fi sensor networks in agricultural settings. Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have been contemporarily used to screen soil and crop conditions for precision agriculture. The performance and reliability of those systems are essential for the accuracy of today’s accrued statistics. This abstract critiques the studies on WSNs for precision agriculture and evaluates modern-day the overall performance and reliability of contemporary current sensors. Mainly, this abstract specializes in the strength necessities, transmission variety, sensing accuracy, and information quality of cutting-edge present systems. The reliability of present-day WSNs in agricultural settings is discussed in phrases of state-of-the-art electricity and sign integrity, statistics storage and control, and facts safety. Sooner or later, present challenges and destiny guidelines for deploying cutting-edge WSNs in precision agriculture are discussed. The latest results in this analysis exhibit that existing WSN technologies have evolved notably over the past few years and feature the potential to emerge as a reliable source of trendy records for precision agriculture applications.

articleTitle: Efficient Multi-Modal MR-PET medical Image Integration using Wavelet Level Depended Fusion Rules
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multi-modal medical image fusion (MMF) is a technique that combines information from different modalities for better diagnosis and treatment planning. MRI displays anatomical information in grayscale with high spatial resolution, whereas PET displays the metabolism of an organ or specific tissue in color with low spatial resolution. This study aims to develop novel Multi-modal medical image fusion including optimum max fusion rule with improved Laplacian of Gaussian in a multi-level approach. The objective of this work is to investigate the optimum max fusion rule for enhancing the structural and edge quality using an improved Laplacian of Gaussian algorithm. The MRI-PET fusion image framework developed in this study uses multi-level wavelet decomposition with feature-dependent multi-fusion rules. DWT high-low frequency coefficients are used to generate detailed and approximate components. The weighted average and max fusion rule were used to obtain detailed and approximate components. The weights are calculated using improved Laplacian and Gaussian filter techniques based on normalized energy. Finally, detailed and approximate components were integrated for the formation of fused images. Subjective and objective evaluations were performed on three datasets of MRI-PET images. The present work introduces a multi-fusion rule-based framework for MRI and PET image fusion using DWT and an improved Laplacian of Gaussian filter. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional methods in terms of enhancing structural (SSIM) and Edge-based similarity (Q(ABF)) features. The results demonstrated that the present MMF approach has greater structural and edge quality than other existing techniques. It can also be used in any application that requires image fusion at the preprocessing stage, such as MRI-PET pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Enhanced Object Detection model in Complex Images using swin-transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The effectively target the detection model on complex images, we will discuss Better Object Detection for Complex Images using Swin-transformer. It’s based on the swing-transformer architecture, a recent transformer-based model with excellent results in image recognition tasks. Following the hand-crafted pipeline with predefined anchor boxes, these two-stage object detections differ from the current paper’s end-to-end learned representations of objects. It makes it easier for the network to identify intricate and diverse images of objects regardless of their sizes, shapes, etc. Finally, multi-scale feature fusion and self-attention mechanisms improve object detection performance. Extensive experimental results on benchmark datasets show the effectiveness of our method over state-of-the-art approaches. The Enhanced Object Detection model in Complex Images using a swing-transformer is a practical road map for deploying more robust and reliable object detection systems, specially designed to fit deployment environments such as Autonomous Driving, surveillance scenes, or remote-sensing scenarios(PropertyName) where accurate object predictions are critical.

articleTitle: Insights into Gun-Related Deaths: A Comprehensive Machine Learning Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work employs both supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques to examine firearm-related fatalities in the US and identify trends, patterns, and risk factors within the data. During the supervised learning phase, techniques such as logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, and neural networks were used to predict the kind of death (suicide, homicide, accidental, or unknown) based on demographic data like sex, age, race, place, and education. Findings show that the neural network and random forest models exhibit promising precision and recall values across several classes, and that they obtained the highest accuracy, reaching $79.88 \%$ and $83.59 \%$, respectively. Using clustering techniques including Agglomerative clustering, K-means, and Gaussian mixture models, gun-related fatalities were categorized based on demographic and temporal data during the unsupervised learning stage. The analysis revealed distinct clusters of deaths, providing insights into the varying patterns and trends over time and across demographic groups. The K-means algorithm, with a silhouette score of 0.42, demonstrated meaningful separation among clusters. The research contributes to understanding the complex dynamics of gun-related deaths, shedding light on both individual risk factors and broader trends. However, further analysis could explore additional dimensions of the dataset or delve deeper into the interpretation of clustering results. The study also highlights how crucial it is to take into consideration the moral consequences and constraints of machine learning applications in complex fields like public health.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Forecasting using Financial Indicators
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the rise of digital financial systems, cryptocurrencies have become a prime example of blockchain’s potential. This paper presents a deep learning approach targeting the time series data of Bitcoin, which is known for its high volatility. By implementing a long short-term memory (LSTM) model, this study aims to capture the underlying trends in cryptocurrency pricing for future price prediction.

articleTitle: Quantum Computational Approaches to Achieve Intrinsic Parallelization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Quantum computation is the effective and inherent parallelized way of solving real world problems over quantum computer. The real world demands for a parallelization just to achieve the performance speed-up and for obtaining optimized computational results. This paper investigates various quantum computational approaches to achieve intrinsic parallelization, focusing on superposition and entanglement to perform multiple computations simultaneously. Based on a comparative classical-quantum aspect, the emergence and significance of the quantum computing is justified. The key quantum algorithms, including Shor’s and Grover’s, are analyzed for their parallel processing potential and impact on solving complex problem. The potential of quantum computation in the cryptography, cybersecurity and machine learning generate benefits and enhances performance using the quantum approaches. This paper aims to advance the understanding and the development of quantum computational methods as highly efficient and it contributes to near future of high-performance computing through intrinsic parallelization.

articleTitle: EEG Conformer Model Based Epileptic Seizure Prediction Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Epilepsy is a disorder of the brain characterized by repeated seizures. A seizure is usually defined as a sudden alteration of behavior due to a temporary change in the electrical functioning of the brain. The emergence of deep learning methodologies has incentivized inventive applications within the domain of medical diagnostics, specifically concerning the prediction of epileptic seizures. In the existing method SVM classifiers was used to differentiate between seizure and non-seizure states based on the extracted features, providing a well-established machine learning framework for binary classification tasks. Used ensemble learning strategies, such as Random Forests and Decision Trees, to combine several models and identify intricate links in the EEG data, improving classification accuracy and accuracy is upto 89.7%. The convolutional Transformer Model, the deep learning architecture designed for precise and timely prediction of epileptic seizures, is proposed in this project. By utilizing the complex patterns and intrinsic focal relationships found in EEG signals, the model is able to extract subtle information that is essential for differentiating between preictal states. Compared to other approaches, the EEG Conformer Model performs better at predicting seizures after training on a large dataset of CHB MIT EEG database. By adding conformer blocks, the model is better to identify long-range dependencies in EEG sequences, which increases prediction accuracy. This project focuses on the development and implementation of an EEG conformer model for epileptic seizure prediction, employing deep learning methodologies. By training the model on diverse and extensive datasets, it is expected to learn and generalize underlying patterns, enabling it to predict seizures with a high degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: Click-Through Rate Analysis for Understanding User Behavior in Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Improving user satisfaction and personalization in information retrieval is an ongoing challenge. This research delves into user behavior analysis using click-through data, providing a deeper understanding of user intent beyond initial interactions. This article utilizes click-through analysis to uncover user preferences, resulting in search results that align more closely with user intent. These insights contribute to more refined search experiences, enhancing user satisfaction and personalization across digital platforms. The experimental outcomes demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for capturing user preferences and tailoring search results accordingly.

articleTitle: A Computer-Aided Risk Assessment and Major Factors Analysis System for Cervical Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cervical cancer stands as a primary cause of premature death among women worldwide with over 85% of fatalities in developing nations. This cancer is influenced by various risk factors, and early detection and treatment overseen by expert medical professionals are crucial to minimizing its negative effects. This study extensively investigates demographic and lifestyle data to identify important factors associated with cervical cancer. This work aims to investigate the feature importance of habits and practices associated with risks of cervical cancer using UCI cervical cancer risk factors dataset. This investigation gives the idea of essential risk factors to enhance the understanding of vaginal health. By employing feature importance algorithm, we thoroughly examine a wide range of variables including demographic, behavioral, and clinical attributes. Robust statistical techniques have enabled the identification of prominent risk factors. Additionally, a computer-aided assessment system has been developed to predict the risk of cervical cancer using machine learning framework. This system simplifies the process, saving time, resources, and reducing complications associated with manual prediction or delayed diagnosis. Six classifiers are evaluated for the proposed predictive model, with random forest consistently outperforming (highest accuracy of 99.36%) than other classification approaches. The future direction of this work includes multi-stage severity assessment and translation of the predictive cervical cancer risk assessment model into mobile or web-based applications.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Neonatal Facial Expression from Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Understanding and interpreting infant emotions is crucial for early childhood development and effective caregiving. In this work, we implemented various deep learning (DL) models to detect emotions in infants from images. By leveraging advancements in computer vision and DL techniques, our goal is to develop a comprehensive system capable of accurately recognizing and classifying a wide range of emotional states in infants. We analyze facial expressions in images of infants, utilizing DL models to extract relevant features and identify emotional patterns. Our approach is evaluated using a comprehensive dataset of infants exhibiting various emotional states. Through rigorous experimentation, we assess different feature extraction methods, machine learning (ML) algorithms, and deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), measuring performance using accuracy metrics to determine the system’s effectiveness in identifying and classifying infant emotions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Virtualization Security with a Z-Score Based Conjugate Self-Organizing Migration ML Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a new machine learning model for detecting malware in cloud computing settings called Conjugate Self-Organizing Migration (CSOM), which is based on Z-score. Feature vectors are standardized by the model through the use of Z-score normalization, which improves its flexibility with changing data distributions. By merging self-organizing migratory processes with statistical analysis, the CSOM model effectively reduces the threat of growing malware. Using Z-score normalization to guarantee correct representation of changing data, the imaging approach depicts the cloud environment as a dynamic, self-organizing landscape. Through conjugate migration techniques, the CSOM model dynamically modifies synaptic weights to minimize false positives and enable the identification of tiny fluctuations in harmful actions. The Z-score-based CSOM model is effective in detecting malware at high accuracy rates in a variety of dynamic cloud environments, as demonstrated by the experimental results. The model demonstrates its flexibility in responding to changing cyberthreats with its strong performance in real-world settings. Finally, with its better accuracy and adaptability, the suggested Z-score-based CSOM model offers a potential approach for cloud computing virus detection. In order to handle the constantly shifting environment of cloud-based cyber threats, further research may examine scalability and more refinement.

articleTitle: Maximizing Marketing ROI with Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Predictive Modeling and Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One common and successful tactic for optimising marketing return on investment is the application of sophisticated deep learning techniques for consumer segmentation and predictive modelling. A family of algorithms known as “deep learning” is able to extract intricate patterns from data, which makes predictions and segmentations more precise. The capacity of sophisticated deep learning methods to handle big and complicated datasets is one of its main advantages. In the constantly evolving digital landscape, marketers have access to a wealth of customer data from a variety of sources, including social media, website interactions, and purchase histories. Deep learning algorithms may be able to process these massive volumes of data and produce relevant information that aids in campaign targeting and consumer segmentation. Furthermore, deep learning techniques can reveal patterns and links in the data that were previously unknown, giving marketers a better insight of the requirements, preferences, and behaviours of their target audience. This makes it possible to implement relevant and customised marketing tactics that connect with customers and increase engagement and conversion rates. Having the capacity to continually learn and get better over time is another benefit of adopting cutting edge deep learning techniques for predictive modelling. Compared to conventional statistical methods, these algorithms are more accurate and dependable since they are trained on big datasets and can adapt to new data.

articleTitle: Pandemic Outbreak Analysis Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pandemics are global health emergencies that pose significant threats to people’s health, the stability of society, and the economy. The development and quick spread of infectious diseases like Monkeypox (Mpox) and COronaVIrus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) are notable examples of the devastating effects of pandemics. The zoonotic disease Mpox, caused by the MPoX Virus (MPXV), has attracted attention worldwide since it can spread across people and shares similarities with smallpox. International Health Organization (IHO) has categorized Mpox and COVID-19 as global health emergencies, highlighting the seriousness and urgency of the situations and calling for collaborative actions to mitigate them. This paper undertakes a comprehensive analysis of the spread patterns and trends of Mpox and COVID-19 using machine learning (specifically, time series analysis) techniques, i.e., Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Seasonal Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA), ARIMA with Genetic Algorithm (ARIMA-GA), SARIMA with GA (SARIMA-GA), ARIMA with Grid Search (ARIMA-GS), SARIMA with Grid Search (SARIMA-GS), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM). Here, we use GA and GS to optimize the hyperparameters. The techniques are extensively simulated and evaluated using two datasets, four performance metrics, the forecast plot and the diagnostic plot to show the efficacy of SARIMA-GS, SARIMA-GA and Bi-LSTM as per their applicability. Understanding these techniques’ prevalence patterns and trends may contribute to risk assessment and enable effective prevention and timely treatment strategies.

Index Terms: Public Health Emergency Of International Concern

articleTitle: Detecting, Demodulating & Decoding LoRa
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper examines the LoRaWAN low-power, wide-area network technology, analyzing its physical layer modulation and network architecture while identifying potential security vulnerabilities like jamming, replay attacks, eavesdropping, and device compromises. To address these issues, the paper develops deep learning models, utilizing spectrograms and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) such as ResNet, InceptionV3, EfficientNet, and custom architectures, for accurate LoRa signal detection and classification. Additionally, this paper presents a reverse-engineering process to uncover LoRa’s encoding and decoding algorithms, facilitating the creation of an open-source LoRa physical layer implementation (gr-lora) within the GNU Radio framework. This implementation will empower ongoing research into LoRaWAN security and the development of innovative IoT applications.

articleTitle: Designing Strategies for Power Optimization Utilizing Formal Methods in Embedded Computer Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, embedded laptop structures have emerged as an increasing number of complicated and strength-hungry, posing a vast assignment for designers. Dealing with power intake has end up a critical thing within the design of embedded systems, as it significantly influences battery existence and device performance. Formal techniques, a mathematically total technique to device design and verification, can resource designers in reaching strength optimization in embedded systems. This paper presents several strategies for using formal techniques in designing powergreen embedded structures. The first method entails modeling the machine at different ranges of abstraction and the usage of formal strategies inclusive of model checking and theorem proving. It Ulets in for early detection of electricity-related layout problems and allows designers to make knowledgeable decisions. The second strategy involves using formal energy analysis techniques to pick out and analyze power bottlenecks within the gadget. It may help optimize the machine by figuring out electricity-hungry components and optimizing their utilization. Every other approach is the use of formal synthesis, which entails routinely generating a poweroptimized implementation from an excessive-stage specification. It eliminates manual layout efforts and guarantees correctness by means of production. Additionally, formal strategies may be used for dynamic energy control, where runtime verification strategies can be applied to ensure that the system is operating within designated strength limits. Furthermore, formal techniques may be applied to the design of electricity.

articleTitle: Implementing Blockchain in Military Supply Chains: Evaluating Viability and Overcoming Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The scope of implementing Blockchain technology in military supply chains is exciting, Blockchain technology can transform the handling of procurement and logistics in military supply chains. Blockchain offers security, efficiency, accountability by offering an immutable and transparent ledger. This paper contributes to the present discussion about implementing this technology in supply chains and application of blockchain technology in the defense sector. This paper focuses on three areas, why blockchain is actually needed to secure supply chains? How will a blockchain based military supply chain network will work? What are the implementation challenges? and possible mitigation remedies for the same. This paper examines the challenges and offers insights to guide the successful integration of blockchain technology, ensuring effective utilization in enhancing military logistics and procurement processes. A country is as strong as its defense forces. This paper underlines that need, by proactively addressing the challenges to maximize the benefits of blockchain integration, ultimately strengthen the resilience and effectiveness of military supply chains.

articleTitle: Secrecy Analysis of CSI Ratio-Based Transmitter Selection with Unreliable Backhaul
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The secrecy performance of a system consisting of multiple transmitters with unreliable backhaul links is explored in this paper. To improve secrecy, we propose a novel transmitter selection (TS) scheme that selects a transmitter with the maximum ratio of the destination channel power gain to the eavesdropping channel power gain. The backhaul reliability factor is incorporated with the distribution of the channel power gain through the utilization of a mixture distribution. We evaluate the non-zero secrecy rate (NZR) and the secrecy outage probability (SOP) as well as their asymptotes in two cases of backhaul activity knowledge, where it is available and where it is unavailable. The results illustrate that because of the unreliable backhaul, the proposed destination-to-eavesdropper channel power gain ratio-based TS scheme is constrained in terms of secrecy performance. However, performance enhancements are observed when the backhaul knowledge activity is utilized. Furthermore, the proposed scheme outperforms all the sub-optimal TS schemes and achieves nearly optimal performance without requiring noise power or the evaluation of the exact secrecy rate measurement.

articleTitle: Suspicious Activity Monitoring System Using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital age, effective surveillance and anomaly detection systems are crucial. YOLOv5, a cutting-edge real-time object detection model that stands out for its remarkable speed and accuracy, making it ideal for these applications. This paper outlines the essential libraries and dependencies for the project, highlighting the importance of setting up the correct environment. It details the process of importing datasets in the YOLO format and provides insights on effective dataset preparation and curation. The exploratory data analysis (EDA) section covers visualizing sample images with bounding boxes, analyzing class distribution, and assessing image size and resolution for YOLOv5 compatibility. The core discusses applying the YOLOv5 algorithm, including model loading, training, and fine-tuning, along with evaluating model performance. Finally, practical applications of the trained model, such as real-time and batch inference, are explored, demonstrating its utility in detecting suspicious activities for security and surveillance. This paper serves as a comprehensive resource for implementing YOLOv5, ensuring the successful deployment of a robust object detection system.

articleTitle: Active Learning Framework for Anomaly Detection in Astronomical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: When properly analyzed, the large astronomical datasets likely yield anomalies, which is meant to be a new phenomenon in the dataset. However, the challenge lies in the scale of the datasets, making it complex for humans to find anomalies by themselves using traditional techniques. The most reliable method for detecting noteworthy irregularities is through anomaly detection algorithms. Even though machine learning proves to be a valuable tool in this context, it faces difficulty in finding out the exact anomalies which are needed to confidently conclude the nature of a point in the data; as such, many broad points in output may not be extremely necessary for getting into a direct conclusion. This is where active learning comes into play; active learning combines human techniques with machine learning’s algorithm, strategically selecting specific data for expert labelling to minimize the workload for maximum efficiency. Here, we present a novel anomaly detection framework called Anomaly detection. In astronomical data, which employs an active learning approach to give an output of probability of finding an anomaly. Furthermore, anomaly detection in astronomical data adaptability allows for integrating new feature extraction methods, anomaly detection algorithms, and alternative active learning techniques.

articleTitle: Interactome: A Platform for Comprehensive Drug-Drug Interaction Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Drug-drug interaction is an important aspect to be taken into consideration when administering multiple drugs to patients with severe diseases. It is important to know if the combination of the drugs causes a positive effect or an ill effect on the person’s body. Thus, Interactome roots to offer a comprehensive solution to assess and find out the interactions between commonly used drugs for the treatment of different ailments such as heart diseases or diabetes and provides an understanding of how the combination of these drugs can cause side effects if not provided with enough details about the drug. Thus, it enables the user to know alternatives to using efficient drugs without any side effects by displaying graphs of the percentage of positive and negative effects and charts depicting the effects. By providing negative and positive feedback on the combination of various drugs used for heart and diabetes patients and displaying the percentage risks with the help of graphs and charts, Interactome ensures the prevention of any unnecessary attacks. Also, it saves the lives of an individual by spreading awareness about drug-drug interactions. We incorporate a Trie data structure that efficiently analyzes the input medications against a database of known interactions. It optimizes the retrieval process by organizing the drugs into a hierarchical structure. Then it ensures rapid and accurate results so that healthcare professionals and individuals receive timely and comprehensive insights into potential drug interactions.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Investment Strategies: Algorithmic Approaches for Indian Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Discovering the correct investment strategies in today’s fast-paced financial markets is like unearthing hidden treasures, particularly in India, where the financial markets are captivating an increasing number of people every day. Our approach takes on this difficulty head-on by automating stock and option trading techniques using cutting-edge technology. We meticulously trained two Deep Q-Network (DQN) agents, tailored for the stock and options markets. For stocks, our crafted strategies—mean reversion and exponential mean average 8 by 55—raked in impressive returns of 14.08% and 14.68%, respectively. With reinforcement learning, these strategies saw an astounding boost, yielding a staggering 51.15% and 33.52% return within just three years. On the options front, our novel trading strategies achieved remarkable returns of 102.82% and 77.14%, showcasing the power of our approach in this domain. By demonstrating the potential of advanced algorithms in enhancing trading efficiency, our work not only highlights the profitability of automated strategies but also offers valuable insights for navigating the Indian financial landscape with greater confidence and success.

articleTitle: Temperature Dependent Investigation On Two RC Equivalent Circuit Battery Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The survey delf into the intricate dynamics of battery behavior nether change temperature conditions, use angstrom comprehensive examination 2RC equivalent circuit battery model. by analyze the relationship between temperature, state of charge (SOC), and voltage feature, the research shed light on the fundamental factor influence battery performance. This probe not lone light the impact of temperature on electrochemical chemical reaction inside the battery merely besides underscore the necessity for effective thermal management scheme to optimize performance and prolong battery life. furthermore, the survey research the deduction of temperature variation on battery thermal profile, identify potential hot spot and hazard that May compromise functionality and safety. The findings supply valuable penetration for engineer and research worker to develop advance thermal management system and compensation algorithm, thereby enhance the dependability and efficiency of battery system, particularly inch demand urban transportation system environment.

articleTitle: Strength of Ensemble Learning in Voting Classifier for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Crop Yield Prediction (CYP) plays a vital role in mitigating emerging food security challenges, particularly when the rapid shifts in global climate patterns occur. Machine Learning (ML) is crucial for CYP because it can estimate the crop production based on different characteristics such as environmental characteristics, soil fertilizers, and crop management. Researchers have used lots of ML techniques with distinct kinds of data analytics techniques. Thus, this study proposes an ensemble model, named Voting-based Ensemble Expert System for Crop Yield Prediction (VEESCYP) to predict the best crop yield for the Assam state of India. This study tries to present the strength of a voting classifier with Ensemble Learning (EL) approaches. The proposed VEESCYP model has performed some data preprocessing tasks before classification, such as the Multiple Imputation by Chained Equation (MICE) to treat the missing values, Isolation Forest (IF) for outlier detection, Genetic Algorithm (GA) for feature selection and Robust Scaling (RS) for data normalization. To show the strength of EL techniques in voting classifier, the proposed VEESCYP model compares with some standard ML algorithms, a Voting-based EL technique using standard ML algorithms and some existing models presented in the literature.

articleTitle: Secure Logistics Using Blockchain and Quantum Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the critical need for securing the vaccine supply chain to ensure its trustworthiness and reliability. This paper proposes a novel framework integrating blockchain technology (BCT) and quantum encryption to address the challenges of vaccine passport falsification, concerns over facility quality standards, and international recognition of vaccination documentation. Blockchain technology offers transparency and immutability, while quantum encryption provides enhanced security for storing sensitive user data such as passwords.Through qualitative content analysis of 126 cases across various industries, this study identifies the capabilities that blockchain-based supply chain systems empower and their performance outcomes. The analysis reveals a focus on capabilities related to operations, specific to information sharing and co-ordination, leading to outcomes such as quality compliance, process improvement, flexibility, cost reduction, and reduced process time.The integration of blockchain and quantum encryption in the proposed framework offers a multifaceted approach to addressing the challenges of vaccine supply chain security. Blockchain technology ensures transparency and immutability by creating an indelible record of transactions and events throughout the supply chain. This transparent ledger enhances trust among stakeholders, mitigating the risk of falsification and ensuring the integrity of vaccine passports and documentation.Furthermore, quantum encryption adds an additional layer of security by leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics to encrypt sensitive user data. Unlike traditional encryption methods, quantum encryption offers unconditional security, protecting user passwords and other confidential information from potential breaches and unauthorized access.The proposed framework combines blockchain technology and quantum encryption to enhance transparency, reliability, and trust in vaccine distribution. It addresses immediate challenges like those posed by COVID-19 while laying the groundwork for a resilient supply chain. The study contributes insights to supply chain management literature and offers a valuable tool for stakeholders. Yet, further empirical research is necessary to validate its effectiveness across industries and contexts, ensuring refinement and adaptability.

articleTitle: Advances and Challenges in Color and Multispectral Image Retrospective Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ever-developing subject of photograph processing and pc vision has made excellent strides inside the advancement of coloration and multispectral photo retrospective analysis. This generation allows for particularly designated and accurate evaluation of images accrued from various sources. Its miles a useful asset for various industries, together with clinical imaging, facial popularity, and remote sensing. Notwithstanding the several blessings and blessings of this generation, there are still numerous demanding situations related to it. these include difficulties of appropriately processing huge amounts of information in a well timed way, the high price of acquiring and implementing the essential hardware and software program, and they want for accuracy and reliability in identifying and extracting precise features from picas. Moreover, the undertaking of dealing with regulators and highbrow assets owners of the imagery must additionally be considered. Even though these challenges persist, the terrific strides in era have enabled greater accuracy and precision, making the challenge of retrospective photograph analysis greater green and price-powerful.

articleTitle: Low Duty Cycle Medium Access Control Protocol with Power Control for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this work, an asynchronous duty cycled Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol for wireless sensor networks has been proposed with the transmission power control. The proposed duty-cycled MAC has been implemented in the CC430-based sensor node hardware platform and the empirical energy consumption analysis of the proposed MAC has been done. Compared to the Low Duty Cycled MAC, the reduction in the reception time and the transmission power are the energy conservation factors in the proposed medium access control protocol. The energy consumption has been compared with LDC MAC implementation and it is shown that the proposed Low Duty Cycle MAC with Power Control (LDC-PC) gives more energy conservation for a single hop network.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Empowered Deep Network Enabled Optimal Controlled Environment For Crop Yield
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper focuses on developing a comprehensive system for optimised climate control in a simulated greenhouse setting with complex environment modelling, communication-enabled agents, and hyperparameter optimisation using multiagent reinforcement learning (MARL). The greenhouse environment model gives the agents a richer and more detailed state representation by extending pertinent climate variables, plant health indicators, and resource levels for each zone. In order to stimulate both individual zone performance and overall greenhouse goals, the incentive function has been changed. This involves goals like preserving a stable climate, optimising resource use, or achieving a balanced yield. Based on the communication-based MARL strategy used, information sharing between agents is made possible by the communication protocols included into multi-agent architecture. This enables the agents to work together and make decisions in unison. Neural network designs are used to build both value and policy networks, allowing the agents to understand intricate relationships and decide on the best course of action depending on the observed situation.

articleTitle: Dual Variational Generation Framework for Enhanced Cross-Modal Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the major challenges in face recognition is accurately identifying faces under varying lighting conditions, leading to a problem known as Heterogeneous Face Recognition (HFR). The objective is to integrate the capabilities of the modified Dual Variational Generator (DVG-Face) framework with traditional recognition methods, such as Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) and the HaarCascade framework, to provide a robust solution to the challenges of heterogeneous face recognition. This involves developing and implementing a model that successfully handles the complexity of HFR tasks utilizing synthetic images generated from Near-Infrared (NIR) and Visible (VIS) modalities. To guarantee identity consistency in the produced paired heterogeneous images, pairwise identity preserving loss is also used. The integration of Haar Cascades, the LBPH algorithm, and the DVG approach, along with person reidentification using the SSRL model, establishes a reliable framework for facial recognition in real-world security applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Wireless Networks and Their Coding Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wi-Fi networks are comprised of numerous gadgets that speak thru radio transmissions to transfer facts and establish connectivity. if you want to make certain efficient statistics transmission, those networks use diverse coding protocols that play a major function in making sure community integrity. This paper explores the basics of Wi-Fi networks, their additives, and the exclusive coding protocols and techniques that are employed to beautify records transmission. We first discuss diverse community sorts and their associated technologies. That is accompanied by means of a dialogue of various coding schemes consisting of forward error correction (FEC) and convolutional coding. We provide an overview of how these techniques can be used to reliably supply records and the way parameters together with code rate, coding benefit, and decidability are used for assessing the various coding protocols. We also offer an assessment between numerous coding protocols and draw conclusions from the analysis. Ultimately, we outline some of the challenges related to the implementation of coding protocols in Wi-Fi networks.

articleTitle: Shellcode Generation: A Resource Efficient Approach using Fine-tuned LLMs
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In order to create better shellcode for offensive cybersecurity, this study investigates the use of large language models (LLMs) such as Mistral and Llama. It focuses on LLM optimizations to improve shellcode accuracy and efficiency with the goal of quickly locating and taking advantage of software vulnerabilities. To optimize shellcode generation, several model parameters are tuned through controlled experiments, with the BLEU score serving as the primary criterion for impartial evaluation. This study achieved a BLEU-1 score of $\mathbf{0. 8 5 0 6,}$ highlighting the effectiveness of the optimization and finetuning strategies. The study explores the subtle aspects of LLMs that influence the creation of shellcode, such as their capacity for learning, their ability to adjust to the peculiarities of cybersecurity, and their ability to replicate complex patterns into effective shellcode. This project intends to expand knowledge of using LLMs for shellcode development by submitting significant experimentation and research, providing insights into more efficient vulnerability exploitation strategies in cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Driving Electric Car Purchase Intentions through AR/VR and Webrooming: Insights from the Tricity (Chandigarh - Mohali - Panchkula) Region in India
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The swift rise of immersive technologies such as Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) has transformed the retail customer experience. These applications enable consumers to virtually test products, envision items in their environments, and interact with brands in innovative ways. This technological shift is altering conventional consumer behaviours and decision-making processes, with webrooming - exploring products online prior to buying in physical stores - becoming increasingly widespread. However, empirical studies investigating the drivers and impacts of webrooming, particularly in AR/VR retail settings, are scarce. To address these limitations, this study aims to develop and evaluate an integrative model connecting AR/VR attributes to webrooming experiences and purchase intentions. Drawing on stimulus-organism-response theory, we propose a framework in which AR/VR attributes (interactivity, vividness, informationality) influence perceptions of convenience and accessibility, which subsequently affect webrooming experiences and purchase intentions. To test our model, we surveyed 374 consumers who recently used AR/VR applications while shopping. We analysed the data using partial least squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM). The results strongly support our framework, revealing significant direct and indirect effects of AR/VR attributes on webrooming experiences and purchase intentions, with information accessibility and convenience perceptions playing a crucial role in fostering positive webrooming experiences. This research contributes to the literature by offering new insights into AR/VR impacts on modern shopping behaviours like webrooming. For practitioners, the results highlight the importance of strategically leveraging AR/VR to facilitate webrooming journeys and drive purchase decisions.

articleTitle: A Review of Disease Detection in Sugarcane Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agriculture has been an active source of food and economic growth, but it faces significant challenges from diseases and climate change. In Indonesia, sugarcane production is severely impacted by viral infections such as Sugarcane mosaic virus (SCMV) and Sugarcane streak mosaic virus (SCSMV). These infectious diseases pose a threat to the world’s sugarcane industry, resulting in significant crop losses in nations like Brazil and India, along with other viruses like the Fiji Disease Virus (FDV), and Sugarcane Yellow Leaf Virus (SCYLV). For such diseases to be managed and performance to be maintained, early detection is essential. Disease detection is accomplished by both conventional and cutting-edge approaches, such as molecular, serological, and imaging methods. However, the advancements in Machine learning, Deep learning and computational image processing algorithms have demonstrated significant potential in the early and precise diagnosis of disease. In this study, different methods used for machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) for plant disease diagnosis were reviewed and it highlights the need of high-quality datasets, various pre-processing techniques, robust extraction of features, and efficient classification techniques. It also discussed the issues with data collection, symptom variability, over-fitting, and imbalances in classes, along with potential avenues for further advancement in diagnosing diseases systems.

articleTitle: Utilizing Recurrent Neural Networks for Predictive Student Performance Analysis in Online Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of online education, the demand for effective tools to assess and predict student performance has grown substantially. This study explores the application of Recurrent Neural Networks RNNs with Long Short term Memory (LSTM) units for predictive student performance analysis in online courses. The LSTM architecture, known for its ability to capture long-range dependencies in sequential data, is leveraged to model the dynamic nature of students’ interactions within the digital learning environment. The proposed RNN-LSTM model is tailored to discern intricate patterns in students’ learning behaviours over time. The LSTM units enable the model to effectively learn and remember information over extended periods, enhancing its capability to make accurate predictions about future academic outcomes. The study rigorously assesses the performance of the RNN-LSTM model through experimentation and validation, comparing its effectiveness against traditional predictive methods. Results highlight the superior predictive accuracy of the proposed model. The Adam optimized RNN-LSTM model shows better accuracy with $97 \%$ which is $14 \%$ higher when compared with Naïve Bayes and Random Forest. The findings of this research not only underscore the potential of RNN-LSTM architectures in educational data analytics but also provide practical implications for, administrators, and instructional designers aiming to optimize online learning experiences.

articleTitle: Hybrid Voting System Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Voting is a vital pillar of democracy, upholding the principles of representation and public expression. Over time, the quest for secure and efficient systems has driven the transition from paper ballots to Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs). Nonetheless, persistent concerns surrounding EVM security have spurred the exploration of blockchain-based voting systems. The inherent attributes of transparency and immutability offered by blockchain technology hold promise in augmenting the security and integrity of the voting process. However, blockchain-based voting systems encounter their own distinct challenges. This paper presents a pioneering hybrid voting system model that harmonizes the merits of existing systems with the potential of blockchain technology. In this hybrid model, the authentication of voters is collaboratively facilitated by government employees and blockchain technology. Subsequently, voters can securely register their votes within the blockchain. Striving to strike a delicate equilibrium between convenience and security, this model aims to engender a resilient and all-encompassing voting system that inspires trust. A comprehensive assessment of the strengths and limitations inherent in traditional voting systems is undertaken, while simultaneously exploring the vast potential of blockchain technology.
