By effectively addressing the concerns pertaining to security and integrity, the proposed hybrid model aspires to forge a path toward a voting system that is both resilient and unequivocally trusted.

articleTitle: Real Time Dress Code Surveillance of College Students Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dress code verification is a technology that uses image recognition and analysis algorithms to enforce dress codes. The technology offers a solution to the problems faced by manual dress code enforcement methods, such as subjectivity, inaccuracies, and inefficiencies. With automatic dress code verification, images are processed and evaluated against predefined dress codes to ensure compliance. CNN for face recognition and YOLO for object detection is used. This technology can be used in a variety of settings, including schools, offices, and events. The benefits of automatic dress code verification include increased accuracy and objectivity, streamlining of the dress code enforcement process, and improved security and accountability. As the technology continues to advance, it has the potential to impact the wider field of image recognition and analysis. Dress code verification is a process of ensuring that employees or attendees adhere to a specific set of clothing standards set by an organization or event such as id and shoe.

articleTitle: Outage Analysis of Multiple IRS-aided Cooperative NOMA System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The traditional cooperative non-orthogonal multiple access (CNOMA) technique improves the outage and data rate performance for cell-edge users, albeit at the expense of near users. Due to the ability to control the propagation environment, introducing intelligent reflective surfaces (IRS) into a multi-user network can reduce costs, signal processing complexity, and energy consumption. In this work, a comprehensive downlink framework for a blind-IRS-supported CNOMA system is established to enhance outage performance for both cell-edge and near users. The closed-form analytical expressions for the outage probability of the near and cell-edge users within this proposed system are derived. Furthermore, these analytical expressions are validated through Monte-Carlo simulations. The cell-edge user of our proposed model outperforms traditional NOMA and IRS-assisted NOMA variants. To achieve a target outage probability of $10^{-3}$, our proposed system requires $\sim 4$ dB lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) compared to other IRS-assisted NOMA variants.

articleTitle: Liability and Responsibility for AI Systems in Computer Engineering and Law
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: artificial Intelligence (AI) structures are growing in complicated pc engineering systems, elevating critical questions about who’s in price and liable for their actions. this example at the intersection of laptop engineering and law has received great hobby because of the capability risks and ethical worries associated with AI generation. criminal duty refers to the crook duty of a person or agency to pay for damages or losses because of their moves. In AI systems, figuring out prison responsibilities can be difficult as those systems regularly make alternatives without human intervention. sometimes, it can be hard to understand the correct cause of an AI device’s malfunction or errors, making it tough to decide who needs to be held responsible. responsibility, however, includes human beings’ and corporations’ moral and ethical duties to ensure their actions now not reason damage. within the context of AI systems, obligation extends beyond the initial creators and operators of the generation to embody folks that modify, use, and are impacted by it.

articleTitle: Optimizing Shielding Techniques for High-Frequency EMC Applications in Aerospace Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The defense of high-frequency electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for aerospace systems is important to ensure the functionality and reliability of aerospace cars. Moreover, the performance of the system has to follow each plane’s requirements and electromagnetic regulations, such as Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations, to hold protection and trustworthiness. While protecting excessive-frequency EMC application is only sometimes taken into consideration, the electrical gadgets, wiring, and numerous components may be electrically laid low with electrical fields, resulting in malfunction of the machine, mistakes in calculations, and faulty indicators. This paper evaluates the optimization of protective techniques for high-frequency EMC packages in aerospace systems through the usage of a mixture of simulation and size strategies. The objectives of the look are to expand an efficient shielding structure and optimize the design to reduce the reflection of electromagnetic wave radiation in the system. A two-layered shielding method with an internal shield of aluminum foil is used to reduce the reflection of electromagnetic wave radiation. Furthermore, the field studies and the simulations executed permit the optimization of the measurements to be greater than it should be predicted. The obtained results imply that the optimized defensive approach makes a good sized enhancement in the defensive overall performance of the device, thereby disposing of errors due to outside EMC resources.

articleTitle: Designing Distributed Deep Learning Architectures for 5G Network Slicing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The intention present day this paper is to advise a dispensed deep ultra-modern (DL) architecture for 5G network slicing. The proposed allotted DL structure utilizes distributed nodes to learn about the network slices. The dispensed nodes and the community slices are interconnected via an orchestrator, for this reason, supplying a comprehensive view present day the environment. Furthermore, the distributed DL structure leverages switch mastering to enhance its overall performance in dispensed situations. In addition, it is also an aspect computing node to research visitors’ styles present day the 5G slices. Eventually, the proposed allotted DL architecture has been aligned with the 5G architecture, and the disbursed nodes are related through a 5G cellular community. The experimental consequences demonstrate that the proposed allotted DL architecture provides performance for network cutting while lowering the strength consumption and improving community security.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Big Data Algorithms in Cloud Computing on Cost of Care in the Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cutting-edge healthcare structures generate and technique a large sort of statistics from a couple of assets. The effective analysis and usage of this facts is vital for decision makers in healthcare, in particular when it comes to optimizing cost of care. current advancements in large statistics algorithms and cloud computing technologies have unfolded the opportunity of leveraging big amounts of healthcare statistics to expand answers which can assist lessen cost of care. This studies appears on the ability of big records algorithms and cloud computing to reduce price of care in the healthcare machine. It focuses on inspecting the impact of integrating algorithmic strategies with cloud computing solutions, with an emphasis on value financial savings and improved performance. An assessment of the prevailing frameworks and tactics is conducted and evaluated metrics are set up to evaluate the effectiveness of the tasks followed. The studies also identifies numerous demanding situations related to the implementation of such techniques and suggests feasible answers to overcome those challenges.

articleTitle: Millibots: Integrating Deep Learning Algorithms for Autonomous Control in Small-Scale Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Millibots, miniature robotic platforms, have emerged as pivotal tools in various domains, ranging from medical interventions to environmental monitoring. However, their diminutive size presents formidable challenges in achieving autonomous navigation and control. In this paper, we delve into the realm of millibots and propose a groundbreaking approach to tackle these challenges by integrating deep learning algorithms for autonomous control. Leveraging the power of deep learning, we address the intricate interplay between perception, decision-making, and locomotion in small-scale robotics. Our methodology not only overcomes the limitations inherent to millibots but also unlocks new frontiers in their application. Through a comprehensive review of related work, meticulous experimentation, and insightful analysis, we demonstrate the unparalleled efficacy of our approach. This paper not only accelerates the advancement of small-scale robotics but also envisions a new era of autonomous exploration and innovation.

articleTitle: Optimizing Vehicle Insurance Processing through Advanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method for predicting insurance claims by utilizing artificial intelligence, specifically a deep learning model within the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework. The purpose is to automate and simplify the insurance claims process. The model utilizes computer vision technology to precisely detect and identify car damage, resulting in a substantial reduction in the processing time for insurance claims. The article describes the creation of a specialized dataset consisting of actual photographs of vehicles that have been wrecked. It also assesses multiple deep learning models, ultimately finding that InceptionV3 is the most successful, achieving an accuracy rate of 97%. The suggested AI system seeks to improve the efficiency of claims processing and decrease the need for human evaluation. This would provide a more dependable and efficient method for handling automobile insurance claims after accidents.

articleTitle: Secure Cloud Computing: Mitigating Network Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As businesses increasingly depend on these cloud-based services, secure cloud computing is vital. There is no free way with the cloud network, and our information is susceptible to vulnerability. Mitigation strategies to address these network vulnerabilities in cloud computing and analysis of the man-in-the-middle attack and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack are discussed in this paper. For instance: enhance network architecture, encryption, and security mechanisms like intrusion detection systems and firewalls. With these steps, organizations can further increase their cloud network security and protect data with zero breaches.

articleTitle: The Role of Feature Based Classification Models in Early Detection of Brain Stroke
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The importance to identify brain strokes early in order to provide timely management and better patient outcomes is imperative. The paper investigates feature-based methods of classification to enhance the early detection of brain stroke. The study provides a foundation for evaluating the effectiveness of various models through an analysis of different forms of brain strokes, their underlying causes, and the existing diagnostic methods, with a particular focus on their potential for early detection of strokes. Various feature-based models employed in the early diagnosis of strokes are explored, analyzing their effectiveness and assessing their strengths and weaknesses. In this paper, we analyze the existing literature to identify the present scenario and potential areas for future research. The findings of the review highlight the significance of addressing present constraints in early detection of brain stroke and utilizing emerging trends and technology. It is observed that the application of feature-based classification models for early stroke detection has potential influence on clinical practice and is the key to better patient outcomes. This review provides useful insights for researchers and clinicians, expanding their understanding of the function of these models in early brain stroke identification.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of CNN-RF Models in Gym Chest Exercise Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the introduction of the demand for personalized fitness plans and the requisite accuracy for recording actions in training sessions, there is a growing need to implement thorough machine learning models. This research builds a hybrid system of the two pattern recognition algorithms, namely CNN-Random Forest (CNN-RF), to classify gym chest training motions. The model was trained and validated on complete images, which were 1,970. The dataset had individuals drawing attention to all types of training-related workout activities, such as push-ups and bench presses. The CNN-RF model used CNNs’ superior spatial feature extraction and R.F.’s powerful classification ability, allowing the model to identify and classify the plant species. Among the many features considered when evaluating a model, accuracy proved to be its most vital point, amounting to 94.32746%. Data analysis showed that the precision parameters of the surveillance system dropped from 93.73% to 98%, with a maximum accuracy of 98% achieved in Class 5 and the cable crossing area simultaneously. The recall metric demonstrated a low divergence, meaning the model needed some modification. It was revealed via an analysis of the confusion matrix that the model presented a percentage of accuracy quite at a very high level on the probable outcomes. On the contrary, sometimes the model is away from precise species classification, including Classes 3 and 4. The model’s stable performance with classes and instances is shown by macro and weighted average accuracy of 94% over 92% in each category. This indicates that the hybrid approach effectively manages the class imbalance problem.

articleTitle: Leveraging Big Data Analysis in Real-Time Automation for Improved Operational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This idea has redefined the practices of an organization and revolutionized business decision-making by harnessing extensive data analysis. With industries becoming increasingly complex and data-dependent, the demand for real-time automation has taken an immense upsurge to enhance operational efficiency. Real-time automation uses massive big data analysis to ensure that the continuous monitoring and analyzing of your crucial data takes place in real time, allowing you to make timely decisions based on facts. It is a type of automation that helps an organization recognize and act on issues or opportunities as soon as they occur in real time, shortening downtime due to potential problems while increasing productivity. Automating data collection, processing, and analysis lets organizations better understand their operations and spot trends, patterns, or even outliers that might not be visible, given how cumbersome the manual processes are. In practice, real-time automation simplifies the process to enhance operational efficiency with cost savings and time efficiencies through automated processes that eliminate manual tasks. It also makes organizations adjust quickly to changes in markets or customer requirements, thus making them agile and more competitive. Utilizing real-time automation with the help of extensive data analysis can boost companies’ competitive advantage by increasing their operational efficiency and decision-making capabilities.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Medical Image Compression and Sharing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The effective transmission and sampling of clinical images are important research areas in computer science, particularly in the healthcare industry. Methods such as personal area networking and body area networking are valuable for medical monitoring systems used in remote surgical guidance and early emergency detection. However, due to the sensitive nature of medical images, strong privacy protection and secure data aggregation/compression techniques are needed. In this study, we use compressive sensing theory to address these challenges with a novel approach. Our technique reduces the size of medical photos by $10 \%$, while maintaining strong secrecy through the use of additive homomorphic encryption.

articleTitle: Video Summarization through Latent Representation: A VAE and KMeans Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Video summarization plays a crucial role in various domains such as surveillance, news, search engines, and social media. It entails condensing lengthy videos into concise summaries by selecting a subset of frames that encapsulate the most pertinent information. This study introduces a novel approach to extract key frames from video data employing a combination of a Variational Auto encoder (VAE) and K-Means clustering. Initially, a VAE model is trained on the video frames, with the encoder segment used to derive the latent representations of these frames. Subsequently, a random search procedure (random search cv) is utilized to estimate the optimal number of clusters. K-Means clustering is now applied to these representations, with the frame closest to each cluster centroid selected as a keyframe. Experimental outcomes show that the suggested method increases the F-score of keyframe based summarization more than the existing methods. The proposed approach efficiently extracts keyframes from video data, with potential applications in video summarization and indexing

articleTitle: Detection of Irregular Shapes Resembling Non-Uniform Gaps for UAV Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper presents a novel approach for the detection and segmentation of non-uniform gaps to facilitate safe autonomous navigation of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) using the YOLOv8 deep learning model. The methodology comprises three key stages: data collection, annotation, and model training using the YOLOv8 architecture. Initially, the model is trained on regular shapes images such as lines, triangles, quadrilateral and hexagons which also resembles the many real-world scenarios to establish a foundational understanding before transitioning to non-uniform gaps. We solved the problem of data scarcity through synthetic to natural data training process. Non-uniform gaps, simulated to real-world, data is meticulously annotated to train the YOLOv8 model, ensuring robustness across diverse scenarios. A post-processing step is introduced to find the centroid of the segmentation mask of detected gaps, providing actionable guidance for UAV maneuvering with proper clearance. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in accurately detecting and segmenting non-uniform gaps, showcasing its potential for real-world deployment in various applications. This research contributes to advancing UAVs navigation by providing a reliable solution for safe passage through complex environments.

articleTitle: Designing Secure Cloud Computing Environments: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Designing relaxed cloud computing environments presents many demanding situations, updating the complexity of the infrastructure, the couple of jurisdictions in which companies are living, the form of protection models that exist for diverse necessities, and the ever-changing security threats. This paper gives an outline of the demanding situations of designing relaxed cloud computing environments and discusses the ability to deal with them. It describes the exclusive layers of safety and the emerging safety models, the security as a provider version, that need to be followed for cozy cloud computing. The paper additionally critiques the safety rules that are adopted to ensure the security of cloud computing and the security risks that could be superior technologies. Moreover, the paper examines the challenges of enforcement, procurement, implementation, and collaboration even as developing comfy cloud computing environments and discusses the answers to address them. Eventually, the paper concludes with the aid of highlighting the want updated expand complete cloud security architecture and updated up to date effect strong enforcement strategies up-to-date successfully relaxed cloud computing ecosystems.

articleTitle: Integrating Multimodal Recognition for Smart Load Management and Spoof Detection in Residential Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing pervasiveness of smart technology necessitates robust security measures to protect interconnected systems within smart societies. This paper introduces a novel, two-pronged more accurate approach to user authentication that enhances security in these environments compared to the existing technologies. It leverages the combined strengths of facial recognition and speaker recognition, addressing limitations present in each individual method. The dual approach of facial and speaker recognition strengthens user authentication, making unauthorized access considerably more difficult. This research offers significant contributions like Liveness Detection: Mitigates the risk of spoofing attempts through facial recognition, and Adaptability: The speaker recognition system’s ability to retrain with new speakers ensures continued effectiveness with multilingual support and Real-time Functionality: Both systems operate in real-time, facilitating seamless user authentication without any external hardware installation. In the domain of facial recognition, this study focuses on the intricacies of real-time biometric recognition. It employs Euclidean Distance Calculation, complemented by an innovative function to search for and map facial identities to their respective embeddings. This also delves into the critical concepts of Haar-like features and cascade classifiers, essential for efficient face detection. Integral graphs streamline feature computations, enhancing speed and accuracy. The project encompasses frame processing, face detection, feature extraction, embedding generation, and liveness prediction, culminating in the recognition of familiar faces. Post-recognition actions meticulously maintain personal records and promptly raise alerts during potential spoof attempts. The speaker recognition segment of this research extracts and preprocesses audio features from audio and proceeds to train and evaluate a speaker recognition model. With the capability to retrain with data from additional speakers, this system offers adaptability and robust performance.

articleTitle: Visual Sentiment-based on FER for Improving Feedback Analysis using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image sentiment analysis has recently become more popular than text sentiment analysis for making various judgments nowadays. Despite this, sentiment analysis based on images only provides sentiment polarities for input that might not accurately represent the user’s emotional state. The development of end-to-end image sentiment analysis methodologies has made extensive use of Transfer Learning(TL) techniques in recent times, and this trend is supposed to continue. Deep learning(DL) algorithms’ autonomous feature-learning capabilities have led to outstanding results in a variety of applications. Despite the challenges of image-based sentiment analysis, there is still significant potential for advancement. This research aims to improve feedback mechanisms using Facial Emotion Recognition(FER), by integrating emotional context with sentiment polarities,utilizing the well-known Deep Convolutional Neural Network(DCNN) VGG19, with its other deep features which enables the network to capture small fine details. By finetuning the VGG-19 architecture, Sentiment-Emotion detection and classification can be efficiently performed using the FER2013 dataset. The accuracy of the proposed method can reach up to $83.23 \%$, as demonstrated by a comparison of its results with various recent studies, This method makes it possible to analyze a person’s visual sentiments based on feelings and emotional patterns, which provides insightful information about the preferences, behaviors, and satisfaction levels of customers.

articleTitle: Multimodal Hate Speech Detection With Explanability Using LIME
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social media platforms link users from all over the world and enable opinion exchange on subjects including politics, finances and social issues. Policies governing objectionable material such as hate speech, that could potentially cause users psychological harm are difficult to reliably implement. Social media platform creators typically rely on human moderators to look into and assess potentially harmful content. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based decision support methods have attracted a lot of attention recently in regard to the identification of hate speech. For instance, AI-based models can be used to identify a variety of undesirable speech communication concepts, such as racism, hate speech and inflammatory language. This paper aims to develop an Explainable AI model for the automatic detection of hate speech in online content, providing transparency and interpretability in the decision-making process. Our initiative addresses the critical issue of hate speech in social media platforms through a multi-modal approach, encompassing both text and image analysis. Building a robust machine learning model that can precisely identify hate speech in diverse content types is one of our key objectives. To foster openness and trust, we employ sophisticated explainability approaches that provide a comprehensive explanation of the reasoning underlying the model’s predictions for both text and image inputs. This ensures that users have a clear understanding of how the model makes decisions, enhancing transparency in our detection system. By making the internet a safer and friendlier environment for everyone, our multi-modal approach enhances the overall effectiveness of combating hate speech across different content formats.

articleTitle: Enhanced Solar Radiation Prediction with Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Analysis of Meteorological Data Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Solar radiation is a crucial source of energy from the sun, with time-varying data that impacts various sectors. The variability of solar generation poses challenges for integration and reliability of solar panels, necessitating accurate forecasting to enhance performance. Machine learning techniques, particularly Random Forest models, are commonly used for solar radiation forecasting. However, there is a need to analyze the characteristics of solar radiation to identify relevant features that have a meaningful correlation between the inputs and outputs of machine learning algorithms. To evaluate the model, we used a comprehensive dataset containing over 149,015 instances of meteorological data. The study highlighted the significance of feature engineering in solar radiation forecasting. The system can forecast radiation values for any day using different meteorological data from the previous data. We compared the model’s performance to other models such as Decision Tree, Linear Regression, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting. An elaborate evaluation of all the models was done to produce a comparison using widely used performance metrics. The results showed that the RF model performed better than the other models in terms of the lowest prediction errors across MSE, RMSE, and MAE, as well as the highest R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value and the lowest MAPE, indicating a good performance in solar radiation prediction. Overall, the RF machine-learning model is an effective method for forecasting radiation in Bangladesh. They can attain high accuracy and provide significant information for the assessment of solar energy resources.

articleTitle: Dynamic Face Interaction: Simulating 3D Spatial Relationships with Mesa and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The dynamic face interaction model simulates real-time spatial connections by calculating distances between recognized faces and a camera by merging Mesa and OpenCV. It leverages OpenCV’s Haar cascades to offer dynamic face interactions depending on proximity in 3D space through the use of FaceAgent and FaceDistanceModel classes. It is useful for social dynamics, surveillance, and human-computer interaction. It employs LBPH facial recognition and Haar cascades to precisely modify agent placements. The purpose-built dataset addresses difficulties in comprehending social dynamics and strengthens the originality of research while promoting ethical research practices. This creative method highlights the transformational potential of combining simulation and AI technologies, and it encourages researchers to carefully examine the dataset in quest of significant breakthroughs while being aware of biases.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multi-Class Text Classification Models for Imbalanced News Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the age of abundant digital journalism, the categorization of news articles has become increasingly crucial for efficient information retrieval and analysis. This article examines different machine learning and deep learning methods used in classifying news articles, with a specific focus on overcoming challenges presented by imbalanced datasets. Conventional techniques like Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Decision Trees provide interpretability but face difficulties in achieving precision, especially in imbalanced scenarios. Advanced models such as Multi-Class CNN-LSTM, MLP, and RNN exhibit superior performance by effectively capturing both local and global features in news articles. Assessments across various categories showcase the flexibility and reliability of these models, with MLP consistently surpassing others. The research underscores the significance of choosing tailored models and highlights notable progress in news categorization accuracy through advanced methodologies. Ongoing exploration in deep learning and ensemble strategies shows potential for further improvements in tackling the evolving challenges of news categorization within the expansive realm of digital journalism and big data.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning in Real-Time Automation for Predictive Maintenance in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The transformation of modern industries by innovative technologies drives the need for Industry 4.0, where a connected machinery system designed to create smart factories will be established. Due to this shift, demand for realtime automation and predictive maintenance is increasing to maintain operations efficiently without any breakdown. Predictive maintenance through sensors’ real-time data analysis and historical records for correct failure detection has shown promising results with machine learning. this grip answers the query, including machine learning in realtime automation (Industry 4.0) and predictive maintenance to understand various relevant terminologies. Sensor data is constantly monitored, and intelligent algorithms based on machine learning can even predict where machines could fail before one has to report downtimes. In addition to extending the machinery’s life, this decreases downtime and maintenance costs. As we know, machine learning is used in real-time automation, giving us dynamic control of production processes, making it more profitable and less wasteful. Machine learning can deliver value across the supply chain and enhance factory operations by improving past data served to a machine or production line. The introduction of machine learning into Industry 4.0 allows companies to take a step toward preventative maintenance for their operations, which reduces costs and increases productivity countless times over. One of the benefits of machine learning for Industry 4.0 is real-time readiness, making it a great tool to help us make our factories truly smart and optimize them continuously with proper IT maintenance from specialists such as Noble1 Technologies.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Leach and Pegasis Routing Protocols in a Wireless Sensor Networks for Smart Water Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the aquaculture industry, maintaining optimal water quality is imperative for the health and productivity of aquatic species such as prawns and pearl spot fish. Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have emerged as a promising technology for real-time water quality monitoring in aquaculture settings due to their cost-effectiveness, scalability, and ability to provide continuous data collection. In this paper we present a comprehensive comparison between two prominent routing protocols, Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) and Power-Efficient GAthering in Sensor Information Systems (PEGASIS) for water quality monitoring. The primary focus is on evaluating their performance in terms of energy efficiency and network lifetime. The performance analysis is conducted through simulations using the MATLAB, considering parameters relevant to the aquaculture environment such as energy efficiency, data aggregation and network lifetime. Our findings reveal the distinct advantages and limitations of both LEACH and PEGASIS in the context of smart aquaculture. LEACH demonstrates superior energy efficiency and scalability through its clustering mechanism, making it suitable for large-scale deployments.

articleTitle: Facial Feature Extraction Review for Contemporary applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recognizing a face is an intricate cognitive process that showcases the remarkable capabilities of the human brain in visual perception, a phenomenon deeply rooted in evolutionary biology. In an attempt to emulate this complex phenomenon, computer vision technology has been developed to serve as a sophisticated tool capable of recognizing and distinguishing faces, akin to the human visual system, particularly in the domain of biometric identification methods employed for verifying individuals’ identities. This is done by identifying the unique features of a human’s face through various algorithms. This paper reviews the efficacy of popular approaches to portraying facial features in face pictures. Geometrical-based methods, template-based methods, and appearance-based methods were traditional ways for extracting facial features before the onset of Machine learning for this application. Accuracy through confusion matrix have been comprehended and traditional methods have been found more fit for static and atomic systems although, machine learning algorithms give better and consistent results at the cost of developing and maintaining the computational system underneath.

articleTitle: Understanding the Strengths and Limitations of AI for Data Access Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerge as an increasing number of famous in recent years due to its potential to learn from facts, make predictions, and automate decision-making techniques. Within the realm of facts get right of entry to optimization, AI algorithms are getting used to enhance the overall performance and performance of information storage, retrieval, and analysis. but, like every other generation, AI has its personal strengths and boundaries that need to be understood on the way to effectively utilize it for information get entry to optimization.one of the key strengths of AI is its capability to technique and examine massive amounts of facts speedy and as it should be. This is important in records get entry to optimization, wherein the speed and accuracy of records retrieval and evaluation is critical for choice-making. By the use of AI, companies can save time and sources that would in any other case be spent on manual records processing and evaluation. Additionally, AI has the potential to identify hidden patterns and correlations in facts that may not be obvious to humans. This may lead to extra efficient and powerful information get entry to strategies, as AI can find insights and traits which can were omitted through human analysts. This is particularly useful in complicated facts environments with high volumes of statistics.

articleTitle: Kidney Stone Detection using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Healthcare sector is a broad field offering diverse facilities which includes diagnosis of medical issues, offering advanced treatments and surgeries to ensure the wellness of a patient. Due to the ever increasing health issues, there are lot of new challenges encountered by the medical sector. To overcome this challenges, deep learning techniques have become an integral part of the medical field aiding in medical image analysis offering valuable insights for diagnosis of diseases. Kidney Stone detection involves deep learning models to analyse the Computed tomography scans of patients to accurately identify the of kidney stones. The models are trained using various pre-processed cross-sectional CT scans of each patient, allowing the model to comprehensively analyze and learn from diverse imaging data for enhanced diagnostic accuracy and effectiveness in detecting and classifying into kidney stones, cysts, tumors and normal conditions along with the identification of kidney stone sizes.

articleTitle: Microgrid Recent Innovations & Uses
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Concerns about global warming brought on by increasing carbon dioxide levels in the environment have sped up technological development in the sustainable energy sector over the past few years. The advancement in science while the shift to less polluting materials sources possesses increased the appeal for DG, subsequent generations distributed generation, using renewable supplies. Nevertheless, it has become widely recognized that increasing DG entry can negatively affect the matrix’s layout and operations. A suggestion made to reduce the effect about DG while improve the suitability of traditional grids over massive DG installation involves the Located concept. encompassing a variety of electrical devices’, the elements and Micro-grids and related power gadgets fields are now very well-liked research areas. This essay examines the history and theory behind microgrids, as well as the present situation regarding the writing, active research initiatives, and pertinent requirements. It additionally provides a more thorough analysis of the numerous Located pilot initiatives which have been implemented surrounding the globe and addresses possible directions for future study.

articleTitle: Advanced Low-Power SRAM Design Techniques at 16nm Node: Combining Multi-Threshold Voltage, MOSFET Stacking, and Body Biasing
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low power SRAM is indispensable for a multitude of applications, spanning embedded systems, systems-on-chip (SoC), and wireless electronic devices. This paper unveils an advanced 10T SRAM cell optimized with 16nm CMOS technology, meticulously designed to curtail both static and dynamic power consumption. Employing sophisticated techniques such as body biasing, multiple threshold voltages, and MOSFET stacking, this design also incorporates a control signal and a VDD supply of 0.8 volts to maximize power efficiency. The resultant SRAM cell showcases remarkable power savings, rendering it exceptionally suitable for power-sensitive applications. Comprehensive simulations conducted via Cadence tools highlight that this optimized 10T SRAM cell significantly surpasses conventional SRAM designs in power efficiency and performance.

articleTitle: Body Area Network(BAN) in Telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper focuses on remotely real-time monitoring of elderly patients who voluntarily opt for home care. The model is designed to adhere to the three essential principles of technology, namely Affordability, Secure Accessibility, and Availability. Once tailored for the routine health surveillance of geriatric patients, the product will ensure the automated administration of primary medication in the event of an emergency. Alert signals will prompt a call to the hospital for ambulance service and notification to patient party if deemed necessary.The model functions by collecting health parameters, analyzing them against predetermined threshold values, and proposing pills as an initial response for individuals experiencing health issues. Additionally, for ailing elderly patients within the safety of their home environment, the model facilitates the automated dispensing of liquid medication(intravenous (IV) injection is planned. Regular updates on the health parameters of affected individuals will be communicated to guardians and healthcare providers, with alerts generated for remote care in urgent situations. This comprehensive approach aims to enhance the overall well-being of elderly patients, promoting a secure and monitored home care environment.

articleTitle: Multifaceted Cyberbullying Detection using Deep Learning Architectures and Semantic Embeddings in Social Media Discourse
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet is growing into an effective communication tool. But the way the medium is used for targeted communication negatively often referred to as cyberbullying is a matter of concern. To build a model that would be able to identify such text orientations automatically, and block or impose a fine on the user would be great to make the internet a more cordial environment. This study focuses on designing a model for classifying tweets into one of the cyberbullying types and is designed as a six-class classification problem, the classes being: religion, age, ethnicity, gender, noncyberbullying, and others. Before building the model, multiple pre-processing steps are done and then the models are trained. Five different kinds of word embeddings were experimented with, along with five different neural network models. The embeddings used are Keras embedding layer, Glove, W2V, Fast text, and BERT. The neural network models used are BERT, CNN, LSTM, and Bi-LSTM. Multiple combinations of embeddings and neural network models are experimented and the results are discussed. Among the various models scrutinized, the hyperparameter finetuned BERT model distinguishes itself by delivering an outstanding performance, with an accuracy rate of $95 \%$. This breakthrough suggests that the hyperparameter finetuned BERT model could be instrumental in applications designed to combat the prevalence of cyberbullying and potentially prevent the adverse effects associated with such harmful conduct. *CRITICAL: Do Not Use Symbols, Special Characters, Footnotes, or Math in Paper Title or. articleTitle: Performance Analysis of ML Algorithms for Disease Prediction Using Water Quality Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article delves into the utilization of machine learning algorithms to advance water quality prediction and disease prediction within aquaculture. Through the integration of technology-driven solutions, such as cutting-edge monitoring systems and predictive analytics, our objective is to optimize efficiency, productivity, and environmental stewardship in fish farming practices. In our comparative analysis of various machine learning models based on accuracy scores, Random Forest emerges as the standout performer, boasting an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 3 5 \%}$. This exceptional performance is attributed to Random Forest’s ensemble nature, resilience to over fitting, and adept handling of complex data structures. While alternative classifiers like Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machines demonstrate satisfactory performance, the superior accuracy of Random Forest underscores its potential to revolutionize aquaculture practices. By harnessing advanced technologies like machine learning algorithms, we aim to propel sustainable aquaculture production while ensuring economic viability and environmental conservation.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection for Log using AutoM and Auto-Sklearn Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the realm of application development, logs represent a pivotal resource for the identification and comprehension of application performance, as well as the detection of anomalies, all of which are essential for ensuring the overall efficiency of an application. The proliferation of users has resulted in a substantial increase in the volume of logs available for analysis in the field of log analysis research. Typically, these logs exhibit an unstructured format, largely dictated by the developer’s design choices. Consequently, there is a need for log parsing techniques to in still structure into these logs, enabling the application of machine learning algorithms for the prediction of anomalies. In the present research, the primary objective is the prediction of anomalies within Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) logs utilizing an AutoML (Automated Machine Learning) tool known as Auto-Sklearn. The research outcomes illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model, which attains an impressive accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$ when applied to the dataset. This study underscores the critical role of logs in application development, highlights the importance of log structure transformation, and demonstrates the substantial predictive capabilities of the Auto-Sklearn model in the context of HDFS log analysis.

Author Keywords: AutoML Classifiers prediction Auto-Sklearn Anomaly detection Log analysis Log parsing

articleTitle: Evaluating Pre-trained Models on Multi-plant Disease Dataset: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Plant production plays a vital significance in the expansion of economy. In recent times, deep learning and feature extraction strategies have assisted in preventing pathogen harm to plants, thereby enabling farmers to be able to identify the diseased plants in advance. Numerous methods have been developed and put to use for the categorization of crop diseases with the help of images of diseased leaves or crops. This study aims to analyze different types of pretrained models in multi-plants like tomatoes, apple, maize, grapes and potatoes to gain a better understanding to learn more about the various applications of pre-trained models. We have used $\mathbf{6 2 5 0}$ images with nine diseases in tomatoes, three diseases in apple, maize, grapes and two diseases in potatoes. The experimental results verify that, in comparison to, MobileNetV2, EfficientNetB0, ResNet50, VGG16, VGG19 and InceptionV3 pre-trained models ResNet50 model outperforms them in different plant disease dataset.

Author Keywords: convolutional neural network, MobileNetV2, EfficientNetB0, ResNet50, VGG16, VGG19, Inception V3

articleTitle: Forecasting the Impact of Deep Learning on Data Science Practices: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: It comprehensively discusses the effect of deep mastering on data technology practices. Deep studying has advanced to become a powerful tool for information mining, pattern recognition, and feature engineering. It is miles Information scientists are increasingly using the accuracy and efficiency of information science initiatives. Furthermore, the era has stepped forward hastily to one of these excessive levels. Many leading facts scientists throughout numerous domains have begun to contain deep mastering into their facts technological know-how workflows. In this paper, we examine and forecast the modern-day and destiny impact of deep gaining knowledge of data technology practices. We start by analyzing the distinct advantages of deep learning, including progressed accuracy, reduced guide attempt, more suitable automation, and advanced scalability. We then become aware of extraordinary applications in which deep learning is being applied and evaluate its impact on the respective information science pipelines. Sooner or later, we provide a comprehensive forecast of the capability applications of deep getting to know within the records technology subject inside the near and far destiny. Notably, we recall the capacity of deep studying to force essential modifications in how information mining, analytical choice-making, and large records packages. Through our analysis, we will forecast the ability of deep studying to revolutionize statistics technological know-how practices in extraordinary ways.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Medical Image Processing through Immersive Metaverse: A Paradigm Shift
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of metaverse technologies into medical image processing represents a transformative shift in healthcare delivery. With the increasing availability of high-resolution medical imaging data and advances in image processing techniques, the potential for a transformative impact on healthcare is evident. Metaverse has potential to revolutionize digital medical images such as Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging process with enhanced diagnostics, treatment planning, and patient care. Combining Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Blockchain, Internet of Things (IoT), and other cutting-edge technologies, metaverse offers boundless opportunities for collaboration, education, and innovation in healthcare. This paper discusses the technological components of metaverse, its features in medical image processing, and its potential applications across various healthcare domains. Furthermore, key factors influencing the growth of the metaverse in medical image processing in revolutionizing healthcare delivery, and future trends are identified and discussed.

articleTitle: Efficient Similarity Search Algorithms for Large Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Efficiently finding similar items in large datasets is a crucial task with applications in various domains. This abstract presents a survey of algorithms and techniques designed for this purpose. Notable approaches include Minhashing, which employs hash signatures to estimate set similarity; Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH), a family of hash functions grouping similar items into common buckets; Cosine Similarity for Vector Spaces, suitable for data represented as vectors; Random Projection, a dimensionality reduction technique preserving pairwise distances; Word Embeddings, leveraging pre-trained embeddings for measuring similarity in text data; Bloom Filters, space-efficient structures for set-membership testing; Tree-based Methods like KD-trees and Ball-trees for efficient nearest neighbor searches; and SimHash, a method generating hash codes to represent similarity. To choose an algorithm the factors such as data characteristics, dataset size, and the desired balance between accuracy and computational efficiency should be considered. Experimentation with different techniques is recommended to determine the most effective approach for specific use cases.

articleTitle: A Novel Consensus Mechanism using Impression based Byzantine Fault-Tolerance for Lightweight Blockchain in IoT enabled Smart Home Autonomous System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The escalation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices accentuates the criticality of cybersecurity, given their capacity to amass confidential multimedia data including audio, imagery, and biometrics. The centralized architecture traditionally supporting IoT introduces a monolithic control over data, elevating risks of data breaches and tampering which may lead to a single point of failure that is vulnerable to attacks. Blockchain technology emerges as a transformative solution by decentralizing data validation, negating the need for a centralized authority, and thus mitigating single-point vulnerability. Classical blockchain frameworks are ill-suited for IoT, primarily due to their public data exposure with the excessive requirements for storage and processing power driven by the continuous growth of the blocks and the intensity of consensus protocols. Addressing these incongruities, this paper suggests a decentralized framework through a lightweight blockchain considering a new Impression based Byzantine Fault-Tolerance (IBFT) consensus mechanism. IBFT minimizes computational demands by utilizing an ‘impression value’ to elect the network’s primary node, significantly enhancing performance. Additionally, integration with the Storj platform, a decentralized storage system is also proposed to ensure robust data encryption with distribution to mitigate vulnerability issues in centralized storage focusing the challenges pertaining to blockchain storage. The proposed next generation blockchain framework outperforms among recent state-of-art algorithms against emerging threats to secure IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: Decentralized File Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The need for safe, scalable, and effective cloud storage solutions has increased in a time when digital information is essential to society. Let us introduce you to Google Drive, a reliable cloud storage solution that is a must-have for both people and businesses. Nonetheless, concerns about data security, privacy, and single points of failure have been raised by Google Drive’s centralization. With the goal of creating a more robust and resilient cloud storage environment, this project explores the decentralisation of Google Drive in an effort to allay these worries. The primary aim is to develop and execute a decentralised system by utilising innovative technologies like distributed file systems, peer-to-peer networks, and blockchain to transform the traditional paradigm of cloud storage. The trip begins with a detailed analysis of cloud storage systems as they exist now, highlighting the benefits and drawbacks of centralised designs. The theoretical underpinnings of decentralisation are then thoroughly examined, including important ideas, difficulties, and possible solutions. Important lessons are learned from current decentralised storage systems, offering a sophisticated perspective on their advantages and disadvantages. The development of a decentralised Google Drive prototype is key to the endeavour. In order to strengthen data integrity, security, and user privacy, this project seamlessly integrates blockchain technology. The implementation of a novel peer-to-peer network design distributes data among several nodes and eliminates the need for a central server. Furthermore, an advanced distributed file system is utilised to maximise the effectiveness of data retrieval and storage.

articleTitle: Integrating Penetration Testing Tools into a Website
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The realm of cybersecurity is continually evolving, with hackers posing a persistent threat to the security of systems and networks. To counter these risks, organizations require effective penetration-testing tools and methodologies. This website serves as an all-inclusive platform aimed at equipping security professionals with the necessary tools and resources to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. This study investigates the methodologies that facilitate the integration of various tools, including API Integration, Backend Command Execution, Cloud-based Integration, Containerization, and Web-based GUI Development. In this research, the website was developed by employing Backend Command Execution for the tools. By implementing Backend Command Execution, the website ensures that the tools are integrated with minimal options to address security issues and vulnerabilities. The research concludes with a website that has been developed and integrated with tools such as Nmap, Nikto, SQLmap, and Searchsploit. For future work, we plan to integrate additional tools and add various features that complement these tools. This paper is structured as follows: Introduction, Literature Survey, Penetration Testing, Methodology, Results and Analysis, and Conclusion. The total word count of this paper is 4000 words.

articleTitle: Detecting Fraudulent Reviews in E-commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fake review detection in e-commerce reviews is a vital issue in preserving the trustworthiness of online platforms. The domain includes a wide range of products and services, each with its own difficulties in finding fraudulent or misleading reviews. The challenges are the complexity of the fake review techniques, the vast number of reviews that are created every day, and the need for the detection of the fake reviews to stop the spread of the misinformation. This work addresses these issues based on a multi-faceted approach that includes the use of advanced natural language processing techniques, machine learning algorithms, ensembled models trained on labeled datasets, and the analysis of user behavior to detect anomalies. Through the combination of these techniques, e-commerce platforms can successfully fight fake reviews, thus, protecting the consumers trust and keeping the online reviews credibility.

articleTitle: Scope of Environmental Harm As A Crime Under International Criminal Law
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper examines the evolving landscape of environmental protection within the framework of international criminal law. It specifically focuses on the jurisdiction of the International Criminal Court (ICC) and international human rights tribunals. Through an analysis of legal instruments, case law, and emerging developments, the paper explores the potential applicability of international criminal law to address environmental harm. It begins by dissecting the scope of the Rome Statute, assessing the extent to which environmental crimes may fall within the ICC’s purview. The paper then delves into recent initiatives, including the Policy Paper of 2016 by the Office of the Prosecutor (OTP), which signals a shift towards considering environmental harm in case selection and prosecution strategies.Furthermore, it discusses the ongoing efforts for the establishment of “ecocide” as a distinct international crime. Additionally, the paper analyzes the evolving recognition of rights concerning the environment within the framework of international human rights law. Finally, it addresses the challenges inherent in extending the scope of international criminal law to prosecuting environmental harm, offering insights into the complexities surrounding this intersection of environmental protection and international justice. Towards the end, suggestions for effective inclusion have been discussed.

articleTitle: A Review of Deep Learning Architectures for Automated Video Analysis in Football Events
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automating the process of analyzing the match footage is one of the important things that is around the football stakeholders. By using deep learning algorithms and architectures, we can have an advanced process of analysis. Here, we focus to delve into exploration of match analysis works in an automated manner. This architecture is covered with the aspects of player tracking, action recognition, semantic segmentation, and event detection using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and 3D CNNs. Also, this work focuses on tactical analysis and performance evaluation, highlighting the usage of deep learning models for extracting insightful information from the footage. Integration of deep learning with traditional scouting methods is also discussed in this work with the implications for the field. Challenges that are faced during this process include data annotation, scalability, and real-time processing. Future research directions and suggestions are also discussed. The work offers a roadmap for researchers, practitioners, and stakeholders interested in deep learning architectures for sports video automation to advance sports technology and analytics.

articleTitle: CNN-SVM Fusion: A Robust Method for Emotion Detection in Faces
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Analysis of facial expressions for emotion detection is relevant to many areas of interest in computer science and engineering among them being, human-computer interaction (HCI), security, and health. The problem with traditional approaches that use fixed sets of features is that facial data may be highly variable and the approaches may then demonstrate poor reliability. In this study, we present a novel approach for the classification of prompted emotive voices which employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) for feature extraction and a support vector machine (SVM) for classification. CNN-SVM hybrid is a technique that combines the advantages of the CNN and the SVM to improve accuracy and reduce the level of random variation. Using the abovementioned proposed method, the system was tested on a benchmark data set to get an accuracy of 0.92 accuracy which surpasses standalone CNN and SVM results as well as other recent works on a similar problem. The findings presented here show that the proposed CNN-SVM fusion model can be used to successfully identify emotions from facial expressions, especially for real-life applications. Future work will investigate additional possibilities with superior model learning and increase the scope of the data used.

articleTitle: Bridging Blockchain with Cloud Computing: A Blockchain-as-a-Service(BaaS) Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing and the use of blockchain have become a possible paradigm that can enhance security, transparency, and efficiency for various businesses. This paper investigates the idea of Blockchain-as-a-Service (BaaS), which combines blockchain technology and cloud computing. It explores the foundational concepts of cloud computing and blockchain technology, evaluates the advantages and difficulties of their combination, looks at current BaaS platforms, and talks about possible uses in various industries. This paper also offers insights into potential future developments in the field of blockchain-cloud convergence. In many ways, it has been determined that blockchain technology is the leading option for fortifying current computer systems. Cloud computing, another of the network-enabled methods, has been widely embraced by the sector thanks to a variety of cloud service models. Blockchain technology integration including existing cloud services presents many opportunities to enhance functionality and productivity, while also protecting privacy and security. How blockchain technology fits within currently implemented cloud solutions as well as makes it possible to redesign data centres in the cloud is still an open subject. This survey looks into current attempts to combine blockchain technology with clouds and tackles this problem. This work covers essentially three technological dimensions. First, the model of services and review Blockchain-as-a-Service (BaaS) were addressed, an emerging blockchain service model important to the cloud; next, security is regarded as a crucial technical aspect in this closer task, and yet accessible encryption methods, as well as access control, are evaluated; and finally, the blockchain-enabled cloud data centres hardware, as well as software performance, were analyzed. The principal results of this study will serve as theoretical foundations for future research on blockchain-enabled cloud centre restructuring.

articleTitle: Kinematic Variability in Healthy and Hemiplegic Gait using OpenSim: A Quantitative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research investigates how Opensim, a tool for biomechanical modeling, can be used to analyze musculoskeletal changes in all three planes, namely, sagittal, frontal, and transverse planes, in individuals with hemiplegia compared to those in a healthy model. Contralateral hemiplegia ($\mathbf{C H}$), marked by one-sided paralysis, triggers significant alterations in bone size and notably affects an individual’s walking pattern. Driven to comprehend the biomechanical impacts of $\mathbf{C H}$ on human motion, we examined ten CH patients with a median age of 46 years (range: 39-52.0 years) and a height of $1.75 \pm 0.6 \mathbf{m}$. OpenSim’s inverse kinematics feature allows for a thorough comparison of joint angles between individuals with health conditions and those with unhealthy ones. Ten individuals with similar body characteristics and in good health were also enlisted. We evaluated musculoskeletal alterations following CH by analyzing bone length data extracted from MRI reports acquired from a hospital. The gait data is presented and scrutinized through statistical methods, including mean absolute deviation, box plots, and a two-sample t-test. The outcomes uncovered substantial disparities in hip flexion, lumbar bending, lumbar extension, pelvis tilt, and ankle joint angles between healthy individuals and those with hemiplegia, supported by significantly low p-values. Notably, no significant distinction was detected in hip adduction, hip rotation, lumbar rotation, pelvic rotation, or knee and subtalar joint angles (p>0.05). These findings enrich our comprehension of hemiplegia-related musculoskeletal changes, suggesting potential avenues for personalized interventions to enhance mobility.

articleTitle: A Reliable and Secure Multicast Transport Protocol for Space-ground Integrated Networks using RBAC
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A space-ground integrated network combines space-based and ground-based components to facilitate communication, data transmission, and other functions related to space missions or satellite operations. The requirement of the space-ground integrated network in satellite communication, remote sensing, navigation, earth observation, and space exploration is essential. These networks often involve complex infrastructure and protocols to ensure reliable and efficient communication across vast distances and varying environmental conditions. They play a crucial role in modern space operations, enabling everything from telecommunications to scientific research to national security activities. Multi-cast transport protocols possess reliability and security loopholes during data transmission among the space and ground networks. This research proposes a reliable and secure multicast transport protocol for the space-ground integrated network using the role-based access mechanism (RBAC). The space and ground networks are communicating with each other through an intermediary. The role of each device in both networks is defined, and any deviation in the role creates an alarm to detect the anomaly in the network, thus making the existing protocol secure. In addition, during the intermediary’s failure between both networks, one backup intermediary is activated to make the protocol reliable. The experimental results provide sufficient evidence for our claim in terms of network performance parameters: throughput (13.5 Mbps), PDR ($0.004\%$), transmission delay $(0.003 \%)$, and execution time of the protocol (30s). The results also show that the proposed method provides a higher anomaly detection rate with a lower error rate.

abstract: To do this experimentation project, we will tackle the notion of multiple diseases in horses, which are challenging to detect, by employing the powers of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and support vector machines (SVM). articleTitle: Mobile Device Security in Wireless Networks: Challenges, issues and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile device protection has emerged as an increasingly important difficulty as more and more customers depend upon wireless networks for everyday conversation and other duties. Wi-Fi networks offer convenience and versatility for users; however, they also come with safety worries. This paper presents an overview of the safety-demanding situations related to Wi -Fi networks, discusses safety issues related to cellular devices, and offers more than a few answers for creating cozy cell surroundings. It focuses on defensive person identification, privacy, statistics, and defending against possible malicious activities. Primarily, the paper explores security solutions, encryption, authentication, community access control, and tool control. Moreover, it appears on the role of service carriers in cell tool protection and shows an aggregate of quality practices and generation to sell secure usage. Finally, the paper recommends persevering with studies to identify new threats and answers to decorate mobile safety similarly.
