articleTitle: Automated Personality Profiling from Handwriting using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Handwriting analysis, also known as graphology, has been traditionally used as a method for assessing personality traits. Various characteristics of handwriting, like letter size, slant, and pressure applied, are believed to provide insights into an individual’s personality. Graphologists typically follow a systematic approach, analyzing handwriting samples by examining various aspects of the writing style and comparing them to established interpretations or psychological theories. This paper presents a novel machine learning architecture developed to infer personality traits from handwritten text samples. Five different handwriting features have been extracted, and feature extraction has been performed using an Ensemble (Random Forest) technique. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of 87.6% in predicting personality traits according to the Big Five personality dimensions. These results indicate the usefulness of the approach in automating handwriting analysis for personality assessment.

articleTitle: CNN Modeling for Recognizing Rice Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study explores the application of deep learning techniques to the identification of diseases affecting rice leaf tissue. Among the most crucial staple crops farmed worldwide is rice. However, its health is in jeopardy due to several illnesses that harm both its productivity and its quality. The detection of these illnesses by manual means can be a time-consuming process that is also prone to mistakes. As a result, the current study presents an automated method that makes use of deep learning algorithms to reliably diagnose and categorize rice leaf illnesses based on photographs. The research makes use of a sizable collection of annotated photographs of rice leaf patterns. These photographs are fed into convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to be trained and evaluated. The results of the experiments show that the approach that was presented was successful. They illustrate that it is possible to get a high level of accuracy when diagnosing and classifying diseases. The model that was built offers a potentially useful approach for the early and accurate identification of rice leaf diseases. This opens the door for prompt intervention and effective management techniques that can reduce crop losses and assure food security.

articleTitle: Advancement in Image Restoration Through GAN-based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces IR-GAN (Image Restoration Generative Adversarial Network), a groundbreaking tool accessible on GitHub, designed to elevate image quality and rejuvenate damaged or low-resolution photographs. Leveraging the power of generative facial priors, IR-GAN adeptly transforms aged images, effectively reducing blurriness and revitalizing historical snapshots with remarkable precision. At the heart of IR-GAN lies its pre-trained Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) model, meticulously crafted to intelligently fill in missing or damaged areas within images by discerning intricate patterns present in the dataset. This innovative approach enables IR-GAN to seamlessly replace distorted or blurred segments with visually coherent elements, preserving the authenticity and essence of the original photographs. Through the integration of advanced image processing techniques and state-of-the-art deep learning methodologies, IR-GAN emerges as a promising solution for digital restoration and preservation endeavours. Its ability to breathe new life into old photographs while maintaining their historical significance holds immense value for archivists, historians, and enthusiasts alike. Experimental results presented in this paper underscore IR-GAN’s efficacy in the transformative process of old photographs into visually appealing images. The showcased capabilities of IR-GAN align with the burgeoning demand for sophisticated image enhancement tools within the realm of image processing, paving the way for future advancements in digital restoration and preservation technologies.

articleTitle: Comparitive study of LSTM and Ensemble models for Hindi text sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a common idea in big data analysis and natural language processing, tries to discern the emotion underlying the text and thoughts of the people. In the Indian Subcontinent, major communication is conducted in a number of languages other than English. These languages are frequently used to communicate opinions, and when such opinions are translated into English, their depth and significance are lost. The suggested study offers a method for analyzing the numerous sentiments found in literature written in different languages in their original tongues. The Hindi language is chosen to assess the functionality and performance of the model under consideration for the sake of simplicity in the demonstration. There are two different models that have been considered to understand the performance of the same. One is the LSTM model and the other was developed by implementing a stacking classifier. The stacking classifier combined different properties of various models into the base classifiers and fine-tuned them which aided in achieving a better accuracy than the previously existing models. The LSTM model showcases an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 9 \%}$ whereas the stacking classifier showcases an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$. This can be useful in different applications including movie reviews, restaurant reviews, product reviews and so on.

articleTitle: A Novel User Authentication and Access Control Model in Enhancing Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ever-increasing use of cloud computing has made data and resource security a major issue. Unauthorized access to data and cloud services puts many people and organizations in danger. This paper aims to improve cloud security by addressing this difficulty by presenting a novel approach for user authentication and access control. The suggested architecture offers a complete solution for avoiding unwanted access in cloud environments by combining cutting-edge user authentication techniques with strong access control mechanisms. The goal of the research is to create a framework that is user-centric and gives security and user experience equal priority. It makes use of cutting-edge techniques and technologies, including Secure Socket Layer (SSL), Encryption, Adaptive Authentication, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), to guarantee quick and easy user authentication and, ultimately, that only authorized users can access cloud services. Through a rigorous evaluation and testing procedure, this technique shows how effective it is in avoiding disruptions to user convenience while preventing unlawful access.

articleTitle: Cloud-Integrated Blockchain Solution for Agricultural Sales Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper involves designing and implementing a cloud based agricultural sales tracking system utilizing blockchain technology to aid farmers. The aims are to increase the transparency and efficiency of record keeping systems to help in tracking crop sales, understanding profits and promote sustainability. Blockchain ties up into this vision as it allows us to enable traceability and accountability throughout the supply chain. Smart contracts will be used to automate certain aspects of the transaction as well as to keep as well as to understand the profit at each stage, this profit data will be used to share a percentage of the total profit to the farmer. Further integration of cloud will be done to help with scalability and availability of the platform to all the farmers who wish to use it to improve their situation. Finally, we hope that this platform will help farmers with pay disparity problems and make their lives better.

articleTitle: Neural Style Transfer: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Neural Style Transfer (NST) has emerged as a powerful technique for artistic image synthesis by fusing the base image with style source. In this study, we present a comparative analysis of NST using popular convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, using pre-trained models such as VGG19, DenseNet121, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2. The methodology involves leveraging the deep features extracted by the models to balance content and style in synthesized images. We delve into the specifics of the model’s layer utilization, loss function definition, and TensorFlow implementation details. Experimental results demonstrate the model’s ability to produce visually compelling images that seamlessly merge content and style characteristics. Densenet121 has demonstrated superior performance compared to the other models in the evaluation. This work not only contributes to the field of NST but also offers a user-friendly TensorFlow framework, fostering further exploration and advancements in the realm of computer vision and image processing.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Transform Coding Techniques in Image and Video Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper c the numerous transform coding strategies used for image and video compression when it comes to their effectiveness, implementation problems, and ability packages. Transform coding is an information compression approach that reduces the number of statistics by exploiting redundancies such as spatial and spectral correlations within the data. The primary remodel coding strategies mentioned encompass the discrete cosine rework (DCT), discrete wavelet remodel (DWT), block-based movement compensation (BMC), and changed discrete cosine remodel (MDCT). Furthermore, the paper compares the extraordinary remodel coding strategies in phrases in their performance, performance, and complexity. The paper starts by introducing the motivation at the back of rework coding techniques and their position in records compression. It then discusses how the numerous rework coding techniques compare to each other and why one technique can be favored over the alternative. The paper examines the overall performance of the special strategies by thinking about parameters including top sign-to-noise ratio (PSNR), compression fee, and objective/subjective nice. Finally, the paper affords an overview of the unique applications in which transform coding may be used. Standard, this paper affords an insightful evaluation of the diverse transform coding strategies used for information compression.

articleTitle: Learning To Code With Text-Bison-001:A Beginner-Friendly Explainer for Python, C, Java

articleTitle: Vision Transformers-based Retinal Image Screening for Glaucoma Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma, a prevalent eye condition affecting approximately 78 million people worldwide as of 2020, is expected to increase to 111.8 million cases by 2040. Even though Deep Learning (DL) techniques are widely used for glaucoma screening, texture exploration of retinal images’ is still suffering with the identification of glaucoma structural changes in the early stages. The pattern exploration in DL approaches primarily concentrates on local features concerning the receptive field dimensions. Adequate balancing of local and nonlocal region extraction is highly recommended for the structural change identification in the initial stages of disease. To achieve this, in this project proposal, Vision Transformers (ViT) has been introduced with extensive support from Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) principle for proper local feature extraction. This study examines the efficacy of three different Vision Transformer (ViT) model variations: ViT-Base, ViT-Large, and ViT-Huge in detecting glaucoma in retinal images. Metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F-score are used to evaluate the model, and the ACRIMA dataset forms the basis for both training and testing the model. We have evaluated the model using ORIGA and DRISHTI-GS in addition to the ACRIMA dataset for comparison, but the ACRIMA dataset yields the best results. Additionally, a comparative study is to be conducted to assess the model’s accuracy against deep learning-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classification techniques.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Single Phase Induction Motor and Data Management Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research presents an innovative approach for real-time monitoring and analysis of induction motors by integrating NodeMCU and Arduino microcontrollers. The system employs a NodeMCU board for sensor data acquisition, while an Arduino board handles control and data processing tasks. Sensors attached to the induction motor collect crucial performance metrics, including temperature, vibration, and current consumption. The collected data is formatted into a Comma-Separated Values (CSV) file by the Arduino microcontroller. A Spring backend system parses the CSV data and stores it in a MongoDB database, enabling efficient management and storage of the acquired sensor data. The system incorporates an analytics service built on the Spring framework, enabling users to perform basic statistical methods and generate insightful visualizations. This functionality enhances the system’s capability to extract valuable insights from the collected data, aiding in predictive maintenance, fault detection, and performance optimization of induction motors. The proposed system offers a comprehensive solution for real-time monitoring, data management, and analysis of induction motors, utilizing the combined capabilities of NodeMCU, Arduino, Spring, and MongoDB.

articleTitle: Enhancing Brain MRI Images: Using DC GAN And WGAN For Image Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Generating and detecting MRI images are most beneficial if the illness requires a fast and accurate cure. Concerning the weakness, there have been negative remarks made about DL for violating the privacy of patients. However, it takes a lot of money and time to collect a rich MRI image database to train the model. It has been found out that way too many medical imaging datasets contain imbalanced data, thus making it difficult for the model to find the outliers. Hence, the basic necessity in working with medical images is the process of data augmentation. The regular forms of data augmentation such as rotation, scale, crops, etc., results in images that look very similar and there isn’t a usual variation that is vital in DL algorithms to learn about the characteristics of the images. On the other hand, Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) have reported the potentiality to generate synthetic data with good generalization to a large image set. It is also important to note that GANs also possess the property of being an cheap in terms of data processing. In this work, we adopted the AGG based on the characteristics of MRI data analysis, and PSNR for the analysis of local information of a source image based on style transfer and multiple GANs for shared information. Style transfer follows aggregation to ensure that the aggregated image is similar to the original images. Then, we perform an analysis of the aggregation and the style transfer and because it drastically reduced the performance, dropped them.

articleTitle: Efficient Development of Gesture Language Translation System using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gesture Language Translation System (GLTS) is an interdisciplinary research field that intersects computer vision, machine learning, also human-machine interaction. This study offers a extensive exploration regarding current technologies, methodologies, and challenges in GLTS. The paper explores the evolution of sign communication recognition systems and their applications across diverse domains, such as human-computer interaction, virtual reality, and healthcare. Particular emphasis is given to sign communication translation, an emerging concept facilitating the translation of gestures into meaningful language, thereby enabling more intuitive communication. Challenges associated with translating gestures into language are discussed, and potential solutions are explored to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of GLTS. The research underscores the real-world impact of GLTS, showcasing its potential to revolutionize human-machine interactions across various contexts. The inclusion of case studies and examples of successful GLTS implementations provides practical insights and lessons learned from these instances. The methodology section details the research approach, encompassing the dataset, tools, and algorithms utilized for evaluating GLTS system effectiveness. The presentation and analysis of experimental results, along with relevant metrics and performance evaluations, form a critical component of this study. The discussion part analyses the results in light of the body of previous research, considers field implications, and suggests possible directions for further study and advancement.

articleTitle: 3D-Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks for Brain Tumour Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gliomas, the most common primary brain tumor, exhibit significant heterogeneity in their prognosis, aggressiveness, and histological composition, encompassing areas such as necrotic cores, enhancing and non-enhancing tumor cores, and peritumoral edema. While multimodal MRI is invaluable for brain tumor detection, precise tumor segmentation remains challenging. To overcome this, a novel 3D volume-to-volume GAN, termed the 3D-Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (3D-cGAN), was developed for the brain tumor segmentation, leveraging data from the 2020 BraTS Challenge. This model utilizes multi channel 3D MRI images to accurately segment core, whole, and enhancing tumor regions. Employing a batch size of 4 and an alpha value of 2, the model demonstrates remarkable accuracy on the BraTS 2020 dataset, achieving a Dice score of 0.8286 and IoU score of 0.7111.

articleTitle: Utilizing AI to Advance Data Science Research
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The emerging field of artificial Intelligence (AI) offers tremendous capability for advancing studies and improvement in the location of data science. AI is capable of automating and enhancing the method of obtaining, organizing, and deciphering records that may growth the accuracy of facts evaluation and strengthen records technological know-how research tasks. This automation can keep time by streamlining responsibilities and loose up researchers’ time to focus on extra complicated components of research. AI can also provide insights into previously unknown records styles, permitting researchers to pursue deeper statistics exploration and find out surprising outputs. Further, AI-based strategies can reveal significant and actionable information from conventional datasets, taking into consideration extra green and correct decisions.

articleTitle: Sign language recognition using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aims to develop a robust deep learning-based solution for accurate detection and recognition of Indian Sign Language (ISL) motions. The proposed model integrates advanced techniques such as MediaPipe Holistic for feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for sign language detection and translation. The overall process is divided into several key phases: data collection, feature extraction, and model training using essential Python modules. In the data collection phase, a comprehensive dataset of ISL motions is compiled in the form of video clips. These videos are meticulously annotated with corresponding textual representations of the signs to facilitate accurate training and evaluation. The preprocessing step involves extracting significant hand landmarks from the video frames, which are crucial for distinguishing between different sign language motions.Feature extraction is carried out using the MediaPipe Holistic algorithm, which is renowned for its high accuracy and efficiency in detecting hand and body landmarks. The provided code snippet outlines the detailed procedure for converting videos to landmark coordinates. This process leverages several libraries including OpenCV for video processing, MediaPipe for landmark detection, and NumPy for efficient data manipulation. The extracted landmarks serve as critical inputs to the subsequent deep learning model. Using the TensorFlow or Keras frameworks, an LSTM network-a type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model-is implemented during the deep learning phase. These frameworks are essential for specifying the model’s architecture, preprocessed data training, and real-time sign language recognition deployment. Because the LSTM network can capture temporal dependencies in sequential data, it is especially well-suited for understanding the dynamic character of sign language motions. The goal of this research is to develop a reliable and accurate system for recognizing sign language. The purpose of this method is to facilitate inclusive communication by removing obstacles to communication that the hearing-impaired community faces. The project’s objectives of precise and dependable ISL recognition depend on the effective fusion of cutting-edge deep learning approaches with effective landmark extraction strategies.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fast-Food Classification Using You Only Look Once (YOLO) Model
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In modern fast-paced society, the prevalence of fast food has spurred a surge in its consumption, emphasizing the need for accurate food identification systems. This study explores the efficacy of using the “You Only Look Once” (YOLO) principles for classifying fast foods using the Food-101 dataset, which includes $\mathbf{1 0 1, 0 0 0}$ images across 101 food categories. Traditional machine learning (ML) methods, i.e., methods not using deep learning (DL), have struggled with the significant variation within classes and minimal distinction between classes characteristic of food images. In contrast, DL models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown significant promise. This research leverages YOLO version 5 (YOLOv5), a cutting-edge object detection model, to achieve a classification accuracy of $\mathbf{8 0. 2 0 \%}$. It outperforms other models such as Inceptionv3 and GoogLeNet. The study employs advanced techniques such as data augmentation, batch normalization, and sophisticated loss functions to optimize performance. The results underscore YOLOv5’s superior capability in handling the complexities of fast-food classification. In the future, this can be useful for developing a robust solution for automated dietary monitoring and caloric intake assessment.

articleTitle: DDoS Attacks Detection using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The advancement of virtual networks such as cloud computing, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) has enabled seamless access to information globally, providing on-the-go services and improving operational efficiency. However, these advancements also present significant threats to the security of information and data on these virtual networks due to their interconnected nature and large attack surface. Among these threats, Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks are one of the most frequent threats to network security that cause severe damage, which hamper network performance. In a DDoS attack, the attacker overwhelms network resources on the victim’s side by sending a massive number of packets or connection requests to the server using bots, thereby disrupting the server’s functionality. The existing works explore only single supervised learning algorithms or a comparison of multiple individual classifiers for DDoS attack detection, which limits their effectiveness in handling diverse attack patterns. To address this limitation, our work proposes an ensemble learning approach that combines multiple supervised machine learning techniques to combat DDoS attacks. Specifically, our ensemble learning framework integrates Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and AdaBoost techniques to detect and identify different DDoS attacks effectively.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: A Simplified Approach of Correlated Rician Fading Channel Estimation in Multi-User Ultra-Massive MIMO RIS-assisted Narrow Band Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Since 6G communication systems operate at millimeter-wave bands, the signals are susceptible to blockages. Towards addressing this issue, Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) is envisioned as one of the key technologies in 6G communications. Estimation of RIS-assisted channels is very challenging since they are highly dependent on system architecture, channel configuration, and the algorithms to compute channel state information. It demands perfect channel state information (CSI) of every individual channel between gNodeB and the UE through RIS, and it is very challenging to obtain perfect CSI in high-speed networks due to their high-mobility scenarios. Also, the existing channel estimation methods perform uniform time-slots assignment during all the stages and cause more errors in the estimation. In this paper, we propose a two-level uplink transmission method to characterize the quasi-static Rician fading channel at gNodeB by exploiting the channel correlation properties in a multi-user ultramMIMO RIS-assisted narrow band radio system using minimum pilot sequence. In the proposed method, early stages of channel estimation are assigned with higher number of timeslots so that the error propagation to the next stage will be reduced. Also, the channel correlation properties utilized in the proposed method minimizes the number of unknowns to be computed. This led to the minimal channel estimation time and complexity. The interference cancellation is performed for the received signal at gNodeB during stage 1 and 2 so that error propagation is minimized. The normalized mean square error (NMSE) is evaluated and compared with the traditional method by exploring the relation between gNodeB antennas and RIS elements to prove the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Farm Management System using Streamlit
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper aims to address the pressing challenges faced by farmers in modern agriculture by introducing an innovative Artificial Intelligence(AI)-Driven Farm Management System, the latest solution that leverages predictive analytics, geo-integrated monitoring, a chatbot similar to GPT, and resource allocation to optimize agricultural operations and enhance overall productivity. Through geo-integrated monitoring, real-time data from various sources such as remote sensors, weather forecasts, satellite imagery is analyzed to enable precise monitoring of crop health, soil moisture levels, and weather patterns. The system provides farmers with valuable insights and data-driven recommendations for decision-making, helping them anticipate and mitigate potential risks while maximizing yields. Additionally, resource allocation algorithms allocate resources such as water, fertilizers, and pesticides in an efficient and sustainable manner, reducing waste and environmental impact. The platform is designed with a user-friendly interface using Streamlit, allowing farmers to easily access and interact with the data and insights generated. The system empowers farmers with real-time field monitoring, data-driven decision-making, resource optimization, predictive planning, and improved crop yields. The motivation stems from the need for modern tools to enhance farm efficiency and productivity, ultimately addressing the evolving challenges in agriculture. By harnessing the power of AI and farm management processes, this system empowers farmers to make informed decisions and optimize their operations for increased profitability and sustainability.

articleTitle: Parametric Sparse Coding of Brain Connectivity Graph Signals for Schizophrenic EEG data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Graph Signal (GS) representations of multi-variable brain recordings offer a synergistic integration between regional brain activity and global communications inside the human brain. The recent advent of Graph Signal Processing tools provides novel mathematical structures to analyze the brain GSs, thus offering a unique opportunity to trace the information flow inside the brain and identify essential biomarkers. However, brain recording’s intrinsically noisy and high-dimensional nature often leads to the misidentification of critical biomarkers and increased computational requirements. Sparsity-based approaches provide data compression and noise reduction by capturing the most significant information using a limited number of non-zero coefficients from an overcomplete basis dictionary. But their application is limited only to regular data structures. This study proposes a framework for sparse representation of the brain GSs that are defined on the irregular connectivity graph structure. The proposed framework incorporates the connectivity information into the basis dictionary in the form of the normalized Laplacian of the underlying weighted network. Specifically, the proposed parametric dictionary consists of multiple concatenated sub-dictionaries, each being a polynomial of the graph Laplacian matrix. This graph-structure-aware sparse representation framework serves the conflicting requirements of both sparsity and discriminability of the resulting sparse codes. The proposed framework is implemented on open-source Schizophrenic Electroencephalogram data, where a 0.0296 sparse reconstruction RMS error is achieved for only 5 non-zero coefficients. Further, utilizing the sparse codes for normal and Schizophrenic detection using the XGBoost model, 10 -fold cross-validated detection accuracies of $88.43 \%$ and $\mathbf{9 5 . 5 9 \%}$ are achieved for 5 and 8 non-zero coefficients, respectively.

articleTitle: Developing Cost-Effective Cloud-Based IoT Solutions for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud-based Iota answers can be an effective price-saving choice for agricultural businesses looking to optimize their operations. articleTitle: Content-Aware Error Concealment in 3D Geometry Compression for Interactive Virtual Reality Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Content-conscious mistake concealment is an emerging era that is being used to enhance the compression of 3-D geometry information for interactive digital reality (VR) programs. The purpose of this generation is to provide interactive VR packages with improved visible enjoyment by decreasing the quantity of excessive data being downloaded while simultaneously preserving the fidelity of the geometry. That is completed with the aid of using numerous techniques consisting of temporal prediction, facial animation, intensity-keeping techniques, and partial-fill strategies. The temporal prediction approach estimates future frames primarily based on the corresponding movement of formerly encoded frames with the help of temporal movement vector estimation. This technique can efficiently reduce the compression-triggered artifacts from 3D geometry facts and, hence, improve the performance of the compression set of rules. The facial animation technique, then again, is used to reduce facial animation errors and beautify the realism of the 3-D geometry. This approach employs movement-based total information compression accompanied by facial animation processes for statistics representation and information restoration after compression. This technique may be correctly used to lessen statistics redundancies due to frame synthesis and convey greater correct facial expressions. Depth-keeping techniques can correctly lessen the number of visible artifacts in compression while maintaining the depth of data.

articleTitle: An enhanced analysis of Machine Learning Techniques for Image Restoration and Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Machine brand new strategies have emerged as present-day famous inside the area of contemporary picture processing and recuperation. These techniques aim to improve the visible first-rate state-of-the-art pictures by minimizing noise, improving details, and restoring broken or degraded snapshots. This technical abstract presents an outline of the latest strategies for modern-day contemporary devices used for photograph recovery and enhancement. Deep present day, which has won a great deal of attention state-of-the-art due to its wonderful performance in diverse fields? Deep gaining knowledge state modern techniques, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Generative antagonistic Networks (GANs) have proven advanced results in photograph restoration and enhancement responsibilities. articleTitle: Predictive Healthcare Analytics: A Multidisease Approach using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Healthcare as a sector has witnessed a major transformation shift in the field of preventive and personalized medicine, leveraging advanced technologies such as machine learning to predict and mitigate the risks associated with various diseases. In this study, we present a comprehensive approach to multiple disease prediction, focusing on four major health concerns: diabetes, heart disease, breast cancer, and lung cancer. This initial phase aims to understand the data distribution, identify patterns, and preprocess the information for subsequent modeling. Utilizing machine learning techniques, particularly logistic regression, we develop predictive models tailored to each disease. Logistic regression offers a robust framework for binary classification tasks, allowing us to estimate the probability of disease occurrence based on input features. The results of our study shows promising predictive capabilities, aiding early detection and personalized interventions for improved patient outcomes in healthcare analytics.

articleTitle: MushroomDetect: An Investigation into Local Mushroom Classification in Bangladesh Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: When it comes to achieving food security, one of the main obstacles is ensuring that the diet includes high-quality foods. The development of scientific technologies has made manual local identification completely impractical because it takes so long and is so imprecise. To address this problem Using a machine vision-based approach to swiftly identify the most popular and farmed mushrooms from photos raises the accuracy level to our desired level. Pictures of our chosen species were carefully clicked to compile the dataset. We carefully selected new circumstances for seven varieties of selected mushrooms, including “Ear mushroom,” “Golden Oyster,” “Milky Mushroom,” “Oyster mushroom(Po2),” “Oyster mushroom(Po10),” “Pink Oyster,” and “Reishi Mushroom,” to generate a bespoke dataset. We collected the 500 basic photographs and divided them into 7 groups. To get a position where training a dataset will be simple, we sought to increase the amount of raw dataset with augmentation. InceptionV3, InceptionResNetV2, and DenseNet201 were the transfer learning models employed in the initial stage. After putting DenseNet201 into practice, we received the intended outcome. All of these models provide us with a respectable level of accuracy, but after training DenseNet201, we were able to reach an accuracy of 96.72%. Accidental mushroom identification may also be possible in this study.

articleTitle: Enhancing Transportation Infrastructure: A Deep Learning Approach for Pothole Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Potholes on roads pose significant challenges to transportation infrastructure, contributing to increased accident risks and substantial maintenance expenses. In response to these issues, this research paper presents a novel approach utilizing deep learning techniques for automated pothole detection on roads. An application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) has been proposed to develop a precise pothole detection model capable of analysing still images of roads. Specifically, the YOLOv8 model has been implemented using PyTorch, a powerful deep learning framework, to design and train the pothole detection system. ‘You Only Look Once’, better known as the YOLO architecture offers efficient object detection on real-time basis, making it suitable for identifying potholes in diverse road conditions. To support model development and evaluation, a comprehensive dataset was leveraged, comprising annotated photos of roads with and without potholes. The efficacy and robustness of the suggested methodology in precisely and resiliently locating potholes are proven through extensive testing and analysis. The trained model exhibits robust performance in detecting potholes of varying sizes and shapes, achieving an average confidence of almost 98% in detecting potholes within images from the validation batch, showcasing its potential for practical deployment in transportation management systems. This research contributes to the advancement of automated infrastructure maintenance practices by harnessing cutting-edge deep learning technologies. The successful implementation of this approach holds promise for improving road safety, optimizing maintenance strategies, and reducing the economic burden associated with pothole-related damages. By showcasing the capabilities of deep learning in pothole detection, this study highlights the transformative potential of artificial intelligence in enhancing transportation infrastructure resilience and sustainability.

articleTitle: The Challenges and Opportunities of Implementing Interactive Communication Media Algorithms in Networking Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We show how the abstract exploration space of possible interactive communication media algorithms arises from implementing networking applications. Specifically, this abstract will describe the challenges to implementing current media algorithms in networking stacks and some benefits and motivations for incorporating those implementations. More significantly, this summary will look at the more excellent performance and stepped forward person revel that could accompany using multimedia codecs of interactive communication media. Moreover, this abstract will explain the challenges and constraints in implementing these algorithms nicely into current networking applications. Ultimately, this summary will discuss the challenges and opportunities associated with network applications by incorporating interactive communication media algorithms for improved performance and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Future Horizons in E-Commerce: Robotics, Virtual Reality, and Green Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Every year, the technology improvements and changing customer expectations are changing the face of e-commerce from one year to another. The following essay discusses three major new technologies: robots, virtual reality (VR), and green automation systems that are likely to change the industry. In the field of e-commerce, robotics has found an increasing application in order to facilitate the effective and efficient management of products and fulfillment of orders with ease, minimal time, and zero mistakes. On the other hand, Virtual Reality is set to change the way people shop, to make it possible for users to interact in 3D with products and, in short, to make purchasing even more immersive and fun. Last will be the green automation systems that find their way into the e-commerce ecosystem. They help make processes more sustainable by reducing waste and making the best use of energy. This paper will examine how such technologies are used, how they can affect e-commerce, and the problems that need to be corrected first before the full help of such technologies can be realized. This paper looks at every nook and cranny in trying to investigate the future of e-commerce and how critically important the sector is for new ideas that are increasingly customer-oriented and ecologically sustainable.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Enhancements for Car Insurance Claim Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the biggest concerns of car insurance industry is efficiently managing car insurance claims while minimizing fraudulent submissions. This study explores the use of machine learning models in the prediction of auto insurance claims. Unlike traditional rule-based systems, which often struggle with intricate patterns and dynamic data, machine learning offers powerful, efficient, and often more accurate methods for predicting car insurance claims. By analyzing historical data on car insurance claims, various machine learning algorithms can be employed to develop a robust predictive model. This research highlights the pivotal role of machine learning in revolutionizing the insurance landscape. Accurate predictions empower insurers to allocate resources efficiently, streamline processes, and ultimately enhance the experience for policyholders. This study focuses primarily on enhancing claim processing efficiency. In terms of accuracy, we found the XG Boost performs the best classifier with an accuracy of 0.84.

articleTitle: Federated Split Learning with HyperNetworks for Medical Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the medical field has significantly enhanced patient healthcare by enabling the development of sophisticated predictive models. However, the conventional method of building these AI models often requires the aggregation of vast amounts of centralized data, which poses substantial risks to patient data privacy and presents major barriers to scaling these solutions. Federated Learning (FL), a distributed machine learning paradigm, addresses this issue by allowing multiple clients to collaboratively train a model without exchanging their data, thus preserving privacy. Despite its benefits, FL faces significant data and computational heterogeneity challenges. Medical environments frequently feature devices with varied computational capacities, which can severely impede the performance of FL. This paper presents a novel model partitioning approach within the Split Learning (SL) framework by incorporating Dynamic Hypernetworks, which dynamically adjust network parameters in real-time. This method optimizes the ‘cut layer’—the point at which data is split between client and server—thereby enhancing computational efficiency and significantly reducing the risk of sensitive information leakage. It enables efficient model training on resource-constrained devices and demonstrates superior performance in a medical classification task when compared to traditional centralized, FL, and standard SL methods. The results show improved effectiveness in maintaining data privacy and highlight the potential of this approach in facilitating the broader adoption of AI in healthcare.

articleTitle: MBTI Based Personality Prediction using Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Existing methods for assessing an individual’s personality are very cumbersome due to those tests being very monotonous and erroneous due to a self-report bias. Whereas data-driven, automatic personality deduction raises privacy concern due to them needing external personal information. In our model, a person’s personality can be classified based on the 16 categories of Myers-Briggs personality types. With the availability of a huge amount of data on human behavior and personality traits, a machine learning model can be trained, and it can predict the personality trait of a person. A MBTI dataset is used to analyze and train the model. Upon analyzing the dataset, we found out that the classes are not balanced. To overcome this problem, we used binary classification. Next, we used the NLTK library to pre-process the data. We selected four machine learning models and trained our data in those models. Furthermore, we compared the results of four different machine learning models and chose the most accurate model. This research can be used to personalize advertisements, coaching for students and companies can use this research to attract specific types of audience.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Classification of Shoulder Pain Pathologies: A Scoping Review
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Shoulder problem is a widely known musculoskeletal disorder that impacts heavily on the life of patients. Effective treatment for this must be preceded by accurate and timely diagnosis but traditional diagnostic techniques have always been subjective and less reliable. In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have shown promising results in improving the accuracy of diagnosing shoulder pain, addressing the limitations of traditional diagnostic methods. Nonetheless, there is a failure to translate these ML models into practical clinical tools that can easily be employed by healthcare professionals. In addition, this paper will present an overview of current understanding and methodologies employed for diagnosing and managing shoulder pain along with reviewing the use of ML techniques in medical image diagnostics. It also suggests development of a user-friendly and accessible diagnosis tool for shoulder pathologies aimed at linking modern research and daily practice in the medical field.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Fusion Based Smart Vehicle Using Single Board Computer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The combination of safe driving with artificial intelligence has emerged as the new approach for the development of transportation as intelligent driving vehicles have entered people’s daily lives. A network based, multi sensor fusion smart vehicle system with traffic signs is proposed in this research as a result, our concept would employ a modelled automobile with a Raspberry Pi to process the acquired photos from the camera and send them to a distant computer, which would process them and send them back. Similarly, several sensors are placed around the automobile to identify potential hazards. The camera and sensors will capture the surroundings in order to identify various objects around; if the obstacles become too close or are about to crash with the vehicle. The raspberry pi minicomputer is utilized to make decisions, and based on those decisions, power is supplied to the motor through motor drives, which then drive the DC motors. A LiDAR sensor detects the lane, and infrared sensor and ultrasonic sensor detects the obstacles nearby the vehicle. The automobile is capable of arriving at the specified location safely, hence avoiding the danger of human mistake. Many current techniques, such as lane detection and obstacle identification, are coupled to give the automobile with the necessary control. This system contains Raspberry Pi as the core system, which having functionalities like, Traffic light detection, Vehicle detection, pedestrian detection, road sign detection to make the vehicle as intelligent.

articleTitle: Smart Safety Surveillance System: Personal Protective Equipment and Drowsiness Detection in Industrial Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Intelligent Safety Surveillance System (ISSS) for Industrial Environments is a comprehensive solution designed to enhance workplace safety by monitoring Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) compliance and detecting worker drowsiness. Leveraging computer vision and machine learning technologies, the ISSS provides real time monitoring and proactive alerting mechanisms. This system employs strategically positioned cameras to detect and recognize PPE items such as helmets, safety masks, and gloves. Deep learning algorithms analyze video feeds to identify instances of noncompliance, triggering immediate alerts to workers and supervisors for corrective action. In addition to PPE compliance monitoring, the ISSS utilizes cameras equipped with infrared sensors to monitor workers’ facial expressions and eye movements for signs of drowsiness. Machine learning models are trained to recognize patterns indicative of drowsiness, such as drooping eyelids or prolonged eye closure. Upon detecting these signs, the system alerts workers and supervisors, mitigating the risk of accidents caused by fatigue-related errors. By combining advanced technologies with proactive safety measures, the ISSS aims to create a safer work environment in industrial settings. Its ability to detect non-compliance and drowsiness in real-time enables timely intervention, ultimately reducing the risk of workplace accidents and injuries.

articleTitle: The Application of Time Series Forecasting to Financial Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Time collection forecasting (TSF) is an essential predictive modeling device for plenty of choice-making contexts, particularly those regarding economic change control. Time collection forecasting involves analyzing a given variable’s past observations or ancient information to expect destiny values or traits in the equal variable. It’s far more and more being used in monetary markets to higher apprehend and expect price moves and different monetary trends, as well as within the monetary chance management context to detect rising dangers and assume destiny marketplace moves. There is an expansion of tactics used in TSF, starting from simple linear models to more significant advanced machine-gaining knowledge of strategies. In this paper, we offer a top-level view of the software of TSF for monetary danger management, with particular emphasis on methods for assessing monetary market dangers and strategies for predicting stock fee moves. We describe the processes available to economic practitioners, including the most famous ones, such as autoregressive shifting standard models, synthetic neural networks, and guide vector machines. ultimately, we speak of the challenges associated with applying TSF in the monetary chance control context and touch upon the modern-day and destiny traits within the region. Time series forecasting is a critical device for financial hazard management. It is a statistical device used to investigate and expect future values of monetary time collection, along with stock expenses, trade charges, interest prices, commodity expenses, stock market indices, etc. Time series forecasting uses quantitative strategies, linear regression, autoregression, and moving averages. It can also rent extra complex strategies, including autoregressive transferring averages and neural networks, to extract and interpret styles in the underlying records. The principle cause of this approach is to offer measures of economic danger and go back, which can be utilized to modify portfolios and become aware of techniques. Time collection forecasting has many blessings when carried out in monetary hazard management. It can improve portfolio performance by becoming aware of the most appropriate investments and providing an early warning if market moves are anticipated. Additionally, it could aid in predicting the direction and volatility of monetary property, which may be used to increase and alter chance mitigation techniques. Finally, it can assist buyers in becoming aware of possibilities in the markets, which includes opportunities to buy or promote specific financial properties at favorable prices. To correctly put time series forecasting for economic risk control in force, monetary specialists ought to have access to correct and well-timed information. These records have to encompass a wide range of variables affecting economic markets along with market volatility.

articleTitle: An Approach to Analyze the Permanent Magnet Motor Torque Ripple for Improving Torque Power Curves used in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An electric car’s permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) will be designed and evaluated for performance in this research article. In order to satisfy the unique needs of the electric car and improve its overall performance, the goal is to achieve the highest torque density and the lowest torque ripple. The study’s goal is to increase the electric vehicle’s power density to do this, which calls for the use of a high-power-density motor. This is addressed by conducting an optimization procedure to increase the generated torque while making sure that the chosen motor stays within the defined size and volume restrictions. The efficient use of permanent magnet (PM) materials with strong thermal limiting capacity, which can enhance the power, is a critical component of this improvement. The efficient use of permanent magnet (PM) materials with high thermal limiting capacity, which may boost the power output under both peak and continuous loads, is a vital component of this optimization. The most important motor design parameters are carefully chosen throughout the optimization process to have the greatest influence on motor performance. Using the finite element software program “CAE Software,” the research team tests and executes the suggested motor design. The overall goal of this project is to build a PMSM that is highly effective and adapted to the needs of electric vehicles. The goal of the study is to optimize critical motor parameters and use modern PM materials with higher thermal properties in order to increase torque density and reduce torque ripple of the motor.

articleTitle: An alternative method for Image Encryption by using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Information security has emerged as a requirement and a hot topic in the modern digital world. The world today is surrounded by tonnes of gigabytes of data generated from digital platforms continually streaming through the Internet. In this perspective, computer scientists are strongly pushed to protect information against unscrupulous persons who evolve quickly with technology. The goal of cryptography is to encrypt and decrypt information by using complex mathematical functions and logics. Encryption not only for text data, but image, audio, and video kind of data as well. This research focuses on encryption and decryption of images. Different kinds of image encryption algorithms have been developed upto this point. In each algorithm, pixel permutation and pixel substitution steps are performed by using mathematical functions such as Logistic map, Cubic-logistic map, and Arnold map. Various Image cryptanalysis works has been going on these conventional image encryption algorithms. In this work, we introduce a new method of encrypting and decrypting images without using any conventional steps like substitution and permutation of image pixels. This proposed method uses a deep learning technique, i.e., convolutional autoencoders. This method targets both compression and encryption so that images can travel with much speed and security over the network.

articleTitle: Empowering data structure visualization through modification in Python
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article introduces a novel approach to data structure visualization through the development of a new programming language, utilizing Python’s Lex-YACC library for lexical analysis and parsing, and the Turtle module for graphics in the backend. The proposed language enables users to visualize various data structures such as arrays, stacks, and queues, along with their operations, facilitating a deeper understanding of these fundamental concepts in computer science. By combining the power of a custom scripting language with Python’s versatile libraries, this research aims to empower users to interactively explore and comprehend complex data structures through intuitive visualizations.

articleTitle: Qcrypt: Leveraging Post-Quantum Cryptography for Enhanced Security of Data at Rest
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The cryptographic landscape is undergoing a significant transformation with the integration of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms. In today’s interconnected world, securing data at rest using quantum-resistant algorithms that employ highly random keys is crucial. It is also imperative to securely manage these keys throughout their lifecycle using a robust Key Management System (KMS). This study identifies the threats to current cryptographic infrastructure, explores potential solutions, and introduces an innovative approach to developing a practical encryption tool with an integrated KMS. This tool is designed to protect data using existing PQC algorithms, facilitate the transition from classical cryptographic algorithms to PQC, and be easily upgradable to incorporate any future NIST-approved algorithms. The tool was evaluated for time taken and data flow within the network on various file types and sizes.

articleTitle: Human-Machine Interaction in Industrial Automation: Gesture-Based PLC Control
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As modern science and technology rapidly evolve and lifestyles change, people increasingly seek intelligence in their daily lives and work. The trend that has emerged as the primary impetus for advancing natural human-machine interaction (HMI) is the integration of machine learning algorithms. Gesture recognition through computer vision is essential for developing novel human-computer interaction methods, enabling innovative ways for people to interact with computers. This paper presents an approach to human-machine interaction through hand gesture detection to control the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), to make it a hands-off operation that is user-friendly and secure, thus enhancing the efficiency and usability of the industrial automation system. Furthermore, using Mitsubishi IQ-R PLC and MR-J4W3 Servo Drive, motion can be controlled through a Human Machine Interface. The system employs Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for recognizing hand signs based on detected key points. The model used is Long-Short-Term Memory (LSTM), which gives an accuracy $92 \%$ for the detection of hand gestures.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of a Novel, Low-Cost Resistive Stretch Sensor Band for Interactions in HCI Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) technology has progressed significantly toward creating immersive experiences. Yet, the physical interaction within these environments often relies on hand controllers or hand tracking systems using gestures that lack the naturalistic feeling of grasping objects and are computationally expensive, respectively. This study introduces the Resistive Stretch Sensor (RSS) Band, a novel approach to bridging this gap by enabling interactions in HCI through the use of conductive rubber. The RSS is designed as a wearable band that conforms to the user’s forearm, responding to muscle expansion during a full power grasp and release motion. As the RSS band stretches, its resistance value changes, which can be used as input for interactions within a virtual environment. The research characterises the conductive rubber material to determine the optimal RSS band design. The design process of the RSS band is detailed, considering ergonomic factors and the need for reliable and repeatable sensor output. A calibration method is developed to translate resistance changes into accurate input for HCI systems. The study concludes by examining the RSS’s potential applications, such as in human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Voxelwise Visual Modeling of Natural Scenes BOLD fMRI responses using weighted-neighbor based regressor
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deciphering the neural substrates underlying visual processing is fundamental in medical imaging, with computational models playing a pivotal role. Voxelwise encoding models are essential in unraveling the complex relationship between visual stimuli and neural responses across cortical regions. However, while feature extraction methodologies have advanced with deep learning, translating features into neural responses through regression remains challenging. Traditional regression methods struggle with the escalating dimensionality of feature spaces, necessitating novel approaches. This paper introduces a novel weighted neighbor-based regression framework for voxelwise visual encoding models to improve predictive accuracy and interpretability. Through systematic experiments, we evaluate the framework’s performance across varying feature dimensions, support neighbor values, and regression methodologies. Leveraging two standard deep-learning models, ALexNet and ResNet18, we extract features representing early and late visual areas and systematically vary the number of support neighbors (n). Results demonstrate the framework’s superiority over traditional linear regression approaches in accurately predicting voxel-wise neural responses. Furthermore, we identify optimal configurations that maximize predictive accuracy while minimizing overfitting or underfitting. Our findings underscore the framework’s potential as a valuable tool in voxelwise visual encoding, shedding light on the complex neural mechanisms underlying visual processing. The proposed framework offers a nuanced and interpretable representation of feature-to-response mapping, enhancing our understanding of visual perception in the human brain. Future research directions include further refinement of the framework, exploration of alternative regression methodologies, and extension to incorporate additional neuroimaging modalities. Ultimately, advancements in voxelwise visual encoding will deepen our understanding of visual cognition and perception.

articleTitle: Automatic Topic Identification in Destination Reviews Using Hybrid Topic Modelling Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nowadays, with user-generated material flooding digital platforms, it is crucial to analyze it thoroughly because it is a huge data source that provides insightful information for both research and economic objectives. Making use of the unstructured destination reviews that are a significant part of this data pool found on the social media platforms, allows for great insight into the preferences of tourists and makes it easier to improve the tourism experience. Using a blend of LDA, LLM, and clustering methods, the proposed model efficiently extracts topics from the vast number of unstructured reviews. For instance the model’s efficiency as it undergoes performance review using coherence and silhouette scores, has shown good results, especially in the case of Coorg, a coherence score of 0.48 for LDA. However, the superb performance was revealed in GPT2 by the silhouette score of 0.57 for Coorg. It reflects that the model is quite capable of extracting intrinsic information from complex texts that refer to Coorg. With the use of this method, significant information can be extracted from even the most intricate and contextually rich evaluations, offering players in the tourist industry deep insights, and streamlining their decision-making processes. In the end, this gives stakeholders the ability to efficiently match offerings with visitor preferences.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Israel-Palestine Conflict Comments Using Sentiment Intensity Analyzer and TextBlob
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis has kept its landmark in Natural Language Processing by analyzing the text to extract sentimental value. The result usually goes with positive, negative, or neutral sentiment with necessary data preprocessing, data processing, and encoding. We collected the dataset from Kaggle which obtains the comments taken from Reddit posts regarding the Israel-Palestine conflict and it has 4,36,425 threads in total. The previous works and hypotheses were analyzed and the implementations of KNN and SVM were seen effective on those. However, the whole concept of sentiment analysis is broadly focused on natural Language Processing, and algorithms related to it should be used for actual accuracy and analysis. We applied Sentiment Intensity Analyzer and TextBlob to do the sentiment analysis of the desired dataset and compared them along with the best traditional approaches. We found accuracy of 92.74% in Sentiment Intensity Analyzer as the maximum. Besides, 49.08%, 53.08%, and 86.13% were found while finding the accuracies of TextBlob, KNN, and SVM respectively. At the end, we showed Geopolitical Stance based on the four categorical topics, such as - Against Israel/Palestine, Supports Palestine, Supports Israel, and Neutral/Stance Not Clear. 53% of the comments were done on the first category of Against Israel/Palestine whereas 27% comments were on Supporting Palestine. 17% comments were Neutral or Stance was not clear and rest of the 3% comments were done supporting Israel.

articleTitle: Evaluating Credit Risk in Banking using AI-based Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AI-based totally set of rules optimization can revolutionize the manner credit score danger is evaluated within the banking industry. This generation utilizes artificial intelligence techniques, including device studying and statistics analysis, to improve the accuracy and efficiency of credit score risk assessment. By combining historical information and actual-time information, those algorithms can identify styles and anomalies in credit statistics, leading to more informed choices on mortgage approvals and danger assessments. The utility of AI-based optimization algorithms in credit score threat assessment gives several advantages to financial institutions. First of all, it could lessen the effort and time required to acquire and examine information, taking into consideration faster decision-making. This also outcomes in value savings for banks, as fewer resources are needed for credit chance assessment. Furthermore, these algorithms can be examined and adapted, continuously improving their overall performance and accuracy over the years. Further to enhancing credit score hazard assessment, AI-primarily based algorithm optimization can also assist in identifying capability fraud and detecting suspicious activities early on. It will help banks mitigate potential losses and maintain the integrity of their lending practices.

articleTitle: Cytokine Expression Profiles in Graves’ Orbitopathy: Insights from Fibrocyte Cultures
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Graves’ Orbitopathy (GO) is an autoimmune disease that causes inflammation in the orbital connective tissues and extra ocular muscle. GO shows increased volume in the orbital connective tissues due to enlargement of extraocular muscles. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) infiltrate in orbit and secret cytokines together with resident orbital fibroblasts and contribute to the inflammatory basis for active GO. A subset of monocytes presents in PBMCs known as fibrocytes can also infiltrate the orbital tissues, and contribute to the pathogenesis of GO. So, the objective of the study was to observe cytokines like IL 6, IL 8, TNF- $\alpha$ expression from fibrocytes in GD and GO. Fibrocytes were cultured for 14 days from PBMCs of 4 control and 10 GD and 10 GO patients.IL-6, IL-8, TNF- $\alpha$ were measured by sandwich ELISA from cell supernatant. In 7-day cultured fibrocytes, individuals with GO exhibited significantly higher expression of IL-6 and IL-8 compared to GD and controls. The cytokine expression patterns further increased when the culture period extended to 14 days, emphasizing the dynamic nature of fibrocytes. TNF- $\alpha$ expression was elevated in both GO and GD at 7 days, with no significant difference between them, but decreased in 14-day cultures. These findings suggest a pro-inflammatory state in fibrocytes from individuals with GO, aligning with the pathophysiology of Graves’ Orbitopathy. this study provides insights into the complex cytokine interplay in cultured fibrocytes from GD and GO patients, highlighting their potential involvement in inflammatory processes and offering potential therapeutic targets for future interventions.

articleTitle: FMLEE: Federated Meta-Learning with Enhanced Encryption for Secure Collaborative Training
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) trains models on distributed devices by aggregating model updates or parameters from multiple clients, enhancing data privacy by keeping data local. However, FL still poses risks of inversion attacks and potential malicious behavior by aggregators. Homomorphic encryption (HE) and other privacy-preserving techniques, while necessary, can be vulnerable to attacks such as adversarial attacks, membership inference attacks, and model inversion attacks by clients with access to the HE private key. This paper introduces Federated Meta-Learning with Enhanced Encryption (FMLEE), a novel framework that integrates HE, symmetric session key encryption to secure multi-party computation. FMLEE allows for collaborative training and refining of a meta-learning model without disclosing sensitive data and model weights, even without completely trusting the aggregator. HE safeguards model weights, enabling the aggregator to perform aggregation without accessing the actual data. Symmetric key encryption secures communication between the aggregator and clients, protecting model weights from being exposed to other clients as well. This dual-layer encryption approach ensures data security during both computation and communication, effectively addressing passive and active security threats. By incorporating meta-learning, FMLEE facilitates the development of robust models with less data. The use of symmetric session keys ensures the secure transmission of model weights without requiring trust in the communication channel. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FMLEE preserves data and model parameter privacy with minimal efficiency loss. This sets a new benchmark for secure federated learning by balancing privacy, security, and performance, making FMLEE highly applicable in sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and national security.

articleTitle: Real-Time Wrong-Way Vehicle Detection System with Automatic Number Plate Recognition for Enhanced Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the pursuit of enhancing road safety, the development of real-time detection systems has become imperative. This paper presents a smart approach to wrong-way vehicle detection utilizing computer vision technology for enhanced road safety. The proposed system presents a combination of YOLO for vehicle and license plate detection and OpenCV for license plate recognition, specifically tailored for Indian vehicle number plate dataset. By integrating YOLO’s single-pass object detection capabilities, the system achieves real-time performance, in order to take immediate intervention in traffic violations. Utilizing methods such as centroid tracking and ‘entry-exit’ analysis, the system effectively differentiates between vehicles traveling in correct lanes and those in wrong lanes, enabling immediate enforcement measures. Centroid tracking assigns and tracks centre points of vehicle bounding boxes across frames, ensuring computational efficiency and simplicity in implementation. The ‘entry-exit’ approach utilizes designated lines in video frames to determine the direction of vehicle movement, leading towards accurate wrong-way detection. Moreover, the system leverages EasyOCR for text extraction, ensuring high accuracy in capturing license plate information. This integration of technologies allows for comprehensive monitoring of traffic patterns and swift identification of violations, contributing to proactive enforcement strategies and improved road safety. Through extensive experimentation on the Indian vehicle number plate YOLO annotated dataset, the proposed system demonstrates robust performance in real-world scenarios, exhibiting high accuracy and reliability in wrong-way vehicle detection and automatic number plate recognition. This research represents a significant advancement in leveraging computer vision for proactive traffic management and underscores the potential of technology in enhancing road safety measures.

articleTitle: Smart Contract Vulnerabilities and Detection Methods: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Smart contracts are fundamental to blockchain technology, enabling automated contract execution without intermediaries. Their widespread adoption, particularly on platforms like Ethereum, has led to significant digital asset holdings. However, the immutability of blockchain magnifies the impact of even minor errors during smart contract development, potentially resulting in substantial financial losses. Given the frequency of vulnerabilities in existing contracts, secure smart contract development is essential. This paper conducts a comprehensive review of known vulnerabilities and detection methods to guide a more secure approach to smart contract development and promote safer blockchain ecosystems.

articleTitle: Prioritizing Communications Software Design Principles for Optimized Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Prioritizing verbal exchange software program layout ideas is essential for optimizing network overall performance. Those design principles address the number one aim of dependable and green data verbal exchange over a community, such as the want for scalability, flexibility, standardization, overall performance, and protection. Scalability allows for improved operations and the capability to handle extra workloads with the same sources. Flexibility originates from modular design, which enables modular substitute, model management, and upgradeability over time. Standardization allows for network interoperability with present and destiny technologies, at the same time as performance is stricken by the capacity to deliver and process statistics quickly and reliably. Sooner or later, safety is important to prevent unauthorized entry and records manipulation. To gain gold standard network performance, scalability must be the concern, as large community length implies more users, packages, and information site visitors. Flexibility ought to be the second precedence, as it guarantees the ability to upgrade or update additives due to changes inside the surroundings or converting consumer demands. Standardization is a third precedence, as it guarantees interoperability amongst one-of-a-kind vendors’ additives. Performance is a fourth priority, as this impacts the rate of data transmission and the capacity to technique information quickly and reliably. Sooner or later, safety is an essential fifth precedence, as it protects the gadget from malicious assaults and intrusions.
