articleTitle: Medical Image Recognition using Deep Learning: Applications in Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Scientific picture reputation using deep learning is an unexpectedly growing discipline of research with goals to grow accuracy and velocity of medical prognosis through the use of deep studying strategies. Deep studying, which is an AI-pushed method, has been applied to enhance the accuracy and speed of analysis of medical photos in an expansion of illnesses. Those encompass most cancers diagnosis and diagnosis of conditions, including diabetic retinopathy and coronary artery ailment. Deep learning-based strategies have proven to offer better accuracy and speed of analysis as compared to standard strategies. In scientific picture recognition, deep knowledge of strategies is used in a selection of methods to classify pics and come across abnormalities. At the maximum primary degree, convolutional neural networks are used to categories pics into pre-defined classes, including most cancers as opposed to healthful tissue. Extra advanced techniques additionally use deep mastering in mixture with the different system getting to know algorithms, such as supervised gaining knowledge of, unsupervised mastering, and reinforcement learning that allows you to discover abnormalities, which include cancerous tumors or symptoms of contamination. Deep studying-primarily based on medical photo popularity, is likewise being implemented to create pc-aided diagnosis systems which may be used to detect various abnormalities in scientific snapshots. CAD systems are used in more than a few programs, together with mammography, in which CAD structures are used to identify tumors in mammograms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Code Insights through Semantic Change Impact Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In software development, system integrity is a measure of the impact code changes have on them. It is determined by the team’s comprehension. However, rapid evolution of change commits and interaction in complex code bases create problems. By evaluating the effect of reflection changes, this study contributes to the improvement of the comprehension of code, a critical success factor for quality and efficiency. This addresses issues by using semantic analysis, change detection, refactoring detection, and semantic change detection and diffing. Our approach documents the semantic differences between the original and changed source code and gives pragmatic conclusions on how to enhance code quality and maintainability. Specifically, we divide the code into AST files using simple python scripts for semantic analysis and compare them for differences to find implications. It executes the method through the focus on development workflows and major projects as it includes the past information while still simplifying argument parsing and file processing. Based on our study findings, a better understanding of code can help developers to improve their decision-making capacity and protect the performance during the enhancement activity of the program.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Enabled Techniques for Anomaly Detection in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the rapid evolution of 5G networks, ensuring robust cyber security measures has become imperative. 5G Network has become a pivotal technology within the new generation ecosystem, facilitating streamlined resource distribution, personalized services, and the provision of diverse applications. This paper introduces a comprehensive Model for detecting attacks in 5G network environment. Leveraging a dataset 5G-SliciNdd specific curated for 5 G network attacks, we employ hybrid feature selection approach to determine the most relevant features for anomaly detection. Several machine learning models are applied to detect and classify attacks accurately. Our methodology focuses on enhancing key performance metrics including false detection rate, accuracy, F1-score, recall, and precision thereby fortifying the security posture of 5 G network against evolving threats. Results of this experiment illustrate the effectiveness of our approach in accurately identifying and mitigating network attacks, contributing to the advancement of malicious traffic detection in next generation communication network.

articleTitle: EEDL-based Detection and Classification of Apple Foliar Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Apple farmers constantly grapple with the challenge of increasing their yield and safeguarding apple trees from diseases. The prevalence of diseases and pests significantly hampers apple production, resulting in substantial financial losses for the industry annually Detecting apple leaf diseases swiftly and accurately is crucial for effectively handling and curbing these issues within orchards. Specifically, advancements in computer vision methods that utilize deep learning have opened avenues for identifying and understanding these diseases at an early stage directly on the leaves Here, the EEDL(Enhanced Efficient Deep Learning)model is proposed for the detection and classification of five types of apple foliar diseases. In the EEDL model, we modify and fine-tune the Efficient Net model variant B0 by adding four additional layers. These layers consist of the augmentation layer, dense layer, dropout layer and the final output classifier dense layer. The AFD-7C dataset(8000 images are gathered in the real filed environment of apple research Centre and apple orchards of Himachal Pradesh. 9037 images are obtained from the Plant Village public dataset) is utilized in the experimental procedure and achieves an accuracy of 97.82%

articleTitle: Cancer Classification using Gene Expression Dataset to Detect Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cancer classification plays a very important role in personalized medicine and targeted therapy. To classify the kinds of cancer based on the gene expression data, three different kinds of algorithms are applied in this paper: the greedy method, the Recursion Tree Method, and Hashing. The selection of these algorithms forms a large combination to address the complexity of the gene expression datasets in an attempt to increase the accuracy of cancer classification and minimize the computational time. The study evaluates the performance of each of the algorithms and also show how well they do in cancer classification through detailed experimentation and review. The Greedy Algorithm and Feature Hashing enable accuracy of 88% and 85%, respectively. Feature Hashing reduces the computational complexity significantly. Such findings bring out the trade-offs between accuracy and computational efficiency, giving insights that might be of importance for cancer detection and treatment methods.

articleTitle: Hybrid Grey Wolf Algorithmic Approach for Optimizing Workflow Scheduling with Budget and Deadline Constraints in IaaS Clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Efficiently allocating virtual machines (VMs) to tasks within cloud computing environments is crucial for optimizing resource usage and cutting operational expenses. Traditional methods often struggle to balance cost efficiency and timeliness, especially in intricate cloud workflow setups. This paper introduces a novel hybridization approach merging Simulated Annealing (SA) and Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) to tackle these challenges. HGWO utilizes SA’s exploratory prowess to escape local optima and leverages GWO’s exploitative abilities to refine solutions towards global optimality. Additionally, the algorithm includes a penalty function to rigorously eliminate solutions that violate predefined budget and deadline constraints, ensuring adherence to Quality of Service (QoS) requirements. Performance evaluation via extensive simulations, modeling realistic cloud workflow scenarios, demonstrates that the hybrid algorithm consistently surpasses existing cost reduction and deadline adherence methods, making it a potent tool for cloud service providers seeking to boost resource allocation efficiency. This study’s implications indicate that integrating diverse optimization techniques can yield more robust solutions in cloud workflow management, fostering adaptive and scalable cloud computing architectures.

articleTitle: Prediction of Neurodevelopmental Disorder by Combining Data-Driven ROI Extraction and Frequency Specific Brain Functional Connectivity Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDDs) such as Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) have a profound impact on children and adolescents. Machine learning (ML) and Deep learning techniques (DeepL) on fMRI data offer a significant effect on predicting NDD with high diagnostics capabilities. Unlike conventional methods that rely solely on predefined brain regions and linear neural signal relationships, this study integrates grouped Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and Dictionary Learning (DL) to explore data-driven brain topology, allowing for a nuanced understanding of brain functional connections (BFC). By addressing non-linear BFC patterns in the frequency domain using Phase Locking Value (PLV), the model achieves high accuracy in predicting ADHD ($\mathbf{90\%} \pm \mathbf{1.1\%)}$) and ASD ($\mathbf{84.3\%}$ $\pm \mathbf{0.31\%}$) on ADHD-200 and ABIDE-I datasets respectively with 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN), through 10-fold cross-validation. This approach offers robustness to amplitude variations and provides insights into synchronized signals over frequency, enhancing our understanding and diagnostic capabilities of NDDs. Incorporating grouped ICA and DL for data-driven time series data generation, offering robustness to amplitude variations, providing a nuanced understanding of synchronized signals over frequency with PLV, and classifying the BFC with 1D-CNN are the significant contributions of this proposed work.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Hybrid Quantum-Classical Convolutional Neural Networks for Audio Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Audio signals being high-dimensional and complex pose challenges for classical machine learning techniques in terms of computation and generalization on real-world data. This paper evaluates the use of hybrid quantum-classical convolutional neural networks (QC-CNN) that leverage quantum effects like superposition and entanglement for audio classification using mel-spectrograms obtained from audio data. Evaluated on both small-sized and large-sized datasets, the proposed QC-CNN model gave comparable training accuracy with classical CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) on the smaller dataset but outperformed classical CNN on test accuracy ($\mathbf{95.04 \%}$ vs $\mathbf{92.88 \%}$) for a larger birdsong dataset and reduced overfitting, thus highlighting the potential advantages of QC-CNNs for audio data. The QC-CNN exhibited higher cross-entropy loss in case of the small-sized dataset which was further significantly reduced when evaluated on the large-sized birdsong dataset. The work demonstrates the application of QC-CNN for audio classification.

articleTitle: Enhancing Content Based Collaborative Filtering Recommendations Using Weighted Word Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the current era of excessive information, recommendation systems are essential for assisting users to discover relevant content efficiently, ensuring high levels of user satisfaction and engagement. The proposed work focuses on enhancing content-based collaborative filtering using advanced word embed ding techniques like Word2Vec, GloVe, and BERT to capture semantic relationships between items. This study utilizes weighted word embeddings, derived from user-provided ratings, to enhance the recommendation system’s capability in identifying and predicting user preferences. By incorporating these weighted embeddings, our approach seeks to improve the precision and relevance of recommendations, eventually increasing user satisfaction. The study conducts a comparative analysis of these word embedding techniques based on cosine similarity scores. Among the three weighted embeddings, GloVe shows the highest cosine similarity score for selected users UserId-68 and UserId-122.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Ensemble Model for Drug Recommendation with Sentiment Analysis from Textual Reviews
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The usage of online recommender systems in health-care, pharmaceuticals, and hospitals is growing. Nowadays, the vast majority of consumers research potential prescriptions online before consulting their doctors for a variety of medical issues. Modern drug recommendation systems frequently pay no attention to the unique needs of a patient and don’t wait for the expectations of the patient. To this, we propose a novel hybrid ensemble model that incorporates Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and Sentiment Analysis. The contribution of the TensorFlow/Keras neural network is in drug review analysis for sentiment, meanwhile LightGBM classifier that offers an alternative approach is another part of the network. Besides TextBlob and a dictionary-based annotation approach, machine learning taking place during classification brings value to sentiment analysis. Forecasts of authorities are pooled, weighted by review influence, and clashed to produce drug-specific studies. This multi-faceted strategy is better compartmentalized and tailor to each patient’s needs, taking emotional state into account, thereby patients are able to access more accurate drug advice and healthcare professionals to make informed decision. Qualitative analysis of the efficiency the model will be carried out using the confusion matrices. Thus, by means of the research on hand, we expect the transformation of the drug recommendation system taking into consideration and patient-individualized system, which will contribute to the improvement of healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Modeling of Mitigation Strategies for the Adoption of Industry 4.0: A DEMATEL Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To adopt Industry 4.0 (I4.0), the current study has identified seventeen mitigation strategies and modelled them for calculating priority ranking and categorizing them into effect-and-cause groups by DEMATEL approach. All factors were prioritized and categorized into cause-and-effect groups. Cause strategies have a greater influence than effect strategies. The cause strategies were E5 (Pilot Projects), E4 (Public-Private Partnerships), E10 (Standardization and Interoperability), E11 (Data Privacy Regulations), E13 (Technology Hubs and Innovation Clusters), and E2 (Infrastructure Development). The effect strategies were E1 (Consultation and Advisory Services), E3 (Skill Development Programs), E6 (SME Support), E7 (Awareness Campaigns), E8 (Cybersecurity Measures), E9 (Research and Development), E12 (Financial Incentives), E14 (Government Policy and Support), E15 (Integration of Supply Chains), E16 (Customizable Solutions), and E17 (Long-term Vision and Strategy). Since cause strategies can drive the whole system, industries can pay more attention to them.

articleTitle: Attention based 1-D CNN system for detection of Freezing of gait (FOG) in Parkinsons Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One common clinical symptom seen in Parkinson’s disease (PD) patients is freezing of gait (FOG). It manifests as an irregular gait, marked by abrupt, involuntary stopping of movement during gait episodes. FOG entails a major negative effect on PD patients’ quality of life. In this work, we analyze the movement data that is collected using the lower-back 3D accelerometer worn by the patients during FOG episodes. By employing machine learning methods to classify this data, we aim to accurately detect FOG trends. In particular, we focus on Deep Learning-based techniques, specifically an attention-based 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN), due to their capacity to extract intricate features from unprocessed sensor input. Our results indicate that the proposed model achieves AUC scores of 0.9032 with respect to the TDCSFOG dataset and 0.8682 for the DeFOG dataset, for a combined average AUC of 0.8857. Mean Average Precision (mAP) scores for TDCSFOG and DeFOG reach 0.8388 and 0.779, respectively, for an average of 0.8089, showing the ability of the model to predict FOG occurrences over time. These findings suggest techniques based on Deep Learning enhance FOG detection, allowing clinicians to more effectively tailor treatments and care strategies for Parkinson’s patients, thus enhancing their ability to move and overall well-being.

articleTitle: Real-Time Edge Computing Services for Internet of Things-based Cloud Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) gadgets and cloud-enabled networks has brought about a dramatic growth in the quantity and kinds of programs that require real-time facet computing offerings. Aspect computing is a rising location of allotted computing that methods facts toward the cease person or tool, supplying low-latency responses to operations and analytics. It enables quicker and more dependable facts-extensive applications that can be personalized to consumer alternatives and needs. This paper discusses the design and implementation of real-time edge computing offerings for IoT-primarily based cloud networks, focusing on key components of the device structure, including carrier deployment, aid management, protection, and scalability. Furthermore, the paper describes the usage of area computing for IoT programs, which include video surveillance, domestic automation, and smart town solutions. Subsequently, the paper presents a survey of cutting-edge area computing companies, summarizing their offerings, business models, and services.

articleTitle: L1 Regularization based Fetal Health Analysis Using ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Perinatal mortality is a significant factor in the mortality rate among children under the age of five. One of the main factors contributing to perinatal death is intrapartum difficulties i.e. fetal health issues. Thus, Early detection and monitoring of fetus during maternity cycle is necessary. Fetal health is monitored using a widely used essential tool called Cardiotocography (CTG). CTG is a non-invasive technique used for recording of contractions of uterus and fetal heart beat simultaneously. The present work uses the CTG fetal health dataset. Inter Quartile Range(IQR) method is used to remove outliers present in the dataset. Addressing class imbalance, Random Over Sampler technique is employed to ensure equal class distribution. The dataset consists of 21 attributes used in the measurement of FHR and UC. These 21 attributes or features helps the model to classify the data as normal, suspect or pathological. This paper is on the study of highly performing algorithms of machine learning, such as K-Nearest Neighbors, SVM, Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, AdaBoost and Extra Tree Classifier. Moreover to enhance model interpretability and efficiency feature selection using L1 Regularization (LASSO Regression) is used which retained only relevant features. Extra Tree Classifier emerged best amongst other models and achieved astonishing accuracy of $99.56 \%$.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Pulmonary Embolism from CT Pulmonary Angiogram by Using Deep Transfer Learning and Sobel Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) indicates a blood thrombus that travels toward the lungs and can lead to significant morbidity and mortality. Thus, early diagnosis and treatments are crucial. An efficient PE detection mechanism can improve radiologists’ productivity by helping to prioritize critical cases and speed up at-risk patient diagnoses. The standard mechanism for diagnosing PE is the chest computed tomography pulmonary angiogram (CTPA) images. A subset of 15000 samples, including normal and PE-positive lung CTPA images were taken from the largest multinational publicly available RSNA-PE-CT dataset for our purpose. Noise and spatial aliasing in CTPA images can make it challenging to discern boundaries between different anatomical structures or abnormalities; therefore, an edge detection filter (Sobel) was deployed to remove noise and highlight the edges in the original image. In this study, PE in lung CTPA image is detected using deep transfer learning models, which utilize Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a widely used deep learning (DL) technique. All selected models were trained and validated by adjusting the hyperparameters, which included the layers, loss function, activation function, rate of learning, and epoch number. Nonetheless, compared to other CNN-based frameworks such as MobileNetV2, Xception, InceptionV3, and ResNet50, the customized Sobel Filter-based DenseNet169 (SF-DenseNet169) model performs better. The SF-DenseNet169 model obtained the maximum training accuracy (97.32%) and validation accuracy (96.67%) with minimal loss. As a result, we propose the improved SF-DenseNet169 model to be the effective and reliable means to diagnose PE-positive patients automatically.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Fuzzy Logic Techniques for Improving Ad-Hoc Wireless Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper examines fuzzy good judgment strategies as a probable strategy for enhancing the safety of Wi-Fi networks. It analyzes the contemporary protection methods, inclusive of encryption algorithms, authentication techniques, and distributed get right of entry to manage frameworks, and contrasts them with fuzzy logic techniques. It then explains the important thing characteristics of the two strategies and opinions on the primary software areas wherein fuzzy good judgment strategies may be used to increase ad-hoc Wi-Fi safety. Subsequently, the paper concludes by summarizing the potential advantages and boundaries of fuzzy common sense technologies for enhancing ad-hoc wireless network protection.

articleTitle: Perception To Application Layer: A Critical Review On Vulnerability Assessment Of Iot Device
publicationTitle: 2024 15th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study highlights the complexities and importance of safeguarding Internet of Things (IoT) networks, spotlighting the pivotal role of vulnerability assessments. As IoT devices are the backbone across diverse sectors, securing their interconnected web is crucial. This paper traverses the trajectory of vulnerability assessments, revealing how they evolve to combat the escalating security challenges within the IoT landscape. Employing a blend of literature review, analytical case explorations, and evaluation of modern assessment methodologies, the presented study unveils the essential requirement of a multilayer approach in these assessments. The fusion of this study demonstrates that preventive and iterative assessment strategies, boosted by collaborative industry efforts, are vital to secure IoT systems against complex threats, thereby ensuring the integrity and resilience of these digital infrastructures.
